attributes.description: Phone number of the guarantor's employer. Used in self-pay collection processes and financial counseling to verify employment status and facilitate payment arrangements.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment status of the guarantor. Used in financial assistance (charity care) eligibility determination, payment plan structuring, and self-pay collection risk stratification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employed_full_time|employed_part_time|self_employed|unemployed|retired|student|disabled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; CMS Financial Assistance Policy Guidelines

attributes.name: estatement_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has consented to receive electronic billing statements (e-statements) via email or patient portal in lieu of paper statements. Supports paperless billing initiatives and reduces statement delivery costs in RCM.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; Epic MyChart — Patient Portal; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: federal_poverty_level_pct
attributes.description: Calculated Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage for the guarantor's household based on annual income and household size. Determines eligibility tier for financial assistance programs, charity care, and sliding-scale discounts per ACA Section 501(r) and CMS guidelines.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); HHS Federal Poverty Guidelines; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: financial_assistance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the guarantor's financial assistance (charity care) application. Drives billing hold, discount application, and collection suspension workflows in the RCM system. Supports ACA Section 501(r) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: financial_assistance_type
attributes.description: Type of financial assistance program approved or applied for by the guarantor. Determines the discount percentage, payment schedule, and billing workflow applied to the account. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charity_care|sliding_scale|payment_plan|hardship|medicaid_pending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; Epic Resolute HB — Financial Assistance

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the guarantor individual. Used in billing correspondence, patient financial counseling communications, and self-pay collection outreach. Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA when linked to patient account data.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor indicating whether the responsible party is the patient themselves, a family member, a legal guardian, an estate, or an organization. Determines billing workflow routing and financial counseling approach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|parent|spouse|legal_guardian|estate|organization — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Type; Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Classification

attributes.name: home_phone
attributes.description: Home telephone number of the guarantor. Primary contact channel for billing inquiries, financial counseling outreach, and self-pay collection calls. Stored in compliance with HIPAA and Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the guarantor's household. Used in conjunction with annual income to determine Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage for financial assistance (charity care) eligibility and sliding-scale fee calculations.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); HHS Federal Poverty Guidelines; CMS Financial Assistance Policy

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family) name of the guarantor individual. Used in billing correspondence, collection letters, and identity verification for patient financial services.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the most recent payment received from the guarantor in USD. Used alongside last_payment_date for payment plan compliance monitoring, collection risk assessment, and RCM reporting.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment History; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from the guarantor toward the outstanding account balance. Used in collection aging analysis, payment plan compliance monitoring, and bad debt risk stratification.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment History; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent billing statement was generated and sent to the guarantor. Used to track billing cycle compliance, manage statement frequency, and support collection escalation timelines in RCM.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Statement Management; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the guarantor individual. Supports identity verification and disambiguation in patient accounting and self-pay collection workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number of the guarantor. Supports SMS billing notifications, payment reminders, and collection outreach. Consent for text messaging must be captured separately per TCPA requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization acting as guarantor when the responsible party is a business entity, estate, or institution rather than an individual. Populated when guarantor_type is 'organization' or 'estate'.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Organization; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: payment_plan_amount
attributes.description: Agreed monthly payment amount under the guarantor's active payment plan arrangement in USD. Used by RCM billing staff to monitor payment plan compliance and trigger collection escalation if payments are missed.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment Plans; Cerner Revenue Cycle; FDCPA

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has an active payment plan arrangement for the outstanding account balance. When True, collection activities are suspended and the account follows the payment plan schedule in the RCM system.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment Plans; Cerner Revenue Cycle; FDCPA

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address. Used for billing statement delivery, collection correspondence, and geographic segmentation in patient financial analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS ZIP Code Standards

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Guarantor's preferred method of contact for billing statements, payment reminders, and financial counseling communications. Drives outreach channel selection in RCM workflows and patient financial services.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Preferences; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522

attributes.name: relationship_to_patient
attributes.description: Describes the guarantor's relationship to the patient as defined in the EHR patient accounting module. Used for financial counseling, billing correspondence, and HIPAA-compliant disclosure of account information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|sibling|grandparent|legal_guardian|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Relationship; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502; HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson

attributes.name: responsibility_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total patient account balance for which this guarantor is financially responsible. Supports scenarios where multiple guarantors share responsibility for a single patient account (e.g., divorced parents of a minor patient). Value range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Responsibility; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: since_date
attributes.description: Date on which the individual or organization was first established as the financial guarantor for the patient account. Marks the effective start of financial responsibility and is used in RCM aging analysis and financial counseling workflows.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Account; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has provided explicit written consent to receive SMS/text message billing notifications and payment reminders. Required for TCPA compliance before sending automated text messages to the guarantor's mobile phone.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; FCC TCPA Regulations; Epic Resolute HB — Communication Preferences

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the guarantor record was sourced (e.g., Epic Resolute HB, Cerner Revenue Cycle, MEDITECH Expanse). Supports data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and audit trail requirements in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Epic Resolute HB; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: ssn_masked
attributes.description: Masked Social Security Number (SSN) of the guarantor, displaying only the last four digits (format: XXX-XX-NNNN). Used for identity verification in self-pay collections, financial assistance screening, and credit bureau reporting. Full SSN must never be stored in the Silver layer per HIPAA and PCI DSS data minimization requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; IRS Publication 1075

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Used for billing correspondence, state-specific financial assistance program eligibility, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS State Abbreviations; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantor record was most recently modified in the patient accounting system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail requirements, and Silver layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Work telephone number of the guarantor. Used as an alternate contact channel for billing and collection communications when home phone is unavailable. Stored in compliance with HIPAA and TCPA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

products.name: emergency_contact
products.description: Patient emergency contact records capturing contact name, relationship type, priority order, phone numbers (home, mobile, work), address, and authorization level (e.g., authorized to receive PHI, healthcare proxy, legal guardian). Supports EMTALA compliance, care coordination, and discharge planning workflows. Sourced from Epic and Cerner registration modules.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson Resource — EMTALA Contact Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the emergency contact record in the Master Patient Index (MPI) system. Primary key for the emergency_contact data product.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient for whom this emergency contact is registered. Links to the patient master record in the Master Patient Index (MPI).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.patient; Epic Registration Module

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the emergency contact's residence. Used for written correspondence, legal notifications, and discharge planning documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the emergency contact (e.g., apartment number, suite, unit). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of residence for the emergency contact. Used in conjunction with state and postal code for complete address resolution and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the patient provided consent to designate this individual as an emergency contact and/or authorized recipient of PHI. Required for HIPAA audit trails and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); OCR HIPAA Guidance; TJC RI.01.03.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member (e.g., registration clerk, nurse) who obtained the patient's consent to designate this emergency contact. Supports HIPAA audit trail requirements and accountability in the registration workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); OCR HIPAA Guidance; TJC RI.01.03.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the emergency contact record. Active = currently valid and reachable; Inactive = no longer applicable (e.g., relationship ended); Deceased = contact has died; Unverified = contact information has not been confirmed with the patient.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.active; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's role relative to the patient. Determines the scope of authority and notification priority. Values include emergency_contact (general notification), healthcare_proxy (authorized to make medical decisions), legal_guardian (legal authority over patient), authorized_representative (authorized to receive PHI per HIPAA), next_of_kin (biological/legal family), guarantor (financial responsibility). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_contact|healthcare_proxy|legal_guardian|authorized_representative|next_of_kin|guarantor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.relationship; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510; Epic Registration

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the emergency contact's address. Supports international patients and contacts residing outside the United States.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.country

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, HIPAA compliance, and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); HITRUST CSF Control 09.ab; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Epic Registration

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this emergency contact designation is no longer valid (e.g., divorce, death of contact, revocation by patient). Null indicates the contact is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.period.end; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this emergency contact designation is considered valid and active. Supports temporal validity tracking for contact records, particularly when contacts change over time (e.g., new spouse, new guardian).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.period.start; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the emergency contact. Used for non-urgent communications, appointment notifications, and electronic delivery of care summaries or discharge instructions where PHI authorization permits.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HITECH Act; Epic MyChart Registration

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given (first) name of the emergency contact individual. Used for identification and communication during care coordination and emergency notification workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName.given; Epic Registration

attributes.name: healthcare_proxy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has been designated as the patient's healthcare proxy (durable power of attorney for healthcare decisions). When True, this individual is legally authorized to make medical decisions on behalf of the patient if the patient is incapacitated. Distinct from phi_disclosure_authorized.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510; State Health Proxy Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: home_phone
attributes.description: Residential landline phone number for the emergency contact. Used as a secondary contact channel when mobile phone is unavailable. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: interpreter_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a professional interpreter is required when communicating with this emergency contact. Supports compliance with Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) language access requirements and TJC communication standards.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; TJC RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Registration

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family (last) name of the emergency contact individual. Used in conjunction with first_name for full identity resolution and communication.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName.family; Epic Registration

attributes.name: legal_guardian_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds legal guardianship over the patient (e.g., parent of a minor, court-appointed guardian for an incapacitated adult). When True, this individual has legal authority over the patient's care decisions and access to medical records.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Guardianship Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: lives_with_patient
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emergency contact resides in the same household as the patient. Relevant for discharge planning, home care coordination, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) assessments.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Reporting; TJC Discharge Planning Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the emergency contact. Supports full legal name resolution and disambiguation when multiple contacts share the same first and last name.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile (cell) phone number for the emergency contact. Preferred channel for urgent notifications and SMS-based communication during emergency and discharge planning workflows. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); Epic Registration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional clinical or administrative notes about this emergency contact (e.g., 'Contact is deaf — use text messaging only', 'Contact travels frequently — try mobile first'). Supports nuanced care coordination and communication planning.
attributes.references: TJC Patient-Centered Communication Standards; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: notification_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has explicitly consented to this contact being notified in the event of an emergency, admission, or discharge. Supports EMTALA compliance and HIPAA-compliant notification workflows.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); Epic Registration

attributes.name: phi_disclosure_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has authorized this contact to receive Protected Health Information (PHI) about their care. Critical for HIPAA compliance — clinical staff must verify this flag before disclosing any PHI to the contact. True = authorized; False = not authorized.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); OCR HIPAA Guidance; Epic Registration

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the emergency contact's address. Supports mail delivery, geographic segmentation, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) analysis.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS ZIP Code Standards; CMS SDOH Reporting

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The contact's preferred communication channel for receiving notifications and messages. Drives automated notification routing in care coordination and discharge planning workflows.
attributes.references: TJC Patient-Centered Communication Standards; TCPA; Epic Registration

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The contact's preferred spoken/written language for communication, expressed as a BCP-47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-CN'). Used to arrange interpreter services and ensure effective communication during emergency notifications and care coordination.
attributes.references: Section 1557 of the ACA (Language Access); TJC RC.02.01.01; HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.communication; CMS Meaningful Access Requirements

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the emergency contact prefers to be called, which may differ from their legal name. Supports patient-centered communication and cultural sensitivity in care coordination.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TJC Patient-Centered Communication Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: priority_order
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the order in which this contact should be notified in an emergency (1 = first contact, 2 = second, etc.). Supports triage and discharge planning workflows where multiple contacts exist for a single patient.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; The Joint Commission (TJC) NPSG.15.01.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: proxy_document_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the proxy authorization document (e.g., durable power of attorney, healthcare proxy form) became legally effective. Used to validate the currency of the authorization during care decisions.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Health Proxy Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01

attributes.name: proxy_document_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the proxy authorization document expires, if applicable. Null indicates the document is open-ended with no expiration. Clinical staff must verify this date before acting on proxy authority.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Health Proxy Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01

attributes.name: proxy_document_type
attributes.description: Type of legal document on file that establishes this contact's authority as a healthcare proxy or legal guardian. Required for clinical staff to verify decision-making authority before acting on the contact's instructions.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Health Proxy Laws; TJC RI.01.02.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: The personal or familial relationship between the emergency contact and the patient (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling). Used for care coordination, discharge planning, and EMTALA compliance. Distinct from contact_type which captures the legal/functional role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|parent|child|sibling|domestic_partner|grandparent|aunt_uncle|friend|employer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.relationship; EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system from which this emergency contact record was sourced (e.g., Epic Registration, Cerner Millennium). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Master Patient Index (MPI) deduplication workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Provenance Resource; HITRUST CSF; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: source_system_contact_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this emergency contact record in the originating source system (e.g., Epic contact ID, Cerner relationship ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation, ETL traceability, and Health Information Exchange (HIE) matching.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Identifier; HITRUST CSF; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the emergency contact's address. Follows USPS state abbreviation standards. Used for geographic reporting and jurisdictional compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS State Abbreviations; Epic Registration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data loading in the Silver Layer lakehouse architecture.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); HITRUST CSF Control 09.ab; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Epic Registration

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member who last verified the accuracy of this emergency contact's information. Supports accountability and data quality governance in the patient registration process.
attributes.references: TJC RC.01.02.01; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Registration

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the emergency contact's information was verified with the patient or the contact directly. Supports data quality management and ensures contact information is current for emergency use.
attributes.references: TJC RC.01.02.01; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Business or workplace phone number for the emergency contact. Used during daytime hours when the contact may be reached at their place of employment. Stored in E.164 international format.

attributes.name: work_phone_extension
attributes.description: Extension number associated with the contact's work phone. Required for routing calls within large organizations where the contact is employed.

products.name: sdoh_assessment
products.description: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) assessment records capturing screening tool used (AHC HRSN, PRAPARE, Hunger Vital Sign, WHO WHOQOL), assessment date, domain scores (food insecurity, housing instability, transportation, interpersonal safety, financial strain, social isolation), identified needs, referral disposition, and reassessment schedule. Supports population health management, ACO quality reporting, CMS SDOH initiatives, and community health needs assessments. Aligned with HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care implementation guide and Gravity Project value sets. Sourced from population health and care management platforms.
products.reference: CMS SDOH Framework — AHC HRSN Screening Tool — HL7 FHIR Observation (SDOH category)

attributes.name: sdoh_assessment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Assessment ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) assessment record in the patient domain. Primary key for this data product; referenced by downstream clinical, population health, and care management entities.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care Implementation Guide; Gravity Project

attributes.name: assessment_care_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.care_site. Business justification: SDOH assessments occur at specific care sites; required for CMS quality measure reporting (screening rates by facility), care management program operations, and community health needs assessments tied

attributes.name: assessment_loinc_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.loinc_code. Business justification: SDOH screening tools use standardized LOINC codes (e.g., LOINC 96777-8 for housing instability) for interoperability, quality reporting, and CMS/HEDIS measure submission. Enables automated screening t

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician or care team member who administered or documented this SDOH assessment. Used for accountability, workflow routing, and provider-level quality reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Practitioner Resource; CMS MIPS Quality Measures

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient who was administered this SDOH assessment. Links to the master patient record via the Master Patient Index (MPI). This is the primary party reference for this transaction.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient Resource; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CMS SDOH Initiative

attributes.name: fhir_observation_id
attributes.description: The HL7 FHIR Observation resource identifier corresponding to this SDOH assessment record in the source system or Health Information Exchange (HIE). Enables interoperability with FHIR-compliant systems and supports data exchange under the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Observation Resource; CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule (CMS-9115-F); 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter during which this SDOH assessment was administered, if applicable. Supports linkage to the Admit-Discharge-Transfer (ADT) encounter context for population health reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource; Epic Healthy Planet; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: administration_method
attributes.description: Method by which the SDOH screening assessment was administered. 'clinician_administered' indicates face-to-face administration by a care team member; 'self_administered' indicates patient completed independently; 'telephone' indicates phone-based administration; 'electronic_portal' indicates patient portal or kiosk; 'proxy' indicates completed by a caregiver or family member on behalf of the patient.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR QuestionnaireResponse; Gravity Project; Epic MyChart; CMS SDOH Initiative

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SDOH screening assessment was administered to the patient. This is the principal real-world business event date used for population health trending, ACO quality reporting, and CMS SDOH initiative compliance.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; HL7 FHIR Observation.effectiveDateTime; NCQA HEDIS SDOH Measures

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this SDOH assessment record, typically system-generated by the population health or care management platform (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet, Salesforce Health Cloud). Used for cross-system referencing, audit trails, and patient communication.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet; Salesforce Health Cloud; HL7 FHIR Observation Resource

attributes.name: assessment_setting
attributes.description: Clinical or community setting in which the SDOH assessment was conducted. Supports stratification of SDOH findings by care setting for population health management and community health needs assessments (CHNA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|emergency|telehealth|community|home|pharmacy — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes; HL7 FHIR Encounter.class; AHRQ SDOH Compendium

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SDOH assessment record. 'completed' indicates all questions were answered; 'in_progress' indicates partial completion; 'refused' indicates patient declined to participate; 'not_applicable' indicates screening was deemed clinically inappropriate; 'cancelled' indicates the assessment was voided.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR QuestionnaireResponse.status; Gravity Project; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the SDOH assessment was administered or documented in the system. Provides sub-day precision for workflow analytics, care coordination timing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Observation.effectiveDateTime; HIPAA Audit Requirements; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: care_program_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient was enrolled in a care management or population health program as a direct result of this SDOH assessment. Supports ACO quality reporting, HEDIS measure tracking, and population health management program analytics.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS; CMS ACO Quality Reporting; Epic Healthy Planet; Salesforce Health Cloud

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient provided informed consent for SDOH screening and data sharing. Required for HIPAA audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; OCR HIPAA Guidance; HL7 FHIR Consent Resource

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient provided informed consent for SDOH screening and data sharing prior to administration of the assessment. Required for HIPAA compliance and data sharing with community-based organizations under the Gravity Project framework.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; HL7 FHIR Consent Resource; Gravity Project; OCR HIPAA Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDOH assessment record was first created in the source system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage, HIPAA audit trail requirements, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: financial_strain_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient screened positive for financial strain. True indicates a positive screen. Supports financial assistance program referrals, charity care eligibility screening, and population health stratification.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; LOINC 93031-3; CMS SDOH Initiative; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: financial_strain_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the financial strain SDOH domain, reflecting the patient's difficulty meeting basic financial needs including utilities, medical bills, and essential expenses. Aligned with Gravity Project financial insecurity value sets.
attributes.references: Gravity Project Financial Insecurity Value Set; LOINC 93031-3; CMS AHC HRSN

attributes.name: food_insecurity_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient screened positive for food insecurity based on validated threshold scoring. True indicates a positive screen requiring intervention or referral. Used for population health stratification and care management prioritization.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; LOINC 88122-7; CMS SDOH Initiative; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: food_insecurity_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the food insecurity SDOH domain, derived from responses to food security screening questions (e.g., Hunger Vital Sign 2-item screener). Higher scores indicate greater food insecurity risk. Used for ACO quality reporting and community health needs assessment.
attributes.references: Gravity Project Food Insecurity Value Set; LOINC 88122-7; CMS AHC HRSN Screening Tool

attributes.name: housing_instability_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient screened positive for housing instability. True indicates a positive screen. Supports ACO quality reporting, CMS SDOH initiatives, and community health needs assessments.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; LOINC 71802-3; CMS SDOH Initiative

attributes.name: housing_instability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the housing instability SDOH domain, capturing risk of homelessness, housing insecurity, or inadequate housing conditions. Derived from validated screening questions aligned with Gravity Project value sets.
attributes.references: Gravity Project Housing Instability Value Set; LOINC 71802-3; CMS AHC HRSN

attributes.name: icd10_z_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM Z-code (Z55-Z65 range) assigned to document the social determinant of health finding for billing, claims, and quality reporting purposes. Examples include Z59.0 (Homelessness), Z59.4 (Lack of adequate food), Z63.0 (Problems in relationship with spouse). Required for CMS SDOH quality measure reporting and value-based care programs.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Z55-Z65 Social Determinants Codes; CMS SDOH Initiative; WHO ICD-10; AMA CPT; Gravity Project

attributes.name: identified_needs_summary
attributes.description: Free-text or structured narrative summarizing the specific social needs identified during this assessment. Documents the patient's expressed needs and priorities as captured by the administering clinician or care team member. Supports clinical documentation and care plan development.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care IG; Gravity Project; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: interpersonal_safety_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient screened positive for interpersonal safety concerns. True indicates a positive screen. Triggers mandatory reporting workflows and care management escalation per facility policy and applicable state law.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; LOINC 95618-5; EMTALA; State Mandatory Reporting Laws; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.512

attributes.name: interpersonal_safety_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the interpersonal safety SDOH domain, capturing exposure to domestic violence, intimate partner violence, or unsafe living conditions. Derived from validated screening questions per Gravity Project value sets.
attributes.references: Gravity Project Interpersonal Safety Value Set; LOINC 95618-5; CMS AHC HRSN; EMTALA

attributes.name: interpreter_used_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a professional interpreter (in-person or telephonic) was used during the SDOH assessment administration. Supports health equity reporting and Section 1557 ACA language access compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; CMS Health Equity Initiatives; The Joint Commission Language Access Standards

attributes.name: language_of_administration
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which the SDOH assessment was administered (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish). Supports health equity reporting, language access compliance, and population health stratification by preferred language.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; CMS Health Equity Initiatives; Section 1557 ACA Language Access Requirements; HL7 FHIR

attributes.name: loinc_panel_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) Panel Code
attributes.description: LOINC code identifying the specific SDOH screening panel administered (e.g., 93025-5 for PRAPARE, 96777-8 for AHC HRSN). Enables standardized clinical data exchange, EHR interoperability, and alignment with national SDOH coding standards.
attributes.references: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes); Regenstrief Institute; Gravity Project; HL7 FHIR

attributes.name: overall_risk_level
attributes.description: Clinician or algorithm-assigned overall SDOH risk stratification level based on the combination of domain scores and positive flags. Drives care management program enrollment, outreach prioritization, and community health worker assignment.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; NCQA HEDIS; ACO Quality Reporting; Epic Healthy Planet Risk Stratification

attributes.name: reassessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next SDOH reassessment based on clinical protocol, risk level, or care management program requirements. Drives outreach scheduling and population health management workflows in Epic Healthy Planet and Salesforce Health Cloud.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; NCQA HEDIS; ACO Quality Reporting; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: reassessment_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between this assessment and the scheduled reassessment, as defined by the applicable care management protocol or clinical guideline. Common intervals include 90, 180, or 365 days depending on risk level and program requirements.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; NCQA HEDIS; ACO Quality Reporting

attributes.name: referral_closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SDOH referral was closed, either due to successful resource connection, patient declination, or inability to contact. Supports referral loop closure tracking required by CMS SDOH initiatives and ACO quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; Gravity Project; HL7 FHIR Task Resource

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the referral to a community resource or social service was placed following identification of SDOH needs. Used for care coordination timeliness tracking and ACO quality measure reporting.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; HL7 FHIR ServiceRequest Resource; Gravity Project

attributes.name: referral_disposition
attributes.description: Outcome disposition indicating whether the patient was referred to community resources or social services based on identified SDOH needs. 'referred' indicates active referral placed; 'declined_referral' indicates patient declined offered resources; 'no_needs_identified' indicates no positive screens; 'pending' indicates referral decision in progress; 'self_managed' indicates patient managing independently.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care IG; Gravity Project; CMS SDOH Initiative; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: referral_organization
attributes.description: Name of the community-based organization (CBO), social service agency, or health-related social needs resource to which the patient was referred. Supports community health needs assessment (CHNA) reporting and ACO community partnership tracking.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; Gravity Project; HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care IG; 2-1-1 Referral Network

attributes.name: referral_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the SDOH referral indicating whether the patient was successfully connected to the referred community resource. 'connected' indicates successful resource engagement; 'not_connected' indicates referral was unsuccessful; 'in_progress' indicates outreach ongoing; 'declined' indicates patient declined; 'unable_to_reach' indicates patient could not be contacted.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; CMS SDOH Initiative; HL7 FHIR Task.status; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: screening_tool_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the validated SDOH screening instrument used for this assessment. Supported tools include: AHC HRSN (Accountable Health Communities Health-Related Social Needs), PRAPARE (Protocol for Responding to and Assessing Patients' Assets, Risks, and Experiences), Hunger Vital Sign, WHO WHOQOL, WellCare, iScreen, and Other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AHC_HRSN|PRAPARE|HUNGER_VITAL_SIGN|WHOQOL|WELLCARE|ISCREEN|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Gravity Project SDOH Value Sets; HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care IG; CMS AHC Model; LOINC Panel Codes

attributes.name: screening_tool_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SDOH screening instrument used (e.g., 'Accountable Health Communities Health-Related Social Needs Screening Tool', 'PRAPARE', 'Hunger Vital Sign'). Complements the code for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; CMS SDOH Initiative; AHRQ SDOH Compendium

attributes.name: screening_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number or edition of the screening instrument used (e.g., '2019', 'v2.0'). Important for longitudinal comparability and regulatory reporting as tool versions may change question sets and scoring algorithms.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; LOINC Versioning; HL7 FHIR Questionnaire Resource

attributes.name: snomed_finding_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNOMED CT Social Determinant Finding Code
attributes.description: SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms) code representing the primary social determinant finding identified in this assessment. Supports clinical documentation, problem list coding, and interoperability with FHIR-based systems per Gravity Project value sets.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT; Gravity Project SDOH Value Sets; HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care IG; NLM Value Set Authority Center

attributes.name: social_isolation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient screened positive for social isolation. True indicates a positive screen. Supports care management program enrollment and community resource referral.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; WHO WHOQOL; LOINC 93029-7; CMS SDOH Initiative

attributes.name: social_isolation_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the social isolation SDOH domain, measuring the patient's level of social connectedness and risk of loneliness. Derived from validated screening questions aligned with Gravity Project and WHO WHOQOL social domain.
attributes.references: Gravity Project Social Connection Value Set; WHO WHOQOL Social Domain; LOINC 93029-7

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this SDOH assessment record was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL audit, and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer. Common sources include Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner PowerChart, and Salesforce Health Cloud.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; Salesforce Health Cloud; MEDITECH Expanse; HL7 FHIR

attributes.name: total_positive_domains
attributes.description: Count of SDOH domains for which the patient screened positive in this assessment. Ranges from 0 to the total number of domains assessed. Used for risk stratification, care management prioritization, and population health reporting. This is a raw count field, not a derived aggregate metric.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Initiative; Gravity Project; NCQA HEDIS; ACO Quality Reporting

attributes.name: transportation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the patient screened positive for transportation barriers. True indicates a positive screen requiring care coordination or community resource referral.
attributes.references: Gravity Project; LOINC 93030-5; CMS SDOH Initiative

attributes.name: transportation_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the transportation barrier SDOH domain, reflecting the patient's difficulty accessing healthcare services, food, or employment due to lack of reliable transportation. Aligned with Gravity Project transportation value sets.
attributes.references: Gravity Project Transportation Value Set; LOINC 93030-5; CMS AHC HRSN

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDOH assessment record was last modified in the source system. Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer, audit trail compliance, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

products.name: preference
products.description: Patient care and communication preferences capturing preferred language for care, interpreter needs, preferred communication channel (phone, portal, mail, text), preferred pharmacy, PCP preference, care setting preferences, accessibility needs (hearing, vision, mobility), cultural and religious care preferences, and patient portal enrollment status. Supports patient-centered care delivery, CAHPS survey performance, and health equity initiatives. Sourced from EHR registration and patient engagement platforms.
products.reference: CAHPS Patient Experience Standards — HL7 FHIR Patient.communication

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Primary key for preference

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient's preferred care facility or clinic location for scheduling outpatient appointments and follow-up care. Used in Epic Cadence and Cerner Millennium to default scheduling to the patient's preferred location.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.managingOrganization; Epic Cadence

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient's designated Primary Care Physician (PCP). Used for care coordination, referral management, and attribution in value-based care programs such as ACO, HMO, and MIPS. Sourced from Epic EHR registration and Salesforce Health Cloud.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Program; NCQA HEDIS; MACRA/MIPS; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.generalPractitioner

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient master record for whom these care and communication preferences are recorded. Links to the patient master identity record.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource

attributes.name: preference_pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient's preferred pharmacy for prescription fulfillment. Used by Epic Willow and Cerner PharmNet to route electronic prescriptions (e-prescribing) to the patient's designated pharmacy. Supports medication adherence and care coordination.
attributes.references: Surescripts E-Prescribing Standards; DEA 21 CFR Part 1300; HL7 FHIR R4 MedicationRequest

attributes.name: preference_preferred_pharmacy_pharmacy_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Preference Preferred Pharmacy Pharmacy Location Id
attributes.description: FK to pharmacy.location

attributes.name: advance_directive_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has a completed advance directive (e.g., living will, healthcare proxy, POLST) on file with the health system. Triggers clinical alerts in Epic ClinDoc and Cerner PowerChart to ensure care team awareness. Required for CMS Conditions of Participation documentation.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §489.102; The Joint Commission RI.01.05.01; Patient Self-Determination Act

attributes.name: appointment_reminder_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has opted in to receive automated appointment reminders via their preferred communication channel. Drives reminder workflows in Epic Cadence and Cerner Millennium scheduling. Supports no-show reduction and patient access metrics.
attributes.references: TCPA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; Epic Cadence Scheduling Module

attributes.name: care_management_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has consented to enrollment in care management or disease management programs (e.g., chronic disease management, transitional care, ACO care coordination). Drives population health outreach in Epic Healthy Planet and Salesforce Health Cloud.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Care Management (CCM) Billing; NCQA HEDIS; ACO Program Requirements; MACRA/MIPS

attributes.name: care_setting_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred care delivery setting for non-emergency services. Informs care team routing, scheduling, and population health outreach strategies. 'ed' indicates Emergency Department (ED) preference for urgent needs. Supports health equity and SDOH analysis.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Framework; CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP); NCQA HEDIS; HL7 FHIR R4

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Patient's preferred channel for receiving appointment reminders, care instructions, test results, and general health communications. Drives outreach workflows in Epic MyChart, Salesforce Health Cloud, and patient engagement platforms. Supports CAHPS patient experience measurement.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.telecom; NCQA HEDIS; CMS Meaningful Use

attributes.name: communication_time_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred time of day for receiving outbound communications such as appointment reminders, care management calls, and health coaching outreach. Used by care coordinators and automated outreach systems to optimize contact rates.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CAHPS Survey Framework; Salesforce Health Cloud Engagement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patient preference record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA accounting of disclosures. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 8601; SOC 2 Type II; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: cultural_care_preference
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of cultural practices, beliefs, or traditions that should be respected during care delivery. Examples include gender-concordant provider preference, traditional healing practices, or specific cultural rituals. Supports culturally competent care and CLAS Standards compliance.
attributes.references: HHS National CLAS Standards; The Joint Commission Patient Rights (RI.01.01.01); NCQA Health Equity Accreditation

attributes.name: dietary_preference
attributes.description: Patient's dietary preferences or restrictions relevant to inpatient meal planning and nutritional care (e.g., vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free, diabetic diet). Sourced from EHR registration and nursing assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vegetarian|vegan|halal|kosher|gluten_free|diabetic|low_sodium|renal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Nutrition Care Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; AHRQ Patient Safety

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that the patient has requested no outbound contact from the health system for non-clinical communications. When true, suppresses all marketing, outreach, and non-essential communications. Must be honored per HIPAA Right to Restrict and TCPA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522 (Right to Restrict); TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: education_material_format
attributes.description: Patient's preferred format for receiving health education materials, discharge instructions, and care plan documents. Drives document generation and delivery in Epic ClinDoc and patient engagement platforms. Supports health literacy and accessibility compliance.
attributes.references: AHRQ Health Literacy; The Joint Commission Patient Education Standards (PC.02.03.01); HHS CLAS Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this set of patient care and communication preferences is considered active and applicable. Enables temporal tracking of preference changes over time and supports preference versioning.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; Epic EHR Registration; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.526 (Amendment)

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this set of patient care and communication preferences expires or is superseded. Null indicates the preferences are open-ended and currently active. Supports preference versioning and historical audit.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; Epic EHR Registration; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.526

attributes.name: gender_concordant_provider
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has expressed a preference to receive care from a provider of the same gender. Used in scheduling and provider assignment workflows to honor patient preferences and support culturally sensitive care delivery.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Patient Rights Standards; CLAS Standards; NCQA Health Equity Accreditation

attributes.name: health_literacy_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the patient's health literacy level, indicating their ability to understand health information, medication instructions, and care plans. Informs the complexity and format of patient education materials. Supports SDOH analysis and health equity initiatives.
attributes.references: AHRQ Health Literacy Universal Precautions Toolkit; HHS National CLAS Standards; NCQA Health Equity Accreditation

attributes.name: hearing_accommodation
attributes.description: Specific hearing-related accessibility accommodation required by the patient during clinical encounters and communications. Drives accommodation scheduling and facility preparation. Supports ADA compliance and CLAS Standards.
attributes.references: ADA Title III; Section 504 Rehabilitation Act; HHS National CLAS Standards; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: interpreter_needed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient requires professional interpreter services for clinical encounters. When true, triggers interpreter scheduling workflows in Epic Cadence and Cerner Millennium scheduling modules. Supports compliance with Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; HHS National CLAS Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) Language Access Standards

attributes.name: interpreter_type
attributes.description: Specifies the modality of interpreter service preferred or required by the patient. 'sign_language' indicates American Sign Language (ASL) or other signed language interpreter. Informs scheduling and resource allocation in Epic Cadence.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; HHS National CLAS Standards; ADA Title III

attributes.name: last_verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member, system, or patient who last verified and confirmed the accuracy of the preference record. Supports audit trail and accountability for preference data quality.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.526; The Joint Commission Documentation Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient's preferences were last reviewed and confirmed as current by the patient or a designated representative. Supports preference currency tracking and drives re-verification workflows at registration. Aligns with CMS patient engagement requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission Patient Rights; NCQA HEDIS Patient Experience

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has opted in to receive health system marketing communications, wellness newsletters, and promotional health content. Distinct from clinical communications. Governed by HIPAA marketing rules and CAN-SPAM Act.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(e) Marketing; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA

attributes.name: mobility_accommodation
attributes.description: Specific mobility-related accessibility accommodation required by the patient for facility navigation, exam room setup, and transport. Informs facility preparation and scheduling in Epic Cadence. Supports ADA compliance.
attributes.references: ADA Title III; The Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number assigned by the facility to uniquely identify the patient within the health system. Used to correlate preferences with clinical and financial records in Epic EHR and Cerner Millennium.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: notification_email
attributes.description: Email address designated by the patient for receiving healthcare notifications, appointment reminders, and portal communications. May differ from the primary contact email on the patient master record. Governed by HIPAA and CAN-SPAM.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; CAN-SPAM Act; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.telecom

attributes.name: notification_phone
attributes.description: Phone number designated by the patient for receiving healthcare notifications, appointment reminders, and care team calls. Expressed in E.164 international format. Governed by TCPA for automated outreach.
attributes.references: TCPA; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.telecom

attributes.name: organ_donation_status
attributes.description: Patient's registered organ and tissue donation preference. Sourced from state donor registries and patient registration. Required for CMS Conditions of Participation and UNOS reporting. Informs clinical teams during end-of-life care planning.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.45; UNOS Policy; National Organ Transplant Act (NOTA)

attributes.name: portal_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is actively enrolled in the patient portal (e.g., Epic MyChart). Portal enrollment enables secure messaging, online scheduling, test result viewing, and medication refill requests. Tracked for CMS Meaningful Use and patient engagement metrics.
attributes.references: CMS Meaningful Use / Promoting Interoperability; 21st Century Cures Act; ONC Interoperability Rule

attributes.name: portal_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient first activated and enrolled in the patient portal. Used to calculate portal engagement duration and for CMS Promoting Interoperability reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Promoting Interoperability Program; 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: preference_source
attributes.description: Source channel or system through which the patient's preferences were captured or last updated. Supports data provenance, audit, and quality assessment. Values align with operational systems including Epic MyChart portal, Salesforce Health Cloud, and EHR registration workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: patient_portal|registration_staff|care_team|phone|mail|ehr_import|health_cloud — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.526; ONC Interoperability Rule; 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the patient preference record. 'active' indicates preferences are current and in use; 'superseded' indicates a newer version exists; 'pending_review' indicates patient-submitted preferences awaiting staff validation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; Epic EHR Registration Module

attributes.name: preferred_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the patient's preferred contact person for care coordination communications, appointment reminders, and non-emergency notifications. May be a family member, caregiver, or healthcare proxy. Distinct from the emergency contact on the patient master record.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b) (Disclosure to Family); The Joint Commission Patient Rights; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: preferred_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the preferred contact person to the patient. Used to determine appropriate disclosure scope under HIPAA and to contextualize care coordination communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|sibling|caregiver|legal_guardian|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson; The Joint Commission Patient Rights

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The patient's preferred spoken and written language for receiving healthcare services, clinical instructions, and communications. Expressed as an ISO 639-1 or BCP-47 language code (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-TW'). Drives interpreter service requests and multilingual document generation. Required for CLAS Standards compliance and CAHPS survey performance.
attributes.references: HHS National CLAS Standards; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.communication; NCQA HEDIS; Section 1557 ACA

attributes.name: religious_preference
attributes.description: Patient's religious or spiritual affiliation relevant to care delivery, chaplaincy services, dietary restrictions, and end-of-life planning. Informs culturally sensitive care and chaplain referrals. Stored as free text or standardized code per facility policy. Supports CAHPS patient experience and health equity initiatives.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Patient Rights Standards (RI.01.01.01); CMS Conditions of Participation; CLAS Standards

attributes.name: research_participation_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has consented to be contacted for clinical research studies and trials. Drives patient recruitment workflows in research management systems. Supports IRB-compliant research operations and HIPAA Authorization requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508 (Authorization); 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); FDA 21 CFR Part 50; IRB Standards

attributes.name: sdoh_screening_consent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Screening Consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has consented to Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) screening and data collection, including housing, food security, transportation, and social support assessments. Required for NCQA Health Equity Accreditation and CMS SDOH initiatives.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Strategy; NCQA Health Equity Accreditation; ICD-10-CM Z Codes (Z55-Z65); HL7 FHIR SDOH Clinical Care IG

attributes.name: surrogate_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has designated a surrogate decision maker (healthcare proxy, power of attorney for healthcare) to make medical decisions on their behalf. Triggers documentation workflows in Epic ClinDoc. Required for CMS Conditions of Participation.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §489.102; Patient Self-Determination Act; The Joint Commission RI.01.05.01

attributes.name: telehealth_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has provided informed consent to receive care via telehealth modalities. Required before scheduling virtual visits in Epic Cadence or Cerner Millennium. Supports compliance with state telehealth consent laws and CMS telehealth billing requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; State Telehealth Consent Laws; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; AMA CPT Telehealth Codes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patient preference record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and HIPAA audit requirements. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 8601; SOC 2 Type II; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: vision_accommodation
attributes.description: Specific vision-related accessibility accommodation required by the patient for clinical materials, consent forms, and communications. Ensures accessible health information delivery per ADA and Section 508 requirements.
attributes.references: ADA Title III; Section 508 Rehabilitation Act; HHS National CLAS Standards

products.name: pcp_attribution
products.description: Patient attribution to Primary Care Physician (PCP) or care team records capturing attributed provider NPI, attribution method (claims-based, enrollment-based, manual), attribution panel, attribution effective and end dates, ACO/HMO/PPO plan attribution, and attribution confidence score. SSOT for care team assignment used in population health, HEDIS, MIPS, and value-based care reporting. Sourced from population health management and payer attribution feeds.
products.reference: CMS Attribution Methodology — NCQA HEDIS Attribution Rules — ACO Attribution

attributes.name: pcp_attribution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each PCP attribution record in the Master Patient Index (MPI) attribution registry. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins across population health, HEDIS, and value-based care reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: aco_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Accountable Care Organization (ACO) record when the attribution is governed by an ACO participation agreement. Required for CMS Shared Savings Program (MSSP) and Next Generation ACO attribution reporting and shared savings calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) Final Rule; CMS ACO Attribution Methodology

attributes.name: attributed_specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: PCP attribution requires tracking the specialty of the attributed provider for network adequacy reporting, panel composition analysis, primary care vs specialist attribution rules, and risk-adjusted q

attributes.name: attribution_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider panel or patient panel record to which this attribution belongs. A panel represents the defined roster of patients assigned to a PCP or care team for population health management, capacity planning, and value-based care performance measurement.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet Panel Management

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary care facility or clinic where the attributed PCP practices and where the patient receives primary care services. Used for facility-level population health reporting, capacity planning, and geographic attribution analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; HL7 FHIR Location Resource; The Joint Commission Facility Standards

attributes.name: care_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the care team record when attribution is assigned to a multidisciplinary care team rather than a single PCP. Supports Accountable Care Organization (ACO) and Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) attribution models where team-based care is the unit of attribution.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Attribution Methodology; HL7 FHIR CareTeam Resource; NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician record for the Primary Care Physician (PCP) or care team lead to whom the patient is attributed. Used to resolve provider demographics, specialty, and panel capacity from the provider domain.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; HL7 FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient record in the Master Patient Index (MPI). Links the attribution record to the attributed patient's demographic and identity data. Every clinical and financial domain references this identifier.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Patient Resource

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer insurance plan record associated with this attribution. Attribution rules and measurement periods vary by plan type (ACO, HMO, PPO, POS). Links to the billing and revenue cycle domain for plan-specific attribution logic.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS-1500 Claim Form

attributes.name: aco_contract_number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract number for the Accountable Care Organization (ACO) governing this attribution. Required for CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) reporting, shared savings reconciliation, and regulatory submissions to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) Final Rule 42 CFR Part 425

attributes.name: attributed_provider_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the attributed Primary Care Physician (PCP) or care team lead as registered with the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES). Required for HEDIS, MIPS, and CMS value-based care reporting submissions.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; NPPES; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: attribution_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the statistical confidence level of the attribution assignment. Higher scores indicate stronger evidence of the patient-PCP relationship based on visit frequency, claims history, or enrollment data. Used to prioritize manual review of low-confidence attributions and to weight population health analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Population Health Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to assign the patient to the PCP or care team. Claims-based attribution uses historical utilization patterns; enrollment-based uses payer plan enrollment data; manual is provider-assigned; algorithm-based uses predictive models; hybrid combines multiple methods; empanelment is practice-panel assignment. Drives HEDIS, MIPS, and ACO reporting logic.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA MIPS Attribution Rules

attributes.name: attribution_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason when an attribution assignment has been manually overridden from the algorithm-generated or payer-assigned attribution. Documents the clinical or administrative justification for the override, supporting audit trails and compliance with CMS and NCQA attribution integrity requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank (1 = primary) when a patient has multiple concurrent attribution records across different payers or plans. Rank 1 designates the primary PCP attribution used for population health management and HEDIS reporting. Higher ranks indicate secondary or supplemental attributions.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: attribution_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or completed date for the next periodic review of this attribution record. Attribution records are reviewed quarterly or annually per payer contract requirements to ensure accuracy of panel rosters and compliance with HEDIS and MIPS reporting periods.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_segment
attributes.description: Insurance coverage segment of the attributed patient. Determines applicable attribution methodology, quality measure set, and regulatory reporting requirements. Dual eligible patients (Medicare and Medicaid) require special attribution handling per CMS duals coordination rules.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare-Medicaid Coordination Office; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this attribution record was sourced. Identifies whether the attribution originated from Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner Millennium, a payer attribution feed, manual entry, HL7 FHIR interface, or a population health management platform. Critical for data lineage and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Provenance Resource; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: attribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PCP attribution record. Active indicates a current, valid attribution; pending indicates awaiting confirmation; disputed indicates a payer or provider challenge; terminated indicates the attribution period has ended; under_review indicates compliance or audit review in progress.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: care_management_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attributed patient is currently enrolled in a care management or disease management program under the attributed PCP or ACO. True = enrolled in care management. Used for population health program tracking and HEDIS care management measure reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Care Management (CCM) Billing Guidelines; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Quality Measures

attributes.name: consent_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has provided documented consent for their health information to be shared with the attributed PCP, care team, and ACO for care coordination and population health management purposes. Required for HIPAA-compliant data sharing under ACO and HIE participation agreements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.506; CMS ACO Beneficiary Notification Requirements; HL7 FHIR Consent Resource

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PCP attribution record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and compliance with HIPAA audit control standards. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
