attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: data_sharing_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has exercised their right to opt out of data sharing with the ACO or population health program under CMS beneficiary notification and opt-out requirements. True = patient has opted out. Patients who opt out must be excluded from ACO attribution and shared data feeds.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Beneficiary Notification and Opt-Out Requirements 42 CFR Part 425; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522

attributes.name: disenrollment_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for the termination of the PCP attribution. Used for panel management analytics, provider turnover reporting, and population health program evaluation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: provider_change|plan_disenrollment|patient_request|provider_termination|death|moved_out_of_area|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the PCP attribution becomes effective and the patient is considered part of the attributed provider's panel. Used as the start boundary for HEDIS measurement periods, MIPS performance calculations, and ACO shared savings attribution windows.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA Final Rule

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the PCP attribution terminates. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active attribution. Used to calculate attribution duration, panel turnover, and to exclude patients from measurement periods after disenrollment or provider change.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service area associated with this attribution record, typically aligned with CMS Hospital Referral Regions (HRR) or payer-defined service areas. Used for population health geographic analysis, regional quality benchmarking, and ACO regional benchmark calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Referral Region (HRR) Definitions; CMS MSSP Regional Benchmark Methodology

attributes.name: hcc_risk_score
attributes.description: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment score for the attributed patient at the time of attribution. Used in Medicare Advantage and ACO shared savings calculations to adjust expected expenditures for patient complexity. Sourced from CMS risk adjustment data or population health platform.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model; CMS Medicare Advantage Final Rule; CMS MSSP Shared Savings Program

attributes.name: hedis_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribution record qualifies the patient for inclusion in HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) measure calculations for the current measurement year. Eligibility is determined by continuous enrollment criteria, plan type, and attribution method per NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Program

attributes.name: is_primary_attribution
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribution record is the patient's primary PCP attribution used as the single source of truth (SSOT) for population health management, HEDIS measurement, and MIPS performance reporting. True = primary attribution; False = secondary or supplemental attribution.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA MIPS Attribution Rules

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualifying primary care visit between the patient and the attributed PCP within the attribution lookback period. Used to assess recency of the patient-provider relationship and to support attribution validation and panel management.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: lookback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months in the historical claims lookback window used to determine claims-based attribution. Standard values are 12 or 24 months per CMS and NCQA attribution methodologies. Stored to support audit and reproducibility of attribution assignments.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this attribution record is applicable for quality measurement reporting (HEDIS, MIPS, ACO quality measures). Attribution records are typically finalized at the start of each measurement year and used throughout the performance period.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS MIPS Performance Period; CMS MSSP Measurement Year

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attributed provider qualifies for Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) performance measurement under MACRA for this attribution record. Eligibility is based on provider NPI, patient volume thresholds, and billing thresholds per CMS MIPS eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: MACRA Final Rule 42 CFR Part 414; CMS MIPS Eligibility Criteria; CMS QPP

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Facility-assigned Medical Record Number (MRN) for the patient. Used to cross-reference attribution records with the Electronic Health Record (EHR) source system (Epic Healthy Planet / Cerner Millennium) and to validate patient identity during attribution reconciliation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier; CMS MPI Standards

attributes.name: override_authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the clinical or administrative staff member who authorized a manual attribution override. Required for audit trail integrity and compliance with CMS and NCQA attribution override documentation requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls

attributes.name: override_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manual attribution override was authorized and applied. Used in conjunction with override_authorized_by and attribution_override_reason to maintain a complete audit trail of attribution changes.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls

attributes.name: panel_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was formally added to the attributed PCP's patient panel in the practice management or population health system (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet empanelment). May differ from the attribution effective date when payer attribution and practice empanelment are managed separately.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet Panel Management; CMS ACO Attribution Methodology; NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: payer_attribution_number
attributes.description: The external attribution identifier assigned by the payer or managed care organization in their attribution feed. Used to reconcile internal attribution records with payer-issued attribution rosters and to resolve attribution disputes with payers.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; ERA/EDI 835 Transaction

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the health insurance payer or managed care organization that issued the attribution assignment. Used for payer-specific attribution reconciliation, HEDIS reporting submissions, and value-based contract performance tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Payer Enrollment Standards; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The type of health insurance plan governing this attribution relationship. Accountable Care Organization (ACO), Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Point of Service (POS), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), or Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH). Determines attribution methodology and performance measurement rules.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Participation Agreement; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Plan Types

attributes.name: risk_stratification_tier
attributes.description: Patient risk stratification tier assigned at the time of attribution, based on clinical complexity, chronic condition burden, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) factors. Used by the attributed PCP and care team to prioritize outreach, care management intensity, and resource allocation in population health programs.
attributes.references: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Model; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Population Health Guidance

attributes.name: sdoh_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has documented Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) risk factors (e.g., food insecurity, housing instability, transportation barriers) that require care coordination support from the attributed PCP or care team. True = SDOH risk factors present.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Framework; NCQA HEDIS SDOH Measures; HL7 FHIR Gravity Project SDOH Clinical Care

attributes.name: source_feed_date
attributes.description: Date of the payer attribution feed or population health system extract from which this attribution record was loaded. Used for data currency validation, ETL reconciliation, and to identify stale attribution records that require refresh from the source system.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Provenance Resource; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001 Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PCP attribution record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used to detect and process incremental changes during ETL pipeline runs and to support audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: visit_count_lookback
attributes.description: Number of qualifying primary care visits with the attributed provider during the claims-based attribution lookback period (typically 24 months). Used to validate and support claims-based attribution assignments and to calculate attribution confidence scores per CMS and NCQA methodologies.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

products.name: eligibility_check
products.description: Real-time and batch insurance eligibility verification transaction records capturing verification date and time, payer queried, verification method (270/271 EDI, portal, phone), eligibility status returned, coverage details confirmed, copay/deductible amounts verified, prior authorization requirements, and verification source system. Supports front-end RCM workflows and reduces claim denials. Sourced from Epic Resolute and Cerner Revenue Cycle eligibility modules.
products.reference: HIPAA 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response — X12 EDI Standard

attributes.name: eligibility_check_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each insurance eligibility verification transaction record in the Silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Eligibility Check Care Site Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.care_site. Business justification: Eligibility verifications occur at registration/service delivery locations; essential for revenue cycle facility-level reconciliation, payer contract compliance tracking by site, and identifying facil

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Real-time benefit verification during CPOE ordering requires linking eligibility checks to specific orders for prior authorization determination, formulary checking, and coverage validation at order p

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: Real-time eligibility verification at registration/scheduling validates patient benefits against specific health plan (not just payer). Deductible, copay, and network status are plan-specific. Removes

attributes.name: imaging_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to radiology.imaging_order. Business justification: Real-time eligibility verification is performed at imaging order placement for prior authorization requirements and coverage verification. Radiology orders frequently require pre-service authorization

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.insurance_coverage. Business justification: Eligibility checks verify specific insurance coverage records. Currently eligibility_check links to payer and subscriber separately, but the authoritative coverage record is insurance_coverage. Adding

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient whose insurance eligibility is being verified. Links to the Master Patient Index (MPI) and serves as the primary party reference for this transaction.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Master Patient Index Standards

attributes.name: ordering_clinician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.clinician. Business justification: Eligibility verifications are often triggered by specific provider orders or referrals. Tracking the ordering clinician supports prior authorization workflows, audit trails for medical necessity, and

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter or scheduled appointment that triggered this eligibility verification. Nullable when verification is performed outside of a specific encounter context (e.g., batch eligibility runs).
attributes.references: Epic Resolute Revenue Cycle; Cerner Millennium Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: clearinghouse_name
attributes.description: The name of the EDI clearinghouse (e.g., Change Healthcare, Availity, Waystar) used to route the 270/271 eligibility transaction between the provider and the payer. Null for direct payer connections.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271; CMS EDI Clearinghouse Standards

attributes.name: coinsurance_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of covered service costs the patient is responsible for after the deductible is met, as confirmed in the eligibility response (e.g., 20.00 for a 20% patient coinsurance obligation).
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has multiple insurance coverages requiring Coordination of Benefits (COB) processing. True = secondary or tertiary payer exists and COB rules must be applied during claims adjudication.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS COB Rules; NCQA COB Standards

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the patient is required to pay at the time of service for the applicable service type (e.g., office visit, specialist, ED), as confirmed in the eligibility response.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates the order of coverage for this payer relative to other payers the patient may have. 'primary' = first-pay payer; 'secondary' = pays after primary; 'tertiary' = pays after secondary.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS COB Rules; CMS-1500 Claim Form Instructions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this eligibility check record was first created in the source system and ingested into the Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: family_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual family deductible amount for the patient's insurance plan as confirmed in the eligibility response. Applicable when the patient is covered under a family plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The insurance group number associated with the patient's coverage plan, as returned in the payer's eligibility response. Identifies the employer group or plan sponsor.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Coverage Verification Standards

attributes.name: individual_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual individual deductible amount for the patient's insurance plan as confirmed in the eligibility response. Represents the amount the patient must pay out-of-pocket before insurance begins covering costs.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: individual_deductible_met_amount
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount of the individual deductible that the patient has already satisfied as of the verification date. Used to calculate remaining patient financial responsibility.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards

attributes.name: individual_out_of_pocket_max
attributes.description: The annual individual out-of-pocket maximum (OOPM) for the patient's plan as confirmed in the eligibility response. Once met, the insurer covers 100% of covered services for the remainder of the benefit year.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; ACA 45 CFR 156.130; CMS Benefit Verification Standards

attributes.name: individual_out_of_pocket_met
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount applied toward the patient's individual out-of-pocket maximum as of the verification date. Used to determine remaining patient financial liability.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; ACA 45 CFR 156.130; CMS Benefit Verification Standards

attributes.name: is_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligibility verification result was manually overridden by a staff member, superseding the automated payer response. True = result was overridden; False = result reflects the original payer response.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Revenue Cycle Compliance; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number (MRN) of the patient as used in the eligibility inquiry submitted to the payer. Captured here as it appeared in the transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Master Patient Index; Joint Commission Record Standards

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rendering provider or facility is in-network or out-of-network with the patient's insurance plan, as confirmed in the eligibility response. Affects patient cost-sharing obligations.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason documented when a staff member manually overrides the eligibility verification result (e.g., patient confirmed coverage verbally, payer system outage). Supports audit trail for compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Revenue Cycle Compliance; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: prior_auth_number
attributes.description: The prior authorization number issued by the payer for the specific service, if authorization has already been obtained at the time of eligibility verification. Null if no prior auth exists or is not yet required.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Prior Authorization Standards; Epic Resolute PB

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer requires prior authorization (PA) for the service type being verified. True = prior authorization must be obtained before rendering service to avoid claim denial.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Prior Authorization Rules; AMA Prior Authorization Standards

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's plan requires a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) before the patient can receive specialist or ancillary services. Common for HMO and POS plan types.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS HMO Referral Requirements; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: The ASC X12 AAA reject reason code returned by the payer when the eligibility inquiry could not be processed (e.g., '15' = Required information missing, '72' = Invalid/missing subscriber/insured ID). Null when verification is successful.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 AAA Segment Reject Reason Codes; CMS EDI Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the rejection reason returned by the payer or clearinghouse when the eligibility inquiry failed. Supports staff workflow resolution and denial prevention.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 AAA Segment; CMS Revenue Cycle Management Standards

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the payer returned the eligibility response (271 transaction or portal/phone response). Used to calculate verification turnaround time for SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Revenue Cycle Management Standards

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The date of service for which eligibility is being verified. May be the date of an upcoming appointment or the date of a completed encounter. Used to confirm coverage was active on the specific date of care.
attributes.references: CMS Revenue Cycle Management; HIPAA ASC X12 270/271

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: The ASC X12 service type code indicating the category of healthcare service for which eligibility was verified (e.g., '30' = Health Benefit Plan Coverage, '98' = Professional Physician Visit, '48' = Hospital Inpatient). Aligns with the 271 EB01 element.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 EB01 Service Type Codes; CMS Coverage Verification Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this eligibility check was originated or processed. Supports data lineage and source reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute PB; Cerner Millennium Revenue Cycle; MEDITECH Expanse

attributes.name: transaction_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number assigned to the 270/271 EDI eligibility inquiry and response transaction set. Used for end-to-end transaction tracing and reconciliation with payer acknowledgments.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271 Transaction Set; CMS EDI Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this eligibility check record was last modified, such as when a manual override or correction was applied post-verification.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the eligibility verification. 'edi_270_271' = HIPAA-compliant EDI transaction; 'portal' = payer web portal; 'phone' = telephone inquiry; 'fax' = fax-based verification; 'real_time_api' = real-time API call (e.g., FHIR-based); 'batch' = overnight batch eligibility run.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271; CMS EDI Standards; HL7 FHIR R4

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility verification transaction as returned by the payer. 'active' = patient is currently covered; 'inactive' = coverage lapsed; 'pending' = awaiting payer response; 'error' = transaction failed; 'partial' = incomplete response received; 'not_found' = member not found in payer system.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 AAA Reject Reason Codes; CMS Revenue Cycle Standards

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the eligibility verification request was initiated and submitted to the payer. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271; Epic Resolute PB Eligibility Module

attributes.name: verification_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligibility check was performed in real-time at point of service, as part of a scheduled batch run (e.g., night-before appointment verification), or manually initiated by a staff member.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute PB Eligibility Module; Cerner Millennium Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: verified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or staff identifier of the person who performed or confirmed the eligibility verification, applicable for manual or portal-based verifications. Null for fully automated EDI or batch verifications.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Audit Controls; Joint Commission Documentation Standards

products.name: registration_event
products.description: Patient registration lifecycle event records capturing event type (new registration, pre-registration, update, merge, unmerge), registration date and time, registering facility, registration source (ED walk-in, scheduled, transfer, online pre-registration), registration completeness score, identity verification method (photo ID, insurance card, biometric), and registration staff. Provides the audit trail for patient identity creation and maintenance events within the MPI lifecycle. Distinct from encounter-level ADT events — this product tracks identity/registration events, not clinical visit movements. Sourced from EHR ADT and registration modules.
products.reference: HL7 ADT Message (A01-A45) — HL7 FHIR Patient.link — MPI Event Log

attributes.name: registration_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each patient registration lifecycle event record in the Master Patient Index (MPI). Primary key for this product. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; Epic ADT Registration Module

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where this registration event was initiated. Enables facility-level MPI analytics and cross-facility duplicate detection.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission; HL7 FHIR R4 Location Resource

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee or user who performed or initiated this registration event. Used for accountability, training quality review, and registration error attribution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Access Controls; The Joint Commission; Epic ADT Registration

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: ADT registration events capture plan-specific enrollment context at point of service for billing and eligibility. Business process: admit/transfer/discharge messages include plan details for claims su

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient's primary insurance coverage record active at the time of this registration event. Used for eligibility verification, prior authorization, and revenue cycle management.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §162; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: primary_registration_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the attending clinician assigned to the patient at the time of registration. Corresponds to HL7 PV1-7 Attending Doctor. Used for care team attribution and provider-level registration analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x PV1-7; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter.participant; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: primary_registration_mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient master record in the Master Patient Index (MPI) for whom this registration event was generated. Links every registration event to the canonical patient identity.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic ADT/Registration

attributes.name: tertiary_registration_pcp_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient's designated Primary Care Physician (PCP) at the time of registration. Used for care coordination, referral authorization, and population health management.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.generalPractitioner; CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: admission_type
attributes.description: Classifies the urgency and nature of the patient's admission at registration. Aligns with UB-04 Form Locator 14 and CMS billing requirements. Drives DRG grouping and reimbursement logic.
attributes.references: UB-04 Form Locator 14; CMS ICD-10-PCS; HL7 v2.x PV1-4

attributes.name: admit_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the chief complaint or reason for the patient's registration or admission at this event. Corresponds to HL7 PV2-3 Admit Reason. Supports clinical documentation and triage analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x PV2-3 Admit Reason; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter.reasonCode; Epic ADT

attributes.name: adt_message_type
attributes.description: The HL7 Admit Discharge Transfer (ADT) message type code that triggered or corresponds to this registration event (e.g., A01, A04, A08, A28, A31, A40). Provides direct traceability to the source HL7 message for interoperability and audit purposes.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x ADT Message Specification; HL7 FHIR R4; Epic ADT Interface

attributes.name: advance_directive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has an advance directive (e.g., living will, healthcare proxy, DNR order) on file at the time of this registration event. Required by the Patient Self-Determination Act and CMS Conditions of Participation.
attributes.references: Patient Self-Determination Act; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13; The Joint Commission RI.01.05.01

attributes.name: completeness_score
attributes.description: A numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the percentage of required registration data fields that were populated at the time of this event. Used to identify incomplete registrations requiring follow-up and to measure registration quality across facilities and staff.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA Data Quality Standards; Epic Registration Completeness Tracking

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's general consent for treatment was obtained and documented during this registration event. Required for HIPAA compliance and The Joint Commission accreditation standards.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.506; The Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this registration event record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage, SLA monitoring, and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; SOC 2

attributes.name: discharge_disposition
attributes.description: The patient's discharge disposition code at the time of a discharge-related registration update event (e.g., home, skilled nursing facility, expired, AMA). Corresponds to UB-04 Form Locator 17 and HL7 PV1-36. Null for non-discharge events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: home|snf|rehab|expired|ama|transfer|hospice|ltac — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UB-04 Form Locator 17; CMS Discharge Disposition Codes; HL7 v2.x PV1-36

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The preliminary Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) code assigned at registration based on the anticipated principal diagnosis and procedure. Used for prospective payment estimation and case mix index (CMI) tracking. May be updated at discharge.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; 3M Health Information Systems; ICD-10-CM/PCS; UB-04

attributes.name: duplicate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration event was identified as a potential duplicate patient record in the Master Patient Index (MPI). Triggers MPI duplicate review and merge workflow. Critical for patient safety and data integrity.
attributes.references: CMS MPI Standards; The Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01; Epic MPI Duplicate Detection

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which insurance eligibility was electronically verified for this registration event. Used for revenue cycle audit trails and payer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1201; CMS Revenue Cycle; Epic Resolute HB/PB

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's insurance eligibility was verified in real-time during this registration event via electronic eligibility transaction (HIPAA 270/271). Supports revenue cycle management and denial prevention.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1201 (270/271 Eligibility); CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Resolute

attributes.name: enterprise_mrn
attributes.description: The enterprise-wide Medical Record Number assigned by the Master Patient Index (MPI) that persists across all facilities and registration events for a single patient identity. Distinct from facility-level MRN.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; Epic MPI

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the registration event. Completed indicates the event was fully processed and committed to the MPI. Pending indicates the event is awaiting verification or approval. Failed indicates a system or validation error prevented completion.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Task.status; Epic ADT Registration Workflow

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the registration event occurred in the source system. Represents the real-world business event time, not the record audit timestamp. Used for MPI audit trail sequencing and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent.recorded; Epic ADT EVN Segment; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of registration lifecycle event: new_registration (first-time patient identity creation), pre_registration (advance registration before arrival), update (demographic or insurance data change), merge (two patient records combined in MPI), unmerge (previously merged records separated). Drives MPI audit trail logic.
attributes.references: HL7 ADT A01/A04/A08/A18/A31/A40 Message Types; Epic ADT Registration; CMS MPI Standards

attributes.name: expected_los_days
attributes.description: The anticipated Length of Stay (LOS) in days estimated at the time of registration or admission. Used for bed management, discharge planning, and case management workflows. Supports Average Length of Stay (ALOS) benchmarking.
attributes.references: CMS DRG Grouper; 3M Health Information Systems; Epic Healthy Planet; AHRQ

attributes.name: financial_class
attributes.description: The patient's financial classification at the time of registration, indicating the primary payer category (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Self-Pay, Charity). Drives revenue cycle routing, eligibility verification, and billing workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medicare|medicaid|commercial|self_pay|charity|workers_comp|tricare — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; UB-04; CMS-1500; Epic Resolute HB/PB

attributes.name: hipaa_notice_delivered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices Delivered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices (NPP) was delivered to the patient during this registration event, as required by the HIPAA Privacy Rule. Supports OCR audit readiness.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.520; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the patient's identity at the time of registration. Options include government-issued photo ID, insurance card, biometric scan, passport, self-reported (no verification), or none. Critical for fraud prevention, HIPAA compliance, and MPI accuracy.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient requires interpreter services at the time of this registration event. Triggers interpreter scheduling workflows and ensures compliance with Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act language access requirements.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration event record is the current active version in the silver layer. Set to False for records superseded by subsequent updates, merges, or corrections. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) pattern for MPI history.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Conventions

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The patient's preferred spoken or written language for communication, captured at registration. Drives interpreter services requests and language-concordant care delivery. Stored as ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, es, zh).
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA Language Access; CMS Conditions of Participation; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.communication

attributes.name: mpi_match_score
attributes.description: The probabilistic match score (0.00–100.00) assigned by the MPI algorithm when this registration event was processed, indicating the confidence level of patient identity matching. Scores above threshold trigger auto-merge; scores in range trigger manual review.
attributes.references: CMS MPI Standards; The Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01; Epic MPI; NCQA Data Quality

attributes.name: mpi_match_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the MPI identity matching process for this registration event. Indicates whether the patient was identified as a new patient, automatically matched to an existing record, flagged for manual review, automatically merged, or returned no match.
attributes.references: CMS MPI Standards; The Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01; Epic MPI; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number assigned to the patient at the registering facility at the time of this event. Serves as the facility-level patient identifier within the Electronic Health Record (EHR). May differ across facilities before MPI merge resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; Epic MPI/ADT

attributes.name: patient_class
attributes.description: The patient classification at the time of this registration event, indicating the intended care setting. Aligns with HL7 PV1-2 Patient Class field. Drives billing, bed management, and regulatory reporting logic.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x PV1-2 Patient Class; CMS Conditions of Participation; UB-04 Form Locator 4

attributes.name: point_of_care
attributes.description: The specific unit, department, or care area within the facility where the patient was registered (e.g., Emergency Department, ICU, Outpatient Clinic). Corresponds to HL7 PV1-3 Assigned Patient Location. Used for capacity and throughput analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x PV1-3 Assigned Patient Location; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic ADT

attributes.name: pre_authorization_number
attributes.description: The prior authorization number obtained from the payer at the time of registration for planned services. Required for revenue cycle management and claim adjudication. Null if no prior authorization was required or obtained.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §162; CMS Prior Authorization Rules; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: prior_mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number of the patient record that was merged or unmerged in this event. Preserved for MPI audit trail and downstream system reconciliation. Null for non-merge events.
attributes.references: HL7 ADT A40 Merge Patient; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic MPI

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the patient registration event was initiated. Used for day-level reporting, scheduling, and operational analytics distinct from the precise event timestamp.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic ADT

attributes.name: registration_source
attributes.description: The channel or pathway through which the patient registration was initiated. Examples include Emergency Department (ED) walk-in, scheduled appointment, inpatient transfer, online pre-registration portal, referral, or direct admission. Supports operational throughput and access analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ed_walk_in|scheduled|transfer|online_pre_registration|referral|direct_admit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 ADT A01/A04 PV1 Segment; Epic ADT Registration; EMTALA

attributes.name: restricted_record_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this patient's record has been flagged for restricted access beyond standard role-based controls (e.g., sensitive diagnoses, employee patient, domestic violence victim). Enforces HIPAA minimum necessary and break-the-glass access policies.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; 42 CFR Part 2 (Substance Use Disorder); OCR HIPAA Enforcement

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this registration event (e.g., Epic EHR ADT, Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH Expanse, manual entry, online pre-registration portal, Salesforce Health Cloud). Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent.source; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this registration event in the originating source system (e.g., Epic ADT event ID, Cerner encounter number). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational EHR system.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent; HITRUST CSF; Epic ADT

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this registration event record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; SOC 2

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has been designated as a VIP (e.g., public figure, employee, board member) requiring enhanced privacy protections and special handling during registration and care delivery. Restricts access to PHI per HIPAA minimum necessary standard.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; The Joint Commission; Epic VIP Patient Designation

products.name: identity_merge_history
products.description: Patient identity merge and unmerge history records tracking MPI overlay events, duplicate patient record resolution, surviving and non-surviving MRNs, merge rationale, merge algorithm used, merge confidence score, approving HIM analyst, merge date, and reversal history. Critical for MPI integrity, HIPAA compliance, and audit trail requirements. Sourced from Epic MPI management and 3M HIS tools.
products.reference: MPI Overlay Prevention — HL7 FHIR Patient.link (replaces/replaced-by) — HIM Standards

attributes.name: identity_merge_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Master Patient Index (MPI) merge or unmerge event record in the identity merge history. Primary key for this table. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — tracks discrete MPI overlay business events with full lifecycle.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient/$merge operation; Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surviving (target) patient record that persists after the merge event. This is the canonical patient identity retained in the Master Patient Index (MPI) following resolution. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient resource; Epic MPI; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: primary_identity_care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility associated with the surviving patient MRN. In multi-facility health systems, the surviving record may be anchored to a specific facility or enterprise entity. Supports facility-level MPI integrity reporting.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: primary_identity_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approving Health Information Management (HIM) Analyst ID
attributes.description: Reference to the Health Information Management (HIM) analyst or workforce member who reviewed and approved the merge event. Required for accountability, HIPAA audit trail, and quality oversight of MPI integrity operations.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); AHIMA HIM Standards; The Joint Commission Record Management

attributes.name: prior_merge_event_identity_merge_history_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original merge event that this record reverses or supersedes. Populated for unmerge events to establish the reversal chain. Enables full audit trail reconstruction of MPI overlay history.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); Epic MPI Management; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines

attributes.name: approving_him_analyst_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approving Health Information Management (HIM) Analyst Name
attributes.description: Full name of the HIM analyst who approved the merge event, captured at the time of approval for audit trail purposes. Retained as a denormalized value to preserve the historical record even if the analyst's workforce record changes.

attributes.name: breach_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal HIPAA breach risk assessment is required as a result of this merge or unmerge event. Set to true when PHI may have been improperly disclosed due to an incorrect merge. Triggers the OCR-mandated breach notification workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.400–414 Breach Notification Rule; OCR Enforcement; HHS Guidance

attributes.name: breach_assessment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the HIPAA breach risk assessment associated with this merge event. Not_required indicates no PHI risk identified; pending indicates assessment not yet started; in_progress indicates under review; completed_no_breach indicates assessment concluded with no reportable breach; completed_breach_confirmed indicates a reportable breach was identified.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.400–414 Breach Notification Rule; OCR Enforcement; HHS Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this identity merge history record was first captured in the data platform (Silver Layer). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for lineage and data governance purposes.

attributes.name: duplicate_detection_method
attributes.description: The technical method used to identify the duplicate patient records prior to the merge event. Exact match uses deterministic field equality; probabilistic uses weighted scoring; manual indicates HIM staff identification; rule_based uses configured business rules; ml_model uses a machine learning classifier; hybrid combines multiple methods.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems MPI; Epic MPI Management; NCQA Patient Matching Standards; ONC Patient Matching Playbook

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the merge event became effective in the Master Patient Index (MPI), which may differ from the merge_timestamp if the event was backdated or scheduled. Used for temporal data governance and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: hl7_message_control_number
attributes.description: The HL7 message identifier (MSH-10 Message Control ID) of the ADT A40 or FHIR Patient/$merge message that triggered or communicated this merge event. Supports HL7 interface traceability, cross-system reconciliation, and Health Information Exchange (HIE) audit.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x ADT A40 Merge Patient; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient/$merge; HIE Standards

attributes.name: matching_fields_used
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of patient demographic fields that were evaluated by the matching algorithm to identify the duplicate records (e.g., last_name, date_of_birth, ssn_last4, address, phone). Supports algorithm transparency, audit, and performance tuning.
attributes.references: ONC Patient Matching Playbook; 3M Health Information Systems MPI; NCQA Patient Matching Standards

attributes.name: merge_algorithm
attributes.description: The identity matching algorithm or ruleset used to identify the duplicate patient records and trigger the merge event (e.g., deterministic exact match, probabilistic scoring, manual HIM review, HL7 EMPI algorithm, 3M MPI algorithm). Supports algorithm performance analysis and audit.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems MPI; Epic MPI Management; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient/$match

attributes.name: merge_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric probability score (0.0000 to 1.0000) produced by the identity matching algorithm indicating the likelihood that the two patient records represent the same individual. Higher scores indicate greater algorithmic certainty. Used to stratify merge decisions and set review thresholds.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems MPI; Epic MPI Management; NCQA Patient Matching Standards

attributes.name: merge_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this MPI merge or unmerge event, assigned by the source system (e.g., Epic MPI or 3M HIS). Used for cross-system traceability, audit inquiries, and HIPAA compliance reporting. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; 3M Health Information Systems; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: merge_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MPI identity event: merge (combining duplicate records), unmerge (reversing a prior merge), overlay (replacing one record's data with another), deactivation (retiring a non-surviving MRN), or reactivation (restoring a previously deactivated MRN). Drives downstream processing logic.
attributes.references: HL7 ADT A40 (Merge Patient); HL7 ADT A41 (Merge Account); Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: merge_rationale
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the HIM analyst or system documenting the clinical or administrative justification for the merge decision. Includes evidence reviewed (e.g., matching demographics, shared encounter history, insurance data). Required for HIPAA audit trail.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); HIM Best Practices; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines

attributes.name: merge_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the merge event. Pending indicates awaiting HIM analyst review; approved indicates authorized but not yet executed; completed indicates fully processed in the MPI; reversed indicates the merge was undone; failed indicates a system error prevented completion; under_review indicates flagged for additional scrutiny. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; HIM Workflow Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: merge_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the MPI merge or unmerge event was executed in the source system. Represents the principal real-world business event time (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP). Critical for audit trail, HIPAA compliance, and chronological sequencing of identity resolution events.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent; Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: merge_trigger_source
attributes.description: The originating source or workflow that initiated the merge event. Indicates whether the merge was triggered by an automated algorithm, manual HIM analyst review, an ADT (Admit Discharge Transfer) feed, patient registration workflow, payer matching, Health Information Exchange (HIE) notification, or batch deduplication process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automated_algorithm|manual_him_review|adt_feed|registration_workflow|payer_match|hie_notification|batch_dedup — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; HL7 ADT; HIE Standards; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines

attributes.name: mpi_overlay_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of data overlaid during the merge event. Full overlay replaces all data from the non-surviving record; partial overlay merges selected data elements; demographic_only merges only identity/demographic fields; clinical_only merges only clinical encounter data. Supports impact analysis and reversal planning.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; 3M Health Information Systems; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines

attributes.name: non_surviving_dob_at_merge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Surviving Patient Date of Birth at Merge
attributes.description: Date of birth of the non-surviving (duplicate) patient as recorded at the time of the merge event. Captured as a point-in-time demographic snapshot for audit trail and identity verification during unmerge or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: non_surviving_enterprise_mrn
attributes.description: The enterprise-level Medical Record Number (MRN) associated with the non-surviving (duplicate) patient record prior to the merge. Retained for audit trail, unmerge operations, and HIPAA compliance.
attributes.references: Epic Enterprise MPI; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: non_surviving_mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number (MRN) of the duplicate or erroneous patient record that is deactivated and subsumed into the surviving MRN during the merge event. Retained for audit trail and reversal capability.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link

attributes.name: non_surviving_patient_name_at_merge
attributes.description: Full name of the non-surviving (duplicate) patient as recorded at the time of the merge event. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for audit trail and reversal purposes. Critical for confirming correct patient identification during unmerge operations.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: patient_safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merge or unmerge event has a potential patient safety impact, such as when clinical records (allergies, medications, diagnoses) from two different patients were commingled. Triggers patient safety event reporting and clinical review workflows.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Patient Safety Goals; AHRQ Patient Safety Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: phi_disclosure_risk_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protected Health Information (PHI) Disclosure Risk Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merge event created a potential Protected Health Information (PHI) disclosure risk, such as when records from two different individuals were incorrectly merged and clinical data may have been exposed to the wrong patient or provider. Triggers mandatory HIPAA breach assessment workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.400–414 Breach Notification Rule; OCR Enforcement; HHS Guidance

attributes.name: quality_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merge event has been flagged for MPI quality review, such as for inclusion in periodic HIM audits, regulatory reporting, or quality improvement initiatives. Supports NCQA, CMS, and internal quality measurement programs.
attributes.references: NCQA Patient Matching Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines

attributes.name: quality_review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the HIM quality reviewer documenting findings, observations, or corrective actions identified during the quality review of this merge event. Supports continuous improvement of MPI integrity processes.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; NCQA Patient Matching Standards; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: records_affected_count
attributes.description: The total number of clinical, financial, or administrative records (encounters, orders, claims, etc.) that were reassociated from the non-surviving MRN to the surviving MRN as a result of this merge event. Indicates the scope and impact of the merge operation.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; HIM Best Practices

attributes.name: reversal_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the HIM analyst or supervisor who authorized the reversal (unmerge) of a prior merge event. Captured as a denormalized string for audit trail permanence. Supports accountability and HIPAA compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); AHIMA HIM Standards; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation documenting why a prior merge event was reversed (unmerged). Populated only for unmerge event types. Common reasons include incorrect patient identification, registration error, or patient dispute. Required for HIPAA audit trail and MPI integrity governance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a prior merge event was reversed (unmerged) in the source system. Populated only for unmerge event types. Supports chronological audit trail reconstruction and MPI integrity reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); Epic MPI Management; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines

attributes.name: review_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this merge event for HIM analyst review queue management. Routine indicates standard processing; urgent indicates elevated risk or patient safety concern; critical indicates immediate action required due to active patient care impact or confirmed PHI disclosure.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; HIM Workflow Standards; The Joint Commission Patient Safety

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this merge event originated (e.g., Epic MPI, Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH Expanse, 3M HIS). Supports data lineage, cross-system reconciliation, and MPI integrity audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Epic|Cerner|MEDITECH|3M_HIS|Manual|HIE|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; 3M Health Information Systems; HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent

attributes.name: source_system_merge_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this merge event by the originating operational system (e.g., Epic MPI event ID, 3M HIS transaction ID). Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the data platform and source systems.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; 3M Health Information Systems; HL7 FHIR R4 AuditEvent

attributes.name: surviving_dob_at_merge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surviving Patient Date of Birth at Merge
attributes.description: Date of birth of the surviving patient as recorded at the time of the merge event. Captured as a point-in-time demographic snapshot for audit trail and identity verification purposes during unmerge or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: surviving_enterprise_mrn
attributes.description: The enterprise-level (cross-facility) Medical Record Number (MRN) assigned to the surviving patient identity in the Master Patient Index (MPI). Distinct from facility-level MRN; used in multi-facility health systems for enterprise-wide patient matching.
attributes.references: Epic Enterprise MPI; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: surviving_mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number (MRN) of the patient record that is retained as the active, canonical identity in the Master Patient Index (MPI) following the merge. All clinical and financial records are associated to this MRN post-merge.
attributes.references: Epic MPI Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier

attributes.name: surviving_patient_name_at_merge
attributes.description: Full name of the surviving patient as recorded at the time of the merge event. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for audit trail purposes, as the patient's name in the master record may change over time. Supports historical audit and HIPAA compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; AHIMA MPI Management Guidelines; Epic MPI Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this identity merge history record was last modified in the data platform, such as when a status update or correction was applied. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp.

products.name: flag
products.description: Patient-level clinical and administrative alert flags capturing flag type (VIP, behavioral alert, fall risk, latex allergy, infectious precaution, financial hardship, interpreter needed, AMA history, legal hold, safety risk), flag severity, flag description, onset and expiration dates, flagging provider or staff, and active status. Persistent patient-level flags that travel with the patient across encounters — distinct from encounter-specific clinical alerts. Supports safe care delivery, staff safety, and administrative workflows across all care settings. Sourced from EHR clinical alert and patient safety systems.
products.reference: Epic Patient Flags — HL7 FHIR Flag Resource

attributes.name: flag_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each patient-level clinical or administrative alert flag record. Primary key for the patient flag entity.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or care setting where this flag was created. Supports multi-facility enterprise deployments where flags may be facility-specific or enterprise-wide.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient for whom this flag is recorded. Links to the master patient record in the patient domain.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.subject; Epic ClinDoc Patient Safety Flags

attributes.name: flag_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician or staff member who created or initiated this flag. Used for accountability, audit, and follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.author; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart; HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: flag_resolved_by_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician or staff member who resolved or inactivated this flag. Supports accountability and audit trail for flag lifecycle management.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: flag_reviewed_by_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician or staff member who most recently reviewed this flag for continued clinical relevance. Supports accountability and periodic review compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission; NCQA; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Clinical flags for infectious disease precautions, isolation protocols, and condition-specific alerts reference ICD-10 codes (e.g., A41.9 for sepsis precautions). Supports infection control workflows,

attributes.name: snomed_concept_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.snomed_concept. Business justification: Clinical flags use SNOMED CT for precise concepts (fall risk, allergy severity, behavioral health alerts). Enables clinical decision support rules, interoperability via FHIR Flag resource, and granula

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Optional reference to the encounter during which this flag was created, if the flag originated in the context of a specific visit. Patient-level flags persist across encounters, but this field captures the originating encounter for traceability.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.encounter; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: acknowledgment_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this flag has been acknowledged by clinical or administrative staff. Supports alert fatigue analysis and compliance monitoring for mandatory acknowledgment flags.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission National Patient Safety Goals; AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: ama_history_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Against Medical Advice (AMA) History Flag Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flag specifically documents a history of the patient leaving Against Medical Advice (AMA). Supports risk management, care planning, and EMTALA compliance workflows.
attributes.references: EMTALA; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic ClinDoc AMA Documentation; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: code_system
attributes.description: Identifies the coding system or terminology used for the flag_code (e.g., SNOMED-CT, ICD-10, LOCAL for facility-defined codes). Supports interoperability and terminology mapping across systems.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Coding.system; SNOMED CT; ICD-10; LOINC

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Confidentiality classification of this flag controlling which roles and users may view it. Restricted and very-restricted flags (e.g., VIP, behavioral, legal hold) are visible only to authorized personnel. Supports HIPAA minimum necessary standard.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502; HL7 FHIR R4 Confidentiality; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: display_in_chart
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flag should be prominently displayed in the patient's electronic health record chart header or banner. Controls EHR display logic for patient safety alerts.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Chart Display Settings; Cerner PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 Flag

attributes.name: display_in_registration
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flag should be surfaced during patient registration and ADT workflows. Supports administrative flags such as financial hardship, legal hold, or VIP status at point of registration.
attributes.references: Epic ADT; Cerner Millennium ADT; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: display_in_scheduling
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flag should be visible in scheduling and appointment management workflows (e.g., Epic Cadence). Supports pre-visit preparation for flags such as interpreter needed, VIP, or behavioral alerts.
attributes.references: Epic Cadence; Cerner Scheduling; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this flag record version is superseded by a newer version. Null indicates the current active version. Supports SCD type 2 history tracking and point-in-time analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; HL7 FHIR R4; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this flag record version is considered valid in the silver layer. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) type 2 history tracking for flag record changes over time.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; HL7 FHIR R4; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this flag is scheduled to expire or be automatically inactivated. Null indicates the flag is indefinite and requires manual resolution. Supports time-limited flags such as infectious precautions or temporary behavioral alerts.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.period.end; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: fall_risk_assessment_tool
attributes.description: Identifies the standardized fall risk assessment instrument used to generate the fall_risk_score. Supports comparability of fall risk data across units and facilities.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission NPSG.09.02.01; NDNQI; AHRQ; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: fall_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric fall risk assessment score (e.g., Morse Fall Scale or Johns Hopkins Fall Risk Assessment Tool score) associated with a fall risk flag. Null when flag_subtype is not fall risk. Supports NDNQI fall prevention reporting and The Joint Commission NPSG.09.02.01.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission NPSG.09.02.01; NDNQI; AHRQ; Epic ClinDoc Fall Risk Assessment; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: flag_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific flag, aligned with the source EHR system's internal code set or a standard terminology (e.g., SNOMED CT concept code for the alert condition). Enables interoperability and cross-system flag reconciliation.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.code; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: flag_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the clinical or administrative alert, including relevant context, specific precautions required, or instructions for care team members. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI) and must be handled per HIPAA requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502; HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.note; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: flag_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the patient flag. Active flags are displayed in clinical workflows; inactive or resolved flags are retained for historical reference; entered-in-error flags are suppressed from display but preserved for audit.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.status; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: flag_type
attributes.description: High-level category of the flag indicating whether it is clinical (e.g., allergy, fall risk), administrative (e.g., VIP, interpreter needed), safety (e.g., infectious precaution, latex allergy), behavioral (e.g., behavioral alert), financial (e.g., financial hardship), or legal (e.g., legal hold). Drives routing and display logic across care settings.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.category; The Joint Commission Patient Safety Standards

attributes.name: flagged_by_role
attributes.description: The professional role or job function of the individual who created this flag. Provides context for the flag's origin and supports role-based analytics on flag creation patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physician|nurse|pharmacist|social_worker|case_manager|administrative|security|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart; The Joint Commission Staff Competency Standards

attributes.name: flagged_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this flag was first entered into the EHR system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp and supports chronological ordering of flag history.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.meta.lastUpdated; HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: infectious_precaution_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of infection control precaution required for this patient when the flag_subtype is infectious precaution. Drives isolation protocols, PPE requirements, and room assignment workflows. Null when not applicable.
attributes.references: CDC Isolation Precautions Guidelines; The Joint Commission Infection Control Standards; CMS HAI Reporting; OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens Standard

attributes.name: interpreter_language
attributes.description: The language for which an interpreter is required when the flag_subtype is interpreter needed. Uses ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes (e.g., es for Spanish, zh for Chinese). Supports Title VI compliance and patient communication workflows.
attributes.references: Title VI Civil Rights Act; CMS Conditions of Participation; Section 1557 ACA; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: is_enterprise_wide
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flag applies across all facilities in the enterprise (True) or is scoped to a specific facility (False). Enterprise-wide flags travel with the patient to any care setting within the health system.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Enterprise Patient Safety; Cerner PowerChart; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: last_acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: The most recent date and time this flag was acknowledged by a staff member. Supports compliance monitoring and identification of flags that have not been recently reviewed.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The date on which this flag was most recently reviewed by a clinician or authorized staff member for continued relevance and accuracy. Supports periodic flag review workflows required by accreditation standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission; NCQA; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this flag record was most recently modified in the source system or the lakehouse. Supports incremental data loading, audit trails, and change detection.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312; HL7 FHIR R4 Meta.lastUpdated; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: legal_hold_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or case identifier associated with a legal hold flag. Links the patient flag to the corresponding legal matter or litigation hold managed by the health system's legal department. Null when flag_subtype is not legal hold.
attributes.references: OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number assigned to the patient at the facility. Carried on the flag record to support direct patient identification in clinical workflows without requiring a join to the patient master.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic MPI

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the condition or circumstance prompting this flag first became clinically or administratively relevant for the patient. Distinct from the date the flag was entered into the system.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Flag.period.start; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: phi_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this flag record contains Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined under HIPAA. Drives data governance, access control, and de-identification workflows in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: requires_acknowledgment
