attributes.references: HIPAA §164.520 Notice of Privacy Practices; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Terms of Use

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the portal terms of use and privacy notice that the patient accepted. Enables tracking of re-consent requirements when terms are updated, supporting HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.520; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Terms Version Management

attributes.name: test_result_notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has enabled portal notifications for new laboratory or radiology test results. Supports patient engagement, timely result delivery, and 21st Century Cures Act information blocking compliance.
attributes.references: 21st Century Cures Act §4004 Information Blocking; CMS Interoperability Final Rule; Epic MyChart Results Notification

attributes.name: two_factor_auth_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has enrolled in two-factor authentication (2FA) for portal access. Supports HIPAA security rule compliance, NIST identity assurance level requirements, and organizational security policy enforcement.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(d) Person Authentication; NIST SP 800-63B AAL2; ISO 27001 A.9.4.2; HITRUST CSF Control 01.d

attributes.name: two_factor_auth_method
attributes.description: The specific method used for two-factor authentication when enrolled. Supports security posture analysis and patient experience optimization for authentication workflows.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; HIPAA §164.312(d); HITRUST CSF Control 01.d

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this portal account record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 A.12.4.1; HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; HITRUST CSF

products.name: proxy_access
products.description: Patient proxy and authorized representative access records capturing proxy type (parent/guardian, adult caregiver, legal guardian, healthcare power of attorney), proxy identity, access level granted (full, limited, view-only), authorization date, expiration date, revocation date, and supporting legal documentation reference. Supports HIPAA-compliant proxy access management in patient portals and clinical settings. Sourced from Epic MyChart proxy management.
products.reference: HIPAA Personal Representative Rules (45 CFR §164.502(g)) — HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson

attributes.name: proxy_access_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each proxy access record in the patient domain. Primary key for the proxy_access data product.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: primary_proxy_person_demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the person record of the authorized proxy representative. Links to the proxy's own identity record in the patient or person master.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Scope of access granted to the proxy representative within the patient portal and clinical systems. Full access includes all PHI; limited restricts to specific data categories; view-only prevents any actions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full|limited|view_only|scheduling_only|messaging_only — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management; OCR HIPAA Guidance on Personal Representatives

attributes.name: access_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the proxy access record. Active indicates the proxy currently has authorized access; expired indicates the authorization period has lapsed; revoked indicates access was explicitly terminated before expiration.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: age_of_majority_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient is expected to reach the age of majority (typically 18th birthday). Used to schedule automatic expiration or review of proxy access for minor patients. Populated only when minor_patient_flag is true.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)(3); State Departments of Health — Minor Consent Laws

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proxy access was formally authorized and activated. Represents the effective start of the proxy's access rights. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management; OCR HIPAA Guidance

attributes.name: authorization_location
attributes.description: Facility or location where the proxy authorization was processed (e.g., hospital registration desk, clinic front desk, online portal). Supports operational reporting and audit.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Record Standards

attributes.name: billing_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proxy is authorized to view billing statements and make payments on behalf of the patient through the patient portal.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; Epic Resolute (Patient Billing); HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member or system that captured the patient's consent for proxy access. Supports accountability and audit trail for HIPAA compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: consent_obtained_method
attributes.description: Method by which the patient's consent for proxy access was obtained. Supports HIPAA consent documentation requirements and audit trail.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this proxy access record was first created in the system. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) (Audit Controls); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proxy access authorization is scheduled to expire. Nullable for open-ended authorizations. System should automatically transition access_status to expired when this date is reached. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: last_access_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent time the proxy accessed the patient's record through the portal or clinical system. Used for access monitoring, dormant account detection, and HIPAA audit log reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) (Audit Controls); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: legal_document_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supporting legal document became effective. Used to validate that the legal authority was in force at the time of proxy authorization.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Departments of Health; OCR HIPAA Guidance

attributes.name: legal_document_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supporting legal document expires, if applicable. Nullable for permanent legal instruments. Triggers review workflows when approaching expiration.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Departments of Health

attributes.name: legal_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document locator for the supporting legal documentation (e.g., court order number, power of attorney document ID, or document management system reference). Enables retrieval of the underlying legal instrument for audit and compliance verification.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Record Standards

attributes.name: legal_document_type
attributes.description: Type of legal documentation supporting the proxy authorization. Required for legal guardian and healthcare power of attorney proxy types. Drives document verification workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: court_order|power_of_attorney|birth_certificate|adoption_decree|guardianship_order|none_required — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); State Departments of Health; OCR HIPAA Guidance on Personal Representatives

attributes.name: messaging_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proxy is authorized to send and receive secure messages with the care team on behalf of the patient through the patient portal.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: minor_patient_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is a minor (under 18 years of age) at the time of proxy authorization. Drives specific access rules and automatic expiration logic when the patient reaches the age of majority.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)(3); State Departments of Health — Minor Consent Laws; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number of the patient whose record is subject to proxy access. Carried here for operational lookup and audit without requiring a join to the patient master.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.501; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier

attributes.name: mychart_proxy_account_number
attributes.description: Epic MyChart system identifier for the proxy's portal account. Used to link the proxy access record to the proxy's active MyChart login session and access audit logs.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 (Access Controls)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by staff regarding special circumstances, conditions, or instructions associated with this proxy access record. May include details about legal authority limitations or patient-specific access restrictions.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Record Standards

attributes.name: phi_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific PHI restrictions apply to this proxy's access (e.g., sensitive categories such as mental health, substance abuse, or reproductive health are excluded from proxy view). When true, restricted_phi_categories should be reviewed.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); 42 CFR Part 2 (Substance Abuse Records); State Mental Health Privacy Laws

attributes.name: portal_access_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proxy currently has active access to the patient portal (e.g., Epic MyChart). May be false even when access_status is active if the proxy has not yet activated their portal account.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: proxy_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the proxy representative. Used for identity verification during proxy authorization and to confirm the proxy meets age requirements (e.g., adult caregiver must be 18+).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_email
attributes.description: Email address of the proxy representative used for MyChart portal login and proxy-related notifications. Serves as the primary digital contact channel for the proxy.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the authorized proxy representative. Captured at time of authorization to support audit and identity verification independent of the proxy's own patient record.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name of the authorized proxy representative. Captured at time of authorization to support audit and identity verification.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the proxy representative for identity verification and contact purposes during proxy authorization or revocation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the proxy relationship type as defined under HIPAA personal representative rules. Determines the legal basis for access. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent_guardian|adult_caregiver|legal_guardian|healthcare_power_of_attorney|personal_representative|minor_self — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: relationship_to_patient
attributes.description: Describes the personal or legal relationship of the proxy to the patient. Distinct from proxy_type which captures the legal authorization category; this field captures the familial or social relationship. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|spouse|child|sibling|grandparent|other_family|non_family — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.relationship; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: restricted_phi_categories
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of PHI categories excluded from this proxy's access scope (e.g., mental_health, substance_abuse, reproductive_health, hiv_status). Populated only when phi_restriction_flag is true. Drives data filtering in the patient portal.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); 42 CFR Part 2; State Mental Health Privacy Laws; OCR HIPAA Guidance

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proxy access was explicitly revoked prior to the scheduled expiration. Populated only when access_status is revoked. Supports HIPAA audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why proxy access was revoked. Required when revocation_date is populated. Supports compliance reporting and audit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: patient_request|proxy_request|legal_order|age_of_majority|death_of_patient|death_of_proxy|administrative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: rx_refill_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proxy is authorized to request prescription refills on behalf of the patient through the patient portal. Relevant for caregiver proxies managing chronic condition patients.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; Epic Willow (Pharmacy); HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: scheduling_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proxy is authorized to schedule, reschedule, or cancel appointments on behalf of the patient through the patient portal.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this proxy access record originated. Supports data lineage, ETL traceability, and multi-system reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Provenance; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_proxy_code
attributes.description: Native identifier for this proxy access record in the originating source system (e.g., Epic MyChart proxy relationship ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational EHR.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Proxy Management; HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.identifier; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this proxy access record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) (Audit Controls); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proxy's identity and legal authority were verified by authorized staff. Supports compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the identity verification process for the proxy representative. Verified indicates the proxy's identity and legal authority have been confirmed by staff. Pending indicates verification is in progress.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(g); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or staff identifier of the individual who verified the proxy's identity and legal authority. Required for audit and accountability under HIPAA access control requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 (Access Controls); OCR HIPAA Enforcement; The Joint Commission (TJC)

products.name: mrn_crosswalk
products.description: Cross-facility and cross-system MRN (Medical Record Number) crosswalk table mapping a patient's enterprise patient_id to facility-specific MRNs, EHR system identifiers (Epic EMPI, Cerner EUID), payer member IDs, and external HIE identifiers. Enables enterprise-wide patient matching and identity resolution across Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, and HIE platforms. Sourced from MPI and ADT integration layers.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier — MPI Cross-Reference Standard — IHE PIX/PDQ Profile

attributes.name: mrn_crosswalk_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each MRN crosswalk record in the enterprise patient identity resolution table.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; CMS Master Patient Index Guidelines

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) that issued the facility-specific MRN. Enables multi-facility MRN disambiguation within an integrated delivery network.
attributes.references: CMS Facility Certification; The Joint Commission (TJC) Facility Standards

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer organization when the identifier_type is a payer member ID. Links the crosswalk record to the specific insurance payer that issued the member identifier, enabling payer-specific patient identity resolution for claims and eligibility workflows.
attributes.references: CMS Payer Enrollment; HIPAA 45 CFR §162 — Standard Transactions

attributes.name: primary_mrn_mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Enterprise-wide unique patient identifier from the Master Patient Index (MPI). This is the golden record identifier that all facility-specific MRNs and system identifiers resolve to. Serves as the anchor for cross-system patient identity resolution.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.id; CMS Master Patient Index (MPI) Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: adt_event_type
attributes.description: The HL7 ADT (Admit, Discharge, Transfer) event type that triggered the creation or update of this crosswalk record (e.g., A01=Admit, A03=Discharge, A08=Update Patient Info, A28=Add Person, A40=Merge Patient). Supports ADT-driven MPI integration and audit tracing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A01|A02|A03|A04|A08|A28|A31|A40 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x ADT Message Specification; HL7 Table 0003 — Event Type

attributes.name: adt_message_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Admit Discharge Transfer (ADT) Message Control ID
attributes.description: The HL7 message control ID from the ADT message that created or last updated this crosswalk record. Enables traceability back to the originating HL7 v2 or FHIR message in the ADT integration layer for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x MSH-10 Message Control ID; HL7 FHIR R4 MessageHeader.id

attributes.name: assigning_authority
attributes.description: The name of the organization or system that assigned and is responsible for maintaining this patient identifier (e.g., 'Epic EMPI', 'Cerner Millennium', 'State HIE', 'CMS', 'BlueCross BlueShield'). Corresponds to the HL7 v2 CX.4 Assigning Authority component.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x CX.4 Assigning Authority; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier.assigner

attributes.name: cerner_euid
attributes.description: The patient identifier assigned by Cerner Millennium's Enterprise Unique ID (EUID) system. Used for patient matching and identity resolution across all Cerner-connected facilities. Populated when source_system = 'Cerner'.
attributes.references: Cerner Millennium EUID Technical Specification; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crosswalk record was first created in the enterprise MPI or data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail requirements and SCD Type 2 history management.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) — Audit Controls; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: crosswalk_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this crosswalk mapping record. Active records are in current use for identity resolution. Deprecated records have been superseded. Pending_review records require MPI analyst review. Merged records indicate the source identifier was consolidated into another enterprise patient record.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.active; CMS MPI Governance Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite data quality score (0.0000 to 1.0000) for this crosswalk record, reflecting completeness, consistency, and accuracy of the identifier mapping. Computed by the MPI data quality engine. Supports NCQA HEDIS data quality reporting and MPI governance dashboards.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Data Quality Standards; AHIMA Data Quality Management Model; CMS MPI Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this identifier crosswalk mapping ceased to be valid. Null indicates the mapping is currently active. Used for SCD Type 2 history management and to support point-in-time identity resolution queries.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier.period.end; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this identifier crosswalk mapping became effective and valid for use in patient identity resolution. Supports temporal validity tracking for slowly changing dimension (SCD) management in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier.period.start; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: enterprise_mrn
attributes.description: The enterprise-level MRN assigned by the Master Patient Index (MPI) to uniquely identify the patient across all facilities and systems within the health system. Used for cross-facility care coordination and longitudinal patient record assembly.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; CMS MPI Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: epic_empi_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Epic Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) ID
attributes.description: The patient identifier assigned by Epic's Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) system. Used for patient matching and identity resolution across all Epic-connected facilities within the health system. Populated when source_system = 'Epic'.
attributes.references: Epic EMPI Technical Documentation; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier

attributes.name: facility_mrn
attributes.description: The facility-specific Medical Record Number (MRN) assigned to the patient at a particular care site. This is the local identifier used within the facility's EHR system (Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH) and on clinical documentation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: fhir_patient_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Patient Reference
attributes.description: The FHIR Patient resource reference URL or logical ID for this patient in the source system's FHIR API endpoint (e.g., 'Patient/12345' or full URL). Enables direct FHIR-based patient record retrieval from the source system for interoperability workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; ONC 21st Century Cures Act FHIR API Requirements; CMS Interoperability Rule

attributes.name: hie_network_name
attributes.description: Name of the Health Information Exchange (HIE) network through which the hie_patient_id was assigned or is used for record exchange (e.g., 'CommonWell Health Alliance', 'Carequality', 'State HIE'). Populated when identifier_type = 'HIEID'.
attributes.references: ONC Health IT Certification; 21st Century Cures Act — Information Blocking Rule; CommonWell Health Alliance Specifications

attributes.name: hie_patient_number
attributes.description: The patient identifier assigned by a regional or national Health Information Exchange (HIE) network. Enables patient record retrieval and longitudinal care summary exchange across participating organizations via HIE platforms.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; ONC Health IT Certification; 21st Century Cures Act — Information Blocking Rule

attributes.name: identifier_system_oid
attributes.description: The HL7 Object Identifier (OID) or URI that uniquely identifies the assigning authority or namespace for this identifier (e.g., the OID for Epic EMPI, Cerner EUID, or a specific facility's MRN namespace). Enables unambiguous identifier resolution in HL7 FHIR and v2 interoperability contexts.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier.system; HL7 OID Registry; ISO/IEC 9834-1

attributes.name: identifier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the identifier represented in this crosswalk record. Distinguishes between facility MRNs, Epic Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) IDs, Cerner Enterprise Unique IDs (EUIDs), payer member IDs, Health Information Exchange (HIE) identifiers, and national identifiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MRN|EMPI|EUID|MemberID|HIEID|NationalID|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier.type; HL7 Table 0203 — Identifier Type

attributes.name: is_golden_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crosswalk record is associated with the MPI golden record — the authoritative, deduplicated enterprise patient identity. Only one active crosswalk record per patient_id should carry this flag as True. Used by downstream systems to select the canonical patient identity.
attributes.references: CMS Master Patient Index (MPI) Guidelines; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link; NCQA Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_identifier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crosswalk record represents the primary or preferred identifier for the patient within the specified source system or facility. When True, this identifier is used as the default lookup key for the patient in that system context.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier.use = 'official'; IHE PIX/PDQ Technical Framework

attributes.name: last_adt_event_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Admit Discharge Transfer (ADT) Event Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent ADT (Admit, Discharge, Transfer) event that updated this crosswalk record. Used to assess record currency and identify stale crosswalk mappings that may require re-validation.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x ADT Message Specification; HL7 FHIR R4 MessageHeader

attributes.name: match_algorithm
attributes.description: Name and version of the matching algorithm or rules engine used to establish the identity link between the source identifier and the enterprise patient_id (e.g., 'Deterministic-v2.1', 'Probabilistic-Jaro-Winkler-v3', 'Manual-Override'). Supports auditability of identity resolution decisions.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Technical Framework; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link; HITRUST CSF Control 07.a

attributes.name: match_confidence_score
attributes.description: Probabilistic confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) assigned by the MPI matching algorithm indicating the likelihood that this identifier correctly maps to the enterprise patient_id. Scores near 1.0 indicate high-confidence deterministic matches; lower scores indicate probabilistic matches requiring manual review.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Patient Identity Matching; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link; NCQA HEDIS Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Current status of the patient identity matching result for this crosswalk record. Indicates whether the identifier has been definitively matched to the enterprise patient_id, is a probable or possible match requiring review, is unmatched, has been identified as a duplicate, or has been retired. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: matched|probable_match|possible_match|unmatched|duplicate|retired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Patient Identity Matching; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link.type; CMS MPI Guidelines

attributes.name: match_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the identity match was established: deterministic (exact rule-based match on key identifiers), probabilistic (statistical scoring), manual (human-reviewed and confirmed), or system_override (administrative correction). Supports data quality governance and audit workflows.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Technical Framework; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.link.type; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: meditech_patient_number
attributes.description: The patient identifier assigned by MEDITECH Expanse EHR system. Used for patient identity resolution when the facility operates on MEDITECH. Populated when source_system = 'MEDITECH'.
attributes.references: MEDITECH Expanse Technical Documentation; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier

attributes.name: overlay_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crosswalk record has been flagged as a potential patient record overlay risk — a patient safety event where one patient's records are incorrectly merged with or attributed to another patient. Triggers immediate MPI analyst review workflow.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) NPSG.01.01.01; AHIMA Patient Identity Integrity White Paper; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: payer_member_number
attributes.description: The insurance payer's member identification number for this patient. Used to link the enterprise patient record to payer eligibility, claims, and Explanation of Benefits (EOB) data. Populated when identifier_type = 'MemberID'.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1402; CMS-1500 Claim Form; HL7 FHIR R4 Coverage.subscriberId

attributes.name: review_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason why this crosswalk record has been flagged for review (e.g., 'Duplicate MRN detected', 'Name mismatch', 'DOB discrepancy', 'Overlay risk identified'). Populated when match_status = 'possible_match' or crosswalk_status = 'pending_review'.
attributes.references: CMS MPI Governance Guidelines; The Joint Commission (TJC) NPSG.01.01.01; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: source_facility_code
attributes.description: The short code or abbreviation identifying the facility that issued the facility_mrn (e.g., 'MGH', 'BWH', 'CHOP'). Used in MRN display formatting and cross-facility reporting where the full facility_id FK is not needed for human-readable identification.
attributes.references: CMS Facility Certification; HL7 v2.x PID-3 Patient Identifier List

attributes.name: source_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this patient identifier record in the originating source system (Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, HIE). Distinct from updated_timestamp which reflects the lakehouse record update time. Used for source-to-target reconciliation and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Meta.lastUpdated; HL7 v2.x EVN-2 Recorded Date/Time

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system that issued or manages this identifier record. Identifies whether the crosswalk record originated from Epic EMPI, Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH Expanse, a Health Information Exchange (HIE), a payer system, or manual entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Epic|Cerner|MEDITECH|HIE|Payer|Manual|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 MessageHeader.source; HL7 v2.x MSH segment

attributes.name: source_system_identifier

products.name: patient_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment and coverage relationship between a patient (MPI record) and a health insurance plan. It captures the complete lifecycle of insurance coverage including enrollment periods, member identification, coordination of benefits priority, coverage tier, and relationship to the primary subscriber. Each record represents one patient's enrollment in one health plan during a specific time period, supporting scenarios where patients have multiple concurrent coverages (e.g., dual Medicare/Medicaid, COB scenarios) or sequential coverages over time (job changes, plan switches). This is the authoritative source for coverage verification, eligibility determination, and claims adjudication routing.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, patients routinely have multiple health plan coverages simultaneously (dual Medicare/Medicaid eligibility, primary employer coverage plus spouse's plan for COB, retiree supplemental coverage) and sequentially over time (job changes, aging into Medicare, Medicaid eligibility changes). Each health plan covers thousands to millions of patients. The business actively manages these coverage relationships as operational records with specific enrollment periods, member IDs per plan, COB priority sequencing, coverage tier assignments, and eligibility verification workflows.

products.name: quality_measure_evaluation
products.description: This association product represents the evaluation of individual patients against specific quality measures across measurement periods. It captures population health gap management, quality reporting compliance tracking, and patient-level measure performance. Each record links one patient demographics profile to one quality measure with attributes tracking eligibility determination, compliance status, gap identification, and closure activities. This is the operational foundation for HEDIS reporting, CMS eCQM submission, MIPS quality performance, value-based care gap closure workflows, and population health outreach campaigns.. Existence Justification: In healthcare quality management, each patient is evaluated against multiple quality measures (HEDIS, CMS eCQMs, MIPS) across measurement years, and each quality measure is evaluated against thousands of eligible patients. The business actively manages these patient-measure evaluations as operational records, tracking denominator eligibility, numerator compliance, gap identification, outreach attempts, and closure activities. This is the core operational entity for population health gap closure workflows, HEDIS submission, VBP performance improvement, and care management prioritization.

products.name: program_enrollment

It captures patient participation in CMS Value-Based Purchasing, MIPS, HEDIS, ACO, and other quality improvement programs. Each record links one patient to one quality program with enrollment dates, risk stratification, eligibility status, and program-specific performance tracking. SSOT for quality program membership, risk tier assignment, and patient-level program participation tracking. Supports CMS quality reporting, risk-adjusted outcome calculation, and program-specific patient cohort identification.. The enrollment relationship is actively managed by quality teams who create enrollment records, assign risk tiers, track eligibility periods, and manage disenrollments based on program-specific criteria.

domains.name: encounter
domains.description: Core operational record of every patient-provider interaction. Owns ADT (Admit, Discharge, Transfer) events, visit types (inpatient, outpatient, ED, observation, telehealth), admission source and disposition, attending and consulting providers, LOS (Length of Stay), DRG assignment, discharge status, and care setting transitions. Central hub linking patient, provider, clinical, and billing domains.
domains.references: HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource, HL7 ADT Messages, UB-04, CMS-1500

products.name: visit
products.description: Core master record for every patient-provider interaction across all care settings (inpatient, outpatient, ED, observation, telehealth, ambulatory). Central hub of the encounter domain and primary linkage point to patient, provider, clinical, and billing domains. Captures visit type, care setting, facility, attending provider, financial class, and visit status. Owns the full admission-through-discharge lifecycle: admission type (elective, urgent, emergent, newborn, trauma), admission source (ED, direct, transfer, referral, birth), admitting diagnosis, admitting provider, insurance verification at admission, admission and discharge timestamps, discharge disposition (home, SNF, rehab, AMA, expired, hospice, transfer), discharging provider, discharge instructions issued, discharge diagnosis summary, LOS (Length of Stay), readmission risk score, follow-up scheduling, and care transition plan. For observation encounters: two-midnight rule compliance assessment, MOON (Medicare Outpatient Observation Notice) delivery timestamp, total observation hours, conversion-to-inpatient flag and timestamp, and financial impact assessment. For telehealth encounters: platform, connection quality, and session metadata. Includes EMTALA compliance flags, consent status at admission, DRG assignment reference, CMI contribution, and financial class. SSOT for all encounter-level identity, classification, lifecycle state, admission, discharge, observation management, and care setting attributes.

attributes.description: Date and time when the provider's active participation in this visit began. Used for time-bounded care team tracking, shift coverage analysis, and provider performance analytics per encounter.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.participant.period.start; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart Care Team

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider's assignment to this visit. 'active' indicates current participation; 'transferred' indicates a handoff to another provider has occurred; 'cancelled' indicates the assignment was voided.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.participant; Epic ClinDoc Provider Assignment Workflow

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the provider came to be assigned to this visit — whether through scheduled care, unscheduled walk-in, emergency response, on-call coverage, or formal consult request. Supports operational staffing and care coordination analytics.
attributes.references: Epic Cadence Scheduling; Cerner PowerChart Care Team; HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.participant

attributes.name: billing_provider_npi
attributes.description: The NPI (National Provider Identifier) used specifically for billing and claims submission for services rendered by this provider during this visit. May differ from the rendering provider NPI when billing under a group practice or supervising physician.
attributes.references: CMS NPPES; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS-1500 Box 33a; UB-04 FL 56

attributes.name: care_setting
attributes.description: The clinical care setting in which the provider is participating for this visit (e.g., inpatient, outpatient, ED (Emergency Department), observation, telehealth, surgical, ICU (Intensive Care Unit)). Supports care setting-specific analytics and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|ed|observation|telehealth|surgical|icu — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes; HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.class; UB-04 Bill Type

attributes.name: care_team_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number indicating the order in which this provider was added to the visit care team. Used to reconstruct care team composition history and identify primary vs. secondary team members in chronological order.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — CareTeam Resource; Epic ClinDoc Care Team; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by clinical staff regarding this provider's assignment to the visit. May include coverage rationale, special instructions, or handoff context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Provider Assignment Notes; Cerner PowerChart Care Team Comments

attributes.name: cosignature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's clinical documentation for this visit requires co-signature by a supervising physician (e.g., resident or student notes requiring attending co-signature). Supports CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement) workflow and compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Teaching Physician Guidelines; The Joint Commission Medical Staff Standards; Epic ClinDoc Co-Signature Workflow

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this visit-provider association record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 — Security Rule; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: credentialing_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's credentials and privileges were verified as current and active at the time of this visit assignment. Supports Joint Commission credentialing compliance and risk management.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Medical Staff Standards MS.06.01.01; Symplr Credentialing; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: drg_attribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider's assignment is attributed to the DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) assignment for inpatient billing purposes. The attending of record's DRG attribution drives inpatient reimbursement under CMS IPPS.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS — DRG Grouping; 3M Health Information Systems Grouper; UB-04 FL 76

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this provider assignment became effective for the visit. Used for date-level scheduling, staffing reports, and daily census attribution distinct from the precise assignment_start_timestamp.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.participant.period; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: handoff_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or note key pointing to the handoff documentation record created when this provider transferred care responsibility to another provider. Supports care continuity, patient safety, and Joint Commission handoff communication standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — NPSG.02.05.01 (Handoff Communication); HL7 FHIR R4 — Communication Resource

attributes.name: is_attending_of_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider is designated as the attending physician of record for the visit. The attending of record bears overall clinical and legal responsibility for the patient's care and is reported on all billing claims.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR 482.13; UB-04 FL 76; CMS-1500 Box 31

attributes.name: is_primary_provider
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider holds primary clinical and billing responsibility for the visit. Only one provider per visit should have this flag set to True. Drives attending physician attribution on claims, UB-04, and CMS-1500 forms.
attributes.references: CMS Claim Form CMS-1500; UB-04 Uniform Billing Form; HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.participant

attributes.name: locum_tenens_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is serving in a locum tenens (temporary substitute) capacity for this visit. Locum tenens billing has specific CMS rules requiring the Q6 modifier on claims.
attributes.references: CMS Locum Tenens Billing Guidelines — Medicare Claims Processing Manual Chapter 1; CMS-1500

attributes.name: mips_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider's participation in this visit is eligible for MIPS (Merit-based Incentive Payment System) performance measurement under MACRA (Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act). Drives quality measure attribution.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS/MACRA — 42 CFR Part 414; NCQA HEDIS; QPP (Quality Payment Program)

attributes.name: note_count
attributes.description: Number of clinical notes authored or co-signed by this provider for this visit. Supports CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement) completeness tracking and provider documentation compliance reporting.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Medical Record Standards RC.02.01.01; Epic ClinDoc; HIM Standards

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the assigned provider as issued by CMS. Captured at time of assignment to support billing, claims adjudication, and RVU (Relative Value Unit) attribution independent of provider master record changes.
attributes.references: CMS — National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES); HIPAA Administrative Simplification 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: on_call_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider was assigned to the visit as part of an on-call coverage rotation rather than a scheduled or direct assignment. Supports on-call scheduling analytics and EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act) compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EMTALA — 42 CFR 489.24; The Joint Commission; Epic Cadence On-Call Scheduling

attributes.name: order_count
attributes.description: Number of clinical orders (lab, radiology, pharmacy, procedures) placed by this provider via CPOE (Computerized Physician Order Entry) for this visit. Supports provider ordering pattern analytics and CPOE adoption reporting.
attributes.references: Epic Orders (CPOE); Cerner PowerChart Orders; ONC Meaningful Use — CPOE Measure

attributes.name: participation_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total number of minutes the provider was actively engaged in this visit, calculated from assignment_start_timestamp to assignment_end_timestamp. Used for time-based billing (e.g., anesthesia, critical care), provider productivity reporting, and staffing analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Time-Based Billing Guidelines; AMA CPT Time-Based Codes; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit CMS Place of Service (POS) code indicating the setting where the provider rendered services during this visit (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room, 02=Telehealth). Required on CMS-1500 professional claims.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes — CMS-1500 Box 24B; AMA CPT Guidelines

attributes.name: privilege_type
attributes.description: The type of clinical privileges held by the provider at the facility for this visit assignment (e.g., full, provisional, temporary, locum tenens, telemedicine). Determines scope of permissible clinical activities.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Medical Staff Standards MS.06.01.05; Symplr Privileging; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR 482.22

attributes.name: provider_role
attributes.description: Clinical role of the provider for this specific visit assignment (e.g., attending, consulting, admitting, covering, resident, hospitalist, surgeon, anesthesiologist, PCP). Determines care team hierarchy, billing responsibility, and RVU attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: attending|consulting|admitting|covering|resident|hospitalist|surgeon|anesthesiologist|pcp|co_surgeon|scrub_tech|circulating_nurse|care_coordinator — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — Encounter.participant.type; CMS Claim Form CMS-1500; Epic ClinDoc Provider Role Codes

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider's credential type for this assignment (e.g., physician, NP (Nurse Practitioner), PA (Physician Assistant), resident, fellow, student, RN, CRNA). Determines billing rules, supervision requirements, and scope of practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physician|np|pa|resident|fellow|student|rn|crna|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider Type Codes; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy; State Scope of Practice Laws

attributes.name: rendering_provider_npi
attributes.description: The NPI (National Provider Identifier) of the individual clinician who actually rendered the service during this visit. Distinct from billing_provider_npi when services are billed under a group or supervising provider.
attributes.references: CMS NPPES; CMS-1500 Box 24J; UB-04 FL 82; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: rvu_credit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider assignment is eligible to receive RVU (Relative Value Unit) credit for services rendered during this visit. Used in provider productivity reporting, compensation modeling, and MIPS (Merit-based Incentive Payment System) performance tracking.
attributes.references: CMS — RBRVS (Resource-Based Relative Value Scale); AMA CPT RVU Guidelines; MACRA/MIPS

attributes.name: rvu_work_units
attributes.description: The physician work RVU (wRVU) value attributed to this provider for services rendered during this visit assignment. Sourced from CMS RBRVS fee schedule and used for provider productivity measurement and compensation calculations.
attributes.references: CMS — RBRVS Fee Schedule; AMA CPT RVU Guidelines; MIPS/MACRA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this provider assignment record was sourced (e.g., Epic ClinDoc, Cerner PowerChart, MEDITECH). Supports data lineage, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) audit, and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance — Data Lineage Standards; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this provider assignment record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic ClinDoc provider assignment ID, Cerner care team member ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance — Data Lineage Standards; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: specialty_at_assignment
attributes.description: The clinical specialty of the provider at the time of this visit assignment, captured as a point-in-time snapshot. Supports specialty-based care team analytics and quality reporting independent of provider master record updates.
attributes.references: CMS — Provider Specialty Codes; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy; HL7 FHIR R4 — Practitioner.qualification

attributes.name: telehealth_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's participation in this visit was conducted via telehealth modality. Affects billing modifier requirements, place of service codes, and state telehealth licensure compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services — 42 CFR 410.78; State Telehealth Parity Laws; Epic Telehealth Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this visit-provider association record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 — Security Rule; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

products.name: drg_assignment

Supports CMI (Case Mix Index) calculation, reimbursement optimization, and CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement) workflows. Sourced from 3M Health Information Systems grouper and Epic Resolute HB.
products.reference: MS-DRG / APR-DRG / CMS DRG Grouper

attributes.name: drg_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for drg_assignment

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hospital or care facility where the encounter occurred. Supports facility-level CMI benchmarking, regulatory reporting, and payer contract management.
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services; The Joint Commission; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the attending physician responsible for the encounter at the time of DRG assignment. Used for physician-level CMI reporting and CDI query targeting.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; NPI Registry; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: drg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.drg. Business justification: Core DRG grouping workflow—every DRG assignment must reference the official DRG definition for payment calculation, case mix index reporting, expected LOS comparison, and reimbursement validation. Ess

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HIM (Health Information Management) coder who finalized the DRG assignment. Supports coding productivity reporting, quality audits, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient associated with this DRG assignment, supporting CMI analysis and population health reporting.
attributes.references: Epic EHR MPI; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary payer (insurance plan) for this encounter. Determines which DRG version and payment methodology applies (e.g., MS-DRG for Medicare, APR-DRG for Medicaid managed care).

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inpatient or observation encounter for which this DRG assignment was generated. Links the DRG record to the core encounter event.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter Resource

attributes.name: actual_los
attributes.description: The actual number of days the patient was hospitalized for this encounter, calculated from admission to discharge. Compared against geometric and arithmetic mean LOS for efficiency and outlier analysis.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS; ALOS Benchmarking; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: admit_source_code
attributes.description: The UB-04 admission source code indicating how the patient was admitted (e.g., 1=Physician Referral, 4=Transfer from Hospital, 7=Emergency Room). Influences DRG grouping logic for certain MDCs.
attributes.references: UB-04 Uniform Billing Manual; CMS; NUBC

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any payer or RAC appeal related to this DRG assignment. Tracks the outcome of reimbursement disputes through the appeals process.
attributes.references: CMS RAC Program; CMS Appeals Process; OIG; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: arithmetic_mean_los
attributes.description: The arithmetic mean length of stay in days for the assigned DRG, published by CMS. Used alongside geometric mean LOS for outlier threshold determination and payer contract benchmarking.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the DRG assignment record: preliminary (initial grouping), final (coding complete and validated), amended (revised after CDI query or audit), or voided (invalidated). Drives revenue cycle workflow routing.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB; 3M CDI Workflow; AHIMA Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the DRG assignment: initial (first grouping at admission), working (interim CDI grouping), final (post-discharge coding), appeal (payer dispute), or rac_review (Recovery Audit Contractor review). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial|working|final|appeal|rac_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS RAC Program; AHIMA; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: base_payment_rate
attributes.description: The hospital-specific or payer-contracted base payment rate (in USD) applied to the DRG weight to calculate expected reimbursement. Reflects IPPS standardized amount or negotiated payer contract rate.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS Final Rule; Payer Contract Terms; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: cc_mcc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Complication and Comorbidity / Major Complication and Comorbidity (CC/MCC) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the encounter qualifies for a Complication and Comorbidity (CC) or Major Complication and Comorbidity (MCC) designation, which elevates the DRG tier and associated reimbursement weight. Critical CDI target for revenue optimization.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG CC/MCC Exclusion List; 3M Health Information Systems CDI

attributes.name: cdi_query_count
attributes.description: The number of CDI queries issued to the attending physician for this encounter to clarify or improve clinical documentation supporting the DRG assignment. Key CDI productivity and impact metric.
attributes.references: AHIMA CDI Practice Guidelines; 3M CDI; Epic CDI Workflow

attributes.name: cdi_query_response_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) Query Response Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether at least one CDI query for this encounter received a physician response that resulted in a documentation change affecting the DRG assignment. Measures CDI program effectiveness.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DRG assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discharge_status_code
attributes.description: The UB-04 patient discharge status code (01–99) indicating the disposition of the patient at discharge (e.g., 01=Home, 02=SNF, 20=Expired). Affects DRG payment under post-acute care transfer rules.
attributes.references: UB-04 Uniform Billing Manual; CMS; NUBC

attributes.name: drg_changed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DRG code was changed from the initial working DRG to the final assigned DRG, typically as a result of CDI query responses or coding review. Tracks CDI program impact on reimbursement.
attributes.references: AHIMA CDI; 3M Health Information Systems; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: drg_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the assigned DRG code (e.g., 'SIMPLE PNEUMONIA AND PLEURISY W MCC'). Used in clinical documentation improvement workflows and reimbursement reporting.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M Health Information Systems

attributes.name: drg_version
attributes.description: The DRG classification system version used for grouping: MS-DRG (Medicare Severity), APR-DRG (All Patient Refined), or IR-DRG (International Refined). Determines the applicable reimbursement methodology and payer contract.

attributes.name: drg_version_number
attributes.description: The specific fiscal year or release version of the DRG grouper applied (e.g., 'v41' for MS-DRG Version 41). Required for audit trails and reimbursement reconciliation across fiscal year transitions.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Annual Update; 3M Health Information Systems Grouper Release Notes

attributes.name: drg_weight
attributes.description: The relative weight assigned to the DRG, reflecting the average resource intensity of cases in that group relative to the average Medicare case. Used to calculate CMI and expected reimbursement from the base payment rate.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Relative Weights Table; 3M APR-DRG Weight Tables

attributes.name: expected_reimbursement
attributes.description: The calculated expected reimbursement amount (in USD) derived from DRG weight multiplied by the base payment rate, before outlier adjustments. Used for revenue forecasting and variance analysis against actual payments.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS; Payer Contract Terms; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: finalized_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the DRG assignment was finalized by the coding team, triggering claim submission eligibility. Key milestone in the revenue cycle management workflow.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB; CMS Timely Filing Requirements; AHIMA

attributes.name: geometric_mean_los
attributes.description: The geometric mean length of stay in days for the assigned DRG, published by CMS. Used as a benchmark for LOS efficiency analysis and outlier payment threshold calculations.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; ALOS Benchmarking

attributes.name: grouper_software
attributes.description: Name of the DRG grouper software used to assign the DRG (e.g., '3M Grouper Plus', 'OptumInsight Encoder'). Required for audit trails and reimbursement dispute resolution.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems; CMS Grouper Certification

attributes.name: grouper_software_version
attributes.description: The specific release version of the grouper software applied (e.g., '3M Grouper Plus v32.1'). Critical for audit compliance and reimbursement reconciliation when grouper logic changes between versions.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems Release Notes; CMS Grouper Certification

attributes.name: grouping_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the DRG grouper software was executed and the DRG code was assigned. Used for tracking CDI workflow timelines and coding productivity.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: initial_drg_code
attributes.description: The DRG code assigned at the initial working grouping (typically at admission or during the stay), before final coding and CDI review. Compared against the final DRG to measure CDI program impact and reimbursement uplift.

attributes.name: initial_drg_weight
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Working Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) Relative Weight
attributes.description: The DRG relative weight associated with the initial working DRG code. Used to calculate the reimbursement uplift achieved through CDI and coding optimization.

attributes.name: is_outlier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this encounter qualifies as a cost outlier under CMS IPPS policy, triggering additional outlier payment beyond the standard DRG payment. True when actual costs exceed the fixed-loss threshold.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS Cost Outlier Policy; 42 CFR §412.84

attributes.name: mdc_code
attributes.description: The Major Diagnostic Category code (01–25 plus PRE for pre-MDC) that serves as the primary clinical grouping tier above the DRG. Derived from the principal diagnosis and used for service-line analytics and CMI benchmarking.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M APR-DRG Grouper

attributes.name: mdc_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the MDC (e.g., 'Diseases and Disorders of the Respiratory System'). Supports service-line reporting and clinical program analytics.

attributes.name: outlier_payment
attributes.description: Additional payment amount (in USD) approved for high-cost outlier cases where actual costs exceed the fixed-loss outlier threshold. Applicable under CMS IPPS cost outlier policy.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS Cost Outlier Policy; 42 CFR §412.84

attributes.name: patient_type
attributes.description: Classifies the encounter type for DRG assignment purposes: inpatient (full admission), observation (outpatient observation status), or short_stay. Determines DRG applicability and reimbursement methodology.
attributes.references: CMS Two-Midnight Rule; 42 CFR §412; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: The ICD-10-CM code for the principal diagnosis — the condition established after study to be chiefly responsible for the admission. Drives DRG grouping logic and is a key CDI target for reimbursement optimization.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting; CMS; WHO; UHDDS Definition of Principal Diagnosis

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the principal ICD-10-CM diagnosis code. Supports CDI workflow review, clinical documentation audits, and payer communication.

attributes.name: principal_procedure_code
attributes.description: The ICD-10-PCS code for the principal procedure performed during the encounter. Surgical procedures are the primary driver of DRG partition assignment (surgical vs. medical) and reimbursement weight.

attributes.name: procedure_count
attributes.description: The total number of ICD-10-PCS procedure codes submitted on the claim. Surgical procedures drive DRG assignment into surgical partitions, significantly affecting reimbursement weight.

attributes.name: rac_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG assignment has been selected for review by a Recovery Audit Contractor (RAC) under the CMS RAC program. Triggers additional documentation retention and appeal workflow.
attributes.references: CMS RAC Program; OIG Compliance; 42 CFR §422.311

attributes.name: secondary_diagnosis_count
attributes.description: The total number of secondary (additional) ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes submitted on the claim. Influences CC/MCC determination and DRG tier assignment; a key CDI metric for documentation completeness.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; CMS; AHIMA CDI

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this DRG assignment record was sourced (e.g., Epic Resolute HB, 3M Grouper Plus). Required for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit purposes.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: transfer_case_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this encounter is a transfer case subject to the post-acute care transfer (PACT) policy, which may reduce DRG payment when the patient is transferred to a post-acute care setting before the geometric mean LOS.
attributes.references: CMS Post-Acute Care Transfer Policy; 42 CFR §412.4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DRG assignment record was last modified. Tracks amendments from CDI queries, coding audits, or payer appeals.
