attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: board_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician holds active board certification from an ABMS-recognized specialty board in their primary specialty. True = currently board certified; False = not board certified or certification lapsed. Used in credentialing, network adequacy, and quality reporting.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC); NCQA

attributes.name: caqh_provider_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Provider ID
attributes.description: Unique 8-digit identifier assigned to the clinician in the CAQH ProView universal credentialing database. Used to streamline payer credentialing and enrollment by providing a single repository of provider credentials. Sourced from Symplr and CAQH ProView.
attributes.references: CAQH ProView; NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: clinician_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the clinician's professional category. Drives role-based access, workflow routing, and analytics segmentation. Physician includes MD/DO; advanced_practice includes NP/PA; nursing includes RN/LPN; allied_health includes PT/OT/RT; pharmacy includes PharmD/RPh; behavioral_health includes LCSW/psychologist.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Practitioner; CMS Provider Taxonomy; NPPES

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the clinician record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Represents the record audit creation time in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and HIPAA audit log requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician's current credentialing approval expires and re-credentialing must be completed. Typically a 2-year cycle per Joint Commission standards. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows in Symplr.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the clinician's credentialing and privileging review within the organization. Credentialed indicates approved to practice; pending indicates initial or re-credentialing in progress; expired indicates lapsed credentials requiring renewal. Sourced from Symplr credentialing system.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Clinician's date of birth. Used for identity verification during credentialing, primary source verification, and DEA registration. PHI/PII — access restricted per HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HL7 FHIR R4 Practitioner; DEA Registration

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number authorizing the clinician to prescribe controlled substances. Format is two letters followed by seven digits. Required for prescribing Schedule II–V medications. Sourced from Symplr credentialing and Epic Willow pharmacy module.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment lifecycle status of the clinician within the organization. Active indicates currently practicing; on_leave includes FMLA and medical leave; suspended indicates temporary practice restriction; terminated indicates separation. Sourced from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; OIG Exclusion List

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the clinician's employment relationship with the healthcare organization. Drives payroll processing, malpractice coverage determination, and credentialing workflows. Sourced from Workday HCM Core HR.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; IRS Worker Classification Guidelines; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: fellowship_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician completed their fellowship training program. Nullable for clinicians without fellowship training. Used for subspecialty credentialing and privileging decisions. Sourced from Symplr.
attributes.references: ACGME; ABMS; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: fellowship_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the fellowship training program completed by the clinician (e.g., Interventional Cardiology Fellowship at Cleveland Clinic). Part of the embedded postgraduate training history per the clinician product SSOT definition. Nullable for clinicians without fellowship training. Sourced from Symplr.
attributes.references: ACGME; ABMS; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the clinician as recorded in the provider master. Used for identity verification, credentialing, and provider directory display. Sourced from Epic EHR provider master and Symplr.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Clinician's self-reported gender identity. Used for workforce diversity reporting, EEOC compliance, and provider directory display where applicable. Restricted per HIPAA and applicable employment privacy regulations.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; EEOC; HL7 FHIR R4 Practitioner

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician was officially hired or onboarded by the healthcare organization. Used for tenure calculations, benefits eligibility, and workforce analytics. Sourced from Workday HCM Core HR.

attributes.name: internship_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician completed their internship or PGY-1 training. Nullable where internship is embedded within residency program. Sourced from Symplr primary source verification.

attributes.name: internship_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the internship or postgraduate year 1 (PGY-1) program completed by the clinician. Part of the embedded postgraduate training history per the clinician product SSOT definition. Nullable for clinicians where internship is embedded within residency. Sourced from Symplr.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family) name of the clinician as recorded in the provider master. Used for identity verification, credentialing, provider directory, and billing. Sourced from Epic EHR provider master and Symplr.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the clinician's primary state medical or professional license. Used by credentialing teams to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous practice authorization. Sourced from Symplr credentialing.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the jurisdiction that issued the primary state medical or professional license. Used for practice authorization validation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the clinician's professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy. Used to ensure continuous coverage and trigger renewal alerts in Symplr credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the clinician's professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage. Required for credentialing and hospital privileging. Sourced from Symplr credentialing. Confidential business data.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: medicaid_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician is actively enrolled as a Medicaid provider in their primary state. True = enrolled and active; False = not enrolled. Critical for revenue cycle management and claims submission for Medicaid patients.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Provider Enrollment; State Departments of Health; 42 CFR Part 455

attributes.name: medical_degree
attributes.description: Highest professional degree awarded to the clinician upon completion of medical or professional school (e.g., MD, DO, MBBS, PharmD, DNP). Used in credentialing, provider directory, and billing. Sourced from Symplr primary source verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|DO|MBBS|PharmD|PhD|DNP|MSN|PA|NP|DDS|DPM — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LCME; AOA (American Osteopathic Association); ACPE; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: medical_school_graduation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician graduated from medical or professional school and received their degree. Used for credentialing, primary source verification, and training history completeness. Sourced from Symplr.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: medical_school_name
attributes.description: Name of the institution from which the clinician received their medical or professional degree (e.g., Johns Hopkins School of Medicine). Part of the embedded education history per the clinician product SSOT definition. Sourced from Symplr credentialing primary source verification.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; LCME (Liaison Committee on Medical Education)

attributes.name: medicare_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician is actively enrolled as a Medicare provider with CMS. True = enrolled and active; False = not enrolled or opted out. Critical for revenue cycle management and claims submission. Sourced from CMS PECOS (Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System).
attributes.references: CMS PECOS; 42 CFR Part 424; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the clinician. Used for identity disambiguation when first and last names are not unique. Sourced from Epic EHR provider master.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName

attributes.name: name_suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the clinician's name (e.g., Jr., Sr., II, III). Distinct from professional credentials/degrees which are stored separately.

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the clinician was screened against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE). CMS requires monthly screening for all providers billing federal healthcare programs.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; CMS Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR Part 1001

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician has been screened against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE). Required monthly per CMS guidance to prevent billing for services rendered by excluded providers. True = checked and clear; False = not yet checked or excluded.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; CMS Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR Part 1001

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Aggregate enrollment status of the clinician with payers for billing purposes. Enrolled indicates the clinician is credentialed and enrolled with at least one active payer; pending indicates enrollment applications in progress. Detailed per-payer enrollment is tracked in the provider_payer_enrollment product. Sourced from Symplr provider enrollment module.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Provider Enrollment; CAQH ProView

attributes.name: primary_source_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician's credentials (education, training, licensure) have been verified directly with the issuing source (primary source verification) as required by The Joint Commission and NCQA credentialing standards. True = verified; False = not yet verified or verification pending.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC

attributes.name: professional_designation
attributes.description: Highest or primary professional credential/degree designation displayed after the clinician's name (e.g., MD, DO, NP, PA-C, RN, PharmD, PhD). Used in provider directories, clinical documentation headers, and credentialing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|DO|NP|PA-C|RN|PharmD|PhD|DDS|DPM|OD|CRNA|CNM|LCSW|PT|OT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT; HL7 FHIR R4 Practitioner.qualification; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: residency_acgme_accredited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician's residency program was accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) at the time of completion. True = ACGME accredited; False = not accredited or international program. Required for privileging decisions.

attributes.name: residency_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician completed their postgraduate residency training program. Used for credentialing and training history verification. Nullable for clinicians who did not complete a residency (e.g., some allied health professionals). Sourced from Symplr.
attributes.references: ACGME; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: residency_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the ACGME-accredited residency program completed by the clinician (e.g., Internal Medicine Residency at Massachusetts General Hospital). Part of the embedded postgraduate training history per the clinician product SSOT definition. Sourced from Symplr.
attributes.references: ACGME (Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: secondary_specialty
attributes.description: The clinician's secondary or subspecialty designation (e.g., Interventional Cardiology, Pediatric Neurology). Nullable when the clinician has only one specialty. Used for advanced referral routing and network adequacy analysis.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); NUCC Taxonomy

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: Primary state medical or professional license number issued by the applicable state licensing board. Represents the clinician's authorization to practice in their primary state of licensure. Additional multi-state licenses are tracked in the clinician_license product.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the clinician's employment or engagement with the organization ended. Nullable for active clinicians. Used to deactivate system access, revoke privileges, and trigger payer disenrollment workflows. Sourced from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the clinician record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance. Updated on every write operation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: Clinician's primary organizational work email address. Used for secure communications, system access provisioning, credentialing notifications, and provider directory. Sourced from Workday HCM and Epic provider master.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Clinician's primary work phone number including direct line or pager number. Used for clinical communications, on-call scheduling, and credentialing contact. Sourced from Epic provider master and Workday HCM.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HL7 FHIR R4 ContactPoint

products.name: org_provider
products.description: Master record for organizational providers including hospitals, clinics, group practices, outpatient facilities, and integrated delivery networks. Captures organizational NPI (Type 2), tax identification number, CMS certification number, facility type, accreditation status, and organizational hierarchy. Distinct from individual clinician records.
products.reference: CMS Provider Enrollment, NPPES Type 2 NPI

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the organizational provider record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the org_provider data product.

attributes.name: accreditation_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_status. Business justification: Healthcare organizations hold accreditations (TJC, DNV, AAAHC). Compliance teams track accreditation status by facility for deemed status determination, public reporting (CMS Hospital Compare), and su

attributes.name: business_associate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.business_associate_agreement. Business justification: Healthcare organizations execute BAAs with business associates (billing vendors, EHR vendors, transcription services). HIPAA compliance requires tracking BAA coverage for all PHI-sharing relationships

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Organizational providers operate as financial entities with dedicated cost centers for revenue and expense tracking, budget management, and financial statement preparation. Core to multi-entity health

attributes.name: reference_npi_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.npi_registry. Business justification: Organizations validate against NPI registry for CMS certification, PECOS enrollment, and organizational credentialing. Healthcare operations require this for Type 2 NPI validation, authorized official

attributes.name: taxonomy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_taxonomy. Business justification: Organizational provider's taxonomy code should reference provider_taxonomy table. Removes taxonomy_code STRING.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The accrediting organization that granted the current accreditation status (e.g., The Joint Commission (TJC), DNV GL Healthcare, Healthcare Facilities Accreditation Program (HFAP), Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TJC|DNV_GL|HFAP|AAAHC|ACHC|CARF|URAC|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Deemed Status Accrediting Organizations; AHRQ

attributes.name: accreditation_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current accreditation certificate expires. Used to trigger renewal workflows and monitor compliance with accreditation maintenance requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Accreditation Standards; CMS Deemed Status

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the organizational provider as granted by a recognized accrediting body (e.g., The Joint Commission, DNV GL, HFAP, AAAHC). Accreditation is required for Medicare deemed status and quality program participation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Accreditation Standards; CMS Deemed Status (42 CFR 488.1); DNV GL Healthcare

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the organizational provider's physical service location. Used for claims billing, provider directory, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; CMS Provider Enrollment; USPS Address Standards

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, floor, building) for the organizational provider's physical service location.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; CMS Provider Enrollment; USPS Address Standards

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: The total number of licensed inpatient beds at the facility as reported to the state Department of Health and CMS. Used for capacity planning, DRG-based reimbursement analysis, and regulatory reporting. Applicable to inpatient facilities; null for outpatient-only organizations.
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services File; State Department of Health Facility Licensing; AHA Annual Survey

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the organizational provider's primary service location. Used for geographic network analysis, provider directory, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.description: The 6-digit CMS Certification Number (formerly Medicare Provider Number) assigned to certified healthcare facilities by CMS. Required for Medicare and Medicaid participation and cost reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Certification and Survey Provider Enhanced Reports (CASPER); 42 CFR Part 489

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County of the organizational provider's primary service location. Used for population health management, HRSA Health Professional Shortage Area (HPSA) designation, and rural health program eligibility.
attributes.references: HRSA HPSA Designation; CMS Rural Health Programs; FIPS County Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the organizational provider record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA audit log requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR 164.312); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organizational provider's current credentialing cycle expires. Triggers re-credentialing workflows in Symplr to maintain uninterrupted network participation and claims payment eligibility.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards (CR 1); Symplr Credentialing; URAC

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the organizational provider as maintained in the credentialing system (Symplr). Tracks whether the organization has completed payer and network credentialing requirements for participation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: critical_access_hospital_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds Critical Access Hospital (CAH) designation from CMS, qualifying it for cost-based Medicare reimbursement. CAH designation requires rural location, 25 or fewer acute care beds, and 24/7 emergency services.
attributes.references: CMS Critical Access Hospital Program (42 CFR Part 485 Subpart F); HRSA Rural Health

attributes.name: disproportionate_share_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility qualifies for CMS Disproportionate Share Hospital (DSH) payment adjustments, which compensate hospitals serving a high proportion of low-income and Medicaid patients.
attributes.references: CMS DSH Program (42 CFR 412.106); ACA Section 3133

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: The trade or operating name under which the organization conducts business if different from the legal name. Commonly used in patient-facing communications and signage.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; State Business Registration

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organizational provider record became effective and the organization was authorized to participate in applicable programs and networks. Used for enrollment tracking and retroactive claims adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS PECOS; NPPES NPI Registry; Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: ehr_system
attributes.description: The primary Electronic Health Record (EHR) or Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system deployed at the organizational provider. Used for HIE connectivity planning, HL7/FHIR interface configuration, and interoperability assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: epic|cerner|meditech|allscripts|athenahealth|other|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ONC Health IT Certification Program; HL7 FHIR R4; 21st Century Cures Act (Interoperability Rule)

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current CMS enrollment status of the organizational provider in Medicare and/or Medicaid programs. Distinct from general provider_status; specifically tracks payer program participation eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS PECOS; 42 CFR Part 424 Subpart P; OIG Exclusion List

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational provider by facility type (e.g., acute care hospital, critical access hospital, ambulatory surgery center, federally qualified health center, skilled nursing facility, outpatient clinic, group practice). Drives billing rules, regulatory requirements, and reimbursement methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acute_care_hospital|critical_access_hospital|ambulatory_surgery_center|federally_qualified_health_center|skilled_nursing_facility|outpatient_clinic|group_practice|long_term_care|behavioral_health|home_health|hospice|urgent_care — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services File; 42 CFR Part 482; Joint Commission Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: fax
attributes.description: Primary fax number for the organizational provider. Used for clinical document transmission, referral communications, and payer correspondence in compliance with HIPAA secure transmission requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164); NPPES NPI Registry

attributes.name: fhir_endpoint_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Endpoint URL
attributes.description: The base URL of the organizational provider's HL7 FHIR R4 API endpoint for electronic health information exchange. Required under the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule for payer-to-provider data exchange.
attributes.references: CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule (CMS-9115-F); HL7 FHIR R4; ONC 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the organizational provider as registered with state licensing authorities, CMS, and the IRS. Used for billing, contracting, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; IRS EIN Registration; State Department of Health Facility Licensing

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code where the facility operating license was issued. Determines applicable state regulatory requirements and Medicaid program participation rules.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; State Department of Health

attributes.name: medicaid_provider_number
attributes.description: State-assigned Medicaid provider identification number for the organizational provider. Required for Medicaid claims submission and program participation. Format varies by state Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS).
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Program; State MMIS; 42 CFR Part 455

attributes.name: medicare_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organizational provider has an active Medicare participation agreement with CMS, authorizing it to bill Medicare for covered services at the Medicare-approved rate.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Participation Agreement (42 CFR 424.516); CMS PECOS

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the organizational provider's participation in contracted payer networks. Drives claims adjudication, patient cost-sharing calculations, and network adequacy reporting to state and federal regulators.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards (45 CFR 156.230); NCQA Network Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organizational provider is currently listed on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Excluded providers are prohibited from participating in federal healthcare programs. Must be checked prior to contracting and claims payment.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE (42 USC 1320a-7); CMS Exclusion Screening Requirements

attributes.name: organization_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the organizational provider's structural type (e.g., hospital, clinic, group practice, Accountable Care Organization (ACO), Integrated Delivery Organization (IDO), health system, outpatient center). Distinct from facility_type which captures the CMS/regulatory classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hospital|clinic|group_practice|aco|ido|health_system|outpatient_center — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS ACO Program; CMS Provider of Services File; HL7 FHIR Organization Resource

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: The ownership classification of the organizational provider indicating whether it is non-profit, for-profit, government-owned, tribal, or faith-based. Affects tax status, CMS cost reporting requirements, and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: IRS 501(c)(3); CMS Cost Report (Form CMS-2552); OIG Ownership Disclosure

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the organizational provider's main administrative or clinical contact line. Used for referral coordination, payer communications, and provider directory.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; CMS Provider Enrollment; Joint Commission

attributes.name: primary_specialty
attributes.description: The primary clinical specialty or service line of the organizational provider as designated in NPPES and CMS enrollment records (e.g., General Acute Care Hospital, Multispecialty Group Practice, Radiology Center). Used for network directory, referral routing, and quality reporting.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; CMS Provider Specialty Codes; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: provider_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational provider record. Drives eligibility for claims submission, referral routing, and network directory inclusion. 'Active' indicates the organization is currently enrolled and operational; 'pending' indicates enrollment or credentialing in progress.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS); Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusion Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organizational provider is listed in the federal SAM.gov exclusions database, which prohibits participation in federal contracts and assistance programs including CMS programs.
attributes.references: SAM.gov Federal Exclusions; 2 CFR Part 180; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this organizational provider record was sourced (e.g., Epic, Cerner Millennium, Symplr, NPPES, CMS PECOS). Used for data lineage tracking and master data management reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: epic|cerner|meditech|symplr|nppes|pecos|manual|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the organizational provider's primary service location. Determines applicable state regulations, Medicaid program rules, and network adequacy requirements.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; USPS State Abbreviations; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: state_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the state-issued facility operating license. Triggers license renewal workflows and compliance monitoring to prevent lapse in operating authority.
attributes.references: State Department of Health Facility Licensing; Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: The facility license number issued by the state Department of Health authorizing the organization to operate as a healthcare facility. Required for state regulatory compliance and CMS certification.
attributes.references: State Department of Health Facility Licensing; 42 CFR Part 482; Joint Commission

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Identification Number (TIN) / Employer Identification Number (EIN)
attributes.description: The federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the IRS to the organizational provider. Required for claims billing, 1099 reporting, and payer contracting.
attributes.references: IRS EIN; CMS Claim Form UB-04; CMS-1500; HIPAA 837 Transaction

attributes.name: teaching_status
attributes.description: Designation of the facility's teaching status as recognized by CMS for Indirect Medical Education (IME) and Direct Graduate Medical Education (DGME) payment adjustments. Major teaching hospitals have a resident-to-bed ratio above CMS thresholds.
attributes.references: CMS IME/DGME Payment Rules (42 CFR 412.105); ACGME Accreditation

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organizational provider's participation or enrollment was terminated. Null for active providers. Used for claims adjudication, network directory management, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CMS PECOS; CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: The American College of Surgeons (ACS) or state-designated trauma center level (I through V) indicating the facility's trauma care capability. Level I provides the highest level of comprehensive trauma care. Used for ED routing, transfer protocols, and quality reporting.
attributes.references: American College of Surgeons (ACS) Trauma Center Verification; State Trauma System Designation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the organizational provider record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR 164.312); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The public-facing website URL of the organizational provider. Used in provider directory, patient portal, and Salesforce Health Cloud patient relationship management.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 45 CFR 156.230 (Network Adequacy)

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the organizational provider's primary service location. Used for geographic network analysis, population health mapping, and claims processing.
attributes.references: NPPES NPI Registry; USPS ZIP Code Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment

products.name: specialty
products.description: Unified reference catalog of recognized medical and clinical specialties, subspecialties, and NUCC (National Uniform Claim Committee) Health Care Provider Taxonomy classifications. Includes specialty code, NUCC taxonomy code, provider type, classification, specialization, board certification body, specialty category, CMS crosswalk to specialty codes, effective date, and whether the specialty requires additional credentialing. Serves as the single consolidated SSOT for all provider classification, taxonomy, and specialization data — no other product in this domain stores NUCC taxonomy codes, provider taxonomy classifications, or specialty definitions. Used for provider directory publishing, network management, referral routing, NPI registry alignment, claims submission specialty coding, payer enrollment specialty validation, and CMS provider enrollment taxonomy reporting.
products.reference: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each specialty record in the provider specialty reference catalog. Primary key for the specialty data product. [REFERENCE_LOOKUP role — canonical_skip_reason: This entity is a reference/lookup catalog of recognized medical specialties and NUCC taxonomy classifications; per-role minimums for REFERENCE_LOOKUP are exempt.]
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: primary_icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Specialties have primary diagnosis domains for referral routing, utilization management, and network adequacy calculations. Healthcare operations use this for automated referral validation, specialty-

attributes.name: snomed_concept_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT) Concept ID
attributes.description: The SNOMED CT concept identifier corresponding to this specialty for clinical terminology interoperability and HL7 FHIR resource alignment. Supports HIE data exchange and FHIR PractitionerRole resource population.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR R4 PractitionerRole Resource; ONC Interoperability Standards

attributes.name: abms_board_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Board Name
attributes.description: The specific American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) member board responsible for certifying physicians in this specialty (e.g., 'American Board of Internal Medicine', 'American Board of Pediatrics'). Used in credentialing verification and Symplr primary source verification workflows.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); AOA Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: acgme_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) Program Code
attributes.description: The ACGME program specialty code used to identify accredited residency and fellowship training programs in this specialty. Used for graduate medical education (GME) tracking, resident credentialing, and workforce planning in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME); CMS GME Reimbursement Rules 42 CFR Part 413

attributes.name: additional_credentialing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty requires additional credentialing steps beyond standard privileging (e.g., DEA registration for controlled substance prescribing, specific procedural competency assessments, or state-mandated specialty certifications). Drives credentialing workflow routing in Symplr.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; DEA Controlled Substances Act; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: board_certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the recognized medical board or certifying organization that issues board certification for this specialty (e.g., 'American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM)', 'American Board of Surgery (ABS)', 'American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology (ABPN)'). Used in credentialing workflows and provider directory publishing.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA) Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: board_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification is required for a provider to be credentialed and privileged in this specialty at the organization. When true, credentialing workflows in Symplr enforce board certification verification before granting privileges.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: cms_enrollment_specialty_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Enrollment Specialty Type
attributes.description: The CMS-defined specialty type label used on provider enrollment applications (CMS-855 series forms) for Medicare and Medicaid enrollment. Distinct from the two-digit CMS specialty code; represents the descriptive label used in enrollment workflows.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Form CMS-855I/CMS-855B; 42 CFR Part 424; CMS Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS)

attributes.name: cms_specialty_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Specialty Code
attributes.description: The two-digit CMS specialty code used in Medicare and Medicaid claims processing and provider enrollment. Derived from the CMS crosswalk to NUCC taxonomy codes. Required for CMS-1500 and UB-04 claim form submission and CMS provider enrollment taxonomy reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Specialty Codes; CMS-1500 Claim Form; UB-04 Uniform Billing Form; 42 CFR Part 424

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this specialty record was first created in the enterprise reference catalog. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: dea_registration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Registration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are required to hold an active DEA registration number for controlled substance prescribing authority. Relevant for specialties such as pain management, psychiatry, and anesthesiology. Used in payer enrollment and credentialing validation.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act 21 CFR Part 1301; CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of specialties in provider directory user interfaces, credentialing dropdown menus, and referral routing selection screens. Lower values appear first in sorted lists.
attributes.references: Enterprise Provider Directory UI Standards; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this specialty code and its associated NUCC taxonomy classification became effective and valid for use in provider credentialing, enrollment, and claims submission. Supports temporal validity tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set Versioning; CMS Provider Enrollment; 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this specialty code and taxonomy classification was retired, superseded, or became invalid. Null indicates the specialty is currently active. Used to enforce temporal validity in claims submission and provider enrollment workflows.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set Versioning; CMS Provider Enrollment; 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: fhir_practitioner_role_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Practitioner Role Code
attributes.description: The HL7 FHIR R4 PractitionerRole.code value corresponding to this specialty for FHIR-compliant API responses and HIE data exchange. Enables alignment with FHIR-based provider directory publishing and ONC interoperability requirements.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 PractitionerRole Resource; ONC 21st Century Cures Act Interoperability Rule; 45 CFR Part 170

attributes.name: hedis_measure_set
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure Set
attributes.description: Identifies the applicable HEDIS measure set(s) associated with this specialty for quality measurement and NCQA reporting purposes (e.g., 'Preventive Care', 'Chronic Conditions', 'Behavioral Health'). Used in Epic Healthy Planet and population health analytics.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Program

attributes.name: hospital_privileges_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are subject to hospital privileging and credentialing requirements for inpatient or procedural care delivery. Drives privileging workflow routing in Symplr and The Joint Commission compliance tracking.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482.22; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are subject to Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) reporting requirements under MACRA. Used for quality reporting program enrollment and CMS value-based payment calculations.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Program; MACRA 42 CFR Part 414 Subpart O; CMS Quality Payment Program

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: Classification of the specialty for CMS and state network adequacy standards, determining minimum provider-to-enrollee ratios and geographic access requirements. Used in network management, payer contracting, and CMS network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards 42 CFR Part 438; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; State Department of Health Network Adequacy Rules

attributes.name: npi_taxonomy_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Provider Identifier (NPI) Taxonomy Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty/taxonomy code is eligible to be declared as a taxonomy code on an NPI application or update with the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES). Ensures only valid NUCC taxonomy codes are submitted during NPI registry alignment.
attributes.references: CMS NPPES NPI Registry; 45 CFR Part 162.408; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: nucc_classification
attributes.description: The second level of the NUCC taxonomy hierarchy representing the provider classification within the provider type (e.g., 'Family Medicine', 'Internal Medicine', 'Psychiatry & Neurology'). Used for payer enrollment specialty validation and network management.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: nucc_provider_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Provider Type
attributes.description: The broadest level of the NUCC taxonomy hierarchy representing the provider type category (e.g., 'Allopathic & Osteopathic Physicians', 'Nursing Service Providers', 'Behavioral Health & Social Service Providers'). First level of the three-level NUCC classification hierarchy.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment Form CMS-855

attributes.name: nucc_specialization
attributes.description: The third and most granular level of the NUCC taxonomy hierarchy representing the specific area of specialization within the classification (e.g., 'Adolescent Medicine', 'Geriatric Medicine', 'Sports Medicine'). May be null for specialties without a defined subspecialization.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: nucc_taxonomy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Taxonomy Code
attributes.description: The 10-character alphanumeric NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy code that uniquely classifies the provider type, classification, and specialization. Required for NPI registry alignment, claims submission, and CMS provider enrollment taxonomy reporting. This product is the SSOT for all NUCC taxonomy codes in the provider domain.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set v23.1; CMS NPI Registry; 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is eligible for payer enrollment and credentialing with commercial and government payers. Specialties marked false may be internal classifications not recognized by external payers for enrollment purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Form CMS-855; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: pecos_specialty_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS) Specialty Code
attributes.description: The specialty code used within the CMS Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS) for Medicare provider enrollment and revalidation. Required for CMS enrollment submissions and RAC audit compliance.
attributes.references: CMS PECOS System; CMS Provider Enrollment Form CMS-855; OIG Exclusion Database

attributes.name: prescribing_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty hold prescribing authority for medications under applicable state and federal law. Used in Epic Willow pharmacy integration, MAR workflows, and CPOE order routing to validate prescriber eligibility.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act; State Medical Practice Acts; Epic Willow Pharmacy; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: primary_care_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty qualifies for Primary Care Physician (PCP) designation in managed care networks including HMO, ACO, and PCMH models. Drives PCP assignment logic in Salesforce Health Cloud and Epic Healthy Planet population health workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Program; PCMH Recognition Program

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether services rendered by providers in this specialty typically require prior authorization from payers before service delivery. Used in Epic order management (CPOE) and revenue cycle pre-authorization workflows.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Rules; NCQA Utilization Management Standards; Epic Resolute Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal referral is required to access providers in this specialty under standard managed care plan rules (HMO, POS). Drives referral authorization workflows in Epic Cadence and Salesforce Health Cloud referral management.
attributes.references: NCQA Utilization Management Standards; CMS Managed Care Rules 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: rvu_work_component
attributes.description: The standard physician work Relative Value Unit (RVU) component associated with the specialty, used as a baseline for productivity benchmarking and compensation modeling. Sourced from CMS Physician Fee Schedule. Used in Workday HCM compensation planning and RCM analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule; AMA RVU Update Committee (RUC); MGMA Physician Compensation Survey

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the specialty suitable for display in constrained UI contexts such as mobile provider directories, claim form dropdowns, and scheduling system specialty selectors. Maximum 100 characters.
attributes.references: Enterprise Provider Directory UI Standards; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the authoritative source system from which this specialty record was ingested or maintained (e.g., NUCC taxonomy feed, CMS specialty crosswalk, Epic EHR, Symplr credentialing). Used for data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Silver layer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nucc|cms|epic|cerner|symplr|meditech|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Audit Controls

attributes.name: specialty_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping category for the specialty used for network management, referral routing, and provider directory segmentation. Classifies specialties into broad functional areas for operational and analytical purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|surgical|behavioral_health|allied_health|nursing|dental|pharmacy|ancillary|administrative|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: Enterprise Provider Directory Standards; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the specialty within the enterprise provider directory and credentialing systems. Used as the business key for specialty lookups across Epic, Cerner, and Symplr integrations.
attributes.references: Enterprise Provider Directory Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: specialty_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specialty including scope of practice, patient population served, and types of conditions or procedures managed. Used in provider directory publishing, patient-facing portals, and referral routing guidance.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; AMA Specialty Definitions; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the medical or clinical specialty (e.g., 'Internal Medicine', 'Orthopedic Surgery', 'Pediatric Cardiology'). Used in provider directories, credentialing workflows, and payer enrollment forms.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; AMA Specialty Definitions

attributes.name: specialty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specialty record in the enterprise reference catalog. Active records are available for provider credentialing, enrollment, and claims submission. Deprecated records are retained for historical reference only.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set Versioning

attributes.name: specialty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specialty as primary care, specialist, subspecialist, hospitalist, advanced practice, or ancillary. Used for referral routing logic, network adequacy analysis, and PCP designation in HMO and ACO network management.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Program Requirements; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: surgical_specialty
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is classified as a surgical specialty, requiring operating room (OR) scheduling, surgical credentialing, and OpTime/SurgiNet integration for case scheduling and documentation.
attributes.references: AMA Specialty Definitions; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission Surgical Standards

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are eligible to deliver services via telehealth modalities under applicable CMS and state regulations. Used for network directory publishing, referral routing, and telehealth program management.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services; 42 CFR Part 410.78; State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this specialty record was last modified in the enterprise reference catalog. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set version number in which this specialty code was introduced or last updated (e.g., '23.1', '22.0'). Enables version-specific taxonomy lookups for historical claims reprocessing and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set Versioning; CMS NPI Registry

products.name: credential
products.description: Master record of all professional credentials, licenses, certifications, registrations, and continuing education held by individual clinicians. Encompasses: (1) State medical licenses (MD, DO, RN, NP, PA) with license number, issuing state board, issue/expiration dates, status, and renewal history; (2) DEA controlled substance registrations with DEA number, schedule authorizations (II-V), state of registration, registration status, business activity type, and expiration date; (3) Specialty board certifications (ABMS, AOA, ABNS, and other recognized boards) with certifying board, specialty certified, certification number, initial certification date, expiration date, MOC (Maintenance of Certification) status, and recertification history; (4) CME (Continuing Medical Education) activity tracking with activity title, accrediting organization (AMA PRA, ACCME), activity type (live, enduring, performance improvement), credit hours, completion date, specialty relevance, and CME category (Category 1, Category 2). Tracks credential type, issuing authority, verification source, and primary source verification status for all credential types. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all provider credentialing artifacts — no other product in this domain stores license, certification, DEA registration, board certification, or CME data. Supports HIPAA-compliant credentialing workflows, state licensure verification, board certification verification, DEA compliance, CME compliance for licensure renewal, and pharmacy order validation for controlled substances.
products.reference: State Medical Board, NURSYS, DEA Registration

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each credential record in the provider credentialing master. Primary key for the credential data product.

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual clinician or healthcare professional who holds this credential. Links to the provider master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Credentialing costs (license fees, verification services, NPDB queries) are tracked by cost center for medical staff office budgeting, cost-per-credential analysis, and departmental expense allocation

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Credentials tracked for non-physician clinical staff (RNs, RTs, pharmacists). Real business need: competency verification, license expiration tracking, regulatory compliance for all clinical employees

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: DEA credentials authorize controlled substance prescribing by schedule (II-V). Material_master tracks controlled substances with dea_schedule. Link enables regulatory compliance verification that clin
