attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Credentials are specialty-specific (e.g., board certifications, specialty licenses). credential.specialty_name should be normalized to specialty table. FK will be populated at credential creation.

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training. Business justification: Credentials like DEA X-waiver require documented training completion. Credentialing systems verify training prerequisites before credential issuance/renewal per regulatory requirements (e.g., 8-hour b

attributes.name: board_action_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent disciplinary action or adverse action was taken by the issuing authority against this credential. Null if no board action exists. Used in conjunction with board_action_flag for credentialing compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; State Medical Practice Acts; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: board_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a disciplinary action, sanction, reprimand, or adverse action has been taken by the issuing authority against this credential. True = board action exists; False = no board action. Triggers mandatory review in credentialing and privileging workflows.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; State Medical Practice Acts; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; OIG LEIE

attributes.name: caqh_submitted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) ProView Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential has been submitted to the CAQH ProView universal credentialing database. CAQH ProView is the industry-standard repository used by most commercial payers for provider credentialing and enrollment verification.
attributes.references: CAQH ProView Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment 42 CFR Part 424

attributes.name: certifying_board_name
attributes.description: Full name of the specialty board that issued the board certification (e.g., 'American Board of Internal Medicine', 'American Board of Surgery', 'American Osteopathic Board of Internal Medicine'). Applicable only to board certification credential types.
attributes.references: ABMS Board Certification Standards; AOA Specialty Board Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: cme_accrediting_organization
attributes.description: The organization that accredited the CME activity (e.g., 'AMA PRA', 'ACCME', 'ANCC', 'ACPE'). Determines whether the CME credits are recognized for state licensure renewal and board recertification purposes.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards; ANCC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: cme_activity_title
attributes.description: The official title of the CME (Continuing Medical Education) activity as designated by the accrediting organization. Applicable only to CME activity credential types. Used for CME compliance tracking and licensure renewal documentation.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards

attributes.name: cme_activity_type
attributes.description: The format or delivery modality of the CME activity as classified by the accrediting organization (e.g., live conference, enduring material, performance improvement activity). Applicable only to CME activity credential types.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards

attributes.name: cme_category
attributes.description: The AMA PRA CME category designation for this activity. Category 1 credits are formally accredited and required for most state licensure renewals; Category 2 credits are self-designated and have more limited acceptance.
attributes.references: AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards; State Medical Board CME Requirements

attributes.name: cme_credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of CME credit hours awarded upon completion of this CME activity. Used to track cumulative CME hours for state licensure renewal requirements and board recertification MOC compliance.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards; State Medical Board CME Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under HIPAA, HITRUST, and ISO 27001 for credentialing data governance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: credential_number
attributes.description: The externally-issued identifier for this credential as assigned by the issuing authority (e.g., state license number, DEA registration number, board certification number, CME activity ID). This is the official reference number used in regulatory and payer verification workflows.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; State Medical Practice Acts; ABMS Board Certification Standards; ACCME Standards for Commercial Support

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credential as reported by the issuing authority or verified through primary source verification. Active credentials authorize clinical practice; expired or revoked credentials trigger immediate workflow alerts in credentialing and pharmacy order validation systems.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the credential record. Distinguishes among state medical/nursing licenses, DEA controlled substance registrations, specialty board certifications, and CME (Continuing Medical Education) activity completions. Drives downstream workflow routing in credentialing and privileging systems such as Symplr.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: days_to_expiration
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until this credential expires, calculated from the current date to the expiration_date. Used for proactive renewal alerting and credentialing dashboard KPIs. Negative values indicate the credential is already expired.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: dea_business_activity_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) Business Activity Type
attributes.description: The DEA-designated business activity type associated with the DEA registration. Defines the authorized scope of controlled substance handling (e.g., practitioner prescribing vs. hospital dispensing vs. research). Applicable only to DEA registration credential types.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; DEA Registration Application Form 224

attributes.name: dea_schedule_authorizations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of controlled substance schedule authorizations granted under this DEA registration (e.g., 'II,III,IV,V'). Applicable only to DEA registration credential types. Used by pharmacy order validation systems (Epic Willow, Cerner PharmNet) to authorize controlled substance prescribing.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this credential record is considered effective and authorizes clinical practice or activity. For state licenses and DEA registrations, this aligns with the issue_date. For board certifications, this is the initial certification effective date. Supports temporal validity queries.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this credential record is considered effective. Aligns with expiration_date for most credential types. Null for open-ended or lifetime credentials. Supports SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) and temporal validity queries in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credential expires and must be renewed or recertified to remain valid. Null for credentials with no expiration (e.g., certain lifetime board certifications). Drives automated renewal alerts in Symplr and Epic credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credential was originally issued or first conferred by the issuing authority. For board certifications, this is the initial certification date. For CME activities, this is the activity completion date.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; ABMS Board Certification Standards; ACCME Standards

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the organization or governmental body that issued or confers this credential (e.g., 'Texas Medical Board', 'U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration', 'American Board of Internal Medicine', 'American Medical Association — PRA'). Used for primary source verification routing.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation where the credential was issued. Applicable to state medical licenses and DEA state-specific registrations. Null for federal DEA registrations, board certifications, and CME activities that are not state-specific.
attributes.references: State Medical Practice Acts; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; FSMB Interstate Medical Licensure Compact

attributes.name: moc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's compliance with the Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program requirements for this board certification. MOC compliance is required by many hospitals for privileging and by payers for network participation. Applicable only to board certification credential types.
attributes.references: ABMS MOC Program Requirements; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff to document relevant context, exceptions, or special circumstances associated with this credential record (e.g., pending renewal documentation, board action history, conditional license restrictions). Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: npdb_queried
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Queried Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) was queried as part of the credentialing verification process for this provider. NPDB queries are required by CMS and The Joint Commission for initial credentialing and re-credentialing.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: npdb_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Date
attributes.description: The date on which the NPDB was queried for this provider's credentialing record. Required documentation for CMS and Joint Commission credentialing compliance audits.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the OIG LEIE (List of Excluded Individuals/Entities) was checked for this provider. CMS recommends monthly screening; documents compliance for RAC audits and OIG investigations.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Advisory Opinion 98-14

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion List Checked Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OIG (Office of Inspector General) List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE) was checked for this provider as part of credentialing. OIG exclusion screening is required by CMS; employing an excluded provider can result in significant civil monetary penalties.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Advisory Opinion 98-14

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is required for or submitted as part of payer enrollment and network participation applications. True = credential is submitted to payers (e.g., state license, DEA, board certification); False = not required for payer enrollment.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment 42 CFR Part 424; CAQH ProView Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: primary_source_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential has been verified directly with the issuing authority (primary source verification). True = verified with issuing authority; False = not yet primary source verified. Required for NCQA and Joint Commission credentialing accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

attributes.name: privileging_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is directly relevant to the provider's hospital privileging determination. True = this credential is required or considered in the privileging decision; False = informational only (e.g., a CME activity not tied to a specific privilege).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482.12

attributes.name: psv_date
attributes.description: The date on which primary source verification was completed for this credential. NCQA and The Joint Commission require re-verification at defined intervals (typically every 3 years). Drives re-verification scheduling in Symplr.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: psv_method
attributes.description: The method used to conduct primary source verification of this credential (e.g., online query to state medical board database, written confirmation from issuing authority, electronic query via NPDB or OIG). Documents the verification audit trail for accreditation surveys.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NPDB Data Bank Regulations

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete recredentialing for this credential to maintain active status. NCQA and The Joint Commission require recredentialing at least every 3 years. Drives workflow queues in Symplr and credentialing management systems.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credential was most recently renewed or recertified by the issuing authority. Tracks the renewal history cycle for compliance reporting and credentialing re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Medical Practice Acts; ABMS MOC Program

attributes.name: restriction_description
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions, conditions, or limitations placed on this credential by the issuing authority (e.g., 'Supervised practice only', 'No DEA Schedule II prescribing', 'Probationary license'). Null if no restrictions apply.
attributes.references: State Medical Practice Acts; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusion Checked Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAM.gov federal exclusions database was checked for this provider. SAM exclusion screening is required for providers participating in federal healthcare programs (Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP).
attributes.references: SAM.gov Federal Exclusions; CMS Conditions of Participation; FAR 52.209-6

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this credential record was sourced or last updated (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH Expanse, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and ETL audit trails in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this credential record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Symplr credential record ID, Epic provider record ID). Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the source system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the credential type. For state licenses: MD, DO, RN, NP, PA, CRNA, PharmD, etc. For DEA registrations: Schedule II, III, IV, V authorization. For board certifications: ABMS, AOA, ABNS, or other recognized board specialty. For CME: Category 1 or Category 2. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|DO|RN|NP|PA|CRNA|PharmD|Schedule_II|Schedule_III|Schedule_IV|Schedule_V|ABMS|AOA|ABNS|CME_Cat1|CME_Cat2 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT; DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; ABMS Board Certification Standards; AMA PRA Category 1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential record was most recently modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer ETL pipeline and audit trail requirements under HIPAA and HITRUST.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: Indicates the source used to verify this credential. Primary source verification (PSV) is required by NCQA, The Joint Commission, and CMS for credentialing. Secondary source verification uses intermediary databases. Self-reported credentials have not been independently verified.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

products.name: privileging
products.description: Tracks clinical privileges granted to individual clinicians at specific facilities, authorizing them to perform defined procedures and services. Captures privilege category, procedure list, granting facility, privilege status (active, provisional, suspended, revoked), effective and expiration dates, and approving medical staff committee. Core to EMTALA compliance and Joint Commission accreditation.
products.reference: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03, EMTALA

attributes.name: privileging_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each clinical privileging record granted to a clinician at a specific facility. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03 — Medical Staff Privileging Standards

attributes.name: approving_committee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the medical staff committee (e.g., Credentials Committee, Medical Executive Committee) that reviewed and approved the privilege grant. Required for Joint Commission accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Clinical privileges are audited for compliance with credentialing standards (TJC MS.06.01.05, CMS 482.12). Compliance teams audit privilege files for documentation of training, case volume, FPPE/OPPE,

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific hospital, clinic, or healthcare facility at which the clinical privileges are granted and exercised. Privileges are facility-specific per Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical department or service line (e.g., Surgery, Cardiology, Emergency Medicine) under whose scope the privileges are administered and reviewed.

attributes.name: privileging_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed clinician or healthcare professional to whom clinical privileges are granted. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: privileging_proctor_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervising or proctoring physician assigned to observe and evaluate the clinician during the provisional privilege period. Required when is_provisional is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Clinical privileges are granted for specific specialties. privileging.specialty_code and specialty_name should reference specialty table as authoritative source.

attributes.name: surgical_bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.surgical_bom. Business justification: Clinical privileges authorize specific procedures by CPT code. Surgical_bom defines supply requirements per procedure/CPT. Link enables verification that clinician has privileges for procedures they'r

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the approving medical staff committee formally voted to grant or renew the clinical privileges. Distinct from the effective date, which may be retroactive or future-dated.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: board_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification in the relevant specialty is a prerequisite for granting this privilege per the facility's medical staff bylaws. True when board certification is required.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: completed_case_volume
attributes.description: Actual number of cases or procedures performed by the clinician under this privilege during the current privilege period. Used for ongoing competency assessment and reappointment decisions.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework

attributes.name: cpt_code
attributes.description: American Medical Association (AMA) Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) code associated with the primary procedure covered by this privilege. Used to align privileging with billing authorization and quality measurement.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards; CMS HCPCS Level I; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this privileging record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA Security Rule audit control requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: delineation_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privilege delineation form used to define the scope of this privilege grant. Tracks which version of the approved privilege form was in effect at the time of granting, supporting audit and accreditation review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege grant becomes active and the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged procedures at the facility. Binding start date per medical staff bylaws.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: emtala_covered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act (EMTALA) Coverage Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this privilege covers emergency on-call obligations under EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act). True when the clinician is authorized and obligated to respond to emergency department on-call requests under this privilege.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG EMTALA Compliance

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege grant expires and must be renewed through the reappointment process. Typically aligned with the medical staff reappointment cycle (commonly every 2 years per TJC standards).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: fppe_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) Completion Date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) was completed and findings were submitted to the medical staff committee. Null when FPPE is not required or not yet completed.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.03 — Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE)

attributes.name: fppe_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) is required for this privilege grant. FPPE is mandatory for all new privileges and triggered by performance concerns per TJC standards. True when FPPE is required.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.03 — Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE)

attributes.name: icd10_procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Procedure Code
attributes.description: ICD-10-PCS procedure code corresponding to the privileged procedure, used for inpatient procedure coding alignment and quality reporting. Applicable primarily for surgical and procedural privileges.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-PCS; CMS ICD-10 Implementation; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: is_provisional
attributes.description: Indicates whether the privilege is granted on a provisional basis, requiring supervision or proctoring during an initial evaluation period before full privileges are confirmed. True when provisional; False when full privileges are granted.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: malpractice_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician's malpractice/professional liability insurance coverage has been verified as current and meeting the facility's minimum coverage requirements at the time of privilege grant. True when verified.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: npdb_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the adverse action was reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB). Must occur within 15 days of the adverse action per HCQIA requirements. Null when no NPDB report is required.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook

attributes.name: npdb_report_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action report to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) is required for this privilege action (e.g., suspension >30 days, revocation). True triggers mandatory NPDB reporting workflow.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; HHS OIG

attributes.name: oppe_last_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) Last Review Date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recent Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) review for this privilege. OPPE must occur at regular intervals (at least every 12 months) per TJC standards to support reappointment.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 — Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE)

attributes.name: peer_review_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or rating assigned during the most recent peer review or focused professional practice evaluation (FPPE) or ongoing professional practice evaluation (OPPE) for this privilege. Used to support reappointment decisions. Sensitive business-confidential data.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 (OPPE); MS.08.01.03 (FPPE); NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: privilege_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the privilege type granted. Clinical covers general patient care; surgical covers operative procedures; procedural covers invasive non-surgical acts; diagnostic covers imaging/interpretation; prescriptive covers medication authority; administrative covers leadership roles.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: privilege_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope and limitations of the clinical privilege, including any conditions, supervision requirements, or volume thresholds specified by the medical staff committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: privilege_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the clinical privilege granted (e.g., 'Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy', 'Cardiac Catheterization', 'Endotracheal Intubation'). Sourced from the facility's approved privilege delineation form.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; AMA CPT Coding Standards

attributes.name: privilege_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the medical staff office to uniquely reference this privileging grant. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and credentialing system lookups (e.g., Symplr privilege record number).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: privilege_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the clinical privilege grant. Active indicates full authorization; provisional indicates supervised practice during initial period; suspended indicates temporary removal pending investigation; revoked indicates permanent removal; expired indicates lapsed without renewal; pending indicates awaiting committee approval.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22; EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24

attributes.name: privilege_type
attributes.description: Specific classification of the privilege grant. Core privileges are standard for the specialty; special privileges require additional training; temporary privileges are time-limited; telemedicine covers remote care delivery; locum tenens covers temporary coverage providers; disaster privileges are emergency-activated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|special|temporary|telemedicine|locum_tenens|disaster|provisional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: provisional_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the provisional privilege period ends and the clinician transitions to full privileges, contingent on satisfactory proctoring evaluation. Null when privilege is not provisional.

attributes.name: reappointment_cycle_years
attributes.description: Number of years in the medical staff reappointment cycle for this privilege (typically 2 years per TJC standards). Determines the frequency of privilege renewal and competency review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinician submitted the privilege request or reappointment application to the medical staff office. Used to track processing turnaround time and compliance with credentialing timelines.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: required_case_volume
attributes.description: Minimum number of cases or procedures the clinician must perform within the privilege period to demonstrate competency and maintain the privilege. Set by the medical staff committee based on specialty standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was permanently revoked, if applicable. Null when privilege has not been revoked. Triggers mandatory NPDB adverse action report within 15 days.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for permanent privilege revocation, such as gross negligence, criminal conviction, license revocation, or sustained peer review findings. Sensitive business-confidential information required for NPDB adverse action reporting.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; OIG Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this privileging record in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr privilege record ID, Epic credentialing record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this privileging record originated (e.g., SYMPLR for Symplr Credentialing, EPIC for Epic OpTime/Cadence, CERNER for Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH for MEDITECH Expanse, MANUAL for paper-based entry).
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was suspended, if applicable. Null when privilege has never been suspended. Required for adverse action reporting to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB).
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for privilege suspension, such as patient safety concern, peer review finding, license lapse, or investigation pending. Sensitive business-confidential information used for adverse action documentation and NPDB reporting.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; OIG Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: telemedicine_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this privilege extends to telemedicine or telehealth delivery of the authorized services. True when the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged activity via remote/virtual care modalities.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Telemedicine Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.12(a)(8); State Telehealth Laws

attributes.name: training_requirement_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician has satisfied all required training, education, or competency documentation prerequisites for this privilege as defined on the privilege delineation form. True when all training requirements are verified.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this privileging record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing for the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

products.name: credentialing_application
products.description: Transactional record of a clinician's formal application for medical staff membership and clinical privileges at a facility, covering the complete credentialing lifecycle: initial credentialing, biennial reappointment, and privilege expansion workflows. Tracks application type, submission date, status, and all verification stages including: (1) Primary source verification of licenses, education, and training; (2) Peer reference evaluations with referee identity, NPI, relationship to applicant, competency ratings, professional conduct assessment, recommendation type, and confidentiality flag; (3) NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank) queries with query type (initial, reappointment, continuous query enrollment), query/response dates, response status, adverse action flags, malpractice payment flags, and query reference number; (4) Malpractice insurance verification with insurer name, policy number, coverage type (occurrence vs. claims-made), per-occurrence and aggregate limits, effective/expiration dates, tail coverage indicator, and coverage status; (5) Reappointment cycle management with review period tracking, peer review summaries, quality indicator results, CME compliance status, renewal decisions, and reappointment effective dates. Records committee review dates, final approval/denial decision, and effective dates. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for the entire credentialing lifecycle workflow — no other product in this domain stores peer references, NPDB queries, malpractice verification, or reappointment cycle data. Compliant with NCQA, Joint Commission, CAQH, and CMS credentialing standards. Sourced from Symplr credentialing workflow.

attributes.name: complete_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credentialing application was deemed complete — all required documents, attestations, and supporting materials received. Triggers the start of the formal credentialing review clock per NCQA and Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the credentialing application record was first created in the system. Sourced from Symplr credentialing workflow. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: The DEA registration number authorizing the provider to prescribe controlled substances. Verified as part of primary source verification. Required for providers with prescribing privileges. Format: two letters followed by seven digits.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 4

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical executive committee or credentialing committee rendered the final approval or denial decision on the application.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: The final disposition rendered by the credentialing committee: approved for full privileges, denied, deferred pending additional information, withdrawn by the applicant, or provisional privileges granted pending full review.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; OIG Exclusion Screening

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the reason for denial or deferral of the credentialing application. Populated only when decision_type is denied or deferred. Confidential per medical staff bylaws and peer review protection statutes.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; State Peer Review Protection Statutes; HCQIA (Health Care Quality Improvement Act)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which approved clinical privileges and medical staff membership become effective, authorizing the provider to practice at the facility. Used for payer enrollment and billing authorization alignment.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the granted clinical privileges and medical staff membership expire, typically 24 months from the effective date per biennial reappointment cycles. Triggers reappointment workflow initiation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.07; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: malpractice_aggregate_limit
attributes.description: The maximum total dollar amount the malpractice insurance policy will pay for all covered claims during the policy period. Expressed in USD. Facilities typically require minimum aggregate limits (e.g., $3,000,000 aggregate).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of professional liability insurance policy: occurrence-based coverage (covers incidents occurring during the policy period regardless of when the claim is filed) or claims-made coverage (covers claims filed while the policy is active, requiring tail coverage upon expiration).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; ACMQ (American College of Medical Quality)

attributes.name: malpractice_insurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the professional liability (malpractice) insurance carrier providing coverage for the applicant. Verified as part of the credentialing process to confirm active coverage.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_per_occurrence_limit
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount the malpractice insurance policy will pay for a single covered claim or occurrence. Expressed in USD. Facilities typically require minimum limits (e.g., $1,000,000 per occurrence).
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current professional liability insurance policy became effective. Used to confirm continuous coverage and identify any gaps.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's current professional liability insurance policy expires. Triggers re-verification and alerts when approaching expiration to ensure continuous coverage.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: malpractice_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the professional liability insurance policy covering the applicant. Used for verification with the insurer and for audit documentation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: medical_staff_category
attributes.description: The category of medical staff membership being applied for, defining the provider's rights, responsibilities, and voting privileges within the medical staff organization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|associate|courtesy|consulting|honorary|provisional|affiliate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.01.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: npdb_adverse_action_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Adverse Action Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB response contains one or more adverse action reports (e.g., clinical privilege revocation, suspension, or restriction by a healthcare entity). True triggers mandatory committee review and may affect credentialing decision.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; HCQIA; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: npdb_malpractice_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Malpractice Payment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB response contains one or more medical malpractice payment reports. True triggers mandatory committee review and documentation of the committee's assessment of the payment history.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 5

attributes.name: npdb_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Date
attributes.description: The date on which the NPDB query was submitted for this credentialing application. Must be within 180 days of the credentialing decision per NCQA standards.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 5

attributes.name: npdb_query_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Type
attributes.description: Type of NPDB query submitted: initial query at first credentialing, reappointment query at biennial renewal, or enrollment in the continuous query program for ongoing monitoring of adverse actions and malpractice payments.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 5; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: npdb_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Reference Number
attributes.description: The unique reference number assigned by the NPDB to the submitted query. Used for audit trail, regulatory reporting, and reconciliation with NPDB records.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 5

attributes.name: npdb_response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Response Date
attributes.description: The date on which the NPDB response was received for the submitted query. Used to confirm timely receipt and to calculate query-to-response turnaround.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 5

attributes.name: npdb_response_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Response Status
attributes.description: Outcome of the NPDB query: no_report indicates a clean response with no adverse action or malpractice payment reports; report_found indicates one or more reports exist requiring committee review.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; 45 CFR Part 60; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 5

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the clinician by CMS. Required on all credentialing applications and used for payer enrollment, claims processing, and provider directory maintenance.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Status
attributes.description: Result of the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE) screening to confirm the provider is not excluded from participation in federal healthcare programs (Medicare, Medicaid). Must be checked at initial credentialing and at least monthly thereafter.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; 42 USC §1320a-7; CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: peer_reference_count
attributes.description: The number of peer reference evaluations collected for this credentialing application. NCQA and Joint Commission standards typically require a minimum of three peer references from physicians familiar with the applicant's clinical competency.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 7; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: peer_references_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required minimum number of peer reference evaluations have been received and reviewed for this application. True when all required references are on file and meet quality standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 7; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: peer_review_summary_status
attributes.description: Status of the formal peer review summary evaluation completed for the reappointment cycle, assessing clinical performance, professional conduct, and adherence to evidence-based practice standards. Protected under state peer review statutes.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 8; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.07; HCQIA; State Peer Review Protection Statutes

attributes.name: provisional_privileges_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which any granted provisional clinical privileges expire. Provisional privileges must be converted to full privileges or terminated upon completion of the credentialing review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: provisional_privileges_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether provisional (temporary) clinical privileges have been granted to the provider pending completion of the full credentialing review. Provisional privileges are time-limited and require a supervising physician attestation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: psv_education_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Source Verification (PSV) Education and Training Status
attributes.description: Status of primary source verification of the provider's medical education (medical school graduation) and graduate medical education (residency/fellowship) directly with the issuing institutions or through ECFMG for international graduates.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 4; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; ECFMG (Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates)

attributes.name: psv_license_status
attributes.description: Status of primary source verification of the provider's state medical license directly with the issuing state medical board. A core PSV element required by NCQA and Joint Commission credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 4; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; FSMB (Federation of State Medical Boards)

attributes.name: psv_work_history_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Source Verification (PSV) Work History Status
attributes.description: Status of verification of the provider's five-year work history, including gaps in employment or training exceeding six months, as required by NCQA credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 4; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: quality_indicator_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the review of clinical quality indicators (e.g., outcomes data, complication rates, mortality rates, HEDIS measures) for the reappointment period. Populated for reappointment and privilege expansion applications.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 8; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.07; CMS MIPS/APM Quality Reporting

attributes.name: reappointment_review_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the clinical performance review period evaluated during a reappointment credentialing cycle. Marks the close of the 24-month interval used to assess quality indicators and peer review summaries.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 8; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.07

attributes.name: reappointment_review_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the clinical performance review period evaluated during a reappointment credentialing cycle. Captures the beginning of the 24-month interval of quality indicators, peer review summaries, and CME compliance assessed for reappointment.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 8; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.07; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the medical staff office officially received and logged the credentialing application. May differ from submission_date when applications are mailed or submitted through intermediaries such as CAQH ProView.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; CAQH ProView

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_check_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusion Check Status
attributes.description: Result of the SAM.gov federal exclusion database screening confirming the provider is not debarred or suspended from federal programs. Required in addition to OIG LEIE screening for comprehensive exclusion verification.
attributes.references: SAM.gov; FAR 52.209-6; OIG Compliance Program Guidance; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: secondary_specialty
attributes.description: The provider's secondary or subspecialty clinical area for which additional privileges may be requested (e.g., Interventional Cardiology as a subspecialty of Cardiology). Nullable when no secondary specialty applies.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 4

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinician formally submitted the completed credentialing application to the medical staff office. Serves as the principal business event date for the credentialing lifecycle and is used to calculate processing turnaround time.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.01

attributes.name: tail_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has obtained tail coverage (extended reporting endorsement) for a prior claims-made policy. Required when a provider transitions between employers or facilities to ensure coverage for claims arising from prior practice.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 6; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: telemedicine_privileges_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is requesting telemedicine or telehealth clinical privileges as part of this credentialing application. Telemedicine credentialing may follow an expedited pathway per CMS and Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.05; CMS Telemedicine Credentialing and Privileging Final Rule 42 CFR §482.12; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the credentialing application record was most recently modified in the system. Used for change tracking, ETL delta processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

products.name: provider_payer_enrollment
products.description: Tracks the enrollment status of individual clinicians and organizational providers with insurance payers (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payers). Captures payer name, payer ID, enrollment type (participating, non-participating), effective date, termination date, enrollment status, PTAN (Provider Transaction Access Number), and credentialing tier. Critical for RCM and claims adjudication. Sourced from Symplr provider enrollment module.
products.reference: CMS Provider Enrollment, PECOS, CAQH

attributes.name: provider_payer_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payer enrollment record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: ar_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_account. Business justification: Payer enrollments enable revenue collection; AR accounts track receivables by payer. Links enrollment status to AR aging for collectability analysis, payer performance tracking, and revenue cycle opti

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual clinician or organizational provider associated with this payer enrollment record. Links to the provider master entity.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payer enrollment activities incur costs (application fees, credentialing services, staff time) tracked by cost center for revenue cycle budgeting and enrollment cost-per-payer analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Payer enrollment for employed providers billing under organizational NPIs. Real business need: revenue cycle - ensuring employed clinicians can bill, tracking enrollment status for compensation/produc

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Organizational providers enroll with payers separately from individual clinicians. FK will be NULL for clinician-only enrollments. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: payer_contract_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the payer contract or fee schedule agreement associated with this enrollment. Links the enrollment to the specific contractual terms governing reimbursement rates and billing rules. Sourced from Symplr or the payer contracting system.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Payer Contracting Standards

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance payer (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer) with whom the provider is enrolled. Links to the payer master entity.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Payer Identification Standards

attributes.name: provider_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific practice location or facility address associated with this payer enrollment. A provider may have multiple enrollments at different locations with the same payer. Links to the facility or location master entity.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Service Location Enrollment Requirements

attributes.name: reference_npi_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.npi_registry. Business justification: Payer enrollment validation requires NPI registry verification for active status, taxonomy code accuracy, and practice location matching. Healthcare operations perform monthly NPI validation during re

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Payer enrollment is specialty-specific. payer_enrollment.specialty_code should reference specialty table as authoritative source.

attributes.name: taxonomy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_taxonomy. Business justification: Payer enrollment's taxonomy code should reference provider_taxonomy table. Removes taxonomy_code STRING.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor_contract. Business justification: Payer enrollment determines reimbursement rates per specialty/procedure. Vendor contracts determine supply costs. Link enables margin analysis (reimbursement minus supply cost) for specific payer-proc

attributes.name: application_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider enrollment application was formally submitted to the payer. Used to track application processing timelines, SLA compliance, and identify delayed enrollments impacting revenue.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS PECOS Application Tracking

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payer formally approved the provider's enrollment application. May differ from the effective date if retroactive enrollment is granted. Used for lifecycle tracking and RCM gap analysis.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: billing_npi
attributes.description: The NPI used specifically for billing purposes under this enrollment, which may be the group/organizational NPI rather than the rendering provider's individual NPI. Determines the pay-to entity on claims.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS-1500; UB-04

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payer enrollment record was first created in the source system (Symplr). Represents the audit trail creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform convention.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance and Audit Standards; HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312(b)

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's credentialing with this payer expires and must be renewed. Payer credentialing typically requires renewal every 2-3 years. Expiration without renewal may result in claims denial.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing Module; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: The credentialing verification status of the provider with this payer, distinct from enrollment status. Credentialing validates the provider's qualifications, licensure, and background. 'Provisional' allows temporary billing while full credentialing is completed. Sourced from Symplr credentialing module.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing Module; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards

attributes.name: credentialing_tier
attributes.description: Payer-assigned credentialing tier that may affect reimbursement rates, network designation, or quality incentive eligibility. Tier classifications vary by payer but generally reflect quality metrics, board certification, and practice standards. Sourced from Symplr credentialing module.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing Module; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number of the provider, required for enrollment with payers that cover controlled substance prescribing. Format: two letters followed by seven digits. Sensitive identifier subject to DEA regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: DEA Practitioner Registration; 21 CFR Part 1301; Symplr Credentialing Module

attributes.name: edi_submitter_code
attributes.description: The EDI submitter identifier assigned by the payer for electronic claims submission (HIPAA 837 transactions) under this enrollment. Required for electronic billing setup and clearinghouse routing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 837 Transaction Standards; ASC X12 EDI Standards; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's enrollment with the payer becomes effective and the provider is authorized to submit claims. Critical for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) to determine billable service dates.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: eft_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has enrolled in Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) with this payer for direct deposit of claim payments. EFT enrollment is required by CMS for Medicare providers under the ACA. True = EFT active; False = paper check.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1104; CMS EFT Enrollment Requirements; NACHA EFT Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique enrollment reference number assigned by the payer or enrollment system (e.g., Symplr enrollment tracking number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and payer correspondence.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Provider Enrollment and Chain Ownership System (PECOS)

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The system or channel through which the enrollment application was submitted. 'Symplr' indicates submission via the Symplr provider enrollment module. 'PECOS' indicates direct submission via CMS Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System. Used for data lineage and process analytics.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS PECOS; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the provider's enrollment with the payer. 'Active' indicates the provider is credentialed and authorized to bill. 'Pending' indicates the application is under review. 'Terminated' indicates the enrollment has ended. 'Suspended' indicates temporary hold. 'Rejected' indicates the application was denied. 'Revalidation_required' indicates CMS-mandated periodic revalidation is due.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Revalidation; 42 CFR Part 424; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Indicates the nature of the provider's participation agreement with the payer. 'Participating' providers accept payer-negotiated rates as payment in full. 'Non-participating' providers may balance-bill patients. 'Opt-out' applies to Medicare providers who have formally opted out. 'Reassignment' indicates benefits are reassigned to a group or facility.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Participating Physician Program; 42 CFR Part 424; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: group_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit NPI of the group practice or organizational entity under which the individual provider is enrolled with this payer. Relevant for reassignment of benefits and group billing scenarios. Distinct from the individual provider's NPI.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS-855B Enrollment Form

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the state in which the provider holds the license submitted for this enrollment. Used to validate licensure jurisdiction against the payer's service area.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; USPS State Abbreviation Standard; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: medicaid_provider_number
attributes.description: State-assigned Medicaid provider identification number issued upon successful Medicaid enrollment. Required for Medicaid claims submission. Varies by state Medicaid program. Null for non-Medicaid enrollments.
attributes.references: State Medicaid Agency Enrollment Requirements; CMS Medicaid Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR Part 455

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently in-network or out-of-network with this payer. In-network status means the provider has a contracted rate agreement. Critical for patient cost-sharing calculations, referral management, and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; ACA Section 1311; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for enrollment coordinators to capture supplemental information, payer-specific instructions, follow-up actions, or exceptions related to this enrollment record. Not used for structured data. Sourced from Symplr enrollment notes field.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; Internal Enrollment Operations Standards

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the provider was screened against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE). CMS mandates monthly screening for all enrolled providers. Used for compliance audit documentation.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; 42 CFR Part 1001; CMS Provider Enrollment Compliance

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has been verified against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities (LEIE) as part of the enrollment process. CMS requires monthly OIG exclusion screening. True = checked and cleared; False = not yet checked.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; 42 CFR Part 1001; CMS Provider Enrollment Compliance; OIG Special Advisory Bulletin

attributes.name: pay_to_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address to which the payer remits payments (Electronic Remittance Advice / ERA and paper checks) for claims submitted under this enrollment. May differ from the service address.
attributes.references: CMS-855 Enrollment Forms; ERA/835 Transaction Standards; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: payer_plan_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific insurance plan or product line within the payer organization for which the provider is enrolled (e.g., 'Medicare Part B', 'Medicaid Managed Care', 'PPO Gold Plan'). A single payer may have multiple plans requiring separate enrollments.
attributes.references: Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; CMS Plan Identification Standards

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payer by program type. Drives billing rules, fee schedules, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Medicare|Medicaid|Commercial|Tricare|Marketplace|Workers_Compensation|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Payer Classification; HIPAA 837 Transaction Standards; AMA CPT Guidelines

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment is for an individual clinician (physician, NP, PA), a group practice, a facility (hospital, clinic), or an ancillary service provider (lab, imaging center). Determines the applicable enrollment form (CMS-855I, CMS-855B, CMS-855A) and billing rules.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Forms CMS-855 Series; 42 CFR Part 424; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: ptan
attributes.description: Provider Transaction Access Number assigned by Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs) upon successful Medicare enrollment. Required for Medicare claims submission and adjudication. Unique per provider-MAC jurisdiction combination.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Provider Enrollment; CMS PECOS; 42 CFR Part 424

attributes.name: revalidation_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete CMS-mandated revalidation of their Medicare or Medicaid enrollment to maintain active billing privileges. Failure to revalidate results in deactivation. Sourced from CMS revalidation lookup and Symplr tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Revalidation; 42 CFR Part 424 Subpart P; CMS PECOS

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusion Check Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has been verified against the federal SAM.gov exclusions database (formerly EPLS) as part of enrollment compliance screening. Required for providers participating in federally-funded programs. True = checked and cleared; False = not yet checked.
attributes.references: SAM.gov Federal Exclusions; 2 CFR Part 180; CMS Provider Enrollment Compliance

attributes.name: service_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the practice location where services are rendered under this enrollment. Submitted to the payer for network directory listings and claims adjudication. Required for CMS enrollment forms.
attributes.references: CMS-855 Enrollment Forms; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; USPS Address Standards

attributes.name: service_city
attributes.description: City of the practice location where services are rendered under this enrollment. Used for network directory, geographic network adequacy analysis, and payer service area validation.
attributes.references: CMS-855 Enrollment Forms; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: service_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the state where services are rendered under this enrollment. Used for state-specific billing rules, Medicaid jurisdiction, and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: CMS-855 Enrollment Forms; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module; USPS State Abbreviation Standard

attributes.name: service_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the practice location where services are rendered under this enrollment. Used for geographic network adequacy analysis, payer locality-based fee schedule assignment, and CMS Geographic Practice Cost Index (GPCI) determination.
attributes.references: CMS-855 Enrollment Forms; CMS GPCI Locality Codes; Symplr Provider Enrollment Module

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: The state-issued medical or professional license number of the provider as submitted in the enrollment application. Payers verify active licensure as part of credentialing. May differ from the license number in the provider master if enrollment is in a different state.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility and Provider Licensing; Symplr Credentialing Module; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: telehealth_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider group offers telehealth or virtual care services. Used for network directory accuracy, patient access reporting, and CMS telehealth billing eligibility under 42 CFR § 410.78.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services — 42 CFR § 410.78; ONC Interoperability Standards; FHIR R4 — PractitionerRole

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group record was terminated or deactivated in the provider master. Null for active records. Used for SCD management, audit trails, and historical reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; HL7 FHIR R4 — Organization Resource

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the provider group record was most recently modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF — Audit Logging; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL for the provider group. Used in patient-facing provider directories, Salesforce Health Cloud referral management, and payer directory submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; Salesforce Health Cloud — Patient Relationship Management

products.name: group_membership
products.description: Association record capturing the complete current and historical membership, affiliations, and employment relationships of individual clinicians within provider groups, hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, and other organizational entities. Includes organization name, organization type (group practice, hospital, health system, academic medical center, FQHC), role within the organization (owner, partner, employee, contractor, attending, consulting), effective and end dates, FTE allocation, primary practice location, departure reason, and voluntary/involuntary separation indicator. Provides complete affiliation history for credentialing primary source verification (work history verification is mandatory per NCQA and Joint Commission), NPDB adverse action reporting context, billing attribution, and workforce planning. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all clinician-to-organization affiliation and employment history records — no other product in this domain stores affiliation history or organizational membership data.
products.reference: CMS Group Practice Reporting

attributes.name: group_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each clinician-to-organization affiliation or employment record. Primary key for the group_membership data product.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical practice location where the provider renders services within this organizational affiliation. Used for billing attribution, credentialing site verification, and workforce planning.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_group. Business justification: group_membership currently has multiple org_provider_id FKs but no provider_group_id. Business semantics: membership in a provider_group entity. Removes group_npi STRING.

attributes.name: group_org_provider_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.org_provider

attributes.name: primary_group_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual clinician or healthcare professional whose organizational affiliation or employment relationship is being recorded. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS NPI Registry; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: primary_group_org_provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational entity (group practice, hospital, health system, academic medical center, FQHC, etc.) with which the provider is affiliated or employed.
