attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: academic_appointment_rank
attributes.description: The academic faculty rank held by the provider within an affiliated academic medical center or teaching institution. Applicable only for academic affiliations. Null for non-academic organizations.
attributes.references: LCME Accreditation Standards; ACGME Institutional Requirements; Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC)

attributes.name: aco_participation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider participates in an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) arrangement under this organizational affiliation. Relevant for value-based care attribution, MIPS reporting, and CMS Shared Savings Program compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP); MACRA; MIPS/APM Framework; CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR 425

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the formal employment or affiliation contract. Null for open-ended contracts. Used for contract renewal tracking, workforce planning, and credentialing continuity management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; Workday HCM Core HR; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the employment or affiliation contract governing this provider-organization relationship. Links to the contract management system for terms, compensation, and obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; Workday HCM Core HR; GAAP and FASB Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the formal employment or affiliation contract governing this provider-organization relationship. May differ from the effective_date if there is a gap between contract execution and service commencement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Contract Management; Workday HCM Core HR; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code associated with this provider's organizational affiliation. Used for financial attribution, RVU-based compensation modeling, and departmental budget reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; GAAP and FASB Financial Reporting Standards; CMS Cost Report

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's credentialing approval expires within this organizational affiliation. Triggers recredentialing workflows. NCQA and Joint Commission require recredentialing at least every three years.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards Section 5; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing verification status for this provider within this organizational affiliation. Tracks whether the provider has completed the organization's credentialing and privileging process as required by NCQA and The Joint Commission.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The clinical or administrative department within the organization to which the provider is assigned under this affiliation (e.g., Department of Medicine, Department of Surgery, Emergency Department). Used for workforce planning and operational reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; Epic EHR Cadence; The Joint Commission (TJC) Organizational Structure Standards

attributes.name: departure_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for the provider's departure or separation from the organizational affiliation. Required for NPDB adverse action reporting context, workforce analytics, and credentialing work history verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|retirement|termination|contract_end|relocation|deceased|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Reporting Guidelines; NCQA Credentialing Standards; OIG Exclusion Reporting

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's affiliation or employment relationship with the organization became effective. Required for credentialing primary source verification and work history validation per NCQA and Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards Section 5; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider's employment or engagement arrangement with the organization. Determines benefits eligibility, malpractice coverage, tax reporting obligations, and credentialing pathway requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; IRS Worker Classification Guidelines; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's affiliation or employment relationship with the organization ended or is scheduled to end. Null for currently active affiliations. Required for complete work history verification per NCQA and Joint Commission credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards Section 5; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: The proportion of the provider's full-time equivalent effort allocated to this organizational affiliation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 = full-time, 0.5 = half-time). Used for workforce planning, productivity analysis, and RVU attribution.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; CMS Physician Fee Schedule RVU Methodology; AHRQ Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: is_accepting_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients under this organizational affiliation. Used for patient access management, referral routing, and provider directory accuracy per CMS and NCQA requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Accuracy Requirements; NCQA Health Plan Accreditation; No Surprises Act Provider Directory Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_affiliation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational affiliation is the provider's primary or principal employment relationship (True) versus a secondary or concurrent affiliation (False). Used for billing attribution, PCP panel assignment, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: is_voluntary_separation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's separation from the organization was voluntary (True) or involuntary (False). Critical for NPDB adverse action reporting — involuntary separations related to clinical competence or conduct must be reported to the NPDB.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Reporting Guidelines 45 CFR Part 60; OIG Exclusion Reporting; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: medical_staff_category
attributes.description: The medical staff membership category assigned to the provider by the hospital or health system's medical staff office. Governs clinical privileges, voting rights, and committee eligibility per medical staff bylaws. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|associate|courtesy|consulting|honorary|provisional|affiliate — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.01.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR 482.22; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: membership_role
attributes.description: The provider's functional role or relationship type within the organization. Determines billing attribution rules, malpractice coverage applicability, and credentialing pathway. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner|partner|employee|contractor|attending|consulting|locum_tenens|volunteer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Bylaws Standards

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the provider's affiliation or employment relationship with the organization. Drives access control, billing eligibility, and credentialing verification workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is eligible for Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) reporting under this organizational affiliation. Drives quality reporting workflows and CMS payment adjustment calculations under MACRA.
attributes.references: MACRA; CMS MIPS Program; CMS Quality Payment Program (QPP); 42 CFR 414 Subpart O

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: The provider's payer network participation status under this organizational affiliation. Determines patient cost-sharing obligations and claim adjudication rules. Critical for No Surprises Act compliance and provider directory accuracy.
attributes.references: No Surprises Act (NSA) 42 CFR 149; CMS Provider Directory Requirements; NCQA Health Plan Accreditation

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, exceptions, or remarks related to this provider-organization affiliation record. Used by credentialing staff for documentation of special circumstances, waivers, or follow-up actions.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: npdb_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Date
attributes.description: The date on which the adverse action or separation event was reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB). Required for compliance tracking and audit purposes under HCQIA.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Reporting Guidelines 45 CFR Part 60; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA)

attributes.name: npdb_report_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this separation or adverse action event requires a mandatory report to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB). Triggered by involuntary terminations related to clinical competence, conduct, or privilege revocation.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Reporting Guidelines 45 CFR Part 60; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA); OIG

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the individual clinician by CMS. Captured at the affiliation level to support billing attribution and payer enrollment verification for this specific organizational context.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA Administrative Simplification 45 CFR Part 162; Health Level Seven (HL7) FHIR R4 Practitioner.identifier

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Status of the provider's enrollment with payers under this organizational affiliation (group billing). Determines whether claims can be submitted under the organization's group NPI for this provider. Managed via Symplr Provider Enrollment.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment 42 CFR 424; Symplr Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: primary_specialty
attributes.description: The provider's primary clinical specialty within this organizational affiliation (e.g., Internal Medicine, Cardiology, General Surgery). Captured at the affiliation level as specialty may differ across organizations. Aligns with CMS specialty taxonomy.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Specialty Codes; NCQA Credentialing Standards; American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS)

attributes.name: privileging_status
attributes.description: Current clinical privileging status for this provider at the affiliated organization. Clinical privileges define the specific procedures and services the provider is authorized to perform. Distinct from credentialing status.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR 482.22; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this group membership record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this group membership record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: secondary_specialty
attributes.description: The provider's secondary or subspecialty clinical designation within this organizational affiliation. Supports multi-specialty credentialing, panel management, and referral routing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Specialty Codes; NCQA Credentialing Standards; American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this affiliation record was sourced (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, Workday HCM). Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and audit traceability.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SOC 2

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this affiliation record in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr provider affiliation ID, Epic provider record ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SOC 2

attributes.name: supervision_level
attributes.description: The level of supervision required for the provider under this organizational affiliation. Relevant for advanced practice providers (NPs, PAs) whose scope of practice may require physician oversight per state law and organizational policy.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; State Medical Practice Acts; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The federal Tax Identification Number (Employer Identification Number or Social Security Number) used for billing and tax reporting under this organizational affiliation. Required for claims submission and IRS 1099 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Reporting Requirements; CMS Provider Enrollment 42 CFR 424; HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the credentialing staff member or system that performed the primary source verification of this affiliation record. Required for credentialing audit trail per NCQA and Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards Section 5; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the affiliation or employment information was last verified through primary source verification as required by NCQA and The Joint Commission credentialing standards. Tracks compliance with mandatory verification timelines.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards Section 5; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

products.name: malpractice_coverage
products.description: Tracks professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage for individual clinicians. Captures insurer name, policy number, coverage type (occurrence vs. claims-made), per-occurrence limit, aggregate limit, effective and expiration dates, tail coverage indicator, and coverage status. Required for credentialing verification and Joint Commission compliance.
products.reference: Joint Commission EC.02.01.01, State Medical Board Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each malpractice (professional liability) insurance coverage record in the system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Malpractice insurance premiums are paid via AP invoices. Links coverage records to payment transactions for premium tracking, accrual verification, and insurance expense reconciliation. Required for f

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Malpractice insurance verification is audited as part of credentialing compliance. Annual audits verify all providers maintain required coverage limits ($1M/$3M typical) and tail coverage for departin

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility or organization at which this malpractice coverage is required for privileging purposes. A provider may have separate coverage records for different facilities within a health system.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; CMS Conditions of Participation; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed healthcare professional (physician, nurse practitioner, PA, etc.) for whom this malpractice coverage is maintained. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; Symplr Credentialing; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.credentialing_application. Business justification: Malpractice coverage is submitted as part of credentialing applications. FK will be NULL until associated with an application. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: credentialing_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider's credentialing file or application record with which this malpractice coverage is associated. Links coverage records to the broader credentialing and privileging workflow.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Malpractice coverage for employed clinical staff. Real business need: risk management requires tracking coverage for all clinical employees, policy compliance verification, claims management, employme

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: The maximum total dollar amount the insurer will pay for all malpractice claims during the policy period. Expressed in USD. Typically expressed as the second number in a coverage limit pair (e.g., $1M/$3M means $1M per occurrence, $3M aggregate).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: certificate_of_insurance_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system path to the scanned or electronic Certificate of Insurance (COI) issued by the insurer. Stored as evidence of coverage for credentialing file documentation requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; HIPAA Security Rule; ISO 27001

attributes.name: claims_history_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has any reported malpractice claims or settlements associated with this policy period. Triggers additional review by the medical staff office and credentialing committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; OIG — Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: coverage_lapse_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether there was a gap or lapse in malpractice coverage for this provider. A coverage lapse may affect hospital privileges, payer enrollment, and credentialing status and must be documented and explained.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: coverage_specialty
attributes.description: The clinical specialty or scope of practice for which this malpractice coverage is underwritten (e.g., General Surgery, Obstetrics, Emergency Medicine). Some policies are specialty-specific and may not cover procedures outside the stated specialty.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; AMA

attributes.name: coverage_state
attributes.description: The U.S. state(s) in which this malpractice policy provides coverage, expressed as a two-letter USPS state abbreviation. Malpractice coverage is often state-specific; providers practicing in multiple states may require separate policies.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the malpractice insurance coverage record. 'Active' indicates the policy is in force and valid for credentialing purposes. Used by credentialing staff to determine whether a provider's coverage is current and compliant.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates the type of professional liability policy structure. 'Occurrence' covers incidents that occur during the policy period regardless of when the claim is filed. 'Claims-made' covers claims filed while the policy is active. 'Claims-made with tail' includes extended reporting endorsement. 'Nose coverage' (prior acts) covers incidents before the current policy start. 'Hybrid' combines elements of both.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this malpractice coverage record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary limits expressed in this coverage record (e.g., USD). Required for multi-entity health systems operating across international jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the malpractice insurance policy becomes effective and coverage begins. Used to determine whether a provider was covered during a specific period for credentialing and claims adjudication purposes.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the malpractice insurance policy expires and coverage ends. Credentialing teams use this date to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous coverage compliance per Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: group_policy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage is provided under a group or organizational malpractice policy (e.g., hospital-sponsored coverage) rather than an individual policy purchased by the provider. Affects credentialing verification workflows.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: insurer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the insurance carrier for verification and claims inquiries related to this policy. Used by credentialing staff during primary source verification (PSV).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: insurer_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the insurance carrier's verification or credentialing department. Used by credentialing staff to conduct primary source verification (PSV) of coverage details.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: insurer_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Insurer National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) company code uniquely identifying the insurance carrier. Used for regulatory verification and insurer financial stability assessment.
attributes.references: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC); State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: lapse_explanation
attributes.description: Free-text explanation documenting the reason for any gap or lapse in malpractice coverage. Required by credentialing committees when coverage_lapse_indicator is True. Applicable only when coverage_lapse_indicator is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: nose_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy includes prior acts (nose) coverage, which extends protection to incidents that occurred before the current policy's effective date. Relevant when a provider transitions between employers or insurers.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff to capture additional context, exceptions, or special conditions related to this malpractice coverage record that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., coverage exclusions, special endorsements, committee decisions).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: open_claims_count
attributes.description: The number of currently open or pending malpractice claims against the provider under this policy. Used by credentialing committees to assess provider risk profile during initial credentialing and re-credentialing.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; OIG — Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: per_occurrence_limit
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for a single malpractice claim or incident. Expressed in USD. Credentialing bodies and hospital medical staff offices verify this meets minimum thresholds (e.g., $1,000,000 per occurrence).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: policy_holder_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the named insured on the malpractice policy. This may be the individual provider, a group practice, or a healthcare organization. Used to confirm the provider is the named insured or an additional insured.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned unique identifier issued by the malpractice insurer for this professional liability policy. Used for verification during credentialing and payer enrollment processes.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: prior_acts_date
attributes.description: The retroactive date from which prior acts (nose) coverage applies. Incidents occurring on or after this date are covered under the current policy even if they predate the policy effective date. Applicable only when nose_coverage_indicator is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credentialing team should initiate the policy renewal workflow to ensure continuous coverage without lapse. Typically set a configurable number of days before the expiration date.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: self_insured_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider or their employing organization is self-insured for professional liability rather than carrying a commercial malpractice policy. Self-insured entities must demonstrate adequate reserves to meet credentialing requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this malpractice coverage record in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr record ID). Used for data lineage, deduplication, and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and source systems.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this malpractice coverage record was sourced (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, or manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: tail_coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the extended reporting period (tail coverage) endorsement becomes effective, typically coinciding with the expiration of the underlying claims-made policy. Applicable only when tail_coverage_indicator is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: tail_coverage_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the extended reporting period (tail coverage) endorsement expires. After this date, no new claims can be reported under the tail endorsement. Applicable only when tail_coverage_indicator is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: tail_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an extended reporting period (tail coverage) endorsement is in place for this claims-made policy. Tail coverage protects against claims filed after the policy expires for incidents that occurred during the policy period. Critical for credentialing continuity when a provider changes employers or retires.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this malpractice coverage record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the malpractice coverage was last verified through primary source verification (PSV) with the insurer. Required by The Joint Commission and NCQA for credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform primary source verification (PSV) of this malpractice coverage. Credentialing standards require documentation of how verification was obtained.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates the primary source verification (PSV) status of this malpractice coverage record. 'Verified' means the coverage has been confirmed directly with the insurer. 'Pending' means verification is in progress. 'Failed' means verification could not be completed. 'Waived' means verification was waived per credentialing policy.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the credentialing staff member or automated system that performed the primary source verification (PSV) of this malpractice coverage record.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

products.name: npdb_query
products.description: Transactional record of National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) queries submitted for clinicians during credentialing and reappointment processes. Captures query type (initial, reappointment, continuous query enrollment), query date, response date, response status, adverse action flag, malpractice payment flag, and query reference number. Mandatory for CMS-participating facilities.
products.reference: NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank), HRSA

attributes.name: npdb_query_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) query record in the system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific facility or hospital campus on behalf of which the NPDB query was submitted. Supports multi-facility health systems where queries may be initiated by different campuses.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare provider (clinician, practitioner) who is the subject of this NPDB query. Links to the provider master record.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: NPDB queries for credentialing are regulatory submissions to NPDB. Credentialing teams track query reference numbers, response dates, and turnaround times to ensure timely completion of credentialing

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credentialing or reappointment application that triggered this NPDB query. Links to the credentialing application record.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: original_query_npdb_query_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query ID
attributes.description: Reference to the original NPDB query record if this record is a resubmission. Null if resubmission_flag is False. Enables lineage tracking across query attempts for the same credentialing event.

attributes.name: reappointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.reappointment. Business justification: NPDB queries are performed during both credentialing and reappointment. Adding reappointment_id FK (credentialing_application_id already exists). FK will be NULL for credentialing-only queries.

attributes.name: adverse_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB response contains one or more adverse action reports against the practitioner, such as clinical privilege revocations, license surrenders, or exclusions. True if adverse action reports are present; False otherwise.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; OIG Exclusion Database

attributes.name: adverse_action_report_count
attributes.description: Number of adverse action reports specifically returned within the NPDB response. Subset of total report_count. Used for credentialing risk stratification.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; OIG

attributes.name: cms_participating_facility_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Participating Facility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NPDB query was conducted as part of mandatory CMS participation requirements. CMS-participating hospitals are required to query the NPDB for all medical staff applicants and reappointments. True if query is CMS-mandated; False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation — 42 CFR Part 482; NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: continuous_query_disenrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the practitioner was disenrolled from the NPDB continuous query (CQ) program, typically upon termination of employment, expiration of privileges, or voluntary withdrawal. Null if still actively enrolled.

attributes.name: continuous_query_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the practitioner was enrolled in the NPDB continuous query (CQ) program. Null if continuous_query_enrollment_flag is False. Used to track the start of ongoing monitoring coverage.

attributes.name: continuous_query_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this query initiated or is associated with a continuous query (CQ) enrollment, which provides ongoing NPDB monitoring and automatic notification of new reports filed against the practitioner. True if enrolled in continuous query; False for one-time queries.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NPDB query record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: credentialing_purpose
attributes.description: Specific credentialing purpose for which the NPDB query was initiated: initial_appointment (new medical staff), reappointment (periodic renewal), privilege_expansion (adding new clinical privileges), locum_tenens (temporary coverage), telemedicine (virtual care credentialing), or research (IRB-related credentialing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_appointment|reappointment|privilege_expansion|locum_tenens|telemedicine|research — promote to reference product if additional purposes emerge]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Error Code
attributes.description: Error code returned by the NPDB system when a query submission or processing failure occurs. Null if no error. Used for troubleshooting and resubmission workflows.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; NPDB Technical Reference Guide

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Error Description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the error returned by the NPDB system when a query fails. Null if no error. Supports credentialing staff in resolving submission issues.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; NPDB Technical Reference Guide

attributes.name: malpractice_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB response contains one or more malpractice payment reports for the practitioner. True if malpractice payment records are present; False otherwise.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) of 1986

attributes.name: malpractice_payment_report_count
attributes.description: Number of malpractice payment reports specifically returned within the NPDB response. Subset of total report_count. Used for credentialing risk assessment and peer review.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) of 1986

attributes.name: notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by credentialing staff regarding the NPDB query, response interpretation, committee deliberations, or follow-up actions required. Supports credentialing file documentation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: practitioner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the practitioner type as submitted in the NPDB query. Determines the applicable NPDB reporting categories and adverse action types relevant to the query response.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; AMA

attributes.name: queried_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the practitioner as submitted in the NPDB query for identity verification and matching. Captured at query time as part of the NPDB required subject identification fields.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; HIPAA Privacy Rule — 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: queried_dea_number
attributes.description: The DEA registration number of the practitioner as submitted in the NPDB query, if applicable. Used when querying for controlled substance-related adverse actions. Captured at query time.
attributes.references: DEA Registration; NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: queried_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation corresponding to the state license number submitted in the NPDB query. Identifies the licensing jurisdiction for the practitioner at the time of query.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; NPDB Guidebook — HHS; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: queried_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the practitioner as submitted in the NPDB query. Captured at query time to preserve the exact identifier used, independent of any subsequent NPI updates on the provider master record.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; 45 CFR Part 162; NPDB Guidebook — HHS

attributes.name: queried_practitioner_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the practitioner as submitted in the NPDB query. Captured at query time to preserve the exact name used for matching, independent of any subsequent name changes on the provider master record.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; HIPAA Privacy Rule — 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: queried_ssn_last4
attributes.business_glossary_term: Queried Social Security Number (SSN) Last Four Digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the practitioner's Social Security Number as submitted in the NPDB query for identity matching purposes. Only the last four digits are stored to minimize PHI exposure while supporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule — 45 CFR Part 164; NPDB Guidebook — HHS; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: queried_state_license_number
attributes.description: The state medical or professional license number of the practitioner as submitted in the NPDB query. Captured at query time to preserve the exact license identifier used for the query.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; NPDB Guidebook — HHS

attributes.name: query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Submission Date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the NPDB query was submitted to the National Practitioner Data Bank. This is the principal business event date for the transaction.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: query_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date on which the NPDB query response expires for credentialing purposes. Per TJC and CMS standards, NPDB responses are typically valid for a defined period (commonly 180 days) for credentialing decisions. After this date, a new query must be submitted.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: query_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Reference Number
attributes.description: Externally assigned unique reference number issued by the NPDB system upon submission of the query. Used for tracking and reconciliation with NPDB responses.

attributes.name: query_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NPDB query: submitted (sent to NPDB), pending (awaiting response), completed (response received and processed), error (submission or processing failure), or cancelled (query withdrawn before completion).

attributes.name: query_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Type
attributes.description: Classification of the NPDB query indicating the purpose: initial credentialing (first-time privilege application), reappointment (periodic renewal), continuous query enrollment (ongoing monitoring subscription), one-time self-query (practitioner self-check), or one-time entity query (facility-initiated). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_credentialing|reappointment|continuous_query|one_time_self|one_time_entity — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: querying_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the healthcare organization (hospital, clinic, health system) that submitted the NPDB query. Required by NPDB to identify the authorized querying entity.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60.10; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: querying_organization_npdb_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Querying Organization National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Registration ID
attributes.description: NPDB-assigned registration identifier for the querying organization. Required for authorized entity queries and used for NPDB audit trail reconciliation.

attributes.name: report_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Count
attributes.description: Total number of individual reports returned by the NPDB in response to this query. Zero indicates a clear response; values greater than zero require credentialing committee review.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; 45 CFR Part 60; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Response Date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the NPDB returned a response to the submitted query. Null if the response has not yet been received.

attributes.name: response_document_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Response Document Reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference or storage path for the official NPDB response document received from the NPDB. Supports retrieval of the original response for credentialing file documentation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; HIPAA Security Rule — 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Response Status
attributes.description: Outcome status returned by the NPDB: no_report (no adverse actions or malpractice payments on file), report_found (one or more reports exist), subject_not_found (practitioner not identified in NPDB), error (NPDB processing error), or pending (response not yet received).

attributes.name: response_turnaround_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Response Turnaround Days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the query submission date and the response date. Used for credentialing process performance monitoring and compliance with facility-defined SLA targets for credentialing turnaround.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: resubmission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NPDB query record represents a resubmission of a previously failed or errored query. True if this is a resubmission; False if this is an original submission.

attributes.name: review_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credentialing committee or medical executive committee completed its review of the NPDB query response. Null if review has not yet been completed or was not required.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the credentialing committee review of the NPDB query response: approved (privileges granted), approved_with_conditions (privileges granted with restrictions), deferred (decision postponed pending additional information), denied (privileges not granted), or pending (review in progress).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB query response requires escalation to the credentialing committee or medical executive committee for review, typically triggered when report_count is greater than zero or adverse_action_flag is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Submission Method
attributes.description: Method by which the NPDB query was submitted: electronic (via NPDB web portal), manual (paper-based or phone submission), or api (system-to-system integration). Supports audit and process improvement analysis.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook — HHS; HITRUST CSF; HL7 FHIR

attributes.name: submitted_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the credentialing staff member who submitted the NPDB query on behalf of the organization. Supports audit trail and accountability for credentialing operations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NPDB query record was most recently modified in the system. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

products.name: sanction
products.description: Records adverse actions, sanctions, exclusions, and disciplinary events against clinicians and organizational providers from regulatory bodies including OIG exclusion list, state medical boards, DEA, CMS, and other federal/state authorities. Captures sanction type, issuing authority, sanction date, reinstatement date, sanction reason, case reference number, and current status. Critical for monthly OIG exclusion screening (mandatory for all CMS-participating organizations), credentialing verification, fraud and abuse prevention under the False Claims Act, and CMS Conditions of Participation compliance. Supports automated exclusion screening workflows and adverse action reporting to NPDB.
products.reference: OIG Exclusion List, LEIE, SAM.gov, NPDB

attributes.name: sanction_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sanction, exclusion, or adverse action record in the provider sanction repository. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins and audit references.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Exclusion Program

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sanctioned healthcare professional or organizational provider in the master provider registry. Links the adverse action to the specific clinician, group, or entity subject to the sanction.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: Sanctions must be reported to NPDB within 30 days, state licensing boards per statute, and potentially CMS. Compliance teams track mandatory reporting submissions, confirmation numbers, and deadlines

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.investigation. Business justification: Every sanction against a provider triggers formal compliance investigation per medical staff bylaws and regulatory requirements. Investigation records document root cause analysis, corrective actions,

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Sanctions can apply to organizational providers in addition to individual clinicians. FK will be NULL for clinician-only sanctions. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: patient_safety_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.patient_safety_event. Business justification: Sanctions may result from serious safety events (sentinel events, never events) requiring regulatory reporting to state boards and NPDB. Linking sanction to originating safety event supports root caus

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: Payer-imposed sanctions (network termination, payment holds, credentialing suspension) must be tracked for compliance and enrollment status. Essential for sanction screening, network participation man

attributes.name: quality_peer_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.peer_review. Business justification: Sanctions (privilege suspension, license restriction) often originate from peer review findings of substandard care. NPDB reporting requires linking sanction actions to the underlying peer review case

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Sanctions are often specialty-specific. sanction.provider_specialty should reference specialty table for consistency.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider formally filed an appeal or administrative challenge against the sanction. Null if no appeal has been filed. Used to track appeal timelines and statutory deadlines.
attributes.references: NPDB; OIG Exclusion Program; Administrative Procedure Act

attributes.name: appeal_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sanctioned provider has filed a formal appeal or administrative challenge against the adverse action. A True value triggers additional workflow steps including legal review, credentialing committee notification, and potential temporary reinstatement consideration.
attributes.references: NPDB; OIG Exclusion Program; Administrative Procedure Act

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the provider's formal appeal of the sanction. Upheld means the original sanction stands; overturned means the sanction was rescinded; modified means the terms were changed; withdrawn means the provider withdrew the appeal. Null if no appeal was filed or outcome is not yet determined.
attributes.references: NPDB; OIG Exclusion Program; Administrative Procedure Act

attributes.name: case_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned case or docket number issued by the sanctioning authority (e.g., OIG case number, state medical board docket, DEA order number). Used for cross-referencing with the issuing regulatory body and NPDB reports.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank); DEA

attributes.name: cia_reference_number
attributes.description: The OIG-assigned reference number for the Corporate Integrity Agreement associated with this sanction record. Null if no CIA was executed. Used for cross-referencing OIG CIA monitoring reports and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: civil_monetary_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of any civil monetary penalty assessed against the provider as part of or in conjunction with the sanction. Applicable when the OIG or CMS imposes financial penalties under the Civil Monetary Penalties Law. Zero or null if no monetary penalty was assessed.
attributes.references: Civil Monetary Penalties Law 42 U.S.C. § 1320a-7a; OIG; CMS

attributes.name: corporate_integrity_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corporate Integrity Agreement was executed between the provider or organization and the OIG as a condition of reinstatement or settlement. A True value requires ongoing compliance monitoring, annual reporting, and independent review organization (IRO) oversight.
attributes.references: OIG Corporate Integrity Agreement Program; False Claims Act 31 U.S.C. § 3729

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the sanction record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail anchor for record provenance, compliance documentation, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: credentialing_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credentialing hold has been placed on the provider as a result of this sanction, preventing the granting or renewal of hospital privileges, payer enrollment, or network participation. True triggers automated workflow in the credentialing system (Symplr) to suspend privilege processing.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; Symplr Credentialing; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: dea_registration_number
attributes.description: The DEA registration number of the provider at the time of the sanction, captured when the adverse action involves controlled substance violations or DEA revocation/suspension. Stored on the sanction record to preserve the identifier as of the action date.

attributes.name: exclusion_type_code
attributes.description: OIG-specific exclusion classification code indicating whether the exclusion is mandatory (e.g., 1128(a)) or permissive (e.g., 1128(b)) under the Social Security Act. Mandatory exclusions require immediate termination from all federal healthcare programs; permissive exclusions are discretionary. Critical for CMS Conditions of Participation compliance.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; Social Security Act § 1128; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The scheduled end date of a time-limited sanction or probationary period as defined in the issuing authority's order. Distinct from reinstatement_date, which reflects actual restoration. Null for indefinite or permanent exclusions.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; State Medical Board Standards; DEA

attributes.name: federal_program_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sanction constitutes an exclusion from participation in federal healthcare programs including Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP, and other CMS-administered programs. True triggers mandatory termination of billing privileges and employment restrictions under CMS Conditions of Participation.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; Social Security Act § 1128

attributes.name: internal_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organization's credentialing committee, medical staff office, or compliance department completed its internal review of the sanction. Used to demonstrate timely response to adverse actions per TJC and CMS standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: internal_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the organization's internal credentialing committee or compliance review of the sanction. Pending indicates review not yet initiated; in_review indicates active committee review; completed indicates review concluded; escalated indicates referral to senior leadership or legal counsel.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, government agency, or licensing board that imposed the sanction (e.g., Office of Inspector General, Drug Enforcement Administration, State Medical Board of California, CMS, NPDB). Critical for determining the scope and legal basis of the adverse action.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; DEA; CMS; State Departments of Health; NPDB

attributes.name: issuing_authority_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the sanctioning authority level. Distinguishes federal exclusions (OIG, CMS, DEA) from state-level actions (state medical boards, state health departments) and accreditation bodies (The Joint Commission). Determines mandatory reporting and screening frequency requirements.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The state professional license number of the provider subject to the sanction at the time of the adverse action. Captured to preserve the license identifier as of the sanction date, particularly for state medical board revocations and suspensions.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; State Medical Board Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation of the jurisdiction that issued the professional license affected by the sanction. Used to identify the applicable state medical board or licensing authority and to scope the geographic impact of the adverse action.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; State Medical Board Standards

attributes.name: medicaid_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is specifically excluded from the Medicaid program. A True value requires notification to the state Medicaid agency and termination of Medicaid billing privileges. State-level exclusions may apply even when federal OIG exclusion is not in effect.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Exclusion Program; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: medicare_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is specifically excluded from the Medicare program. A True value requires immediate termination of Medicare billing privileges and prohibits the organization from employing or contracting with the excluded individual in any capacity paid by Medicare.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Exclusion Program; Social Security Act § 1128

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, compliance officer observations, legal counsel notes, or supplementary information related to the sanction that is not captured in structured fields. Used by credentialing and compliance staff for case management.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which notifications regarding the sanction were dispatched to required internal and external parties. Used for compliance audit trails demonstrating timely adverse action response.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC); NPDB

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required notifications have been sent to relevant internal stakeholders (medical staff office, department chief, compliance officer, revenue cycle) and external parties (payers, state licensing boards) following identification of the sanction.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC); OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: npdb_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adverse action was reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank. Must occur within 30 days of the action per HCQIA requirements. Null if not yet reported or reporting is not required for this sanction type.
attributes.references: NPDB; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. § 11101

attributes.name: npdb_report_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Number
attributes.description: The unique report identifier assigned by the National Practitioner Data Bank when the adverse action was reported. Required for NPDB query and response matching, credentialing verification, and mandatory adverse action reporting compliance under HCQIA.
attributes.references: NPDB; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. § 11101

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to the sanctioned provider. Required for OIG exclusion screening, NPDB adverse action reporting, and payer enrollment verification. Stored directly on the sanction record to preserve the identifier at the time of the adverse action.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA Administrative Simplification 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sanction has triggered or is expected to trigger termination or suspension of the provider's payer enrollment with one or more health plans or government programs. True initiates payer notification workflows and revenue cycle impact assessment.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Exclusion Program; Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: privilege_suspension
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's clinical privileges at the organization's facilities have been suspended as a direct result of this sanction. Distinct from credentialing_hold, which applies to new or renewal applications. True requires immediate notification to department chiefs and medical staff office.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; HCQIA

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sanctioned entity is an individual clinician (physician, nurse, allied health professional) or an organizational provider (hospital, group practice, DME supplier). Determines applicable screening rules, reporting obligations, and credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; OIG Exclusion Program; NPDB

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the basis or grounds for the adverse action as stated by the issuing authority. May include fraud, abuse, patient harm, controlled substance violations, billing irregularities, or professional misconduct. Used for credentialing review, CDI, and fraud and abuse prevention analysis.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; False Claims Act 31 U.S.C. § 3729; DEA; State Medical Board Standards

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the category of misconduct or violation that led to the sanction, as defined by the issuing authority or NPDB classification scheme (e.g., OIG exclusion basis codes: 1128a, 1128b). Enables structured analytics and regulatory reporting across sanction types.
attributes.references: NPDB; OIG Exclusion Program; Social Security Act § 1128

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was formally reinstated or restored to good standing by the issuing authority following completion of the sanction period or successful appeal. Null if the sanction is still active or has not been lifted.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; NPDB; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: reported_to_npdb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reported to National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse action has been reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank as required under the Health Care Quality Improvement Act. Mandatory reporting is required for clinical privilege actions, professional society membership actions, and certain licensure actions.
attributes.references: NPDB; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. § 11101; CMS

attributes.name: sanction_date
attributes.description: The official effective date on which the sanction, exclusion, or adverse action was imposed by the issuing authority. This is the principal business event date used for OIG exclusion screening compliance, credentialing holds, and False Claims Act liability calculations.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; False Claims Act 31 U.S.C. § 3729

attributes.name: sanction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sanction record. Active indicates the adverse action is in force; reinstated indicates the provider has been restored; expired indicates the sanction period has lapsed; appealed indicates a formal challenge is pending; withdrawn indicates the issuing authority rescinded the action.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; NPDB

attributes.name: sanction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adverse action imposed on the provider. Drives downstream workflow routing, credentialing holds, and regulatory reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exclusion|suspension|revocation|probation|reprimand|civil_monetary_penalty|debarment|restriction|surrender — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; State Medical Board Standards; DEA

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organization performed the exclusion screening check that identified or confirmed this sanction record. Mandatory for demonstrating monthly OIG exclusion screening compliance as required by CMS Conditions of Participation. Distinct from sanction_date.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: screening_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the organization screens this provider against exclusion lists. Monthly screening is the OIG-recommended standard for all CMS-participating organizations. Quarterly or annual may apply to certain vendor categories. Supports compliance monitoring and audit documentation.
attributes.references: OIG Compliance Program Guidance; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: screening_source
attributes.description: The authoritative data source from which the sanction record was identified or verified. OIG_LEIE refers to the OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities; SAM refers to the System for Award Management federal debarment list; NPDB is the National Practitioner Data Bank. Drives audit trail for monthly OIG screening compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OIG_LEIE|SAM|NPDB|state_board|DEA|CMS|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; SAM.gov; NPDB; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of any financial settlement reached between the provider and the sanctioning authority in connection with the adverse action. Relevant for False Claims Act settlements, corporate integrity agreements, and OIG settlement agreements. Null if no settlement was reached.
attributes.references: False Claims Act 31 U.S.C. § 3729; OIG; DOJ

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the official sanction order, exclusion notice, or adverse action document issued by the sanctioning authority. Supports audit documentation, legal review, and credentialing file maintenance.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Program; NPDB; HIM (Health Information Management) Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the sanction record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to sanction status, appeal outcomes, reinstatement dates, and compliance flags. Essential for change data capture (CDC) in the lakehouse ETL pipeline.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

products.name: dea_registration
products.description: Master record of DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) controlled substance registrations for clinicians authorized to prescribe Schedule II-V medications. Captures DEA number, registration date, expiration date, DEA schedule authorizations, state of registration, registration status, and business activity type. Required for pharmacy order validation and controlled substance compliance.
products.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act, 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: dea_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each DEA controlled substance registration record in the enterprise data platform. Primary key for the dea_registration data product.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: DEA registration fees are paid through AP. Links registration records to payment transactions for fee tracking, renewal payment verification, and regulatory compliance expense reporting.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary healthcare facility or practice location associated with this DEA registration. DEA registrations are location-specific; this links the registration to the enterprise facility master record for network and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; Joint Commission Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed healthcare professional or organizational provider who holds this DEA registration. Links to the authoritative provider master record.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; NPI Registry — CMS

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: DEA registration renewals and modifications are regulatory submissions to DEA. Credentialing teams track submission dates, DEA confirmation numbers, payment receipts, and approval status to maintain u

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider's credentialing record in the credentialing management system (e.g., Symplr). Links the DEA registration to the broader credentialing and privileging workflow for the provider.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: business_activity_type
attributes.description: The DEA-defined category of business activity for which the registration is issued. Determines the type of controlled substance activities the registrant is authorized to perform. Practitioner covers physicians, dentists, and veterinarians; mid-level practitioner covers nurse practitioners and physician assistants; hospital and pharmacy cover institutional registrants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: practitioner|mid-level_practitioner|hospital|pharmacy|researcher|manufacturer|distributor|importer|exporter|reverse_distributor|narcotic_treatment_program — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.13; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: days_until_expiration
attributes.description: The number of calendar days remaining until the DEA registration expires, calculated as of the most recent data refresh date. Supports proactive credentialing management and pharmacy compliance dashboards. Note: This is a point-in-time snapshot value loaded during ETL; it is not a real-time computed field.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.31; Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: The official DEA registration number assigned by the Drug Enforcement Administration to authorize the registrant to handle controlled substances. Format: two-letter prefix followed by seven digits. Used for pharmacy order validation and controlled substance prescribing verification.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.13; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: expiration_alert_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiration alert notification was sent to the provider and/or credentialing staff. Null if no alert has been sent. Used for credentialing workflow audit trails.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; Internal Credentialing Policy

attributes.name: expiration_alert_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an expiration alert notification has been sent to the provider and/or credentialing staff regarding the upcoming expiration of this DEA registration. Supports proactive renewal workflow management.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; Internal Credentialing Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the DEA registration expires and the provider is no longer authorized to prescribe or handle controlled substances under this registration. DEA registrations are typically issued for a three-year term. Critical for pharmacy order validation and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.13; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: fee_amount
