attributes.description: The registration fee paid to the DEA for the current registration period, in U.S. dollars. DEA registration fees vary by registrant type and are set by federal regulation. Used for credentialing cost tracking and budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.21; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: fee_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant is exempt from DEA registration fees. Fee exemptions apply to federal, state, and local government practitioners, as well as certain public health service providers. Relevant for registration cost tracking and compliance.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.21; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff to document additional context, exceptions, or administrative notes related to the DEA registration. Examples include documentation of DEA correspondence, special conditions, or manual verification notes.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; Internal Credentialing Policy

attributes.name: npi_number
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) associated with the provider holding this DEA registration. Used to cross-reference the DEA registration with the provider's NPI record for pharmacy claims validation, payer enrollment verification, and PDMP (Prescription Drug Monitoring Program) reporting.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.406; Health Level Seven (HL7) FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DEA registration fee was paid for the current registration period. Used for financial reconciliation and credentialing audit trails.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.21; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: pdmp_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) Reporting Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider holding this DEA registration is subject to mandatory Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) reporting requirements in the registered state. PDMP reporting obligations vary by state and practitioner type.
attributes.references: State PDMP Statutes; PDMP TTAC (Training and Technical Assistance Center); DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: practitioner_type_code
attributes.description: DEA-assigned code identifying the specific practitioner type category (e.g., MD, DO, DDS, DVM, NP, PA, CRNA). Determines prescribing authority scope and schedule authorization eligibility. Sourced from DEA registration application form. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|DO|DDS|DMD|DVM|NP|PA|CRNA|CNM|PharmD|RPh|ND|OD|DPM|PhD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1300.01; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this DEA registration record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this DEA registration record was most recently updated in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the practice location registered with the DEA. The DEA registration is location-specific; a provider with multiple practice sites may require separate registrations per location.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, unit number) of the practice location registered with the DEA. Supplements the primary address line for precise location identification.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City of the practice location registered with the DEA for this controlled substance registration.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registered_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the individual practitioner or organization as it appears on the DEA registration certificate. May differ from the provider's operational display name. Used for verification against DEA public registry and pharmacy dispensing records.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.13; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registered_zip_code
attributes.description: U.S. ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the practice location registered with the DEA. Used for geographic analysis of controlled substance prescribing patterns and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; USPS Postal Standards

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the DEA registration was originally issued or most recently renewed by the Drug Enforcement Administration. Represents the effective start of the current registration period.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.13; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registration_state
attributes.description: The U.S. state or territory in which the DEA registration is valid and the provider is authorized to prescribe controlled substances. DEA registrations are state-specific; a provider practicing in multiple states requires a separate DEA registration for each state. Represented as a two-letter USPS state abbreviation.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DEA registration. Active indicates the registration is valid and the provider may prescribe controlled substances. Expired indicates the registration has lapsed and must be renewed before prescribing. Suspended or revoked indicates regulatory action has been taken.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration is held by an individual practitioner or by an institutional entity (e.g., hospital, clinic, pharmacy). Institutional registrations cover all authorized practitioners operating under the institution's DEA number.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.12; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider submitted a renewal application to the DEA for continuation of the controlled substance registration. DEA regulations require renewal applications to be submitted at least 45 days before expiration. Used for credentialing workflow tracking in Symplr.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.31; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: renewal_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation or tracking number issued by the DEA upon receipt of a renewal application. Used to track the status of pending renewals and follow up with the DEA Diversion Control Division.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.31; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DEA registration was formally revoked by the Drug Enforcement Administration. Revocation is a permanent action distinct from suspension. Null when the registration has not been revoked.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: schedule_ii_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule II controlled substances (e.g., opioids such as oxycodone, stimulants such as amphetamine). Schedule II substances have high abuse potential with severe psychological or physical dependence. Required for CPOE validation in Epic Willow and Cerner PharmNet.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.12; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_iii_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule III controlled substances (e.g., anabolic steroids, buprenorphine combinations). Schedule III substances have moderate to low physical dependence potential.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.13; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_iin_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule IIN non-narcotic controlled substances (e.g., stimulants such as methylphenidate, Adderall). Distinct from Schedule IIN narcotic authorizations for pharmacy dispensing and order validation purposes.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.12; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_iv_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule IV controlled substances (e.g., benzodiazepines, tramadol). Schedule IV substances have lower abuse potential relative to Schedule III.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.14; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: schedule_v_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DEA registration authorizes the provider to prescribe Schedule V controlled substances (e.g., cough preparations with less than 200mg of codeine per 100mL). Schedule V substances have the lowest abuse potential among controlled substances.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308.15; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this DEA registration record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation across credentialing platforms.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier for this DEA registration in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr provider ID, Epic provider record number). Used for ETL reconciliation and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: surrender_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider voluntarily surrendered the DEA registration to the Drug Enforcement Administration. Voluntary surrender may occur upon retirement, change of practice, or in lieu of revocation proceedings.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.52; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DEA registration was suspended by the Drug Enforcement Administration or voluntarily surrendered by the provider. Null when the registration has not been suspended. Triggers immediate pharmacy order blocking in CPOE systems.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for suspension or revocation of the DEA registration, as documented by the DEA or the provider's credentialing department. Includes regulatory action codes, voluntary surrender reasons, or administrative hold explanations.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301.36; OIG Exclusion Database

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the DEA registration was verified against the DEA Diversion Control Division public registry or through a primary source verification process. Required for Joint Commission and NCQA credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the DEA registration during the credentialing or re-credentialing process. DEA portal indicates direct query to the DEA Diversion Control Division online registry; primary source indicates direct contact with the DEA; third party indicates use of a credentialing verification organization (CVO).
attributes.references: Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards; DEA Diversion Control Division

attributes.name: x_waiver_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider holds a DATA 2000 waiver (formerly X-waiver) authorizing the prescribing of buprenorphine for opioid use disorder treatment in an office-based setting. As of the SUPPORT Act (2023), the X-waiver requirement was eliminated, but this flag tracks historical and current waiver status for compliance and analytics.
attributes.references: Drug Addiction Treatment Act of 2000 (DATA 2000); SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act (2018); DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; SAMHSA

attributes.name: x_waiver_patient_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of patients the provider is authorized to treat with buprenorphine for opioid use disorder under the DATA 2000 waiver. Common limits are 30, 100, or 275 patients depending on provider type and waiver tier. Null if x_waiver_authorized is false or not applicable.
attributes.references: Drug Addiction Treatment Act of 2000 (DATA 2000); SAMHSA; DEA Diversion Control Division

products.name: board_certification
products.description: Tracks specialty board certifications earned by clinicians from recognized certifying bodies (ABMS, AOA). Captures certifying board name, specialty certified, certification number, initial certification date, expiration date, maintenance of certification (MOC) status, and recertification history. Used in credentialing, provider directory, and quality reporting.
products.reference: ABMS (American Board of Medical Specialties), AOA

attributes.name: board_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each board certification record in the system. Primary key for the board_certification data product within the provider domain.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: Board certification exam fees and recertification costs are paid via AP invoices. Links certification records to payment transactions for CME budget tracking and credentialing expense analysis.

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed healthcare professional (physician, nurse practitioner, or allied health professional) who holds this board certification. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Registry

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.credentialing_application. Business justification: Board certifications are submitted during credentialing applications. FK will be NULL for certifications not tied to a specific application. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: credentialing_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider's credentialing file or application record in the credentialing management system (e.g., Symplr). Links this board certification to the broader credentialing and privileging workflow for the provider.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Board certifications held by employed physicians. Real business need: competency verification, privileging decisions, compensation tier determination, quality reporting, medical staff reappointment fo

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.specialty

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training. Business justification: Board certifications require MOC (Maintenance of Certification) training activities. Credentialing systems link CME courses to specific board MOC requirements to track compliance with recertification

attributes.name: caqh_provider_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) Provider ID
attributes.description: The CAQH ProView universal provider identifier associated with the provider for this certification record. CAQH ProView is the industry-standard credentialing data repository used by payers and health plans for provider enrollment and re-credentialing. Enables direct linkage to the provider's CAQH profile.
attributes.references: CAQH ProView Credentialing Data Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric certificate number issued by the certifying board to the provider upon successful completion of board examination and certification requirements. Used as the externally-known business identifier for this certification record in credentialing and payer enrollment workflows.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA) Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the board certification. Active = valid and in good standing; Expired = past expiration date without renewal; Revoked = rescinded by certifying board due to disciplinary action or fraud; Suspended = temporarily inactive; Pending = examination passed but certificate not yet issued; Lapsed = MOC requirements not met within required window.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) Credentialing Standards MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record represents an initial board certification, a recertification cycle, an added qualification (subspecialty), or a Maintenance of Certification (MOC) milestone. Drives credentialing workflow routing and expiration tracking logic.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: certifying_board_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or abbreviation identifying the certifying board (e.g., ABIM for American Board of Internal Medicine, ABS for American Board of Surgery). Used in downstream credentialing systems and payer enrollment data exchanges.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); CAQH ProView Credentialing Data Standards

attributes.name: certifying_board_name
attributes.description: Full name of the recognized specialty certifying board that issued this certification (e.g., American Board of Internal Medicine, American Board of Surgery). Must be an ABMS member board or AOA-recognized certifying board for credentialing acceptance.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA); The Joint Commission (TJC) Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: certifying_organization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the umbrella organization under which the certifying board operates. ABMS = American Board of Medical Specialties (allopathic physicians), AOA = American Osteopathic Association (osteopathic physicians), ANCC = American Nurses Credentialing Center, AANP = American Association of Nurse Practitioners, AAPA = American Academy of Physician Associates.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association (AOA); American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this board certification record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data governance, lineage tracking, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current certification cycle or recertification became effective. For initial certifications this may equal initial_certification_date; for recertifications this reflects the start of the renewed certification period.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); CAQH ProView Credentialing Data Standards

attributes.name: exam_attempt_number
attributes.description: The sequential attempt number on which the provider passed the board certification examination. A value of 1 indicates first-attempt pass. Used in quality and credentialing analytics to assess examination performance.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Examination Policies

attributes.name: exam_pass_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider successfully passed the board certification examination administered by the certifying board. Distinct from initial_certification_date, which reflects when the certificate was formally issued.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); AOA Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current board certification expires and must be renewed through recertification or Maintenance of Certification (MOC). Null for lifetime certifications issued prior to time-limited certification policies. Critical for credentialing expiration alerts and payer enrollment compliance.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: initial_certification_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the provider first achieved board certification in this specialty from this certifying board. Represents the effective start of the agreement/credential. Used to calculate years of board certification and tenure in credentialing analytics.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: is_active_privileges_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether active hospital privileges in this specialty are required to be maintained in conjunction with this board certification per the organization's medical staff bylaws or credentialing policies.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR 482.22

attributes.name: is_lifetime_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this board certification was issued as a lifetime (non-time-limited) certificate, typically granted to physicians who achieved certification prior to the introduction of time-limited recertification requirements by ABMS member boards. When True, expiration_date is expected to be null.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) Time-Limited Certification Policy

attributes.name: is_primary_specialty
attributes.description: Indicates whether this board certification represents the provider's primary specialty designation. A provider may hold multiple board certifications; this flag identifies the principal specialty used for provider directory listings, referral routing, and quality reporting.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment Chain and Ownership System (PECOS)

attributes.name: moc_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the provider must complete all required Maintenance of Certification (MOC) activities to maintain certification in good standing. Used for proactive credentialing alerts and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; The Joint Commission (TJC) Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: moc_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider enrolled in the Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program associated with this board certification. Used to track MOC program participation timelines and compliance windows.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program

attributes.name: moc_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program the provider is enrolled in for this certification (e.g., ABIM MOC, ABS Continuous Certification). Different boards operate distinct MOC programs with varying requirements.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program Directory

attributes.name: moc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's participation in the Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program as required by the certifying board. MOC programs require ongoing professional development, self-assessment, and practice improvement activities to maintain board certification in good standing.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: notes
