attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to the provider or organization at this location. Used for claims submission, payer enrollment, and provider directory publishing. May be the individual NPI (Type 1) or organizational NPI (Type 2) depending on the location context.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; 45 CFR Part 162; CMS NPI Final Rule

attributes.name: parking_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text description of parking availability and instructions for patients visiting this location. Supports patient experience and navigation in provider directories.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; NCQA Provider Directory Standards

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the practice location used for patient scheduling, referrals, and provider directory publishing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR Part 438; NCQA Provider Directory Standards

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the practice location. Used for geographic proximity searches, network adequacy distance calculations, and CMS enrollment validation.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: public_transit_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location is accessible via public transportation. Supports Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) analysis and patient access equity reporting.
attributes.references: SDOH Framework (HHS); CMS Health Equity Initiatives; NCQA Health Equity Accreditation

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this provider location record was sourced (e.g., Epic Cadence, Symplr, NPPES). Supports data lineage, ETL audit, and master data management reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Epic|Cerner|MEDITECH|Symplr|NPPES|CMS|Salesforce|Manual — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; HL7 FHIR R4 Location Resource; CMS Interoperability Final Rule

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this location record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic department ID, Symplr location ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Location Resource; CMS Interoperability Final Rule; Epic Cadence

attributes.name: specialty_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy codes representing the clinical specialties offered at this location. Used for provider directory specialty filtering and network adequacy specialty gap analysis.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; NPPES NPI Registry; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the practice location. Drives state licensure validation, Medicaid enrollment eligibility, and state-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; CMS Provider Enrollment; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: taxonomy_code
attributes.description: Primary NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy code for this location, representing the provider type and classification at this site. Used in NPPES NPI registry, claims submission, and provider directory classification.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; NPPES NPI Registry; HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider location record was or will be deactivated. Null for currently active locations. Used for CMS disenrollment processing, payer contract termination, and provider directory removal.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR Part 424; CMS-855 Enrollment Application

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider location record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public-facing website URL for the practice location. Published in provider directories to support patient self-service and appointment scheduling.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR Part 438

products.name: reappointment
products.description: Transactional record of the periodic medical staff reappointment process for clinicians at a facility, typically conducted every two years per Joint Commission standards. Captures reappointment cycle, review period, peer review summary, quality indicator results, CME compliance status, reappointment decision, and effective date of renewed appointment. Drives ongoing credentialing lifecycle management.
products.reference: Joint Commission MS.08.01.01, NCQA Recredentialing Standards

attributes.name: reappointment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each medical staff reappointment record. Primary key for the reappointment data product.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05 — Medical Staff Reappointment

attributes.name: approving_committee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.committee. Business justification: Reappointment reviews are conducted by medical staff committees (credentials committee). The reappointment table has credentials_committee_review_date and credentials_committee_recommendation attribut

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Reappointment processes are audited for compliance with medical staff bylaws and TJC MS standards. Credentials committees require documented audit trails of reappointment file reviews, OPPE/FPPE compl

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, or care site) at which the provider is being reappointed to the medical staff.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare provider (clinician) undergoing the reappointment process. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical department or service line within the facility to which the provider is being reappointed (e.g., Surgery, Internal Medicine, Emergency Medicine).

attributes.name: quality_peer_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.peer_review. Business justification: Reappointment decisions directly reference specific peer review cases from the review period as evidence of clinical competency. Medical staff bylaws require documented peer review outcomes for reappo

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Reappointment reviews are specialty-specific. reappointment.specialty_code and specialty_name should reference specialty table.

attributes.name: application_deadline_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the provider must submit a completed reappointment application to avoid lapse of appointment. Typically set 90–120 days before current appointment expiration.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: application_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed reappointment application was received from the provider. Triggers the formal credentialing review timeline and regulatory clock.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: appointment_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years of the renewed appointment granted upon successful reappointment. Standard term is two years per Joint Commission requirements; may be shorter for provisional or conditional appointments.

attributes.name: case_volume
attributes.description: Total number of clinical cases, procedures, or patient encounters attributed to the provider during the reappointment review period. Used to assess clinical activity sufficiency for privilege maintenance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: cme_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the provider has satisfied the CME credit hour requirements for reappointment eligibility. Non-compliant status may result in conditional approval or deferral.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: cme_hours_completed
attributes.description: Actual number of CME credit hours completed by the provider during the review period as documented in the credentialing file. Compared against cme_hours_required to determine CME compliance status.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME); State Medical Board CME Requirements

attributes.name: cme_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Medical Education (CME) credit hours required for this provider to satisfy reappointment eligibility during the review period, per facility bylaws and state licensure requirements.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME); State Medical Board CME Requirements

attributes.name: conditions_of_reappointment
attributes.description: Narrative description of any conditions, restrictions, or requirements attached to a conditional reappointment approval (e.g., mandatory proctoring, case volume minimums, additional CME in specific areas, mandatory consultation requirements).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reappointment record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) — Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: credentials_committee_recommendation
attributes.description: Formal recommendation of the credentials committee submitted to the medical executive committee regarding the provider's reappointment application.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: credentials_committee_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credentials committee formally reviewed the provider's reappointment application and supporting documentation, and forwarded a recommendation to the medical executive committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: current_appointment_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the provider's existing medical staff appointment that this reappointment process is renewing. Defines the urgency and timeline of the reappointment cycle.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of how many times this provider has been reappointed at this facility (e.g., 1 = first reappointment, 2 = second reappointment). Supports longitudinal credentialing history analysis.

attributes.name: dea_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Registration Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's DEA registration (if applicable) has been verified as current and active through primary source verification during this reappointment cycle.
attributes.references: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Final outcome of the reappointment review process as determined by the medical executive committee and/or governing board. Drives downstream privileging, payer enrollment, and NPDB reporting actions.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NPDB Guidebook; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the medical executive committee or governing board rendered the final reappointment decision (approved, denied, or deferred).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for denial or deferral of the reappointment application. Required for due process notifications and National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA)

attributes.name: due_process_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider invoked their right to a fair hearing or appeal following an adverse reappointment decision (denial or significant restriction). Triggers the formal hearing process per medical staff bylaws and HCQIA.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA); The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.09.01.01 — Fair Hearing

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the renewed medical staff appointment becomes effective following a successful reappointment decision. Marks the start of the new appointment term.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: health_status_attestation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider has completed the required health status attestation confirming physical and mental fitness to perform the clinical privileges requested during this reappointment cycle.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA); EEOC Guidelines

attributes.name: license_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's state medical license has been verified as current and in good standing through primary source verification (PSV) during this reappointment cycle.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage per occurrence as verified during this reappointment cycle. Compared against facility-required minimums.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 8

attributes.name: malpractice_insurance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage has been verified as meeting facility minimum requirements during this reappointment cycle.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 8

attributes.name: medical_staff_category
attributes.description: Category of medical staff membership being reappointed (e.g., Active, Associate, Courtesy, Consulting). Determines voting rights, call obligations, and scope of privileges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|associate|courtesy|consulting|honorary|affiliate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.01.01.01; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: new_appointment_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the newly granted appointment term resulting from this reappointment. Typically two years from the effective date per Joint Commission standards.

attributes.name: npdb_adverse_finding
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Adverse Finding Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPDB query returned any adverse action reports, malpractice payment history, or licensure actions for this provider. Triggers mandatory committee review and potential conditions on reappointment.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Guidebook; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) §11135

attributes.name: npdb_queried
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Queried Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) was queried for adverse action reports, malpractice payment reports, and licensure actions during this reappointment cycle. Mandatory query per HCQIA for all reappointments.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Guidebook; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) §11135; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: npdb_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Date
attributes.description: Date on which the NPDB was queried for this provider during the reappointment cycle. Must be within the credentialing review window to satisfy regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Guidebook; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) §11135

attributes.name: npdb_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Date
attributes.description: Date on which the adverse action report was submitted to the NPDB following a denial or adverse reappointment decision. Must be submitted within 30 days of the final decision per HCQIA requirements.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Guidebook; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) §11133

attributes.name: npdb_report_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action report must be submitted to the NPDB as a result of this reappointment decision (e.g., denial, voluntary surrender of privileges during investigation). Mandatory reporting obligation under HCQIA.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Guidebook; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) §11133; CMS 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: oppe_performance_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) Performance Rating
attributes.description: Overall performance rating assigned during the most recent OPPE review cycle. Summarizes clinical quality, patient safety, and professional conduct indicators evaluated during the review period.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 — Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE)

attributes.name: oppe_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) Review Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) completed for this provider prior to the reappointment decision. OPPE data is a required input to the reappointment process per Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 — Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE)

attributes.name: peer_review_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the peer review findings conducted during the reappointment review period. Synthesizes Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) and Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) results. Protected under state peer review privilege statutes.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 (OPPE); MS.08.01.03 (FPPE); State Peer Review Protection Statutes

attributes.name: quality_indicator_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider met all required quality performance indicators (e.g., core measures, HEDIS metrics, VBP benchmarks) during the review period. A value of False may trigger additional review or conditions on reappointment.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP); NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: reappointment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the reappointment cycle record, used in correspondence, committee agendas, and credentialing file references (e.g., REAPPT-2024-000123).
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: reappointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reappointment application. Tracks progression from initiation through committee review to final decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_review|approved|denied|deferred|withdrawn — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Symplr Credentialing Workflow

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the clinical performance review period evaluated during this reappointment cycle. Marks the close of the data collection window for quality indicators and peer review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the clinical performance review period evaluated during this reappointment cycle. Typically covers the prior two years of practice activity at the facility.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: sanctions_check_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether OIG exclusion list, SAM.gov, and state Medicaid exclusion database checks were completed for this provider during the reappointment cycle. Mandatory for participation in federal healthcare programs.
attributes.references: Office of Inspector General (OIG) — List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE); SAM.gov; CMS 42 CFR §1001

attributes.name: sanctions_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OIG exclusion list and related sanctions database checks were completed for this provider during the reappointment cycle.
attributes.references: Office of Inspector General (OIG) — LEIE; SAM.gov; CMS 42 CFR §1001

attributes.name: sanctions_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether any active OIG exclusion, SAM.gov debarment, or state Medicaid exclusion was identified during the sanctions check. A True value mandates immediate escalation and precludes reappointment.
attributes.references: Office of Inspector General (OIG) — LEIE; CMS 42 CFR §1001; State Medicaid Exclusion Databases

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr reappointment record ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system of record.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; ETL Data Lineage Standards; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this reappointment record originated (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH Expanse, or Manual entry).
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; Epic EHR; Cerner Millennium; MEDITECH Expanse

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reappointment record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) — Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

products.name: peer_reference
products.description: Records peer reference evaluations submitted on behalf of a clinician during credentialing or reappointment. Captures referee name, referee NPI, relationship to applicant, evaluation date, clinical competency ratings, professional conduct assessment, recommendation type, and confidentiality flag. Required by NCQA and Joint Commission credentialing standards.
products.reference: NCQA Credentialing Standards, Joint Commission

attributes.name: peer_reference_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the peer reference evaluation record. Primary key for the peer_reference data product.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility or organization at which this peer reference evaluation is being processed, typically the credentialing entity.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Hospital Accreditation; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credentialing or reappointment application for which this peer reference was solicited. Links the evaluation to the specific credentialing cycle.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.investigation. Business justification: Negative peer references trigger compliance investigations into provider competency per medical staff bylaws. Adverse peer feedback (low ratings, adverse action knowledge) requires formal investigatio

attributes.name: primary_peer_clinician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinician (applicant) who is the subject of this peer reference evaluation. Used to associate the reference with the provider undergoing credentialing or reappointment.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: reappointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.reappointment. Business justification: Peer references are collected during both credentialing and reappointment. Adding reappointment_id FK (credentialing_application_id already exists). FK will be NULL for credentialing-only references.

attributes.name: referee_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: References provided by internal employees during credentialing. Real business need: tracking when current employees serve as peer references, conflict-of-interest management, reference quality assessm

attributes.name: adverse_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any adverse actions, disciplinary events, or concerns known to the referee regarding the applicant. Populated only when adverse_action_knowledge is True. Treated as confidential credentialing information.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB); OIG — Fraud and Abuse; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: adverse_action_knowledge
attributes.description: Indicates whether the referee has knowledge of any adverse actions, disciplinary proceedings, malpractice claims, or sanctions against the applicant. A True value triggers mandatory follow-up by the credentialing committee.
attributes.references: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB); OIG — Fraud and Abuse; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: clinical_competency_rating
attributes.description: Overall rating of the applicant's clinical competency as assessed by the referee. Reflects the referee's judgment of the applicant's medical knowledge, clinical skills, and patient care quality.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; ACGME Core Competencies

attributes.name: committee_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credentialing committee formally reviewed this peer reference as part of the credentialing or reappointment decision.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this peer reference record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the referee completed and submitted the peer reference evaluation form. This is the principal real-world event date for the evaluation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: follow_up_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the nature of required follow-up actions, outcomes of follow-up conversations, or committee decisions related to concerns raised in this peer reference.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credentialing committee has determined that additional follow-up is required based on the content of this peer reference (e.g., due to concerns raised or adverse action knowledge).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the peer reference evaluation form used for this submission. Ensures that ratings and questions are interpreted in the context of the correct form version, supporting audit and compliance reviews.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: interpersonal_communication_rating
attributes.description: Referee's rating of the applicant's ability to communicate effectively with patients, families, and the healthcare team. Covers listening, verbal, and written communication skills.
attributes.references: ACGME Core Competencies; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: is_confidential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the referee has requested that their identity and evaluation content be kept confidential from the applicant. When True, the reference is protected from disclosure per credentialing confidentiality policies.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.524

attributes.name: is_verbal_reference
attributes.description: Indicates whether this peer reference was obtained verbally (e.g., by phone) rather than via a written form. Verbal references require documentation of the conversation by the credentialing staff member who conducted the call.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: last_reminder_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent reminder communication sent to the referee. Used to manage follow-up cadence and determine when to escalate or seek an alternative referee.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: medical_knowledge_rating
attributes.description: Referee's rating of the applicant's medical knowledge, including understanding of biomedical, clinical, and social sciences relevant to their specialty.
attributes.references: ACGME Core Competencies; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: patient_care_rating
attributes.description: Referee's rating of the applicant's patient care competency, including compassionate and appropriate care, clinical judgment, and patient safety practices.
attributes.references: ACGME Core Competencies; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: professional_conduct_assessment
attributes.description: Referee's overall assessment of the applicant's professional conduct, including any behavioral, ethical, or disciplinary concerns observed during the period of professional acquaintance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; OIG Exclusion List; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: professionalism_rating
attributes.description: Referee's rating of the applicant's professionalism, including ethical behavior, accountability, respect for patients and colleagues, and adherence to professional standards.
attributes.references: ACGME Core Competencies; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: recommendation_type
attributes.description: The referee's overall recommendation regarding the applicant's fitness for credentialing, reappointment, or privilege grant. This is the primary decision-support field reviewed by the credentialing committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: referee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the referee to support their ratings and recommendation. May include specific examples of clinical performance, strengths, or areas of concern. Treated as confidential credentialing information.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: referee_license_number
attributes.description: State medical or professional license number of the referee. Verified to confirm the referee holds an active, unrestricted license at the time of evaluation.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: referee_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the referee holds their primary professional license. Used for license verification and jurisdictional compliance.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: referee_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the referee. Used to verify the referee's identity, licensure, and standing as a qualified peer evaluator per CMS and credentialing standards.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: referee_specialty
attributes.description: Primary clinical specialty of the referee. Used to assess whether the referee is a qualified peer (same or related specialty) as required by credentialing standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique identifier assigned to this peer reference request. Used for tracking and correspondence with the referee and credentialing committee.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: reference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the peer reference request. Tracks whether the reference has been requested, sent to the referee, received back, completed and reviewed, expired without response, or withdrawn.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: reference_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credentialing activity for which this peer reference is being collected. Distinguishes between initial credentialing, periodic reappointment, specific privilege requests, or focused professional practice evaluation (FPPE).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: relationship_to_applicant
attributes.description: Nature of the professional relationship between the referee and the applicant. Required by credentialing standards to confirm the referee has direct knowledge of the applicant's clinical performance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: colleague|supervisor|department_chief|program_director|co_practitioner|other — promote to reference product if additional values needed]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: reminder_sent_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder communications sent to the referee requesting completion of the peer reference form. Used to track follow-up efforts and escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: request_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the peer reference request form was sent to the referee. Used to track response timeliness and manage credentialing workflow deadlines.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the referee must return the completed peer reference form. Used to manage credentialing timelines and trigger follow-up reminders.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: reviewed_by_committee
attributes.description: Indicates whether this peer reference has been formally reviewed by the medical staff credentialing committee as part of the credentialing or reappointment decision process.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this peer reference record originated (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, Cerner, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; Epic EHR; Cerner Millennium; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr reference ID). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the completed peer reference was submitted by the referee. Used for audit trail and to determine documentation requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: systems_based_practice_rating
attributes.description: Referee's rating of the applicant's ability to work effectively within healthcare systems, including resource utilization, care coordination, and quality improvement participation.
attributes.references: ACGME Core Competencies; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this peer reference record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: verbal_reference_obtained_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the credentialing staff member who conducted and documented the verbal peer reference call. Required when is_verbal_reference is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: years_known
attributes.description: Number of years the referee has known the applicant in a professional capacity. Provides context for the depth and reliability of the evaluation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

products.name: cme_activity
products.description: Tracks Continuing Medical Education (CME) activities completed by clinicians to maintain licensure and board certification. Captures activity title, accrediting organization (AMA PRA, ACCME), activity type (live, enduring, performance improvement), credit hours, completion date, specialty relevance, and CME category (Category 1, Category 2). Supports licensure renewal and reappointment compliance.
products.reference: AMA PRA Category 1, ACCME, State CME Requirements

attributes.name: cme_activity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Continuing Medical Education (CME) activity record in the system. Primary key for the cme_activity data product.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: CME activity registration fees are paid via AP invoices. Links CME records to payment transactions for continuing education budget tracking, compliance cost analysis, and reimbursement processing.

attributes.name: board_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.board_certification. Business justification: CME activities can be linked to specific board certifications for MOC (Maintenance of Certification) tracking. FK will be NULL for non-MOC activities. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility or organization for which this CME activity is being tracked for reappointment or privileging compliance purposes. Supports multi-facility provider credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; Symplr Credentialing; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed healthcare professional (physician, nurse, allied health professional) who completed this CME activity. Links to the authoritative provider master record.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; ACCME Standards; AMA PRA Credit System

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: CME tracking for employed clinical staff. Real business need: license renewal compliance, competency maintenance, reappointment eligibility, performance review integration, continuing education budget

attributes.name: reappointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.reappointment. Business justification: CME activities are tracked for reappointment cycles. FK will be NULL for activities not tied to a specific reappointment. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: CME activities are specialty-specific. cme_activity.specialty_relevance_code and specialty_relevance_name should reference specialty table.

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training. Business justification: CME activities satisfy compliance training requirements (HIPAA, infection control, cultural competency). Compliance systems track which mandatory training requirements are fulfilled by specific CME co

attributes.name: accreditation_standard
attributes.description: The accreditation framework under which CME credit is awarded. AMA PRA (Physician's Recognition Award) is the most common for physicians; ANCC for nurses; ACPE for pharmacists; AOA for osteopathic physicians. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ama_pra|accme|aoa|ancc|acpe|aapa|state_medical_society — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines; ACCME Standards; ANCC Accreditation Standards; ACPE Standards

attributes.name: accrediting_organization_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier code assigned by ACCME or the relevant accrediting body to the organization that provided CME accreditation for this activity. Used for verification and reporting.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; ACCME Provider Directory

attributes.name: accrediting_organization_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the organization accredited by ACCME or a state medical society to provide CME credit for this activity (e.g., 'American College of Cardiology', 'Mayo Clinic School of Continuous Professional Development').
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: activity_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned by the accrediting organization to identify this specific CME activity. Used for verification and transcript reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Credit System

attributes.name: activity_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CME activity concluded. For multi-day live events, this is the final day. For enduring materials, this is the date the provider submitted the post-test or evaluation.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Credit System

attributes.name: activity_location
attributes.description: Physical location or online platform where the CME activity was conducted (e.g., 'Chicago, IL', 'Virtual — Zoom Webinar', 'Mayo Clinic — Rochester, MN'). Used for audit and verification purposes.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements

attributes.name: activity_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CME activity began. For live events, this is the first day of the conference or course. For enduring materials, this is the date the provider began the activity.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Credit System

attributes.name: activity_state
attributes.description: U.S. state where the CME activity was conducted or where the online activity was registered. Relevant for state-specific CME requirements (e.g., mandatory opioid prescribing CME, implicit bias training).
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements; DEA CME Requirements

attributes.name: activity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CME activity record. Completed indicates the provider finished the activity; pending_verification indicates awaiting credential verification; verified indicates confirmed by the accrediting body; rejected indicates the credit was not accepted.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; ACCME Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards

attributes.name: activity_title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the Continuing Medical Education activity as provided by the accrediting organization or sponsoring institution (e.g., 'Advanced Cardiac Life Support Update 2024').
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CME activity format as defined by ACCME. Live activities include conferences and workshops; enduring materials are self-study formats; performance improvement activities are practice-based. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: live|enduring_material|performance_improvement|internet_searching|journal_based|test_item_writing|manuscript_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: board_certification_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CME credits from this activity are applicable toward the provider's Maintenance of Certification (MOC) requirements with their specialty board. True when the activity meets the board's CME criteria.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); AOA Specialty Boards; ACCME Standards

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accrediting organization issued the CME completion certificate or transcript entry to the provider. May differ from completion date for activities with delayed certificate processing.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or transcript number issued by the accrediting organization upon completion of the CME activity. Used as the primary verification reference for licensure renewal and reappointment.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: cme_category
attributes.description: AMA Physician's Recognition Award (PRA) credit category designation. Category 1 credits are awarded for accredited educational activities; Category 2 credits are self-designated for non-accredited learning activities.
attributes.references: AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines; AMA Physician's Recognition Award

attributes.name: commercial_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CME activity received commercial support (financial or in-kind) from a pharmaceutical, device, or other commercial entity. Required disclosure per ACCME Standards for Commercial Support and OIG guidelines.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; OIG Compliance Guidance; PhRMA Code on Interactions with Healthcare Professionals

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider completed the CME activity and earned the associated credit hours. Used for licensure renewal cycle calculations and reappointment compliance verification.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this CME activity record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per HIPAA and HITRUST standards.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of CME credit hours awarded upon completion of this activity, expressed as a decimal to support fractional credits (e.g., 0.5, 1.0, 2.5). Used for licensure renewal and board certification tracking.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Mode of delivery for the CME activity. In-person includes conferences and workshops; online includes webinars and e-learning modules; simulation includes procedural skills labs; journal-based includes reading and post-test activities.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Credit System

attributes.name: evaluation_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider completed the required post-activity evaluation or satisfaction survey. Many accredited CME activities require evaluation completion as a condition of credit award.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: U.S. state for which this CME activity is being applied toward licensure renewal. A provider may hold licenses in multiple states with different CME requirements; this field identifies the applicable state.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements; Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB)

attributes.name: licensure_cycle_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CME credits from this activity are applicable toward the provider's current state medical licensure renewal cycle. True when the activity falls within the active licensure renewal period.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements

attributes.name: licensure_renewal_cycle_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the state medical licensure renewal cycle to which this CME activity is being applied. Used to ensure CME credits are counted within the correct renewal period for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; State Medical Board Licensure Requirements; Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB)

attributes.name: mandatory_topic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CME activity covers a state-mandated or federally-mandated topic (e.g., opioid prescribing, implicit bias, infection control, child abuse recognition). Mandatory topic CME is tracked separately for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; DEA CME Requirements; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: mandatory_topic_type
attributes.description: Specific type of state or federally mandated CME topic covered by this activity. Populated only when mandatory_topic_flag is True. Used for compliance gap analysis and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: opioid_prescribing|implicit_bias|infection_control|child_abuse|domestic_violence|end_of_life_care|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State Departments of Health; DEA CME Requirements; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: moc_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of Maintenance of Certification (MOC) points earned through this CME activity, as recognized by the relevant specialty board. MOC points may differ from CME credit hours depending on the board's conversion formula.
attributes.references: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) MOC Program; AOA Specialty Boards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff or the provider to capture additional context about the CME activity, such as exceptions, special circumstances, or supplemental documentation references.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider who completed this CME activity. Used for cross-referencing with payer enrollment records and CMS reporting. NPI is a HIPAA-mandated standard identifier.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; CMS NPI Registry; 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score required on the post-activity assessment to earn CME credit for this activity. Typically set by the accrediting organization (commonly 70% or 80%).
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: post_test_score
attributes.description: Percentage score achieved by the provider on the post-activity assessment or post-test, where applicable. Required for some enduring material and journal-based CME activities to earn credit.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Guidelines

attributes.name: reappointment_cycle_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CME activity counts toward the provider's hospital reappointment CME requirements. True when the activity falls within the current reappointment cycle period and meets facility-specific CME criteria.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this CME activity record was sourced (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, manual entry). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: symplr|epic|cerner|meditech|manual|cme_tracker|external — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this CME activity record in the originating source system (e.g., Symplr activity ID, Epic CME record ID). Used for data lineage, deduplication, and back-referencing to the system of record.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: sponsoring_organization
attributes.description: Name of the commercial or non-commercial organization that sponsored or funded the CME activity. Required for ACCME commercial support disclosure and OIG compliance. Distinct from the accrediting organization.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; OIG Compliance Guidance; PhRMA Code on Interactions with Healthcare Professionals

attributes.name: topic_area
attributes.description: Clinical or professional topic area covered by the CME activity (e.g., 'Patient Safety', 'Opioid Prescribing', 'Infection Control', 'Diabetes Management'). Used for population health and quality improvement reporting.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; CMS Quality Reporting; HEDIS Measure Specifications

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this CME activity record was last modified in the system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CME activity record was verified against the accrediting organization's records or the provider's official CME transcript. Populated when verification_status transitions to 'verified'.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: Source used to verify the CME activity record. Primary source verification (direct contact with accrediting organization) is the gold standard. Provider attestation is acceptable for Category 2 credits.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the credential verification process for this CME activity. Verified indicates the certificate and credit hours have been confirmed with the accrediting organization. Used by credentialing staff during reappointment review.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medical Staff Standards; Symplr Credentialing

products.name: telehealth_authorization
products.description: Tracks state-specific telehealth practice authorizations and interstate compact memberships for clinicians delivering virtual care across state lines. Captures originating state, distant state, authorization type (state license, interstate compact, federal waiver), effective date, expiration date, platform restrictions, and CMS telehealth eligibility indicator. Critical for multi-state telehealth compliance.
products.reference: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, CMS Telehealth Policy, Ryan Haight Act

attributes.name: telehealth_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each telehealth authorization record. Primary key for the telehealth_authorization data product in the provider domain.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (distant site) from which the clinician delivers telehealth services under this authorization. Links to the provider.org_provider or facility master record.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; 42 CFR §410.78; HL7 FHIR Location Resource

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed clinician for whom this telehealth authorization is issued. Links to the provider.clinician master record.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: Interstate telehealth licenses and compact enrollments are regulatory submissions to state medical boards and compact commissions. Compliance teams track application status, approval dates, and renewa

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.credentialing_application. Business justification: Telehealth authorizations may be part of credentialing process. FK will be NULL for authorizations obtained independently. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: credentialing_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credentialing file or record in the credentialing management system (e.g., Symplr) that contains supporting documentation for this telehealth authorization, including primary source verification artifacts.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: FK to provider.specialty

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinician or their credentialing team submitted the application for this telehealth authorization to the relevant state board or compact administrator.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issuing authority (state licensing board, compact administrator, or federal agency) formally approved this telehealth authorization.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: audio_only_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization permits audio-only (telephone) telehealth encounters in addition to or instead of video-based encounters. CMS and many states have specific rules governing audio-only telehealth reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; 42 CFR §410.78; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally generated unique reference number for this telehealth authorization, used for tracking and correspondence with state licensing boards, payers, and interstate compact administrators.
attributes.references: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC); CMS Telehealth Policy

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the telehealth authorization. Active indicates the clinician is currently authorized to deliver telehealth in the distant state. Pending indicates application submitted but not yet approved. Expired, suspended, and revoked indicate the authorization is no longer valid.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal basis under which the clinician is authorized to deliver telehealth services across state lines. Values include state_license (full state license in distant state), interstate_compact (IMLC or PSYPACT membership), federal_waiver (CMS or DEA waiver), reciprocity_agreement (bilateral state agreement), or emergency_waiver (public health emergency authorization).
attributes.references: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC); PSYPACT; CMS Telehealth Waivers; 42 CFR §410.78

attributes.name: cms_telehealth_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Telehealth Eligibility Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician is eligible to bill Medicare and Medicaid for telehealth services under this authorization per CMS telehealth coverage rules (42 CFR §410.78). True = CMS-eligible telehealth provider; False = not eligible for CMS telehealth reimbursement under this authorization.
attributes.references: 42 CFR §410.78; CMS Telehealth Policy; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: compact_membership_number
attributes.description: Unique membership or registration identifier assigned by the interstate compact administrator (e.g., IMLC, PSYPACT, NLC) when the clinician is authorized under a compact rather than a full state license. Null if authorization_type is not interstate_compact.
attributes.references: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC); PSYPACT; Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC)

attributes.name: compact_type
attributes.description: Identifies the specific interstate compact program under which this authorization is granted. IMLC = Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (physicians), PSYPACT = Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact, NLC = Nurse Licensure Compact, ASLP-IC = Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Interstate Compact, PT_Compact = Physical Therapy Compact, OT_Compact = Occupational Therapy Compact. Null or 'none' if not compact-based. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IMLC|PSYPACT|NLC|ASLP-IC|PT_Compact|OT_Compact|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC); PSYPACT; Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC); ASLP-IC; PT Compact

attributes.name: controlled_substance_prescribing_allowed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Controlled Substance Prescribing Allowed via Telehealth
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician is authorized to prescribe controlled substances via telehealth under this authorization. Governed by the Ryan Haight Act, DEA telemedicine rules, and applicable state law. Critical for pharmacy compliance and MAR (Medication Administration Record) workflows.
attributes.references: DEA — Controlled Substances; Ryan Haight Online Pharmacy Consumer Protection Act; 21 CFR §1306

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this telehealth authorization record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164; ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: cross_border_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for international telehealth authorizations where the clinician or patient is located outside the United States. Null for domestic (US-only) authorizations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; HHS International Telehealth Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: distant_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the state where the clinician (distant site) is physically located and licensed when delivering telehealth services. The clinician must hold valid authorization to practice in this state.
attributes.references: 42 CFR §410.78; CMS Telehealth Policy; Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this telehealth authorization becomes legally effective and the clinician is permitted to deliver virtual care services under its terms.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: expiration_alert_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated expiration alert notification has been sent to the clinician and credentialing team for this telehealth authorization. Used to track renewal workflow initiation.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; Internal Credentialing Workflow Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this telehealth authorization expires and the clinician is no longer authorized to deliver telehealth services under this authorization. Null for open-ended or indefinite authorizations.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, state licensing board, or compact administrator that issued this telehealth authorization (e.g., 'California Medical Board', 'Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission', 'CMS', 'DEA').
attributes.references: State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing; CMS; Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)

attributes.name: medicaid_telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician is eligible to bill Medicaid in the distant state for telehealth services under this authorization. Medicaid telehealth policies vary by state and are distinct from Medicare eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Telehealth Policy; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician is participating in-network for telehealth services in the distant state under this authorization. Relevant for payer contracting, patient cost-sharing, and ACO/HMO/PPO network management.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff to capture additional context, conditions, or remarks associated with this telehealth authorization that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., special conditions imposed by the issuing authority, internal compliance notes).
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; Internal Credentialing Workflow Policy

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the clinician as assigned by CMS. Required for telehealth billing and payer enrollment verification. Stored here for authorization record completeness and cross-referencing with payer systems.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.406; HL7 FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: originating_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the state where the patient (originating site) is physically located at the time of the telehealth encounter. Per CMS telehealth rules, the originating state determines applicable licensure and coverage requirements.
attributes.references: 42 CFR §410.78; CMS Telehealth Policy; FHIR R4 Location Resource

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinician was successfully enrolled with payers for telehealth billing in the distant state under this authorization.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Indicates the clinician's enrollment status with payers for telehealth billing in the distant state. Enrolled = active payer enrollment for telehealth services; Pending = enrollment application submitted; Not_enrolled = not yet enrolled; Terminated = enrollment ended.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: platform_restriction

attributes.name: abms_board_name

attributes.name: acgme_program_code

attributes.description: The ACGME program specialty code associated with the residency or fellowship training program that corresponds to this taxonomy classification. Used to validate training pathway alignment during provider credentialing.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME); NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: board_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification is a standard credentialing requirement for providers holding this taxonomy code. Used in credentialing completeness validation and payer enrollment eligibility checks.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: The second level of the NUCC taxonomy hierarchy representing the provider's primary discipline or specialty grouping within the provider type (e.g., 'Family Medicine', 'Internal Medicine', 'Pediatrics'). Used in payer enrollment and claims adjudication to route claims to appropriate fee schedules.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: cms_specialty_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Specialty Code
attributes.description: The two-digit CMS specialty code that maps to this NUCC taxonomy code, used in Medicare and Medicaid claims processing, fee schedule assignment, and PECOS enrollment. Enables crosswalk between NUCC taxonomy and CMS specialty classification for reimbursement purposes.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Specialty Codes; CMS PECOS; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: cms_specialty_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Specialty Description
attributes.description: The descriptive label associated with the CMS specialty code crosswalk for this taxonomy entry (e.g., 'General Practice', 'Cardiology', 'Pathology'). Supports reporting and validation in Medicare claims adjudication workflows.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Specialty Codes; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this taxonomy code record was first loaded into the enterprise data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL monitoring.
