attributes.name: dea_registration_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are typically required or eligible to obtain a DEA registration number for prescribing controlled substances. Supports credentialing completeness checks and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA); DEA — Controlled Substances

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The official NUCC narrative definition describing the scope of practice, training requirements, and clinical activities associated with this taxonomy code. Used by credentialing staff and payer enrollment teams to validate appropriate taxonomy selection.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The full human-readable display name for the taxonomy code as published by NUCC, combining provider type, classification, and specialization into a single descriptive label used in UI dropdowns, reports, and provider directories.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this taxonomy code became effective and valid for use in NPI registry enrollment, claims submission, and payer credentialing. Aligns with the NUCC code set release date.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this taxonomy code was retired or deactivated by NUCC. Null for currently active codes. Used to prevent use of retired codes in new NPI enrollments and claims submissions.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: fhir_practitioner_role_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Practitioner Role Code
attributes.description: The HL7 FHIR PractitionerRole code that corresponds to this NUCC taxonomy code, used in FHIR-based API integrations, HIE data exchange, and interoperability with external EHR systems.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4; Health Level Seven International (HL7); FHIR — Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources

attributes.name: hospital_privileges_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are subject to hospital privileging and credentialing requirements. Drives privileging workflow initiation in credentialing systems such as Symplr.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); Symplr Credentialing; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: individual_or_organization
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code applies to an individual healthcare professional (Type 1 NPI) or an organizational/group provider (Type 2 NPI). Drives NPI enumeration type selection and payer enrollment form routing.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS NPI Registry; 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: medicaid_enrollment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to enroll as Medicaid providers. Supports state Medicaid agency enrollment workflows and payer credentialing validation.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); State Departments of Health

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to participate in the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) under MACRA. Used in quality reporting program enrollment and value-based care analytics.
attributes.references: MACRA; MIPS; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act (MACRA)

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: The network adequacy classification assigned to this taxonomy code by CMS or state regulators, indicating the minimum provider-to-enrollee ratios and geographic access standards required for health plan network compliance (e.g., 'Primary Care', 'Specialist', 'Behavioral Health', 'Ancillary').
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); NCQA; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Supplemental notes published by NUCC clarifying usage, scope limitations, or cross-references to related taxonomy codes. Assists credentialing and billing staff in selecting the most appropriate taxonomy code for a provider.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: npi_type
attributes.description: The NPI enumeration type associated with this taxonomy code: Type 1 for individual healthcare providers and Type 2 for organizational providers. Determines the NPI application process and NPPES registry classification.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; NPPES; 45 CFR Part 162; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: nucc_grouping
attributes.description: The broad grouping category assigned by NUCC above the provider type level, used to segment taxonomy codes into major provider categories such as 'Individual', 'Non-Individual', or specific functional groupings (e.g., 'Behavioral Health & Social Service Providers', 'Dental Providers'). Supports high-level analytics and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: pecos_enrollment_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Provider Enrollment and Chain Ownership System (PECOS) Enrollment Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to enroll in Medicare through the PECOS system. Used by revenue cycle and credentialing teams to determine Medicare participation eligibility during provider onboarding.
attributes.references: CMS PECOS; Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: prescribing_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers classified under this taxonomy code typically hold prescribing authority for medications. Used in pharmacy benefit management, DEA registration workflows, and Computerized Physician Order Entry (CPOE) access control configuration.
attributes.references: DEA — Controlled Substances; Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA); NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: primary_care_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this taxonomy code is recognized as a primary care designation by CMS and payers. Used in network adequacy analysis, HMO/PPO panel assignments, ACO attribution, and HEDIS measure reporting.
attributes.references: CMS; NCQA HEDIS; National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA); Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether services rendered by providers with this taxonomy code typically require prior authorization from payers. Used in utilization management configuration and claims pre-authorization workflow routing.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); NCQA

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: The highest-level grouping in the NUCC taxonomy hierarchy that broadly categorizes the provider (e.g., 'Allopathic & Osteopathic Physicians', 'Nursing Service Providers', 'Hospitals', 'Laboratories'). Corresponds to the Type level of the NUCC three-level hierarchy.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral from a primary care provider is typically required before a patient can access services from a provider with this taxonomy code. Relevant for HMO and POS plan configurations.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); NCQA

attributes.name: replacement_taxonomy_code
attributes.description: The NUCC taxonomy code that replaces this code when it has been retired or deprecated. Enables automated migration of provider taxonomy assignments during NUCC code set updates and supports backward compatibility in claims processing.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: rvu_work_component

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference

attributes.name: specialization

May be null for taxonomy codes that do not have a defined specialization.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: surgical_specialty

attributes.name: taxonomy_status

attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers with this taxonomy code are eligible to deliver and bill for telehealth services under CMS and payer policies. Supports telehealth program configuration and claims validation.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); CMS Telehealth Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this taxonomy code record was last modified in the enterprise data platform, reflecting updates from NUCC code set releases or CMS crosswalk revisions.

attributes.name: version

attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set

attributes.name: affiliated_org_state

attributes.name: affiliated_org_zip_code

attributes.name: affiliation_status

attributes.name: caqh_provider_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: department_name

attributes.name: departure_reason

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinician's affiliation with the organization ended. Null if the affiliation is currently active. Used for credentialing gap analysis and NPDB adverse action reporting context.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NPDB Guidebook

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of full-time equivalent (FTE) effort the clinician dedicated to this affiliated organization during the affiliation period. Used for workforce analytics and credentialing work history completeness validation.

attributes.name: gap_explanation

attributes.name: is_current

attributes.name: is_voluntary_separation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician's departure from the affiliated organization was voluntary (True) or involuntary (False). Critical for NPDB adverse action reporting context and credentialing primary source verification. Null if the affiliation is still active.

attributes.name: privilege_restriction_at_departure

attributes.name: psv_method

products.name: study_team_member
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between clinician and research_study. It captures the formal research personnel assignment that is required for regulatory compliance (FDA Form 1572), effort reporting, conflict of interest management, and IRB documentation. Each record links one clinician to one research study with role, time period, and effort allocation that exist only in the context of this research assignment. This is the operational SSOT for study team composition, investigator roles, and research personnel accountability across all active and historical studies.. Existence Justification: Healthcare research operations require tracking multiple clinicians per study (Principal Investigator, sub-investigators, coordinators, research nurses) and clinicians routinely participate in multiple concurrent research studies. The business actively manages study team composition as a formal operational process requiring regulatory documentation (FDA Form 1572), IRB amendments for personnel changes, delegation logs, effort reporting, conflict of interest disclosures, and training verification. This is not a derived correlation but an operational entity that research coordinators and regulatory specialists create, update, and audit continuously.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: form_1572_signed_date

attributes.name: gcp_training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinician completed Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training that is current and valid for this study assignment. attributes.name: protocol_training_completion_date

attributes.name: role_type

attributes.name: start_date

products.name: assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between clinician and position. It captures the operational relationship where healthcare professionals are assigned to authorized organizational positions, including concurrent assignments, job-sharing arrangements, and historical assignment tracking. Each record links one clinician to one position with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment relationship, including FTE split, effective dates, cost center allocation, and primary vs secondary assignment designation.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, clinicians routinely hold multiple concurrent position assignments (e.g., an attending physician may simultaneously serve as Medical Director 0.2 FTE, Department Chair 0.1 FTE, and Clinical Attending 0.7 FTE). Conversely, positions can be filled by multiple clinicians through job-sharing arrangements, coverage rotations, or sequential assignments over time. The business actively manages these assignments with specific effective dates, FTE splits, cost center allocations, and primary/secondary designations.

products.name: affiliation
products.description: This association product represents the affiliation relationship between clinicians and organizational units within the healthcare workforce structure. It captures the many-to-many relationship where clinicians can hold appointments across multiple departments, divisions, or service lines, and each organizational unit has multiple affiliated clinicians. Each record links one clinician to one org unit with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific affiliation: FTE allocation percentage, affiliation type (primary, courtesy, consulting), medical staff category, and temporal validity dates. This is the operational system of record for clinician-department affiliations as managed jointly between Epic EHR provider master and Workday HCM organizational assignments.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, clinicians routinely hold appointments across multiple organizational units simultaneously. A cardiologist may have a primary affiliation with the Cardiology department (80% FTE), a courtesy affiliation with the ICU (15% FTE), and a consulting affiliation with the Cardiac Catheterization Lab (5% FTE). Each affiliation carries distinct attributes: FTE allocation percentage, affiliation type (primary/courtesy/consulting), medical staff category per department, and temporal validity dates. This is the 'Department Affiliation' business concept actively managed by medical staff offices and credentialing teams.

products.name: provider_network_participation
products.description: This association product represents the contractual network participation relationship between organizational providers and insurance payers. It captures the enrollment, credentialing, and network status of each provider-payer pairing. Each record links one organizational provider to one payer with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, including enrollment status, credentialing status, network tier, effective dates, and termination dates.. attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag

domains.name: clinical
domains.description: Comprehensive clinical documentation and care delivery data. Owns diagnoses (ICD-10), procedures (CPT, HCPCS), clinical notes, problem lists, allergies, immunizations, vital signs, care plans, assessments, nursing documentation, clinical observations (LOINC-coded), SNOMED CT-coded clinical findings, and CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement) workflows. Core EHR/EMR operational data.
domains.references: ICD-10, CPT, SNOMED CT, LOINC, HL7 FHIR Clinical Resources

products.name: diagnosis
products.description: SSOT for all patient diagnoses documented in the EHR. Captures ICD-10-CM coded diagnoses, diagnosis type (principal, secondary, admitting, discharge), onset date, resolution date, clinical status (active, resolved, chronic), severity, certainty (confirmed, suspected, rule-out), and the encounter or problem list context. Sourced from Epic ClinDoc and Cerner PowerChart. Supports CDI workflows, DRG assignment, and quality reporting.
products.reference: ICD-10-CM Diagnosis

attributes.name: admit_diagnosis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis was the stated reason for inpatient admission as documented at the time of admission. The admitting diagnosis may differ from the principal discharge diagnosis and is required on UB-04 claim form field 69.
attributes.references: UB-04 FL 69; CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; UHDDS Admitting Diagnosis Definition

attributes.name: care_setting
attributes.description: The clinical care setting in which this diagnosis was documented (e.g., ICU, ED, OR, ambulatory clinic). Supports care-setting-specific quality reporting, resource utilization analysis, and population health stratification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|ED|ICU|OR|ambulatory|telehealth — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter.serviceType; TJC Care Setting Definitions

attributes.name: cdi_query_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a CDI specialist has issued a physician query related to this diagnosis for clarification or specificity improvement. Supports CDI workflow tracking and documentation quality metrics.
attributes.references: ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; 3M Health Information Systems CDI Module

attributes.name: cdi_query_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CDI physician query associated with this diagnosis. Tracks whether the provider has responded and whether the diagnosis was amended based on the query outcome.
attributes.references: ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; 3M Health Information Systems CDI Module; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: chronic_condition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a chronic condition as defined by CMS Chronic Condition Warehouse (CCW) criteria. Used for population health management, HEDIS measure attribution, and ACO quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Condition Warehouse (CCW); NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Quality Reporting

attributes.name: clinical_status
attributes.description: Current clinical state of the diagnosis as documented by the provider. Active indicates an ongoing condition; resolved indicates the condition has been treated or cleared; chronic conditions may persist across encounters.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.clinicalStatus; SNOMED CT Clinical Finding Hierarchy

attributes.name: coding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ICD-10-CM code was assigned or finalized by the HIM coder. Used for coding turnaround time reporting, revenue cycle management, and compliance audits.
attributes.references: AHIMA Coding Guidelines; CMS Timely Filing Requirements; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: coding_status
attributes.description: Indicates the Health Information Management (HIM) coding workflow status for this diagnosis. Finalized diagnoses are ready for claim submission; amended diagnoses reflect post-coding corrections.
attributes.references: AHIMA Coding Guidelines; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: complication_comorbidity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this secondary diagnosis qualifies as a Complication (CC) or Major Complication/Comorbidity (MCC) under CMS DRG grouping logic. CC/MCC status elevates DRG weight and reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M Health Information Systems Grouper; CMS ICD-10-CM/PCS MS-DRG v41

attributes.name: diagnosis_date
attributes.description: The date on which the diagnosis was formally documented in the EHR by the clinician. Distinct from onset date (when the condition began) and encounter date. Used as the principal business event date for this transaction record.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.recordedDate; Epic ClinDoc Diagnosis Entry Date

attributes.name: diagnosis_rank
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the ordering of diagnoses within an encounter (1 = principal, 2 = first secondary, etc.). Used for UB-04 claim form sequencing, DRG optimization, and CDI prioritization.
attributes.references: UB-04 FL 67–67Q; CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; UHDDS Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: diagnosis_type
attributes.description: Classifies the role of this diagnosis within the encounter or problem list context. Principal diagnosis drives DRG assignment; admitting diagnosis reflects the reason for admission; secondary diagnoses capture comorbidities and complications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: principal|secondary|admitting|discharge|working|chronic_problem_list — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Section II; UB-04 FL 67; UHDDS Definitions

attributes.name: discharge_diagnosis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis was finalized as a discharge diagnosis at the conclusion of the inpatient encounter. Discharge diagnoses are used for final DRG assignment, claim submission, and discharge summary documentation.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Section II; UB-04 Billing Guidelines; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: drg_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis contributes to the DRG assignment for the associated inpatient encounter. Used by the 3M grouper and revenue cycle teams to identify diagnoses that impact reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M Health Information Systems Grouper; 42 CFR §412

attributes.name: encounter_diagnosis_source
attributes.description: Identifies the role of the person who entered or assigned this diagnosis in the EHR. Supports CDI workflow analysis, coding quality audits, and provider attribution reporting.
attributes.references: AHIMA Coding Guidelines; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; Epic ClinDoc Audit Trail

attributes.name: encounter_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of encounter in which this diagnosis was documented. Inpatient diagnoses are subject to POA reporting and DRG grouping; outpatient diagnoses follow CMS-1500 coding guidelines. Denormalized from the encounter for direct diagnosis-level analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes; UB-04 vs CMS-1500 Billing Guidelines; HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter.class

attributes.name: external_cause_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM external cause code (V, W, X, Y codes) documenting the mechanism, intent, and place of occurrence for injury-related diagnoses. Required for trauma registries, workers compensation claims, and injury surveillance reporting.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Chapter 20; CDC Injury Surveillance; OSHA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: hac_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis qualifies as a CMS-designated Hospital-Acquired Condition (HAC). HAC-flagged diagnoses that were not present on admission may trigger payment reductions under the HAC Reduction Program.
attributes.references: CMS HAC Reduction Program; 42 CFR §412.64; CMS-1500 and UB-04 Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: icd10_version
attributes.description: The CMS fiscal year version of the ICD-10-CM code set used to assign this diagnosis code (e.g., FY2024). ICD-10-CM is updated annually; version tracking ensures accurate historical code interpretation and audit defense.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Annual Updates; WHO ICD-10 Versioning; HIPAA Transaction Standards 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this diagnosis record was most recently modified in the source EHR system. Used for incremental data loads, CDI amendment tracking, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; Joint Commission RC.01.02.01

attributes.name: laterality
attributes.description: Specifies the anatomical side affected by the diagnosis where applicable (e.g., left knee fracture, right breast mass). ICD-10-CM codes often encode laterality; this field provides an explicit queryable attribute for surgical scheduling and quality reporting.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; Joint Commission Universal Protocol for Preventing Wrong-Site Surgery

attributes.name: mcc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis specifically qualifies as a Major Complication or Comorbidity (MCC) — the highest severity tier in CMS DRG grouping. Distinct from the general CC flag; MCC status drives the highest DRG weight tier.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M Health Information Systems Grouper; CMS ICD-10-CM/PCS MS-DRG v41

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The facility-assigned Medical Record Number (MRN) for the patient associated with this diagnosis. Denormalized from the patient record to support direct clinical documentation queries without a join.

attributes.name: note_text
attributes.description: Free-text clinical note or comment associated with this diagnosis entry, as documented by the provider or CDI specialist. May include clinical rationale, specificity details, or query responses. Classified as confidential due to clinical content.
attributes.references: Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.note

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the condition or diagnosis first began, as documented by the clinician. Used for chronic disease management, population health analytics, and longitudinal patient record construction.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.onset; Joint Commission Clinical Documentation Standards

attributes.name: present_on_admission
attributes.description: CMS-required Present on Admission (POA) indicator for inpatient diagnoses. Y=present at admission, N=not present at admission, U=unknown, W=clinically undetermined, 1=unreported/not used. Affects hospital-acquired condition (HAC) payment adjustments and quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS POA Reporting Guidelines; ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Appendix I; 42 CFR §412.64

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is designated as the principal diagnosis for the encounter (True). The principal diagnosis is the condition established after study to be chiefly responsible for the admission and drives DRG assignment.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Section II; UHDDS Principal Diagnosis Definition; UB-04 FL 67

attributes.name: problem_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is part of the patient's longitudinal problem list (True) or is encounter-specific only (False). Problem list diagnoses persist across encounters and drive chronic disease management workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.category; Epic Problem List; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: quality_measure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is relevant to one or more quality measures (e.g., HEDIS, MIPS, VBP, TJC core measures). Used to identify patients for quality measure denominator and numerator attribution.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS MIPS Quality Measures; TJC Core Measure Specifications

attributes.name: recorded_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this diagnosis record was first created in the source EHR system (Epic ClinDoc or Cerner PowerChart). Supports audit trails, CDI workflow timing, and data lineage.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.recordedDate; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the condition was resolved, cured, or no longer clinically active. Null for ongoing or chronic conditions. Used to calculate episode duration and support transitions of care.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.abatement; CMS Chronic Condition Warehouse Definitions

attributes.name: sdoh_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is classified as a Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) condition (Z55–Z65 ICD-10-CM Z-codes). Used for population health management, care coordination, and CMS SDOH reporting initiatives.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Strategy; ICD-10-CM Z55-Z65 Codes; NCQA HEDIS SDOH Measures

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Clinical severity level of the diagnosis as documented by the provider. Drives care intensity decisions, DRG complexity, and quality measure stratification. Aligns with SNOMED CT severity qualifiers.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Severity Qualifier; CMS Case Mix Index (CMI) Methodology; AHRQ Quality Indicators

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating EHR or clinical information system from which this diagnosis record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation across systems, and HIE interoperability.
attributes.references: ONC 21st Century Cures Act; HL7 FHIR R4 Provenance Resource

attributes.name: source_system_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this diagnosis record in the originating source system (e.g., Epic diagnosis ID, Cerner diagnosis ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse and the operational EHR.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.identifier; ONC Interoperability Standards

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates the degree of clinical certainty for this diagnosis. Confirmed diagnoses are used for billing and DRG assignment; provisional and differential diagnoses support CDI workflows and clinical decision-making. Maps to Epic ClinDoc diagnosis certainty and Cerner PowerChart diagnosis qualifier.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.verificationStatus; CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines Section III

products.name: procedure_event

Sourced from Epic OpTime, ClinDoc, and Cerner SurgiNet. Supports revenue cycle charge capture and quality measurement.

attributes.name: cpt_modifier_2

attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; HITRUST CSF Control 09.aa; ISO 27001 A.12.4

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from procedure start to procedure end. Derived from start and end timestamps at source and stored for OR utilization analytics, anesthesia billing, and surgical quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; AHRQ OR Utilization Metrics

attributes.name: estimated_blood_loss_ml
attributes.description: Estimated blood loss in milliliters recorded by the surgical team during the procedure. Used for post-operative care planning, transfusion trigger assessment, and surgical quality benchmarking (ACS NSQIP).
attributes.references: ACS NSQIP; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; AABB Transfusion Guidelines

attributes.name: icd10_pcs_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision Procedure Coding System (ICD-10-PCS) Code
attributes.description: ICD-10-PCS code for inpatient procedures, used on UB-04 institutional claims for DRG grouping and inpatient quality reporting. Required for CMS inpatient prospective payment system (IPPS) reimbursement.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-PCS; CMS IPPS; UB-04 FL 74; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping

attributes.name: laterality
attributes.description: Body side on which the procedure was performed. Required for surgical safety verification (Universal Protocol), correct-site surgery compliance, and ICD-10-PCS/CPT modifier application.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Universal Protocol UP.01.01.01; AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis code representing the primary indication for the procedure. Required for medical necessity validation, DRG grouping, and claim adjudication by payers.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-CM; CMS ICD-10 Implementation Guide; AMA CPT Medical Necessity Guidelines; 3M Grouping

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Clinical urgency classification of the procedure at time of scheduling or ordering. Drives OR scheduling queue prioritization, resource allocation, and EMTALA compliance tracking for emergent cases.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act); The Joint Commission EC.02.01.01

attributes.name: procedure_category
attributes.description: High-level clinical category classifying the nature of the procedure. Used for service-line analytics, OR scheduling resource allocation, and population health stratification.

attributes.name: procedure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the procedure was performed. Used as the primary date dimension for reporting, HEDIS measure denominator logic, and claim date-of-service on CMS-1500 and UB-04 forms.
attributes.references: CMS-1500 Box 24A; UB-04 FL 45; HEDIS Technical Specifications; AMA CPT Guidelines

attributes.name: procedure_end_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the procedure was completed (wound closure for surgical cases, or final intervention for non-surgical). Used with start time to calculate procedure duration for OR scheduling, staffing, and quality metrics.

attributes.name: procedure_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this procedure event, assigned by the source EHR system (e.g., Epic OpTime case number or Cerner SurgiNet procedure ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and charge capture reference.

attributes.name: procedure_start_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the procedure was initiated (knife-to-skin for surgical cases, or first intervention for non-surgical). Principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction. Used for OR utilization, LOS calculation, and quality measure timing.

attributes.name: procedure_status

attributes.name: procedure_type

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime

attributes.name: service_line

products.name: vital_sign
products.description: Patient vital sign measurements captured during clinical encounters, nursing assessments, and continuous monitoring. Includes LOINC-coded observation types: blood pressure (systolic/diastolic), heart rate, respiratory rate, temperature, SpO2, height, weight, BMI, pain score, and Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS). Captures measured value, unit of measure, measurement method, body site, patient position, device used, measurement date/time, and recording clinician. Supports early warning score (EWS/MEWS/NEWS) calculations, sepsis screening, and clinical deterioration detection. High-volume time-series clinical data sourced from Epic ClinDoc flowsheets, Cerner PowerChart, and bedside monitoring device integrations. Separated from clinical_observation due to distinct high-frequency time-series ingestion patterns, dedicated device integration pipelines, and specialized analytics (trending, alerting, waveform correlation). Maps to FHIR Observation with vitals profile (US Core Vital Signs).

products.name: observation
products.description: SSOT for all structured clinical observations, assessments, scored evaluations, and clinical findings documented by clinicians during patient care. Encompasses LOINC-coded and SNOMED CT-coded observations across all clinical contexts including: nursing assessments (head-to-toe, skin integrity, restraint, fall risk using Morse/Braden scales, pressure injury staging, discharge readiness), functional status assessments (Barthel Index, FIM, ADL/IADL), behavioral health screenings (PHQ-9, CAGE-AID, Columbia Suicide Severity), SDOH screenings, wound assessments, intake/output measurements, neurological assessments (GCS components), physical examination findings, symptom documentation, and clinical impressions. Captures observation code, value (numeric, coded, or text), units, reference range, interpretation flag (normal, abnormal, critical), observation_category (nursing, functional, finding, screening, exam), assessment tool used, body system/site, laterality, severity, presence status (present, absent, unknown), observation date/time, and recording clinician. High-volume structured clinical data sourced from Epic ClinDoc flowsheets, Cerner PowerChart, and structured documentation modules. Supports nursing quality metrics, discharge planning, population health stratification, Joint Commission compliance, and FHIR Observation resource interoperability.

products.name: care_plan
products.description: Patient-centered care plans documenting clinical goals, interventions, and expected outcomes across the care continuum. Captures care plan type (inpatient, outpatient, chronic disease, discharge, transitional), status (draft, active, completed, revoked), effective date range, care setting, authoring provider, care team assignment, patient goals with individual lifecycle tracking, clinical problems addressed, and care plan category (SNOMED CT coded). Supports transitions of care, population health management, ACO care coordination, and CMS Conditions of Participation for discharge planning. Sourced from Epic Healthy Planet and Cerner.

attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.506; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13(b); Joint Commission RI.01.03.01

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the care plan per HL7 FHIR CarePlan status value set. 'draft' indicates not yet activated; 'active' is in use; 'on-hold' is temporarily suspended; 'completed' indicates all goals met; 'revoked' indicates cancelled before completion.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CarePlan.status; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.43

attributes.name: plan_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the care plan as displayed in the EHR (e.g., 'Diabetes Management Plan', 'Post-Surgical Discharge Plan', 'CHF Chronic Disease Management').
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CarePlan.title; Epic Healthy Planet; Cerner Millennium PowerChart

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the care plan by care setting and purpose. Drives workflow routing and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|chronic_disease|discharge|transitional|palliative|preventive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CarePlan.category; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.43 (Discharge Planning); NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: population_health_program
attributes.description: Name or code of the population health management program (e.g., 'Diabetes Registry', 'CHF Disease Management', 'Hypertension Control', 'Preventive Care Outreach') under which this care plan is managed. Supports HEDIS measure attribution and ACO program reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS; CMS Healthy Planet; CMS Population Health Management Framework

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_description
attributes.description: Plain-text description of the primary diagnosis or clinical problem driving this care plan, corresponding to the primary ICD-10 code. Stored for reporting and display without requiring a code lookup.

attributes.name: primary_icd10_code
attributes.description: The primary ICD-10-CM diagnosis code representing the principal clinical problem or condition being addressed by this care plan. Supports DRG grouping, quality measure attribution, and population health stratification.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM (WHO/CDC); CMS ICD-10 Coding Guidelines; AMA CPT alignment

attributes.name: readmission_risk_level
attributes.description: Clinician-assigned or algorithmically-derived readmission risk stratification for this patient at the time of care plan creation. Drives care management intensity and post-discharge follow-up scheduling. Supports CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP); AHRQ; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Prescribed frequency at which this care plan should be formally reviewed and updated by the care team. Drives scheduling of care plan review encounters and supports NCQA PCMH and CMS chronic care management billing requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|as_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Care Management (CCM) Billing Requirements; NCQA PCMH Standards; Joint Commission PC.01.02.03

attributes.name: sdoh_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) factors (e.g., food insecurity, housing instability, transportation barriers) have been identified and incorporated into this care plan. Supports CMS SDOH screening requirements and population health management.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Screening Requirements; NCQA HEDIS SDOH Measures; HL7 FHIR Gravity Project

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating EHR or clinical system from which this care plan record was sourced (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner Millennium PowerChart). Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and HIE interoperability tracking.
attributes.references: ONC 21st Century Cures Act Interoperability Rule; HL7 FHIR R4 CarePlan.meta.source

attributes.name: transitions_of_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care plan was created or updated specifically to support a transition of care event (e.g., hospital discharge to home, SNF transfer, ED to inpatient admission). Supports CMS Transitions of Care quality measures and readmission reduction programs.
attributes.references: CMS Transitions of Care Quality Measures (NQF 0647); CMS Conditions of Participation §482.43; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number incremented each time the care plan is substantively revised. Supports care plan history tracking, CDI audit trails, and regulatory documentation of plan evolution.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CarePlan.meta.versionId; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24

products.name: care_plan_goal
products.description: Individual clinical goals within a care plan, each with its own lifecycle, target values, and achievement status. Captures goal description, SNOMED CT coded goal category, target measure (LOINC coded), target value, target date, current status (proposed, accepted, in-progress, achieved, cancelled), priority, and the provider responsible for the goal. Enables granular tracking of patient progress toward clinical objectives. Sourced from Epic Healthy Planet.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR Goal

attributes.name: care_plan_goal_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual clinical goal within a care plan. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Goal record identifier

attributes.name: care_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent care plan under which this goal is defined. Each goal belongs to exactly one care plan.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Care Plan record

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician (physician, nurse practitioner, care manager) accountable for monitoring and advancing this specific goal.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Goal owner provider; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.expressedBy

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the population health or disease management program under which this goal was established (e.g., Diabetes Management Program, Hypertension Control Program). Supports program-level outcome analytics.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Program enrollment; CMS — Accountable Care Organization (ACO); NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient for whom this clinical goal is established. Links to the Master Patient Index (MPI) patient record.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Healthy Planet — Patient record

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Icd10 Related Condition Code Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Goal-to-condition linkage for chronic disease management, quality measure attribution, and care gap closure. Population health teams use ICD-10 codes to associate goals with specific conditions for HE

attributes.name: imaging_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to radiology.imaging_order. Business justification: Specific care plan goals require imaging to measure achievement (tumor reduction, fracture healing). Essential for goal progress tracking and outcome measurement in value-based care programs.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Goals may require specific DME or supplies (e.g., mobility goals → walkers, wound healing goals → wound care supplies). Enables goal-driven supply ordering and care plan supply cost tracking.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prescription. Business justification: Specific goals (achieve BP <140/90, HbA1c <7%) linked to prescribed medication regimens for outcome tracking. Required for population health management and HEDIS measure reporting.

attributes.name: problem_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.problem. Business justification: Care plan goals are created to address specific problems on the patient's problem list. This is a core clinical workflow: problem identified → goal created → interventions planned → outcomes measured.

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_record. Business justification: Individual goals (especially behavioral health, genetic testing, SDOH interventions) may require separate consent beyond the care plan. Patient agreement tracking and consent for goal-specific interve

attributes.name: supporting_clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Care plan goals drive specific orders. Real workflow: goal to reduce A1C below 7 triggers quarterly lab orders. Essential for goal-directed care tracking, care gap closure, value-based care reporting,

attributes.name: target_measure_loinc_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Measure Loinc Code Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.loinc_code. Business justification: Measurable goal definition for care plan tracking, outcome measurement, and patient engagement. Care coordinators use LOINC-coded goals to automatically track progress from lab results, vital signs, a

attributes.name: target_observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.observation. Business justification: Care plan goals often target specific observable measures (e.g., 'reduce HbA1c to <7%', 'maintain systolic BP <140'). Linking care_plan_goal to observation allows tracking goal achievement against act

attributes.name: target_test_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.test_result. Business justification: Goal achievement measured by lab values (HbA1c<7% for diabetes control). Role prefix 'target_' indicates goal measurement. Essential for value-based care reporting and patient engagement dashboards.

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter during which this goal was established or most recently reviewed. May be null for goals created outside a discrete encounter context.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc — Encounter record; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.encounter

attributes.name: achieved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical goal was documented as achieved. Populated only when goal_status is 'achieved'. Used for outcome measurement and quality reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.statusDate; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal completion date; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: achievement_status
attributes.description: Clinical assessment of the degree to which the patient is progressing toward or has achieved the goal. Distinct from lifecycle status — captures clinical trajectory rather than workflow state. Aligns with HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.achievementStatus.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.achievementStatus; NCQA HEDIS — Care Management Standards

attributes.name: barrier_notes
attributes.description: Free-text documentation of identified barriers preventing the patient from achieving this goal (e.g., financial constraints, transportation issues, health literacy). Supports Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) analysis and care coordination.
attributes.references: SDOH — Social Determinants of Health; CMS — Population Health; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal barriers; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Clinical or administrative reason for cancelling this goal (e.g., 'Patient declined', 'Goal no longer clinically appropriate', 'Superseded by updated goal'). Required for care plan audit and CDI workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.statusReason; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal cancellation reason; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: cancelled_date
attributes.description: The date on which this clinical goal was cancelled or discontinued. Populated only when goal_status is 'cancelled'. Supports care plan audit and quality review.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.statusDate; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal cancellation date

attributes.name: care_gap_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goal was created in response to an identified care gap (e.g., overdue preventive screening, uncontrolled chronic condition measure). Supports HEDIS gap closure tracking and value-based care reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS — Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set; CMS — Value-Based Purchasing (VBP); Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: care_team_role
attributes.description: Clinical role of the care team member primarily responsible for this goal (e.g., 'Primary Care Physician', 'Care Manager', 'Registered Nurse', 'Dietitian'). Supports care team coordination and workload analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant.role; Epic Healthy Planet — Care team role; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this care plan goal record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance with medical record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 — Audit Controls; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Medical Record Standards; ISO 27001

attributes.name: current_value
attributes.description: Most recently recorded value for the LOINC-coded target measure, representing the patient's current status relative to the goal target. Enables real-time progress tracking and gap analysis.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Goal current value; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.note (progress); NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: current_value_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current measured value was recorded. Used to assess recency of progress data and identify goals with stale measurements.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Goal current value date; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.note

attributes.name: expressed_by_type
attributes.description: Indicates who expressed or originated this goal — the patient themselves, a practitioner, a related person (family member), or a caregiver. Supports patient-centered care analytics and CAHPS reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.expressedBy; CAHPS — Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems; CMS

attributes.name: fhir_goal_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Goal Resource ID
attributes.description: HL7 FHIR R4 logical resource ID for this goal, enabling interoperability with external systems, Health Information Exchanges (HIE), and patient-facing applications via FHIR APIs.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — Goal Resource; CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule (CMS-9115-F); ONC 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: goal_category_display
attributes.description: Human-readable display name corresponding to the SNOMED CT goal category code (e.g., 'Dietary Goal', 'Exercise Goal', 'Medication Adherence'). Used in clinical reporting and care plan summaries.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT — Clinical Terminology; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.category.display

attributes.name: goal_category_snomed_code
attributes.description: SNOMED CT coded category classifying the clinical domain of this goal (e.g., dietary goal, exercise goal, medication adherence goal, physiological goal). Enables standardized population health analytics and HEDIS reporting.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT — Clinical Terminology; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.category; WHO ICD Classification alignment

attributes.name: goal_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the clinical goal, including clinical rationale, patient-specific context, and any relevant instructions. Supports Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) and care coordination.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.description; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Care Planning Standards

attributes.name: goal_external_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this goal as assigned by the originating Electronic Health Record (EHR) system (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet goal ID). Supports cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Goal.ID; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.identifier

attributes.name: goal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the clinical goal reflecting its progression from proposal through achievement or cancellation. Aligns with HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.lifecycleStatus value set.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.lifecycleStatus; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal status

attributes.name: goal_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarizing the clinical goal (e.g., 'Reduce HbA1c to below 7%', 'Achieve 10,000 steps daily'). Used in clinical dashboards and patient-facing care plan summaries.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.description; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal description

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the care team last formally reviewed this goal's progress. Used for care management workflows, overdue review identification, and regulatory compliance with care plan review requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Care Planning Review Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Free-text clinical annotation or progress note associated with this goal, capturing care team observations, patient feedback, or contextual information not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.note; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal notes; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Documentation Standards

attributes.name: patient_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has agreed to and accepted this clinical goal as part of their care plan. Supports shared decision-making documentation and patient engagement analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation — Patient Rights; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Patient-Centered Care; HIPAA

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Clinical priority level assigned to this goal relative to other goals in the care plan. Guides care team focus and resource allocation. Aligns with HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.priority value set.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.priority; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal priority

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Prescribed frequency at which this goal should be reviewed by the care team. Drives care management workflow scheduling and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation — Care Planning; The Joint Commission (TJC); Epic Healthy Planet — Goal review schedule

attributes.name: sdoh_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goal is related to Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) factors such as food insecurity, housing instability, or transportation barriers. Enables SDOH-stratified population health reporting.
attributes.references: SDOH — Social Determinants of Health; CMS — Interoperability and Patient Access Rule; Healthy People 2030

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which this goal record was sourced (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner Millennium, Health Information Exchange). Supports data lineage and ETL audit.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.identifier.system; Health Level Seven (HL7) — Interoperability Standards; HIE — Health Information Exchange

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which work toward this clinical goal was initiated or the goal became active. Used for goal duration calculations and longitudinal care analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.startDate; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal start date

attributes.name: status_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the goal_status was most recently changed (e.g., from 'proposed' to 'accepted', or from 'in-progress' to 'achieved'). Enables lifecycle duration analytics and care management SLA reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.statusDate; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal status history; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: target_date
attributes.description: The date by which the patient is expected to achieve this clinical goal. Used for care plan timeline management, overdue goal identification, and population health reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.target.dueDate; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal due date; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Care Planning Standards

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Numeric target value the patient is expected to achieve for the specified LOINC-coded measure (e.g., 7.0 for HbA1c percentage, 130 for systolic blood pressure in mmHg). Used in progress tracking and outcome analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.target.detailQuantity; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal target value

attributes.name: target_value_comparator
attributes.description: Relational comparator indicating the direction of the target (e.g., '<=' means the measured value should be less than or equal to the target). Enables precise goal evaluation logic in clinical decision support.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.target.detailQuantity.comparator; Epic Healthy Planet — Goal comparator

attributes.name: target_value_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Goal Target Value Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the numeric target value, expressed using UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure) notation (e.g., '%', 'mm[Hg]', 'kg', 'steps/d'). Required for clinical interpretation and interoperability.
attributes.references: UCUM — Unified Code for Units of Measure; HL7 FHIR R4 Goal.target.detailQuantity.unit

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this care plan goal record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 — Audit Controls; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Medical Record Standards; ISO 27001

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number incremented each time this goal record is substantively updated. Supports audit trail requirements and longitudinal goal history tracking.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Medical Record Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; OIG — Fraud and Abuse Prevention

products.name: care_team
products.description: Clinical care team assignments for patients, documenting which providers are responsible for a patient's care in a given context. Captures care team type (inpatient, outpatient, primary, specialty, multidisciplinary), team status, assignment dates, and individual member detail records: member type (physician, NP, PA, RN, social worker, pharmacist, care coordinator), role code, on-call flag, primary contact flag, participation start/end dates, and active status. Members are modeled as line items within the care team — each with their own assignment lifecycle but always in the context of a parent team. Distinct from workforce scheduling — this is the clinical accountability record. Enables care coordination queries, transitions of care documentation, and care plan team assignment. Sourced from Epic and Cerner care team modules.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR CareTeam

attributes.name: care_team_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical care team record in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc / Cerner PowerChart — Care Team Module

attributes.name: care_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated care plan that this team is responsible for executing. Links care team accountability to specific clinical goals, interventions, and outcomes defined in the care plan.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.reasonReference; Epic Healthy Planet Care Plan; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where this care team operates. Supports multi-facility enterprise analytics and regulatory reporting by facility.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Facility; CMS Facility Reporting; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an individual care team member record (line item within the care team). Each member has their own assignment lifecycle within the parent team. Supports the member-level detail model described in the product specification.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Care Team Member; Cerner PowerChart Care Team Participant; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant

attributes.name: improvement_initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.improvement_initiative. Business justification: Quality initiatives often involve specific care teams (sepsis team, stroke team). Direct linkage enables tracking team-based initiative impact. Essential for care team performance improvement and acco

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient for whom this care team is assigned. Links to the master patient record (MPI). Core PARTY_REFERENCE required by TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc / Cerner PowerChart — Patient Care Team; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.501 (PHI)

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical department or unit (e.g., ICU, Cardiology, ED, Oncology) to which this care team is assigned. Enables department-level care coordination and staffing analytics.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Department; Cerner PowerChart Department

attributes.name: primary_contact_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the care team member designated as the primary point of contact for the patient and family. May differ from the attending provider (e.g., a care coordinator or NP may be the primary contact). Supports care coordination and patient communication workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant; Epic ClinDoc Primary Contact Flag

attributes.name: tertiary_care_member_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider (clinician) record for this care team member. Links to the clinician master record for NPI, credentials, and specialty information.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant.member

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter (inpatient admission, outpatient visit, ED visit) with which this care team is associated. A care team may exist without a specific encounter for longitudinal/primary care contexts.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc / Cerner PowerChart — Encounter Care Team; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.encounter

attributes.name: aco_attributed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care team is associated with an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) attribution for the patient. Relevant for value-based care reporting, MSSP program compliance, and population health management.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP ACO Program; MACRA/MIPS; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: care_coordination_level
attributes.description: Classification of the intensity of care coordination required for this team, based on patient complexity and care needs. Drives resource allocation, staffing decisions, and care management program enrollment.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Care Management (CCM) Codes; NCQA HEDIS; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: care_setting
attributes.description: Clinical care setting in which the team operates. Distinct from team_type — care_setting describes the physical/virtual environment of care delivery (e.g., ED, ICU, telehealth), while team_type describes the organizational model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|emergency|observation|telehealth|home_health|skilled_nursing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.category; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: cdi_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care team record has been flagged for Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) review. CDI specialists use this flag to identify cases where care team documentation may require clarification to support accurate coding, DRG assignment, and reimbursement.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Standards; CMS DRG Grouping; Epic CDI Workflow

attributes.name: coverage_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this care team member's coverage period ended. Used in conjunction with coverage_start_timestamp to define shift-level coverage windows and identify coverage gaps.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Coverage; Cerner PowerChart Shift Coverage; The Joint Commission Handoff Standards

attributes.name: coverage_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this care team member's coverage period began (e.g., start of a shift or on-call rotation). More granular than member_start_date; used for shift-level coverage gap analysis and handoff documentation.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Coverage; Cerner PowerChart Shift Coverage; The Joint Commission Handoff Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the care team record was first created in the source EHR system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance requirements. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) — Audit Controls; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: discharge_disposition_code
attributes.description: CMS-standard discharge disposition code indicating the patient's destination upon leaving this care team's care (e.g., '01' = Home, '03' = SNF, '20' = Expired). Populated for inpatient and transitional care teams at team closure. Required for UB-04 billing and CMS quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS UB-04 Discharge Disposition Codes; NUBC; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.name: ehr_care_team_csn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Care Team Contact Serial Number (CSN)
attributes.description: Epic-specific Contact Serial Number (CSN) uniquely identifying the care team context within an Epic encounter. Used for cross-referencing Epic ClinDoc records during ETL and data reconciliation.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Care Team Module — CSN

attributes.name: hie_shared
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care team record has been shared via a Health Information Exchange (HIE) to external care partners (e.g., referring providers, ACO partners, post-acute facilities). Supports care coordination across organizational boundaries and HIE participation reporting.
attributes.references: ONC Health IT Certification; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam; 21st Century Cures Act — Information Blocking

attributes.name: is_multidisciplinary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care team is formally designated as a multidisciplinary team (MDT), involving providers from two or more distinct clinical disciplines. MDT designation is relevant for complex case management, oncology tumor boards, and regulatory quality reporting.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MDT Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: is_on_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care team member is currently designated as on-call for the patient. On-call designation determines who is contacted for urgent clinical decisions outside of normal coverage hours.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc On-Call Flag; Cerner PowerChart On-Call; The Joint Commission Coverage Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this care team member is designated as the primary point of contact for the patient and family within the team. Only one member per team should hold this designation at any given time.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Primary Contact Flag; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant; The Joint Commission Patient Communication Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_team
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the patient's primary care team (as opposed to a consulting or specialty team). A patient may have multiple concurrent care teams; this flag identifies the team with primary clinical accountability.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc Primary Team Flag; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.category

attributes.name: member_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Care Team Member Participation End Date
attributes.description: Date on which this individual member's participation in the care team ended (e.g., due to rotation, discharge, or reassignment). Null for currently active members. Supports member lifecycle and coverage gap analysis.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant.period.end; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart

attributes.name: member_role_code
attributes.description: Standardized role code for the care team member's function within the team (e.g., SNOMED CT role codes or Epic-defined role codes such as 'ATT' for Attending, 'RES' for Resident, 'CON' for Consultant). More granular than member_type.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Care Team Role Codes; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant.role; Epic ClinDoc Role Code

attributes.name: member_role_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the care team member's role (e.g., 'Attending Physician', 'Consulting Cardiologist', 'Charge Nurse', 'Clinical Pharmacist'). Complements member_role_code for display in EHR panels and reports.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc; Cerner PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4 CareTeam.participant.role.text

attributes.name: member_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Care Team Member Participation Start Date
attributes.description: Date on which this individual member began participating in the care team. Supports member-level assignment lifecycle tracking, transitions of care documentation, and care coordination analytics.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of when in the care continuum the assessment was performed. Admission assessments establish baseline; discharge assessments support post-acute placement; interim assessments track progress; annual assessments support population health programs.
attributes.references: CMS MDS 3.0; CMS OASIS-E; Epic ClinDoc Assessment Workflow

attributes.name: cage_aid_score
attributes.description: Total score from the CAGE-AID (Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener — Adapted to Include Drugs) substance use disorder screening tool, ranging from 0 to 4. A score of 2 or higher is considered a positive screen for alcohol or drug use disorder.
attributes.references: CAGE-AID (Brown & Rounds 1995); SAMHSA Screening Tools; CMS MIPS Substance Use Measures; Epic ClinDoc Behavioral Health SmartForm

attributes.name: care_setting
attributes.description: Clinical care setting in which the functional status assessment was performed. Drives assessment tool selection, regulatory reporting requirements (MDS for SNF, OASIS for home health), and post-acute care placement decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|ed|icu|snf|home_health|hospice|rehabilitation — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS MDS 3.0 (SNF); CMS OASIS-E (Home Health); CMS IRF-PAI (Inpatient Rehab); Epic ClinDoc Encounter Type

attributes.name: caregiver_support_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has an identified informal caregiver (family member, friend, or unpaid caregiver) available to assist with post-discharge care needs. Critical factor in discharge planning and community care placement decisions.
attributes.references: CMS Discharge Planning Rule 42 CFR §482.43; AHRQ Caregiver Assessment; Epic ClinDoc Social Work Assessment

attributes.name: clinical_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documentation by the assessing clinician providing qualitative context, clinical observations, and nuanced findings beyond the structured scoring fields. Contains Protected Health Information (PHI) and is subject to HIPAA minimum necessary standards.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(b) Minimum Necessary; 42 CFR Part 2 (if substance use); Epic ClinDoc SmartText; TJC Medical Record Standards

attributes.name: cognitive_score
attributes.description: Sub-score measuring cognitive function including orientation, memory, attention, language, and executive function. Derived from MMSE (0–30), MoCA (0–30), FIM cognitive subscale, or BIMS (Brief Interview for Mental Status). Supports dementia screening and care planning.
attributes.references: CMS MDS 3.0 Section C (BIMS); MMSE; MoCA; Epic ClinDoc Cognitive Assessment Flowsheet

attributes.name: communication_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the patient's ability to communicate effectively, including speech, language, hearing, and vision. Impacts assessment validity, informed consent processes, and care plan communication. Triggers speech-language pathology referrals.
attributes.references: CMS MDS 3.0 Section B; TJC Patient Rights Standards; ADA Communication Requirements; Epic ClinDoc Communication Assessment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this functional status assessment record was first created in the source EHR system. Supports audit trail requirements under HIPAA Security Rule and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; HITRUST CSF; Epic ClinDoc Record Creation Audit

attributes.name: discharge_disposition_recommended
attributes.description: Clinician-recommended post-discharge care setting based on functional status assessment findings. Drives discharge planning workflows, post-acute care referrals, and transitions of care coordination. Supports CMS Discharge Planning Rule compliance.
