Enables granular payment reconciliation, underpayment identification, net revenue calculation, and contractual variance analysis per payer contract terms.

products.name: study_attribution
products.description: This association product represents the billing attribution relationship between insurance claims and research studies. It captures the operational linkage required for clinical trial billing compliance, determining which portions of a claim are attributable to research protocols versus standard-of-care, and establishing billing responsibility between the institution and study sponsor. Each record links one claim to one research study with attributes that govern coverage determination and sponsor invoicing.. Existence Justification: In healthcare research operations, a single insurance claim can legitimately span multiple concurrent research studies when a patient is enrolled in multiple trials simultaneously (e.g., a cancer treatment trial plus a supportive care trial). Conversely, each research study generates thousands of claims across its enrolled patient population. The business actively manages claim-study attribution records to ensure clinical trial billing compliance, determine coverage responsibility (standard-of-care vs research-only services), and generate accurate sponsor invoices.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the attribution determination. PENDING_REVIEW = awaiting coverage analysis; DETERMINED = billing responsibility established; DISPUTED = sponsor or payer contest; RESOLVED = dispute settled; INVOICED = billed to responsible party; PAID = payment received.

products.name: audit_sample
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific claim in a compliance audit sample. It captures the selection rationale, review status, and findings for each claim-audit pair. Each record links one claim to one audit with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit review relationship.. Existence Justification: In healthcare compliance operations, audits routinely sample multiple claims for review (RAC audits typically review 30-50 claims per provider, Joint Commission surveys sample across multiple encounters). Individual claims can be included in multiple audits over time—an initial HIPAA audit, a follow-up verification audit, a separate OIG work plan audit, or a CMS validation survey. The business actively manages claim audit samples as operational records, tracking selection rationale, review status, findings, and corrective actions for each claim-audit pair.

attributes.name: fda_establishment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment Number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned establishment registration number for vendors who manufacture, repackage, or relabel medical devices or drugs. Required for device and pharmaceutical manufacturers per FDA 21 CFR Part 807.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807; FDA Establishment Registration; Medical Device Amendments

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered line items fulfilled completely by the vendor without backorder or substitution. Critical metric for supply continuity and par-level replenishment reliability.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain KPI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: gpo_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) through which this vendor holds a contract (e.g., Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust). GPO affiliation determines contract pricing tiers and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: AHRMM GPO Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: gpo_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number assigned by the GPO for the vendor's pricing agreement. Used to validate contract compliance during purchase order creation and invoice matching.
attributes.references: AHRMM GPO Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Contract Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of insurance number evidencing the vendor's general liability, product liability, and workers' compensation coverage. Required for vendor credentialing and contract compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Vendor Credentialing Standards; OSHA; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor's insurance certificate expires. Supply chain and compliance teams must track this to ensure continuous coverage and prevent lapsed vendor access.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Vendor Credentialing Standards; OSHA; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected delivery for this vendor. Used in par-level replenishment calculations and inventory safety stock planning.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: minimum_order_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value required per purchase order for this vendor. Orders below this threshold may incur handling fees or be rejected. Used in procurement workflow validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFM1); Infor Lawson Supply Chain; AHRMM Procurement Standards

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to vendors who are also healthcare providers (e.g., pharmacy chains, home health agencies). Nullable for non-provider vendors.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA Administrative Simplification (45 CFR Part 162); NPI Final Rule

attributes.name: oig_excluded_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Excluded Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is currently listed on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE) or SAM.gov exclusion list. Excluded vendors must not be used for federally-funded programs.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; SAM.gov; 42 CFR Part 1001; CMS Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_checked_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the vendor was verified against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE) and SAM.gov exclusion database. Required for CMS compliance and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; SAM.gov; CMS Compliance Guidelines; 42 CFR Part 1001; HIPAA

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the confirmed delivery date. Key performance indicator (KPI) for vendor scorecard and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain KPI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the healthcare organization remits payment to the vendor. ACH and EFT are preferred for efficiency. Drives accounts payable processing in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master (LFB1.ZWELS); NACHA ACH Standards; PCI DSS

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Drives accounts payable scheduling and early payment discount capture in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM Vendor Master (LFB1.ZTERM); GAAP; FASB ASC 210

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite performance score (0.00–5.00) assigned to the vendor based on on-time delivery, fill rate, quality, and responsiveness metrics. Used in vendor scorecards and sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61); Infor Lawson

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the vendor's primary business address. Used for geographic segmentation, freight zone determination, and tax jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.PSTLZ); USPS; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor has been designated as a preferred supplier by the healthcare organization's value analysis committee or supply chain leadership. Preferred vendors receive priority in sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: AHRMM Value Analysis Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor account representative. Used for purchase order transmission, invoice correspondence, and contract communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 (for PHI-related communications)

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary account representative or sales contact at the vendor organization. Used for procurement communications, contract negotiations, and issue escalation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1/KNVK); Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary vendor account representative. Used for order inquiries, delivery coordination, and urgent supply chain communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: punchout_catalog_url
attributes.description: URL for the vendor's cXML punchout catalog integration, enabling procurement staff to browse and order directly from the vendor's online catalog within the ERP system (SAP MM or Infor Lawson).
attributes.references: cXML Punchout Standard; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM Catalog Integration

attributes.name: recall_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is enrolled to receive FDA product recall notifications and safety alerts. Critical for medical device and pharmaceutical recall management per FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA MedWatch; Medical Device Safety Act; Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA)

attributes.name: remittance_email
attributes.description: Email address designated by the vendor for receipt of Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) and payment notifications. Used in accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master; ERA/EFT Standards; NACHA

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the vendor's primary business address. Used for tax jurisdiction, state licensing verification, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; USPS State Abbreviations; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the IRS. Required for 1099 reporting, contract execution, and financial compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; GAAP; FASB; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: udi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supports Unique Device Identifier (UDI) data transmission on invoices and advance ship notices. Required for implantable device tracking per FDA UDI Rule.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Parts 801, 830); FDA GUDID; DSCSA; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor master record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between SAP MM and Infor Lawson, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor organization as registered with the state or federal government. Used for contract execution, purchase orders, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File; IRS EIN Registration

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric vendor code assigned by the healthcare organization's procurement system (SAP MM or Infor Lawson). Used on purchase orders, invoices, and remittance documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.LIFNR); Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor record. Active vendors are approved for purchasing. Blocked vendors are temporarily restricted. Debarred vendors are excluded per OIG or SAM.gov exclusion lists.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.SPERR); OIG Exclusion List; SAM.gov; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor's role in the supply chain. Distinguishes manufacturers (produce devices/drugs), distributors (resell/warehouse), GPO prime vendors, pharmacy wholesalers, service providers, and consultants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturer|distributor|gpo_prime_vendor|pharmacy_wholesaler|service_provider|consultant|sole_source|specialty_distributor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Transactional record of all procurement purchase orders issued to vendors for medical-surgical supplies, devices, and equipment. Captures PO number, vendor reference, vendor contract reference, ordering facility, ship-to location, order date, requested delivery date, total value, approval status, PO type (standard, blanket, emergency, standing), GPO contract reference, freight terms, payment terms, and fulfillment status. Supports three-way match (PO → goods receipt → invoice) and contract compliance validation. Sourced from SAP MM Purchase Orders and Infor Lawson Procurement module.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Order / Infor Lawson PO

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the purchase order record in the healthcare supply chain data platform. Primary key for the purchase_order data product.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Orders; Infor Lawson Procurement

attributes.name: buyer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Healthcare procurement requires tracking the purchasing agent/buyer for each PO to support approval workflows, audit trails, spend analysis by buyer, performance metrics, and accountability for contra

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) that issued this purchase order. Used for facility-level spend reporting and budget allocation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Plant/Purchasing Organization; Infor Lawson Facility

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Purchase orders must post to specific GL accounts for expense recognition and financial reporting. Currently has gl_account_code as text. FK to chart_of_accounts enables proper financial integration,

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Patient-specific implant POs (custom prosthetics, orthopedic hardware) directly linked to the clinical order awaiting the device. Real in joint replacement, spinal surgery. Enables order-to-receipt tr

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: POs are created and approved within fiscal periods for budget period tracking, commitment accounting, and period-end open PO accrual reporting. Essential for budget vs. actual analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific delivery location (warehouse, storeroom, department, or clinical unit) where ordered goods are to be received. May differ from the ordering facility.
attributes.references: SAP MM Delivery Address; Infor Lawson Ship-To Location

attributes.name: reimbursement_payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: When purchasing high-cost implantable devices or capital equipment, healthcare organizations track which payer will reimburse to ensure coverage compliance. Real business process: capital equipment pu

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor contract or Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) contract under which this purchase order is issued. Supports contract compliance validation and pricing verification.
attributes.references: SAP MM Contract (ME31K); Infor Lawson Contract Management

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) from whom goods or services are being procured. Links to the vendor master record for contract compliance and spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Infor Lawson Vendor Master

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the ship-to location. Used to calculate vendor on-time delivery rate and actual lead time versus requested lead time.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Infor Lawson Receiving; AHRMM Supply Chain KPIs

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the purchase order. Distinct from overall PO status — captures the authorization state within the procurement approval chain (e.g., department head, CFO, supply chain director).
attributes.references: SAP MM Release Strategy (ME28); Infor Lawson Approval Workflow; OIG Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order received final procurement approval. Used for approval cycle time analysis and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Release (EKKO-FRGDT); Infor Lawson Approval Log; OIG Compliance; SOC 2

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year against which this purchase order is budgeted and encumbered. Used for annual budget consumption tracking and year-end financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year (EKKO-GJAHR); Infor Lawson Fiscal Year; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for cancellation of the purchase order (e.g., duplicate order, vendor unable to fulfill, product recall, budget freeze). Populated only when po_status is 'cancelled'. Used for procurement analytics and process improvement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Cancellation Reason; Infor Lawson PO Cancellation; AHRMM Procurement Standards

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the vendor in response to the purchase order. Compared against requested_delivery_date to measure vendor on-time delivery performance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Order Acknowledgment; Infor Lawson Vendor Confirmation; AHRMM Vendor Performance Metrics

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which the purchase order expenditure is allocated. Used for departmental budget tracking, financial reporting, and cost accounting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center (CSKS-KOSTL); Infor Lawson Cost Center; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was first created in the source procurement system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and procurement cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Creation Date (EKKO-AEDAT); Infor Lawson; ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency procurement for international medical device vendors.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP MM Currency (EKKO-WAERS); GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the purchase order, including GPO contract discounts, volume rebates, and negotiated price reductions. Reduces gross amount to arrive at net order value.
attributes.references: SAP MM Conditions (KONV); Infor Lawson Discount; GAAP; GPO Contract Compliance

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Total freight and shipping charges associated with the purchase order. Captured separately to support freight cost analysis and vendor freight term compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Freight Conditions; Infor Lawson Freight; AHRMM Supply Chain Cost Benchmarks

attributes.name: freight_terms_code
attributes.description: Incoterms or freight terms code defining responsibility for shipping costs and risk of loss during transit (e.g., FOB Origin, FOB Destination). Impacts cost allocation and liability.
attributes.references: SAP MM Incoterms (EKKO-INCO1); Infor Lawson Freight Terms; ICC Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current goods receipt fulfillment status of the purchase order. Tracks whether ordered quantities have been partially or fully received at the ship-to location. Drives open order reporting and expediting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Delivery Completion (EKPO-ELIKZ); Infor Lawson Receiving Status; AHRMM Supply Chain KPIs

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code for financial posting of the purchase order. Determines how the procurement expense is classified in the chart of accounts (e.g., medical supplies, capital equipment).
attributes.references: SAP FI GL Account (SKA1-SAKNR); Infor Lawson GL Account; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: gpo_contract_number
attributes.description: The Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) contract number under which this purchase order is placed (e.g., Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust). Used to validate contract compliance and capture GPO-negotiated pricing.
attributes.references: AHRMM GPO Contract Management; CMS Supply Chain Transparency; OIG Anti-Kickback Statute

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of the purchase order before discounts, taxes, and freight charges. Sum of all line item extended prices. Used for budget encumbrance and spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP MM Net Order Value (EKKO-NETWR); Infor Lawson PO Amount; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current invoicing status of the purchase order from the vendor. Tracks whether vendor invoices have been received and matched against the PO. Supports accounts payable aging and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Status (EKBE); Infor Lawson Invoice Matching; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order is classified as a capital expenditure (CapEx) for medical equipment or facility assets, as opposed to an operating expenditure (OpEx) for consumable supplies. Drives fixed asset creation workflow.
attributes.references: SAP MM Account Assignment Category (EKPO-KNTTP); GAAP; FASB ASC 360; CMS Capital Cost Reporting

attributes.name: is_contract_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order was placed in compliance with an active vendor contract or GPO agreement. Non-compliant orders (maverick spend) are flagged for supply chain compliance review.
attributes.references: AHRMM Contract Compliance; OIG Anti-Kickback Statute; CMS Supply Chain Transparency; GPO Contract Terms

attributes.name: is_emergency_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order was issued as an emergency procurement, bypassing standard approval workflows due to urgent patient care or operational need. Triggers post-hoc review and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Emergency PO; SAP MM Emergency Procurement; OIG Compliance; EMTALA Supply Requirements

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items (distinct products or services) included in this purchase order. Used for order complexity analysis and procurement workload metrics.
attributes.references: SAP MM PO Item Count (EKPO); Infor Lawson PO Lines

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total net value of the purchase order after discounts, plus taxes and freight. Represents the total financial obligation to the vendor. Used for three-way match invoice validation and budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Net Value (EKKO-NETWR); Infor Lawson PO Net Amount; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the purchase order, such as delivery instructions, handling requirements for sterile or temperature-sensitive medical supplies, or vendor communication notes.
attributes.references: SAP MM PO Header Text (EKKO-BSTXT); Infor Lawson PO Notes

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was formally created and issued. Used as the principal business event date for procurement reporting, aging analysis, and contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Document Date (EKKO-BEDAT); Infor Lawson PO Date; GAAP Procurement Standards

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor payment terms code specifying the due date and early payment discount conditions (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30). Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow management.
attributes.references: SAP MM Payment Terms (EKKO-ZTERM); Infor Lawson Payment Terms; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable purchase order number assigned by the procurement system (SAP MM or Infor Lawson). Used in three-way match (PO → goods receipt → invoice) and vendor communications.
attributes.references: SAP MM ME21N; Infor Lawson PO10; CMS Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order. Tracks progression from draft creation through approval, transmission to vendor, goods receipt, and final closure or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM PO Status (EKKO-STATU); Infor Lawson PO Status; AHRMM Procurement Standards

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement strategy. Standard: one-time order; Blanket: pre-negotiated volume agreement; Emergency: urgent unplanned procurement; Standing: recurring scheduled order; Consignment: vendor-managed inventory at facility.
attributes.references: SAP MM Document Type (EKKO-BSART); Infor Lawson PO Type; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: SAP MM purchasing group code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for this purchase order. Used for buyer workload analysis and accountability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchasing Group (EKKO-EKGRP); Infor Lawson Buyer Code

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP MM purchasing organization code representing the organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Defines the legal and contractual entity issuing the purchase order.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchasing Organization (EKKO-EKORG); Infor Lawson Purchasing Entity

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the ordering facility requires the goods to be delivered. Used for vendor performance measurement, lead time analysis, and par-level replenishment planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM Delivery Date (EKET-EINDT); Infor Lawson Requested Date; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this purchase order record was extracted (e.g., SAP MM, Infor Lawson). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_po_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or document number of this purchase order in the originating source system (SAP MM EKKO-EBELN or Infor Lawson PO number). Enables back-tracing to the system of record for reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM EKKO-EBELN; Infor Lawson PO Number; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the purchase order (e.g., sales tax, use tax on taxable medical supplies). May be zero for tax-exempt healthcare organizations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Tax (EKKO-MWSKZ); Infor Lawson Tax; IRS Tax-Exempt Status; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process validating alignment between the purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Exceptions trigger accounts payable holds and supply chain investigation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Verification (MIRO); Infor Lawson Three-Way Match; GAAP; OIG Fraud Prevention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was last modified in the source procurement system. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Document; Infor Lawson Audit Log; ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: vendor_quote_number
attributes.description: The vendor-assigned quotation or bid reference number associated with this purchase order. Used to trace back to the original vendor quote for price verification and contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM RFQ (ME41); Infor Lawson Vendor Quote; AHRMM Procurement Standards

products.name: purchase_order_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each purchase order, representing individual material items ordered from a vendor. Captures line number, material master reference, ordered quantity, unit of measure, unit price, extended amount, promised delivery date, received quantity, and line status. Enables granular tracking of item-level procurement activity and receipt matching.
products.reference: SAP MM PO Line Item / Infor Lawson PO Line

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each purchase order line item within the healthcare supply chain. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) that is the delivery destination and consuming entity for this line item. Supports multi-facility procurement analytics and facility-level spend reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Ship-To Location; SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: PO lines require GL account assignment for expense classification, automated journal entry posting, and financial statement reporting. Essential for procure-to-pay financial integration and month-end

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Surgical and procedural supply orders often reference specific CPT codes to ensure correct items are ordered for scheduled procedures. Enables procedure-specific supply cost analysis and contract comp

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: PO lines charged to restricted funds enable grant compliance, fund balance checking at PO approval, and restricted fund expenditure tracking. Required for grant-funded research and donor-restricted pu

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: DME and billable supply orders use HCPCS codes for reimbursement tracking and payer compliance. Critical for revenue cycle matching supply costs to billable codes and ensuring formulary compliance.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the item being ordered. Links to the supply domain material catalog, enabling item-level procurement analytics and inventory reconciliation. [RESOURCE_REFERENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE role minimum category]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Item Master

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order header to which this line belongs. Establishes the header-detail relationship for line-level procurement tracking. [HEADER_REFERENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE role minimum category]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase requisition that generated this purchase order line. Enables traceability from clinical or departmental demand through procurement to fulfillment.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Requisition Module; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Requisition

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply contract or group purchasing organization (GPO) agreement governing the pricing and terms for this line item. Enables contract compliance and off-contract spend detection.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA MM — Outline Agreement

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) fulfilling this line item. Supports vendor performance analysis, spend analytics, and contract compliance tracking at the line level.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Vendor Master; SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this purchase order line, particularly relevant for high-value items, capital equipment, non-formulary items, or off-contract purchases requiring additional authorization.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Approval Workflow; SAP S/4HANA MM — Release Strategy; OIG — Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the individual who approved this purchase order line. Supports audit trail requirements, segregation of duties compliance, and procurement governance.
attributes.references: OIG — Compliance Program Guidance; SOC 2 — Access Controls; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM — Release Strategy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this purchase order line was approved. Provides an audit trail for procurement governance, segregation of duties compliance, and approval cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: OIG — Compliance Program Guidance; SOC 2 — Audit Logging; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: backorder_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of this line item that the vendor has placed on backorder due to stock unavailability. Critical for supply chain risk management, clinical supply continuity planning, and substitute item sourcing.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: cancelled_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of this line item that has been cancelled and will not be fulfilled. Supports open order management, budget release, and vendor communication for partial cancellations.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center to which the expense for this line item is allocated. Enables departmental spend tracking, budget variance analysis, and cost accounting within the healthcare organization's financial system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Center Accounting; GAAP; CMS Cost Report

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this purchase order line record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and procurement cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency procurement for international vendors and foreign-sourced medical supplies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GAAP; FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the unit price for this line item, as negotiated in the vendor contract or GPO agreement. Used for net price calculation, contract compliance reporting, and savings tracking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Contract Pricing; SAP S/4HANA MM — Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Classification of the line item expenditure as direct patient care supply, indirect supply, capital equipment, research, or administrative. Used for cost accounting, departmental charge allocation, and financial reporting under GAAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Cost Element; GAAP — Expense Classification; CMS Cost Report

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The manufacturer-assigned expiration date for the ordered item. Used for expiration tracking, FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, and compliance with Joint Commission and FDA requirements for expired product management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 — Pharmaceutical Expiration Dating; The Joint Commission (TJC) — EC.02.02.01; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Expiration Tracking

attributes.name: extended_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of this line item, calculated as ordered quantity multiplied by unit price. Represents the financial commitment for this line and is used for purchase order value reporting, budget encumbrance, and accounts payable matching.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA FI/MM; GAAP — Accrual Accounting

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: The freight or shipping charge allocated to this purchase order line item. Used for total landed cost calculation, vendor freight compliance, and supply chain cost analytics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM — Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this line item's expense is posted in the financial system. Supports financial reporting, audit trails, and integration between supply chain and the SAP S/4HANA FI module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Chart of Accounts; GAAP; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: gpo_contract_number
attributes.description: The contract number from the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) agreement under which this item is being procured. Enables GPO compliance reporting, rebate tracking, and contract utilization analytics.
attributes.references: GPO Contract Terms; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Contract Management; OIG — GPO Safe Harbor

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity of this line item that has been invoiced by the vendor. Used for three-way match processing, accounts payable reconciliation, and detection of invoice quantity discrepancies.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Accounts Payable; SAP S/4HANA FI — Invoice Verification

attributes.name: is_contract_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is purchased under an active vendor contract or GPO (Group Purchasing Organization) agreement. Used to identify off-contract spend and measure contract compliance rates.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA MM — Outline Agreement; GPO Contract Compliance

attributes.name: is_formulary_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is an approved formulary item (pharmaceutical or supply) within the healthcare organization's approved product list. Non-formulary items may require additional approval workflows.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Item Master; CMS Formulary Requirements; The Joint Commission (TJC) — MM.01.01.03

attributes.name: is_recall_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item on this purchase order line is currently subject to an active FDA or manufacturer recall. Triggers procurement holds, receiving alerts, and recall management workflows to protect patient safety.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Regulations — 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC) — EC.02.02.01; OIG — Fraud and Abuse Prevention

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the ordered item into a supply category. Drives procurement routing, budget coding, regulatory handling (e.g., implant tracking, DEA scheduling), and spend analytics by category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: med_surg|pharmaceutical|implant|capital_equipment|reagent|linen|dietary|office|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Item Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Type; ECRI Institute Product Categories

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the medical-surgical supply, implantable device, pharmaceutical, or other material item being ordered. Sourced from the material master or vendor catalog and used for procurement documentation and receiving verification.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Item Master; SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Description

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this purchase order line record was most recently updated in the source system. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number identifying the position of this item within the parent purchase order. Used for ordering, display, and reference in procurement documents and EDI transactions. [LINE_SEQUENCE — TRANSACTION_LINE role minimum category]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM; ANSI X12 EDI 850

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the purchase order line item. Tracks the lifecycle from open order through receipt, closure, or cancellation. Drives procurement dashboards and open order reporting. [LIFECYCLE_STATUS — TRANSACTION_LINE role minimum category]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classifies the procurement mechanism for this line item. Standard lines represent direct purchases; blanket releases draw against a blanket PO; consignment lines track vendor-owned inventory; drop-ship lines are delivered directly to a patient or department.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM — Item Category

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's lot or batch number for the ordered item. Critical for recall management, expiration tracking, and traceability of medical-surgical supplies and pharmaceuticals per FDA and Joint Commission requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Quality System Regulation; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Implant and Supply Traceability; FDA UDI Rule

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: National Drug Code identifying the specific pharmaceutical product, dosage form, and package size when this line item is a drug or pharmaceutical supply. Required for pharmacy procurement, formulary management, and DEA controlled substance tracking.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; DEA — Controlled Substances Act; CMS Drug Rebate Program

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the item requested on this purchase order line, expressed in the line's unit of measure. Represents the original procurement intent and is used for receipt matching, backorder tracking, and spend commitment calculations. [LINE_QUANTITY — TRANSACTION_LINE role minimum category]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor has committed to delivering this line item to the ordering facility. Used for supply chain planning, par-level replenishment scheduling, and vendor on-time delivery performance measurement.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Date

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity of this line item that has been physically received and confirmed at the facility receiving dock. Used for three-way match (PO-receipt-invoice), backorder calculation, and inventory replenishment confirmation.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Receiving Module; SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the ordering department or facility requested delivery of this line item. May differ from the promised delivery date when vendor lead times exceed clinical or operational needs.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Requisition Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: ship_to_location_code
attributes.description: The specific delivery location code (e.g., central receiving dock, pharmacy, OR suite, storeroom) within the facility where this line item is to be delivered. Supports receiving workflow routing and departmental delivery management.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Ship-To Location; SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this purchase order line was sourced (e.g., Infor Lawson, SAP S/4HANA MM, MEDITECH). Supports data lineage, multi-system reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; MEDITECH Expanse; ISO 27001 — Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The applicable tax amount for this purchase order line item. Supports accounts payable processing, tax reporting, and financial reconciliation for taxable supply purchases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Tax Processing; GAAP; IRS Tax Regulations; State Tax Authorities

attributes.name: udi
attributes.description: FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier for implantable devices and high-risk medical equipment ordered on this line. Enables device tracking, recall management, and compliance with FDA UDI regulations (21 CFR Part 830). Populated for Class II and Class III medical devices.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule — 21 CFR Part 830; FDA GUDID Database; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Implant Tracking

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the ordered quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, BX=Box, PK=Pack, VI=Vial, BT=Bottle). Governs quantity interpretation for receiving, inventory, and invoice matching. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|BX|PK|DZ|VI|BT|KG|LB|ML|L — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — UOM Master; SAP S/4HANA MM; GS1 Standards; ANSI X12 EDI

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The contracted or negotiated price per unit of measure for this line item, as agreed with the vendor or per the applicable GPO/contract. Used for extended amount calculation, invoice matching, and contract compliance validation. [LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT — TRANSACTION_LINE role minimum category]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Contract Pricing; SAP S/4HANA MM — Info Record; GPO Contract Terms

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The vendor's own catalog or part number for the item being ordered. Used for order transmission to the vendor, EDI matching, and vendor invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; ANSI X12 EDI 850; GS1 Standards

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Transactional record capturing the physical receipt of medical supplies and devices against a purchase order. Records receipt date, receiving location, received quantities, lot numbers, expiration dates, UDI scan data for implantable devices, condition on receipt, and discrepancy flags. Triggers inventory update and three-way match for accounts payable. Sourced from SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO) and Infor Lawson Receiving.
products.reference: SAP MM MIGO / Infor Lawson Receiving

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the goods receipt record in the healthcare supply chain lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Receiving

attributes.name: awaiting_clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Patient-specific implant receipts linked to the clinical order awaiting the device (e.g., custom knee implant arrives for scheduled surgery). Enables order-to-receipt workflow and surgical scheduling

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where the goods were physically received and inventoried.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Inventory; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Goods receipts post to inventory or expense GL accounts for real-time inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and received-not-invoiced accrual processing. Critical for three-way match and financial cl

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Goods receipts must be assigned to fiscal periods for period-end cutoff, inventory valuation timing, received-not-invoiced accrual accuracy, and financial close processes. Critical for matching princi

attributes.name: hipaa_privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.hipaa_privacy_incident. Business justification: Receipt of patient-specific items (custom orthotics, patient-labeled medications) delivered to wrong location triggers privacy incidents. Privacy officers investigate goods receipt errors that expose

attributes.name: inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location, warehouse bin, or department within the facility where goods were received (e.g., central supply, pharmacy, OR storeroom).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Inventory

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: goods_receipt has material_number and item_description which are authoritative attributes of material_master. Each goods receipt line receives a specific material item. This is standard N:1 relationsh

attributes.name: primary_goods_received_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain or materials management employee who physically received and documented the goods. Required for accountability, audit trail, and Joint Commission receiving documentation standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Receiving; ISO 27001

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this goods receipt was posted. Enables three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) for accounts payable processing in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Procurement; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order_line. Business justification: goods_receipt is the physical receipt event against a specific PO line item. Line-to-header rule applies - goods_receipt should link to purchase_order_line (not just purchase_order header) for traceab

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier who shipped the goods. Used for vendor performance tracking, recall management, and accounts payable matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Procurement

attributes.name: condition_on_receipt
attributes.description: The physical condition of the goods as assessed by the receiving staff at time of delivery. Drives quality hold, vendor return, or discrepancy workflow initiation. 'damaged' or 'contaminated' triggers a quality block in inventory.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); FDA 21 CFR Part 820; SAP S/4HANA MM Quality Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values on this goods receipt (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency environments and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP and FASB; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The vendor's packing slip or delivery note number accompanying the shipment. Used for three-way match (purchase order, delivery note, invoice) and discrepancy resolution with the vendor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Receiving; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a discrepancy was identified between the purchase order, delivery note, and actual goods received (quantity, item, condition, or pricing mismatch). When True, triggers a discrepancy resolution workflow and may block accounts payable posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Receiving; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the discrepancy observed at receipt, entered by the receiving staff. Provides context for vendor dispute resolution, accounts payable hold, and quality management follow-up.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Receiving; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the discrepancy identified at receipt: quantity variance, wrong item delivered, price mismatch against purchase order, unacceptable condition, or missing documentation. Populated only when discrepancy_flag is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Receiving

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The manufacturer-assigned expiration or use-by date for the received goods. Critical for par-level replenishment, FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, and preventing use of expired medical supplies per Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; The Joint Commission (TJC); SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: implantable_device_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received item is an implantable medical device subject to FDA UDI scanning requirements and implant registry tracking (e.g., orthopedic implants, cardiac devices, vascular grafts). Drives UDI capture workflow.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: inventory_update_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the goods receipt has successfully triggered an inventory quantity update in the warehouse management system. False may indicate a posting error or quality block preventing inventory movement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Inventory; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's lot or batch number assigned to the received goods. Critical for recall management, expiration tracking, and traceability of medical-surgical supplies and implantable devices per FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods were manufactured, as indicated on the product label or UDI barcode. Used for shelf-life calculation, quality assurance, and FDA UDI traceability.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP MM or Infor Lawson inventory movement type code classifying the nature of the goods receipt transaction (e.g., SAP movement type 101=GR for PO, 122=Return to Vendor, 161=GR for Returns). Drives accounting document generation and inventory valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|122|161|501|521|531 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The SAP plant code or Infor Lawson site code representing the organizational unit (hospital campus, distribution center) where the goods receipt is posted. Used for inventory segmentation and financial posting to the correct cost center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: posting_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the goods receipt was posted in the ERP system (SAP MIGO or Infor Lawson), triggering inventory update and accounts payable liability. Distinct from the physical receipt date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity of goods specified on the originating purchase order line. Used to calculate over/under receipt discrepancies and to support three-way match for accounts payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Procurement; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: The actual quantity of goods physically received and accepted at the receiving dock. Compared against the purchase order quantity and delivery note quantity for three-way match and discrepancy detection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO; Infor Lawson Receiving; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received lot or item has been subsequently identified as subject to an FDA or manufacturer recall. When True, triggers recall management workflow to quarantine and return affected inventory.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: recall_reference_number
attributes.description: The FDA or manufacturer-assigned recall identification number associated with this goods receipt when a recall has been issued. Populated only when recall_flag is True. Supports regulatory reporting to FDA and OIG.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; Office of Inspector General (OIG); FDA GUDID

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical receipt of goods occurred at the receiving dock. This is the principal business event date used for inventory valuation, expiration tracking, and accounts payable aging.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO; GAAP and FASB; Infor Lawson Receiving

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this goods receipt document, corresponding to the SAP MIGO material document number or Infor Lawson receiving document number. Used in three-way match and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Receiving

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the goods receipt document. 'posted' indicates inventory has been updated; 'reversed' indicates a cancellation posting; 'blocked' indicates a quality or discrepancy hold pending resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's serial number for serialized items such as capital equipment, durable medical devices, or high-value implants. Supports individual asset tracking and FDA UDI compliance.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The native document number from the source system (e.g., SAP material document number from MIGO, or Infor Lawson receiving document number). Enables traceability back to the originating system for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO; Infor Lawson Receiving; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this goods receipt was sourced (SAP S/4HANA MM MIGO, Infor Lawson Receiving, MEDITECH, or manual entry). Required for data lineage and Extract Transform Load (ETL) reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: sterile_processing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received item requires sterile processing or reprocessing before clinical use. When True, routes the item to the Sterile Processing Department (SPD) workflow rather than direct inventory stocking.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); AAMI ST79; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; OSHA

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the received goods as specified by the manufacturer (e.g., refrigerated for biologics and vaccines, frozen for certain pharmaceuticals, ambient for standard medical-surgical supplies). Drives putaway routing in the warehouse.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; USP <1079>; The Joint Commission (TJC); SAP S/4HANA MM WM

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion was detected during transit or at receipt for cold-chain items (vaccines, biologics, temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals). When True, triggers quality review and potential rejection per cold-chain management protocols.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; USP <1079>; CDC Vaccine Storage and Handling Toolkit; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Current status of the three-way match process between the purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. 'matched' enables accounts payable payment; 'exception' indicates a variance requiring resolution before payment release.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM; GAAP and FASB; Infor Lawson Procurement

attributes.name: total_receipt_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of goods received, calculated as quantity received multiplied by unit cost. Used to post the goods receipt liability in accounts payable and for inventory valuation in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO/MM; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: udi_device_identifier
attributes.description: The FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier (UDI) Device Identifier (DI) portion scanned from the device label barcode (GS1, HIBCC, or ICCBBA format) for implantable and Class II/III medical devices. Required for FDA UDI compliance and implant registry reporting.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; FDA GUDID Database; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: udi_production_identifier
attributes.description: The FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier (UDI) Production Identifier (PI) portion containing lot/batch number, serial number, manufacturing date, and/or expiration date as encoded on the device label. Complements the UDI Device Identifier for full UDI compliance.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; FDA GUDID Database

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The contracted or invoice unit cost per unit of measure for the received item. Used for inventory valuation, three-way match, and cost accounting in SAP FI/CO. Classified confidential as it reflects negotiated contract pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO/MM; GAAP and FASB; Infor Lawson Procurement

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the received quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, BX=Box, CS=Case, PK=Pack, BT=Bottle, VI=Vial). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure and Infor Lawson stocking unit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|BX|CS|PK|BT|VI|DZ|TU|KG|LT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this goods receipt record was last modified in the source system (e.g., reversal, correction, or status change). Supports incremental Extract Transform Load (ETL) processing.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor's invoice number associated with this shipment, if provided at time of receipt. Supports early three-way match initiation and accounts payable processing in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM; GAAP and FASB; Infor Lawson Procurement

products.name: inventory_location
products.description: Master record for all physical and logical storage locations within the healthcare supply chain, including central storerooms, OR supply rooms, nursing unit supply closets, automated dispensing cabinets (ADC), and off-site warehouses. Captures location code, facility, department, location type, par-level management flag, temperature requirements, and responsible cost center.
products.reference: SAP MM Storage Location / Infor Lawson Location

attributes.name: inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical or logical inventory storage location within the healthcare supply chain. Primary key for this master record.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: FK to facility.building

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where this inventory location physically resides. Links to the facility master record.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Facility Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Plant

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique device identifier for the Automated Dispensing Cabinet (ADC) unit (e.g., Pyxis MedStation, Omnicell) associated with this location. Populated only when location_type is 'adc'. Used for device-level inventory reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA — Medical Device Unique Device Identification (UDI); DEA Controlled Substance Dispensing

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical or operational department (e.g., ICU, OR, ED, Pharmacy) that owns or primarily uses this inventory location. Drives cost allocation and par-level management.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Department Master; SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center

attributes.name: osha_safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.osha_safety_program. Business justification: Storage locations must comply with OSHA safety programs (hazmat storage, temperature monitoring, controlled substance security). Safety officers audit locations against program requirements for inspec

attributes.name: parent_location_inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier to the parent inventory location in a location hierarchy (e.g., a bin within a storeroom, a storeroom within a facility warehouse). Supports hierarchical location structures for reporting and replenishment rollup.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Structure

attributes.name: access_restriction_level
attributes.description: Physical and system access control level for this location. Drives security configuration in ADC systems, badge access systems, and EHR supply dispensing workflows. Controlled substance locations require dual-key or pharmacist-only access per DEA regulations.
attributes.references: DEA — Controlled Substances Act 21 CFR Part 1301; HIPAA Security Rule; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: adc_manufacturer
attributes.description: Manufacturer of the Automated Dispensing Cabinet (ADC) installed at this location. Used for maintenance scheduling, vendor management, and integration configuration with pharmacy systems.
attributes.references: FDA — Medical Device Registration; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Equipment Master

attributes.name: bin_aisle
attributes.description: Aisle designation within the storage location (e.g., 'A', 'B', '01'). Used in warehouse management and central storeroom operations to direct pickers to the correct aisle.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Bin Location; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management

attributes.name: bin_shelf
attributes.description: Shelf or rack level within the aisle for this storage location. Combined with bin_aisle, provides the precise bin address for pick-and-put-away operations.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Bin Location; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory location master record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and compliance with HIPAA Security Rule audit control requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001 — Information Security Management

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for physical inventory cycle counts at this location. Drives the cycle count calendar in the materials management system. High-value or controlled substance locations typically require more frequent counts per Joint Commission and DEA requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Supply Chain Standards; DEA — Controlled Substance Inventory Requirements; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this inventory location was or is scheduled to be deactivated or decommissioned. Nullable for currently active locations. Supports historical analysis and facility transition planning.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this inventory location became or is scheduled to become operationally active. Used for location lifecycle management, historical reporting, and integration with facility opening/renovation projects.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: expiration_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether expiration date tracking is enforced for items stored at this location. When true, the system monitors item expiration dates and generates alerts for items approaching or past expiration, supporting patient safety and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Medication Management Standards; FDA — Drug Expiration Dating 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Floor or level within the building where the inventory location is situated. Used for delivery routing, pick-path optimization, and emergency supply logistics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Address

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code to which supply expenses from this location are posted. Supports financial reporting, cost allocation, and budget variance analysis per GAAP and FASB standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: hazardous_material_storage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is approved for storage of hazardous materials including chemotherapy agents, flammable chemicals, or OSHA-regulated hazardous substances. Drives compliance with OSHA Hazard Communication Standard and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA — Hazard Communication Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA — Hazardous Waste Regulations; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: humidity_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location has active humidity control. Required for certain medical supplies, sterile packaging, and pharmaceutical products sensitive to moisture per FDA and USP storage standards.

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory cycle count was completed at this location. Used to identify overdue counts, support audit readiness, and ensure compliance with Joint Commission and DEA inventory requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Supply Chain Standards; DEA — Controlled Substance Inventory Requirements

attributes.name: lawson_location_code
attributes.description: Source system location identifier from Infor Lawson Supply Chain. Used for ETL reconciliation, cross-system data lineage, and integration with procurement and inventory modules.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the storage location, as assigned in Infor Lawson or SAP MM. Used on requisitions, pick tickets, and transfer orders to reference the physical or logical location.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the storage location (e.g., 'Central Storeroom A', '3rd Floor Nursing Supply Closet', 'OR Supply Room 2'). Used in reports, labels, and user interfaces.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master

attributes.name: location_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or access directions relevant to this inventory location. Examples: 'Key held at nursing station', 'Refrigerator alarm monitored by facilities', 'Restricted to OR staff only'.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Master

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory location. Controls whether the location is available for receiving, picking, and replenishment transactions. Inactive or decommissioned locations are excluded from par-level replenishment runs.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Status

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the storage location by its operational role within the supply chain. Drives replenishment rules, access controls, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: central_storeroom|or_supply_room|nursing_unit_closet|adc|off_site_warehouse|satellite_pharmacy|procedure_room|loading_dock — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Type; SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Type

attributes.name: next_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next physical inventory cycle count is scheduled for this location. Supports proactive scheduling of materials management staff and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission — Supply Chain Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Cycle Count Schedule

attributes.name: par_level_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is managed using par-level replenishment methodology. When true, the system monitors on-hand quantities against defined par levels and triggers automatic replenishment requisitions when stock falls below the par threshold.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Par Level Management; Joint Commission Supply Standards

attributes.name: par_replenishment_method
attributes.description: The replenishment methodology used to restock this location. Automated Dispensing Cabinet (ADC) locations use automated dispensing; nursing units may use cart exchange or Periodic Automatic Replenishment (PAR) rounds; central storerooms may use demand-based replenishment.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Replenishment Method

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary responsible person (e.g., charge nurse, materials manager, storeroom supervisor) accountable for this inventory location. Used for escalation, cycle count coordination, and supply chain communications.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Contact

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary responsible contact for this inventory location. Used for supply delivery coordination, urgent replenishment requests, and recall notifications.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Contact; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: recall_management_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is enrolled in the automated recall management process. When true, FDA and manufacturer recall notifications trigger automated inventory holds and quarantine workflows for affected items at this location.
attributes.references: FDA — Medical Device Recall 21 CFR Part 806; FDA — Drug Recall; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency
