attributes.description: How frequently this location is scheduled for replenishment review and restocking. Drives supply chain scheduling and staffing for materials management rounds.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Replenishment Schedule

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: Specific room or suite identifier within the building and floor for this inventory location. Provides precise physical address for supply delivery and cycle counting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Address

attributes.name: sap_storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP MM storage location code corresponding to this inventory location. Used for integration with SAP S/4HANA Materials Management for goods movements, purchase orders, and inventory postings.

attributes.name: secure_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated and secured for storage of DEA Schedule II–V controlled substances. Locations flagged true must comply with DEA 21 CFR Part 1301 physical security requirements and are subject to enhanced audit and access controls.
attributes.references: DEA — Controlled Substances Act 21 CFR Part 1301; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: sterile_processing_staging
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location serves as a staging area for sterile processing and reprocessing of reusable surgical instruments and devices. Locations flagged true are subject to sterile processing compliance standards and AAMI/AORN guidelines.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 — Comprehensive Guide to Steam Sterilization; AORN Perioperative Standards; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cubic_ft
attributes.description: Physical volumetric capacity of the storage location in cubic feet. Used for space planning, facility management, and determining whether bulk or oversized items can be stored at this location.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Capacity; SAP S/4HANA MM Warehouse Management

attributes.name: storage_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of individual supply units or item slots this location can physically hold. Used for capacity planning, space utilization analysis, and par-level setting. Represents the principal quantitative capacity fact for this resource.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Location Capacity; SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Bin Capacity

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location. Exceedances trigger environmental monitoring alerts and may require product quarantine or disposal per FDA and USP guidelines.
attributes.references: FDA — Drug Storage Requirements; USP <1079>; ISO 13485 — Medical Devices Quality Management

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location. Used for environmental monitoring alerts and compliance reporting with FDA and USP storage standards.
attributes.references: FDA — Drug Storage Requirements; USP <1079>; ISO 13485 — Medical Devices Quality Management

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required temperature storage condition for items held at this location. Critical for compliance with FDA storage requirements for pharmaceuticals, biologics, and temperature-sensitive medical supplies. Ambient = 15–25°C; Refrigerated = 2–8°C; Frozen = -20°C; Ultra-Low Frozen = -80°C.
attributes.references: FDA — Drug Storage Requirements; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices

attributes.name: udi_tracking_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unique Device Identification (UDI) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location participates in FDA Unique Device Identification (UDI) tracking for implantable devices and high-risk medical supplies. When true, all UDI-regulated items received or dispensed at this location are captured in the UDI audit trail per FDA 21 CFR Part 830.
attributes.references: FDA — UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission Supply Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory location master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture, ETL incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001 — Information Security Management

products.name: inventory_balance
products.description: Current on-hand inventory position for each material item at each storage location, serving as SSOT for stock levels, par-level configuration, and replenishment parameters. Tracks quantity on hand, on order, reserved, and in transit; ownership type (owned, consignment); reorder point, par level, maximum level, and replenishment method (par, kanban, min-max); lot/serial tracking; expiration visibility; and last physical count date. Supports par-level replenishment, stockout prevention, consignment reconciliation, expiration alerting, and inventory valuation. Sourced from SAP MM Inventory Management and Infor Lawson Inventory.
products.reference: SAP MM Inventory Management / Infor Lawson Inventory

attributes.name: inventory_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inventory balance record representing the on-hand position of a material item at a specific storage location. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP MM Inventory Management; Infor Lawson Inventory

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where this inventory balance is held. Supports multi-facility enterprise inventory visibility.
attributes.references: SAP MM Plant (T001W); Infor Lawson Facility Master

attributes.name: inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (e.g., storeroom, OR supply room, nursing unit, pharmacy satellite, or warehouse bin) where this inventory balance is maintained.
attributes.references: SAP MM Storage Location (MARD); Infor Lawson Location Master

attributes.name: inventory_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master

attributes.name: primary_inventory_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record identifying the specific medical-surgical supply, implantable device, pharmaceutical, or consumable item tracked in this inventory balance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master (MM60); Infor Lawson Item Master

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor_contract. Business justification: inventory_balance has contract_number as STRING. For consignment inventory or contract-specific pricing/ownership, this should be FK to vendor_contract for referential integrity and to enable joining

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vendor or supplier associated with this inventory item, used for consignment reconciliation and replenishment sourcing.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Infor Lawson Vendor Master

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC inventory classification indicating the relative value and usage frequency of the item. 'A' items are high-value/high-usage requiring tight control; 'B' items are moderate; 'C' items are low-value/low-usage; 'X' items are unclassified or obsolete.
attributes.references: SAP MM ABC Indicator (ABCIN); Infor Lawson ABC Analysis; AHRMM Inventory Stratification

attributes.name: balance_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this inventory balance record was captured or last refreshed from the source system. Represents the as-of time for all quantity fields, enabling point-in-time inventory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Inventory Management; Infor Lawson Inventory Snapshot; GAAP ASC 330 Inventory Reporting

attributes.name: below_reorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current on-hand quantity has fallen below the defined reorder point, signaling that a replenishment order should be initiated. Distinct from stockout_flag which indicates zero or critically low stock.
attributes.references: SAP MM MRP Exception Messages; Infor Lawson Reorder Alerts; AHRMM Replenishment Best Practices

attributes.name: consignment_vendor_number
attributes.description: The vendor account number for consignment stock held at this location. Populated only when ownership_type is 'consignment'. Used for consignment reconciliation, liability reporting, and vendor settlement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Consignment Stock (KONS); Infor Lawson Consignment Management; GAAP ASC 330 Consignment Accounting

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost and inventory valuation amounts (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency enterprise environments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: days_to_expiration
attributes.description: Number of days from the current date until the earliest expiration date for on-hand stock. Used to trigger expiration alerts and prioritize consumption. Supports proactive waste management and patient safety.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Supply Expiration Policy; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; AHRMM Expiration Management

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The earliest expiration date among current on-hand stock for this item at this location. Used for expiration alerting, FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking, and waste reduction. Critical for patient safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; The Joint Commission (TJC) Medication and Supply Expiration Standards; SAP MM Shelf Life (MHDRZ)

attributes.name: formulary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is on the facility's approved formulary or preferred item list. Supports value analysis, standardization initiatives, and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: AHRMM Value Analysis; The Joint Commission (TJC) Formulary Management; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the inventory balance record. 'blocked' indicates stock held pending quality review; 'recalled' indicates FDA or manufacturer recall action; 'quarantine' indicates items pending investigation or inspection.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock Type (LGTYP); FDA Recall Guidance; The Joint Commission (TJC) Supply Standards; ISO 13485

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the inventory item type. Drives handling rules, regulatory tracking requirements, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical_surgical|implant|pharmaceutical|prosthetic|sterile_processing|capital_equipment|office_supply — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Type (MTART); Infor Lawson Item Category; FDA Device Classification

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory transaction (receipt, issue, transfer, or adjustment) for this item at this location. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete stock.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Document (MKPF); Infor Lawson Inventory Transaction History

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed for this item at this location. Used to assess inventory accuracy, schedule next count, and support audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Physical Inventory (MI01); Infor Lawson Cycle Count; GAAP ASC 330 Inventory Accuracy; The Joint Commission (TJC) Supply Chain Audit

attributes.name: last_physical_count_qty
attributes.description: The quantity recorded during the most recent physical inventory count for this item at this location. Used to calculate inventory variance and assess system accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP MM Physical Inventory Document (ISEG); Infor Lawson Cycle Count Results; GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt for this item at this location. Used to assess replenishment cycle performance and vendor delivery timeliness.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Infor Lawson Purchase Order Receipt

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or internal lot/batch number for the current stock of this item. Required for expiration tracking, recall management, and FDA traceability. Populated only when lot_tracking_enabled is true.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; SAP MM Batch Number (CHARG); ISO 13485 Lot Traceability

attributes.name: lot_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether lot/batch number tracking is active for this item at this location. Required for items subject to FDA recall management, expiration tracking, and chain-of-custody compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; SAP MM Batch Management (MCHB); ISO 13485 Traceability

attributes.name: max_level
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of the item that should be held at this storage location. Prevents overstocking, reduces waste from expiration, and optimizes storage space utilization.
attributes.references: SAP MM Maximum Stock Level (MABST); Infor Lawson Max Level; AHRMM Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: National Drug Code assigned by the FDA for pharmaceutical items in inventory. Identifies the labeler, product, and package configuration. Null for non-pharmaceutical items.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; DEA Controlled Substances Tracking; CMS Drug Reimbursement

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates the ownership arrangement for this inventory. 'consignment' means the vendor retains title until use; 'loaner' applies to implant trays or devices temporarily on-site for a specific procedure; 'owned' means the facility has purchased and holds title.
attributes.references: SAP MM Special Stock Indicator (SOBKZ); Infor Lawson Consignment Tracking; GAAP ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: par_level
attributes.description: The target stock quantity (Periodic Automatic Replenishment level) that should be maintained at this location. When on-hand quantity falls below par, a replenishment order is triggered to restore stock to this level.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson PAR Replenishment; AHRMM PAR Level Management Best Practices

attributes.name: qty_in_transit
attributes.description: Quantity of the item that has been shipped from the vendor or a central warehouse but has not yet been received at the destination storage location. Supports in-transit visibility for supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM Stock in Transit (UMLMD); Infor Lawson Transfer Orders

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Current unrestricted quantity of the item physically present and available for use at the storage location. This is the primary stock level metric used for replenishment decisions and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unrestricted Stock (LABST); Infor Lawson On-Hand Quantity; GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: qty_on_order
attributes.description: Total quantity of the item currently on open purchase orders or requisitions that have not yet been received. Used to project future availability and prevent duplicate ordering.
attributes.references: SAP MM Open Purchase Orders (EKPO); Infor Lawson Open Requisitions

attributes.name: qty_quarantine
attributes.description: Quantity of the item currently held in quarantine stock pending quality inspection, recall investigation, or regulatory hold. Not available for clinical use until released.
attributes.references: SAP MM Quality Inspection Stock (EINME); FDA Recall Guidance; ISO 13485 Quality Management

attributes.name: qty_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity of the item reserved for specific procedures, surgical cases, or patient orders but not yet consumed. Reduces available-to-promise quantity for replenishment calculations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation (RESB); Infor Lawson Reservation Management; OpTime Surgical Case Picking

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any on-hand stock of this item at this location is subject to an active FDA or manufacturer recall. When true, the item should be quarantined and removed from clinical use pending recall resolution.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Guidance (21 CFR Part 7); The Joint Commission (TJC) Recall Management; OIG Compliance

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: FDA or manufacturer-assigned recall identification number associated with the active recall affecting this inventory. Populated only when recall_flag is true. Used for recall tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Database; FDA 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC) Recall Procedures

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold at which a replenishment order must be initiated to avoid stockout, accounting for lead time and safety stock. Used in min-max and reorder-point replenishment methods.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reorder Point (MINBE); Infor Lawson Reorder Point; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: The method used to trigger restocking of this item at this location. 'par' uses periodic automatic replenishment to a defined par level; 'kanban' uses visual/signal-based pull; 'min_max' triggers orders when quantity falls below minimum; 'vendor_managed' delegates replenishment to the supplier.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Par Replenishment; SAP MM MRP Type (DISMM); AHRMM Supply Chain Best Practices

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity maintained above the reorder point to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Critical for high-utilization clinical items to prevent patient care disruptions.
attributes.references: SAP MM Safety Stock (EISBE); Infor Lawson Safety Stock; AHRMM Stockout Prevention

attributes.name: serial_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual serial number tracking is active for this item. Typically enabled for high-value implantable devices, capital equipment, and items requiring UDI-level traceability.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); SAP MM Serial Number Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) Implant Tracking

attributes.name: source_record_key
attributes.description: The natural key or composite identifier from the source system (e.g., SAP plant/storage location/material combination or Infor Lawson item/location key) that uniquely identifies this balance record in the originating system.
attributes.references: SAP MM MARD Table Key; Infor Lawson Inventory Balance Key

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this inventory balance record was sourced (e.g., SAP MM, Infor Lawson). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; HL7 FHIR Supply Delivery Resource

attributes.name: stockout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current on-hand quantity is zero or below the safety stock threshold, representing a stockout condition. Used to trigger emergency procurement and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: AHRMM Stockout Prevention Guidelines; The Joint Commission (TJC) Supply Availability Standards; Infor Lawson Stockout Alerts

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: The specific bin, shelf, or slot identifier within the storage location where this item is physically stored. Supports directed putaway, picking, and cycle count operations.
attributes.references: SAP WM Storage Bin (LGPLA); Infor Lawson Bin Location

attributes.name: udi_code
attributes.description: FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier for implantable and high-risk medical devices. Enables device tracking, recall management, and post-market surveillance per FDA UDI regulation (21 CFR Part 830). Null for non-device items.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); FDA GUDID Database; The Joint Commission (TJC) Device Tracking

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The standard or moving average cost per unit of measure for this item at this location. Used for inventory valuation, charge capture, and cost accounting. Classified as confidential due to vendor pricing sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP MM Moving Average Price (VERPR); GAAP ASC 330 Inventory Valuation; CMS Cost Report

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which inventory quantities are tracked (e.g., EA=Each, BX=Box, CS=Case, PK=Pack, BG=Bag, DZ=Dozen). Aligns with the material master UOM for consistent quantity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); Infor Lawson UOM; GS1 Unit of Measure Codes

products.name: inventory_transaction
products.description: Transactional log of all inventory movements including issues to patient care areas, returns, transfers between locations, adjustments, waste disposals, cycle count corrections, and physical count results. Captures movement type, material master reference, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination locations, reference document (PO, requisition, patient encounter), cost center, unit cost, extended cost, posting date, reason code, lot/serial number, and count variance (for physical counts). Provides full audit trail for supply utilization, cost allocation to departments, implant charge capture support, and inventory accuracy measurement. Sourced from SAP MM Goods Movement (MIGO 201-309) and Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Document / Infor Lawson Inventory Transaction

attributes.name: inventory_transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for inventory_transaction

attributes.name: case_cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.case_cart. Business justification: inventory_transaction has surgical_case_number as STRING, but case_cart is the operational record for surgical case supply assembly. Inventory movements for case cart assembly/return should link to ca

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Inventory movements (issues, returns, adjustments, write-offs) must post to specific GL accounts for inventory valuation, expense recognition, and financial statement accuracy. Enables automated GL po

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Supply issues and returns tied to specific clinical orders for charge capture audit and inventory reconciliation. Links supply movement to clinical event for billing validation and waste analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Inventory transactions post to specific fiscal periods for inventory valuation, COGS timing, expense recognition, and period-end inventory reconciliation. Required for accurate financial statements an

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_receipt. Business justification: Inventory transactions for receipts should link to the goods_receipt record for full traceability of the receiving event (who received, condition on receipt, discrepancies, UDI capture, etc.). This co

attributes.name: inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_location. Business justification: inventory_transaction has source_storage_location as STRING, but this should be FK to inventory_location for referential integrity and to enable joins for location attributes (care_site, department, t

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: inventory_transaction has material_number and material_description which are authoritative in material_master. Every inventory movement is for a specific material item. Adding material_master_id FK en

attributes.name: performed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee or user ID of the staff member who performed or authorized the inventory transaction. Supports accountability, audit trail, and compliance with HIPAA and Joint Commission documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (USNAM); Infor Lawson Supply Chain; HIPAA Security Rule; ISO 27001

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: inventory_transaction has purchase_order_number as STRING. For movements related to PO receipts, this should be FK for referential integrity and to enable joining to PO header attributes (vendor, cont

attributes.name: recall_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.recall_notice. Business justification: inventory_transaction has recall_flag and recall_number. Movements related to recalls (quarantine, return to vendor, destruction) should link to recall_notice for full context (recall class, health ha

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.requisition. Business justification: inventory_transaction has requisition_number as STRING. For movements related to requisition fulfillment (issues to departments), this should be FK to requisition for traceability to the requesting de

attributes.name: source_transaction_id
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., SAP MM material document item number or Infor Lawson transaction sequence number). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (MBLNR/ZEILE); Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions; SOC 2; ISO 27001

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier associated with this inventory transaction, applicable for goods receipt and return-to-vendor movements. Links to the vendor master for supplier performance analysis and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Vendor Management

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient encounter associated with this inventory transaction, applicable when supplies are issued directly to a patient care event. Enables implant charge capture support and supply cost allocation to specific patient encounters for revenue cycle management.
attributes.references: Epic EHR (OpTime; ClinDoc); Cerner Millennium; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center to which the supply cost is allocated. Corresponds to SAP CO cost center (KOSTL) and is used for departmental cost reporting, budget variance analysis, and CMS cost report preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP and FASB; CMS Cost Reporting (Form 2552)

attributes.name: count_variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between the physical count quantity and the system book quantity for physical inventory and cycle count transactions. A positive value indicates a surplus; a negative value indicates a shortage. Used for inventory accuracy measurement and shrinkage analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory (MI); Infor Lawson Cycle Count; GAAP and FASB Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: count_variance_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the physical count variance, calculated as count_variance_quantity multiplied by unit_cost. Used for financial reporting of inventory adjustments and write-offs in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory (MI); GAAP and FASB Inventory Valuation; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory transaction record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary values in this transaction (e.g., USD). Required for multi-entity health systems operating across different currency jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: destination_storage_location
attributes.description: The receiving storage location or inventory location to which the supply item was moved. Applicable for transfer and receipt transactions. Corresponds to SAP MM receiving storage location or Infor Lawson destination location.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date the physical goods movement or source document was created, which may differ from the posting date. Used for audit trail and reconciliation between physical activity and financial posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (BLDAT); GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the specific lot or batch of the supply item involved in this transaction. Critical for expiration tracking, FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, and compliance with FDA and Joint Commission requirements for expired product management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (Expiration Dating); The Joint Commission (TJC) EC.02.05.01; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the inventory transaction calculated as quantity multiplied by unit cost. Represents the monetary value of the goods movement for cost center allocation, departmental charge capture, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Valuation; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the inventory transaction value is posted in SAP FI. Supports financial reconciliation between supply chain and the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal (cancellation) of a previously posted goods movement. When True, the transaction negates the original movement for audit and financial correction purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Reversal; GAAP and FASB; SOC 2 Audit Controls

attributes.name: issuing_department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department code responsible for issuing or consuming the supply item, such as ICU, ED, OR, or a specific nursing unit. Used for departmental supply utilization reporting and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer lot or batch number assigned to the supply item. Critical for recall management, expiration tracking, and traceability of medical-surgical supplies and implantable devices. Corresponds to SAP MM batch number (CHARG).
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission (TJC); SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP MM material document number (MBLNR) generated upon goods movement posting. Serves as the primary business identifier for the transaction, traceable in SAP MIGO and Infor Lawson transaction logs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year associated with the material document number in SAP MM. Required in combination with material_document_number to uniquely identify a goods movement document in SAP.

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the inventory movement for analytics and reporting. 'issue' = supply issued to patient care area or department; 'return' = unused supply returned to stock; 'transfer' = movement between storage locations; 'adjustment' = manual inventory correction; 'waste' = disposal or expiration write-off; 'count' = physical or cycle count result; 'receipt' = goods receipt from vendor or PO. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issue|return|transfer|adjustment|waste|count|receipt — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory; SAP S/4HANA MM; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory

attributes.name: movement_type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the movement type code, such as 'Goods Issue to Cost Center', 'Transfer Posting', 'Physical Inventory Count Adjustment', 'Scrapping/Waste Disposal', or 'Return from Patient Care Area'. Supports reporting and analytics without requiring code lookups.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory

attributes.name: par_location_code
attributes.description: The PAR (Periodic Automatic Replenishment) location code identifying the nursing unit, procedure room, or supply cabinet from which the item was issued or replenished. Used for par-level replenishment analysis and supply utilization reporting by care area.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain PAR Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP MM plant code (WERKS) representing the facility or organizational unit where the inventory transaction occurred. Maps to a hospital, clinic, or outpatient facility within the health system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Facility

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the inventory movement was posted to the ledger. Determines the accounting period for cost allocation and financial reporting. Corresponds to SAP MIGO Posting Date (BUDAT) and Infor Lawson transaction date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (BUDAT); GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the supply item involved in the inventory movement. Positive values indicate goods receipt or return; negative values indicate goods issue or write-off, consistent with SAP MM sign convention. Supports supply utilization analysis and inventory accuracy measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason explaining why the inventory transaction occurred, particularly for adjustments, waste disposals, and returns. Examples include EXPIRED (expiration date reached), DAMAGED (item damaged), RECALLED (manufacturer recall), COUNT_VARIANCE (physical count discrepancy), PATIENT_USE (issued for patient care). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXPIRED|DAMAGED|RECALLED|COUNT_VARIANCE|PATIENT_USE|OVERSTOCK|WRONG_ITEM|THEFT|SPOILAGE|TRANSFER_REQUEST — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Reason Code; Infor Lawson Inventory; FDA Recall Management

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the reason code, such as specific details about damage, recall notice number, or count discrepancy explanation. Supports audit trail and investigation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; The Joint Commission (TJC) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item involved in this transaction is subject to an active manufacturer or FDA recall notice. When True, triggers recall management workflows and patient safety notifications.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) Patient Safety; 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number of the original transaction that this reversal transaction cancels. Populated only when is_reversal is True. Enables full audit trail linking reversals to their originating documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Reversal; SOC 2 Audit Controls; ISO 27001

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number for serialized items such as implantable devices, capital equipment components, or high-value prosthetics. Enables individual unit-level traceability for patient safety and recall management.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission (TJC); SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this inventory transaction was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; MEDITECH Expanse; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: sterile_processing_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item involved in this transaction is subject to sterile processing (reprocessing/sterilization) workflows. When True, the item is tracked through the sterile processing department (SPD) for reuse cycle management.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) IC.02.02.01; AAMI ST79 Sterilization Standards; AHRQ

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory transaction. 'posted' indicates the goods movement has been successfully recorded; 'reversed' indicates a cancellation document has been posted; 'pending' indicates awaiting system confirmation; 'error' indicates a posting failure requiring resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions

attributes.name: udi_code
attributes.description: The FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier (UDI) for implantable devices and high-risk medical devices. Composed of the Device Identifier (DI) and Production Identifier (PI) components. Required for implant charge capture, recall management, and FDA UDI compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); FDA GUDID Database; The Joint Commission (TJC) Implant Tracking

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the supply item at the time of the transaction, sourced from the material master valuation price or moving average price. Used for cost allocation to departments and cost center accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Valuation; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the transaction quantity is expressed, such as EA (each), BX (box), CS (case), PK (pack), or ML (milliliter). Corresponds to SAP MM base unit of measure (MEINS) or Infor Lawson unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; ISO 80000 Units of Measurement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory transaction record was last modified, such as upon reversal, status change, or correction. Supports change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

products.name: requisition
products.description: Internal supply requisition submitted by clinical departments, nursing units, or OR teams requesting materials from the central storeroom or supply chain. Captures requisition number, requesting department, requested items with quantities and material master references, urgency level (routine, urgent, STAT), clinical justification, approval workflow status, fulfillment method (stock pull, direct purchase), linked purchase order (if non-stock), and fulfillment status. Supports par-level auto-replenishment triggers and manual ad-hoc requests. Sourced from Infor Lawson Requisitions module and SAP MM Purchase Requisitions.
products.reference: Infor Lawson Requisition / SAP MM Purchase Requisition

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the internal supply requisition record. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Purchase Requisitions

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved or rejected the requisition. Used for accountability, audit trail, and compliance with procurement authorization policies.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Release Strategy; OIG Compliance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hospital, clinic, or outpatient facility from which the requisition originates. Supports multi-facility health system reporting and inventory allocation.
attributes.references: CMS Facility Reporting; The Joint Commission; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Requisitions originate from requesting cost centers for budget checking, approval routing by cost center manager, and spend tracking against departmental budgets. Core to budget control workflow.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical department, nursing unit, or OR team that submitted the requisition. Links to the facility/department master. Examples include ICU, ED, OR, pharmacy, or a specific nursing unit.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Cost Center; CMS Facility Reporting

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order generated from this requisition when the fulfillment method is direct purchase. Null for stock pull fulfillments. Links the requisition to the procurement and accounts payable workflow.
attributes.references: SAP MM EBELN (Purchase Order Number); Infor Lawson PO Module; GAAP

attributes.name: recall_notice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product recall event that triggered this requisition, when is_recall_related is True. Links supply replacement activity to FDA recall management records for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 806; The Joint Commission; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee (nurse, OR coordinator, department manager, or clinical staff member) who created and submitted the requisition. Used for accountability, approval routing, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM AFNAM (Requisitioner); HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: surgical_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) template used to auto-populate line items for a surgical procedure or standard care protocol. Supports standardized supply utilization and procedure cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP MM BOM; Infor Lawson; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: surgical_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surgical case or procedure for which this requisition was generated. Populated when requisition_type is 'surgical_case'. Links supply consumption to OR scheduling and BOM (Bill of Materials) for procedure costing.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; SAP MM; AHRMM Surgical Supply Standards

attributes.name: triggering_clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Supply requisitions often triggered BY clinical orders (e.g., surgical case order triggers OR supply pull, patient-specific implant order triggers procurement). Natural parent-child relationship for s

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active supply contract or group purchasing organization (GPO) agreement under which this requisition's items are procured. Ensures contract compliance and enables contract utilization reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Contract (EKKO); Infor Lawson Contract Management; AHRMM GPO Standards

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or contracted vendor for direct purchase fulfillments. Populated when fulfillment_method is 'direct_purchase' or 'consignment'. Links to the vendor master for contract pricing and performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Infor Lawson Vendor Master; OIG Excluded Parties List

attributes.name: actual_total_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost of all fulfilled line items on the requisition, updated upon fulfillment. May differ from estimated_total_cost due to substitutions, partial fulfillments, or price changes. Used for budget variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM; Infor Lawson; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the requisition within the approval workflow. Distinct from requisition_status, which tracks overall fulfillment lifecycle. Approval status specifically tracks the authorization decision by supply chain management or department leadership.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions Approval Workflow; SAP MM Release Strategy; OIG Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition was approved (or rejected) by the authorized approver. Used for cycle time analysis, SLA compliance, and procurement audit trails.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; OIG Compliance Guidelines; ISO 27001

attributes.name: budget_period
attributes.description: Fiscal budget period (year and quarter or month) to which this requisition's costs are allocated (e.g., '2024-Q3' or '2024-07'). Used for departmental budget tracking and financial close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Infor Lawson GL; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: clinical_justification
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the requester explaining the clinical or operational reason for the supply request. Required for non-routine or high-cost requisitions. Supports CDI and compliance review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Supply Chain Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; Infor Lawson Requisitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; Infor Lawson Requisitions

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this requisition (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency health systems and international procurement.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Specific physical delivery point within the facility where the requested supplies should be delivered (e.g., 'ICU 4N Med Room', 'OR Suite 3 Supply Closet', 'ED Trauma Bay'). More granular than department; used for last-mile storeroom delivery routing.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Delivery Address; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: estimated_total_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of all line items on the requisition at time of submission, based on material master standard costs or contract pricing. Used for budget pre-authorization and spend visibility. Not a calculated aggregate — sourced directly from the requisition system at submission time.
attributes.references: SAP MM; Infor Lawson; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: expiration_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether items on this requisition require lot/expiration date tracking at fulfillment. Applies to pharmaceuticals, biologics, sterile supplies, and reagents. Supports FIFO inventory management and recall readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (Pharmaceutical); The Joint Commission MM Standards; USP <797>; Infor Lawson Inventory

attributes.name: fulfilled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the requisition was fully fulfilled and materials were delivered to the requesting department. Used for cycle time measurement, SLA reporting, and supply chain performance analytics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; AHRMM Supply Chain KPIs

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the requisition will be fulfilled. Stock pull draws from central storeroom inventory; direct purchase triggers a purchase order to a vendor; consignment pulls from vendor-managed inventory on-site; loaner is for temporary implant or device use; transfer moves stock between facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock_pull|direct_purchase|consignment|loaner|transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; AHRMM Supply Chain Best Practices

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code used to classify the supply expense for financial reporting. Derived from the charge description master or material master. Supports revenue cycle and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Infor Lawson GL; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any items on this requisition are classified as hazardous materials (e.g., chemotherapy agents, radioactive materials, flammable chemicals). Triggers special handling, transport, and storage protocols per OSHA and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (Hazard Communication); FDA; DOT Hazmat Regulations; The Joint Commission EC Standards

attributes.name: is_capital_expense
attributes.description: Indicates whether any items on this requisition are classified as capital expenditures (equipment or assets above the capitalization threshold) rather than operating supply expenses. Triggers different approval and financial coding workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; GAAP; FASB ASC 360; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: is_par_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was automatically generated by a par-level replenishment trigger rather than manually submitted. True = system-generated par replenishment; False = manual ad hoc request. Supports par management analytics and storeroom automation reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions Par Management; SAP MM MRP; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_recall_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was generated in response to a product recall event, requiring replacement of recalled medical-surgical supplies or implantable devices. Supports FDA recall compliance tracking and patient safety reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 806 (Medical Device Recalls); The Joint Commission; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; Infor Lawson Requisitions

attributes.name: needed_by_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested materials must be available for clinical use. Drives fulfillment prioritization, vendor lead time calculations, and storeroom scheduling. Maps to SAP MM LFDAT (Delivery Date) and Lawson required date field.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM LFDAT; The Joint Commission Supply Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special handling requirements, or communication between the requester and supply chain staff. Examples include delivery location specifics, substitution preferences, or sterile processing instructions.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Text Fields; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the approver when a requisition is rejected. Supports process improvement, requester feedback, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; OIG Compliance

attributes.name: requester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who submitted the requisition. Retained for display and audit purposes. Classified as confidential as it identifies internal workforce members.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; HIPAA Workforce Provisions

attributes.name: requesting_department_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the clinical department or nursing unit that submitted the requisition (e.g., 'ICU 4 North', 'Operating Room 3', 'Emergency Department'). Retained for reporting and display without requiring a join.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable requisition identifier assigned by the source system (Infor Lawson or SAP MM). Used for cross-system tracking, communication with supply chain staff, and audit trail. Maps to Lawson RQ10 requisition number or SAP BANFN field.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions Module; SAP MM BANFN (Purchase Requisition Number)

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the requisition. Drives approval routing, fulfillment actions, and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|partially_fulfilled|fulfilled|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Purchase Requisition Status; The Joint Commission Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition by its origination method. Par replenishment is auto-triggered when stock falls below par level; ad hoc is a manual one-time request; surgical case is linked to an OR procedure BOM; direct purchase bypasses storeroom stock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: par_replenishment|ad_hoc|surgical_case|direct_purchase|emergency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Document Type; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this requisition record was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing. Values: Infor Lawson Requisitions module, SAP MM Purchase Requisitions, Epic OpTime (surgical case supply), or manual entry.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; Epic OpTime; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Natural key or internal identifier of this requisition record in the originating source system (e.g., Lawson RQ10 internal ID or SAP BANFN). Used for ETL reconciliation, deduplication, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM BANFN; ISO 27001; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: sterile_processing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether items on this requisition require sterile processing or reprocessing before delivery to the requesting department. Triggers coordination with the sterile processing department (SPD) and tracks instrument tray readiness.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission IC Standards; AAMI ST79 Sterilization Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition was formally submitted by the requesting department or unit. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for cycle time measurement and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; ISO 8601

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct line items (material/item requests) included in this requisition. Sourced directly from the requisition header record in Infor Lawson or SAP MM — not a derived aggregate. Used for complexity classification and processing time estimation.

attributes.name: udi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more items on this requisition are implantable devices or Class II/III medical devices requiring FDA Unique Device Identifier (UDI) tracking. Triggers UDI capture workflow at fulfillment and patient implant documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI); FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: urgency_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the requisition indicating how quickly the requested materials are needed. STAT (immediate clinical need), Urgent (same-day), or Routine (standard replenishment cycle). Drives fulfillment prioritization and storeroom workflow.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Priority; The Joint Commission Supply Standards

products.name: udi_record
products.description: Unique Device Identifier (UDI) tracking record for implantable devices and high-risk medical devices as required by FDA UDI regulations. Captures device identifier (DI), production identifier (PI), lot number, serial number, expiration date, manufacturer, device description, implant status, patient association, and recall status. Supports FDA 21 CFR Part 830 compliance and implant registry reporting.
products.reference: FDA UDI Database (GUDID) / 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: udi_record_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each UDI tracking record in the lakehouse silver layer. System-generated BIGINT for internal referencing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: UDI tracking deficiencies are common FDA and Joint Commission audit findings. Quality teams link UDI records to findings for evidence of remediation (missing scans, incomplete documentation) and corre

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, surgical center) where the device was received, stored, or implanted. Supports facility-level inventory and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; FDA 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: UDI tracking for implanted devices MUST link to the clinical order that authorized implantation. FDA regulatory requirement for device traceability, recall management, and adverse event reporting. Cri

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed clinician (surgeon or interventionalist) who performed the device implantation procedure. Required for implant registry reporting, credentialing verification, and provider-level quality analytics.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; CMS Implant Registry; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; NPI (National Provider Identifier)

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient in whom the device was implanted or used. Populated when the device has been associated with a specific patient encounter or implant event. Null for devices not yet implanted.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; HL7 FHIR Device Resource

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: Implantable devices tracked via UDI require HCPCS codes for billing and reimbursement. Mandatory for device registry reporting, charge capture validation, and payer claims submission—regulatory and re

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: UDI records track implanted devices that must link to supply master for: FDA recall management requiring device master data, warranty claim processing, cost capture for implant billing, inventory repl

attributes.name: message_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.message_log. Business justification: UDI records are transmitted via HL7/FHIR messages to implant registries, FDA MedWatch, and HIEs for care coordination. Tracks which interface message transmitted the device data for audit and reconcil

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: Implantable device tracking requires linking to the payer who covered the implant for warranty claims, recall remediation, and reimbursement disputes. Real business process: FDA MDR reporting, payer-s

attributes.name: primary_udi_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or manufacturer from whom the device was procured. Used for vendor performance tracking, recall management, and procurement analytics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: procedure_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surgical or procedural event record during which the device was implanted or used. Enables direct linkage between the UDI record and the clinical procedure documentation in the EHR.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; HL7 FHIR Procedure Resource; FDA 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter (e.g., surgical procedure, inpatient admission) during which the device was implanted or used. Links UDI record to the clinical event for traceability.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this UDI record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: The mandatory, fixed portion of the Unique Device Identifier (UDI) that identifies the labeler and the specific version or model of a device. Corresponds to the Device Identifier (DI) component of the FDA UDI system. Sourced from the FDA Global Unique Device Identification Database (GUDID).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA GUDID; HL7 FHIR Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the device should not be used, as labeled by the manufacturer. Critical for sterile device management, expiration tracking, and preventing use of expired devices. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; The Joint Commission (TJC) EC.02.04.01; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: explant_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously implanted device was surgically removed (explanted) from the patient. Populated when implant_status transitions to 'explanted'. Used for device lifecycle tracking and adverse event reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; FDA MedWatch; CMS Implant Registry Requirements

attributes.name: explant_reason
attributes.description: The clinical or administrative reason for device explantation. Used for adverse event reporting, quality improvement, and FDA MedWatch reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: device_failure|infection|patient_request|end_of_life|recall|revision|death|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch; FDA 21 CFR Part 803 (MDR); The Joint Commission (TJC); AHRQ

attributes.name: gmdn_code
attributes.description: The Global Medical Device Nomenclature (GMDN) code assigned to the device type, providing an internationally recognized classification for medical devices. Supports interoperability with international device registries.

attributes.name: implant_date
attributes.description: The date on which the device was surgically implanted into the patient. Populated when implant_status transitions to 'implanted'. Required for implant registry reporting and patient safety tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; CMS Implant Registry Requirements; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: implant_site
attributes.description: The anatomical location in the patient's body where the device was implanted (e.g., left hip, thoracic cavity, lumbar spine). Supports clinical documentation, implant registry reporting, and post-market surveillance.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms); HL7 FHIR Device.location; CMS Implant Registry

attributes.name: implant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the implantable device. Tracks whether the device is available in inventory, has been implanted in a patient, has been explanted (removed), wasted, recalled, or quarantined pending investigation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; HL7 FHIR Device.status; The Joint Commission (TJC); Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: implantable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device is classified as implantable per FDA UDI regulations. Implantable devices require mandatory UDI documentation at the point of care and patient-level tracking in the medical record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; FDA 21 CFR Part 801.45; HL7 FHIR Device.implantable

attributes.name: issuing_agency
attributes.description: The FDA-accredited issuing agency that assigned the UDI system used for this device. Valid values include GS1 (Global Standards One), HIBCC (Health Industry Business Communications Council), ICCBBA (International Council for Commonality in Blood Banking Automation), and IFA (Informationsstelle für Arzneispezialitäten).

attributes.name: laterality
attributes.description: The side of the body where the device was implanted (left, right, bilateral, or not applicable). Used for surgical documentation, implant registry reporting, and clinical analytics.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The current physical storage location code within the facility where the device is stored (e.g., OR supply room, cath lab, central sterile). Used for inventory management, par-level replenishment, and device retrieval.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; The Joint Commission (TJC) EC.02.04.01

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer-assigned lot or batch number for the device. Used for recall management, quality investigations, and traceability to the manufacturing batch. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation); Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which the device was manufactured, as labeled by the manufacturer. Used for shelf-life calculations, quality investigations, and traceability. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA GUDID; HL7 FHIR Device.manufactureDate

attributes.name: mdr_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse event or malfunction associated with this device has been determined to be reportable to the FDA under Medical Device Reporting (MDR) regulations. Triggers mandatory FDA MedWatch reporting workflow.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803 (Medical Device Reporting); FDA MedWatch; OIG

attributes.name: production_identifier
attributes.description: The conditional, variable portion of the UDI that identifies one or more of the following: lot/batch number, serial number, expiration date, manufacturing date, and distinct identification code. Corresponds to the Production Identifier (PI) component per FDA UDI regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA GUDID; HL7 FHIR Device.udiCarrier.carrierHRF

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: The FDA classification of the recall by severity: Class I (serious adverse health consequences or death), Class II (temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences), Class III (unlikely to cause adverse health consequences). Drives urgency of recall response.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.3; FDA Recall Database

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific device unit has been identified as subject to an active FDA recall, market withdrawal, or safety alert. True when the device's lot number or serial number matches an active recall notice.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 (Recall Policy); FDA MedWatch; The Joint Commission (TJC) RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: The FDA-assigned recall identification number associated with this device if it is subject to a recall. Used to cross-reference the FDA recall database and track recall remediation actions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA Recall Database; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: recall_remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of recall remediation actions taken for this device unit. Tracks whether the facility has been notified, the device has been returned to the manufacturer, replaced, destroyed, or if no action is required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC); OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: receiving_date
attributes.description: The date on which the device was received at the healthcare facility from the vendor or manufacturer. Marks the start of the facility's custody and responsibility for the device. Used for inventory aging and shelf-life calculations.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer-assigned serial number uniquely identifying an individual device unit within a lot. Required for implantable devices and high-risk devices. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 801.45; HL7 FHIR Device.serialNumber

attributes.name: single_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device is labeled as single-use only by the manufacturer. Single-use devices (SUDs) must not be reprocessed or reused unless compliant with FDA reprocessing regulations. Critical for patient safety and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 801.109; FDA Guidance on Reprocessing SUDs; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this UDI record was sourced. Used for data lineage, ETL (Extract Transform Load) audit, and reconciliation between supply chain and clinical systems.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this UDI record in the originating operational system (e.g., Infor Lawson item transaction ID, Epic OpTime implant record ID). Supports data lineage tracing and reconciliation with source systems.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; Epic OpTime; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: sterile_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device is labeled as sterile by the manufacturer. Sterile devices require specific storage conditions and handling protocols. Used by sterile processing and supply chain teams.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 880; ISO 11135; The Joint Commission (TJC) IC.02.02.01; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: The manufacturer-specified storage condition required to maintain device integrity and sterility. Used by supply chain and sterile processing teams to ensure proper storage and prevent device degradation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 11607; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; The Joint Commission (TJC) EC.02.04.01

attributes.name: udi_carrier_aidc
attributes.business_glossary_term: UDI Carrier Automatic Identification and Data Capture (AIDC)
attributes.description: The UDI as encoded in the Automatic Identification and Data Capture (AIDC) technology on the device label (e.g., barcode, RFID). Used for automated scanning during receiving, dispensing, and implant documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 801.20; GS1 Application Identifier Standards; HL7 FHIR Device.udiCarrier.carrierAIDC

attributes.name: udi_carrier_hrf
attributes.description: The full UDI string as it appears in human-readable form (HRF) on the device label, combining both the Device Identifier (DI) and Production Identifier (PI). Used for manual verification and label reconciliation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 801.20; HL7 FHIR Device.udiCarrier.carrierHRF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this UDI record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

products.name: surgical_bom
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) for surgical and procedural cases, defining the standard set of supplies, implants, instruments, and consumables required for each procedure type. Captures procedure code (CPT), service line, preference card reference, item list with standard quantities, substitution rules, and cost estimates. Enables OR supply preparation, case cart building, and procedure-level cost analysis.
products.reference: OR Preference Card / SAP MM BOM

attributes.name: surgical_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the surgical Bill of Materials (BOM) record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility (hospital or surgical center) where this BOM is applicable. Links to the facility master.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Surgical preference cards must align with clinical policies (formulary compliance, product standardization, evidence-based practice). Value analysis committees enforce policy compliance in BOM design

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Surgical preference cards and BOMs are inherently tied to specific CPT procedures. Enables procedure-specific supply cost benchmarking, case costing, and surgeon preference card management—core periop

attributes.name: preference_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surgeon or procedure preference card from which this BOM was derived or linked. Preference cards in Epic OpTime or Cerner SurgiNet define surgeon-specific supply preferences.

attributes.name: primary_surgical_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee (typically a clinical director, OR manager, or supply chain director) who approved this BOM for active use. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical service line (e.g., Orthopedics, Cardiovascular, General Surgery) to which this BOM belongs. Drives OR supply planning by specialty.

attributes.name: standardized_order_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_set. Business justification: Surgical preference cards (BOMs) often standardized as clinical order sets for procedure protocols. Links supply planning to clinical ordering workflow for efficiency and compliance. Real in periopera

attributes.name: tertiary_surgical_supply_chain_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supply chain or materials management staff member responsible for maintaining item availability, pricing, and substitution rules for this BOM.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: anesthesia_type
attributes.description: Standard anesthesia type associated with this procedure BOM. Drives anesthesia supply requirements and may influence BOM item composition for anesthesia-specific consumables.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this BOM was formally approved for clinical and operational use. Required for audit trail and version lifecycle management.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Clinical and supply chain approval status of this BOM. 'pending' awaits review; 'approved' is cleared for OR use; 'rejected' was not approved; 'expired' approval has lapsed and requires renewal.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: bom_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the surgical BOM, typically reflecting the procedure type and service line (e.g., 'Total Knee Arthroplasty — Orthopedics'). Used for display and search in OR management systems.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this surgical BOM. Used in OR scheduling, case cart building, and supply requisitions. Sourced from Infor Lawson or SAP MM.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surgical BOM. 'draft' indicates in development; 'active' is approved for use; 'under_review' is pending clinical or supply chain review; 'superseded' has been replaced by a newer version; 'retired' is no longer in use.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); Infor Lawson Supply Chain
