attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the BOM (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports versioning when supply lists are updated due to clinical preference changes, product substitutions, or cost reviews.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: case_cart_template_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is designated as the standard case cart template for the associated procedure type. Case cart templates drive automated pick lists in materials management systems.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA and HITRUST record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary cost estimates in this BOM (e.g., USD). Supports multi-facility and international health system cost reporting.

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: CMS Diagnosis-Related Group code associated with the procedure. Used for reimbursement benchmarking and procedure-level cost analysis against expected DRG payment.
attributes.references: CMS DRG Classification; IPPS; 3M Health Information Systems

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM version is approved and active for use in OR case cart preparation and supply requisitions.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: estimated_case_duration_min
attributes.description: Standard estimated duration of the surgical procedure in minutes. Used for OR scheduling, staffing planning, and supply consumption rate estimation.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: estimated_implant_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost attributable specifically to implantable devices within this BOM. Separated from general supply cost to support implant cost tracking, vendor negotiations, and UDI compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule; CMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: estimated_supply_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost of all supplies, implants, and consumables listed in this BOM at standard unit costs. Used for procedure-level cost analysis, budgeting, and value-based purchasing (VBP) initiatives.
attributes.references: CMS VBP; GAAP; FASB; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this BOM version is no longer valid for use. Null indicates the BOM is open-ended with no planned expiration. Supports version lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: implant_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM includes one or more implantable devices requiring UDI tracking and implant log documentation per FDA regulations. Triggers implant-specific workflows in the OR.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (supplies, implants, instruments, consumables) included in this BOM. Provides a quick summary metric for BOM complexity and case cart preparation effort.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date this BOM was most recently reviewed by clinical or supply chain staff for accuracy, item availability, and cost relevance. Supports periodic review compliance requirements.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; AORN Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for clinical or supply chain notes related to this BOM, such as special handling instructions, vendor-specific requirements, or known substitution constraints.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: or_room_type
attributes.description: Type of operating room or procedural suite required for this procedure. Determines room-specific supply requirements and equipment availability for BOM fulfillment.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: patient_position
attributes.description: Standard patient positioning required for this procedure (e.g., supine, prone, lateral decubitus, lithotomy). Determines positioning equipment and padding supplies included in the BOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: supine|prone|lateral_decubitus|lithotomy|trendelenburg|reverse_trendelenburg|sitting|jackknife — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AORN Guidelines; The Joint Commission (TJC); Epic OpTime

attributes.name: procedure_category
attributes.description: Clinical category grouping for the procedure (e.g., Orthopedic, Cardiovascular, Neurosurgery, General Surgery, Gynecology). Used for OR supply planning and service line reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: orthopedic|cardiovascular|neurosurgery|general_surgery|gynecology|urology|ophthalmology|plastics|thoracic|vascular — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS; The Joint Commission (TJC); AMA CPT Coding Standards

attributes.name: procedure_name
attributes.description: Internal clinical name of the surgical procedure as used within the facility's OR scheduling and EHR systems (e.g., 'Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy'). May differ slightly from the CPT description.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; SNOMED CT

attributes.name: recall_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any item in this BOM is currently subject to an active FDA recall or safety alert, requiring review before case cart preparation proceeds.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Regulations (21 CFR Part 7); CMS; OIG

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency in days at which this BOM must be reviewed and validated (e.g., 180 for semi-annual, 365 for annual). Drives compliance review scheduling.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; AORN Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system_bom_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this BOM record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic OpTime BOM ID, Infor Lawson BOM number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this BOM was sourced or is maintained (e.g., Epic OpTime, Cerner SurgiNet, Infor Lawson, SAP MM). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: sterile_processing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether instruments or reusable items in this BOM require sterile processing (decontamination, sterilization) prior to case use. Triggers sterile processing department (SPD) workflows.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); AAMI ST79; OSHA; CMS

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether item-level substitutions are permitted when a listed supply is unavailable. When true, substitution rules defined at the BOM line level may be applied during case cart building.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: HIPAA; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

products.name: case_cart
products.description: Operational record for each surgical case cart assembled by sterile processing and supply chain for a scheduled surgical procedure. Captures case cart number, linked surgical case, OR room, scheduled procedure date, assembly status, items picked vs. items requested, missing item flags, substitution actions, delivery confirmation, and return/waste reconciliation post-case. Bridges supply chain with surgical scheduling and sterile processing workflows.
products.reference: OR Case Cart / OpTime Supply Integration

attributes.name: case_cart_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each surgical case cart record in the supply chain system. Primary key for the case_cart data product.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hospital or surgical facility where the case cart is assembled and used.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary surgeon for the associated surgical case, used to link case cart supply usage to surgeon-level preference card accuracy and cost analytics.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; NPI Registry

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Surgical case carts are charged to OR cost centers for departmental supply cost tracking, case costing, and surgeon/procedure profitability analysis. Essential for OR financial management.

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Case carts are assembled for specific surgical procedures identified by CPT codes. Links actual supply usage to procedure codes for cost-per-case analysis, variance reporting, and reimbursement reconc

attributes.name: fulfilling_clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Case carts assembled to fulfill specific surgical orders (preference card execution). Direct operational link between supply preparation and clinical order for charge capture, waste tracking, and supp

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: Surgical case carts are assembled based on patient coverage - certain implants/supplies are only used if covered by patient's plan. Real business process: pre-surgical authorization verification and s

attributes.name: or_suite_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Operating Room (OR) to which this case cart is assigned for the scheduled surgical procedure.

attributes.name: primary_case_assembled_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sterile processing technician or supply chain staff member who assembled and picked the case cart items.
attributes.references: TJC Sterile Processing Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: recall_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.recall_notice. Business justification: case_cart has recall_flag. If a case cart is flagged for recall (item in cart is subject to active recall), it should link to the specific recall_notice for traceability and to enable notification wor

attributes.name: surgical_bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.surgical_bom. Business justification: case_cart has preference_card_id and bom_version attributes indicating it references a surgical BOM template. surgical_bom defines standard supply sets for procedures. This is N:1 (many case carts ref

attributes.name: surgical_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled surgical case for which this case cart was assembled. Links supply chain to surgical scheduling (OpTime/SurgiNet).

attributes.name: tertiary_case_delivered_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member who physically transported and delivered the case cart to the Operating Room (OR).
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Standards

attributes.name: assembly_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the case cart assembly was completed and verified by sterile processing staff.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: assembly_location
attributes.description: Name or code of the sterile processing department (SPD) or supply room where the case cart was assembled (e.g., Central Sterile Processing, Satellite SPD-North).
attributes.references: TJC Sterile Processing Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: assembly_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when sterile processing staff began physically assembling and picking items for this case cart.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: assembly_status
attributes.description: Granular status of the physical picking and assembly process within sterile processing, distinct from the overall cart lifecycle status.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: cart_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the physical case cart by sterile processing or supply chain. Used for barcode scanning and physical tracking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: cart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the case cart from initial request through assembly, delivery, use, and return. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|in_assembly|assembled|delivered|in_use|returned|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: case_cart_type
attributes.description: Classification of the case cart indicating whether it was assembled from a standard preference card, customized for a specific patient, added on during a procedure, or assembled for an emergency case.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this case cart record was first created in the supply chain system, representing the initial cart request.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this case cart record (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: delivery_confirmation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether delivery of the case cart to the Operating Room (OR) has been formally confirmed by OR staff, completing the chain of custody.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Standards

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the assembled case cart was physically delivered to the assigned Operating Room (OR) or holding area, confirmed by delivery staff.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: expiration_check_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all items on the case cart have been verified for expiration date compliance prior to delivery. False indicates expiration verification is incomplete.
attributes.references: TJC Sterile Processing Standards; FDA — Drugs and Devices; AHRQ

attributes.name: implant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this case cart contains one or more implantable devices subject to Unique Device Identifier (UDI) tracking requirements under FDA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); TJC Implant Tracking Standards

attributes.name: items_picked_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items actually picked and placed on the case cart during assembly. Compared against items_requested_count to identify shortages.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: items_requested_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items requested on the case cart pick list per the surgeon preference card or BOM (Bill of Materials).
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: items_returned_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct item lines returned to supply chain or sterile processing after the surgical procedure, used for post-case reconciliation and restocking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: items_wasted_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct item lines disposed of as waste post-procedure (opened but unused, contaminated, or expired during the case), used for waste tracking and cost analysis.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; OSHA; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: missing_item_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct line items that were requested but could not be fulfilled during case cart assembly, providing granularity beyond the binary missing_item_flag.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; AHRQ Patient Safety Standards

attributes.name: missing_item_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more requested items could not be picked and are missing from the assembled case cart. True signals a potential patient safety or surgical delay risk.
attributes.references: AHRQ Patient Safety Standards; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for sterile processing or supply chain staff to document special instructions, exceptions, substitution rationale, or other relevant information about this case cart.
attributes.references: TJC Sterile Processing Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: or_room_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the Operating Room (OR) assigned to this case cart (e.g., OR-7, Main OR Suite 3).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to this case cart assembly request, reflecting the urgency of the associated surgical procedure (e.g., elective routine vs. emergent trauma).

attributes.name: procedure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the surgical procedure for which this case cart is assembled (e.g., orthopedic, cardiac, general surgery, neurosurgery). Drives item selection and BOM (Bill of Materials) requirements.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any item on this case cart is subject to an active product recall. Triggers immediate hold and substitution workflows per recall management protocols.
attributes.references: FDA — Drugs and Devices; OIG Fraud and Abuse; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: return_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the case cart was returned to sterile processing or supply chain after the surgical procedure concluded, initiating post-case reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; TJC Sterile Processing Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_procedure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the surgical procedure linked to this case cart is scheduled to occur. Used for assembly lead-time planning and par-level replenishment.
attributes.references: Epic Cadence; Cerner SurgiNet; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: scheduled_procedure_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time the surgical procedure is scheduled to begin, used for delivery timing and sterile processing workflow sequencing.

attributes.name: sterility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sterility of all applicable items on the case cart has been confirmed by sterile processing staff prior to delivery to the OR.
attributes.references: TJC Sterile Processing Standards; AHRQ; OSHA

attributes.name: substitution_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct item substitutions made during case cart assembly, used for supply chain performance analysis and preference card accuracy tracking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more items on the case cart were substituted with an equivalent alternative due to stockout, recall, or expiration of the originally requested item.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; FDA — Drugs and Devices; TJC Standards

attributes.name: total_supply_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of all supplies included in the case cart based on item unit costs at time of assembly. Used for surgical case costing, DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) profitability analysis, and RCM (Revenue Cycle Management).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; CMS DRG; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: udi_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Unique Device Identifier (UDI) documentation is required for one or more items on this case cart, triggering mandatory UDI capture workflows per FDA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this case cart record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: waste_cost
attributes.description: Total supply cost of items wasted or disposed of post-procedure, calculated from item unit costs. Used for supply chain cost management and surgical service line analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; GAAP and FASB

products.name: sterile_processing_record
products.description: Record of sterilization and reprocessing activities for reusable surgical instrument sets, trays, and medical devices managed by the Sterile Processing Department (SPD). Captures instrument set identity (set name, code, instrument count), sterilization method (steam, ETO, hydrogen peroxide), cycle parameters, biological indicator results, load number, technician, sterilization date, expiration date, release status, tray weight, decontamination protocol, and current lifecycle status. Supports instrument set tracking through the full cycle: OR use → decontamination → assembly → sterilization → storage. Compliant with Joint Commission and AAMI sterilization standards.
products.reference: SPD Sterilization Record / AAMI ST79

attributes.name: sterile_processing_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each sterile processing and reprocessing record within the Sterile Processing Department (SPD). Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission EC.02.04.01

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility (hospital, surgical center) where the sterile processing activity was performed.

attributes.name: case_cart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.case_cart. Business justification: Sterile processing records prepare instrument sets for specific surgical cases. case_cart is the operational record for case supply assembly. Linking sterile_processing_record to case_cart provides tr

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Sterilized instrument sets prepared for specific scheduled surgical orders. Links sterile processing workflow to clinical order for OR readiness, quality assurance, and turnaround time tracking.

attributes.name: cms_condition_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.cms_condition_status. Business justification: Sterile processing is a CMS Condition of Participation (Infection Prevention and Control). Hospitals track SPD records against CoP status for survey readiness, deficiency remediation, and certificatio

attributes.name: equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific sterilizer unit (autoclave, ETO chamber, hydrogen peroxide sterilizer) used for this cycle. Enables equipment-level traceability and maintenance correlation.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 10, The Joint Commission EC.02.04.01

attributes.name: primary_sterile_technician_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SPD technician who performed or supervised the sterilization cycle for this record. Used for accountability and traceability per Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission HR.01.02.01, AAMI ST79

attributes.name: recall_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.recall_notice. Business justification: sterile_processing_record has recall_flag and recall_reason. If an instrument set or sterilization consumable is recalled, the record should link to recall_notice for full context. recall_reason detai

attributes.name: surgical_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surgical case or OR procedure for which this instrument set was processed and dispatched. Enables traceability from sterilization record back to the clinical procedure.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission RC.02.01.01, AAMI ST79

attributes.name: assembly_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the instrument set was assembled and inspected prior to packaging and sterilization. Supports full lifecycle tracking from decontamination through sterilization.

attributes.name: biological_indicator_lot
attributes.description: Lot number of the biological indicator product used in this sterilization cycle. Required for traceability and documentation per AAMI and Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: biological_indicator_result
attributes.description: Result of the biological indicator (BI) spore test used to verify sterilization efficacy. A 'pass' (negative growth) confirms sterilization; 'fail' (positive growth) triggers load recall. 'not_required' applies to cycles exempt from BI testing per protocol.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 10, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01, CDC Sterilization Guidelines

attributes.name: bowie_dick_result
attributes.description: Result of the Bowie-Dick (air removal) test performed on pre-vacuum steam sterilizers to verify adequate air removal and steam penetration. Required daily before first processed load on pre-vacuum sterilizers.

attributes.name: chemical_indicator_result
attributes.description: Result of the chemical indicator (CI) used to monitor sterilization process parameters. Chemical indicators provide immediate visual confirmation that sterilization conditions were met, complementing biological indicator testing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sterile processing record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164, ISO 27001, HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential cycle number assigned by the sterilizer unit for the specific run. Combined with sterilizer_id and sterilization_date, provides a unique reference for the physical sterilization event.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: The specific cycle program used within the sterilization method (e.g., gravity displacement, pre-vacuum/dynamic air removal, flash/immediate-use steam sterilization (IUSS), low-temperature). Determines exposure time and temperature parameters.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, CDC Guidelines for Disinfection and Sterilization

attributes.name: decontamination_method
attributes.description: The decontamination protocol applied to the instrument set prior to sterilization (e.g., manual wash, automated washer-disinfector, ultrasonic cleaner). Documents the cleaning phase of the reprocessing cycle.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 7, AAMI TIR30, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: decontamination_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the decontamination (cleaning) phase was completed for the instrument set. Establishes the start of the clean/sterile processing workflow.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the sterility of the instrument set can no longer be guaranteed and the set must be reprocessed before use. Determined by packaging type, storage conditions, and facility policy per AAMI event-related sterility guidelines.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 11, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: exposure_temperature_c
attributes.description: The sterilization chamber temperature in degrees Celsius recorded during the exposure phase of the cycle. Validated against cycle type parameters to confirm sterilization efficacy.

attributes.name: exposure_time_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes of the sterilization exposure phase for this cycle. Must meet minimum exposure time requirements per sterilization method and cycle type.

attributes.name: immediate_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sterilization cycle was performed as Immediate Use Steam Sterilization (IUSS / flash sterilization) for an urgent clinical need. IUSS is subject to additional documentation and justification requirements per Joint Commission and AAMI standards.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 10.7, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01, CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting findings from the instrument set inspection, including specific instruments flagged for damage, missing items, or functional defects identified during assembly.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Result of the visual and functional inspection performed during assembly to verify instrument cleanliness, integrity, and functionality. 'fail' or 'conditional' results require instrument removal or repair before sterilization.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 8, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: instrument_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual instruments included in the set or tray at the time of assembly and sterilization. Used to verify completeness against the Bill of Materials (BOM) for the set.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 8, The Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: iuss_justification
attributes.description: Clinical justification documented for performing Immediate Use Steam Sterilization (IUSS). Required by The Joint Commission when IUSS is used; must document the reason the set could not be processed through standard sterilization workflow.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 10.7, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage of the instrument set in its full reprocessing lifecycle: OR use → decontamination → assembly → sterilization → storage → dispatched. Enables real-time tracking of set location and readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_use|decontamination|assembly|sterilization|storage|dispatched|expired|recalled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission EC.02.04.01

attributes.name: load_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a specific sterilizer load or batch. Used to trace all items processed together in a single sterilization cycle. Critical for recall management and lot traceability.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 10, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging used to wrap or contain the instrument set for sterilization and sterile storage. Packaging type affects sterility maintenance duration and event-related sterility shelf life.

attributes.name: pressure_psi
attributes.description: Chamber pressure in pounds per square inch (PSI) recorded during the sterilization cycle. Applicable primarily to steam sterilization; used to validate cycle parameters.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sterilization record has been reviewed and approved by a quality assurance supervisor or SPD lead as part of the facility's quality management program.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission QSA.01.01.01, AAMI ST79, ISO 13485

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sterilization load has been subject to a recall event due to failed biological indicator, sterilizer malfunction, or packaging compromise. True triggers notification and retrieval of all items in the load.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01, FDA 21 CFR Part 806

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Current release status of the instrument set following sterilization. 'released' indicates the set is cleared for clinical use; 'quarantined' holds the set pending biological indicator results; 'recalled' indicates a load recall event; 'rejected' indicates failed cycle parameters.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01, FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: reprocessing_cycle_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this instrument set has been reprocessed (sterilized) over its lifetime. Used to monitor instrument set wear, compliance with manufacturer reprocessing limits, and maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, FDA UDI Rule, Manufacturer IFU (Instructions for Use)

attributes.name: set_code
attributes.description: Facility-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the instrument set type within the CDM (Charge Description Master) or supply catalog. Used for inventory and billing alignment.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: set_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the surgical instrument set or tray (e.g., 'Basic Laparoscopy Set', 'Orthopedic Hip Tray'). Used for identification and workflow routing in the SPD.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this sterilization record was sourced (e.g., Infor Lawson Supply Chain, SAP MM, Cerner SurgiNet, Epic OpTime, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.

attributes.name: sterilization_method
attributes.description: The sterilization modality applied to the instrument set. Common methods include steam (autoclave), ethylene oxide (ETO), hydrogen peroxide (plasma), dry heat, peracetic acid (Steris), and radiation. Governs cycle parameters and biological indicator requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam|ethylene_oxide|hydrogen_peroxide|dry_heat|peracetic_acid|radiation|formaldehyde — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, AAMI TIR34, FDA 21 CFR Part 880, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: sterilization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sterilization cycle was initiated or completed for this load. The principal business event timestamp for this record. Used for expiration date calculation and traceability.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79, The Joint Commission IC.02.02.01

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the sterilized instrument set is stored after release (e.g., sterile core room, OR storage cabinet, SPD shelf designation). Used for inventory management and retrieval.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 11, The Joint Commission EC.02.06.01

attributes.name: tray_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the assembled instrument tray in kilograms at the time of sterilization. Used to verify compliance with maximum tray weight limits per AAMI guidelines (typically ≤ 25 lbs / 11.3 kg) to ensure steam penetration.
attributes.references: AAMI ST79 Section 8.3, The Joint Commission

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sterile processing record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data loading in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164, ISO 27001, HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: washer_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or cycle number assigned by the automated washer-disinfector used during the decontamination phase. Enables traceability of the cleaning cycle for quality and compliance audits.

products.name: recall_notice
products.description: Record of FDA and manufacturer-initiated product recalls, safety alerts, and field corrections affecting medical supplies, devices, and implants held in inventory or already used on patients. Captures recall number, FDA recall class (I, II, III), affected UDI or lot range, recall reason, affected quantity on hand, patient impact assessment status, vendor notification date, and remediation action. Supports FDA MedWatch and patient safety notification workflows.
products.reference: FDA MedWatch / FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: recall_notice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recall notice record in the healthcare supply chain system. Primary key for the recall_notice data product.

attributes.name: assigned_to_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain or materials management employee responsible for managing the recall response, including inventory assessment, quarantine, patient impact review, and remediation coordination.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Core HR; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility where the recalled product is held in inventory or was used on patients. Supports facility-level patient impact assessment and remediation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — Facility Standards; FDA MedWatch

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action_plan. Business justification: Product recalls require formal corrective action plans for FDA and accreditation compliance (quarantine, patient notification, vendor remediation). Supply chain and quality teams link recalls to CAPs

attributes.name: fda_recall_event_id
attributes.description: FDA-assigned recall event identifier from the FDA Enforcement Report or CDRH recall database. Enables direct cross-referencing with the FDA public recall database for regulatory compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FDA Enforcement Report; FDA CDRH Recall Database; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain item master record for the recalled product, medical device, or implant. Links to the item catalog for inventory impact assessment.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Item Master; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: message_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.message_log. Business justification: Recall notifications are transmitted to trading partners, HIEs, and public health agencies via HL7 messages. Tracks outbound recall notification transmissions for regulatory compliance and patient saf

attributes.name: notified_payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: Payers require notification of recalls affecting their members for risk management and potential claims review. Real business process: regulatory reporting to payers for implantable device recalls, co

attributes.name: public_health_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.public_health_report. Business justification: FDA MedWatch reporting and public health surveillance require recall data submission. Links recalls to their regulatory report submissions for compliance tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or manufacturer who issued or is subject to the recall. Used to link recall notices to vendor master records for notification and remediation tracking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Vendor Master; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: affected_lot_number_range
attributes.description: Lot number or range of lot numbers affected by the recall as specified in the recall notice. Used to identify specific inventory batches and patient implant records that require assessment. May be a single lot, a range (e.g., LOT001-LOT050), or a pattern.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA MedWatch; ISO 15223-1 — Medical Device Symbols

attributes.name: affected_serial_number_range
attributes.description: Serial number or range of serial numbers affected by the recall as specified in the recall notice. Applicable for serialized devices and implants. Complements lot number range for precise device identification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830 — UDI System; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recall notice record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and recall response timeline tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 — Audit Controls; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of financial credit or reimbursement expected or received from the vendor for recalled products returned or destroyed. Expressed in USD. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and financial impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Accounts Payable; GAAP — ASC 330 Inventory; FASB Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date_range_end
attributes.description: End of the expiration date range for products affected by the recall. Used with expiration_date_range_start to bound the affected expiration window for inventory identification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Medication and Supply Expiration Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date_range_start
attributes.description: Start of the expiration date range for products affected by the recall. Supports identification of recalled items in inventory by expiration date when lot numbers are not available.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Medication and Supply Expiration Standards

attributes.name: fda_notice_date
attributes.description: Date the FDA publicly issued or posted the recall notice in the FDA Enforcement Report or MedWatch system. Used to track regulatory publication timelines and ensure timely organizational response.
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch; FDA Enforcement Report; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: financial_credit_expected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the healthcare organization expects a financial credit or replacement from the vendor for returned or destroyed recalled products. Triggers accounts payable and procurement follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Accounts Payable; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement; GAAP — ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: health_hazard_assessment
attributes.description: FDA or manufacturer health hazard evaluation narrative describing the potential clinical consequences of using the recalled product. Informs clinical decision-making and patient notification priority. Sourced from the official recall notice.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.41 — Health Hazard Evaluation; FDA MedWatch

attributes.name: implantable_device_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recalled product is an implantable medical device subject to UDI tracking and mandatory patient implant registry requirements. Triggers enhanced patient impact assessment and long-term follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830 — UDI System; FDA GUDID; 21st Century Cures Act — Implant Registry

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for supply chain staff to document internal observations, escalation notes, communication logs, or special handling instructions related to the recall response. Not transmitted externally.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — EC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: internal_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the healthcare organization's supply chain or materials management team internally received and logged the recall notice. Marks the start of the internal response workflow and is distinct from the vendor notification date.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) — EC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: manufacture_date_range_end
attributes.description: End of the manufacture date range for products affected by the recall. Used with manufacture_date_range_start to bound the affected production window for inventory and implant identification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA MedWatch Recall Notice Fields

attributes.name: manufacture_date_range_start
attributes.description: Start of the manufacture date range for products affected by the recall. Used in conjunction with manufacture_date_range_end to identify inventory and implanted devices by production date when lot/serial numbers are unavailable.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA MedWatch Recall Notice Fields

attributes.name: patient_impact_assessment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the clinical review to determine whether any patients received or were implanted with the recalled product. Drives patient notification workflows and adverse event reporting. Required for Class I and Class II recalls.
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Patient Safety Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; AHRQ Patient Safety

attributes.name: patient_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which affected patients were notified of the recall and any required clinical follow-up actions. Null if patient notification is not required or not yet completed. Required for regulatory audit documentation.
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch; The Joint Commission (TJC) — RI.01.02.01; HIPAA Privacy Rule — 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: patient_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether affected patients must be notified of the recall per FDA guidance, clinical risk assessment, or organizational policy. True for Class I recalls and high-risk Class II recalls involving implanted devices.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC) — RI.01.02.01; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: patients_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of patients identified as having received, been implanted with, or otherwise exposed to the recalled product. Populated upon completion of the patient impact assessment. Drives patient notification and clinical follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Patient Safety Standards; AHRQ Patient Safety Taxonomy

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Manufacturer or FDA product code identifying the specific product line or model subject to recall. Used for cross-referencing with the item master and FDA product classification database.
attributes.references: FDA Product Classification Database; FDA 21 CFR Part 807

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial or trade name of the recalled medical supply, device, implant, or pharmaceutical product as stated in the recall notice. Provides human-readable identification for clinical and supply chain staff.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA Device Registration and Listing

attributes.name: quantity_destroyed
attributes.description: Number of units of the recalled product that have been destroyed or disposed of on-site per recall instructions. Required for regulatory documentation when return to vendor is not feasible.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; EPA Waste Disposal Regulations; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand_affected
attributes.description: Total quantity of the recalled product currently held in the facility's inventory that falls within the affected lot, serial, or date range. Used to assess inventory exposure and plan quarantine and return logistics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: quantity_quarantined
attributes.description: Number of units of the recalled product that have been physically quarantined or placed on hold in inventory pending disposition. Tracks remediation progress against the total affected quantity on hand.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Inventory Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) — EC.02.01.01

attributes.name: quantity_returned_to_vendor
attributes.description: Number of units of the recalled product that have been returned to the vendor or manufacturer as part of the recall remediation process. Supports return merchandise authorization (RMA) tracking and financial credit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement; SAP S/4HANA MM; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: FDA-defined classification indicating the severity of health risk posed by the recalled product. Class I: serious adverse health consequences or death; Class II: temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences; Class III: unlikely to cause adverse health consequences.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.3(m) — Recall Classification; FDA MedWatch

attributes.name: recall_initiation_source
attributes.description: Identifies who initiated the recall action. Distinguishes between FDA-mandated recalls, voluntary manufacturer recalls, distributor-initiated recalls, Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) alerts, and state health department notifications.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 — Recall Procedures; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Official FDA-assigned or manufacturer-assigned recall identification number. Used as the primary external reference for cross-referencing with FDA MedWatch, regulatory databases, and vendor communications. Example: Z-1234-2024.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.59 — Recall Number Assignment; FDA MedWatch

attributes.name: recall_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the root cause or reason for the recall (e.g., sterility failure, labeling error, device malfunction, contamination, software defect). Aligns with FDA recall reason classification codes for regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Sterility Failure|Labeling Error|Device Malfunction|Contamination|Software Defect|Packaging Defect|Material Defect|Design Defect|Manufacturing Defect|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA Recall Reason Classification; AHRQ Patient Safety Taxonomy

attributes.name: recall_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the reason for the recall as stated in the official recall notice. Provides clinical and supply chain staff with the full context of the safety concern, defect, or hazard identified.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA MedWatch; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recall notice within the healthcare organization. Tracks progression from initial receipt through assessment, remediation, and closure. Supports regulatory reporting and patient safety workflows.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 — Recall Procedures; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Patient Safety Standards

attributes.name: recall_type
attributes.description: Category of the recall action. Distinguishes between mandatory FDA recalls, voluntary market withdrawals, safety alerts, field corrections (in-place remediation), and hazard alerts issued by the manufacturer or FDA.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 — Recall Procedures; FDA MedWatch

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory report was submitted to the FDA, CMS, or other applicable governing body. Null if not yet submitted. Required for compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch 3500A; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory report (e.g., FDA MedWatch 3500A, CMS adverse event report) has been submitted to the applicable governing body. Required for Class I and Class II recalls and adverse event reporting compliance.
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch 3500A; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC) — Sentinel Event Reporting

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Prescribed or completed remediation action for the recalled product as directed by the FDA or manufacturer recall notice. Determines the disposition workflow for affected inventory and guides supply chain response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Return to Vendor|Destroy On-Site|Relabel|Repair|Replace|Quarantine Pending|No Action Required — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Inventory Disposition; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required remediation actions (quarantine, return, destruction, replacement) were completed for this recall notice. Marks the operational closure of the recall response and is required for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; The Joint Commission (TJC) — EC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the healthcare organization must complete its recall response, including inventory quarantine, patient impact assessment, and remediation actions. Typically defined by FDA guidance or internal policy based on recall class.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: source_document
attributes.description: Reference to the original recall notice document, such as an FDA Enforcement Report URL, manufacturer letter reference number, or document management system identifier. Provides traceability to the authoritative source of the recall.
attributes.references: FDA Enforcement Report; FDA MedWatch; ISO 27001 — Document Control

attributes.name: udi_device_identifier
attributes.description: The fixed portion of the Unique Device Identifier (UDI) that identifies the specific version or model of the recalled medical device. Conforms to FDA UDI system requirements for implantable and high-risk device tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830 — UDI System; FDA GUDID Database; IMDRF UDI Guidance

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the recalled product quantities (e.g., EA=Each, BX=Box, CS=Case, PK=Pack, VL=Vial, KT=Kit). Ensures consistent quantity reporting across inventory, quarantine, return, and destruction counts.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Item Master; SAP S/4HANA MM; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recall notice record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to recall status, quantities, assessment results, or remediation actions. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 — Audit Controls; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: vendor_notification_date

products.name: location_audit
products.description: This association product represents the Event of a compliance audit being conducted at a specific inventory location. It captures the audit findings, compliance scores, and follow-up requirements for each location-audit combination. Each record links one inventory location to one audit with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit event at this specific location.. Existence Justification: In healthcare compliance operations, a single audit (e.g., Joint Commission survey, OSHA inspection) routinely covers multiple inventory locations across a facility, examining controlled substance storage, temperature monitoring, sterile processing areas, and hazardous material storage. Conversely, each inventory location is subject to multiple audits over time (annual HIPAA audits, quarterly controlled substance audits, infection control surveys). The business actively manages audit findings, compliance scores, and corrective action plans at the location-audit level.

products.name: material_policy_governance
products.description: This association product represents the governance relationship between supply items and organizational policies. It captures which policies govern which materials, tracking compliance status, exceptions, and review cycles. Each record links one material master to one policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this governance relationship.. Existence Justification: Healthcare organizations actively manage which organizational policies govern which supply items through formal governance processes. A single high-cost implantable device may be governed by multiple policies simultaneously (formulary approval policy, preference card standardization policy, value analysis policy, vendor contract policy), and a single formulary policy governs hundreds or thousands of supply items. The compliance department tracks compliance status, exceptions, and review cycles for each material-policy pairing as part of regulatory and operational governance.
