attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Date the care site began operations and started accepting patients. Used for historical trending, market entry analysis, and anniversary planning.

attributes.name: hierarchy_effective_date
attributes.description: Date the current organizational hierarchy relationship became effective. Supports time-variant hierarchy reporting for mergers, acquisitions, and reorganizations.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Position of this care site within the IDN organizational hierarchy. Supports multi-level reporting, cost allocation, and governance structure representation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this care site record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and downstream system synchronization.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the care site in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, service area mapping, and distance-based referral routing.

attributes.name: license_effective_date
attributes.description: Date the current facility license became effective. Used to track license renewal cycles and ensure continuous compliance.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the current facility license expires. Triggers renewal workflows and compliance monitoring to prevent operational disruption.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: State-issued facility license number. Required for legal operation and must be displayed publicly per state regulations.

attributes.name: licensed_bed_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of inpatient beds the facility is licensed to operate by the state health department. Determines staffing requirements, certificate of need compliance, and CMS cost report bed counts.

attributes.name: licensure_status
attributes.description: Current state of the facility license issued by the state health department. Active status is required for legal operation and Medicare/Medicaid participation.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the care site in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, service area mapping, and distance-based referral routing.

attributes.name: medicaid_provider_number
attributes.description: State-specific Medicaid provider identification number. Required for Medicaid claims submission and varies by state Medicaid program.

attributes.name: medicare_provider_number
attributes.description: Legacy Medicare provider identification number, now replaced by CCN but still used in some legacy systems and historical reporting.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the care site. Active status indicates the site is open and accepting patients. Used for capacity planning, referral routing, and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the care site. Determines tax status, regulatory oversight, and eligibility for certain federal programs and grants.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the care site. Used for patient inquiries, referral coordination, and emergency contact.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code for the care site location. Used for geographic market segmentation, service area mapping, and population health analytics.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the care delivery location as registered with state licensing authorities and used in patient-facing communications.

attributes.name: site_npi
attributes.description: Type 2 NPI assigned to the organizational care site by CMS for billing and identification purposes. Required for Medicare/Medicaid claims submission.
attributes.references: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES)

attributes.name: sole_community_hospital
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is designated as a Sole Community Hospital, providing enhanced Medicare reimbursement for rural hospitals that are the sole source of care in their area.

attributes.name: staffed_bed_capacity
attributes.description: Number of beds currently staffed and available for patient occupancy. May be less than licensed capacity due to staffing constraints or seasonal demand patterns.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory postal abbreviation. Determines applicable state licensing board, Medicaid program, and health department jurisdiction.

attributes.name: teaching_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is a teaching hospital with approved residency programs. Teaching status affects CMS reimbursement through Graduate Medical Education (GME) payments and indirect medical education (IME) adjustments.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the care site location. Used for scheduling, appointment coordination, and timestamp normalization across multi-site IDN operations.

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: American College of Surgeons trauma center verification level. Indicates capability to provide comprehensive trauma care and determines EMS transport protocols.
attributes.references: American College of Surgeons Committee on Trauma

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public-facing website URL for the care site. Provides patient access to services information, provider directories, and online scheduling.

products.name: building
products.description: Physical building or structure associated with a care site. Tracks building name, code, address, construction year, square footage, number of floors, building type (clinical, administrative, research, parking), fire safety classification, seismic zone, HVAC system type, electrical capacity, emergency generator coverage, and current operational status. Supports facilities management, capital planning, and environmental services operations.
products.reference: SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the building. Primary key.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the care site or facility that owns or operates this building.

attributes.name: property_tax_parcel_geographic_region_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Property Tax Parcel Geographic Region Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.geographic_region. Business justification: Property parcels must be classified by geographic region for HSA/HRR assignment, regional health planning, certificate of need applications, and CMS geographic adjustment factors. Essential for facili

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building meets Americans with Disabilities Act accessibility requirements including ramps, elevators, restrooms, and signage.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the building including street number and name. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or building designation. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: annual_property_tax_amount
attributes.description: Annual property tax liability for the building in US dollars. Used for budgeting and financial planning.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the building for internal identification and facility management systems. Used in SAP PM and facility operations.

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Official name of the building as recognized by the organization and used in signage, wayfinding, and facility documentation.

attributes.name: building_type
attributes.description: Primary functional classification of the building indicating its predominant use within the healthcare delivery network.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the building is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number
attributes.description: CMS-issued certification number (CCN) authorizing participation in Medicare and Medicaid programs. Required for federal reimbursement.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year the building was originally constructed. Used for capital planning, depreciation calculations, and facility lifecycle management.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the building is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this building record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the building record became active in the system or when the building was placed into service.

attributes.name: electrical_service_capacity_kva
attributes.description: Total electrical service capacity of the building measured in kilovolt-amperes. Used for load planning, equipment installation approval, and utility management.

attributes.name: emergency_generator_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Total capacity of emergency backup generator systems in kilowatts. Critical for life safety systems, operating rooms, intensive care units, and emergency departments.

attributes.name: emergency_generator_coverage_type
attributes.description: Scope of building systems and areas covered by emergency generator backup power. Determines operational resilience during utility outages.

attributes.name: facility_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the state facility license. Tracked for renewal planning and regulatory compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: facility_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued license number authorizing operation of healthcare services within the building. Required for regulatory compliance and reimbursement.

attributes.name: fire_safety_classification
attributes.description: Building construction type classification based on fire resistance ratings and combustibility of structural elements per International Building Code.

attributes.name: gross_square_footage
attributes.description: Total interior floor area of the building measured in square feet, including all floors and spaces. Used for space utilization analysis and facility cost allocation.

attributes.name: helipad_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building has a rooftop or ground-level helipad for emergency medical transport. Critical for trauma centers and tertiary care facilities.

attributes.name: hvac_system_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) System Type
attributes.description: Primary type of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system serving the building. Critical for infection control, environmental services, and energy management.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Property and casualty insurance policy number covering the building. Used for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: joint_commission_accreditation_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of The Joint Commission accreditation. Tracked for survey preparation and continuous compliance.

attributes.name: joint_commission_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status from The Joint Commission indicating compliance with national healthcare quality and safety standards.

attributes.name: last_major_renovation_year
attributes.description: Year of the most recent major renovation or significant capital improvement project affecting the building structure or systems.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this building record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the building in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, emergency response, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: leed_certification_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Level
attributes.description: Level of LEED green building certification achieved by the building. Indicates sustainability performance and environmental design standards.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the building in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, emergency response, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: medical_gas_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building has a medical gas distribution system for oxygen, medical air, nitrous oxide, and vacuum services. Required for clinical buildings.

attributes.name: net_usable_square_footage
attributes.description: Usable interior floor area excluding mechanical spaces, circulation, and structural elements. Used for space planning and departmental allocation.

attributes.name: number_of_elevators
attributes.description: Total count of passenger and service elevators installed in the building. Used for vertical transportation capacity planning and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: number_of_floors
attributes.description: Total count of floors in the building including basement and sub-basement levels. Used for elevator planning, emergency evacuation, and vertical transportation analysis.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the building indicating whether it is in service, under construction, renovation, or decommissioned.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership or control arrangement for the building. Impacts financial reporting, capital planning, and operational decision-making.

attributes.name: parking_spaces_count
attributes.description: Total number of parking spaces associated with or adjacent to the building. Used for access planning, patient experience, and workforce management.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the building location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: property_tax_parcel_number
attributes.description: Local government assessor parcel number used for property tax assessment and real estate records.

attributes.name: replacement_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost to replace the building at current construction prices. Used for insurance coverage determination and capital planning.

attributes.name: seismic_zone
attributes.description: Seismic design category or zone classification indicating the level of earthquake risk and required structural design standards for the building location.

attributes.name: sprinkler_system_type
attributes.description: Type of automatic fire sprinkler system installed in the building. Critical for fire safety compliance and insurance underwriting.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the building is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the building was decommissioned, sold, or otherwise removed from active service. Null for active buildings.

products.name: unit
products.description: Clinical or administrative unit within a building, such as ICU, ED, OR suite, NICU, med-surg floor, radiology department, pharmacy, or administrative wing. Captures unit name, unit code, unit type (inpatient, outpatient, procedural, diagnostic, administrative), specialty service line, licensed bed count, staffed bed count, isolation room count, negative pressure room count, unit manager, and operational hours. Supports ADT workflows, bed management, and staffing.
products.reference: Epic ADT Department, HL7 FHIR Location

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical or administrative unit within the healthcare facility. Primary key.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility or building where this unit is located. Links to the facility master data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: manager_clinician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.clinician. Business justification: Unit management accountability requires linking the manager to their clinician record for credentialing verification, privileging status, and regulatory reporting. Hospitals must track which credentia

attributes.name: accepts_admissions
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is currently accepting new patient admissions. False when the unit is at capacity, under diversion, or temporarily closed to new admissions.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ADT Bed Management, HL7 ADT A01 Message

attributes.name: accepts_transfers
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is currently accepting patient transfers from other units or facilities. Used in bed management and patient flow coordination.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ADT Bed Management, HL7 ADT A02 Message

attributes.name: acuity_level
attributes.description: Typical patient acuity level served by the unit. Critical (ICU, CCU), acute (step-down, telemetry), intermediate (med-surg), general (rehab, skilled nursing), ambulatory (outpatient clinics).
attributes.references: AHRQ Patient Acuity Classification, CMS Case Mix Index (CMI)

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Age restriction policy for the unit. Pediatric-only (NICU, PICU, pediatric floors), adult-only (most general units), geriatric-only (specialized elder care), or all ages (ED, some outpatient clinics).
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation, Joint Commission Patient Rights Standards

attributes.name: air_changes_per_hour
attributes.description: Number of complete air changes per hour in the unit. Minimum 6 ACH for general patient rooms, 12+ ACH for isolation rooms, 15+ ACH for operating rooms per ASHRAE and CDC guidelines.
attributes.references: ASHRAE Standard 170, CDC Environmental Infection Control Guidelines

attributes.name: chest_pain_center_accreditation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit (typically ED or cardiac unit) holds accreditation as a Chest Pain Center from the American College of Cardiology or Society of Cardiovascular Patient Care.
attributes.references: ACC Chest Pain Center Accreditation, SCPC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the unit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, HITRUST Audit Logging Requirements

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric department code used in operational systems for grouping units into clinical or administrative departments. Used for reporting, scheduling, and organizational hierarchy.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Department Master, Workday HCM Organizational Structure

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the unit became operational or when the current configuration became effective. Used for historical tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: electronic_health_record_system
attributes.description: Name and version of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system used in the unit, such as 'Epic Hyperspace 2023', 'Cerner Millennium PowerChart', or 'MEDITECH Expanse'. Used for interoperability and training planning.
attributes.references: ONC Certified EHR Technology, HL7 FHIR Interoperability Standards

attributes.name: emergency_power_backup
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit has emergency generator backup power. Required for critical care units (ICU, OR, ED, NICU) per NFPA 99 and Joint Commission Life Safety Standards.
attributes.references: NFPA 99 Health Care Facilities Code, Joint Commission Life Safety Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the unit was closed, decommissioned, or when the current configuration expired. Null for active units. Used for historical tracking and capacity planning.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Physical floor or level within the building where the unit is located. May be numeric (1, 2, 3) or alphanumeric (G for ground, B1 for basement 1, M for mezzanine).

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Gender restriction policy for the unit. Male-only or female-only for certain inpatient units (e.g., obstetrics, urology). Mixed for most units. Not applicable for procedural or diagnostic units.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation, Joint Commission Patient Rights Standards

attributes.name: hvac_system_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) System Type
attributes.description: Type of HVAC system serving the unit, such as 'Central Air', 'Variable Air Volume (VAV)', 'Dedicated Outdoor Air System (DOAS)', or 'Negative Pressure Isolation System'. Critical for infection control and environmental safety.
attributes.references: ASHRAE Standard 170, CDC Environmental Infection Control Guidelines

attributes.name: infection_control_zone
attributes.description: Infection control risk classification for the unit. Standard (general units), enhanced (oncology, transplant), high-risk (ICU, burn unit), isolation (dedicated infectious disease units). Drives environmental services protocols.
attributes.references: CDC Healthcare Infection Control Practices, Joint Commission Infection Prevention Standards

attributes.name: is_twenty_four_seven
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. True for ICU, ED, inpatient floors. False for outpatient clinics, procedural units with scheduled hours.

attributes.name: isolation_room_count
attributes.description: Number of isolation rooms within the unit designed for patients requiring infection control precautions (contact, droplet, or airborne isolation). Critical for infection prevention and Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) management.
attributes.references: CDC Isolation Precautions Guidelines, Joint Commission Infection Control Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the unit record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, HITRUST Audit Logging Requirements

attributes.name: licensed_bed_count
attributes.description: Total number of beds the unit is licensed to operate by state or federal regulatory authorities. This is the maximum legal capacity and is reported to CMS and state health departments.
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services File, State Health Department Licensing

attributes.name: magnet_recognition
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is part of a Magnet-recognized nursing program by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC). Magnet recognition signifies excellence in nursing care and patient outcomes.

attributes.name: medical_gas_system
attributes.description: Type of medical gas system installed in the unit, such as 'Oxygen, Medical Air, Vacuum', 'Full Surgical Suite Gases (O2, N2O, Medical Air, Vacuum)', or 'None'. Critical for clinical operations and safety inspections.
attributes.references: NFPA 99 Medical Gas Systems, Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: negative_pressure_room_count
attributes.description: Number of negative pressure (airborne infection isolation) rooms within the unit, used for patients with airborne infectious diseases such as tuberculosis, measles, or COVID-19. Subset of isolation rooms.
attributes.references: CDC Guidelines for Environmental Infection Control, ASHRAE Standard 170

attributes.name: nurse_call_system_type
attributes.description: Type of nurse call system installed in the unit, such as 'Wired Pillow Speaker', 'Wireless Badge System', 'Integrated EMR Alert System', or 'Mobile App-Based'. Used for patient safety and response time monitoring.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Patient Safety Standards, AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators

attributes.name: nurse_to_patient_ratio
attributes.description: Target nurse-to-patient staffing ratio for the unit, expressed as 1:X (e.g., 1:2 for ICU, 1:4 for step-down, 1:6 for med-surg). Used for staffing planning and quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: State Nurse Staffing Laws, Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: operational_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time for unit operations in HH:MM 24-hour format. For 24/7 units, this is typically 23:59. For outpatient or procedural units, this reflects scheduled closing time.

attributes.name: operational_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time for unit operations in HH:MM 24-hour format. For 24/7 units (ICU, ED), this is typically 00:00. For outpatient or procedural units, this reflects scheduled opening time.

attributes.name: revenue_center_code
attributes.description: Four-digit revenue center code used on UB-04 claims for billing and reimbursement. Maps to CMS revenue code standards (e.g., 0100-0219 for room and board, 0300-0329 for laboratory).
attributes.references: CMS UB-04 Revenue Code List, NUBC Revenue Code Standards

attributes.name: specialty_service_line
attributes.description: Clinical specialty or service line associated with the unit, such as 'Cardiology', 'Oncology', 'Pediatrics', 'Orthopedics', 'Neurology', 'General Surgery', 'Obstetrics', or 'Behavioral Health'. Supports clinical analytics and resource planning.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Specialty Codes, NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the unit's physical space. Used for facility planning, space utilization analysis, and environmental services scheduling.
attributes.references: Facility Management Standards, SAP PM Asset Master

attributes.name: staffed_bed_count
attributes.description: Number of beds currently staffed and available for patient occupancy. Staffed bed count is typically less than or equal to licensed bed count and reflects actual operational capacity based on workforce availability.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Compare, AHRQ Hospital Survey

attributes.name: stroke_center_designation
attributes.description: Stroke center certification level for units providing acute stroke care. Comprehensive (highest), primary, acute stroke ready, or not designated. Impacts patient routing and quality reporting.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Stroke Certification, CMS Stroke Quality Measures

attributes.name: teaching_unit_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is designated as a teaching unit where medical residents, fellows, nursing students, or other trainees receive clinical education. Impacts staffing models and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ACGME Accreditation Standards, CMS Graduate Medical Education (GME) Reporting

attributes.name: telemetry_monitoring_capability
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit has continuous cardiac telemetry monitoring capability. True for ICU, CCU, step-down, and telemetry units. False for general med-surg and outpatient units.
attributes.references: American Heart Association Telemetry Standards, Joint Commission Critical Care Standards

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: Trauma center level designation for Emergency Department (ED) units. Level 1 is highest capability (comprehensive trauma care), Level 4 is basic. Not applicable for non-ED units.
attributes.references: American College of Surgeons Trauma Center Verification, State EMS Trauma System

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the unit in operational systems, scheduling, and Admit Discharge Transfer (ADT) workflows. Typically 2-10 characters.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Cadence Unit Code, HL7 ADT Message PV1-3

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit, such as 'Medical Surgical Floor 3 West', 'Intensive Care Unit (ICU) North', 'Emergency Department (ED) Main', or 'Operating Room (OR) Suite B'.

attributes.name: unit_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the unit. Active units are open and accepting patients. Inactive or temporarily closed units are not operational. Under construction units are being built or renovated. Decommissioned units are permanently closed.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the unit's operational purpose: inpatient (patient stays overnight), outpatient (same-day care), procedural (OR, cath lab), diagnostic (radiology, lab), administrative (offices), or support (pharmacy, supply).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Location.type, CMS Facility Type Codes

attributes.name: wing_or_section
attributes.description: Wing, section, or zone designation within the floor, such as 'North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Tower A', 'Pavilion B'. Used for wayfinding and spatial organization.

products.name: room
products.description: Individual room within a unit, including patient rooms, procedure rooms, operating rooms (OR suites with laminar airflow class, imaging integration, boom configuration), exam rooms, consultation rooms, and support rooms. Tracks room number, room name, room type (patient, OR, procedure, exam, consultation, support, isolation, negative pressure), room class (private, semi-private, ward), square footage, isolation capability, negative pressure flag, telemetry capability, ventilator outlet count, medical gas outlets (O2, vacuum, air, N2O), hand hygiene station count, OR-specific features (airflow class, HVAC air exchange rate per ASHRAE 170, equipment inventory), current room status (available, occupied, cleaning, out-of-service), last deep-clean date, and assigned department. Also captures space allocation and occupancy assignments linking rooms to departments, cost centers, and service lines with effective dating, allocated square footage, occupancy percentage, lease/ownership indicator, and monthly space cost. Supports ADT workflows, perioperative scheduling, bed management, space utilization analysis, infection prevention (isolation room tracking), and cost center chargebacks.
products.reference: Epic ADT Room, HL7 FHIR Location

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the room. Primary key for the room entity.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility or hospital where this room is located. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center to which room occupancy and maintenance costs are allocated. Supports revenue cycle management and financial reporting.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent unit or department within the facility where this room is located. Links to the unit master data.

attributes.name: workforce_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical department or service line that has primary operational responsibility for this room. Used for scheduling, cost allocation, and resource management.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the room by relevant accrediting bodies (e.g., The Joint Commission, AAAHC). Impacts operational authorization and reimbursement eligibility.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is currently active and available for use in operational systems. Supports soft-delete patterns and historical record retention.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility requirements for patients and staff with disabilities. Required for regulatory compliance and patient access.

attributes.name: bariatric_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is equipped and structurally reinforced to accommodate bariatric patients (typically over 350 lbs). Includes specialized beds, lifts, and wider doorways.

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: Number of patient beds or stretchers that can be accommodated in the room. Used for bed management, capacity planning, and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: boom_configuration
attributes.description: Description of ceiling-mounted equipment boom configuration in the room (e.g., single boom, dual boom, articulating arm). Relevant for OR and ICU rooms with suspended equipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the room record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current room configuration, assignment, or status became effective. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the current room configuration, assignment, or status is valid. Null indicates current/active record. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: emergency_power_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is connected to emergency backup power systems. Critical for life-safety equipment in ORs, ICUs, and emergency departments.

attributes.name: hand_hygiene_station_count
attributes.description: Number of hand hygiene stations (sinks or alcohol-based hand rub dispensers) in the room. Critical for infection prevention compliance and Joint Commission accreditation.
attributes.references: WHO Hand Hygiene Guidelines, The Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: hvac_air_exchange_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Air Exchange Rate
attributes.description: Number of complete air changes per hour (ACH) provided by the HVAC system. Critical for infection control, OR sterility, and regulatory compliance per ASHRAE 170.
attributes.references: ASHRAE 170 Ventilation of Health Care Facilities

attributes.name: imaging_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room has integrated imaging equipment (e.g., C-arm, fluoroscopy, intraoperative CT/MRI). Common in hybrid ORs and interventional procedure rooms.

attributes.name: isolation_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is equipped and certified for isolation of infectious patients. Critical for infection prevention and control workflows.

attributes.name: last_deep_clean_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent terminal or deep cleaning of the room. Used for infection prevention tracking, environmental services scheduling, and outbreak investigation.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or safety inspection of the room. Used for compliance tracking and accreditation readiness.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Standards, State Health Department Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the room record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: lease_ownership_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room space is owned by the organization, leased from a third party, shared with another entity, or contracted. Impacts financial reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: State or regulatory license number for the room, if applicable (e.g., for surgical suites, radiology rooms). Required for compliance and accreditation tracking.
attributes.references: State Department of Health Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: medical_air_outlet_count
attributes.description: Number of medical air outlets for compressed air delivery. Used for respiratory therapy and surgical equipment.

attributes.name: monthly_space_cost
attributes.description: Allocated monthly cost for the room space, including lease payments, depreciation, utilities, and maintenance. Used for cost center chargebacks and financial analysis.

attributes.name: negative_pressure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room has negative pressure ventilation to prevent airborne pathogen spread. Required for airborne isolation (e.g., tuberculosis, COVID-19).
attributes.references: CDC Guidelines for Environmental Infection Control, ASHRAE 170

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance activity for the room or its equipment. Supports biomedical engineering and facilities management workflows.

attributes.name: nitrous_oxide_outlet_count
attributes.description: Number of nitrous oxide gas outlets. Typically present in operating rooms and dental procedure rooms for anesthesia delivery.

attributes.name: is_low_bed

attributes.name: is_private_room

attributes.name: last_cleaned_timestamp

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date

attributes.name: out_of_service_reason

attributes.name: position

products.name: or_suite
products.description: Operating room suite configuration master, capturing OR number, OR name, OR type (general, cardiac, orthopedic, neurosurgery, hybrid, endoscopy, cath lab), room dimensions, imaging integration (C-arm, intraoperative MRI), laminar airflow class, HVAC air exchange rate, boom configuration, equipment inventory list, scheduled maintenance window, and current operational status. Supports OpTime surgical scheduling and perioperative capacity management.

attributes.name: unit_id

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: emergency_power_backup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OR is connected to the emergency power system (generator or UPS) to maintain critical functions during power outages. Required for life safety and continuation of surgical procedures.

attributes.name: emergency_use_flag

attributes.name: equipment_inventory_list

Sprinkler systems are common but may require equipment protection. Critical for life safety and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: next_accreditation_survey_due_date

products.name: equipment_asset

products.name: maintenance_order
products.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance work order for facility infrastructure and biomedical equipment, including the preventive maintenance schedule definitions that drive recurring work order generation. For work orders: captures work order number, order type (preventive, corrective, emergency, inspection-driven, recall-driven), priority level (critical, urgent, routine, scheduled), asset or location reference, problem description, failure code, assigned technician, trade type (biomedical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, fire protection), scheduled start and end datetime, actual start and completion datetime, labor hours, parts consumed with cost, total cost, and completion status. For PM schedules: captures schedule name, maintenance task template, frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual), estimated labor hours, required trade, regulatory driver (TJC EC.02.04.01, CMS, NFPA 99, NFPA 101, state DOH), risk-based assessment score (AEM/AHJ), last completed date, next due date, and schedule active status. Supports biomedical engineering PM compliance rates, facilities management KPIs, and regulatory audit evidence.

products.name: inspection
products.description: Regulatory, accreditation, and internal facility inspection record with detailed findings tracking and Plans of Correction (PoC) lifecycle management. Captures inspection type (TJC triennial survey, CMS certification survey, state DOH survey, fire marshal inspection, OSHA inspection, internal safety round, life safety code inspection), inspection date, inspector name and organization, scope (facility-wide, department, specific system), overall disposition (passed, conditional, failed, preliminary denial of accreditation). Individual findings are tracked as detail records capturing finding number, standard or regulation cited (TJC standard code, CMS Condition of Participation, OSHA standard, NFPA Life Safety Code), finding description, severity level (immediate jeopardy, condition-level, standard-level, observation), responsible department, corrective action plan narrative, corrective action owner, due date, resolution status, and evidence of correction. For CMS surveys: tracks Plan of Correction (PoC) submission date, CMS acceptance date, follow-up survey date, and PoC completion verification. Supports TJC Environment of Care chapter compliance, CMS certification lifecycle, state licensure survey management, and systematic deficiency remediation tracking.

This is the operational silver-layer record of capacity state, distinct from analytical aggregations. Note: comprehensive emergency preparedness planning artifacts (emergency operations plans, communication plans, training/exercise records) require coverage beyond capacity snapshots — see next_vibes_items.

products.name: safety_incident
products.description: Facility safety and environment of care (EOC) incident record, including hazardous material inventory management. For incidents: captures event type (fire/smoke event, utility failure, water intrusion, security threat, hazardous material spill, workplace injury, infant/child abduction drill, active shooter drill, infrastructure failure), incident date and time, location (care site, building, unit, room), description, immediate actions taken, injuries sustained, property damage assessment, root cause analysis, corrective actions, regulatory reporting obligation (OSHA 300 log, OSHA 301, state DOH notification, CMS immediate jeopardy notification), and closure status. For hazardous materials inventory: captures material name, chemical name, CAS number, hazard class (OSHA GHS classification), storage location, maximum allowable quantity, current quantity on hand, SDS (Safety Data Sheet) reference, regulatory permit required flag, disposal method, and responsible department. Supports OSHA compliance, EPA Tier II reporting, TJC Environment of Care standards (EC.02.01.01 safety management, EC.02.02.01 security management), and comprehensive EOC management. Distinct from clinical patient safety events (adverse drug events, falls, hospital-acquired conditions) owned by the quality domain.

products.name: network_contract
products.description: This association product represents the contractual network participation agreement between a care delivery site and an insurance payer. It captures the legal and operational terms governing how the facility participates in the payer's provider network, including reimbursement methodology, network tier status, claims submission requirements, and credentialing obligations. Each record links one care_site to one payer with contract-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this bilateral agreement. This is the operational foundation for revenue cycle management, network adequacy compliance, and provider directory accuracy.. Existence Justification: Healthcare facilities routinely participate in multiple insurance payer networks simultaneously (Medicare, Medicaid, Blue Cross, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, etc.), and each payer contracts with hundreds or thousands of facilities to build adequate provider networks. This is a foundational operational reality in healthcare revenue cycle management. Each care_site-payer combination has its own contract with unique terms: effective dates, reimbursement rates, network tier status, claims submission rules, and credentialing requirements. Business stakeholders actively manage these contracts through contracting departments, refer to them as 'payer contracts' or 'network participation agreements,' and query them regularly for network directory updates, contract renewals, and revenue cycle operations.

products.name: facility_program_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between care sites and quality programs within the integrated delivery network. It captures site-specific enrollment, performance tracking, and regulatory submission data for each care site's participation in CMS Value-Based Purchasing, MIPS, accreditation programs, and internal quality initiatives. Each record links one care site to one quality program with participation dates, coordinator assignments, submission methods, performance scores, and payment adjustments that exist only in the context of this specific site-program combination. SSOT for quality program participation tracking and performance management at the facility level.. Existence Justification: In healthcare integrated delivery networks, care sites participate in multiple quality programs simultaneously (a hospital participates in VBP, HRRP, HAC Reduction, MIPS, TJC accreditation), and each quality program spans multiple care sites across the health system. Quality teams actively manage site-specific participation including enrollment dates, coordinator assignments, submission methods, performance tracking, and payment adjustments for each site-program combination. This is an operational M:N relationship with substantial relationship data.

products.name: block_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the scheduled block time assignment between an operating room suite and a surgeon or surgical team member. It captures recurring OR block schedules that allocate specific time windows in specific operating rooms to specific surgeons. Each record links one OR suite to one employee (surgeon) with block schedule attributes including time windows, day of week, block type, priority level, and effective period. Critical for OR utilization management, surgical scheduling, and capacity planning in perioperative services.. Existence Justification: OR block scheduling is a core perioperative business process where surgeons are allocated recurring time blocks in specific operating rooms. One surgeon typically has block assignments in multiple ORs (e.g., general OR on Mondays, cardiac OR on Thursdays), and one OR has blocks assigned to multiple surgeons across different days and time windows. The business actively manages these block assignments with specific terms (block type, priority, utilization thresholds, release deadlines) and tracks them as operational entities called 'OR Block Assignments' or 'Surgical Block Schedules'.

products.name: equipment_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization and competency verification between equipment assets and clinical workforce members. It captures which employees are trained, authorized, and competent to operate specific medical and facility equipment. Each record links one equipment asset to one employee with competency verification dates, authorization periods, assignment type (primary vs backup operator), and usage authorization status. Supports biomedical engineering competency tracking, clinical staff credentialing, equipment safety compliance, and TJC HR.01.06.01 staff competency requirements.. Existence Justification: Healthcare operations require explicit tracking of which clinical staff members are trained, authorized, and competent to operate specific medical equipment assets. One employee can be authorized to use many different equipment types (ventilators, infusion pumps, imaging devices, surgical robots), and one equipment asset can have multiple authorized operators (primary user, backup operators, trained staff pool). This is an operational business process managed by biomedical engineering and clinical education departments, not an analytical correlation.
