attributes.name: actual_end_datetime
attributes.description: The actual date and time the employee clocked out or ended the shift. Used for actual hours worked calculation and overtime determination.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours the employee actually worked during this shift, based on actual clock-in and clock-out times. Used for payroll processing and overtime variance analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: actual_start_datetime
attributes.description: The actual date and time the employee clocked in or began the shift. Compared against scheduled_start_datetime for variance analysis and late-arrival tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the staffing agency or contract labor vendor supplying the worker for this shift, when is_agency_staff is true. Used for vendor performance tracking and agency spend management.

attributes.name: approval_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the shift schedule assignment was approved by the responsible manager or charge nurse.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the individual shift assignment (e.g., scheduled, confirmed, swapped, cancelled, no_show, completed). Tracks the workflow state of the shift from planning through execution.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: break_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled break time in minutes for this shift (meal and rest breaks). Used for net hours worked calculation and OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA Workplace Safety Standards; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for shift cancellation when assignment_status is 'cancelled'. Supports workforce analytics on cancellation patterns and FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employee_request|low_census|call_out|fmla|bereavement|administrative|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: care_setting
attributes.description: Classification of the care environment where the shift takes place (e.g., inpatient, ED (Emergency Department), ICU (Intensive Care Unit), OR (Operating Room), outpatient, ambulatory, telehealth). Drives staffing ratio requirements and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|ed|icu|or|outpatient|ambulatory|telehealth — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: created_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: fte_value
attributes.description: FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) contribution of this shift assignment, calculated as scheduled hours divided by standard full-time hours. Used for workforce capacity planning and regulatory staffing ratio reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Staffing Reporting; Workday HCM Scheduling Module

attributes.name: is_agency_staff
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shift is filled by agency or contract (traveler) staff rather than direct-hire employees. Used for labor cost analysis, agency spend tracking, and staffing mix reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; CMS Staffing Reporting

attributes.name: is_charge_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is serving in a charge nurse or charge clinician capacity during this shift, carrying supervisory and unit management responsibilities.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Staffing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: is_float_assignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is assigned as a float pool staff member, meaning they are not permanently assigned to this unit and may be deployed across multiple departments as needed.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Record Last Updated Date and Time
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift schedule record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL (Extract Transform Load) processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: nurse_to_patient_ratio
attributes.description: Actual nurse-to-patient ratio achieved during this shift, calculated as the number of nurses on duty divided by patient census. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; State Nurse Staffing Laws

attributes.name: on_call_response_minutes
attributes.description: Required response time in minutes for on-call staff to report to the facility when called in. Applicable when shift_type is 'on_call'. Used for operational readiness and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Staffing Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard shift threshold (typically 8 hours/day or 40 hours/week) that qualify as overtime under FLSA. Used for payroll and labor cost management.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: patient_census
attributes.description: Number of patients in the unit/department at the time of the shift. Used to validate nurse-to-patient ratio compliance and assess staffing adequacy relative to patient volume.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: pay_code
attributes.description: Payroll pay code associated with this shift assignment (e.g., REG for regular, OT for overtime, HOL for holiday, DIFF for differential). Drives payroll processing in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: published_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule was published and made visible to staff. Marks the transition from draft to published schedule status.

attributes.name: required_fte_coverage
attributes.description: The minimum FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) staffing level required for the unit/department during this shift period, as defined by staffing plans and nurse-to-patient ratio standards.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments associated with this shift schedule assignment, capturing special instructions, accommodation requests, or operational context from the scheduler.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shift schedule record, used for cross-system reference and operational communication (e.g., SCH-202401150001).

attributes.name: schedule_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the scheduling period to which this shift belongs. Defines the boundary of the scheduling block.

attributes.name: schedule_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the scheduling period (e.g., start of a two-week or four-week scheduling block) to which this shift belongs.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the overall schedule period record (e.g., draft, published, approved, closed, archived). Distinguishes between working schedules and finalized/locked schedules.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time the employee is scheduled to end the shift. Used for shift duration calculation and overtime tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the employee is planned to work during this shift, derived from scheduled start and end times. Used for FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) coverage planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; CMS Staffing Reporting

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time the employee is scheduled to begin the shift. Used for precise scheduling, overtime calculation, and time-and-attendance variance analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: shift_category
attributes.description: Operational category of the shift assignment indicating the nature of the work arrangement (e.g., regular scheduled, overtime, on-call, callback, charge nurse, float pool). Affects pay rate and staffing classification.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shift is scheduled to occur. Used for day-level staffing planning and nurse-to-patient ratio compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift by time-of-day or operational category (e.g., day, evening, night, on-call, weekend, holiday). Drives differential pay calculations and staffing coverage analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduling Module; CMS Staffing Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this shift schedule record originated (e.g., WORKDAY, EPIC_CADENCE, CERNER, MEDITECH, MANUAL). Supports data lineage and ETL (Extract Transform Load) traceability.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this shift schedule record in the originating operational system (e.g., Workday shift ID, Epic Cadence schedule ID). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

products.name: time_attendance
products.description: Time, attendance, and payroll processing records for all employees. Captures clock-in/clock-out events, total hours worked, overtime hours, missed punches, meal break deductions, pay period totals, approval status, and timekeeper corrections. Includes complete payroll processing: gross pay, net pay, base salary/hourly rate, shift differentials, overtime pay, bonuses, deductions (taxes, benefits, garnishments), pay period dates, payroll run status, payment method (direct deposit, check), and GL cost center allocation. Tracks FLSA compliance flags and supports labor cost allocation by cost center and department. SSOT for all workforce time tracking and payroll data. Sourced from Workday HCM Time Tracking and Payroll modules.
products.reference: Workday HCM — Time Tracking; FLSA

attributes.name: time_attendance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each time and attendance / payroll record in the Workday HCM Time Tracking and Payroll system. Primary key for the time_attendance data product.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking and Payroll

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where the worker performed their shift or work assignment.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Time and attendance records must post labor costs to specific GL accounts for payroll expense recognition. Currently has gl_account_code as text. FK to chart_of_accounts enables proper labor cost acco

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger (GL) cost center to which labor costs for this record are allocated. Supports labor cost allocation by department and cost center for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Payroll accruals and labor costs must align with fiscal period close. Links time/attendance to fiscal period for payroll accrual accuracy, period-end labor cost cutoff, and reconciliation of payroll e

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the Workday HCM payroll run batch in which this record was processed. Used for payroll reconciliation, audit, and reprocessing of failed payroll runs.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific position or job assignment held by the worker during this pay period, supporting multi-position employees common in healthcare settings.

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contract worker whose time and attendance record this row represents. Links to the workforce worker/employee master.

attributes.name: workforce_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Time and attendance records must be linked to organizational unit for labor cost allocation, payroll processing by org unit, and workforce analytics. time_attendance currently has department_code (den

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the time and attendance record in the approval lifecycle. Pending indicates awaiting manager review; approved indicates manager-confirmed; corrected indicates timekeeper adjustment applied.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manager or timekeeper approved this time record. Distinct from payroll processing timestamp; used for SLA monitoring of approval workflows.

attributes.name: base_pay_rate
attributes.description: The employee's base hourly rate or annualized salary rate used for payroll calculation. For hourly employees, expressed as dollars per hour; for salaried employees, expressed as annual salary divided by pay periods.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: benefits_deduction
attributes.description: Total amount deducted for employee benefits including health insurance premiums, dental, vision, life insurance, and retirement plan contributions (e.g., 401k) during this pay period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act)

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Any bonus, incentive, or supplemental pay included in this payroll record, such as retention bonuses, sign-on bonuses, or performance incentives. Zero if no bonus applies.

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the worker clocked in to begin their shift, as recorded by Workday HCM Time Tracking. Represents the principal real-world business event time for shift start.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the worker clocked out to end their shift. Null if the worker has not yet clocked out or if a missed punch was recorded.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: correction_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a timekeeper correction was applied to this record. Required when timekeeper_corrected is True for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time and attendance record was first created in Workday HCM. Serves as the audit record creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) — Audit Controls

attributes.name: flsa_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: System-generated flag indicating whether this time record is compliant with FLSA requirements (e.g., overtime thresholds met, minimum wage satisfied). False triggers a compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); U.S. Department of Labor; OIG — Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: flsa_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is classified as exempt from FLSA overtime requirements (True = exempt salaried; False = non-exempt hourly). Critical for overtime eligibility determination and FLSA compliance audits.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: The Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) percentage associated with this worker's position for this pay period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time). Used for workforce FTE tracking and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: garnishment_deduction
attributes.description: Total amount withheld for court-ordered wage garnishments (child support, creditor garnishments, tax levies) during this pay period. Zero if no garnishment applies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) Title III

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code used to post labor costs for this time record in SAP S/4HANA. Supports financial reporting and labor cost allocation by GL account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total gross compensation earned by the employee for the pay period before any deductions, including base pay, shift differentials, overtime pay, and bonuses. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time and attendance record was most recently modified in Workday HCM, including timekeeper corrections, approval status changes, or payroll adjustments.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) — Audit Controls

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of leave applied to this time record if the worker was absent. None indicates no leave; FMLA indicates Family and Medical Leave Act protected leave. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|pto|fmla|sick|bereavement|jury_duty|military|unpaid — promote to reference product if additional values needed]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: meal_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes deducted for meal breaks during the shift or pay period. Applied per facility meal break policy and state labor law requirements to compute compensable hours.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: missed_punch_count
attributes.description: Number of missed clock-in or clock-out punch events recorded for this worker during the pay period. Used for attendance compliance monitoring and timekeeper correction workflows.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total net compensation paid to the employee after all deductions (taxes, benefits, garnishments) have been subtracted from gross pay. Represents the actual take-home amount.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; IRS Publication 15; GAAP and FASB

attributes.name: on_call_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the employee was designated as on-call during the pay period. Tracked separately for on-call differential pay calculations and staffing analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: osha_incident_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time record is associated with an OSHA-reportable workplace incident (e.g., injury, illness resulting in lost time). True triggers linkage to OSHA incident reporting workflows.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked during the pay period, as defined by FLSA thresholds (hours exceeding 40 per workweek for non-exempt employees). Used for overtime pay calculation and FLSA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime compensation earned during the pay period, calculated at the applicable overtime rate (typically 1.5x base rate per FLSA) applied to overtime_hours.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this time and attendance record. Together with pay_period_start_date defines the payroll processing window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this time and attendance record. Used to group time entries into payroll processing cycles.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is compensated on an hourly, salaried, per diem, or contract basis. Drives payroll calculation logic and FLSA exemption status determination.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Direct deposit is the standard method; check and pay card are alternatives for employees without bank accounts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; NACHA Operating Rules (for direct deposit)

attributes.name: payroll_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payroll run that processed this record was executed. Distinct from pay_period_end_date; used for payroll processing SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: payroll_run_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current payroll processing state for this time record. Processed means the record has been included in a completed payroll run; reversed indicates a payroll correction was applied.

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of regular (non-overtime) hours worked by the employee during the pay period or shift, as calculated by Workday HCM Time Tracking after meal break deductions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work shift occurred. For overnight shifts, this is the date the shift started. Used for daily labor reporting and scheduling reconciliation.

attributes.name: shift_differential_amount
attributes.description: Additional compensation earned for working evening, night, weekend, or holiday shifts. Calculated based on shift_type and applicable differential rate per the collective bargaining agreement or HR policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work shift for differential pay and scheduling purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: day|evening|night|on_call|weekend|holiday|rotating — promote to reference product if additional values needed]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: time_entry_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the time entry for payroll calculation and labor cost reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|overtime|on_call|callback|charge|training|orientation|meeting — promote to reference product if additional values needed]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: timekeeper_corrected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a timekeeper or payroll administrator applied a manual correction to this time record. True when a correction has been made; supports audit trail and compliance review.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: total_tax_deduction
attributes.description: Total amount withheld for all applicable taxes (federal income tax, state income tax, FICA/Social Security, Medicare) during this pay period. Supports W-2 preparation and tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; IRS Publication 15; GAAP and FASB

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Employee benefit enrollment records capturing elected benefit plans (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, FSA, HSA, 403(b)/401(k) retirement), coverage tier (employee only, employee+spouse, family), enrollment effective date, termination date, and annual election amounts. Tracks open enrollment events and qualifying life event changes. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefits module.
products.reference: Workday HCM — Benefits Administration; ERISA; ACA

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each benefit enrollment record in the workforce domain. Primary key for the benefit_enrollment data product.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific benefit plan elected by the worker (e.g., medical plan, dental plan, 403(b) retirement plan). Links to the benefit plan master record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or worker who elected this benefit plan. Links to the workforce worker/employee master record.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Benefit eligibility and plan offerings often vary by position type (full-time vs. part-time, union vs. non-union, executive vs. staff). Adding position_id enables position-specific benefit analysis an

attributes.name: aca_affordability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's required contribution for the lowest-cost self-only coverage does not exceed the ACA affordability threshold (percentage of household income or safe harbor). Used for ACA employer mandate compliance and IRS Form 1095-C reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H(b); IRS Section 36B; IRS Form 1095-C; CMS; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: aca_minimum_essential_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this medical benefit enrollment satisfies the Affordable Care Act (ACA) Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC) requirement. True for qualifying employer-sponsored health plans. Used for ACA employer mandate compliance reporting on IRS Forms 1094-C and 1095-C.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H; IRS Section 5000A; IRS Forms 1094-C/1095-C; CMS; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: aca_minimum_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the elected medical plan meets the ACA Minimum Value (MV) standard, meaning the plan pays at least 60% of the total allowed cost of benefits. Required for ACA employer mandate compliance and IRS Form 1095-C Line 14 reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 36B; IRS Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C; CMS; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: The total annual dollar amount elected by the employee for spending accounts (FSA, HSA, dependent care FSA) or retirement plan contributions (403(b)/401(k)). Applicable primarily to FSA, HSA, and retirement benefit types. Null for insurance plan types.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; IRS Section 223 (HSA); IRS Section 129 (DCFSA); IRS Section 402(g); IRS Section 415; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the primary beneficiary designated by the employee for life insurance and retirement benefit plans. Required for life insurance and 403(b)/401(k) plans. Null for health, dental, vision, FSA, and HSA plans.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 205; Workday HCM Benefits Module; IRS Form 5500

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the primary beneficiary to the enrolled employee for life insurance and retirement plans. Used for ERISA compliance and beneficiary designation validation.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 205; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: benefit_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan elected by the worker. Classifies the enrollment into major benefit program types: medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability (short-term or long-term), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), or retirement (403(b)/401(k)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability|fsa|hsa|retirement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; ERISA; IRS Section 125; IRS Section 401(k); IRS Section 403(b)

attributes.name: carrier_confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurance carrier confirmed receipt and processing of the enrollment eligibility record. Used to reconcile Workday enrollment records against carrier enrollment files and resolve discrepancies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; HIPAA 834 Transaction Standard; ERISA

attributes.name: carrier_eligibility_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the eligibility file for this enrollment was transmitted to the insurance carrier or benefit administrator. Used to track carrier file transmission status and resolve eligibility discrepancies between Workday and the carrier.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; HIPAA 834 Transaction Standard (ASC X12 834); ERISA

attributes.name: carrier_group_number
attributes.description: The group policy number assigned by the insurance carrier to the healthcare organization's benefit plan. Used on insurance cards, claims submissions, and eligibility verification. Shared across all employees enrolled in the same plan.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: carrier_member_number
attributes.description: The unique member identification number assigned by the insurance carrier to the enrolled employee. Used for claims processing, eligibility verification, and member services. This is a PHI-adjacent identifier that can be used to access health information.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or benefit administrator providing the elected benefit plan (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'Aetna', 'Delta Dental', 'Fidelity Investments'). Used for carrier billing, eligibility file transmission, and member ID card generation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) continuation coverage upon termination of this enrollment. True when the enrollment termination is due to a qualifying COBRA event (e.g., employment termination, reduction in hours). Drives COBRA notification workflow.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); Workday HCM Benefits Module; DOL COBRA Regulations

attributes.name: cobra_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the COBRA election notice was sent to the employee following a qualifying event. The employer must provide notice within 14 days of being notified of the qualifying event. Required for COBRA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1166); DOL COBRA Regulations 29 CFR Part 2590; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Coverage level elected by the employee indicating who is covered under the benefit plan. Drives premium calculation and payroll deduction amounts. Standard tiers: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family coverage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; ACA Section 1302

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR § 164.312(b); ISO 27001

attributes.name: deduction_frequency
attributes.description: The payroll deduction frequency for the employee's benefit premium contribution. Determines how often the employee_premium_amount is deducted from the employee's paycheck. Must align with the employee's pay frequency in Workday Payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; Workday HCM Benefits Module; FLSA

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: The number of dependents (spouse, children, domestic partner) enrolled under this benefit plan election. Used to validate coverage tier selection and for carrier eligibility file reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; IRS Section 152; ACA

attributes.name: disability_benefit_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the disability benefit enrollment is for Short-Term Disability (STD) or Long-Term Disability (LTD) coverage. Applicable only when benefit_type is 'disability'. Drives different elimination periods, benefit durations, and premium rates.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; FMLA; State Disability Insurance Laws

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage becomes effective and the employee is entitled to use the elected benefit plan. This is the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM date for this enrollment record.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Section 125; Workday HCM Benefits Module; ACA

attributes.name: employee_premium_amount
attributes.description: The employee's share of the benefit plan premium per pay period, expressed in USD. This is the amount deducted from the employee's paycheck via pre-tax or post-tax payroll deduction. Drives payroll deduction configuration in Workday Payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; IRS Section 125; ERISA; GAAP ASC 715

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The employer's annual contribution to the employee's HSA, FSA, or retirement account (403(b)/401(k) match), expressed in USD. Distinct from employer_premium_amount which applies to insurance plans. Used for IRS reporting and total compensation statements.
attributes.references: IRS Section 223 (HSA); IRS Section 401(k); IRS Section 403(b); ERISA; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: employer_match_rate
attributes.description: The employer's matching contribution rate as a percentage of the employee's retirement contribution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50% match up to a cap). Applicable only when benefit_type is 'retirement'. Used for total compensation reporting and retirement plan compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); IRS Section 403(b); ERISA; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: employer_premium_amount
attributes.description: The employer's contribution toward the benefit plan premium per pay period, expressed in USD. Represents the healthcare organization's cost of providing the benefit. Used in total compensation reporting and benefits cost analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; GAAP ASC 715; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation number generated by Workday HCM or the carrier's enrollment portal upon successful submission of the benefit election. Provided to the employee as proof of enrollment. Used for audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this benefit enrollment record, used in correspondence with carriers, payroll, and HR operations. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefits module.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The business event or process that initiated this benefit enrollment. Distinguishes between annual open enrollment elections, mid-year qualifying life event (QLE) changes (e.g., marriage, birth, loss of other coverage), new hire enrollment, rehire enrollment, or administrative corrections.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; ERISA; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit enrollment record. 'Active' indicates coverage is in force; 'pending' indicates awaiting carrier confirmation; 'terminated' indicates coverage has ended; 'waived' indicates the employee declined coverage; 'suspended' indicates coverage is temporarily paused.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: enrollment_submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee submitted their benefit election in Workday HCM. Distinct from the effective_date (when coverage begins). Used to verify timely enrollment within the election window and for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: fsa_plan_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of Flexible Spending Account (FSA) elected: healthcare FSA (for medical expenses), dependent care FSA (DCFSA for childcare/eldercare), or limited-purpose FSA (for dental/vision only, compatible with HSA). Applicable only when benefit_type is 'fsa'.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; IRS Section 129; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: hsa_contribution_limit
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated annual contribution limit applicable to this HSA enrollment based on coverage tier (individual vs. family) and the employee's age (catch-up contributions for age 55+). Used to validate that annual_election_amount does not exceed IRS limits. Applicable only when benefit_type is 'hsa'.
attributes.references: IRS Section 223; IRS Revenue Procedure (annual HSA limits); Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was most recently modified in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR § 164.312(b); ISO 27001

attributes.name: life_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face value (death benefit) of the life insurance policy elected by the employee, expressed in USD. Applicable only when benefit_type is 'life_insurance'. May be a flat amount or a multiple of annual salary (e.g., 1x, 2x base salary).
attributes.references: IRS Section 79; Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: open_enrollment_period
attributes.description: Identifier for the annual open enrollment window during which this election was made (e.g., 'OE-2024'). Null for mid-year qualifying life event enrollments. Used to group and audit all elections made during a specific open enrollment campaign.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; IRS Section 125; ERISA

attributes.name: other_coverage_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing the employee's other coverage when the employee has waived the employer's plan due to having coverage elsewhere. Used for coordination of benefits (COB) and ACA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H; CMS Coordination of Benefits; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal plan year to which this enrollment applies (e.g., '2024'). Used to associate elections with the correct annual benefit period for reporting, compliance, and ACA employer mandate tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; ACA Section 4980H; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: pretax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's premium contribution is deducted on a pre-tax basis under a Section 125 Cafeteria Plan (True) or on a post-tax basis (False). Affects the employee's taxable income and W-2 reporting. Most medical, dental, and vision premiums are pre-tax.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; IRS Form W-2; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of qualifying life event (QLE) that triggered a mid-year benefit change, when enrollment_source is 'qualifying_life_event'. Examples include marriage, divorce, birth, adoption, death of dependent, loss of other coverage, change in employment status. Null when enrollment_source is open_enrollment or new_hire. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death_of_dependent|loss_of_coverage|employment_change|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; ERISA Section 702; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_rate
attributes.description: The employee's elected contribution rate as a percentage of gross pay for retirement plans (403(b)/401(k)), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0600 = 6%). Used to calculate per-period retirement deductions in Workday Payroll. Applicable only when benefit_type is 'retirement'.
attributes.references: IRS Section 402(g); IRS Section 403(b); IRS Section 415; ERISA; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the benefit coverage ends and the employee is no longer entitled to the elected benefit plan. Null for currently active enrollments. This is the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL date. Triggers COBRA eligibility notification requirements under federal law.
attributes.references: ERISA; COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); IRS Section 125; Workday HCM Benefits Module

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: The combined total premium for the benefit plan per pay period (employee share plus employer share), expressed in USD. Used for carrier billing reconciliation and total benefits cost reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; ERISA; GAAP ASC 715

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: The stated reason why the employee waived (declined) coverage for this benefit plan, when enrollment_status is 'waived'. Common reasons include coverage through spouse's employer, coverage through Medicare/Medicaid, or other qualifying coverage. Required for ACA employer mandate compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H; IRS Section 125; Workday HCM Benefits Module

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Employee leave of absence requests and approved leave records, including FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), personal leave, military leave (USERRA), workers compensation leave, bereavement, and PTO. Captures leave type, requested start/end dates, approved dates, intermittent leave tracking, FMLA eligibility determination, and return-to-work status. Sourced from Workday HCM Absence Management.
products.reference: Workday HCM — Absence Management; FMLA; USERRA

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each employee leave of absence request record in the Workday HCM Absence Management module.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) where the employee is assigned. Used for site-level absence tracking, FMLA 50-employee threshold determination, and operational coverage planning.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.110(a)(3); Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contingent worker submitting the leave request. Links to the workforce worker/employee master record.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational position held by the employee at the time of the leave request, used for backfill planning and FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) impact analysis.

attributes.name: workforce_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational department to which the employee belongs at the time of the leave request. Used for departmental absence reporting, coverage planning, and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request was formally approved or denied by the HR approver in Workday HCM. Used to measure HR processing time and compliance with FMLA 5-business-day notification requirement.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.300(d); Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the HR manager or leave administrator who approved or denied the leave request in Workday HCM. Supports audit trail and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b)

attributes.name: approved_end_date
attributes.description: The HR-approved last calendar date of the leave of absence. Used for return-to-work planning, benefits administration, and FMLA entitlement tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.300; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: approved_start_date
attributes.description: The HR-approved first calendar date of the leave of absence, which may differ from the requested start date. Drives payroll processing, benefits continuation, and FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.300; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: benefits_continuation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's group health benefits are being continued during the leave period. FMLA requires employers to maintain group health coverage under the same terms as if the employee had continued working.

attributes.name: cobra_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) continuation coverage notification was sent to the employee, applicable when benefits are not continued during the leave or upon separation.
attributes.references: COBRA 29 U.S.C. §1166; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for denial of the leave request (e.g., insufficient FMLA entitlement remaining, ineligible leave type, incomplete certification, operational necessity). Required for compliance documentation and potential grievance or legal proceedings.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.300(d); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fitness_for_duty_received_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fitness for Duty Certification Received Date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer received the completed fitness-for-duty medical certification from the employee's healthcare provider, clearing the employee to return to work.

attributes.name: fitness_for_duty_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fitness for Duty Certification Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer requires a fitness-for-duty medical certification before the employee may return to work. Applicable for FMLA leave taken for the employee's own serious health condition.

attributes.name: fmla_eligibility_determination_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Eligibility Determination Date
attributes.description: Date on which HR formally determined and communicated the employee's FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) eligibility status. FMLA regulations require notification within 5 business days of the leave request.

attributes.name: fmla_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Eligibility Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee meets the FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) eligibility criteria at the time of the leave request: employed for at least 12 months, worked at least 1,250 hours in the prior 12 months, and works at a location with 50+ employees within 75 miles.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.110; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fmla_hours_remaining
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Hours Remaining
attributes.description: Remaining FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) entitlement hours available to the employee in the current FMLA leave year after accounting for hours used. Supports HR compliance monitoring and employee communication.

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Hours Used
attributes.description: Cumulative FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) hours consumed by the employee in the current FMLA leave year for this request. FMLA entitlement is capped at 480 hours (12 weeks) per year for most qualifying reasons.

attributes.name: hr_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the HR leave administrator documenting case-specific details, communications with the employee, or special circumstances. May contain PHI (Protected Health Information) and is subject to HIPAA confidentiality requirements.

attributes.name: intermittent_duration_hours
attributes.description: Expected duration in hours of each intermittent leave episode as certified by the healthcare provider. Used to calculate FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) impact and schedule coverage needs.

attributes.name: intermittent_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency of intermittent leave episodes as certified by the healthcare provider (e.g., Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed). Used for scheduling and absence pattern monitoring.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.202; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: is_intermittent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently (in separate blocks of time or by reducing the normal weekly or daily work schedule) rather than as a single continuous period. Intermittent FMLA requires separate tracking of each absence episode.

attributes.name: leave_duration_days
attributes.description: Total approved duration of the leave in calendar days, calculated from approved start and end dates. Used for ALOS (Average Length of Stay) benchmarking, workforce planning, and payroll impact analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR §825.200

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Specific reason or qualifying condition for the leave request (e.g., serious health condition of employee, care for family member, military deployment, birth/adoption of child). Constitutes PHI (Protected Health Information) when related to a medical condition and is subject to HIPAA and FMLA confidentiality requirements.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave of absence request. Includes federally protected leave types such as FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), USERRA military leave, workers compensation, and employer-defined types such as bereavement and PTO. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FMLA|Personal|Military|Workers_Compensation|Bereavement|PTO|Parental|Disability|Jury_Duty|Administrative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); USERRA (38 U.S.C. §§ 4301–4335); Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: leave_year_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Leave Year Start Date
attributes.description: Start date of the 12-month FMLA leave year applicable to this request. Employers may use a calendar year, fixed year, or rolling 12-month period. Determines the entitlement window for FMLA hour calculations.

attributes.name: medical_certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the medical certification supporting the leave request expires. HR must request recertification before this date for ongoing or intermittent leave.

attributes.name: medical_certification_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer received the completed medical certification form (e.g., WH-380-E or WH-380-F) from the employee or their healthcare provider.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.305; U.S. Department of Labor WH-380

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certification from a healthcare provider is required to support the leave request. Required for FMLA leave related to a serious health condition.

attributes.name: military_order_number
attributes.description: Official military order number from the deployment or activation orders provided by the employee for USERRA military leave verification. Supports compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USERRA 38 U.S.C. §4312; U.S. Department of Defense

attributes.name: military_service_branch
attributes.description: Branch of the U.S. Armed Forces for which the employee is taking military leave under USERRA (Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act). Populated only for military leave type requests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Army|Navy|Air_Force|Marine_Corps|Coast_Guard|Space_Force|National_Guard — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USERRA 38 U.S.C. §§ 4301–4335; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: notice_provided_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Notice Provided Date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer provided the required FMLA designation notice to the employee, informing them whether the leave qualifies as FMLA and the amount of leave counted against their entitlement.

attributes.name: pay_status
attributes.description: Compensation status during the leave period. Indicates whether the employee receives full pay, partial pay, short-term disability (STD) benefits, long-term disability (LTD) benefits, or is on unpaid leave. Drives payroll processing in Workday HCM Payroll.

attributes.name: pto_hours_applied
attributes.description: Number of accrued PTO (Paid Time Off) hours the employee has elected or is required to use concurrently with the leave period. FMLA regulations permit employers to require concurrent use of accrued paid leave.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.207; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the leave request, used in correspondence with employees, HR, and payroll teams (e.g., LR-2024-000123).

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the leave request within Workday HCM Absence Management. Tracks progression from initial submission through HR review, approval or denial, and any subsequent cancellation or withdrawal by the employee. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Draft|Submitted|Pending_Approval|Approved|Denied|Cancelled|Withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The employee-requested last calendar date of the leave of absence period. May differ from the approved end date if HR modifies the duration during the approval process.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.300; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The employee-requested first calendar date of the leave of absence period. Used for scheduling, coverage planning, and FMLA eligibility period calculations.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.300; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Actual date the employee returned to active employment following the leave of absence. May differ from the approved end date due to early return, extended leave, or AMA (Against Medical Advice) situations.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.312; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: return_to_work_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the employee's return to work following the leave. Indicates whether the employee returned as scheduled, extended the leave, separated from employment, or has not yet returned.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR §825.312; Workday HCM Absence Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system of record from which the leave request was sourced (e.g., Workday HCM Absence Management, manual HR entry, API integration). Supports data lineage and ETL (Extract Transform Load) audit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee formally submitted the leave request in Workday HCM. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction and is used to measure HR response time SLAs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR §825.300 (notice requirements)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the leave request record in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL (Extract Transform Load) processing and audit trail.

attributes.name: workday_absence_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of the leave request record in the Workday HCM Absence Management source system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and ETL (Extract Transform Load) deduplication.

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: Insurance claim number assigned by the workers compensation carrier for leave requests associated with a workplace injury or illness. Links the leave record to the workers compensation claim for coordinated benefits management.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; State Workers Compensation Statutes

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Comprehensive employee performance management, talent development, and conduct records. Captures performance evaluation cycles (annual, mid-year, probationary), overall ratings, goal achievement, competency ratings, manager feedback, self-assessments, development goals, and review completion status. Includes talent profile data: education history, skills inventory, career interests, mobility preferences, mentorship participation, succession plan inclusion, and high-potential designation. Encompasses progressive discipline records: verbal/written warnings, performance improvement plans (PIPs), suspensions, terminations for cause, policy violations, appeal status, and resolution outcomes. Supports merit increases, promotion eligibility, internal mobility, succession management, workforce planning, and HR compliance documentation. SSOT for all employee performance, talent, and disciplinary data. Sourced from Workday HCM Talent Management.
products.reference: Workday HCM — Talent Management; Performance Management

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each performance review record in the workforce performance management system. Primary key for the performance_review data product.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position held by the worker at the time of the performance review, capturing the role context for the evaluation.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contingent worker who is the subject of this performance review. Links to the workforce worker master record.

attributes.name: review_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the performance review template or form used for this evaluation cycle, defining the rating scales, competency sections, and goal sections applied.

attributes.name: reviewer_worker_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who conducted and submitted the performance review. Typically the direct reporting manager in the supervisory organization.

attributes.name: appeal_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has filed a formal appeal against the performance rating or disciplinary action documented in this review record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Employee Relations Standards

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal appeal was resolved and a final determination was communicated to the employee. Used for HR compliance and legal documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Employee Relations Standards

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employee's formal appeal against the performance rating or disciplinary action. Populated only when appeal_filed is true.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Employee Relations Standards

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance rating for this review was finalized through the HR calibration process. Populated when calibration_status is 'calibrated' or 'approved'.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Status of the performance rating calibration process for this review, indicating whether the rating has been reviewed and validated through the HR calibration session.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: career_interest_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description of the employee's stated career interests, desired roles, and long-term professional aspirations as captured during the performance review discussion.

attributes.name: cme_hours_completed
attributes.description: Total Continuing Medical Education (CME) credit hours completed by the employee during the review period, as relevant for clinical staff performance evaluation and credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Learning; Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME); The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: competency_rating
attributes.description: Composite rating reflecting the employee's demonstration of required competencies (clinical, behavioral, leadership) as defined in the review template for the position.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) Competency Assessment Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this performance review record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HIPAA Security Rule; SOC 2

attributes.name: development_goals_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description of agreed-upon professional development goals, training plans, and career growth objectives established during the performance review discussion.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Talent Development Standards

attributes.name: discipline_type
attributes.description: Type of progressive disciplinary action associated with this review record, if applicable. Captures the formal discipline step per HR policy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|verbal_warning|written_warning|pip|suspension|termination_for_cause — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; OSHA Workplace Safety Standards; OIG Fraud and Abuse Guidelines

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the performance review must be completed and submitted by the manager. Used for HR compliance tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee acknowledged receipt and review of their completed performance evaluation. Required for HR compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; OSHA Workplace Documentation Standards

attributes.name: goal_achievement_rating
attributes.description: Composite rating reflecting the employee's achievement of defined performance goals and objectives for the review period. Distinct from competency ratings.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: is_high_potential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has been formally designated as high-potential (HiPo) during this review cycle, qualifying them for accelerated development programs and succession consideration.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Succession Planning Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this performance review record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HIPAA Security Rule; SOC 2

attributes.name: manager_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the reviewing manager summarizing the employee's performance, strengths, areas for development, and behavioral observations during the review period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Documentation Standards

attributes.name: manager_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manager formally submitted the completed performance review in Workday HCM. Used to measure review completion timeliness against the due date.

attributes.name: mentorship_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently participating in a formal mentorship program (as mentor or mentee) as documented in the talent profile associated with this review.

attributes.name: merit_increase_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for a merit-based compensation increase based on their overall performance rating and HR policy criteria for the review cycle.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Compensation Management Standards

attributes.name: merit_increase_percent
attributes.description: The recommended or approved merit salary increase percentage associated with this performance review outcome. Expressed as a percentage of base salary (e.g., 3.50 = 3.5%).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; GAAP and FASB Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: mobility_preference
attributes.description: Employee's stated preference regarding geographic relocation or mobility for career advancement opportunities, as captured in the talent profile during the review cycle.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The final overall performance rating assigned by the manager for the review period. Drives merit increase eligibility, promotion decisions, and succession planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exceeds_expectations|meets_expectations|partially_meets|does_not_meet|outstanding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score corresponding to the overall performance rating on the defined rating scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00). Enables quantitative comparison and ranking across the workforce for merit and succession analytics.

attributes.name: pip_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) period concludes. Used to track PIP duration and schedule follow-up evaluations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: pip_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) upon conclusion of the PIP period. Drives subsequent HR actions such as continued employment, further discipline, or termination.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: pip_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) was formally initiated for the employee. Populated only when discipline_type is 'pip'.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SHRM Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: policy_violation_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific HR or organizational policy that was violated, if this review is associated with a disciplinary action. Aligns with the HR policy code library.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) HR Standards; OSHA Workplace Safety Standards

attributes.name: promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has been identified as eligible for promotion to a higher-level position based on performance review outcomes and manager recommendation.

attributes.name: review_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal performance review discussion meeting was held between the employee and their manager. Distinct from the manager submission date.

attributes.name: osha_301_completed

attributes.name: reported_datetime

attributes.name: return_to_work_date

attributes.name: severity_level

attributes.name: supervisor_name

attributes.name: treating_provider_name

attributes.name: treatment_facility_name

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: actual_fte

attributes.name: actual_hours

attributes.name: actual_labor_cost

attributes.name: agency_fte
attributes.description: The FTE equivalent of agency or contract labor utilized within this budget line during the fiscal period. Tracked separately from employed FTE for labor cost benchmarking and workforce mix analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Workday HCM; CMS

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this FTE budget allocation was formally approved by the authorized budget authority. Marks the transition from pending to approved status.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the budget authority (e.g., CFO, VP of Finance, Department Director) who approved this FTE budget allocation. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.

attributes.name: benefits_burden_pct
attributes.description: The percentage applied to base wages to account for employer-paid benefits costs (health insurance, retirement, FICA, workers compensation) for this FTE budget line. Used to calculate total labor cost including benefits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Workday HCM; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this FTE budget allocation record, used for cross-system reference between SAP S/4HANA CO and Workday HCM.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this FTE budget allocation record: draft (in preparation), pending_approval (submitted for review), approved (authorized), rejected (denied), or superseded (replaced by a revised version).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Workday HCM; GAAP

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Identifies the version of the FTE budget record: original (initial approved budget), revised (mid-year amendment), final (year-end actuals reconciliation), or forecast (rolling forecast update). Supports budget cycle management.

attributes.name: budgeted_avg_hourly_rate
attributes.description: The budgeted average hourly wage rate in USD for positions covered by this FTE budget line, inclusive of base pay and applicable differentials. Used for labor cost projection and variance analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SAP S/4HANA CO; FLSA

attributes.name: budgeted_fte
attributes.description: The authorized number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions approved for this department, cost center, job family, and fiscal period. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 2.5 FTE). The principal quantitative fact of this budget record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SAP S/4HANA CO; CMS; AHRQ

attributes.name: budgeted_hours
attributes.description: Total authorized worked hours budgeted for this FTE line in the fiscal period. Derived from budgeted FTE and standard hours per period; stored for direct comparison with actual hours from time and attendance.

attributes.name: budgeted_labor_cost
attributes.description: Total authorized labor cost in USD for this FTE budget line for the fiscal period, including base wages, differentials, and benefits burden. Used for workforce financial planning and labor cost management.

attributes.name: budgeted_nonproductive_fte
attributes.description: The portion of the total budgeted FTE allocated to non-productive hours including paid time off (PTO), orientation, education, and leave. Supports total labor cost planning.

attributes.name: budgeted_overtime_fte
attributes.description: The FTE equivalent of overtime hours budgeted for this department and fiscal period. Supports overtime cost management and FLSA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: budgeted_productive_fte
attributes.description: The portion of the total budgeted FTE allocated specifically to productive (direct patient care) hours. Used to calculate staffing ratios and productivity benchmarks per adjusted patient day.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO cost center code to which this FTE budget is financially assigned. Enables labor cost allocation and variance reporting at the cost center level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this FTE budget allocation becomes effective and binding for workforce planning and financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: employment_type

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this FTE budget allocation expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended or current-period budgets. Supports temporal budget management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (quarter Q1–Q4 or accounting period P01–P12) within the fiscal year for which this FTE budget is authorized. Supports monthly and quarterly workforce financial planning cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this FTE budget allocation applies, aligned with the organization's financial planning calendar (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: flsa_classification

attributes.name: fte_variance
attributes.description: The difference between budgeted FTE and actual FTE (budgeted_fte minus actual_fte) for the fiscal period. Positive value indicates under-utilization; negative value indicates over-budget staffing. Supports labor cost variance reporting.

products.name: workforce_provider_network_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between clinical employees (providers) and insurance payers. It captures the credentialing and network participation relationship required for claims submission and reimbursement. Each record links one clinical provider to one payer network with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, including credentialing status, payer-specific provider identifiers, network tier assignments, and participation dates.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, clinical providers (physicians, nurses, allied health professionals) participate in multiple insurance payer networks simultaneously to maximize patient access and reimbursement opportunities. Each payer contracts with many providers across their network. The relationship represents an operational business entity called 'provider network participation' or 'credentialing' that revenue cycle and payer contracting teams actively manage, tracking credentialing status, payer-specific provider numbers, network tier assignments, participation dates, and reimbursement terms for each provider-payer combination.

products.name: clinical_privilege
products.description: This association product represents the credentialing relationship between healthcare workforce members and specific CPT procedures they are authorized to perform. It captures the medical staff services office's privilege granting, competency assessment, and ongoing professional practice evaluation. Each record links one employee (clinician) to one CPT code with privilege-specific attributes including grant/expiration dates, competency level, volume requirements, and supervision needs. This is the operational foundation of medical staff credentialing and delineation of privileges.. Existence Justification: Clinical privileges represent the operational credentialing relationship where healthcare providers (physicians, nurses, allied health) are granted authority to perform specific procedures (CPT codes). In real-world medical staff services operations, a single surgeon holds privileges for 20-200 different CPT codes (e.g., appendectomy, cholecystectomy, hernia repair), and each CPT code has 50+ credentialed clinicians across the health system. The medical staff services office actively manages these privileges with grant/expiration dates, competency assessments, volume requirements, and supervision rules.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association
