products.name: channel_support_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational support assignment between healthcare IT workforce members and interface channels. It captures the tiered support structure (primary, backup, escalation), on-call rotation schedules, and assignment lifecycle for incident management and workforce scheduling. Each record links one employee to one interface channel with role-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this support relationship.. Existence Justification: Healthcare IT operations require multi-tiered support coverage for interface channels (HL7 feeds, FHIR endpoints, Direct messaging). A single interface channel has multiple support staff assigned in different roles (primary, backup, escalation), and a single IT workforce member supports multiple interface channels across different systems. Organizations actively manage these assignments for on-call rotations, incident escalation paths, and workforce scheduling.

products.name: position_procedure_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization relationship between workforce positions and CPT procedure codes. It captures which procedures each position type is credentialed and authorized to perform, including supervision requirements, volume expectations, and training prerequisites. Each record links one position to one CPT code with authorization-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship. Supports competency management, credentialing workflows, and clinical privilege tracking.. Existence Justification: In healthcare workforce management, positions are authorized to perform multiple CPT procedures based on credentials, training, and clinical privileges, and each CPT procedure can be performed by multiple position types with varying authorization levels. The business actively manages position-procedure authorizations as part of credentialing workflows, competency frameworks, and clinical privilege management. This is an operational relationship tracked in medical staff services and HR systems, not an analytical correlation.

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Quality measurement, patient safety, regulatory reporting, and clinical compliance. Owns HEDIS measures, CAHPS surveys, CMS quality programs (VBP - Value-Based Purchasing, MIPS, APM), HAI tracking (CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI), patient safety events, mortality reviews, CDI metrics, TJC survey readiness, CMS Conditions of Participation compliance, and accreditation management. Supports Healthy Planet population health analytics.
domains.references: NCQA HEDIS, CAHPS, CMS VBP, TJC ORYX, AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators, The Joint Commission Core Measures

products.name: hedis_measure
products.description: Master catalog of HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) measures as defined by NCQA. Stores measure specifications, measurement year, eligible population criteria, numerator/denominator definitions, benchmark thresholds, and reporting periods. SSOT for all HEDIS measure definitions used in population health and payer reporting.
products.reference: NCQA HEDIS Measure Specifications

attributes.name: hedis_measure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Measure ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each HEDIS measure record in the master catalog. Primary key for the hedis_measure data product.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: HEDIS measures reference specific versions of CPT, LOINC, and ICD code sets. Quality measure definitions must be tied to code set versions to ensure accurate measure calculation across reporting perio

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: HEDIS measures require documented policies for implementation procedures, data collection methods, and compliance with NCQA specifications. Healthcare organizations must maintain policy documentation

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: HEDIS measures reference CPT code lists in cpt_code_list attribute for procedure-based quality metrics (e.g., preventive screenings, immunizations). Quality systems must validate CPT codes against ref

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: HEDIS measures are plan-specific; health plans define which measures apply for NCQA accreditation and CMS Star Ratings. Plans report measure performance annually to NCQA by product line.

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: HEDIS measures reference ICD-10 code lists in icd10_code_list attribute for denominator/numerator definitions. Quality reporting systems must validate codes against reference tables for NCQA submissio

attributes.name: loinc_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.loinc_code. Business justification: HEDIS measures reference LOINC code lists in loinc_code_list attribute for lab-based quality metrics (e.g., HbA1c control, cholesterol screening). Quality systems must validate LOINC codes against ref

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum patient age (in years) for inclusion in the eligible population for this measure. A null value indicates no upper age limit. Used in conjunction with age_range_min to define the eligible cohort.

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum patient age (in years) for inclusion in the eligible population for this measure. Used to filter patient cohorts in Epic Healthy Planet and population health analytics queries.

attributes.name: allowable_gap_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days of enrollment gap permitted during the continuous enrollment period without disqualifying the patient from the eligible population. Defined per NCQA specifications (e.g., 45 days for most measures).

attributes.name: clinical_area
attributes.description: Clinical or programmatic area the measure addresses (e.g., 'Diabetes', 'Cardiovascular', 'Cancer Screening', 'Behavioral Health', 'Maternal Health', 'Pediatric Care'). Supports clinical program alignment and population health segmentation in Epic Healthy Planet.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Clinical Classifications

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Method used to collect data for the measure: administrative (claims-based), hybrid (claims + medical record review), survey (CAHPS), or electronic clinical data (EHR-based via eCQM). Determines data extraction approach from Epic, Cerner, or claims systems.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS eCQM Framework

attributes.name: continuous_enrollment_days
attributes.description: Number of days of continuous enrollment required for a patient to be included in the eligible population for this measure (e.g., 365 days). Reflects NCQA continuous enrollment specifications used in payer and ACO reporting.

attributes.name: cpt_code_list
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of CPT procedure codes used to identify qualifying services in the numerator or denominator for this measure. Sourced from NCQA Value Sets and AMA CPT coding standards. Used in administrative and hybrid data collection.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Value Sets; AMA CPT Coding Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this HEDIS measure record was first created in the master catalog. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking per HIPAA audit control requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls (45 CFR §164.312(b)); ISO 27001

attributes.name: denominator_definition
attributes.description: Formal definition of the denominator population for this measure — the subset of the eligible population that meets all inclusion criteria and is not excluded. Specifies the patient cohort against which numerator compliance is measured.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Measure Specifications

attributes.name: domain_category
attributes.description: NCQA-defined domain category grouping the measure (e.g., 'Effectiveness of Care', 'Access and Availability of Care'). Used for domain-level performance aggregation and regulatory reporting to CMS and NCQA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Effectiveness of Care|Access and Availability of Care|Experience of Care|Utilization and Risk Adjusted Utilization|Health Plan Descriptive Information|Measures Collected Using Electronic Clinical Data Systems — promote to reference product]
attributes.value_regex: Effectiveness of Care|Access and Availability of Care|Experience of Care|Utilization and Risk Adjusted Utilization|Health Plan Descriptive Information|Measures Collected Using Electronic Clinical Data Systems
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Domain Framework

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: HEDIS Measure Specification Effective End Date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the HEDIS measure specification was retired or superseded. Null for currently active specifications. Enables point-in-time querying of the measure catalog for historical reporting and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Annual Release Calendar

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: HEDIS Measure Specification Effective Start Date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the HEDIS measure specification became effective and applicable for data collection and reporting. Used to manage specification versioning and ensure correct logic is applied to the appropriate measurement year.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Annual Release Calendar

attributes.name: eligible_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the eligible population (initial patient population) for this measure, including age range, diagnosis criteria, enrollment requirements, and continuous enrollment specifications as defined in the NCQA technical specification.

attributes.name: exception_criteria
attributes.description: Description of denominator exceptions — patients who are excluded from the denominator based on medical reasons, patient refusal, or system limitations that are not captured as standard exclusions. Distinct from exclusions in NCQA methodology.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria
attributes.description: Description of denominator exclusions — patients who meet the eligible population criteria but are excluded from the denominator due to medical, patient, or system reasons (e.g., hospice enrollment, contraindications, prior procedures). Critical for accurate rate calculation.

attributes.name: hedis_ecqm_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: HEDIS Electronic Clinical Quality Measure (eCQM) Identifier
attributes.description: CMS-assigned eCQM identifier (e.g., 'CMS122v12') when this HEDIS measure has a corresponding electronic clinical quality measure specification. Enables FHIR-based data extraction from Epic and Cerner for digital quality reporting to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS eCQM Library; HL7 FHIR Quality Reporting; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: hybrid_medical_record_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: HEDIS Hybrid Medical Record Review Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measure requires medical record review as part of the hybrid data collection method. True when administrative data alone is insufficient to satisfy numerator criteria and chart abstraction is required from Epic ClinDoc or Cerner PowerChart.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Hybrid Data Collection Guidelines

attributes.name: icd10_code_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code List
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of ICD-10 diagnosis codes used to identify eligible patients or define the denominator/numerator for this measure. Sourced from NCQA Value Sets and aligned with WHO ICD-10 classification. Used in claims-based and hybrid data extraction.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Value Sets; WHO ICD-10; CMS ICD-10-CM Guidelines

attributes.name: loinc_code_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) Code List
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of LOINC codes for laboratory tests, clinical observations, or assessments used to satisfy numerator criteria for this measure (e.g., HbA1c test codes for CDC measure). Supports EHR-based eCQM data extraction from Beaker LIS and Cerner PathNet.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Value Sets; Regenstrief Institute LOINC Standard

attributes.name: measure_code
attributes.description: Official NCQA-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the HEDIS measure (e.g., CDC, CBP, COL, BCS, AWC). Used as the externally-known business identifier across payer reporting, population health platforms, and Epic Healthy Planet.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Measure Codes Registry

attributes.name: measure_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the HEDIS measure as published by NCQA (e.g., 'Comprehensive Diabetes Care', 'Controlling High Blood Pressure', 'Colorectal Cancer Screening'). Human-readable label used in dashboards, regulatory submissions, and quality reports.

attributes.name: measure_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used short name for the HEDIS measure (e.g., 'CDC', 'CBP'). Used in operational reporting, Tableau dashboards, and Power BI tiles where space is limited.

attributes.name: measure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this HEDIS measure specification record: active (in use for current measurement year), retired (no longer reported), suspended (temporarily paused by NCQA), under review (specification being revised), or new (newly introduced measure). Drives inclusion in reporting workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Annual Updates

attributes.name: measure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measure by its quality measurement type: process (was a service delivered), outcome (did the patient's health improve), patient experience, access, utilization, or structure. Drives interpretation of performance results and benchmarking methodology.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Quality Measure Framework

attributes.name: measure_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the NCQA measure specification (e.g., '2024.1'). Tracks specification changes across measurement years to ensure correct logic is applied during data extraction and reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Annual Updates

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the HEDIS measure is being evaluated and reported (e.g., 2024). Defines the performance period used by NCQA, CMS, and payers for quality benchmarking and value-based contracting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Programs

attributes.name: minimum_performance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable performance rate for this measure below which the organization may face regulatory penalties, payer contract adjustments, or accreditation risk. May reflect CMS floor thresholds, payer contract minimums, or internal quality targets.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Program; NCQA Accreditation Standards; MIPS Quality Category

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HEDIS measure is also reportable under the CMS MIPS quality category for eligible clinicians. True when the measure maps to a MIPS quality measure, enabling dual-reporting workflows and avoiding redundant data collection.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Quality Category; MACRA; CMS Quality Payment Program

attributes.name: national_average_rate
attributes.description: NCQA-published national average (mean) performance rate for this measure and measurement year, expressed as a decimal proportion. Used as a baseline comparison for organizational performance assessment and gap analysis reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks and Thresholds; NCQA Quality Compass

attributes.name: national_benchmark_rate
attributes.description: NCQA-published national benchmark performance rate for this measure and measurement year, expressed as a decimal proportion (e.g., 0.8250 = 82.50%). Represents the 90th percentile or mean threshold used for health plan accreditation and VBP incentive calculations.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks and Thresholds; CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Program

attributes.name: ncqa_program
attributes.description: NCQA quality program under which this measure is reported (e.g., HEDIS, HEDIS MY for Medicare/Medicaid, CAHPS, HOS, PCMH, ACO HEDIS). Determines submission pathway, benchmark set, and accreditation implications.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: ncqa_specification_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official NCQA HEDIS technical specification document for this measure and measurement year. Provides direct access to the authoritative specification for CDI analysts, quality abstractors, and data engineers configuring extraction logic.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Website

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, clarifications, or implementation guidance specific to this measure (e.g., known data quality issues, Epic Healthy Planet configuration notes, payer-specific reporting variations, or CDI workflow instructions).
attributes.references: Internal Quality Governance; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: numerator_definition
attributes.description: Formal definition of the numerator for this measure — the subset of the denominator population that received the required service, met the outcome threshold, or satisfied the measure criteria. Defines what constitutes a compliant event.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Measure Specifications

attributes.name: performance_rate_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher or lower performance rate represents better quality for this measure. 'Higher is better' applies to most preventive care measures; 'lower is better' applies to utilization and adverse event measures (e.g., avoidable ED visits). Critical for correct benchmarking logic.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Health plan product line for which this measure applies: commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, Exchange (ACA Marketplace), or CHIP. NCQA publishes separate technical specifications and benchmarks by product line; this field drives correct specification selection.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications by Product Line; CMS Medicaid/Medicare Quality Programs

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the official HEDIS measurement and reporting period for this measure and measurement year. Services occurring after this date are excluded from the current measurement year calculation.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the official HEDIS measurement and reporting period for this measure and measurement year. Defines the window during which eligible services must occur to count toward numerator compliance.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: reporting_submission_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline date by which HEDIS measure results must be submitted to NCQA, CMS, or the applicable payer for this measurement year. Drives quality reporting project timelines and SLA management for the Quality and Compliance department.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Submission Guidelines; CMS Quality Reporting Deadlines; TJC Survey Readiness

attributes.name: responsible_program
attributes.description: Name of the internal quality program or department responsible for owning, monitoring, and improving performance on this measure (e.g., 'Population Health', 'Diabetes Disease Management', 'Preventive Care', 'Behavioral Health Integration'). Used for accountability assignment in quality governance.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Governance; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: stratification_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the stratification dimensions required for this measure (e.g., 'Age 18-64 / Age 65+', 'Race/Ethnicity per OMB categories', 'Gender'). Populated only when stratification_required is True. Supports health equity analytics and SDOH reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Health Equity Reporting; OMB Race/Ethnicity Standards

attributes.name: stratification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether NCQA requires this measure to be reported with stratified results (e.g., by age group, race/ethnicity, or gender). True when stratification is mandatory for NCQA submission or CMS health equity reporting under SDOH initiatives.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Health Equity Reporting Requirements; SDOH Framework

attributes.name: target_performance_rate
attributes.description: Organization-defined internal target performance rate for this measure and measurement year, expressed as a decimal proportion. Set by the Quality department as a stretch goal above the minimum threshold, used for internal KPI tracking and quality improvement planning.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS MIPS Quality Category; Internal Quality Governance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this HEDIS measure record was most recently modified in the master catalog. Used to detect specification changes, trigger downstream recalculation workflows, and maintain data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls (45 CFR §164.312(b)); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: value_set_oid
attributes.description: Object Identifier (OID) referencing the NCQA-published value set associated with this measure. Used to retrieve the authoritative code lists from the NCQA Value Set Directory and align with HL7 FHIR value set resources for interoperability.
attributes.references: NCQA Value Set Directory; HL7 FHIR R4; OID Registry

products.name: hedis_result
products.description: Transactional records capturing the calculated HEDIS measure performance results for each reporting period and care site or health plan. Stores numerator count, denominator count, exclusion count, rate achieved, benchmark comparison, gap count, and submission status to NCQA or payer. Supports HEDIS hybrid and administrative measure methodologies.
products.reference: NCQA HEDIS Reporting

attributes.name: hedis_result_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Result ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each HEDIS measure performance result record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: billing_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.coverage. Business justification: HEDIS measures are calculated and reported by health plan and product line. Results must link to specific coverage to attribute performance rates to payer contracts, enable product-line stratification

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, clinic, or care site for which this HEDIS measure result is calculated. Supports site-level performance stratification and benchmarking.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; The Joint Commission (TJC) Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim. Business justification: HEDIS results aggregate claim-level data for numerator compliance. Healthcare NCQA audit processes require tracing HEDIS results to source claims for medical record validation and hybrid methodology r

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: HEDIS results must be submitted to NCQA and health plans annually. Compliance system tracks submission status, deadlines, audit requirements, and acceptance for Stars ratings, accreditation, and healt

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: HEDIS performance results directly impact value-based payment adjustments and Medicare Star Ratings, which drive cost center financial performance. Finance teams analyze quality measure results by cos

attributes.name: drg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.drg. Business justification: HEDIS results are stratified by DRG for risk adjustment and case mix analysis in hospital quality reporting. VBP and star rating calculations require DRG-level stratification to ensure fair performanc

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan (HMO, PPO, POS) for which this HEDIS measure result is reported. Supports payer-level performance stratification and NCQA plan accreditation submissions.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings

attributes.name: hedis_measure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HEDIS measure definition record identifying which specific HEDIS measure (e.g., CDC, CBP, BCS, COL) this result is calculated for.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: interface_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.interface_channel. Business justification: HEDIS results are electronically submitted to NCQA and health plans via specific interface channels. Tracking which channel transmitted each result is essential for submission audit trails, troublesho

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: HEDIS results are reported by organizational providers (hospitals, health systems) to NCQA and CMS for quality measurement programs. VBP and Star Ratings require organizational-level performance track

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reporting period definition record that defines the measurement year and period boundaries for this HEDIS result calculation.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Annual Quality Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: research_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_study. Business justification: HEDIS performance rates must stratify or exclude research subjects to prevent investigational interventions from skewing standard care quality benchmarks. CMS and NCQA require separate reporting for r

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Status of the NCQA-required HEDIS Compliance Audit for this measure result. NCQA mandates an annual compliance audit by a licensed HEDIS auditor for health plan submissions. Tracks audit readiness and outcomes.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Compliance Audit Standards; NCQA Auditor Licensure Requirements

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the NCQA-licensed organization that performed or is performing the HEDIS Compliance Audit for this measure result (e.g., Cotiviti, Inovalon, Optum). Required for NCQA accreditation submissions.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Compliance Audit Standards; NCQA Licensed Auditor Registry

attributes.name: benchmark_comparison_result
attributes.description: Categorical result of comparing the organization's performance rate against NCQA national benchmarks. Indicates whether performance is above the 90th percentile, between the 50th and 90th percentile, or below the 50th percentile. Used for accreditation status determination and quality improvement prioritization.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks and Thresholds; NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: calculation_run_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the HEDIS measure calculation was executed to produce this result record. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transactional record. Used for audit trails and recalculation tracking.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Compliance Audit Standards; HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls (45 CFR §164.312(b))

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HEDIS result record was first created and persisted in the silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and record management.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls (45 CFR §164.312(b)); HITRUST CSF Control 09.aa; ISO 27001 A.12.4

attributes.name: data_source_type
attributes.description: Primary data source type used to calculate this HEDIS measure result. Indicates whether the result was derived from administrative claims, EHR clinical data (Epic/Cerner), laboratory data (Beaker/PathNet), pharmacy data (Willow/PharmNet), external registry, or a hybrid combination.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Data Source Validation Requirements

attributes.name: denominator_count
attributes.description: Total count of eligible members or patients who meet the HEDIS measure denominator criteria (initial patient population minus exclusions) for the reporting period. Represents the population at risk for the measure.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Measure Calculation Guidelines

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Count of members or patients who qualify for a medical or patient exception to the measure numerator requirement (e.g., patient refusal, medical contraindication documented by clinician). Distinct from exclusions; exceptions are included in the denominator but not penalized.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Exception Criteria Guidelines

attributes.name: exclusion_count
attributes.description: Count of members or patients removed from the initial patient population due to valid NCQA-defined exclusion criteria (e.g., hospice enrollment, contraindications, prior procedures). Reduces the denominator.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Exclusion Criteria Guidelines

attributes.name: gap_count
attributes.description: Count of members or patients in the denominator who did NOT meet the numerator criteria and have an open care gap. Calculated as denominator_count minus numerator_count minus exception_count. Drives care gap closure outreach and population health interventions.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Program; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: hybrid_sample_size
attributes.description: For hybrid methodology measures, the number of medical records sampled for manual review as part of the HEDIS hybrid data collection process. Null for administrative-only measures. NCQA specifies minimum sample sizes.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Hybrid Methodology Specifications; NCQA Sampling Guidelines

attributes.name: hybrid_supplemental_data_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: HEDIS Hybrid Supplemental Data Used Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supplemental data sources (e.g., EHR data from Epic Healthy Planet, lab data from Beaker, pharmacy data from Willow) were used to supplement administrative claims data in the hybrid measure calculation. True if supplemental data was incorporated.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Supplemental Data Guidelines; NCQA Electronic Clinical Data Systems (ECDS) Specifications

attributes.name: initial_population_count
attributes.description: Total count of members or patients who meet the initial patient population criteria for the HEDIS measure before applying exclusions. Provides the starting universe for denominator calculation.

attributes.name: is_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HEDIS measure result meets NCQA minimum denominator size requirements (typically n≥30) and is eligible for external reporting and submission. False if the denominator is too small for reportable results.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Small Denominator Reporting Rules

attributes.name: is_starred_measure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HEDIS measure is included in the CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings program. True if the measure contributes to the plan's overall Star Rating score, which affects CMS bonus payments and plan marketing.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings Technical Notes; CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The four-digit calendar year for which HEDIS performance is being measured and reported (e.g., 2024). Aligns with NCQA annual measurement year definitions.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Annual Quality Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: methodology_type
attributes.description: Indicates the HEDIS measurement methodology used to calculate this result: administrative (claims-based), hybrid (claims plus medical record review), survey (CAHPS-based), or ECDS (Electronic Clinical Data Systems). Drives data collection and audit requirements.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Hybrid Methodology Guidelines

attributes.name: mips_quality_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Quality Category
attributes.description: Indicates the MIPS performance category this HEDIS measure contributes to under the CMS MACRA/MIPS program. Supports provider-level MIPS quality score calculation and APM reporting.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Quality Measure Specifications; CMS MACRA Final Rule; CMS MIPS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: ncqa_benchmark_percentile_50
attributes.description: NCQA-published national 50th percentile benchmark rate for this HEDIS measure and measurement year. Used to assess whether the organization's performance is at or above the national median.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks and Thresholds; NCQA Quality Compass

attributes.name: ncqa_benchmark_percentile_90
attributes.description: NCQA-published national 90th percentile benchmark rate for this HEDIS measure and measurement year. Represents the high-performance threshold used for NCQA accreditation and CMS Star Rating top-box scoring.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks and Thresholds; NCQA Quality Compass; CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings

attributes.name: numerator_count
attributes.description: Count of eligible members or patients in the denominator who met the HEDIS measure numerator criteria (i.e., received the required service, achieved the clinical threshold, or had the desired outcome) during the measurement period.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Measure Calculation Guidelines

attributes.name: performance_rate
attributes.description: Calculated HEDIS measure performance rate expressed as a decimal proportion (numerator_count / denominator_count). Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.7823 = 78.23%). Used for benchmarking, VBP scoring, and NCQA accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: prior_year_performance_rate
attributes.description: The organization's HEDIS performance rate for this same measure from the immediately preceding measurement year. Enables year-over-year trend analysis and improvement tracking.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Improvement Reporting

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line or line of business for which this HEDIS result is calculated (e.g., Commercial, Medicaid, Medicare, Exchange/Marketplace, CHIP). NCQA publishes separate benchmarks by product line.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings; CMS Medicaid Quality Reporting

attributes.name: rate_change_from_prior_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: HEDIS Rate Change from Prior Year
attributes.description: Difference between the current year performance rate and the prior year performance rate (current minus prior). Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline. Supports trend reporting and VBP improvement scoring.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS VBP Program Improvement Scoring

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the HEDIS measurement period for this result, typically December 31 of the measurement year. Defines the inclusive end boundary for eligible member identification and event capture.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the HEDIS measurement period for this result, typically January 1 of the measurement year. Defines the inclusive start boundary for eligible member identification and event capture.

attributes.name: result_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this HEDIS result record, used in NCQA submissions, payer reporting, and audit trails. Format: HEDIS-{YEAR}-{MEASURE_CODE}-{SITE_CODE}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: result_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for quality analysts and HIM staff to document relevant notes about this HEDIS result, such as data quality issues, audit findings, corrective action plans, or explanations for performance outliers.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Compliance Audit Standards; TJC Quality Improvement Documentation Standards

attributes.name: result_version
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this HEDIS result record, supporting recalculation scenarios where the measure is rerun due to data corrections, supplemental data additions, or audit findings. Version 1 is the initial calculation.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Compliance Audit Standards; NCQA Data Correction and Resubmission Guidelines

attributes.name: star_rating_weight
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned weight factor for this HEDIS measure in the Medicare Advantage Star Ratings composite score calculation. Higher weights indicate greater impact on the overall Star Rating. Null for non-Star measures.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings Technical Notes; CMS HEDIS Measure Weighting Methodology

attributes.name: stratification_category
attributes.description: Population stratification dimension applied to this result record (e.g., age band, gender, race/ethnicity, geographic region, payer mix). Supports health equity analysis and NCQA stratified reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overall|age_18_64|age_65_plus|male|female|race_white|race_black|race_hispanic|geographic_urban|geographic_rural — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Health Equity Reporting Requirements; AHRQ National Healthcare Quality and Disparities Report

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this HEDIS measure result was formally submitted to NCQA or the applicable payer. Used for compliance tracking against NCQA submission deadlines.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Audit and Compliance Standards; NCQA Submission Deadline Calendar

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this HEDIS result record in the submission lifecycle to NCQA or the applicable payer. Tracks progression from internal draft through validation, submission, and acceptance or rejection.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Audit and Compliance Standards; CMS Quality Reporting Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: submission_target
attributes.description: Identifies the recipient organization or program to which this HEDIS result is being submitted (e.g., NCQA for accreditation, CMS for Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, state Medicaid agency, commercial payer, or internal quality reporting only).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Star Ratings; CMS Medicaid Quality Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HEDIS result record was most recently modified (e.g., recalculation, status update, audit finding correction). Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule — Audit Controls (45 CFR §164.312(b)); HITRUST CSF Control 09.aa; ISO 27001 A.12.4

products.name: cahps_survey
products.description: Master and transactional entity for CAHPS (Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems) survey programs and patient responses. Stores program-level data: survey type (Hospital CAHPS, Clinician and Group CAHPS, Home Health CAHPS), survey version, administration mode (mail, phone, mixed), sampling methodology, CMS certification status, and vendor information. Stores response-level data: patient-level survey responses, composite domain scores (communication with doctors, responsiveness of staff, pain management, communication about medicines, discharge information, overall hospital rating), response date, administration mode, and non-response tracking. SSOT for CAHPS survey program definitions and patient experience measurement data. Supports CMS VBP HCAHPS domain scoring and patient experience reporting.
products.reference: CMS CAHPS Survey Program

attributes.name: cahps_survey_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Survey ID
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each CAHPS survey program definition or patient response record in the master and transactional entity.
attributes.references: CMS CAHPS Program; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Program

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: CAHPS surveys are audited for methodology compliance, sampling adequacy, vendor certification, and data integrity by CMS and accrediting bodies. Audit findings impact VBP scores and public reporting.

attributes.name: billing_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.coverage. Business justification: CAHPS surveys assess patient experience by insurance coverage type. Linking enables payer-specific satisfaction scoring, VBP patient experience domain reporting, and stratification by commercial vs. M

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hospital, clinic, or care facility associated with the survey. Used for facility-level CAHPS performance reporting and CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) scoring.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; TJC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician or provider group associated with the survey, applicable for Clinician and Group CAHPS (CG-CAHPS) programs.
attributes.references: CMS CG-CAHPS Survey; NCQA HEDIS; NPI Registry

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: CAHPS surveys measure patient experience for specific health plans. CMS requires plan-level HCAHPS reporting for Hospital VBP and Star Ratings. Survey vendor administers by plan contract.

attributes.name: interface_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.interface_channel. Business justification: CAHPS survey data is transmitted to CMS and survey vendors via interface channels for VBP and Star Ratings programs. Linking enables tracking of submission status, resolving transmission failures, and

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient who received and responded to the CAHPS survey. Links to the patient master record for demographic and encounter context.
attributes.references: CMS CAHPS Program; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Program

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_record. Business justification: CMS HCAHPS and CAHPS programs require documented patient consent before survey administration. Survey vendors must maintain consent records for certification. Links survey administration to regulatory

attributes.name: subject_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.subject_enrollment. Business justification: Patient experience surveys for research subjects require linkage to track whether trial participation affects satisfaction scores and to comply with research-specific CAHPS requirements. AHRQ mandates

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.unit. Business justification: HCAHPS patient experience surveys analyzed at nursing unit level for unit-specific improvement initiatives. Nurse managers review unit-level communication scores, responsiveness ratings, and quietness

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter (inpatient stay, outpatient visit, or home health episode) that triggered the CAHPS survey administration.
attributes.references: CMS CAHPS Program; HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource

attributes.name: administration_mode
attributes.description: Method used to administer the CAHPS survey to the patient. CMS-approved modes include mail, telephone, mixed (mail with telephone follow-up), active interactive voice response (IVR), and web. Affects response rate calculations and mode adjustment factors.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number
attributes.description: CMS Certification Number (CCN) of the hospital or facility submitting HCAHPS data. Used to link survey results to CMS facility records and Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) calculations.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Conditions of Participation; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: cms_submission_date
attributes.description: Date the CAHPS survey data was submitted to CMS for the reporting period. Used to verify timely submission compliance with CMS quality reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Quality Reporting Programs; CMS IQR Program

attributes.name: cms_submission_status
attributes.description: Status of the CAHPS data submission to CMS for the reporting period. Tracks whether data has been submitted, accepted, or requires resubmission for quality reporting compliance.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Quality Reporting Programs; CMS Inpatient Quality Reporting (IQR) Program

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the CAHPS survey record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was discharged from the facility. HCAHPS surveys must be administered between 48 hours and 6 weeks post-discharge. Used to validate survey timing compliance.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: eligible_discharges
attributes.description: Total number of patient discharges or encounters eligible for CAHPS survey sampling during the reporting period, prior to exclusion criteria application.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Reason a patient was excluded from CAHPS survey sampling per CMS eligibility criteria. Includes deceased, no valid address, court-ordered, non-English speaking (if no translated instrument), psychiatric, under 18, or hospice patients. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deceased|no_address|court_ordered|non_english|psychiatric|under_18|hospice|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Eligibility Guidelines

attributes.name: hcahps_linear_mean_score
attributes.description: CMS-calculated linear mean score for the HCAHPS survey submission, used in VBP achievement and improvement scoring. Derived from the HCAHPS Summary Star Rating methodology.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; CMS HCAHPS Star Ratings Methodology

attributes.name: minimum_case_threshold_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAHPS Minimum Case Threshold Met Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility met the CMS minimum case threshold (typically 100 completed surveys) required for public reporting and VBP scoring eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: mode_adjustment_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a CMS-approved mode adjustment factor was applied to the survey scores to account for differences in response patterns across administration modes (mail, telephone, mixed).
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Mode Adjustment Guidelines

attributes.name: overall_hospital_rating
attributes.description: Patient's overall rating of the hospital on a 0-10 numeric scale. Top-box score (9-10) is a key CMS VBP Patient Experience domain metric and publicly reported on Hospital Compare.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; CMS Hospital Compare

attributes.name: patient_mix_adjustment_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether patient-mix adjustment (case-mix adjustment) was applied to HCAHPS scores to account for patient demographic and health status differences across facilities, enabling fair comparisons.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Patient-Mix Adjustment Guidelines

attributes.name: publicly_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CAHPS survey results for this facility and reporting period are publicly reported on CMS Care Compare (formerly Hospital Compare). Facilities must meet minimum case thresholds for public reporting.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Care Compare; CMS Hospital Compare

attributes.name: recommend_hospital
attributes.description: Patient's response to whether they would recommend the hospital to friends and family. Four-point scale: definitely yes, probably yes, probably no, definitely no. Top-box (definitely yes) is publicly reported on Hospital Compare.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; CMS Hospital Compare

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the CAHPS data collection and reporting period. Used to aggregate results for CMS submission and VBP scoring.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the CAHPS data collection and reporting period (typically quarterly or annual). Used to aggregate results for CMS submission and VBP scoring.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: Date the patient completed and returned the CAHPS survey. Used to calculate response lag from discharge and to validate response within the CMS-required window.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: response_language
attributes.description: Language in which the patient completed the CAHPS survey (e.g., English, Spanish, Chinese). CMS provides translated HCAHPS instruments for approved languages. ISO 639-1 two-letter language code.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Translated Instruments; ISO 639-1

attributes.name: response_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a completed survey response was received from the patient. Used in response rate calculations and non-response tracking.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of patients sampled for the CAHPS survey administration period. Used in statistical reliability calculations and CMS reporting.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Sampling Guidelines

attributes.name: sampling_methodology
attributes.description: Statistical sampling approach used to select patients for CAHPS survey administration. CMS allows census (all eligible patients), random sample, or stratified random sample. Affects weighting and representativeness of results.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Sampling Guidelines

attributes.name: score_care_transition
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Care Transition domain of HCAHPS. Measures whether patients understood their care responsibilities and had a clear plan post-discharge. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_cleanliness
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Cleanliness of Hospital Environment Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported score for the Cleanliness of Hospital Environment item of HCAHPS. Measures how often the patient's room and bathroom were kept clean. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_communication_doctors
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Communication with Doctors Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Communication with Doctors domain of HCAHPS. Derived from questions about how often doctors communicated well. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses. Key input to CMS VBP Patient Experience domain.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_communication_medicines
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Communication About Medicines Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Communication About Medicines domain of HCAHPS. Measures how often staff explained medications and side effects. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_communication_nurses
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Communication with Nurses Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Communication with Nurses domain of HCAHPS. Derived from questions about how often nurses communicated well. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_discharge_information
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Discharge Information domain of HCAHPS. Measures whether patients received adequate information about recovery and follow-up care at discharge. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_pain_management
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Pain Management domain of HCAHPS. Measures how well hospital staff helped manage patient pain. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_quietness
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Quietness of Hospital Environment Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported score for the Quietness of Hospital Environment item of HCAHPS. Measures how often the area around the patient's room was quiet at night. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: score_responsiveness_staff
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Responsiveness of Hospital Staff Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Responsiveness of Hospital Staff domain of HCAHPS. Measures how often staff responded promptly to patient needs. Expressed as a percentage (0-100) of top-box responses.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS VBP Program; AHRQ CAHPS Scoring Guidelines

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: CMS HCAHPS Summary Star Rating (1-5 stars) assigned to the facility based on HCAHPS composite and global item scores. Publicly reported on CMS Care Compare website.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Star Ratings Methodology; CMS Care Compare

attributes.name: survey_followup_date
attributes.description: Date of the follow-up contact attempt (second mailing or telephone follow-up) for non-responding patients in mixed-mode administration.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: survey_mailed_date
attributes.description: Date the CAHPS survey was first mailed or initiated to the patient. Used to calculate response windows and follow-up timing per CMS protocols.

attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific CAHPS survey program.
