attributes.name: survey_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the survey administration for a given patient. Tracks progression from sampling through completion or non-response determination per CMS HCAHPS protocols.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; AHRQ CAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the CAHPS survey type indicating the care setting or program type. Drives composite domain scoring logic and CMS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: AHRQ CAHPS Survey Program; CMS HCAHPS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: survey_version
attributes.description: Version number or label of the CAHPS survey instrument used (e.g., HCAHPS v15.0, CG-CAHPS 3.0). Ensures responses are interpreted against the correct question set and scoring methodology.
attributes.references: AHRQ CAHPS Survey Program; CMS HCAHPS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the CAHPS survey record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vbp_patient_experience_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Patient Experience Domain Score
attributes.description: Calculated CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) patient experience domain score derived from HCAHPS composite and global item scores. Used in VBP Total Performance Score (TPS) calculation affecting Medicare reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS VBP Program; CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: vendor_certification_number
attributes.description: CMS-issued certification number for the approved CAHPS survey vendor. Required for HCAHPS data submission validation and CMS audit purposes.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Vendor Certification Program

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the CMS-approved survey vendor contracted to administer the CAHPS survey on behalf of the facility. CMS requires use of an approved vendor for HCAHPS submission.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey; CMS Approved Survey Vendors List

products.name: cahps_response
products.description: Transactional records of individual patient responses to CAHPS surveys. Captures patient-level survey responses, composite domain scores (communication with doctors, responsiveness of staff, pain management, communication about medicines, discharge information, overall hospital rating), response date, administration mode, and non-response tracking. Supports CMS VBP HCAHPS reporting.
products.reference: HCAHPS Survey — CMS

attributes.name: cahps_response_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) Response ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual CAHPS survey response record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: billing_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.coverage. Business justification: Individual survey responses must tie to patient's active coverage at service time for accurate payer-specific satisfaction scoring. Replaces denormalized payer_type with proper FK to coverage, enablin

attributes.name: cahps_survey_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific CAHPS survey instrument version administered to the patient. Links to the survey definition including question set, version, and CMS program year.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hospital or care facility where the patient received care. Used for facility-level HCAHPS reporting to CMS and internal benchmarking.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: Individual CAHPS responses roll up to plan-level scores for CMS Star Ratings and public reporting. Payer type on response determines applicable measure set and benchmarks.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient who completed or was sampled for the CAHPS survey. Links to the patient master record. Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_record. Business justification: Individual survey responses must be traceable to consent documentation for vendor certification and regulatory audits. CMS requires consent verification at response level for publicly reported HCAHPS

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inpatient or outpatient encounter that triggered the CAHPS survey sampling. Used to link survey responses back to the clinical episode for Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) reporting.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: adjusted_composite_score
attributes.description: The overall case-mix and mode-adjusted HCAHPS composite score for this response, calculated per CMS linear mean scoring methodology. Adjusts for patient mix differences (age, education, health status, service category, language) to enable fair hospital comparisons.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: administration_mode
attributes.description: The method used to administer the CAHPS survey to the patient. CMS-approved modes include mail, telephone, mail with telephone follow-up, active interactive voice response (IVR), and web. Affects response rate benchmarking and mode adjustment factors.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: care_transition_score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Care Transition domain. Derived from questions about whether staff took patient preferences into account, understood the purpose of medications, and knew what to do if concerned after discharge. Scored on a 0–100 scale.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number
attributes.description: The six-digit CMS Certification Number (CCN) identifying the hospital for HCAHPS submission to the CMS Quality Net portal. Required for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Quality Net Submission Requirements; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: The total number of contact attempts made to the patient by the survey vendor (mailings sent, telephone calls placed). Used to document vendor compliance with CMS minimum contact attempt requirements.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CAHPS response record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per HIPAA and HITRUST CSF.

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: The date the patient was discharged from the inpatient encounter that triggered the CAHPS survey. CMS requires surveys to be administered between 48 hours and 6 weeks post-discharge.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: discharge_information_score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Discharge Information domain. Derived from questions about whether patients received written information about symptoms to watch for and understood their care responsibilities after discharge. Scored on a 0–100 scale.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: doctor_communication_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Communication with Doctors Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Communication with Doctors domain of the HCAHPS survey. Derived from questions about how often doctors communicated clearly, listened carefully, and explained things in an understandable way. Scored on a 0–100 scale per CMS methodology.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: education_level
attributes.description: Patient's self-reported highest level of education completed as captured on the CAHPS survey. Used as a case-mix adjustment covariate in CMS HCAHPS linear mean score methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 8th_grade_or_less|some_high_school|high_school_graduate|some_college|4_year_college_graduate|more_than_4_year_college — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: first_contact_date
attributes.description: The date of the first survey contact attempt (initial mailing or first telephone call) made to the patient. Used to track the survey administration timeline and compliance with CMS contact windows.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: hospital_environment_score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Hospital Environment domain covering cleanliness and quietness of the hospital environment. Scored on a 0–100 scale per CMS HCAHPS methodology.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: ineligibility_reason
attributes.description: The specific reason a patient was excluded from the HCAHPS survey sampling frame. Populated only when is_eligible is False. Used for sampling frame documentation and CMS audit compliance.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: is_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient met all CMS eligibility criteria for HCAHPS survey inclusion (e.g., age 18+, non-psychiatric admission, non-excluded diagnosis, minimum one-night stay). Ineligible patients are excluded from the sampling frame.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: is_sampled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligible patient was selected into the HCAHPS survey sample for the reporting period. Hospitals may use census or random sampling per CMS guidelines.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: language_of_response
attributes.description: The ISO 639-2 three-letter language code indicating the language in which the patient completed the CAHPS survey. CMS requires survey vendors to offer surveys in multiple languages. Used for language-stratified response rate analysis.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; ISO 639-2

attributes.name: length_of_stay_days
attributes.description: The number of inpatient days for the encounter associated with this survey. Used as a case-mix adjustment covariate in HCAHPS linear mean score calculations per CMS methodology.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: medicine_communication_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Communication About Medicines Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Communication About Medicines domain. Derived from questions about how often staff explained the purpose of new medications and described possible side effects. Scored on a 0–100 scale per CMS methodology.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number assigned to the patient in the source Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. Used for survey sampling frame construction and de-duplication. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Patient Resource

attributes.name: nurse_communication_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Communication with Nurses Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Communication with Nurses domain of the HCAHPS survey. Derived from questions about how often nurses communicated clearly, listened carefully, and explained things in an understandable way. Scored on a 0–100 scale per CMS methodology.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: overall_hospital_rating
attributes.description: Patient's overall rating of the hospital on a 0–10 numeric scale as reported on the HCAHPS survey. A key individual measure used in CMS VBP Patient Experience of Care domain scoring.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: pain_management_score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Pain Management domain. Derived from questions about how often staff did everything they could to help with pain and how often pain was well controlled. Scored on a 0–100 scale. Note: CMS removed this domain from VBP scoring in 2018 due to opioid concerns; retained for historical trending.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program Historical

attributes.name: patient_service_line
attributes.description: The clinical service line associated with the patient's inpatient stay (e.g., cardiology, orthopedics, oncology, obstetrics). Used for service-line-level HCAHPS performance stratification and internal benchmarking.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; TJC Survey Readiness Standards

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The CMS fiscal year for which this CAHPS response contributes to Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) performance scoring and MIPS quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS VBP Program; MACRA MIPS Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: recommend_hospital
attributes.description: Patient's response to the HCAHPS question asking whether they would recommend the hospital to friends and family. One of four ordinal response options. Used in CMS VBP Patient Experience of Care domain.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: reporting_quarter
attributes.description: The CMS reporting quarter in which this survey response is included for HCAHPS public reporting and Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) scoring. Format: YYYYQn (e.g., 2024Q1).
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the patient completed and returned the CAHPS survey. Used to determine the survey reporting period and CMS submission quarter.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: The disposition of the survey attempt indicating whether the patient completed the survey or the reason for non-response. Used for response rate calculation and CMS non-response bias analysis.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: sampling_date
attributes.description: The date the patient was selected into the CAHPS survey sample from the eligible discharge population. Used for sampling frame documentation and CMS audit trail.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: self_reported_health_status
attributes.description: Patient's self-reported general health status as captured on the CAHPS survey. Used as a case-mix adjustment covariate in CMS HCAHPS linear mean score methodology to account for patient mix differences across hospitals.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The CMS-defined patient service category for the inpatient stay: Medical, Surgical, or Maternity. Used as a case-mix adjustment variable in HCAHPS scoring and for CMS VBP stratified reporting.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this CAHPS survey response record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL audit in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: staff_responsiveness_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCAHPS Responsiveness of Hospital Staff Composite Score
attributes.description: Patient-reported composite score for the Responsiveness of Hospital Staff domain. Derived from questions about how often patients received help as soon as they wanted when using the call button or needing to use the bathroom. Scored on a 0–100 scale.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: The specific CAHPS instrument type administered. HCAHPS is the Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems used for CMS VBP reporting. Other types support outpatient and specialty settings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HCAHPS|CGCAHPS|PCMH_CAHPS|ED_CAHPS|OAS_CAHPS|ICH_CAHPS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AHRQ CAHPS Program; CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: top_box_doctor_communication
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient provided the most favorable (top-box) response for the Communication with Doctors composite domain. CMS VBP scoring uses top-box percentage rates across the patient population.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: top_box_nurse_communication
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient provided the most favorable (top-box) response for the Communication with Nurses composite domain. Used in CMS VBP Patient Experience of Care domain top-box rate calculation.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: top_box_overall_rating
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient gave an overall hospital rating of 9 or 10 (top-box threshold per CMS methodology). Used in CMS VBP Patient Experience of Care domain scoring.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: top_box_recommend
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient responded 'Definitely Yes' to the hospital recommendation question (top-box threshold per CMS methodology). Used in CMS VBP Patient Experience of Care domain scoring.
attributes.references: CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CAHPS response record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse. Used for incremental load processing and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: vbp_patient_experience_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Patient Experience of Care Score
attributes.description: The individual patient-level contribution score to the CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Patient Experience of Care domain, calculated from HCAHPS composite and global measures per CMS scoring methodology.
attributes.references: CMS VBP Program; CMS HCAHPS Survey Administration and Specifications Manual

products.name: patient_safety_event
products.description: Transactional record of patient safety events and their formal investigations. Captures event data: event type, harm level (NCC MERP or Severity of Harm scale), event description, contributing factors, immediate actions taken, patient outcome, disclosure status, and regulatory reporting obligations (TJC sentinel event, CMS). Captures investigation data: review type (RCA, ACA, apparent cause), review team members, root causes identified, contributing factors analysis, action plan items, corrective action due dates, completion status, and effectiveness verification. SSOT for the full patient safety event lifecycle from initial report through root cause analysis to action plan completion. Supports TJC sentinel event review, CMS Conditions of Participation compliance, and organizational patient safety culture.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this mortality case was identified as having a potential impact on the facility's Case Mix Index (CMI) due to coding gaps or Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) opportunities. Supports CDI program prioritization.
attributes.references: CMS DRG Grouper; 3M Health Information Systems CDI; CMS CMI Reporting

attributes.name: cms_mortality_measure_code
attributes.description: Specific CMS mortality outcome measure identifier (e.g., MORT-30-AMI, MORT-30-HF, MORT-30-PN, MORT-30-COPD, MORT-30-STK) applicable to this mortality case. Populated when cms_mortality_measure_flag is true.
attributes.references: CMS IQR Program; CMS Hospital Compare Mortality Measures; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: cms_mortality_measure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mortality case is included in a CMS Hospital Inpatient Quality Reporting (IQR) mortality outcome measure (e.g., AMI-30-day, HF-30-day, PN-30-day mortality). Supports CMS quality program reporting and VBP scoring.
attributes.references: CMS IQR Program Mortality Measures; CMS VBP Program; CMS Hospital Compare

attributes.name: committee_findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the peer review committee's findings regarding the mortality case, including clinical assessment, care quality observations, and determination rationale. Protected under peer review privilege in most jurisdictions. Confidential business data.
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; State Peer Review Privilege Statutes; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: committee_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the peer review committee formally convened to review this mortality case. Supports compliance tracking against medical staff bylaws and TJC peer review timeliness requirements.
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: confidentiality_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mortality review record is protected under state peer review privilege statutes, restricting discoverability in legal proceedings. Critical for legal and compliance governance of peer review documentation.
attributes.references: State Peer Review Privilege Statutes; HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164; OIG Peer Review Guidance; TJC MS.08.01.01

attributes.name: contributing_factor_1
attributes.description: Primary contributing clinical factor identified by the peer review committee as having contributed to the patient's death (e.g., delayed diagnosis, medication error, communication failure, system failure). Supports root cause analysis and quality improvement planning.
attributes.references: AHRQ Common Formats for Patient Safety Reporting; TJC Sentinel Event Policy; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: contributing_factor_2
attributes.description: Secondary contributing clinical factor identified by the peer review committee. Captures additional systemic or clinical issues beyond the primary factor that contributed to the mortality outcome.
attributes.references: AHRQ Common Formats for Patient Safety Reporting; TJC Sentinel Event Policy

attributes.name: contributing_factor_3
attributes.description: Tertiary contributing clinical factor identified by the peer review committee. Supports comprehensive root cause analysis when multiple systemic issues are identified.
attributes.references: AHRQ Common Formats for Patient Safety Reporting; TJC Sentinel Event Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mortality review record was first created in the quality management system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: days_from_admission_to_death
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed between the patient's admission date and the date of death. Supports Length of Stay (LOS) analysis, early mortality detection (death within 24-48 hours), and CMS mortality outcome measure stratification.
attributes.references: CMS IQR Mortality Measures; AHRQ ALOS Benchmarks; TJC PI.02.01.01

attributes.name: death_classification
attributes.description: Clinical classification of the death as expected (consistent with terminal prognosis or end-of-life care plan) or unexpected (unanticipated given the patient's clinical condition). Core field for CMS mortality outcome measures and peer review triage.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Inpatient Quality Reporting (IQR) Program; AHRQ PSI-04 Death Among Surgical Inpatients; TJC PI.02.01.01

attributes.name: death_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the patient death occurred. Principal real-world event date for the mortality review. Used in CMS mortality outcome measure calculations and TJC accreditation reporting. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.514; CMS IQR Mortality Measures; ICD-10-CM Death Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: death_location_type
attributes.description: Clinical care setting within the facility where the patient death occurred (e.g., ICU, ED, OR, inpatient unit). Supports unit-level mortality analysis and identification of high-risk care areas. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient_unit|icu|ed|or|pacu|step_down|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13; AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators (PSI)

attributes.name: death_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time of patient death as documented in the Electronic Health Record (EHR). Used for time-of-day analysis, shift-level mortality reporting, and clinical event sequencing. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Observation Resource; TJC RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: dnr_status_at_death
attributes.business_glossary_term: Do Not Resuscitate (DNR) Status at Time of Death
attributes.description: Patient's resuscitation code status at the time of death as documented in the EHR. Informs the expected vs. unexpected death classification and supports advance directive compliance review. Relevant to EMTALA and CMS Patient Rights Conditions of Participation.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13 Patient Rights; EMTALA; TJC RI.01.05.01

attributes.name: hai_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) — such as CLABSI, CAUTI, or SSI — was identified as a contributing factor to the patient's death. Supports HAI mortality linkage reporting to CMS and CDC National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN).
attributes.references: CDC NHSN HAI Reporting; CMS Hospital-Acquired Condition (HAC) Reduction Program; TJC NPSG.07

attributes.name: hai_type
attributes.description: Specific type of Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) linked to this mortality case when hai_related_flag is true. Values include CLABSI (Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection), CAUTI (Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infection), SSI (Surgical Site Infection), C. diff, VAP, MRSA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clabsi|cauti|ssi|cdiff|vap|mrsa|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDC NHSN HAI Definitions; CMS HAC Reduction Program; TJC NPSG.07

attributes.name: hospice_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient was enrolled in a hospice program at the time of or prior to the encounter. Supports expected death classification and CMS hospice quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Hospice Conditions of Participation §418; CMS IQR Program

attributes.name: improvement_recommendation
attributes.description: Narrative description of quality improvement recommendations issued by the peer review committee as a result of this mortality review. Drives performance improvement plans and TJC survey readiness activities. Protected under peer review privilege.
attributes.references: TJC PI.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.21 Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI); OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: mips_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mortality case is reportable under the Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) quality performance category for the attending provider. Supports MACRA/MIPS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Program; MACRA (Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act); CMS Quality Payment Program (QPP)

attributes.name: palliative_care_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the palliative care team was involved in the patient's care during the encounter. Supports expected death classification validation and end-of-life care quality metrics.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13; NCQA HEDIS Palliative Care Measures; TJC PC.04.02.01

attributes.name: preventability_determination
attributes.description: Peer review committee's determination of whether the death was preventable, potentially preventable, not preventable, or indeterminate based on clinical evidence review. Core outcome field for quality improvement and CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) reporting.
attributes.references: CMS VBP Program; AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators; TJC PI.02.01.01; OIG Fraud and Abuse Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_cause_of_death_description
attributes.description: Plain-language description of the primary underlying cause of death corresponding to the ICD-10 code. Supports readability in committee reports and regulatory submissions without requiring code lookup.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10 Classification; CMS IQR Program

attributes.name: primary_icd10_cause_of_death
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary ICD-10 Cause of Death Code
attributes.description: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) code representing the primary underlying cause of death as coded by Health Information Management (HIM). Used for mortality statistics, DRG grouping, and CMS quality measure reporting.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10 Classification; CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; NCHS Cause of Death Coding

attributes.name: readmission_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient was readmitted within 30 days of a prior discharge and died during the readmission encounter. Supports CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) mortality linkage analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP); CMS IQR Readmission Measures

attributes.name: review_case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric case number assigned by the quality department or peer review committee to uniquely identify and track this mortality review case across systems and correspondence.
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_completed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mortality review was formally completed and findings were finalized by the peer review committee. Used to calculate review cycle time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal mortality review process was initiated by the quality department. Used to measure timeliness of review initiation against TJC and internal SLA standards.
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the mortality review case. Tracks progression from initial case opening through committee review to final closure. Drives quality dashboard reporting and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_trigger_type
attributes.description: Criterion or event that triggered the formal mortality review (e.g., unexpected death, post-surgical death, death within 24 hours of admission, Against Medical Advice (AMA) discharge followed by death, readmission death). Determines review pathway and committee assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unexpected_death|surgical_death|icu_death|ed_death|readmission_death|ama_death|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TJC Medical Staff Standards MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22; AHRQ PSI

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) has been mandated for this mortality case, either due to sentinel event classification or internal quality policy. Triggers RCA workflow in the quality management system.
attributes.references: TJC Sentinel Event Policy SE.04.01.01; AHRQ Patient Safety Improvement; CMS QAPI §482.21

attributes.name: sentinel_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this mortality case has been classified as a TJC Sentinel Event requiring a formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective action plan submission to The Joint Commission.
attributes.references: TJC Sentinel Event Policy; TJC CAMH SE.04.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.21

attributes.name: surgical_case_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient underwent a surgical procedure during the encounter associated with this mortality review. Triggers AHRQ PSI-04 (Death Among Surgical Inpatients) measure inclusion and surgical mortality peer review pathway.
attributes.references: AHRQ PSI-04 Death Among Surgical Inpatients; CMS IQR Program; TJC Surgical Care Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this mortality review record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF

products.name: vbp_program
products.description: Master entity for CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) program participation and performance tracking. Stores program year, domain weights (clinical outcomes, person and community engagement, safety, efficiency and cost reduction), baseline and performance period definitions, total performance score methodology, and payment adjustment factor. SSOT for VBP program configuration.
products.reference: CMS Hospital VBP Program

attributes.name: vbp_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) program record. Primary key for this master configuration entity.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR Part 412

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: VBP programs define withhold rates (1-2% of Medicare payments) and payment adjustment factors that directly impact annual operating budgets. Finance teams budget specifically for VBP penalties/incenti

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_submission. Business justification: VBP programs require regulatory submissions to CMS for performance data, quality measure results, attestations, and payment adjustment calculations. Compliance system tracks submission status, deadlin

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: VBP programs are payer-sponsored quality initiatives. Each program is administered by a specific payer for their contracted providers. Payer defines measure set, payment methodology, and performance t

attributes.name: promoting_interoperability_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.promoting_interoperability. Business justification: VBP programs include Promoting Interoperability (formerly Meaningful Use) as a scored domain with defined weight. This link connects VBP program configuration to PI measure attestations, enabling calc

attributes.name: quality_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_program. Business justification: vbp_program represents specific VBP (Value-Based Purchasing) program instances, while quality_program is the master portfolio entity for all quality programs. This FK connects VBP programs to the broa

attributes.name: achievement_benchmark_percentile
attributes.description: National performance percentile representing the benchmark (top performance) for achievement scoring. Typically set at the 95th percentile of baseline period national performance.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: achievement_threshold_percentile
attributes.description: National performance percentile that a hospital must exceed to earn achievement points for a given measure. Typically set at the 50th percentile of baseline period national performance.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: applicable_provider_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare provider or facility to which this VBP program configuration applies. Determines eligibility rules, measure sets, and payment adjustment calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acute_care_hospital|critical_access_hospital|psychiatric_hospital|long_term_care|skilled_nursing_facility|home_health_agency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS Provider Enrollment; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality leadership role (e.g., Chief Quality Officer, VP Quality) who approved this VBP program configuration for use in performance tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; TJC Survey Readiness; OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the VBP program configuration was formally approved by quality leadership for operational use. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; TJC Survey Readiness; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: baseline_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the baseline period used to establish benchmark performance scores for achievement scoring calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: baseline_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the baseline period used to establish benchmark performance scores against which the performance period is compared for achievement scoring.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: cahps_survey_vendor_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAHPS Survey Approved Vendor Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether hospitals must use a CMS-approved CAHPS survey vendor to collect patient experience data for the Person and Community Engagement domain. True for HVBP programs.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CAHPS Hospital Survey; 42 CFR §412.163; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: clinical_outcomes_domain_weight
attributes.description: Proportional weight assigned to the Clinical Outcomes domain in the Total Performance Score (TPS) calculation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%). Includes mortality, complications, and readmission measures.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: cms_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Program Identifier
attributes.description: Official CMS-assigned program identifier used in federal regulatory filings, CMS Quality Reporting systems, and QualityNet submissions. Serves as the external reference key for CMS correspondence.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CMS QualityNet; 42 CFR §412.160

attributes.name: correction_window_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: VBP Score Correction Window End Date
attributes.description: Deadline by which hospitals must submit data corrections or reconsideration requests following the preview report release. After this date, scores are finalized for payment adjustment calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.166; CMS QualityNet

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBP program configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: efficiency_cost_reduction_weight
attributes.business_glossary_term: Efficiency and Cost Reduction Domain Weight
attributes.description: Proportional weight assigned to the Efficiency and Cost Reduction domain in the TPS calculation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%). Includes Medicare Spending Per Beneficiary (MSPB) measure.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: federal_register_notice
attributes.description: Federal Register citation (volume, page, and date) for the CMS IPPS Final Rule that established this program year's VBP parameters (e.g., '88 FR 49000, July 31, 2023'). Supports regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS Final Rule; Federal Register; ACA Section 3001; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: final_score_publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which CMS publicly releases final Total Performance Scores (TPS) and payment adjustment factors for all participating hospitals. Triggers the payment adjustment application in the payment year.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.166; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Federal fiscal year (October 1 – September 30) to which this VBP program configuration applies (e.g., 2024 for FY2024). Drives payment adjustment calculations and performance period alignment.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: is_new_measure_set
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program year introduces a new or substantially revised measure set compared to the prior fiscal year. Triggers additional staff education, CDI workflow updates, and quality committee review.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CMS Measure Management System; TJC Survey Readiness

attributes.name: max_achievement_points
attributes.description: Maximum number of achievement points a hospital can earn per measure under the VBP scoring methodology (typically 10 points).
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: max_domain_score
attributes.description: Maximum possible score achievable within any single domain before weighting is applied. Used to normalize domain scores to a common scale for TPS calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: max_improvement_points
attributes.description: Maximum number of improvement points a hospital can earn per measure under the VBP scoring methodology (typically 9 points).
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: max_payment_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Maximum payment adjustment factor (multiplier) that can be applied to a hospital's Medicare IPPS payments under this program year. Values above 1.0000 represent a net payment bonus.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: max_tps
attributes.description: Maximum possible Total Performance Score (TPS) a hospital can achieve under this program year configuration. Defines the upper bound for payment adjustment factor calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: measure_set_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the CMS-published measure set applicable to this program year (e.g., 'FY2024-v1.2'). Tracks changes in included measures, specifications, and exclusion criteria across program years.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CMS Measure Management System; NQF Measure Endorsement

attributes.name: min_case_volume_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Case Volume Required for Measure Eligibility
attributes.description: Minimum number of eligible cases required for a measure to be scored for a hospital. Measures with case volumes below this threshold are suppressed from scoring to ensure statistical reliability.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule; AHRQ Statistical Reliability Standards

attributes.name: min_measure_count_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Measure Count Required for Scoring
attributes.description: Minimum number of measures a hospital must have reportable data for in order to receive a domain score and be included in VBP payment adjustment calculations. Hospitals below this threshold are excluded from VBP.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: min_payment_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Minimum payment adjustment factor (multiplier) that can be applied to a hospital's Medicare IPPS payments under this program year. Values below 1.0000 represent a net payment reduction.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: nqf_alignment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Quality Forum (NQF) Measure Alignment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all measures in this program year's measure set are endorsed by the National Quality Forum (NQF). NQF endorsement is a CMS requirement for VBP measure inclusion.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; NQF Measure Endorsement Policy; ACA Section 3001

attributes.name: payment_adjustment_formula
attributes.description: Narrative or coded description of the formula used to translate the Total Performance Score (TPS) into a payment adjustment factor. Documents the linear exchange function parameters published in the CMS IPPS Final Rule.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: Federal fiscal year in which the VBP payment adjustment (bonus or penalty) is applied to Medicare IPPS payments. Typically lags the performance period by approximately two years.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: performance_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the performance period during which hospital quality data is collected and measured for VBP scoring.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: performance_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the performance period during which hospital quality data is collected and measured for VBP scoring. Distinct from the baseline period.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: person_community_engagement_weight
attributes.business_glossary_term: Person and Community Engagement Domain Weight
attributes.description: Proportional weight assigned to the Person and Community Engagement domain (formerly Patient Experience / CAHPS) in the TPS calculation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%).
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CAHPS Hospital Survey; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: preview_report_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which CMS releases preliminary VBP performance scores to hospitals for review and correction prior to final score publication. Hospitals have a defined review and correction window following this date.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.166; CMS QualityNet

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known CMS-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this VBP program configuration (e.g., VBP-IPPS-2024). Used in CMS reporting submissions and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CMS-1533-F; 42 CFR §412.160

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the VBP program year configuration, including key policy changes from the prior year, new measures added, measures removed, and notable methodology updates.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official CMS-designated name of the VBP program (e.g., 'Hospital Value-Based Purchasing Program FY2024'). Used in regulatory reports, dashboards, and executive communications.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; ACA Section 3001

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VBP program configuration. 'active' indicates the program is in effect for the current fiscal year; 'pending' indicates approved but not yet effective; 'archived' indicates a prior program year record retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VBP program variant: HVBP (Hospital VBP), PVBP (Physician VBP), ESRD_QIP (End-Stage Renal Disease Quality Incentive Program), SNF_VBP (Skilled Nursing Facility VBP), HH_VBP (Home Health VBP). Determines applicable domain weights and scoring methodology.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.160; ACA Section 3001

attributes.name: qualitynet_program_code
attributes.description: Program code used within the CMS QualityNet reporting portal for data submission, preview reports, and final VBP scoring. Required for electronic data interchange with CMS.
attributes.references: CMS QualityNet; CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; HL7 FHIR Quality Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_rule_citation
attributes.description: Primary federal regulatory citation governing this VBP program year (e.g., '42 CFR Part 412 Subpart O'). Used for compliance documentation, audit support, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR Part 412; ACA Section 3001; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: safety_domain_weight
attributes.description: Proportional weight assigned to the Safety domain in the TPS calculation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.25 = 25%). Includes HAI measures such as CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI, and MRSA.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CDC NHSN; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: total_domain_weight_check
attributes.description: Sum of all four domain weights (clinical outcomes + person and community engagement + safety + efficiency and cost reduction). Must equal 1.0000 (100%) for a valid program configuration. Used for data quality validation and audit.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: tps_methodology
attributes.description: Scoring methodology used to calculate the Total Performance Score (TPS). 'achievement_improvement_higher' selects the higher of achievement or improvement scores per measure; 'achievement_only' uses only achievement; 'improvement_only' uses only improvement.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; 42 CFR §412.163; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBP program configuration record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: withhold_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of Medicare IPPS base operating DRG payments withheld from all participating hospitals to fund the VBP incentive pool, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 = 2.0%). Established annually by CMS per ACA mandate.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; ACA Section 3001; 42 CFR §412.160; CMS IPPS Final Rule

products.name: measure

Consolidates all measure definitions including HEDIS measures formerly tracked separately. SSOT for all enterprise quality measure definitions.
products.reference: NQF Measure Registry; CMS eCQM Library

attributes.name: measure_id
attributes.description: Primary key for measure

attributes.name: cpt_code_set
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or value set reference of CPT procedure codes used in the measure logic (e.g., qualifying visit codes, procedure codes for numerator events). References the official value set OID where applicable.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards; CMS eCQM Value Sets

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measure record was first created in the enterprise quality catalog. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls (45 CFR §164.312); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary source system or data type used to calculate the measure (e.g., EHR, claims, registry, survey, ADT, lab, pharmacy, manual abstraction, hybrid). attributes.name: denominator_definition
attributes.description: Formal definition of the denominator population — the eligible patient or encounter population to which the measure applies (e.g., 'All patients aged 65+ with at least one qualifying visit during the measurement period').
attributes.references: NQF Measure Specification; CMS eCQM Library; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: denominator_exception
attributes.description: Criteria allowing removal of patients from the denominator for clinical or patient-choice reasons that do not constitute exclusions (e.g., 'Patient declined vaccination — documented medical reason'). Distinct from exclusions; applies to process measures only.
attributes.references: NQF Measure Specification; CMS eCQM Library

attributes.name: denominator_exclusion
attributes.description: Criteria for excluding patients or encounters from the denominator (e.g., 'Patients with documented allergy to influenza vaccine'). Null if no exclusions apply. Critical for accurate measure calculation.
attributes.references: NQF Measure Specification; CMS eCQM Library; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this measure was retired or deactivated in the enterprise quality catalog. Null for currently active measures. Enables point-in-time historical reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this measure became effective and active in the enterprise quality catalog. Supports historical trending and measure lifecycle management.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: eligible_population_criteria
attributes.description: Initial patient population criteria defining who is eligible to be included in the measure calculation (age range, diagnosis codes, encounter types, payer types, etc.). Serves as the outermost filter before denominator logic is applied.
attributes.references: NQF Measure Specification; CMS eCQM Library; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: floor_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable performance rate (as a percentage) below which the organization is subject to payment penalties or accreditation risk. Distinct from the benchmark target; represents the regulatory floor.
attributes.references: CMS VBP Program; CMS Conditions of Participation; TJC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: hai_category
attributes.description: For HAI-related measures, identifies the specific infection type tracked: CLABSI (Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection), CAUTI (Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infection), SSI (Surgical Site Infection), MRSA, CDI (C. difficile), VAE (Ventilator-Associated Event), or NONE for non-HAI measures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CLABSI|CAUTI|SSI|MRSA|CDI|VAE|NONE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS HAI Reporting; CDC National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN); CMS IQR

attributes.name: higher_is_better
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher measure rate represents better performance (True) or worse performance (False). For example, vaccination rates are higher-is-better; readmission rates are lower-is-better. Critical for correct performance scoring logic.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Measure Polarity Standards; NQF Measure Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: icd10_code_set
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code Set
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or value set reference of ICD-10 diagnosis codes used in the measure's eligible population, numerator, or denominator logic (e.g., 'E11.9, E11.65'). References the official value set OID where applicable.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM; WHO ICD Classification; CMS eCQM Value Sets

attributes.name: loinc_code_set
attributes.business_glossary_term: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) Code Set
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or value set reference of LOINC codes used in the measure logic for laboratory results, clinical observations, or survey instruments (e.g., HbA1c result codes for diabetes measures).
attributes.references: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes); Regenstrief Institute; CMS eCQM Value Sets

attributes.name: measure_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the measure within the enterprise catalog. Used as the business-facing key across reporting systems and dashboards.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: measure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the measure by its methodological type per NQF/CMS taxonomy: process (care delivery steps), outcome (patient results), structural (organizational capacity), patient experience (CAHPS-based), efficiency (resource use), or intermediate outcome.
attributes.references: NQF Measure Evaluation Criteria; CMS Quality Measure Development Plan

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Data collection and calculation methodology used for the measure: administrative (claims/ADT data), hybrid (claims + chart review), chart_abstracted (manual chart review), ecqm (electronic clinical quality measure via EHR), survey (patient-reported, e.g., CAHPS), or registry.
attributes.references: CMS Measure Methodology Guidelines; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the measure is being tracked and reported (e.g., 2024). Used to version measure performance results and align with annual reporting cycles.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS Annual Specifications

attributes.name: minimum_sample_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of eligible patients or encounters required for the measure result to be reportable and statistically valid. Results below this threshold are typically suppressed in public reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Small Denominator Suppression Policy; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: mips_category
attributes.description: MIPS performance category to which this measure contributes: quality, promoting_interoperability, improvement_activities, cost, or NONE if not applicable to MIPS. Supports MACRA/MIPS composite score calculation for eligible clinicians.
attributes.references: MIPS (Merit-Based Incentive Payment System); MACRA; CMS

attributes.name: nqf_number
attributes.description: National Quality Forum (NQF) endorsement number assigned to the measure (e.g., NQF-0028). Null if the measure is not NQF-endorsed. Used for regulatory alignment and cross-program mapping.

attributes.name: numerator_definition
attributes.description: Formal definition of the numerator population for the measure — the subset of the denominator that meets the quality criterion (e.g., 'Patients who received a flu vaccination during the measurement period'). Derived from the official measure specification.
attributes.references: NQF Measure Specification; CMS eCQM Library; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: Last date of the measurement/reporting period during which patient encounters and events are evaluated for this measure (e.g., 2024-12-31 for an annual measure).

attributes.name: reporting_period_start

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_model

attributes.name: short_name
