attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Submission Status
attributes.description: The submission status of this measure result to the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) for HEDIS reporting and health plan accreditation purposes. Null for non-HEDIS measures.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; NCQA Health Plan Accreditation

attributes.name: nqf_number
attributes.description: The National Quality Forum (NQF) endorsement number for this quality measure (e.g., NQF-0059 for Diabetes HbA1c Poor Control). Null if the measure is not NQF-endorsed.
attributes.references: NQF Measure Stewardship; CMS Quality Reporting Programs

attributes.name: numerator_count
attributes.description: The number of patients, encounters, or events in the denominator that met the numerator criteria (i.e., received the desired care or outcome) for this quality measure.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NQF Measure Stewardship

attributes.name: payer_submission_status
attributes.description: The submission status of this measure result to the applicable health plan or payer (e.g., commercial payer, Medicaid managed care organization). Tracks whether the result has been transmitted and acknowledged.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS; CMS Quality Reporting Programs; Payer Contracts

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: The percentile rank of this facility's or provider's performance rate relative to national or peer benchmarks for this measure (e.g., 75.00 = 75th percentile nationally).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Benchmarks; CMS Quality Reporting Programs; AHRQ

attributes.name: performance_rate
attributes.description: The calculated performance rate for this quality measure, expressed as a decimal proportion (numerator / adjusted denominator). For example, 0.8750 represents 87.50% compliance.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NQF Measure Stewardship

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which this quality measure result is being reported (e.g., 2024). Used for year-over-year trending and regulatory submission alignment.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: reporting_program
attributes.description: The quality reporting program under which this measure result is submitted (e.g., CMS Inpatient Quality Reporting (IQR), Outpatient Quality Reporting (OQR), Value-Based Purchasing (VBP), Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS), HEDIS, state program, Alternative Payment Model (APM), CAHPS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMS_IQR|CMS_OQR|VBP|MIPS|HEDIS|STATE|APM|CAHPS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS IQR; CMS OQR; CMS VBP; MACRA/MIPS; NCQA HEDIS; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: reporting_quarter
attributes.description: The calendar quarter (1–4) within the performance year for which this measure result is reported, applicable for measures with quarterly reporting cycles (e.g., CMS OQR quarterly submissions).
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; CMS OQR

attributes.name: result_calculated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this quality measure result was calculated or generated by the analytics or quality measurement system.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this measure result record (e.g., draft during calculation, final after internal validation, submitted to payer/CMS, accepted or rejected by the receiving entity, under_review for audit).
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; TJC Survey Readiness

attributes.name: sir_value
attributes.description: The Standardized Infection Ratio (SIR) for HAI measures, calculated as observed infections divided by predicted infections based on national baseline data. A SIR below 1.0 indicates better-than-expected performance. Null for non-HAI measures.
attributes.references: CDC NHSN SIR Methodology; CMS HAI Reporting; CMS IQR

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the underlying data for this measure result was extracted (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner Millennium, 3M HIS, MEDITECH Expanse). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: target_rate
attributes.description: The internally established or externally mandated performance target rate for this measure in the given reporting period (e.g., organizational goal of 0.9000 for 90% compliance).
attributes.references: CMS VBP; NCQA HEDIS; TJC Performance Improvement Standards; AHRQ

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measure result record was last modified.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; HIPAA Security Rule; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: vbp_achievement_score
attributes.description: The CMS VBP domain-level achievement score for this measure, reflecting performance relative to national achievement thresholds and benchmarks. Null for non-VBP measures.

attributes.name: vbp_domain
attributes.description: The CMS Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) program domain to which this measure belongs (e.g., Clinical Outcomes, Safety, Person and Community Engagement, Efficiency and Cost Reduction). Applicable only for VBP-reported measures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clinical_outcomes|safety|person_community_engagement|efficiency_cost_reduction — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vbp_improvement_score
attributes.description: The CMS VBP domain-level improvement score for this measure, reflecting performance improvement relative to the facility's own baseline performance. Null for non-VBP measures.

products.name: cdi_review
products.description: Transactional record of Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) concurrent and retrospective chart reviews and all associated physician queries. Captures review data: review date, review type (initial, follow-up, post-discharge), working DRG, final DRG, CC/MCC capture status, POA assignment, CMI impact, and reviewer credentials. Captures query data: query type (compliant vs. leading), query method (verbal, written, electronic), clinical indicator supporting query, physician response, documentation impact (DRG change, CC/MCC capture, POA status), and query outcome. SSOT for CDI program activity encompassing both review and query workflows. Supports CDI program productivity tracking, CMI optimization, physician query response rate monitoring, and quality documentation integrity.
products.reference: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; AHIMA CDI Practice

attributes.name: cdi_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CDI concurrent or retrospective chart review record. Primary key for the cdi_review data product.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems — CDI Grouping; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: CDI reviews are subject to compliance audits for documentation integrity, query appropriateness, physician response rates, and DRG assignment accuracy. Audits by RACs, MACs, and OIG assess compliance

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hospital or care facility where the encounter and CDI review occurred.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; TJC Hospital Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: cdi_worksheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CDI worksheet record in the clinical.cdi_worksheet product used to document the structured review findings for this encounter.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; Epic EHR ClinDoc

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the attending physician responsible for the patient encounter being reviewed. Used for physician query response rate monitoring.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ClinDoc; CMS National Provider Identifier (NPI) Standard

attributes.name: drg_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to encounter.drg_assignment. Business justification: CDI reviews analyze specific DRG assignments to validate coding accuracy, identify documentation gaps, and track DRG changes. Real business process: CDI specialists review assigned DRGs, initiate quer

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CDI specialist or clinician who performed the chart review. Used for productivity tracking and reviewer credentialing.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: CDI reviews directly impact final billing through DRG optimization and CC/MCC capture. The invoice reflects the financial outcome of CDI findings. Linking enables tracking of CDI program ROI, DRG chan

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient whose medical record is under CDI review. Protected Health Information (PHI) per HIPAA.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: CDI reviews target specialty-specific documentation patterns for DRG optimization. Cardiology, orthopedics, and other specialties have distinct documentation requirements for CC/MCC capture and CMI im

attributes.name: subject_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.subject_enrollment. Business justification: CDI reviews for research subjects require special handling because research protocols drive diagnoses, procedures, and documentation patterns that differ from standard care. Linkage prevents inappropr

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.unit. Business justification: Clinical documentation improvement reviews analyzed by unit to identify unit-specific documentation gaps and physician education needs. CDI specialists target units with low CC/MCC capture rates and h

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inpatient or outpatient encounter being reviewed. Links the CDI review to the clinical encounter record.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ClinDoc; HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource

attributes.name: working_drg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.drg. Business justification: CDI reviews evaluate working DRG assignments during concurrent review to identify documentation improvement opportunities. CDI specialists must reference DRG definitions, relative weights, and CC/MCC

attributes.name: admit_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was admitted to the facility. Used to calculate review lag (days from admission to first CDI review) and concurrent review timeliness.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ClinDoc; CMS ADT Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: cc_mcc_opportunity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CDI reviewer identified a potential CC or MCC capture opportunity requiring physician query or documentation clarification.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: cc_mcc_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Complication and Comorbidity / Major Complication and Comorbidity (CC/MCC) Capture Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Complication and Comorbidity (CC) or Major Complication and Comorbidity (MCC) was captured in the documentation at the time of review. Critical CDI metric driving DRG assignment and reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG CC/MCC List; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping; ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines

attributes.name: clinical_indicator_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the clinical indicators identified in the medical record that support the CDI review finding or physician query. Documents the clinical basis for the query per AHIMA/ACDIS compliant query guidelines.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; TJC Medical Record Standards

attributes.name: cmi_impact
attributes.description: Calculated difference in DRG relative weight between the working DRG and the potential or final DRG resulting from CDI review activity. Quantifies the CMI optimization contribution of this review.
attributes.references: CMS Case Mix Index Methodology; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this CDI review record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was discharged from the facility. Populated for post-discharge retrospective reviews. Used to calculate Length of Stay (LOS) context for CDI review.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ClinDoc; CMS ADT Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: documentation_impact
attributes.description: Category of documentation improvement resulting from the CDI review and query: DRG change, CC/MCC capture, POA status change, or no impact. Used for CDI program ROI and quality reporting.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: drg_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CDI review and associated query activity resulted in a change to the DRG assignment. Key CDI program outcome metric.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: poa_status
attributes.description: Present on Admission (POA) indicator status for the principal diagnosis at the time of CDI review. Affects HAI reporting, quality metrics, and CMS payment adjustments.
attributes.references: CMS POA Reporting Guidelines; ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM code for the principal diagnosis at the time of CDI review. Used to assess documentation specificity and identify query opportunities.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; WHO ICD Classification; CMS IPPS

attributes.name: query_initiated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physician query was initiated as a result of this CDI review. Used to calculate query rate and CDI program activity metrics.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; 3M Health Information Systems CDI

attributes.name: query_method
attributes.description: Method by which the physician query was communicated: verbal, written paper-based, or electronic (e.g., via Epic In-Basket or Cerner PowerChart message). Supports CDI workflow analysis and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; Epic EHR ClinDoc

attributes.name: query_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the physician query: whether the physician agreed with the CDI suggestion, disagreed, amended documentation, or indicated clinical undetermination. Core CDI program outcome metric.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; 3M Health Information Systems CDI

attributes.name: query_response_date
attributes.description: Date the attending physician responded to the CDI query. Used to calculate query response turnaround time and physician engagement metrics.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; 3M Health Information Systems CDI

attributes.name: query_response_status
attributes.description: Current status of the physician query response. Used to monitor physician query response rates, a key CDI program KPI.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: query_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physician query as compliant (meets AHIMA/ACDIS standards), leading (directs physician to a specific answer), or non-compliant. Supports CDI compliance monitoring and OIG audit readiness.
attributes.references: AHIMA/ACDIS Guidelines for Achieving a Compliant Query Practice; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: review_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the CDI review was marked complete. Used to calculate review turnaround time and CDI specialist productivity.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the CDI specialist performed the chart review. Principal business event date for the review record.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: review_finding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CDI reviewer's primary finding from the chart review. Drives query initiation workflow and CDI program productivity reporting.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: review_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed between the patient admission date and the date of this CDI review. Used to measure concurrent review timeliness; a key CDI program performance indicator.
attributes.references: ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the CDI review record. Used for cross-system reference and audit trail. Format: CDI-YYYY-NNNNNNN.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; HIM Department Operational Standards

attributes.name: review_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this review within the encounter (1 = initial review, 2 = first follow-up, etc.). Used to track review frequency per encounter and CDI program throughput.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the CDI chart review. Drives CDI program productivity dashboards and workqueue management.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the CDI review was initiated in the CDI system. Used for concurrent review timeliness measurement and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CDI review by timing and purpose: initial concurrent review, follow-up concurrent review, or post-discharge retrospective review. Drives CDI workflow routing and productivity metrics.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; CMS VBP Program

attributes.name: reviewer_credential
attributes.description: Professional credential of the CDI reviewer performing the review (e.g., CCDS, CDIP, RN, MD). Used for CDI program staffing analytics and credential-based productivity reporting.
attributes.references: ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; AHIMA Coding and CDI Credential Standards

attributes.name: reviewer_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the individual performing the CDI review. Distinguishes between CDI specialists, physician advisors, coders, and supervisors for productivity and workflow analysis.
attributes.references: ACDIS CDI Practice Standards; 3M Health Information Systems CDI

attributes.name: source_review_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of the CDI review record in the originating operational system (e.g., 3M CDI internal review ID, Epic CDI activity ID). Supports cross-system traceability and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; Epic EHR ClinDoc

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this CDI review record was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL audit, and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: 3M Health Information Systems CDI; Epic EHR ClinDoc; Cerner Millennium PowerChart

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this CDI review record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing.

products.name: accreditation_program
products.description: Master and transactional entity for accreditation, certification, and regulatory compliance programs. Stores program-level data: accrediting body (TJC, DNV, HFAP, NCQA, URAC, CMS), program type (hospital accreditation, disease-specific certification, primary stroke center, chest pain center), accreditation cycle, current status, and expiration date. Stores survey-level data: survey date, survey type (triennial, unannounced, for-cause, validation, internal mock, readiness tracer), surveyor team, survey scope (tracer methodology, environment of care, life safety), standards chapters reviewed, findings count, and accreditation decision. Stores finding-level data: standard reference (TJC NPSG, CMS CoP condition, state regulation), finding type (RFI, Immediate Threat, Condition-Level Deficiency, Standard-Level Deficiency), compliance status, evidence, plan of correction, CMS acceptance status, and resolution status. SSOT for organizational accreditation portfolio, survey history, and compliance findings.
products.reference: TJC Accreditation Programs; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: accreditation_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accreditation program record. Primary key for the accreditation_program data product in the quality domain.

attributes.name: accreditation_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_status. Business justification: Quality accreditation programs (TJC, DNV, HFAP) must link to compliance tracking of accreditation status, deemed status for CMS certification, survey cycles, and findings resolution. Compliance system

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or organizational entity to which this accreditation program applies.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP)

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: Accreditation programs (NCQA, URAC) are often payer-sponsored for contracted facilities. Payers track facility accreditation status for network adequacy requirements and quality assurance. Payer contr

attributes.name: quality_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_program. Business justification: Accreditation programs are a specialized type of quality program. This FK establishes the parent-child relationship, enabling accreditation programs to inherit program-level attributes and be included

attributes.name: accreditation_coordinator_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal staff member or manager responsible for coordinating the accreditation program, managing survey logistics, and tracking compliance activities.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); Internal Organizational Standards; NCQA

attributes.name: accreditation_cycle_years
attributes.description: The standard duration in years of the accreditation cycle for this program (e.g., 3 years for TJC hospital accreditation, 2 years for some disease-specific certifications). Drives renewal scheduling and survey planning.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Comprehensive Accreditation Manual for Hospitals (CAMH); CMS; NCQA

attributes.name: accreditation_decision
attributes.description: The formal accreditation decision issued by the accrediting body following the most recent survey or review cycle (e.g., accredited, accredited_with_follow_up, conditional, preliminary_denial, denial, not_accredited). Distinct from program_status which reflects the current operational state.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Accreditation Decision Rules; CMS Survey and Certification; NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: accrediting_body
attributes.description: The external organization responsible for granting and maintaining the accreditation or certification (e.g., TJC = The Joint Commission, CMS = Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, NCQA = National Committee for Quality Assurance, DNV = DNV Healthcare, HFAP = Healthcare Facilities Accreditation Program, URAC = Utilization Review Accreditation Commission).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; NCQA; DNV Healthcare; HFAP; URAC

attributes.name: cms_acceptance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Plan of Correction Acceptance Status
attributes.description: Status of CMS review and acceptance of the submitted Plan of Correction. 'accepted' = CMS approved the PoC; 'rejected' = CMS rejected and requires revision; 'pending' = under CMS review; 'not_applicable' = no CMS PoC required for this program.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); 42 CFR Part 488.28; CMS Survey and Certification

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number
attributes.description: The six-digit CMS Certification Number (CCN), formerly known as the Medicare Provider Number, assigned by CMS to identify the certified provider or supplier. Required for Medicare and Medicaid participation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488

attributes.name: complaint_survey_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the most recent survey was triggered by a complaint or adverse event report filed with the accrediting body or CMS. True = complaint-triggered survey; False = routine or scheduled survey.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); The Joint Commission (TJC); Office of Inspector General (OIG)

attributes.name: condition_level_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as Condition-Level Deficiencies (CLDs) identified during the survey. Condition-level deficiencies indicate substantial non-compliance with a CMS Condition of Participation and require a Plan of Correction.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488; CMS Survey and Certification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation program record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: deemed_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organization holds CMS Deemed Status through this accreditation program, meaning the accrediting body's standards are recognized by CMS as meeting or exceeding CMS Conditions of Participation. True = deemed status granted; False = not deemed.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); 42 CFR Part 488.1; Social Security Act §1865

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current accreditation or certification became effective and binding. Marks the start of the accreditation cycle.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); NCQA

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current accreditation or certification expires and must be renewed. Used for renewal tracking, compliance monitoring, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); NCQA; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: finding_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the primary finding from the most recent survey. Tracks whether the organization has achieved compliance with the cited standard or condition.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Survey and Certification; NCQA

attributes.name: finding_evidence
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evidence observed or documented by surveyors that supports the primary finding or deficiency citation. Used for Plan of Correction development and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488

attributes.name: finding_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the primary accreditation finding was resolved and verified as compliant by the accrediting body or internal quality team.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Survey and Certification

attributes.name: finding_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current resolution status of the primary accreditation finding. Tracks the lifecycle from identification through corrective action to verified closure.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Survey and Certification; NCQA; The Joint Commission Evidence of Standards Compliance (ESC)

attributes.name: finding_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific accreditation standard, National Patient Safety Goal (NPSG), CMS Condition of Participation (CoP) condition, or state regulation citation associated with the primary or most significant finding from the survey (e.g., 'TJC NPSG.07.01.01', 'CMS CoP 482.13', 'State Health Code §405.1'). For multi-finding surveys, this captures the lead citation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) NPSG; CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); State Departments of Health

attributes.name: finding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary or most significant finding type from the survey. 'RFI' = Requirement for Improvement (TJC); 'immediate_threat' = Immediate Threat to Health and Safety; 'condition_level_deficiency' = CMS Condition-Level Deficiency; 'standard_level_deficiency' = CMS Standard-Level Deficiency; 'observation' = non-scored observation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up survey or focused review is required following the most recent survey due to unresolved findings or conditional accreditation status. True = follow-up required; False = no follow-up required.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Survey and Certification; NCQA

attributes.name: follow_up_survey_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the follow-up survey or focused review required to verify correction of findings from the primary survey. Populated only when follow_up_required is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Survey and Certification

attributes.name: immediate_threat_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Immediate Threat to Health and Safety Finding Count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as Immediate Threat to Health and Safety (ITHS) identified during the survey. These are the most severe findings requiring immediate corrective action and may trigger CMS termination proceedings.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488.24

attributes.name: is_cms_cop_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Conditions of Participation (CoP) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether CMS Conditions of Participation apply to this accreditation program. True = CMS CoP requirements govern this program; False = program is not subject to CMS CoP (e.g., voluntary certification programs).
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); 42 CFR Part 482; CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP)

attributes.name: last_cms_validation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Validation Survey Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent CMS validation survey conducted to verify that the accrediting body's survey process meets CMS standards for deemed status programs. CMS conducts validation surveys on a sample of accredited organizations.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS); 42 CFR Part 488.8; Social Security Act §1865

attributes.name: next_survey_due_date
attributes.description: The projected or scheduled date by which the next accreditation survey must occur to maintain continuous accreditation. Calculated from the accreditation cycle and effective date. Used for survey readiness planning.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; NCQA; DNV Healthcare

attributes.name: plan_of_correction
attributes.description: Narrative description of the organization's Plan of Correction (PoC) submitted to the accrediting body or CMS in response to identified findings or deficiencies. Describes corrective actions, responsible parties, and timelines.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488.28; The Joint Commission (TJC) Evidence of Standards Compliance (ESC)

attributes.name: poc_due_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which the Plan of Correction must be submitted to the accrediting body or CMS. Drives compliance workflow and escalation management.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488.28; The Joint Commission (TJC)

attributes.name: poc_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Plan of Correction was submitted to the accrediting body or CMS. CMS requires PoC submission within 10 calendar days of receipt of the Statement of Deficiencies (Form CMS-2567).
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation (CoP); 42 CFR Part 488.28; CMS Form CMS-2567

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the accreditation or certification program (e.g., 'Hospital Accreditation', 'Primary Stroke Center Certification', 'Chest Pain Center Certification', 'NCQA Health Plan Accreditation').
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; NCQA; DNV Healthcare; HFAP; URAC

attributes.name: program_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned or internally tracked unique program identifier issued by the accrediting body (e.g., TJC organization ID, CMS certification number, NCQA organization ID). Used for cross-referencing with accrediting body portals and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC); CMS; NCQA; DNV Healthcare; HFAP; URAC

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accreditation program. attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.24

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable case identifier assigned by the medical staff office or quality committee (e.g., PR-2024-00412). Used for tracking, correspondence, and committee minutes.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: case_open_date
attributes.description: The date on which the peer review case was formally opened and assigned to a reviewer by the medical staff office.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the peer review case through the medical staff quality committee process.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: case_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the clinical case under review, including relevant clinical context, key events, and the basis for the review. Protected under peer review confidentiality statutes.
attributes.references: State peer review protection statutes; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01

attributes.name: committee_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical staff quality committee formally reviewed and voted on the case determination. May differ from the individual reviewer completion date.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: confidentiality_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this peer review record is protected under applicable state peer review protection statutes, shielding it from discovery in civil litigation.
attributes.references: State peer review protection statutes; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. §11101; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this peer review case record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: educational_opportunity_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific educational opportunity identified for the reviewed provider (e.g., documentation improvement, clinical guideline adherence, procedural technique).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: educational_opportunity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the peer review case identified an educational opportunity for the reviewed provider, regardless of the care determination outcome.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: external_reviewer_organization
attributes.description: Name of the external organization or independent review entity engaged to conduct the peer review when an internal reviewer is not available or a conflict of interest exists.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: fppe_trigger_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) Trigger Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this peer review case resulted in the initiation of a Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) for the reviewed provider.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22(a)(1)

attributes.name: npdb_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Date
attributes.description: The date on which the adverse action was reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB). Required within 30 days of the action per HCQIA.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. §11101; NPDB Guidebook

attributes.name: npdb_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the action taken as a result of this peer review case meets the threshold for mandatory reporting to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) under HCQIA.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. §11101; National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Guidebook; OIG compliance guidance

attributes.name: oppe_cycle
attributes.description: The OPPE review cycle period to which this peer review case contributes (e.g., 2024-H1, 2024-Q3). Used to aggregate peer review outcomes into the provider's OPPE profile for reappointment decisions.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22(a)(1)

attributes.name: patient_outcome
attributes.description: The clinical outcome experienced by the patient as a result of the care event under review. Used to contextualize the severity of the case and inform the care determination.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Sentinel Event Policy; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13; AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators

attributes.name: privileging_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outcome of this peer review case has a direct impact on the reviewed provider's clinical privileges (restriction, suspension, or revocation).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22; NCQA credentialing standards

attributes.name: protection_statute_reference
attributes.description: The specific state or federal statute under which peer review confidentiality protection is claimed (e.g., California Evidence Code §1157, Texas Occupations Code §160.007).
attributes.references: State peer review protection statutes; Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 U.S.C. §11101

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the peer review case was completed and a determination was rendered by the reviewer or committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the peer review case as established by medical staff bylaws or committee policy (typically 30–60 days from case open date).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_level
attributes.description: The organizational level at which the review is conducted: department-level (chief review), committee-level (medical staff quality committee), external (independent third-party reviewer), or appellate (appeal hearing panel).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the review type: OPPE (Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation) for routine periodic review, FPPE (Focused Professional Practice Evaluation) for targeted review of specific concerns, sentinel event review, or complaint-driven review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oppe|fppe|sentinel_event|focused|routine|complaint_driven|mortality|morbidity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22(a)(1)

attributes.name: reviewer_findings
attributes.description: Narrative of the peer reviewer's clinical findings, analysis of the care provided, and rationale supporting the care appropriateness determination.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; State peer review protection statutes

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Medical specialty of the provider under review (e.g., General Surgery, Internal Medicine, Emergency Medicine). Used to ensure peer reviewer is of the same specialty.
attributes.references: American Medical Association (AMA) Specialty Taxonomy; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01

attributes.name: trigger_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific event, complaint, or indicator that triggered this peer review case (e.g., unexpected intraoperative complication, patient complaint regarding surgical outcome).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: The initiating event or mechanism that caused this peer review case to be opened. OPPE = Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation; FPPE = Focused Professional Practice Evaluation.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.22(a)(1)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this peer review case record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: care_gap_description

Used by care coordinators and providers in outreach communications.

attributes.name: closure_date

attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet; CMS ACO Quality Reporting

attributes.name: closure_method
attributes.description: The method by which the care gap was satisfied and closed. 'Claim' indicates closure via a paid claims record; 'clinical_documentation' via EHR charting; 'patient_attestation' via patient self-report; 'lab_result' via a qualifying lab value; 'immunization_registry' via state registry data; 'care_plan' via documented care plan goal achievement.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Hybrid Methodology; CMS Administrative Data Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this care gap record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event for Silver Layer lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source of data used to identify or close this care gap. Indicates whether the gap was identified or satisfied via EHR clinical documentation, administrative claims, lab feed, immunization registry, patient attestation, or care plan documentation. Supports HEDIS hybrid vs. administrative methodology tracking.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Hybrid Methodology; CMS Administrative Data Specifications; HL7 FHIR

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the care gap must be closed to count toward the current HEDIS measurement year or quality program reporting period. Drives outreach prioritization and care coordinator workload management.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Quality Reporting Deadlines

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: The reason a patient has been excluded from the denominator for this care gap measure. Applies when gap_status is 'excluded'. Examples include medical contraindication, patient refusal, hospice enrollment, patient death, or geographic ineligibility. Aligns with NCQA HEDIS denominator exclusion criteria.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications — Denominator Exclusions; CMS eCQM Exclusion Logic

attributes.name: gap_category
attributes.description: Clinical sub-category of the care gap describing the nature of the required service (e.g., screening, immunization, lab monitoring, medication management, counseling, follow-up visit). Supports stratified reporting and outreach prioritization.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Clinical Quality Measures

attributes.name: gap_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for this care gap record, used in outreach workflows, care coordinator communications, and ACO quality reporting. Sourced from Epic Healthy Planet gap tracking.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet — Care Gap Management

attributes.name: gap_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the care gap. 'Open' indicates the gap has not been addressed; 'closed' indicates the gap has been satisfied; 'excluded' indicates the patient meets a denominator exclusion criterion; 'in_progress' indicates active outreach is underway; 'voided' indicates the gap was identified in error.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet; CMS ACO Quality Reporting

attributes.name: gap_type
attributes.description: Classification of the care gap by clinical category. Indicates whether the gap relates to preventive care (e.g., cancer screening), chronic disease management (e.g., diabetes HbA1c), HEDIS measure compliance, medication adherence, or behavioral health. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preventive_care|chronic_disease_management|hedis_measure|medication_adherence|behavioral_health|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Quality Payment Program; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: The date on which this care gap was first identified for the patient, typically generated by Epic Healthy Planet during a registry refresh or care gap analysis run. Represents the business event timestamp for gap creation.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet; NCQA HEDIS Measurement Year Definitions

attributes.name: is_denominator_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient meets the denominator eligibility criteria for the associated quality measure (True = eligible; False = ineligible). Ineligible patients are excluded from gap rate calculations.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications — Denominator Definition; CMS eCQM Denominator Logic

attributes.name: is_numerator_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient currently meets the numerator criteria for the associated HEDIS or quality measure (True = compliant, gap closed; False = non-compliant, gap open). Directly drives HEDIS rate calculations and ACO quality score submissions.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications — Numerator Definition; CMS eCQM Numerator Logic

attributes.name: last_outreach_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used for the most recent outreach attempt (phone call, mailed letter, patient portal message, care coordinator visit, telehealth, or SMS text). Supports outreach channel effectiveness analytics.

attributes.name: last_outreach_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent outreach attempt made to the patient or their care team regarding this care gap. Used to manage follow-up scheduling and avoid duplicate outreach.

attributes.name: measurement_year

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
