attributes.description: The full ICD-10-CM diagnosis code or ICD-10-PCS procedure code as published by WHO and maintained by CMS. Format follows alphanumeric pattern with optional decimal subdivision (e.g., A01.0, Z99.89).

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: ICD (International Classification of Diseases) Code Long Description
attributes.description: Full clinical description of the diagnosis or procedure code, providing comprehensive detail for clinical documentation, coding accuracy, and medical record completeness.

attributes.name: manifestation_code_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this code represents a manifestation of an underlying disease and must be sequenced after the underlying condition code per ICD-10-CM coding conventions.

attributes.name: mcc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is classified as a Major Complication or Comorbidity (MCC) for DRG assignment and severity adjustment purposes. MCCs have greater impact on reimbursement than standard CCs.

attributes.name: parent_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parent ICD (International Classification of Diseases) Code
attributes.description: The immediate parent code in the ICD-10 hierarchy, enabling hierarchical rollup and drill-down navigation for reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: poa_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is exempt from the CMS Present on Admission (POA) reporting requirement for inpatient claims. POA-exempt codes do not require a POA indicator on UB-04 claims.

attributes.name: replacement_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Replacement ICD (International Classification of Diseases) Code
attributes.description: The ICD code that replaces this code if the code has been retired or superseded. Used for code mapping and historical claims reprocessing.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: ICD (International Classification of Diseases) Code Short Description
attributes.description: Abbreviated clinical description of the diagnosis or procedure code, typically used in constrained display contexts such as billing forms and summary reports.

attributes.name: snomed_ct_mapping
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms) Mapping
attributes.description: The corresponding SNOMED CT concept identifier(s) mapped to this ICD code, enabling interoperability with clinical terminology systems and EHR platforms.
attributes.references: SNOMED International ICD-10 to SNOMED CT Map

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: The four-character subcategory code providing additional clinical specificity within a category (e.g., A01.0 for typhoid fever).

attributes.name: unacceptable_principal_dx_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code is prohibited from being used as the principal diagnosis on an inpatient claim per CMS coding guidelines.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ICD code record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: valid_for_coding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this code is valid for use in clinical documentation and coding. Codes may be invalid due to retirement, replacement, or administrative reasons.

products.name: cpt_code
products.description: Authoritative master catalog of CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) codes published by the AMA. Captures CPT code, descriptor (short and full), category (Category I, II, III), work RVU, practice expense RVU, malpractice RVU, total RVU, global period, effective and termination dates. Used by professional billing (CMS-1500), MIPS reporting, and clinical order management.
products.reference: CPT (AMA)

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CPT code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: CPT codes are published annually by the AMA with version-specific RVU values and payment amounts. The cpt_code table tracks effective_date and termination_date but lacks explicit version tracking. Add

attributes.name: age_range_high
attributes.description: Maximum patient age (in years) for which the CPT code is clinically appropriate. Null if no upper age restriction applies. Used for claims editing and clinical decision support.

attributes.name: age_range_low
attributes.description: Minimum patient age (in years) for which the CPT code is clinically appropriate. Null if no lower age restriction applies. Used for claims editing and clinical decision support.

attributes.name: anesthesia_base_units
attributes.description: Base unit value assigned to anesthesia CPT codes, representing the complexity and risk of the anesthesia service. Used in anesthesia billing formulas along with time units and modifying factors.

attributes.name: clinical_family
attributes.description: Grouping of clinically related CPT codes, such as all codes for a specific type of surgery or diagnostic test. Used for clinical pathway design, order sets, and utilization management.

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Dollar amount multiplied by total RVU to calculate Medicare payment. Updated annually by CMS. Used in revenue cycle forecasting and contract modeling.

attributes.name: cpt_code
attributes.description: Five-digit numeric code published by the American Medical Association (AMA) that identifies medical, surgical, and diagnostic services. This is the authoritative business identifier used on CMS-1500 claims, in CPOE systems, and for professional billing.

attributes.name: cpt_code_category
attributes.description: Classification of the CPT code. Category I codes describe established procedures and services. Category II codes are supplemental tracking codes for performance measurement. Category III codes are temporary codes for emerging technology, services, and procedures.

attributes.name: cpt_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CPT code. Active codes are valid for billing. Inactive codes have been retired but retained for historical claims. Deleted codes are no longer recognized. Pending codes are scheduled for future activation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CPT code record was first created in the enterprise reference data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) Code Effective Date
attributes.description: Date on which the CPT code became valid for use in billing and clinical documentation. Typically January 1 of the release year for annual updates.

attributes.name: facility_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CPT code is typically performed in a facility setting (hospital, ASC) or non-facility setting (physician office). Affects practice expense RVU calculation.

attributes.name: full_descriptor
attributes.description: Complete clinical description of the procedure or service, including anatomical site, approach, and any modifiers or conditions. Used for clinical documentation, coding review, and CDI workflows.

attributes.name: gender_specific
attributes.description: Indicates whether the procedure is anatomically or clinically specific to male or female patients. Used for claims editing and clinical decision support.

attributes.name: global_period
attributes.description: Number of days of post-operative care included in the procedure payment. 000 = endoscopic or minor procedure with 0-day follow-up. 010 = minor procedure with 10-day follow-up. 090 = major surgery with 90-day follow-up. XXX = global concept does not apply. YYY = carrier determines global period. ZZZ = add-on code. MMM = maternity codes with global period. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 000|010|090|XXX|YYY|ZZZ|MMM — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: malpractice_rvu
attributes.description: Relative Value Unit representing the professional liability insurance component. Reflects the relative risk and cost of malpractice insurance for the service.

attributes.name: medically_unlikely_edit_value
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of service that CMS considers medically reasonable for a single patient on a single date of service. Used for claims editing and fraud detection.

attributes.name: modifier_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether bilateral surgery, assistant surgeon, or co-surgeon modifiers are applicable. 0 = not subject to modifier rules. 1 = bilateral surgery applies. 2 = assistant surgeon may not be paid. 3 = assistant surgeon and co-surgeon rules apply. 9 = concept does not apply.

attributes.name: multiple_procedure_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates payment adjustment rules when multiple procedures are performed in the same session. 0 = no payment adjustment. 1 = standard payment adjustment applies. 2 = bilateral adjustment applies. 3 = assistant surgeon adjustment. 4 = diagnostic imaging adjustment. 5 = therapy adjustment. 9 = concept does not apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 0|1|2|3|4|5|9 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: national_payment_amount
attributes.description: National average Medicare payment amount for the CPT code, calculated as total RVU multiplied by the conversion factor. Actual payment varies by geographic locality. Used for budgeting and benchmarking.

attributes.name: ncci_edit_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: NCCI (National Correct Coding Initiative) Edit Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CPT code is subject to National Correct Coding Initiative edits, which prevent inappropriate code combinations from being billed together. Used for claims scrubbing and compliance.

attributes.name: physician_supervision_required
attributes.description: Level of physician supervision required for the service to be billable. Direct = physician must be present in the room. General = physician must be immediately available. Personal = physician must perform the service. None = no supervision required.

attributes.name: place_of_service_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of valid CMS Place of Service codes where this CPT code may be performed and billed. Used for claims editing and compliance validation.

attributes.name: practice_expense_rvu
attributes.description: Relative Value Unit representing the practice expense component, including clinical staff, medical supplies, and equipment costs. Varies by facility vs non-facility setting.

attributes.name: section
attributes.description: High-level section of the CPT code set to which this code belongs, such as Evaluation and Management, Anesthesia, Surgery, Radiology, Pathology and Laboratory, or Medicine. Used for reporting and analytics grouping.

attributes.name: short_descriptor
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the procedure or service, typically 28 characters or fewer, used in billing systems and charge capture interfaces for space-constrained displays.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system or reference data vendor from which this CPT code record was sourced, such as AMA CPT Database, 3M Coding and Reimbursement, or Epic Resolute Professional Billing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this CPT code in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

attributes.name: subsection
attributes.description: Subsection within the CPT section, providing more granular classification such as Digestive System, Cardiovascular System, or Office Visits. Used for clinical analytics and charge capture workflows.

attributes.name: telemedicine_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service can be delivered via telemedicine or telehealth platforms and remain eligible for reimbursement. Updated based on CMS and payer policies.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) Code Termination Date
attributes.description: Date on which the CPT code was retired or deleted from the active code set. Null for currently active codes. Used to prevent billing of obsolete codes and support historical claims adjudication.

attributes.name: total_rvu
attributes.description: Sum of work RVU, practice expense RVU, and malpractice RVU. Used to calculate Medicare reimbursement and benchmark physician productivity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CPT code record was last modified in the enterprise reference data system. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: work_rvu
attributes.description: Relative Value Unit representing the physician work component, including time, technical skill, physical effort, mental effort, and judgment required to perform the service. Used in MIPS reporting and physician compensation models.

products.name: hcpcs_code
products.description: Master catalog of HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Level II codes maintained by CMS. Covers durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, supplies, drugs, and non-physician services not captured by CPT. Includes code, description, category, coverage indicator, pricing methodology, effective and termination dates. Used in facility billing (UB-04) and Medicare/Medicaid claims.
products.reference: HCPCS Level II (CMS)

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Code ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HCPCS code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: HCPCS Level II codes are maintained by CMS with annual updates and quarterly releases. The hcpcs_code table has version_year (INT) and status attributes that should be normalized to code_set_version f

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates any age-based coverage restrictions for this HCPCS code (e.g., pediatric only, adult only, age 65+). Defines patient age eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: anesthesia_base_units
attributes.description: The base unit value assigned to anesthesia-related HCPCS codes, used in calculating anesthesia reimbursement. Null for non-anesthesia codes.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule, ASA Relative Value Guide

attributes.name: asc_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the payment methodology for this HCPCS code when performed in an Ambulatory Surgical Center setting. Defines whether the code is separately payable, bundled, or excluded from ASC payment.

attributes.name: assistant_surgeon_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an assistant surgeon is allowed for this HCPCS code and the applicable payment percentage for assistant surgeon services.

attributes.name: bilateral_surgery_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code is eligible for bilateral surgery payment adjustment when performed on both sides of the body during the same operative session.

attributes.name: co_surgeon_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether co-surgeons are allowed for this HCPCS code, where two surgeons perform distinct portions of a complex procedure.

attributes.name: code_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Code Type
attributes.description: Classification of the code lifecycle: permanent codes are established in the annual update, temporary codes are used for emerging technology or services, deleted codes are no longer valid.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the HCPCS code is covered by Medicare: covered codes are reimbursable, not_covered codes are excluded, carrier_discretion allows local Medicare Administrative Contractor (MAC) determination, bundled codes are included in other services, conditional codes require specific clinical criteria.
attributes.references: CMS National Coverage Determinations (NCD), CMS Local Coverage Determinations (LCD)

attributes.name: diagnosis_requirement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code requires specific ICD-10 diagnosis codes for coverage. True if diagnosis-based medical necessity criteria apply, false otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS National Coverage Determinations (NCD), CMS Local Coverage Determinations (LCD)

attributes.name: dme_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code represents durable medical equipment as defined by Medicare. True for DME items (typically E-codes), false for other categories.

attributes.name: drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code represents a pharmaceutical drug or biological product (typically J-codes). True for drug codes, false for equipment, supplies, and services.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Effective Date
attributes.description: The date on which this HCPCS code became valid and available for use in billing and claims submission.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: frequency_limit
attributes.description: The maximum frequency at which this HCPCS code can be billed (e.g., once per year, once per lifetime, twice per month). Defines time-based coverage restrictions.
attributes.references: CMS National Coverage Determinations (NCD), CMS Local Coverage Determinations (LCD)

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates any gender-based restrictions for this HCPCS code. Some codes are specific to male or female anatomy; most have no restriction.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: global_period
attributes.description: The number of days of post-operative care included in the payment for this HCPCS code (e.g., 000, 010, 090, XXX, YYY, ZZZ). Defines the global surgical package period.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule, Global Surgery Policy

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Category
attributes.description: The major category of the HCPCS code based on the first letter: A=Transportation/Medical Supplies, B=Enteral/Parenteral, C=Outpatient PPS, D=Dental, E=DME, G=Temporary Procedures, H=Alcohol/Drug, J=Drugs, K=Temporary Codes, L=Orthotics/Prosthetics, M=Medical Services, P=Pathology/Lab, Q=Temporary Codes, R=Diagnostic Radiology, S=Private Payer, T=State Medicaid, V=Vision/Hearing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A|B|C|D|E|G|H|J|K|L|M|P|Q|R|S|T|V — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Code
attributes.description: The five-character alphanumeric HCPCS Level II code (e.g., E0601, J1234). First character is always a letter (A-V), followed by four digits. Used to identify durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, supplies, drugs, and non-physician services.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: intraoperative_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total payment allocated to intraoperative services for this HCPCS code within the global surgical package.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date on which this HCPCS code record was last modified in the reference data system, reflecting the most recent change to code attributes, descriptions, or coverage indicators.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Long Description
attributes.description: Full detailed description of the HCPCS code, providing comprehensive information about the item, service, drug, or supply represented by the code.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: modifier_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a modifier is required when billing this HCPCS code. True if a modifier is mandatory for proper claims adjudication, false otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: multiple_procedure_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether and how payment adjustments apply when this HCPCS code is billed with other procedures on the same date of service. Defines reduction percentages for subsequent procedures.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule, Multiple Procedure Payment Reduction (MPPR) Policy

attributes.name: ndc_crosswalk_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code has an associated NDC crosswalk mapping. True for drug codes that map to specific NDC products, false otherwise.

attributes.name: opps_payment_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: OPPS (Outpatient Prospective Payment System) Payment Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the payment status for this HCPCS code under the Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System. Defines whether the code is separately payable, packaged, or excluded from OPPS payment.

attributes.name: place_of_service_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates any restrictions on where this HCPCS code may be performed or billed (e.g., inpatient only, outpatient only, office only). Defines valid place of service codes.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Codes, 42 CFR 414

attributes.name: postoperative_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total payment allocated to postoperative services for this HCPCS code within the global surgical package.

attributes.name: preoperative_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total payment allocated to preoperative services for this HCPCS code within the global surgical package.

attributes.name: pricing_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Pricing Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the pricing methodology for the HCPCS code: fee_schedule uses CMS published rates, asc uses Ambulatory Surgical Center payment, reasonable_charge uses historical pricing, not_priced has no established rate, contractor_priced is determined by local MAC.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule, CMS ASC Payment System

attributes.name: prior_authorization_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code requires prior authorization from the payer before services can be rendered. True if pre-approval is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: professional_component_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code has separate professional and technical components (e.g., for radiology and pathology services). Defines billing options for split or global billing.

attributes.name: quantity_limit
attributes.description: The maximum allowable quantity of this HCPCS code that can be billed per claim, per day, or per time period as defined by coverage policy. Null if no limit applies.
attributes.references: CMS National Coverage Determinations (NCD), CMS Local Coverage Determinations (LCD)

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Short Description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the HCPCS code, typically 28 characters or less, used for display on claims and billing screens.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or data feed from which this HCPCS code record was obtained (e.g., CMS HCPCS Annual Update, 3M Coding System, internal reference data management system).

attributes.name: superseded_by_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Code
attributes.description: The HCPCS code that replaces this code if it has been superseded or deleted. Null for active codes that have not been replaced.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: team_surgery_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether team surgery is allowed for this HCPCS code, where multiple surgeons of different specialties are medically necessary.

attributes.name: technical_component_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this HCPCS code includes a technical component representing facility resources, equipment, and supplies.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: HCPCS (Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System) Termination Date
attributes.description: The date on which this HCPCS code was discontinued or replaced. Null for currently active codes.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit of measure for billing this HCPCS code (e.g., each, milligram, milliliter, hour, day, unit). Defines the quantity increment for claims submission.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Manual

products.name: drg
products.description: Master table of Diagnosis-Related Groups (DRGs) and their parent Major Diagnostic Categories (MDCs) used for inpatient prospective payment under CMS MS-DRG, AP-DRG, and APR-DRG grouper systems. DRG records capture DRG code, title, type (medical/surgical/procedure), relative weight, geometric and arithmetic mean LOS, cost threshold, effective fiscal year, and grouper version. MDC records (included as a classification dimension) capture MDC number, title, description, principal diagnosis criteria, and associated DRG range. Central to inpatient reimbursement, CMI (Case Mix Index) calculation, case mix analysis, and service line performance management.
products.reference: MS-DRG / AP-DRG (CMS, 3M)

attributes.name: drg_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DRG record. Primary key.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: DRG grouper systems (MS-DRG, APR-DRG, AP-DRG) are versioned annually by CMS with fiscal-year-specific relative weights and payment rules. The drg table has grouper_version (STRING), fiscal_year (INT),

attributes.name: mdc_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent Major Diagnostic Category under which this DRG is classified.

attributes.name: arithmetic_mean_los
attributes.description: The arithmetic mean (average) length of stay in days for cases in this DRG. Used for benchmarking and operational performance analysis.

attributes.name: bundled_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG is included in bundled payment initiatives such as the Bundled Payments for Care Improvement (BPCI) program or Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement (CJR) model.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement (BPCI), CMS Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement (CJR)

attributes.name: clinical_family
attributes.description: Grouping of related DRGs into clinical families for service line analysis (e.g., 'Cardiovascular', 'Orthopedic', 'Neurology'). Facilitates portfolio management and strategic planning.

attributes.name: complication_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Complication or Comorbidity (CC) / Major Complication or Comorbidity (MCC) Level
attributes.description: Indicates the severity level of complications or comorbidities included in this DRG definition: without CC/MCC, with CC (moderate complications), or with MCC (major complications). Drives relative weight differentiation.

attributes.name: cost_outlier_threshold
attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which a case qualifies for additional outlier payment. Calculated as: (DRG payment × fixed loss ratio) + fixed loss amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this DRG record was first created in the reference data system. Used for data lineage and historical analysis.

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The official numeric code assigned to this DRG by the grouper system (e.g., 470, 871). Used as the business identifier for reimbursement and case mix reporting.

attributes.name: drg_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the DRG, including clinical context, typical procedures, and coding guidance. Used for clinical documentation improvement (CDI) and coder education.

attributes.name: drg_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DRG as medical (non-surgical), surgical, or procedure-based. Used for service line segmentation and resource planning.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this DRG definition and relative weight became effective (typically October 1 of the fiscal year).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this DRG definition and relative weight expire (typically September 30 of the fiscal year). Null for currently active DRGs.

attributes.name: geometric_mean_los
attributes.description: The geometric mean length of stay in days for cases in this DRG, calculated from national claims data. Used as the threshold for identifying outlier cases and calculating outlier payments.

attributes.name: grouper_system
attributes.description: The DRG grouper classification system under which this DRG is defined: MS-DRG (Medicare Severity), AP-DRG (All Patient), APR-DRG (All Patient Refined), or IR-DRG (International Refined).
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper, 3M Health Information Systems APR-DRG

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this DRG record was last modified in the reference data system. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: national_average_charges
attributes.description: The national average total charges (not payments) for cases in this DRG. Used for charge benchmarking and cost-to-charge ratio analysis.

attributes.name: national_average_payment
attributes.description: The national average Medicare payment amount for this DRG, calculated as: national base rate × relative weight. Used for benchmarking and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: national_case_volume
attributes.description: The total number of Medicare cases nationally that grouped to this DRG in the most recent fiscal year. Used for prevalence analysis and market sizing.

attributes.name: operating_room_procedure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG is classified as an OR procedure DRG, which affects payment and resource allocation.

attributes.name: post_acute_transfer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG is subject to the post-acute care transfer policy, which adjusts payment when a patient is discharged to a post-acute care setting (SNF, IRF, LTCH, HHA) before the geometric mean LOS.

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_range_end
attributes.description: The ending ICD-10-CM diagnosis code in the range of principal diagnoses that can group to this DRG.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines, MS-DRG Grouper Logic

attributes.name: principal_diagnosis_range_start
attributes.description: The starting ICD-10-CM diagnosis code in the range of principal diagnoses that can group to this DRG. Used for grouper logic validation and clinical documentation improvement.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines, MS-DRG Grouper Logic

attributes.name: procedure_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG requires the presence of a specific ICD-10-PCS procedure code to group (true for surgical DRGs, false for medical DRGs).

attributes.name: quality_measure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG is associated with specific quality measures under the Hospital Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) or Hospital-Acquired Condition (HAC) Reduction Programs.

attributes.name: readmission_penalty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG is included in the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) and subject to payment penalties for excess readmissions.

attributes.name: relative_weight
attributes.description: The DRG relative weight representing the average resource intensity for cases in this DRG compared to the national average (1.0000). Used to calculate expected reimbursement: base rate × relative weight.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record from which this DRG definition was sourced (e.g., '3M Grouper', 'Epic Resolute', 'Cerner Revenue Cycle'). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: special_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DRG has special payment rules or adjustments (e.g., new technology add-on payments, device-intensive procedures).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The full descriptive title of the DRG (e.g., 'Major Hip and Knee Joint Replacement or Reattachment of Lower Extremity with MCC').

products.name: snomed_concept
products.description: Master catalog of SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms) clinical concepts as distributed by SNOMED International and the NLM. Each record captures concept ID, fully specified name, preferred term, semantic tag, concept status (active/inactive), module, effective time, and hierarchy path. Provides the clinical terminology backbone for problem lists, allergies, clinical findings, and FHIR-based interoperability.
products.reference: SNOMED CT (SNOMED International / NLM)

attributes.name: snomed_concept_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms) Concept Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SNOMED CT concept as assigned by SNOMED International. This is the primary key and corresponds to the SCTID (SNOMED CT Identifier) in the SNOMED CT release files.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Release Format

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: The SNOMED CT release version identifier from which this concept was loaded (e.g., '20230901', '2023-09-01'). Supports version tracking and change management across SNOMED CT releases.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Release Notes

attributes.name: parent_concept_snomed_concept_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the immediate parent concept in the SNOMED CT IS-A hierarchy. Used to navigate the taxonomy and determine subsumption relationships. A concept may have multiple parents in a polyhierarchy.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Concept Model

attributes.name: clinical_documentation_section
attributes.description: The typical section(s) of clinical documentation where this concept is used (e.g., 'Problem List', 'Allergies', 'Past Medical History', 'Assessment', 'Plan', 'Procedures'). Supports context-aware search and documentation templates.
attributes.references: HL7 Consolidated Clinical Document Architecture (C-CDA) Implementation Guide

attributes.name: concept_class
attributes.description: Additional classification of the concept beyond the semantic tag, used for grouping and filtering (e.g., 'diagnosis', 'symptom', 'surgical procedure', 'medication', 'laboratory test'). May be derived from semantic tag or additional metadata.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Editorial Guide

attributes.name: concept_definition
attributes.description: A formal textual definition of the concept providing clinical context and meaning. May be sourced from SNOMED International or supplemented with organizational definitions for clarity.

attributes.name: concept_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SNOMED CT concept. Active concepts are available for use in clinical documentation; inactive concepts are deprecated and should not be used for new entries but may appear in historical data.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Editorial Guide

attributes.name: cpt_map_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) Map Target Code
attributes.description: The CPT code(s) to which this SNOMED CT procedure concept is mapped, if applicable. Supports billing and revenue cycle management by linking clinical procedures to reimbursable CPT codes.
attributes.references: American Medical Association (AMA) CPT to SNOMED CT Map

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this concept record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: definition_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concept is primitive (defined only by its stated relationships) or fully defined (sufficient conditions provided for automated classification). Fully defined concepts can be automatically classified by description logic reasoners.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Technical Implementation Guide

attributes.name: effective_time
attributes.description: The date on which this version of the concept became effective in the SNOMED CT release. Represents the snapshot date of the concept state in the release cycle (typically in YYYYMMDD format in source, stored as DATE).
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Release File Specifications

attributes.name: fhir_value_set_membership
attributes.business_glossary_term: FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) Value Set Membership
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of FHIR value set identifiers (URIs) to which this concept belongs. Used to support FHIR-based interoperability and constrain coded elements in FHIR resources.

attributes.name: fully_specified_name
attributes.description: The complete, unambiguous name of the SNOMED CT concept including the semantic tag in parentheses (e.g., 'Pneumonia (disorder)'). The FSN uniquely identifies the concept and includes the semantic category to distinguish homonyms.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Compositional Grammar Specification

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth of this concept in the SNOMED CT hierarchy, with the root concept at level 0. Used for hierarchy traversal, rollup queries, and determining concept granularity.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Concept Model

attributes.name: icd10_map_correlation
attributes.description: The correlation type between the SNOMED CT concept and the ICD-10 map target, indicating the semantic equivalence of the mapping (e.g., exact match, SNOMED concept is narrower than ICD-10 code, SNOMED concept is broader, partial overlap, or not mappable).
attributes.references: SNOMED International ICD-10 Map Reference Set

attributes.name: icd10_map_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: ICD-10 (International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision) Map Target Code
attributes.description: The ICD-10 code(s) to which this SNOMED CT concept is mapped, if applicable. Supports billing, reporting, and interoperability with systems that use ICD-10 for diagnosis coding. Multiple codes may be pipe-separated.
attributes.references: SNOMED International ICD-10 Map Reference Set

attributes.name: is_ehr_preferred
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is EHR (Electronic Health Record) Preferred Concept Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this concept is designated as a preferred term for use in the organization's EHR system. Preferred concepts are promoted in search results and pick lists to standardize documentation.

attributes.name: is_leaf_concept
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this concept is a leaf node in the hierarchy (has no child concepts). Leaf concepts represent the most granular clinical terms available.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Concept Model

attributes.name: is_primitive
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the concept is primitive (true) or fully defined (false). Primitive concepts require manual classification; fully defined concepts can be automatically classified by reasoners.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Technical Implementation Guide

attributes.name: is_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this concept represents a condition that must be reported to public health authorities (e.g., notifiable diseases, healthcare-associated infections). Used to trigger automated reporting workflows.
attributes.references: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS)

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this concept was used in clinical documentation within the organization. Used to identify obsolete or rarely used concepts for potential retirement or training needs.

attributes.name: loinc_map_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) Map Target Code
attributes.description: The LOINC code(s) to which this SNOMED CT concept is mapped, if applicable. Used for laboratory and clinical observations to support interoperability with laboratory information systems and FHIR resources.
attributes.references: SNOMED International LOINC to SNOMED CT Map

attributes.name: module_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the SNOMED CT module (namespace) to which this concept belongs. Modules represent different editions or extensions (e.g., International Edition, US Edition, UK Edition) and control versioning and governance.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Module Dependency Reference Set

attributes.name: patient_friendly_term
attributes.description: A simplified, patient-friendly description of the concept for use in patient portals, after-visit summaries, and patient education materials. Avoids medical jargon and uses plain language.
attributes.references: Plain Language Medical Dictionary, Patient Education Standards

attributes.name: preferred_term
attributes.description: The preferred human-readable term for the concept in the default language (typically English). This is the term most commonly used in clinical documentation and user interfaces, without the semantic tag.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Language Reference Sets

attributes.name: quality_measure_inclusion
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of quality measure identifiers (e.g., HEDIS, CMS, MIPS) for which this concept is included in the numerator, denominator, or exclusion criteria. Supports automated quality reporting and value-based care programs.
attributes.references: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) HEDIS Technical Specifications, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Quality Measures

attributes.name: relationship_count
attributes.description: The total number of active relationships (both stated and inferred) associated with this concept. Relationships define the concept's meaning and position in the ontology.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Relationship File

attributes.name: rxnorm_map_target
attributes.description: The RxNorm code(s) to which this SNOMED CT pharmaceutical/biologic product concept is mapped, if applicable. Enables medication interoperability and e-prescribing by linking to the NLM RxNorm drug terminology.
attributes.references: National Library of Medicine (NLM) RxNorm to SNOMED CT Map

attributes.name: semantic_tag
attributes.description: The high-level semantic category of the concept extracted from the FSN (e.g., 'disorder', 'procedure', 'finding', 'body structure', 'substance', 'organism'). Used to classify concepts into broad clinical domains.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Concept Model

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system or module from which this concept record was sourced (e.g., 'SNOMED International RF2', 'Epic Clarity', 'Cerner Millennium', 'NLM UMLS'). Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: specialty_relevance
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of medical specialties for which this concept is particularly relevant (e.g., 'Cardiology', 'Oncology', 'Pediatrics', 'Emergency Medicine'). Used to customize pick lists and search results by provider specialty.

attributes.name: synonym_count
attributes.description: The number of active synonym descriptions associated with this concept. Synonyms provide alternative terms for the same concept to support varied clinical documentation styles and search.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Description File

attributes.name: top_level_hierarchy
attributes.description: The top-level SNOMED CT hierarchy to which this concept belongs (e.g., 'Clinical Finding', 'Procedure', 'Body Structure', 'Pharmaceutical / Biologic Product', 'Organism', 'Substance', 'Physical Object', 'Qualifier Value', 'Observable Entity', 'Situation', 'Event', 'Environment', 'Social Context', 'Staging and Scales', 'Linkage Concept', 'Special Concept', 'Navigational Concept', 'Record Artifact'). Derived from the root ancestor in the IS-A hierarchy.
attributes.references: SNOMED International SNOMED CT Concept Model

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this concept record was last updated in the enterprise data platform. Used for change tracking and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: usage_frequency_rank
attributes.description: Rank of this concept based on usage frequency in clinical documentation within the organization. Lower numbers indicate higher usage. Used to prioritize search results and optimize user interfaces.

products.name: loinc_code
products.description: Authoritative catalog of LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) codes maintained by the Regenstrief Institute. Captures LOINC number, component, property, time aspect, system, scale type, method type, long common name, short name, class, order/observation flag, status, and effective dates. Used to standardize lab results, vital signs, clinical observations, and radiology reports across LIS, RIS, and EHR systems.
products.reference: LOINC (Regenstrief Institute)

attributes.name: loinc_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) Code ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the LOINC code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: LOINC codes are maintained by Regenstrief Institute with biannual releases. The loinc_code table has version_first_released (STRING), version_last_changed (STRING), and status attributes that should b

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: The high-level category or domain of the observation (e.g., CHEM=Chemistry, HEM/BC=Hematology/Blood Count, MICRO=Microbiology, RAD=Radiology, VITALS=Vital Signs).

attributes.name: component
attributes.description: The substance or entity being measured or observed (e.g., Glucose, Hemoglobin, Creatinine). This is the analyte, the target of the measurement.

attributes.name: consumer_name
attributes.description: A patient-friendly, lay-language name for the observation or test, used in patient portals and consumer-facing applications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this LOINC code record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: deprecated_date
attributes.description: The date when this LOINC code was deprecated or retired. Null if the code is still active.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The preferred display name for this LOINC code in the current implementation. May be customized by the organization while maintaining the standard LOINC number.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this LOINC code became active and available for use in clinical systems.

attributes.name: example_ucum_units
attributes.business_glossary_term: Example UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure) Units
attributes.description: The standardized UCUM representation of the example units. Used for interoperability and unit conversion.
attributes.references: UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure)

attributes.name: example_units
attributes.description: Common units of measure for this observation (e.g., mg/dL, mmol/L, %). Provides guidance for result reporting.
attributes.references: Regenstrief Institute LOINC Standard, UCUM (Unified Code for Units of Measure)

attributes.name: external_copyright_notice
attributes.description: Copyright or licensing information for LOINC codes that incorporate third-party content (e.g., SNOMED CT, CPT). Required for compliance with external terminology licenses.
attributes.references: Regenstrief Institute LOINC Standard, Third-Party Terminology Licenses

attributes.name: hl7_field_subfield_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: HL7 (Health Level Seven) Field Subfield ID
attributes.description: The HL7 v2.x message field identifier where this LOINC code is typically used (e.g., OBX-3 for observation identifier). Supports HL7 message mapping.

attributes.name: hl7_v3_code_system_oid
attributes.business_glossary_term: HL7 (Health Level Seven) Version 3 Code System OID (Object Identifier)
attributes.description: The HL7 v3 object identifier for the LOINC code system (typically 2.16.840.1.113883.6.1). Used in CDA documents and HL7 v3 messages.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this LOINC code is currently active and available for use in the organization. True=active, False=inactive or deprecated locally.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date when this LOINC code mapping was last reviewed and verified by clinical informatics or laboratory staff. Supports ongoing terminology governance.

attributes.name: local_code
attributes.description: Organization-specific internal code or identifier mapped to this LOINC code. Used for legacy system integration and local terminology management.

attributes.name: loinc_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) Number
attributes.description: The unique LOINC code identifier assigned by Regenstrief Institute. Format: numeric-numeric (e.g., 2345-7). This is the authoritative external identifier for the observation or test.

attributes.name: long_common_name
attributes.description: The full, human-readable display name for the LOINC code. This is the primary display term used in clinical systems and reports.

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: The method or technique used to make the observation or measurement (e.g., Electrophoresis, Immunoassay, Microscopy). May be null if method is not specified.

attributes.name: order_observation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this LOINC code is used for ordering tests, recording observations, or both. Order=orderable panel or test, Observation=result only, Both=can be used for ordering and results.

attributes.name: panel_type
attributes.description: Indicates if this LOINC code represents a panel (group of related tests), battery (predefined test group), or set (collection of observations). Null for individual observations.

attributes.name: property
attributes.description: The characteristic or attribute of the analyte being measured (e.g., Mass Concentration, Substance Concentration, Presence, Volume).

attributes.name: related_names
attributes.description: Synonyms, alternate names, or legacy names for this observation. Supports search and mapping from legacy systems.

attributes.name: scale_type
attributes.description: The scale of measurement for the observation result. Qn=Quantitative (numeric), Ord=Ordinal (ranked), Nom=Nominal (named categories), Nar=Narrative (free text), Doc=Document (attached file).

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: An abbreviated display name for the LOINC code, used when space is limited in user interfaces or reports.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record from which this LOINC code mapping was sourced (e.g., Epic Beaker, Cerner PathNet, MEDITECH LIS). Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: survey_question_source
attributes.description: The source instrument or questionnaire from which the survey question originates (e.g., PHQ-9, PROMIS, CAHPS).

attributes.name: survey_question_text
attributes.description: For LOINC codes representing survey or assessment questions, this field contains the full question text as presented to the patient or clinician.

attributes.name: system
attributes.description: The specimen or body system from which the observation was made (e.g., Blood, Serum, Urine, Plasma, Cerebrospinal fluid).

attributes.name: time_aspect
attributes.description: The time dimension of the measurement (e.g., Point in time, 24 hour, 8 hour). Indicates whether the observation is a single point measurement or collected over a time interval.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this LOINC code record was last modified. Audit trail field.

products.name: ndc_drug
products.description: Master catalog of NDC (National Drug Code) drug products as maintained by the FDA, enriched with RxNorm normalized drug concept mappings (RxCUI, term type, ingredient/brand/clinical drug hierarchy) published by the NLM. NDC records capture the 11-digit NDC, labeler name, product name, proprietary and non-proprietary names, dosage form, route of administration, strength, unit, DEA schedule, marketing category, application number, package description, and active/inactive status. RxNorm normalization records capture RxCUI, name, term type (TTY: ingredient, brand name, clinical drug, etc.), source vocabulary, suppress flag, and effective dates, providing the canonical drug terminology layer that maps NDC codes, proprietary names, and generic names to a single clinical drug concept. Consumed by pharmacy, formulary management, MAR, medication reconciliation, FHIR MedicationRequest interoperability, and billing domains.
products.reference: NDC (FDA)

attributes.name: ndc_drug_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NDC drug product record in the enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: NDC drug products are maintained by the FDA with weekly updates to the NDC Directory. The ndc_drug table has ndc_status attribute and marketing_start_date/marketing_end_date that track product lifecyc

attributes.name: active_ingredient
attributes.description: The chemical substance or compound responsible for the therapeutic effect of the drug.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, UNII

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: The FDA application number associated with the drug approval (e.g., NDA number, ANDA number, BLA number).

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification code, used internationally for drug classification.
attributes.references: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology

attributes.name: biosimilar_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is a biosimilar product, highly similar to an already-approved biological product.

attributes.name: black_box_warning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug carries an FDA black box warning, the strictest warning for serious or life-threatening risks.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: The controlled substance schedule classification assigned by the DEA (CI through CV), indicating the drug's potential for abuse and accepted medical use. Empty if not a controlled substance.

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form in which the drug is administered (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, inhaler).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this NDC drug record became effective in the enterprise reference data system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this NDC drug record is no longer valid or was superseded. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: fhir_medication_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Medication Code
attributes.description: The standardized medication code used in FHIR MedicationRequest and Medication resources for interoperability.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is included in the organization's formulary and any restrictions or preferences applied.

attributes.name: gpi_code
attributes.description: The Medi-Span Generic Product Identifier, a 14-character hierarchical classification code used in pharmacy systems.

attributes.name: high_alert_medication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a high-alert medication by ISMP, requiring special handling and verification procedures.

attributes.name: labeler_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or entity that manufactures, repackages, or distributes the drug product.

attributes.name: marketing_category
attributes.description: The regulatory pathway under which the drug was approved (e.g., NDA, ANDA, BLA, OTC Monograph).

attributes.name: marketing_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug product was discontinued or withdrawn from the market. Null if still active.

attributes.name: marketing_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug product was first marketed or made available for distribution.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code assigned by the FDA, uniquely identifying the labeler, product, and package size. Format: 5-4-2 (labeler-product-package).

attributes.name: nonproprietary_name
attributes.description: The generic or non-proprietary name of the drug, typically the active ingredient name established by the United States Adopted Names (USAN) Council.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, USAN

attributes.name: orange_book_code
attributes.description: The therapeutic equivalence code from the FDA Orange Book, indicating whether a generic drug is therapeutically equivalent to the brand-name drug.

attributes.name: over_the_counter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is available for purchase without a prescription.

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: A textual description of the package size and configuration (e.g., bottle of 100 tablets, box of 10 vials).

attributes.name: package_quantity
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of units contained in the package.

attributes.name: package_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the package quantity (e.g., tablet, capsule, mL, vial).

attributes.name: pregnancy_category
attributes.description: The FDA pregnancy category classification indicating the risk of fetal harm (A=safest, X=contraindicated, N=not classified). Note: FDA replaced this with narrative labeling in 2015.
attributes.references: FDA Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The full product name as registered with the FDA, including strength and dosage form.

attributes.name: proprietary_name
attributes.description: The brand or trade name under which the drug is marketed to consumers and healthcare providers.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NDC drug record was first created in the enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NDC drug record was last updated in the enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: refrigeration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug requires refrigerated storage to maintain stability and efficacy.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered into the body (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, subcutaneous, intramuscular).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, HL7 FHIR RouteOfAdministration

attributes.name: rxcui
attributes.description: The RxNorm Concept Unique Identifier assigned by the National Library of Medicine, providing a normalized drug concept mapping for interoperability.

attributes.name: rxnorm_name
attributes.description: The normalized drug name as defined in RxNorm, representing the clinical drug concept.

attributes.name: rxnorm_source_vocabulary
attributes.description: The source vocabulary from which the RxNorm concept was derived (e.g., RXNORM, VANDF, MMSL, NDDF).

attributes.name: rxnorm_suppress_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RxNorm concept is suppressed from use (N=not suppressed, Y=suppressed, O=obsolete, E=entry term).

attributes.name: rxnorm_term_type
attributes.description: The RxNorm term type classification (e.g., IN for ingredient, BN for brand name, SCD for semantic clinical drug, GPCK for generic pack).

attributes.name: snomed_ct_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT) Code
attributes.description: The SNOMED CT concept code representing the drug product or substance for clinical documentation and interoperability.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The concentration or potency of the active ingredient(s) in the drug product, expressed as a numeric value with unit (e.g., 500 mg, 10 mg/mL).

attributes.name: strength_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the drug strength (e.g., mg, mL, mcg, IU, %).
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory, UCUM

attributes.name: therapeutic_class
attributes.description: The therapeutic or pharmacological classification of the drug (e.g., antibiotic, antihypertensive, analgesic).
attributes.references: AHFS Drug Information, VA Drug Class

attributes.name: unii_code
attributes.description: The FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier code for the active ingredient, used for substance identification.

attributes.name: vaccine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug product is a vaccine used for immunization.

products.name: fhir_value_set
products.description: Master catalog of HL7 FHIR value sets, terminology bindings, and their expanded member concepts used across the enterprise for interoperability. Value set header records capture OID, canonical URL, name, title, status, version, publisher, binding strength (required/extensible/preferred/example), FHIR resource type, and effective dates. Member detail records capture the individual coded concepts belonging to each value set: concept system (SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, CPT, etc.), concept code, display name, designation, include/exclude flag, and effective dates. Supports runtime validation of coded fields in FHIR resources, terminology server $expand operations, and clinical decision support rule evaluation.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR Value Sets (HL7 International)

attributes.name: fhir_value_set_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Value Set Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FHIR value set record. Primary key.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version. Business justification: FHIR value sets are versioned by HL7 with release-specific canonical URLs and expansion timestamps. The fhir_value_set table has version (STRING) and status attributes that should be normalized to cod

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this value set was formally approved by the governance authority for production use. Required for regulatory compliance and change control.

attributes.name: binding_strength
attributes.description: Defines how strictly FHIR resources must conform to this value set. Required = must use codes from this set only, Extensible = should use but may extend, Preferred = recommended but not enforced, Example = illustrative only.

attributes.name: canonical_url
attributes.description: Globally unique canonical URL that permanently identifies this value set across all FHIR implementations. Used for terminology server lookups and resource references.

attributes.name: compose_exclude_count
attributes.description: Number of exclude rules defined in the value set composition. Exclude rules remove specific concepts from the included set.

attributes.name: compose_include_count
attributes.description: Number of include rules defined in the value set composition. Each include rule specifies a code system and filter criteria for selecting concepts.

attributes.name: contact_json
attributes.description: JSON-encoded contact details for the publisher or steward of this value set, including name, email, phone, and URL. Used for support and governance inquiries.

attributes.name: copyright
attributes.description: Legal copyright and licensing terms governing the use of this value set. Critical for code systems like SNOMED CT, CPT, and ICD-10 that require licensing agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this value set record was first created in the enterprise terminology repository. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this value set version is retired and should no longer be used for new data entry. Null indicates the value set is currently active with no planned retirement.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this value set version becomes active and available for use in clinical systems. Part of the temporal validity window.

attributes.name: expansion_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the current expansion of this value set. Changes each time the value set is expanded by a terminology server to reflect the current set of member concepts.

attributes.name: expansion_offset
attributes.description: Paging offset used when the expansion was generated. Supports large value sets that cannot be returned in a single response.

attributes.name: expansion_parameter_json
attributes.description: JSON-encoded parameters used during the expansion operation, such as language, display variant, or active-only filters. Stored as text for auditability.

attributes.name: expansion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the value set was last expanded by a terminology server to produce the current list of member concepts. Critical for cache invalidation and version control.

attributes.name: expansion_total_concepts
attributes.description: Total number of coded concepts included in the current expansion of this value set. Used for validation and performance optimization.

attributes.name: experimental_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this value set is for testing or experimental purposes and should not be used in production clinical systems. True means not approved for operational use.

attributes.name: fhir_element_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Element Path
attributes.description: Specific element path within the FHIR resource where this value set binding applies, using dot notation. Example: Observation.code, Condition.clinicalStatus, Procedure.category.

attributes.name: fhir_resource_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Resource Type
attributes.description: The FHIR resource type that this value set is bound to, such as Observation, Condition, Procedure, MedicationRequest, or AllergyIntolerance. Indicates where this terminology is applied in clinical workflows.

attributes.name: fhir_value_set_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the value set purpose, scope, and intended use cases. Provides clinical and business context for terminology consumers.

attributes.name: immutable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the value set definition is immutable and will never change once published. True means the expansion will always produce the same set of codes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166 country codes or jurisdiction identifiers where this value set is intended for use. Examples: USA, CAN, GBR. Supports regional terminology requirements.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this value set was last reviewed for clinical accuracy and relevance. Used to trigger periodic re-validation cycles per governance policy.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this value set record was last updated in the enterprise terminology repository. Supports change tracking and cache invalidation.

attributes.name: publisher
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual responsible for publishing and maintaining this value set. Examples include HL7, SNOMED International, LOINC, or internal enterprise teams.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Explanation of why this value set was created and the specific clinical or administrative problem it addresses. Helps users understand appropriate usage scenarios.

products.name: crosswalk
products.description: Enterprise terminology crosswalk and mapping table maintaining authoritative code-to-code translations between clinical and billing code systems. Each mapping record captures source code system, source code, target code system, target code, mapping type (equivalent, broader, narrower, related), mapping quality (exact, inexact), directionality, source and target code_set_version references, effective and termination dates, and source authority. Covers ICD-9→ICD-10 GEMs, SNOMED CT→ICD-10 maps, NDC→RxNorm, CPT→SNOMED procedure maps, LOINC→SNOMED observation maps, and SDOH code mappings (ICD-10-Z↔SNOMED↔LOINC SDOH panels). Essential for claims migration, clinical-to-billing translation, SDOH reporting, and cross-system interoperability.
products.reference: GEMs / SNOMED Maps / NLM Mappings (CMS, NLM)

attributes.references: HL7 FHIR ConceptMap.group.element.target.comment, UMLS Mapping Notes

attributes.name: mapping_type
attributes.description: The semantic relationship between source and target codes: equivalent (1:1 exact match), broader (source is more specific than target), narrower (source is more general than target), related (associated but not hierarchical), inexact (approximate match), unmatched (no suitable target).
