attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis record. Primary key for the risk register.

attributes.name: affected_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IT asset, facility, or resource in the asset inventory that is exposed to this risk.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to an internal or external audit finding that identified this risk, if applicable.

attributes.name: interface_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.interface_channel. Business justification: HIPAA security risk assessments must evaluate interface channels as potential threat vectors for ePHI exposure. Linking risks to specific channels enables risk-based interface security controls, vulne

attributes.name: primary_hipaa_risk_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or role accountable for managing and monitoring this risk. Typically a department head, system owner, or security officer.

attributes.name: related_incident_hipaa_privacy_incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to a security incident or breach event that triggered the identification of this risk, if applicable.

attributes.name: tertiary_hipaa_identified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee, auditor, or security analyst who identified and documented this risk.

attributes.name: affected_ephi_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) System
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the information system, application, or asset that contains or processes ePHI and is subject to this risk. Examples include EHR system, billing system, patient portal, or backup storage.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this risk was formally closed or resolved, indicating it is no longer an active concern.

attributes.name: control_effectiveness
attributes.description: Assessment of how well existing controls are functioning to mitigate the risk. Rated as effective, partially effective, ineffective, or not implemented.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this risk record was first created in the risk management system.

attributes.name: existing_controls
attributes.description: Description of current safeguards, policies, procedures, or technical controls already in place that reduce the likelihood or impact of this risk.

attributes.name: identification_method
attributes.description: Method or source through which the risk was identified, such as vulnerability scan, penetration test, internal audit, external audit, incident investigation, or self-assessment.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk was first identified and documented in the risk register.

attributes.name: impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential harm or damage if the risk is realized. Considers confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact on ePHI, as well as financial, reputational, and regulatory consequences.

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the magnitude of impact if the risk occurs, typically on a scale of 1-5 or 1-10, used for quantitative risk calculation.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk level before considering existing controls, calculated from likelihood and impact. Categorized as critical, high, medium, or low. Represents the raw exposure.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric inherent risk score, typically calculated as likelihood_score multiplied by impact_score, representing the risk exposure before mitigation.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk was last reviewed and reassessed by the risk owner or security team.

attributes.name: likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the probability that the threat will exploit the vulnerability. Rated as very low, low, medium, high, or very high based on threat frequency, vulnerability severity, and existing controls.

attributes.name: likelihood_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the likelihood of occurrence, typically on a scale of 1-5 or 1-10, used for quantitative risk calculation.

attributes.name: mitigation_actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when mitigation controls were fully implemented and verified as operational.

attributes.name: mitigation_controls_implemented
attributes.description: List or description of new safeguards, policies, procedures, or technical controls that have been implemented to mitigate this risk.

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the action plan to reduce the risk, including specific controls to be implemented, responsible parties, and timelines.

attributes.name: mitigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when mitigation activities began or are scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: mitigation_target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date by which mitigation controls should be fully implemented and operational.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this risk record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this risk to reassess likelihood, impact, control effectiveness, and treatment decisions. HIPAA requires annual risk analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, context, or documentation related to this risk, including historical decisions, stakeholder discussions, or special considerations.

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific HIPAA Security Rule section or other regulatory requirement that this risk relates to, such as §164.308(a)(3) for workforce security or §164.312(a)(1) for access control.

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk level after considering existing and planned mitigation controls. Categorized as critical, high, medium, or low. Represents the remaining exposure after treatment.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric residual risk score after mitigation, calculated from adjusted likelihood and impact scores, representing the remaining risk exposure.

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk acceptance decision was formally approved by management.

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and approval documentation for accepting a risk without further mitigation, including cost-benefit analysis and management sign-off.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_cycle_code
attributes.description: Reference to the annual or periodic risk assessment cycle during which this risk was identified. Links to the broader compliance assessment program.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk aligned with HIPAA Security Rule safeguard categories: administrative, physical, technical, or organizational.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the risk, typically formatted as a human-readable code (e.g., RISK-2024-001) for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: risk_owner_department
attributes.description: Department or business unit responsible for managing this risk, such as IT, Compliance, Clinical Operations, or Health Information Management (HIM).

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk: open (newly identified), in progress (mitigation underway), mitigated (controls implemented), accepted (risk tolerance decision made), or closed (risk no longer applicable).

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the risk within the category, such as access control, encryption, workforce security, or facility access.

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the identified risk, summarizing the threat or vulnerability in business terms.

attributes.name: risk_treatment_decision
attributes.description: Strategic decision on how to address the risk: accept (tolerate the risk), mitigate (implement controls to reduce risk), transfer (shift risk via insurance or contract), or avoid (eliminate the activity causing the risk).

attributes.name: threat_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the threat agent or event that could exploit the vulnerability and cause harm to ePHI (Electronic Protected Health Information). Examples include malware, unauthorized access, natural disaster, or insider threat.

attributes.name: vulnerability_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the weakness or gap in controls that could be exploited by the threat. Examples include unpatched systems, weak passwords, lack of encryption, or inadequate physical security.

attributes.name: prior_hipaa_security_risk_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on hipaa_security_risk (prior_hipaa_security_risk_id)

products.name: training
products.description: Master catalog of all mandatory and elective compliance training programs required by regulation or organizational policy. Captures training program name, training type (HIPAA Privacy, HIPAA Security, Corporate Compliance, OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens, Fire Safety, Abuse/Neglect, Cultural Competency, Code of Conduct), regulatory mandate driving the requirement, target audience (role, department, all staff), training format (online, in-person, simulation), frequency (annual, biennial, one-time, upon hire), passing score threshold, and training status. Distinct from workforce.cme_activity which tracks clinical continuing education.
products.reference: OIG Compliance Program Element 5, Joint Commission HR.01.05, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance training program. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Training programs are delivered by specific departments and funded through their cost centers. Training costs (development, delivery, vendor fees) must be allocated for financial tracking, budget mana

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Procedure coding training targets specific CPT codes with high error rates, compliance risk, or frequent NCCI edits, necessitating direct linkage for curriculum design and effectiveness tracking.

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Compliance training modules focus on specific high-risk or frequently misused diagnosis codes (sepsis, MI, diabetes with complications), requiring direct code references for targeted coder education.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Organization that has accredited or certified this training program. Examples: ANCC, AMA, AAFP. Null if not accredited.

attributes.name: accreditation_number
attributes.description: Unique accreditation or certification number assigned by the accrediting body. Used for external reporting and audit.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Role or individual who approved this training program for deployment. Examples: Chief Compliance Officer, Chief Medical Officer, VP Human Resources.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the training program was formally approved for use by the approval authority.

attributes.name: assessment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training includes a graded assessment that must be passed for completion. True if assessment is required, False if completion is based on participation only.

attributes.name: attestation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the learner must sign an attestation statement acknowledging understanding and commitment to comply. Common for Code of Conduct and policy-based training.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a completion certificate is issued upon successful completion of the training. True if certificate is generated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: content_author
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team who developed the training content.

attributes.name: content_location_url
attributes.description: URL or file path where the training content is hosted. Used by learning management systems to launch the training.

attributes.name: content_owner
attributes.description: Department or role responsible for maintaining the training content and ensuring accuracy and regulatory alignment. Examples: Compliance Department, Infection Prevention, Human Resources.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training program record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Expected time in minutes required to complete the training program. Used for workforce planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this training program version became active and available for assignment. Used to track training content versioning.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days past the due date after which non-completion triggers an escalation to management. Used for compliance enforcement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this training program version is no longer valid or available for new assignments. Null if the training has no planned end date.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Delivery method for the training program. Determines how learners access and complete the training. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Online|In-Person|Blended|Simulation|On-the-Job|Self-Study|Webinar|Video — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: How often the training must be completed to maintain compliance. Drives recurrence scheduling and assignment logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Annual|Biennial|One-Time|Upon Hire|Upon Role Change|Quarterly|As Needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation, OSHA Healthcare Standards, The Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: frequency_months
attributes.description: Numeric representation of training recurrence interval in months. Used for automated scheduling. Examples: 12 for annual, 24 for biennial, null for one-time.

attributes.name: keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords and tags used for training catalog search and discovery.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the training content was last reviewed and validated for accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: learning_objectives
attributes.description: Summary of the key learning outcomes and competencies the training is designed to achieve. Used for curriculum mapping and competency tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training program record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next content review. Used to trigger review workflows and ensure training remains current.

attributes.name: non_compliance_consequence
attributes.description: Description of the organizational consequence for failing to complete required training. Examples: Loss of system access, disciplinary action, termination.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to successfully complete the training, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Null if no assessment is required.

attributes.name: policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational policy or policies that this training supports. Links training to the governance framework.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this training program. Critical and High priority training may trigger escalation workflows for non-completion.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or agency that mandates this training requirement. Examples: HHS Office for Civil Rights, OSHA, CMS, The Joint Commission, State Department of Health.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, OSHA, CMS, The Joint Commission

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate
attributes.description: The specific regulation, statute, or accreditation standard that requires this training. Examples: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.530(b), OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030, Joint Commission HR.01.06.01.
attributes.references: HIPAA, OSHA, CMS Conditions of Participation, The Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: retired_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the training program was retired. Examples: Superseded by new version, Regulatory requirement removed, Content no longer relevant.

attributes.name: retired_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training program was retired and removed from active use. Null if the training is still active or suspended.

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months at which the training content must be reviewed for accuracy and regulatory alignment. Examples: 12, 24, 36.

attributes.name: supersedes_training_number
attributes.description: Training program number that this version replaces. Used to track training evolution and ensure learners complete the most current version.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the workforce population required to complete this training. May specify roles, departments, or all staff. Examples: All Staff, Clinical Staff, Physicians, Nurses, Environmental Services, IT Staff, Revenue Cycle Staff.

attributes.name: target_department
attributes.description: Specific department or service line required to complete this training. Used for automated assignment rules.

attributes.name: target_role
attributes.description: Specific job role or role category required to complete this training. Used for automated assignment rules.

attributes.name: training_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the training program content, scope, and purpose. Displayed to learners and used for catalog search.

attributes.name: training_name
attributes.description: Full name of the compliance training program as displayed to learners and in catalogs.

attributes.name: training_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the training program, used for external reference and reporting. Typically follows format TRN-XXXXXX.

attributes.name: training_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training program. Active programs are available for assignment and completion.

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Category of compliance training program. Defines the subject matter and regulatory domain covered by the training. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HIPAA Privacy|HIPAA Security|Corporate Compliance|OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens|Fire Safety|Abuse and Neglect|Cultural Competency|Code of Conduct|Emergency Preparedness|Infection Control|Patient Rights|Workplace Violence Prevention|Hazardous Materials|Radiation Safety|Respiratory Protection|Other — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation, OSHA Healthcare Standards, The Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: vendor_course_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the external vendor for this training course. Used for integration and reporting with vendor learning management systems.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or content provider if the training is sourced from a third party. Null for internally developed training.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the training content. Incremented when training materials are updated. Format: major.minor (e.g., 2.1).

attributes.name: prerequisite_training_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on training (prerequisite_training_id)

products.name: training_completion
products.description: Transactional record of each individual staff member's completion of a required compliance training program. Captures employee reference, training program reference, assigned date, completion date, training method, score achieved, pass/fail status, certificate number, expiration date, and completion status (assigned, in progress, completed, overdue, waived). Enables compliance reporting on training completion rates by department, role, and regulatory requirement. Supports Joint Commission HR.01.05 and OIG compliance program documentation.
products.reference: OIG Compliance Program, Joint Commission HR.01.05.03

attributes.name: training_completion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training completion record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who completed or was assigned the training. Links to the workforce domain employee master.

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training. Business justification: CRITICAL FIX: training_completion.training_program_id currently points to compliance.program.program_id, but it should point to compliance.training.training_id. Training completion records should refe

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization that accredited or approved this training program. Examples include ACCME, ANCC, state boards, or internal compliance committees.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME)

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the training program was assigned to the employee. Marks the start of the compliance obligation period.

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for this training completion. Increments when an employee retakes a failed training.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: Date when the training certificate was officially issued. May differ from completion date for trainings requiring manual review or approval.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued upon successful completion. Used for external verification and audit documentation.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee successfully completed the training program. Null if training is not yet completed.

attributes.name: completion_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this training completion event. May be used for certificate tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training completion record. Tracks progression from assignment through completion or expiration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assigned|in_progress|completed|overdue|waived|expired|not_started — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the training was marked complete in the Learning Management System (LMS). Used for audit trail and time-sensitive compliance verification.

attributes.name: continuing_education_credits
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education (CE) or Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits awarded for this training completion. Used for professional licensure maintenance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training completion record was first created in the data platform. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Type of continuing education credit awarded. CME (Continuing Medical Education) for physicians, CEU (Continuing Education Unit) for general staff, CNE (Continuing Nursing Education) for nurses, or contact hours.
attributes.references: Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME)

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the training must be completed to maintain compliance. Used for overdue tracking and escalation.

attributes.name: employee_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit of the employee at the time of training completion. Captured for compliance reporting by department.

attributes.name: employee_facility
attributes.description: Healthcare facility or location where the employee is assigned. Used for facility-level compliance reporting and Joint Commission readiness.

attributes.name: employee_role
attributes.description: Job role or title of the employee at the time of training completion. Used for role-based compliance reporting and gap analysis.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the overdue training was escalated to management. Part of the compliance enforcement audit trail.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this overdue training has been escalated to management or compliance leadership. True if escalated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this training completion expires and requires renewal. Null for one-time trainings that do not expire.

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the instructor or facilitator who delivered the training. Applicable for in-person and instructor-led sessions.

attributes.name: last_reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent reminder notification was sent to the employee. Used for escalation timing and communication tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training completion record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this training completion. May include special circumstances, technical issues, or compliance officer annotations.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee passed or failed the training assessment. Not applicable for trainings without assessments.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the training. Captured at completion time to preserve historical pass/fail criteria.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_satisfied
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulatory requirement satisfied by this training completion. Examples include HIPAA Privacy Rule, OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens Standard, Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: Joint Commission HR.01.05.01, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.530(b), OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030

attributes.name: reminder_sent_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder notifications sent to the employee for this training assignment. Used for tracking engagement and escalation.

attributes.name: score_achieved
attributes.description: Numeric score or percentage achieved by the employee on the training assessment. Null if training does not include a scored assessment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system that originated this training completion record. Examples include Workday Learning, internal LMS, or manual entry system.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this training completion record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: training_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the employee spent completing the training. Captured from Learning Management System (LMS) tracking data.

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training was conducted. May be a facility name, room number, or online platform identifier.

attributes.name: training_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training was delivered to the employee. Used for effectiveness analysis and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: waiver_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the training waiver was officially approved. Part of the compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authority who approved the training waiver. Required for audit trail when waiver is granted.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training requirement was waived for this employee. True if waived, False otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for waiving the training requirement. Required when waiver_flag is True. Subject to compliance review.

attributes.name: reattempted_training_completion_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on training_completion (reattempted_training_completion_id)

products.name: compliance_regulatory_submission
products.description: Transactional record of mandatory regulatory data submissions and reports filed with government agencies and accrediting bodies. Covers CMS quality measure reporting (IQR, OQR, IPFQR), state health department licensure reports, OSHA 300/300A annual injury logs, OCR breach notifications, OIG self-disclosures, Joint Commission periodic performance reviews, and CDC NHSN HAI reporting. Captures submission type, submitting entity, receiving agency, reporting period, submission date, submission method (electronic, paper, portal), submission status, and acknowledgment receipt. Distinct from quality.regulatory_submission which is quality-measure-specific.
products.reference: CMS QualityNet, OSHA 300A, OCR Breach Portal, NHSN

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory submission record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: original_submission_compliance_regulatory_submission_id

attributes.name: public_health_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.public_health_report. Business justification: Many regulatory submissions to CMS, CDC, and state agencies are transmitted via public health reporting interfaces. Linking submissions to their transmission records enables tracking of submission sta

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_change. Each submission should optionally link to the regulatory change that triggered it. This allows

attributes.name: acceptance_date

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the receiving agency acknowledged receipt of the submission.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_number

attributes.name: attestation_date

attributes.name: attestation_officer_name

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective actions are required as a result of audit findings or agency feedback. True = corrective action required, False = no corrective action required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: document_location_url
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference where the submitted regulatory report or supporting documentation is stored.
attributes.references: Internal Document Management, Health Information Management (HIM)

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the submission must be filed to remain compliant.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Deadlines, State Licensure Renewal Schedules, OSHA Reporting Deadlines

attributes.name: external_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is subject to external audit or validation by the regulatory agency or third-party auditor. True = subject to external audit, False = not subject to external audit.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting Programs, Joint Commission Accreditation, RAC Audits

attributes.description: Data classification level governing access to and disclosure of investigation records. Restricted indicates highest sensitivity requiring need-to-know access. Confidential indicates limited distribution. Internal indicates organization-wide access. Public indicates no restriction.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the investigation findings require formal corrective action plan. True indicates CAP must be developed, approved, and tracked to completion.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this investigation record was first created in the compliance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: department_involved
attributes.description: Primary department or business unit where the alleged violation occurred or that is the subject of the investigation.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_taken_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether employee disciplinary action was taken as a result of investigation findings, including counseling, suspension, termination, or other personnel action.

attributes.name: external_referral_agency
attributes.description: Name of external regulatory, law enforcement, or oversight agency to which the investigation was referred, such as HHS OIG, DOJ, FBI, OCR, state attorney general, or state health department.

attributes.name: external_referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigation was formally referred to external authority. Null if no external referral made.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or calculated financial impact of the violation in US dollars, including overpayments, penalties, refunds, or potential liability exposure. Used for self-disclosure calculations and reserve estimation.

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Comprehensive narrative summary of the investigation findings, including evidence reviewed, interviews conducted, timeline of events, root cause analysis, and factual determinations. This field supports legal privilege and compliance program documentation.

attributes.name: investigation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique investigation case number assigned at initiation, formatted as INV-YYYYNNNN for tracking and reference in compliance documentation and legal proceedings.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investigation. Initiated indicates case opened but not yet assigned. Active indicates investigation in progress. Suspended indicates temporarily paused pending additional information. Closed indicates investigation concluded. Escalated indicates elevated to senior leadership or legal counsel. Referred external indicates case transferred to external authority such as OIG, OCR, or law enforcement.

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation based on the nature of the alleged compliance violation. Privacy breach covers HIPAA violations and unauthorized PHI disclosure. Billing fraud includes upcoding, unbundling, and false claims. Workplace safety covers OSHA violations. Abuse/neglect includes patient harm and mistreatment. Anti-kickback covers illegal remuneration. Stark violation covers physician self-referral violations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, OSHA Standards

attributes.name: investigator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary investigator assigned to this case for business reporting and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: legal_privilege_asserted_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether attorney-client privilege or attorney work product privilege has been asserted over investigation materials. True indicates privileged status requiring special handling and access controls.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Evidence, State Bar Ethics Rules

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent update to this investigation record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for investigator notes, observations, and supplementary information not captured in structured fields. May include interview summaries, document references, and investigative leads.

attributes.name: patient_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct patients affected by or involved in the alleged violation. Used to assess breach notification requirements under HIPAA and scope of potential harm.

attributes.name: patient_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the investigation involves a specific patient or patient PHI. True indicates patient-specific investigation requiring additional privacy protections and breach notification assessment.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency classification of the investigation based on severity of alleged violation, potential financial impact, patient safety risk, and regulatory exposure. Critical indicates immediate patient safety or significant regulatory risk. High indicates substantial compliance risk. Medium indicates moderate risk. Low indicates minor or technical violation.

attributes.name: recommended_actions
attributes.description: Detailed recommendations for corrective and preventive actions resulting from investigation findings, including policy revisions, training requirements, system controls, disciplinary actions, and process improvements.

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory statute, rule, or standard that was violated, including citation reference such as HIPAA 45 CFR 164.502, False Claims Act 31 USC 3729, Stark Law 42 USC 1395nn, Anti-Kickback Statute 42 USC 1320a-7b, or OSHA standard number.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential organizational risk exposure associated with the alleged violation, considering financial, reputational, regulatory, and patient safety dimensions.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the boundaries and focus of the investigation, including specific allegations, time period under review, departments or individuals involved, and types of evidence to be examined.

attributes.name: self_disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date on which voluntary self-disclosure was submitted to the applicable regulatory authority. Null if no disclosure required or not yet submitted.

attributes.name: self_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the investigation findings require voluntary self-disclosure to regulatory authority such as OIG, CMS, or OCR under self-disclosure protocols. True indicates disclosure obligation exists.
attributes.references: OIG Self-Disclosure Protocol, CMS Voluntary Self-Referral Disclosure Protocol

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal investigation was officially opened and investigative activities commenced. Used to track timeliness of investigation response and compliance with regulatory reporting deadlines.

attributes.name: target_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the investigation based on regulatory timelines, internal SLA, or urgency classification. Used to monitor investigation timeliness and escalate overdue cases.

attributes.name: trigger_source
attributes.description: Origin or channel through which the investigation was initiated. Hotline report indicates anonymous or named report through compliance hotline. Audit finding indicates discovery during internal or external audit. Self-disclosure indicates proactive identification by organization. External referral indicates notification from regulatory body, payer, or law enforcement. Patient complaint indicates grievance filed by patient or family. Employee report indicates direct report from staff member. Regulatory inquiry indicates investigation prompted by CMS, OCR, or state agency request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hotline_report|audit_finding|self_disclosure|external_referral|patient_complaint|employee_report|regulatory_inquiry — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OIG Compliance Program Guidance, HIPAA Breach Notification Rule

attributes.name: violation_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the investigation substantiated a compliance violation. True indicates confirmed violation requiring corrective action and potential self-disclosure.

attributes.name: related_investigation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on investigation (related_investigation_id)

products.name: osha_safety_program

products.name: accreditation_status
products.description: Master record tracking the current accreditation and certification status for each accrediting body and program applicable to the organization. Covers The Joint Commission (TJC) hospital accreditation, DNV GL, HFAP, CARF, CAP laboratory accreditation, ACR radiology accreditation, AAAHC, and state-specific certifications. Captures accrediting body, program type, accreditation status (accredited, accredited with follow-up, conditional, not accredited), accreditation award date, expiration date, next survey window, and deemed status for CMS. Distinct from quality.accreditation_program which tracks survey activities.
products.reference: Joint Commission Accreditation, DNV GL, CMS Deemed Status 42 CFR §488

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accreditation status record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Unique certificate or accreditation number issued by the accrediting body to identify this specific accreditation award.

attributes.description: Total cost in US dollars (USD) associated with obtaining and maintaining this accreditation, including survey fees, application fees, annual fees, and consulting costs.

attributes.name: accreditation_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accrediting body made the formal accreditation decision following survey review and any appeals process.

attributes.name: accreditation_status

attributes.name: accrediting_body_code

attributes.references: The Joint Commission, DNV GL, HFAP, CARF, CAP, ACR, AAAHC Standards

attributes.name: accrediting_body_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the accrediting organization (e.g., The Joint Commission, DNV GL Healthcare, Healthcare Facilities Accreditation Program).

attributes.name: annual_maintenance_fee_amount

attributes.description: Outcome of the appeal process if an appeal was filed. Upheld indicates original decision stands; overturned indicates decision reversed; modified indicates decision changed; pending indicates appeal in progress; not applicable if no appeal filed.

attributes.name: contact_person_phone

attributes.name: contact_person_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary organizational contact person for this accreditation (e.g., Director of Regulatory Compliance, Chief Quality Officer, Accreditation Coordinator).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: critical_findings_count

attributes.name: deemed_status_flag

True if deemed status is granted; false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Description of any services, departments, or programs explicitly excluded from the scope of this accreditation.

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: follow_up_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required follow-up activity (evidence submission, corrective action plan, or follow-up survey) was completed and accepted by the accrediting body.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accrediting body requires a follow-up survey, evidence of standards compliance (ESC), or corrective action plan submission to address findings. True if follow-up is required; false otherwise.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Evidence of Standards Compliance, DNV GL Follow-Up Standards

attributes.name: last_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent accreditation survey conducted by the accrediting body that resulted in the current accreditation status.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission, DNV GL, HFAP Survey Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation status record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: next_survey_window_end_date
attributes.description: Latest date within the window by which the next accreditation survey must be completed to maintain continuous accreditation.

attributes.name: next_survey_window_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest date within the window when the next accreditation survey may be scheduled or conducted.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, or important information about this accreditation status not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Type of accreditation program applicable to the facility (e.g., hospital accreditation, ambulatory care accreditation, laboratory accreditation, radiology accreditation, behavioral health, rehabilitation, home health). attributes.references: The Joint Commission, DNV GL, HFAP, CARF, CAP, ACR, AAAHC Program Classifications

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation status is publicly disclosed on the accrediting body's website or public database. True if publicly disclosed; false if confidential.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Quality Check, DNV GL Public Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: quality_report_url
attributes.description: Web address (URL) where the public quality report or accreditation details can be accessed on the accrediting body's website (e.g., The Joint Commission Quality Check).

attributes.name: state_licensure_alignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation is recognized by the state health department for facility licensure purposes or whether it satisfies state licensure requirements. True if aligned; false otherwise.

attributes.name: survey_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of findings, deficiencies, or requirements for improvement identified during the last accreditation survey.

attributes.description: Type of survey that resulted in this accreditation status. products.name: business_associate_agreement

products.name: notice_of_privacy_practices
products.description: Master and transactional record for the organization's HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices (NPP) versions and patient acknowledgment tracking. Captures NPP version number, effective date, distribution method (paper, electronic, portal), acknowledgment type (signed, electronic, verbal, refused), patient acknowledgment date, and acknowledgment status. products.name: phi_access_log
products.description: Transactional audit log of PHI access events reviewed for compliance purposes, capturing access to electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) systems for HIPAA Security Rule audit control compliance. Records user identity, access date/time, system accessed, PHI record accessed, access type (view, print, export, modify), access reason, and whether the access was flagged for review. Supports HIPAA Security Rule §164.312(b) audit control requirements and privacy officer investigations. Distinct from IT system access logs — this is the business compliance record of PHI access reviews.

products.name: program_policy_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the formal assignment of organizational policies to compliance programs. It captures which policies are governed under which compliance programs, with program-specific enforcement requirements, audit schedules, and applicability rules. Each record links one compliance program to one policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this program-policy relationship, such as whether the policy is mandatory under that specific program, program-specific audit frequency, and effective dates for the assignment.. Existence Justification: In healthcare compliance operations, a single compliance program (e.g., HIPAA Compliance Program) governs multiple organizational policies (privacy policy, security policy, breach notification policy), and conversely, a single policy (e.g., Privacy Policy) may be governed under multiple compliance programs (HIPAA program, state privacy law program, Joint Commission accreditation program). Compliance officers actively manage these program-policy assignments, setting program-specific requirements such as mandatory vs. optional status, audit frequency, and scope applicability for each assignment.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

products.name: policy_regulatory_impact
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory impact assessment and policy response relationship between regulatory changes and organizational policies. It captures the compliance management workflow where regulatory changes trigger policy creation, updates, or retirement. Each record links one regulatory change to one policy with attributes tracking the impact assessment, implementation timeline, and policy response actions that exist only in the context of this regulatory-driven policy lifecycle event.. Existence Justification: In healthcare compliance operations, a single regulatory change (e.g., CMS rule update) routinely triggers updates to multiple organizational policies (clinical protocols, billing policies, privacy procedures), and conversely, a single policy often incorporates requirements from multiple regulatory sources (HIPAA, state law, Joint Commission standards, CMS rules). Compliance officers actively manage this relationship through a structured workflow: regulatory change monitoring → impact assessment → policy drafting/revision → approval → implementation tracking. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational compliance management process.

products.name: policy_payer_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the applicability relationship between organizational policies and insurance payers. It captures which compliance policies (credentialing, claims submission, appeals, medical records retention) apply to which payer relationships, including payer-specific policy versions, acknowledgment tracking, and compliance status for contract management and regulatory audit readiness. Each record links one policy to one payer with attributes that exist only in the context of this payer-specific policy application.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, compliance policies (e.g., credentialing requirements, claims submission standards, appeals procedures, medical records retention) apply to multiple insurance payers, and each payer relationship is governed by multiple organizational policies. The compliance department actively manages which policies apply to which payers, tracks payer acknowledgment of policy requirements, monitors compliance status for audit readiness, and maintains payer-specific policy versions or addendums required by contract terms.
