attributes.references: GAAP, CMS Cost Report Fiscal Year Definition

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: The fiscal calendar configuration code defining the number of periods, period lengths, and special period rules for this ledger. Aligns with enterprise resource planning system fiscal calendar structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the primary currency in which this ledger operates and reports financial results. All transactions are translated to this currency for consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: general_ledger_description
attributes.description: A detailed narrative description of the general ledgers purpose, scope, and usage within the healthcare organizations financial management framework. Provides context for financial analysts and auditors.

attributes.name: intercompany_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether intercompany transaction tracking is enabled for this ledger. When true, transactions between legal entities are identified and reconciled for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP, FASB ASC 810 Consolidation, SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: last_closed_period
attributes.description: The most recent fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) that has been closed for this ledger. Closed periods are locked from further posting to ensure financial statement integrity.

attributes.name: last_posting_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent journal entry posted to this ledger. Used to monitor ledger activity and identify dormant or inactive ledgers.

attributes.name: leading_ledger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the leading (primary) ledger for the organization. The leading ledger serves as the authoritative source for financial reporting and drives consolidation processes.
attributes.references: GAAP, SAP S/4HANA FI Leading Ledger Concept

attributes.name: ledger_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying this general ledger within the enterprise chart of accounts structure. Used as the business identifier for journal entry postings and financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP, SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: ledger_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the general ledger, providing human-readable identification for financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the general ledger. Active ledgers accept new postings, inactive ledgers are temporarily disabled, closed ledgers are finalized for a fiscal period, suspended ledgers are under review or audit, and archived ledgers are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: ledger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the general ledger by its primary purpose. Corporate ledgers support consolidated financial statements, management ledgers support internal decision-making, statutory ledgers meet regulatory reporting requirements, consolidation ledgers aggregate multi-entity financials, budget ledgers track planned allocations, and forecast ledgers project future performance.
attributes.references: GAAP, IFRS, SAP S/4HANA FI Ledger Framework

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this general ledger record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any attribute for change management and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: parallel_accounting_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parallel accounting is enabled, allowing simultaneous posting to multiple ledgers with different accounting principles (e.g., GAAP and IFRS). Supports organizations with multi-jurisdictional reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP, IFRS, SAP S/4HANA FI Parallel Accounting

attributes.name: profit_center_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether profit center accounting is enabled for this ledger. When true, revenue and expense transactions are tracked by profit center for segment profitability analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP, SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: project_accounting_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether project-based accounting is enabled for this ledger. When true, costs and revenues can be tracked at the project level for capital budgeting and grant management.
attributes.references: GAAP, FASB ASC 605 Revenue Recognition, SAP S/4HANA PS Project Systems

attributes.name: reporting_entity_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the reporting entity for external financial statement preparation. Maps this ledger to the appropriate regulatory and stakeholder reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP, SEC Regulation S-X, CMS Cost Report Requirements

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years that ledger data must be retained to meet regulatory, legal, and business requirements. Drives archival and purge policies for historical financial records.
attributes.references: GAAP, SOX Section 802, CMS Record Retention Requirements 42 CFR 413.24

attributes.name: segment_reporting_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether segment reporting dimensions are enabled for this ledger. When true, financial results can be analyzed by business segment for FASB ASC 280 segment disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: parent_general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on general_ledger (parent_general_ledger_id)

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master catalog of all GL account codes used across the healthcare enterprise. Captures account code, account name, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account subtype, natural balance (debit/credit), financial statement classification (balance sheet, income statement), cost center applicability flag, fund applicability flag, account status (active/inactive), effective date range, and GAAP/GASB classification. Serves as the SSOT for account code definitions used in journal entries, budgets, and cost accounting.
products.reference: Chart of Accounts (COA)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chart of accounts entry. Primary key for the chart of accounts master catalog.

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of accounts for reporting and analysis purposes. Examples include patient service revenue, supply expense, labor expense, administrative expense.

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying the general ledger account. This is the primary business identifier used in journal entries, budgets, and financial statements.

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and any special instructions for posting transactions. Provides context for finance staff and auditors.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts Documentation Standards

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the general ledger account. Human-readable label used in financial reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: account_owner
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the department, role, or individual responsible for managing and monitoring this account. Supports accountability and financial stewardship.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account. Active accounts are available for use in transactions; inactive accounts are closed and cannot be used in new entries.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts Management Standards

attributes.name: account_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed grouping within the account category providing additional analytical granularity. Supports drill-down reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: The secondary classification providing additional granularity within the account type. Examples include current asset, fixed asset, operating expense, non-operating revenue, etc.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The primary classification of the account according to the fundamental accounting equation. Determines which financial statement the account appears on and its natural balance.

attributes.name: alternate_account_code
attributes.description: An alternate or legacy account code used for cross-reference purposes during system migrations or for integration with external systems.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions posted to this account require additional approval beyond standard posting authority. True for sensitive or high-risk accounts.

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions against this account are subject to budget availability checking. True for expense accounts with budget controls.

attributes.name: consolidation_account_code
attributes.description: The account code used in consolidated financial statements when multiple legal entities are combined. Supports multi-entity healthcare system reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires a cost center assignment when used in journal entries or budget allocations. True for departmental expense and revenue accounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this account. Supports multi-currency accounting for international healthcare operations.

attributes.name: department_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires a department assignment when used in transactions. Supports departmental financial reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: drg_cost_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs in this account are allocated to DRG-based cost accounting for case mix analysis and reimbursement optimization.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account becomes inactive and is no longer available for new transactions. Null for currently active accounts with no planned closure date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account becomes active and available for use in financial transactions. Supports temporal validity and historical account structure tracking.

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier used for external regulatory reporting such as Medicare Cost Reports, state financial reporting, or bond covenant reporting.

attributes.name: financial_statement_classification
attributes.description: Identifies which primary financial statement this account appears on. Critical for automated financial statement generation and reporting.

attributes.name: financial_statement_line_item
attributes.description: The specific line item or section within the financial statement where this account balance is reported. Examples include current assets, operating expenses, net patient service revenue.

attributes.name: fund_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires a fund assignment for fund accounting purposes. Relevant for healthcare organizations with restricted grants, endowments, or governmental funding.

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: The specific GAAP classification code or category for this account. Ensures compliance with US GAAP financial reporting requirements.

attributes.name: gasb_classification
attributes.description: The GASB classification for governmental and not-for-profit healthcare entities. Applicable for public hospitals and healthcare systems.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions between legal entities within the healthcare system. Supports consolidation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: natural_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance. Assets and expenses have debit natural balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue have credit natural balances.

attributes.name: posting_restriction
attributes.description: Defines restrictions on how transactions can be posted to this account. Manual-only accounts prevent automated postings; system-only accounts prevent manual journal entries.

attributes.name: project_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account can be used for project-based accounting and requires a project code assignment. Common for capital projects, research grants, and special initiatives.

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external statements or subsidiary ledgers. True for cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and other balance sheet accounts.

attributes.name: rollup_account_code
attributes.description: The parent or summary account code to which this account rolls up for consolidated reporting. Supports hierarchical financial statement presentation.

attributes.name: rvu_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs in this account are allocated based on relative value units for physician productivity and compensation analysis.

attributes.name: statistical_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical account used to track non-monetary metrics such as patient days, procedures performed, or full-time equivalents (FTEs). Statistical accounts do not carry monetary balances.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_category
attributes.description: The tax reporting classification for this account. Used for IRS Form 990 reporting for not-for-profit healthcare entities and other tax compliance purposes.

attributes.name: parent_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on chart_of_accounts (parent_chart_of_accounts_id)

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for all cost centers within the healthcare organization, representing the primary financial accountability unit for departmental cost tracking and budget management. Captures cost center code, cost center name, cost center type (clinical, administrative, ancillary, overhead), responsible manager, parent cost center (for hierarchy), associated facility/care site, department code, fund code, service line, active status, and effective date range. Used for cost allocation, departmental P&L, and workforce FTE budget tracking.
products.reference: Cost Center

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master record.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility or care site where this cost center operates. Links cost center to physical location for facility-level financial reporting and multi-site cost analysis.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.fund

attributes.name: general_ledger_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger Chart Of Accounts Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: cost_center has general_ledger_account (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Using 'general_ledger_chart_of_accounts_id' as the FK name to be explicit. Enables joining to get

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational cost center hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical cost allocation. Null for top-level cost centers.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved annual budget allocation for this cost center in US dollars. Used for budget variance analysis, financial planning, and departmental performance measurement.

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the budget amount is allocated. Enables multi-year budget tracking and year-over-year cost center performance comparison.

attributes.name: cms_provider_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Provider Number
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned provider number for the facility or organizational unit associated with this cost center. Used for Medicare cost reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to allocate indirect costs to this cost center. Direct allocation assigns costs directly, step-down allocation cascades costs through support departments, activity-based costing allocates based on resource consumption, and RVU-based allocation uses relative value units for clinical departments.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Additional categorical classification for specialized cost center grouping beyond the primary type. Examples include inpatient, outpatient, emergency, surgical, diagnostic, therapeutic, administrative. Used for detailed financial analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the cost center within the healthcare organization's chart of accounts. Used for financial reporting, budget tracking, and departmental cost allocation.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center, representing the department, unit, or functional area for which costs are tracked and budgeted.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers are operational and accepting charges, inactive cost centers are temporarily disabled, pending cost centers are awaiting approval, closed cost centers are permanently retired, and suspended cost centers are on hold pending review.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its primary business function. Clinical cost centers provide direct patient care, administrative cost centers support operations, ancillary cost centers provide diagnostic or therapeutic services, overhead cost centers represent shared services, support cost centers provide enabling functions, and revenue cost centers generate billable services.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The average cost per unit of service delivered by this cost center. Unit definition varies by cost center type (e.g., cost per patient day, cost per procedure, cost per visit). Used for efficiency benchmarking and pricing analysis.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department code to which this cost center belongs. Used for departmental grouping, workforce planning, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: The full name of the department to which this cost center is assigned. Provides human-readable context for departmental cost analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: drg_weight
attributes.description: The average DRG case mix weight for patients treated in this cost center. Used for case mix index calculation, reimbursement analysis, and clinical complexity adjustment. Applicable primarily to inpatient clinical cost centers.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) DRG Classification Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost center was closed or inactivated. Null for currently active cost centers. Used for historical cost analysis and departmental lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost center became active and began accepting financial transactions. Used for historical cost tracking and period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: The approved number of full-time equivalent positions allocated to this cost center. Used for workforce planning, labor cost analysis, and productivity measurement.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Workforce Standards

attributes.name: is_capital_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center requires significant capital equipment investment. True for departments with major medical equipment (e.g., radiology, surgical services, laboratory), false for labor-intensive departments. Used for capital budgeting and depreciation allocation.

attributes.name: is_direct_patient_care
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center provides direct patient care services. True for clinical departments with patient contact, false for support and administrative departments. Used for clinical cost allocation and quality reporting.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: is_revenue_generating
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center generates billable revenue through patient services. True for clinical and ancillary departments that bill for services, false for administrative and overhead departments.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Revenue Cycle Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this cost center record. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the cost center. Used for documenting organizational changes, budget justifications, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to specific regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., CMS cost reports, state health department reporting, Joint Commission reporting). Used for compliance tracking and audit preparation.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: rvu_target
attributes.description: The target number of relative value units this cost center is expected to generate annually. Used for physician productivity measurement, reimbursement forecasting, and clinical efficiency analysis. Applicable to clinical cost centers with physician services.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Physician Fee Schedule

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The clinical or operational service line to which this cost center contributes. Examples include cardiology, orthopedics, oncology, emergency services, surgical services. Used for service line profitability analysis and strategic planning.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Service Line Reporting Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of service used to measure cost center activity and calculate cost per unit. Examples include patient days, procedures, visits, tests, hours, admissions. Varies by cost center type and service line.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core transactional record of every journal entry posted to the general ledger. Captures journal entry number, journal source (manual, system-generated, recurring, reversing), journal category (accrual, cash receipt, payroll, depreciation, intercompany), accounting period, fiscal year, posting date, effective date, total debit amount, total credit amount, currency code, exchange rate, preparer ID, approver ID, approval date, posting status (draft, approved, posted, reversed), reversal indicator, reversal journal entry reference, and supporting document reference. SSOT for all GL postings.
products.reference: Journal Entry (JE)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the journal entry for posting. Required for entries subject to approval workflow.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary cost center associated with this journal entry. Used for departmental and responsibility accounting.

attributes.name: financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity or business unit to which this journal entry belongs. Critical for multi-entity consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: journal_entry has accounting_period (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to fiscal_period master. Enables joining to get period details (start_date, end_date, period_status, close_date) and ensur

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that prepared or created the journal entry. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_reversal_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the journal entry that reversed this entry, if applicable. Null if the entry has not been reversed.

attributes.name: recurring_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recurring schedule template from which this entry was generated, if applicable. Null for non-recurring entries.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of adjustment entries. Identifies whether the entry is a standard posting, prior period adjustment, audit adjustment, reclassification, or error correction.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, FASB ASC 250

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was approved by the designated approver. Null for entries not requiring approval or pending approval.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this journal entry to external audit documentation or audit trail systems. Used for regulatory compliance and audit support.

attributes.name: batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of journal entries processed together. Used for bulk posting and batch reconciliation.

attributes.name: consolidation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is included in consolidated financial reporting. True if included, False if excluded.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date for which the journal entry is effective. This may differ from the posting date and represents the actual accounting period impact date.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency amounts to the functional currency, if applicable. Null for entries in functional currency.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry belongs. Used for annual financial reporting and multi-year analysis.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code for the functional currency of the reporting entity. Used when the entry currency differs from the functional currency.

attributes.name: gl_interface_status
attributes.description: Status of the journal entry in the interface process to the general ledger system. Tracks whether the entry has been successfully transmitted and accepted.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between related entities. True for intercompany, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: journal_category
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by accounting treatment type. Common categories include accrual entries, cash receipts, payroll postings, depreciation calculations, intercompany transactions, and adjusting entries.

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the purpose and nature of the journal entry. Provides business context for the accounting transaction.

attributes.name: journal_entry_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the journal entry, typically a sequential or formatted number used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: journal_source
attributes.description: Origin or method by which the journal entry was created. Indicates whether the entry was manually entered, automatically generated by a system process, part of a recurring schedule, or a reversing entry.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this journal entry record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments related to the journal entry. Used for supplementary information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Null for entries not yet posted.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the system date when the entry became part of the official accounting records.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Tracks progression from draft through approval, posting, and potential reversal.

attributes.name: recurring_entry_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is part of a recurring schedule. True for recurring entries, False for one-time entries.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry impacts regulatory reporting requirements such as CMS cost reports or state financial filings. True if reportable, False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS - Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, HHS - Department of Health and Human Services

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry was reversed. Null if the entry has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry has been reversed. True if reversed, False if active.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing this journal entry, if applicable. Examples include error correction, period adjustment, or policy change.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system or module that generated this journal entry. Examples include Epic Resolute, SAP FI, Workday, or manual entry.

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating transaction in the source system that triggered this journal entry. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to supporting documentation for this journal entry, such as invoices, contracts, or approval memos. Used for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total debit amount for a balanced entry.

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total credit amount for a balanced entry.

attributes.name: reversing_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on journal_entry (reversing_journal_entry_id)

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit or credit line within a journal entry, representing the atomic unit of GL posting. Captures journal entry reference, line sequence number, GL account code, cost center code, fund code, project code, debit amount, credit amount, functional currency amount, transaction currency amount, exchange rate, line description, intercompany indicator, intercompany entity, statistical amount, statistical UOM, and segment values (department, location, program). Enables full account-level drill-down for financial reporting and audit.
products.reference: Journal Entry Line

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line. Primary key for the journal entry line product.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: journal_entry_line has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to a FK to chart_of_accounts master. This establishes referential integrity and allows joining to get account_name, account_t

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: journal_entry_line has cost_center_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to cost_center master. Enables joining to get cost center details for journal entry line allocation.

attributes.name: drg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.drg. Business justification: Healthcare finance requires linking journal entries to DRGs for Medicare cost reporting, case-mix analysis, and reimbursement reconciliation. The existing drg_code string should be replaced with a pro

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: journal_entry_line has accounting_period (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to fiscal_period master. Enables joining to get period details at the line level. Note: journal_entry already has fis

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: journal_entry_line has fund_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to fund master. Enables joining to get fund details for fund accounting at the journal entry line level.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header that this line belongs to. Links the line to its containing journal entry batch.

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person or system account that created this journal entry line. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: reversed_line_journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry line that this line reverses. Null if this is not a reversal entry. Provides audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: tertiary_journal_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved this journal entry line for posting. Null if not yet approved. Used for segregation of duties and internal controls.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line was approved for posting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if not yet approved. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount for this journal entry line in functional currency. Zero or null if this is a debit line. Credits increase liability, equity, and revenue accounts.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount for this journal entry line in functional currency. Zero or null if this is a credit line. Debits increase asset and expense accounts.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department segment code for detailed organizational reporting. Provides finer granularity than cost center for departmental analysis.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to functional currency. Expressed as functional currency per unit of transaction currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry line belongs. Used for annual financial reporting and multi-year analysis.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The functional currency of the organization in which the debit and credit amounts are recorded. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: intercompany_entity_code
attributes.description: The code of the counterparty legal entity for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries during consolidation.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line represents an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the healthcare system. True if intercompany, false otherwise.

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the purpose and nature of this specific journal entry line. Provides audit trail and business context for the posting.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry, used for ordering and referencing individual lines within the entry.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or facility code where the transaction occurred. Used for multi-site healthcare systems to track financial activity by hospital, clinic, or facility.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry line record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: natural_account_code
attributes.description: Natural account classification code representing the type of expense or revenue (e.g., salaries, supplies, utilities). Part of the chart of accounts structure.

attributes.name: payer_code
attributes.description: Payer or insurance plan code for revenue and receivables tracking. Used to analyze financial performance by payer mix (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial, self-pay).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this journal entry line was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current posting status of the journal entry line. Tracks the lifecycle from draft through posting to final state. Posted lines affect the general ledger balances.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Program or service line code for program-based reporting. Examples include cardiology, oncology, orthopedics, or community health programs.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Project or grant identifier for project-based accounting. Used to track capital projects, research grants, and special initiatives.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when this journal entry line was reconciled. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if not yet reconciled. Used for account reconciliation tracking.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The reconciliation status of this journal entry line. Tracks whether the line has been reconciled with supporting documentation or subsidiary ledgers.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line is part of a reversing journal entry. True if this line reverses a prior entry, false for original postings.

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the source document that generated this journal entry line (e.g., invoice number, payment batch number, payroll run ID). Provides audit trail to originating transaction.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The source system or module that originated this journal entry line. Examples include Epic (Resolute), SAP FI, Workday Financials, or manual entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: epic|cerner|sap|workday|meditech|manual|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: statistical_amount
attributes.description: Non-monetary statistical quantity associated with this line, such as patient days, procedures performed, or full-time equivalents (FTE). Used for cost allocation and unit cost analysis.

attributes.name: statistical_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the statistical amount. Common healthcare units include patient days, procedures, FTE (full-time equivalents), visits, admissions, discharges, bed days, and RVUs (relative value units). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: patient_days|procedures|fte|visits|admissions|discharges|bed_days|rvus|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The original transaction amount in transaction currency before conversion to functional currency. Used for foreign currency accounting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The original transaction currency if different from functional currency. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Used for foreign currency transactions.

attributes.name: offset_journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on journal_entry_line (offset_journal_entry_line_id)

products.name: fiscal_period
products.description: Reference master defining all fiscal periods, quarters, and fiscal years for the healthcare organization's financial calendar. Captures period name, period number, fiscal year, period type (month, quarter, year), start date, end date, period status (open, closed, permanently closed, future), close date, ledger association, and period-end close checklist completion flag. Controls which periods are open for journal entry posting and drives financial period-end close workflows.
products.reference: Fiscal Period / Accounting Period

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fiscal period record. Primary key.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger to which this fiscal period applies. Supports multi-ledger environments (e.g., corporate ledger, statutory ledger, management ledger).

attributes.name: parent_period_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fiscal period in a hierarchical structure (e.g., a monthly period references its parent quarter, a quarter references its parent year). Null for top-level periods.

attributes.name: primary_prior_period_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding fiscal period of the same type. Used for period-over-period comparisons and sequential processing.

attributes.name: adjustment_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an adjustment period used for year-end closing entries. True if adjustment period, False otherwise.

attributes.name: budget_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period is used for budget planning and allocation. True if budget period, False otherwise.

attributes.name: business_days_in_period
attributes.description: The total number of business days (excluding weekends and holidays) in the fiscal period. Used for operational and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: calendar_month
attributes.description: The calendar month in which the fiscal period starts (1-12). Null for non-monthly periods.

attributes.name: calendar_quarter
attributes.description: The calendar quarter in which the fiscal period starts (1, 2, 3, or 4). Null for non-monthly periods.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the fiscal period starts (e.g., 2024). May differ from fiscal_year for organizations with non-calendar fiscal years.

attributes.name: close_approved_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who approved the period close. Used for segregation of duties and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was closed. Null if the period is still open or future. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: close_initiated_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who initiated the period close process. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cms_reporting_period_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reporting Period Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period is used for CMS cost reporting and reimbursement submissions. True if CMS reporting period, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: The total number of calendar days in the fiscal period. Calculated as end_date minus start_date plus one.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the fiscal period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_description
attributes.description: Additional descriptive text or notes about the fiscal period, such as special circumstances, adjustments, or business context.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: period_end_close_checklist_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all period-end close checklist tasks have been completed for this period. True if complete, False otherwise.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fiscal period (e.g., 'January 2024', 'Q1 FY2024', 'FY2024').

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the period within the fiscal year (e.g., 1 for January, 2 for February, or 1 for Q1).

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fiscal period: future (not yet started), open (available for journal entry posting), closed (temporarily closed, can be reopened), permanently_closed (locked, no further entries allowed).

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Type of fiscal period: month (monthly period), quarter (quarterly period), year (annual period), or adjustment (adjustment period for year-end entries).

attributes.name: permanent_close_date
attributes.description: The date when the fiscal period was permanently closed and locked from further entries. Null if not permanently closed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: quarter_number
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number within the fiscal year (1, 2, 3, or 4). Null for non-monthly periods or adjustment periods.

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: The date when a previously closed period was reopened for adjustments. Null if never reopened. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reporting_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fiscal period is used for external financial reporting (e.g., quarterly earnings, annual reports). True if reporting period, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting Standards, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the fiscal period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fiscal period record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: parent_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fiscal_period (parent_fiscal_period_id)

products.name: budget
products.description: Master record for each approved operating or capital budget for the healthcare organization. Captures budget name, budget type (operating, capital, cash flow, grant), fiscal year, budget version (original, revised, final), budget status (draft, submitted, approved, active, closed), approval date, approver, total budgeted revenue, total budgeted expense, total budgeted capital, budget methodology (zero-based, incremental, activity-based), associated cost center or department, and budget narrative. SSOT for all budget authorizations.
products.reference: Operating Budget / Capital Budget

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or executive who approved this budget.

attributes.name: budget_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who owns and is accountable for this budget.

attributes.name: budget_last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who last modified this budget record.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) to which this budget applies.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center or department to which this budget is assigned.

attributes.name: financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_entity. Business justification: budget should link to financial_entity to identify which legal entity the budget belongs to. This is essential for multi-entity healthcare organizations to track budgets by subsidiary. No existing att

attributes.name: fte_budget_id

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department responsible for this budget.

attributes.name: parent_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent or master budget if this budget is a sub-budget or departmental allocation within a larger organizational budget.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Budgets are allocated to positions (budgeted headcount). Links budget line items to specific authorized positions for variance analysis, vacancy tracking, and position control reporting required for w

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget was officially approved by authorized management or board.

attributes.name: assumptions
attributes.description: Key assumptions underlying the budget (e.g., inflation rate, patient volume growth, reimbursement rate changes).

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level expense category classification for the budget: personnel (salaries, benefits), supplies (medical and office), equipment (capital purchases), facilities (rent, utilities), services (contracted), overhead (indirect costs), or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personnel|supplies|equipment|facilities|services|overhead|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the budget (e.g., 'FY2024 Operating Budget - Cardiology Department').

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the budget, used in financial reporting and communications.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget: draft (being prepared), submitted (awaiting review), under_review (in approval process), approved (authorized but not yet active), active (in effect), closed (fiscal period ended), cancelled (withdrawn). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|active|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by its purpose: operating (day-to-day expenses), capital (long-term investments), cash flow (liquidity planning), grant (externally funded), project (specific initiative), or departmental (unit-level).

attributes.name: budgeted_cmi
attributes.description: Projected average case mix index reflecting the expected complexity and resource intensity of patient cases.

attributes.name: budgeted_fte_count
attributes.description: Total number of full-time equivalent staff positions budgeted for the period.

attributes.name: budgeted_net_income
attributes.description: Projected net income (revenue minus expenses) for the fiscal period, in USD.

attributes.name: budgeted_patient_volume
attributes.description: Projected number of patient encounters or admissions for the fiscal period, used for volume-based budgeting.
attributes.references: CMS Quality Reporting and Volume Metrics

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget period ends and the budget is closed.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget becomes effective and active for financial tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget applies (e.g., 2024 for FY2024).
attributes.references: GAAP and FASB Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for this budget: internal operations, federal grant, state grant, private foundation, donor contribution, research contract, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|federal_grant|state_grant|private_foundation|donor|research_contract|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Grant Management Standards (OMB Uniform Guidance)

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: External grant or funding source identifier if this budget is associated with a specific grant award.
attributes.references: Federal Grant Management Standards (OMB Uniform Guidance)

attributes.name: is_baseline_budget
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the baseline (original approved) budget used for variance analysis. True if baseline, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: methodology
attributes.description: Budgeting approach used: zero_based (justify all expenses from zero), incremental (adjust prior year), activity_based (cost by activity), value_based (align with value drivers), rolling (continuous forecast).
attributes.references: GAAP and Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Detailed textual description or justification of the budget, including assumptions, strategic priorities, and key drivers.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, comments, or special instructions related to the budget.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget was formally submitted for review and approval.

attributes.name: total_budgeted_capital
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure amount budgeted for long-term investments (equipment, facilities, technology), in USD.

attributes.name: total_budgeted_expense
attributes.description: Total operating expense amount budgeted for the fiscal period, in USD.

attributes.name: total_budgeted_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue amount budgeted for the fiscal period, in USD.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable variance percentage threshold for budget-to-actual monitoring; triggers review if exceeded.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the budget: original (initial submission), revised (mid-year adjustment), final (approved version), supplemental (additional allocation).

attributes.name: prior_budget_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on budget (prior_budget_id)

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within an approved budget, representing the granular allocation of budgeted amounts by account, cost center, and period. Captures budget reference, GL account code, cost center code, fund code, service line, fiscal period, budgeted amount, budget category (salary, benefits, supplies, purchased services, depreciation, capital), FTE count budgeted, volume assumption, statistical basis, and line notes. Enables variance analysis between actual and budgeted amounts at the account-period level.
products.reference: Budget Line Item

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget line item. Primary key for the budget line entity.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent budget document or master budget to which this line item belongs.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: budget_line has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Enables joining to get account metadata and ensures budget lines reference valid GL accounts.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: budget_line has cost_center_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to cost_center master. Enables joining to get cost_center_name, cost_center_type, and ensures referential integrity.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: budget_line has fund_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to fund master. Enables joining to get fund_name, fund_type, restriction_type, and ensures budget lines reference valid funds.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate indirect costs or shared expenses to this budget line (e.g., direct, step-down, activity-based, proportional).
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total cost allocated to this budget line when using proportional or percentage-based allocation methods.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this budget line item in the budget approval workflow.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved this budget line item.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget line item was approved.

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: The approved budgeted dollar amount allocated to this line item for the specified period. Primary financial measure for variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budgeted amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency budget management.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget line ceases to be effective. Null for ongoing budget lines.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this budget line becomes effective and active for financial tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period within the year (e.g., Q1, Q2, M01, M02, FY for full year). Enables period-level budget tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget line applies (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: fte_count
attributes.description: Number of full-time equivalent positions budgeted for this line item. Applicable primarily to salary and benefits budget lines.

attributes.name: is_capital
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line represents a capital expenditure (True) or operating expenditure (False).
attributes.references: GAAP Capital vs Operating Expense Classification

attributes.name: is_restricted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line is funded by restricted funds (True) or unrestricted funds (False). Common in not-for-profit healthcare organizations.

attributes.name: line_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, assumptions, or justification for this budget line item.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent budget document for ordering and reference purposes.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who last modified this budget line record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget line record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: prior_year_actual
attributes.description: Actual expenditure amount for this line item in the prior fiscal year. Used for trend analysis and budget variance comparison.

attributes.name: service_line_code
attributes.description: Clinical or operational service line code (e.g., cardiology, orthopedics, emergency services) for service line profitability and budget management.

attributes.name: statistical_basis
attributes.description: Description of the statistical or actuarial basis used to calculate this budget line (e.g., historical trend, regression model, industry benchmark, clinical guideline).
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Budget Standards

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable variance threshold percentage for this budget line. Variances exceeding this threshold trigger management review or corrective action.

attributes.name: volume_assumption
attributes.description: The volume metric assumption underlying this budget line (e.g., patient days, procedures, visits, admissions). Used for flexible budgeting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Budget Standards

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume assumption (e.g., patient days, procedures, visits, admissions, discharges, RVUs).
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Budget Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created this budget line record. Audit trail field.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on budget_line (parent_budget_line_id)

products.name: budget_transfer
products.description: Transactional record of approved budget transfers and amendments between cost centers, accounts, or periods within an approved budget. Captures transfer date, transfer type (budget amendment, budget transfer, budget revision), source budget line, destination budget line, transfer amount, transfer reason, requestor, approver, approval date, and supporting documentation reference. Maintains a complete audit trail of all budget modifications post-approval.
products.reference: Budget Transfer / Budget Amendment

attributes.name: budget_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget transfer transaction. Primary key for the budget transfer record.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the budget transfer. Links to the employee master data for authorization tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: destination_budget_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific budget line item to which funds are being transferred. Links to the budget line master data.

attributes.name: destination_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center, department, or organizational unit to which budget funds are being transferred. Links to the cost center master data.

attributes.name: destination_gl_account_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general ledger account to which budget funds are being transferred. Links to the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting Module

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Budget Transfer Created By User ID
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who created this budget transfer record in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general ledger journal entry that recorded this budget transfer in the financial system. Links to the journal entry master data for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting Module

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Budget Transfer Modified By User ID
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who last modified this budget transfer record. Part of standard audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: original_transfer_budget_transfer_id
attributes.description: If this transfer is a reversal or correction of a previous transfer, this field contains the budget_transfer_id of the original transfer being reversed. Null for original transfers.

attributes.name: primary_budget_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general ledger account from which budget funds are being transferred. Links to the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting Module

attributes.name: primary_budget_requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who initiated or requested the budget transfer. Links to the employee master data for accountability tracking.

attributes.name: source_budget_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific budget line item from which funds are being transferred. Links to the budget line master data.

attributes.name: source_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center, department, or organizational unit from which budget funds are being transferred. Links to the cost center master data.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the budget transfer was formally approved by the authorized approver. Null if transfer is not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational level at which the budget transfer was approved, indicating the authority level required based on transfer amount and type: department_manager, director, vice_president, chief_financial_officer (CFO), or board_of_directors.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who approved the budget transfer, captured for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the complete audit trail or change log for this budget transfer, linking to detailed history of all modifications and approvals.

attributes.name: batch_code

attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this budget transfer complies with all applicable financial policies, regulatory requirements, and budget constraints. True if compliant, False if exceptions exist.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting compliance review findings, exceptions, or special considerations related to regulatory or policy requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this budget transfer record was first created in the database. Part of standard audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget transfer applies, typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). Critical for period-based budget management and year-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this budget transfer record was last modified in the database. Part of standard audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: requestor_department
attributes.description: Name of the department or organizational unit of the employee who requested the transfer, for organizational analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: requestor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who requested the budget transfer, captured for audit trail and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget transfer was reversed or undone. Null if the transfer has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this budget transfer has been reversed or undone. True if reversed, False if still in effect.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why the budget transfer was reversed, including business justification and corrective action taken.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to supporting documentation for the budget transfer (e.g., memo, business case, board resolution, email approval). Critical for audit trail and compliance.

attributes.name: transfer_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value being transferred from the source budget line to the destination budget line. Always positive; direction is indicated by source/destination fields.

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The business date when the budget transfer was initiated or became effective. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction, distinct from audit timestamps.

attributes.name: transfer_number

attributes.name: gl_date

attributes.name: hold_date

attributes.name: hold_reason_code

attributes.name: invoice_amount

attributes.name: invoice_currency_code

attributes.name: invoice_date

attributes.name: invoice_number

attributes.name: invoice_source

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow: received (entered into system), validated (passed data quality checks), matched (matched to PO and receipt), approved (approved for payment), on_hold (payment hold applied), scheduled_for_payment (queued for payment run), paid (payment issued), cancelled (invoice voided), or rejected (invoice returned to vendor). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|validated|matched|approved|on_hold|scheduled_for_payment|paid|cancelled|rejected — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: The classification of the invoice transaction: standard invoice for goods/services, credit memo for returns/adjustments, debit memo for additional charges, prepayment for advance payments, expense report for employee reimbursements, or recurring for subscription-based invoices.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to pay this invoice: check (paper check), ach (Automated Clearing House), wire_transfer (bank wire), eft (Electronic Funds Transfer), credit_card (corporate card), or virtual_card (single-use virtual card).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The check number, ACH trace number, wire confirmation number, or other payment transaction identifier.

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: po_match_indicator

attributes.name: po_number

attributes.name: received_date

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: tax_code

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: The status of the three-way match process (PO, receipt, invoice): not_applicable (non-PO invoice), pending (match in progress), matched (all three documents reconciled), variance (discrepancies identified within tolerance), or failed (discrepancies exceed tolerance).

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: The net total amount payable to the vendor, calculated as invoice_amount + tax_amount + freight_amount - discount_amount.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this invoice record was last modified in the accounts payable system.

attributes.name: voucher_number
attributes.description: The internal accounting voucher number assigned to this invoice for general ledger posting and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: credited_ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ap_invoice (credited_ap_invoice_id)

products.name: ap_invoice_line

attributes.name: ap_invoice_line_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: fund_id

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
