attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order_line. Business justification: Invoice lines must link to PO lines for three-way match validation (PO-receipt-invoice), price variance analysis, and automated GL account inheritance from PO. Core AP matching process.

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who requested or authorized this purchase. Supports accountability and spend analysis by requester.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Asset category or class for capital items. Determines depreciation method, useful life, and financial statement classification for capitalized purchases.

attributes.name: asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents a capital asset purchase that should be capitalized rather than expensed. Triggers asset tracking and depreciation processes.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Vendor contract or agreement number governing the pricing and terms for this line item. Links the invoice to negotiated contract terms for compliance verification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this invoice line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount applied to this line item. May represent volume discounts, promotional discounts, or negotiated contract pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: distribution_date
attributes.description: Date when this line item was distributed and posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period in which the expense is recognized.

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Status of general ledger distribution for this line item. Indicates whether the expense has been posted to the general ledger and financial statements.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is on hold and blocked from payment. Used to prevent payment pending resolution of issues or additional approvals.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why this line item is on hold. Documents the issue preventing payment and guides resolution activities.

attributes.name: item_code
attributes.description: Vendor or internal catalog item code identifying the specific product or service being purchased. Used for inventory tracking and spend analysis.

attributes.name: line_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for this line item before taxes and adjustments. Typically calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price.

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the goods or services being billed on this line. Provides context for the charge and supports audit and reconciliation activities.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items on the invoice.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this invoice line item. Tracks the line through the approval, matching, and payment workflow.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Facility or location code where this expense will be utilized or allocated. Supports multi-site cost allocation and facility-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: match_exception_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for match exceptions or variances. Documents why the invoice line does not match the PO or receipt (e.g., price variance, quantity variance).

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Status of three-way matching (PO-receipt-invoice) for this line item. Indicates whether the invoice line has been successfully matched to purchase order and goods receipt.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this invoice line record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to support change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about this line item. Captures additional context, special instructions, or explanations for unusual transactions.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Program or service line code for this expense. Used to allocate costs to specific clinical programs or service lines for profitability analysis.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Project or capital initiative code if this line item is associated with a specific project. Enables project-based cost tracking and capital budgeting.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of items or units of service being billed on this line. Used in conjunction with unit price to calculate line amount.

attributes.name: service_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period covered by this line item. Used with start date to determine expense allocation across accounting periods for prepaid services.

attributes.name: service_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period covered by this line item. Used for service-based invoices to determine the period of benefit and expense recognition timing.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this line item. Includes sales tax, use tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and item taxability.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining the tax treatment and rate for this line item. Used to calculate applicable taxes based on jurisdiction and item type.

attributes.name: total_line_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including taxes and discounts. Represents the net amount payable to the vendor for this line.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field. Defines how the quantity is counted or measured (e.g., each, box, hour, kilogram). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|box|case|unit|hour|day|month|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure for this line item. Multiplied by quantity to derive the line amount before taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: credited_ap_invoice_line_id

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was approved for disbursement. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: check_number

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount

attributes.name: exchange_rate

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the organization's functional currency (typically USD for US-based healthcare organizations) using the exchange rate.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: payment_amount

attributes.name: payment_date

attributes.name: payment_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo field providing additional context about the payment purpose or contents.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method or instrument used to disburse the payment. Common values: check (paper check), ach (Automated Clearing House), eft (Electronic Funds Transfer), wire_transfer, virtual_card, cash.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique payment identifier or check number assigned by the financial system. Used for external reference and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the payment for processing. Values: standard (normal processing), urgent (high priority), expedited (rush processing).

attributes.name: payment_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Bank reconciliation status of the payment. Values: unreconciled (not yet matched to bank statement), reconciled (matched and cleared), exception (discrepancy identified).

attributes.name: payment_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source financial system that originated this payment record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Epic Resolute PB).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment. Values: issued (payment created and sent), cleared (payment successfully processed by bank), voided (payment cancelled before clearing), stopped (stop payment placed), cancelled (payment cancelled), pending (awaiting approval or processing).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to this payment (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Reflects the terms under which the vendor invoices were paid.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment transaction type. Values: invoice_payment (standard vendor invoice payment), prepayment (advance payment), refund (return of funds), expense_reimbursement (employee expense reimbursement).

attributes.name: reconciled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was reconciled against the bank statement. Null if not yet reconciled.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the remittance advice document sent to the vendor detailing which invoices this payment settles.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was voided or cancelled. Null if payment has not been voided.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or explanation for why the payment was voided. Null if payment has not been voided.

attributes.name: wire_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Bank confirmation or reference number for wire transfer payments. Null for non-wire payment methods.

attributes.name: voided_ap_payment_id

attributes.name: ar_account_id

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: ar_account has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Enables joining to get account metadata for the receivable GL account.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: primary_ar_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal staff member or external collection agency assigned to manage collection activities for this account. Used for workload distribution, performance tracking, and accountability.

attributes.name: quaternary_ar_assigned_collector_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quaternary Ar Assigned Collector Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: tertiary_ar_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the person or process that most recently modified this AR account record. Used for accountability, audit trail, and change management.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number assigned to this receivable account. Used for identification in financial systems and external communications with debtors.

attributes.name: account_status

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|closed|written_off|in_collections|disputed|on_hold|pending_resolution — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable account indicating the nature of the financial relationship. Distinguishes between payer receivables, self-pay patient receivables, intercompany transactions, grant funding, physician practice management fees, rental income, and other non-RCM receivables. Note: This is for non-patient-billing AR; patient billing AR is managed in billing.patient_account. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payer|self_pay|intercompany|grant|physician_practice_management|rental_income|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Categorization of the receivable based on the number of days outstanding since the original invoice or billing date. Used for aging analysis, collection prioritization, and allowance for doubtful accounts estimation. Current indicates not yet due; subsequent buckets indicate days past due.

attributes.name: collection_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external third-party collection agency to which this account has been referred, if applicable. Null if account is managed internally or not yet in collections.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AR account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and account lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency denomination of all monetary amounts on this account. Defaults to USD for domestic operations; supports multi-currency for international grants or intercompany receivables.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding receivable balance as of the current date. Reflects original balance minus payments received, plus any adjustments, interest, or fees. This is the amount currently owed. Denominated in USD unless otherwise specified in currency_code.

attributes.name: days_outstanding
attributes.description: The number of calendar days that have elapsed since the original invoice or billing date. Used to calculate aging bucket and assess collection risk. Key metric for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) reporting.

attributes.name: debtor_name
attributes.description: The legal or business name of the entity or individual that owes payment on this receivable account. May be a payer organization, self-pay patient, affiliated entity, grantor, or other debtor.

attributes.name: debtor_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the debtor entity. Segments debtors into commercial insurance payers, government payers (Medicare, Medicaid), self-pay individuals, affiliated healthcare entities, grant-making organizations, corporate tenants, and other categories for reporting and collection strategy purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial_payer|government_payer|self_pay_individual|affiliated_entity|grant_organization|corporate_tenant|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debtor formally notified the organization of the dispute. Used to track dispute aging and ensure timely resolution per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the debtor has formally disputed the receivable amount or validity. True indicates an active dispute; false indicates no dispute. Disputed accounts typically require special handling and may be placed on hold pending resolution.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason provided by the debtor for disputing the receivable, such as services not rendered, incorrect billing amount, duplicate invoice, or contractual disagreement. Used to guide dispute resolution process.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is contractually due per the invoice terms or agreement. Used to determine whether the account is current or past due and to calculate late fees or interest if applicable.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to overdue balances on this account, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%). Null if no interest is charged. Used to calculate interest charges on past-due amounts per contractual terms or state regulations.
attributes.references: State Usury Laws and Contract Terms

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original invoice or billing statement was issued to the debtor. Serves as the starting point for aging calculations and payment term enforcement.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which any activity occurred on this account, including payments received, adjustments posted, collection calls made, correspondence sent, or status changes. Used to identify dormant accounts and prioritize follow-up.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AR account record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the most recent payment received on this account. Denominated in the account's currency_code. Used for payment trend analysis and debtor behavior assessment.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent payment was received and posted to this account. Used to assess payment patterns and predict future payment likelihood.

attributes.name: legal_action_date
attributes.description: The date on which legal action was initiated for collection of this receivable. Null if no legal action has been taken. Used for legal case tracking and statute of limitations monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_action_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether legal action (lawsuit, lien, garnishment) has been initiated to collect this receivable. True indicates active legal proceedings; false indicates no legal action. Used for legal department coordination and risk management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording important notes, comments, or special instructions related to this account. May include collection history, debtor communication summaries, special handling requirements, or internal coordination notes.

attributes.name: original_balance
attributes.description: The initial receivable amount established when the account was opened. Represents the total amount originally owed before any payments, adjustments, or write-offs. Denominated in USD unless otherwise specified in currency_code.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The contractual payment terms agreed upon with the debtor, typically expressed as net days (e.g., Net 30, Net 60) or other terms such as due on receipt, installment plan, or custom terms. Defines the expected payment timeline.

attributes.name: settlement_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the debtor has accepted a settlement offer. True indicates acceptance; false indicates no acceptance or no offer made. Used to track settlement negotiations and finalize account closure.

attributes.name: settlement_offer_amount
attributes.description: The reduced amount offered to the debtor as a settlement to close the account, if applicable. Typically less than current_balance. Null if no settlement has been offered. Denominated in the account's currency_code.

attributes.name: total_adjustments
attributes.description: The cumulative sum of all adjustments (positive or negative) applied to this account, including billing corrections, contractual allowances, courtesy adjustments, and dispute resolutions. Denominated in the account's currency_code.

attributes.name: total_fees_assessed
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of late fees, collection fees, administrative fees, or other charges assessed on this account. Included in the current_balance. Denominated in the account's currency_code.

attributes.name: total_interest_accrued
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of interest that has accrued on this account due to late payment. Included in the current_balance. Denominated in the account's currency_code.

attributes.name: total_payments_received
attributes.description: The cumulative sum of all payments received on this account since inception. Used to calculate current_balance and assess payment history. Denominated in the account's currency_code.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The amount written off as uncollectible bad debt. Populated when account_status is written_off. Represents the portion of the receivable removed from active AR and recognized as a loss. Denominated in the account's currency_code.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the receivable was written off as uncollectible. Null if the account has not been written off. Used for bad debt reporting and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or categorization of why the receivable was written off, such as debtor bankruptcy, inability to locate debtor, cost of collection exceeds balance, statute of limitations expired, or management decision. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: parent_ar_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ar_account (parent_ar_account_id)

products.name: ar_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of every accounts receivable financial event including charges, payments received, adjustments, and write-offs for non-RCM AR accounts. Captures transaction date, transaction type (charge, payment, credit memo, adjustment, write-off), AR account reference, GL account, cost center, amount, currency, reference document number, transaction description, posting period, and posting status. Provides the complete AR subledger transaction history for reconciliation and aging analysis.
products.reference: AR Transaction / AR Subledger Entry

attributes.name: ar_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable transaction record. Primary key for the AR transaction subledger.

attributes.name: applied_to_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the charge transaction that this payment, credit memo, or adjustment is applied against. Enables payment application tracking and open item reconciliation.

attributes.name: ar_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AR account (non-RCM receivable account) associated with this transaction. Links to the AR account master for customer or entity billing relationships outside of revenue cycle management.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of transactions processed together. Used for batch reconciliation and control totals validation.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: ar_transaction has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Enables joining to get account metadata for the GL account affected by the AR transaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: ar_transaction has cost_center_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to cost_center master. Enables joining to get cost center details for AR transaction allocation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: ar_transaction has posting_period (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to fiscal_period master. Enables joining to get period details and ensures AR transactions reference valid fiscal periods.

attributes.name: primary_ar_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created or entered this AR transaction into the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_ar_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original AR transaction that this entry reverses. Null for non-reversal transactions. Creates audit trail for transaction corrections.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for adjustment transactions: billing error, pricing correction, contractual adjustment, goodwill credit. Null for non-adjustment transactions.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Calculated aging category based on days outstanding from transaction date to current date: current (0 days), 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, or over 90 days. Used for AR aging analysis and collection prioritization.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this AR transaction was approved for posting. Null for transactions not requiring approval or still pending approval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this AR transaction record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Supports multi-currency AR management and foreign exchange reconciliation.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is expected or required for charge transactions. Used to calculate days outstanding and aging. Null for payment and adjustment transactions.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to functional currency. Null for transactions in functional currency.

attributes.name: functional_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the organization's functional reporting currency (typically USD) using the exchange rate at transaction date. Used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this AR transaction record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about the transaction providing supplementary context for accounting staff, auditors, or management review.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used for payment transactions: check, wire transfer, ACH, credit card, cash, or electronic funds transfer. Null for non-payment transaction types.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number such as check number, wire confirmation, or ACH trace number. Used for payment reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the transaction was posted to the general ledger and became part of the official financial record.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current posting status of the AR transaction: draft (not yet posted), posted (finalized in GL), reversed (cancelled with offsetting entry), voided (cancelled before posting), or pending_approval (awaiting authorization).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when this transaction was reconciled and cleared. Null for unreconciled transactions.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the transaction in the AR reconciliation process: unreconciled (not yet matched), reconciled (matched and cleared), disputed (discrepancy identified), or under_review (being investigated).

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this AR transaction to source documents such as invoices, payment receipts, credit memos, or adjustment authorizations.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this transaction is a reversal entry that offsets a previously posted transaction. True for reversal entries, False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system or module that created this AR transaction: SAP FI, Workday Financials, manual entry, interface from external system.

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source system. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation back to operational systems.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the transaction amount for charge transactions. Used for tax reporting and reconciliation. Null for non-taxable transactions.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or tax type code applied to this transaction. Used for tax reporting and compliance with state and federal tax regulations.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the AR transaction in the transaction currency. Positive for charges and debits, negative for payments and credits.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date when the AR transaction event occurred. This is the principal event timestamp for aging analysis and financial period assignment.

attributes.name: transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text business description of the AR transaction providing context about the nature of the charge, payment, or adjustment.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or document reference assigned to this AR transaction for external communication and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AR transaction event: charge (new receivable), payment (cash received), credit_memo (reduction), debit_memo (increase), adjustment (correction), write_off (uncollectible), or refund (payment reversal). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charge|payment|credit_memo|debit_memo|adjustment|write_off|refund — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for write-off transactions: bad debt, small balance, bankruptcy, deceased, statute of limitations. Null for non-write-off transactions.

attributes.name: reversed_ar_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ar_transaction (reversed_ar_transaction_id)

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Master record for every capitalized fixed asset owned or leased by the healthcare organization, including medical equipment, buildings, land, leasehold improvements, IT infrastructure, and vehicles. Captures asset tag number, asset name, asset description, asset category (medical equipment, building, land, furniture, IT equipment, vehicle), acquisition date, placed-in-service date, acquisition cost, salvage value, useful life (years), depreciation method (straight-line, MACRS, units of production), accumulated depreciation, net book value, asset status (active, disposed, transferred, fully depreciated), physical location, responsible cost center, and vendor/manufacturer.
products.reference: Fixed Asset / Capital Asset

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset entity.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility where the fixed asset is physically located and assigned for operational use.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: fixed_asset has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Enables joining to get the GL asset account for the fixed asset.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center or department responsible for the fixed asset and to which depreciation expense is allocated for financial reporting and budgeting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since the asset was placed in service. Contra-asset account that reduces the gross book value. Recorded in USD.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of acquiring the fixed asset including purchase price, installation costs, freight, and other costs necessary to prepare the asset for its intended use. Recorded in USD.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the healthcare organization legally acquired ownership or control of the fixed asset through purchase, donation, or construction completion.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the fixed asset type. Medical equipment includes diagnostic and treatment devices; buildings include owned structures; land includes real property; leasehold improvements include tenant modifications; IT equipment includes servers and network infrastructure; vehicles include ambulances and transport.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fixed asset including specifications, model information, and distinguishing characteristics.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the fixed asset for identification and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Active indicates in-service use; disposed indicates sold or scrapped; transferred indicates moved to another entity; fully depreciated indicates zero net book value but still in use; under construction indicates not yet placed in service; retired indicates removed from service.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the asset category (e.g., MRI scanner, CT scanner, ultrasound machine for medical equipment category).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Unique physical identifier affixed to the asset for tracking and inventory purposes. Externally visible barcode or RFID tag number used in physical audits.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_met
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset acquisition cost met or exceeded the organization's capitalization threshold policy. True indicates the asset was properly capitalized; False would indicate an expense treatment.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to systematically allocate the cost of the fixed asset over its useful life. Straight-line allocates evenly; declining balance accelerates early depreciation; MACRS (Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System) follows IRS tax rules; units of production bases depreciation on usage; sum of years digits accelerates depreciation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was disposed of through sale, donation, scrapping, or other removal from service. Null for active assets.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the fixed asset was disposed. Sold indicates sale to third party; donated indicates charitable contribution; scrapped indicates destruction; traded in indicates exchange for new asset; returned to lessor indicates lease termination; transferred indicates internal move to another entity.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value of consideration received from disposal of the fixed asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal. Recorded in USD.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: fda_device_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Device Class
attributes.description: FDA classification of the medical device based on risk level. Class I is low risk; Class II is moderate risk; Class III is high risk. Not applicable for non-medical equipment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 860 - Medical Device Classification

attributes.name: fda_regulated_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Regulated Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the fixed asset is a medical device or equipment subject to FDA regulatory oversight and compliance requirements. True for FDA-regulated medical equipment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 - Quality System Regulation

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum insured value or coverage limit for the fixed asset under the insurance policy. Recorded in USD.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the insurance coverage protecting the fixed asset against loss, damage, or theft. Used for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance service performed on the fixed asset. Used to track maintenance compliance and schedule next service.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory audit or verification confirming the existence and condition of the fixed asset.

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease agreement for the fixed asset expires. Null for owned assets. Used for lease renewal planning and return logistics.

attributes.name: lease_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the fixed asset is leased (True) or owned (False). Determines accounting treatment under ASC 842 lease accounting standards.

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease agreement if the asset is leased. Operating lease transfers use rights; finance/capital lease transfers substantially all risks and rewards of ownership. Not applicable for owned assets.

attributes.name: maintenance_schedule
attributes.description: Frequency of scheduled preventive maintenance required for the fixed asset to ensure safe operation and regulatory compliance. Critical for medical equipment and life safety systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|as_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) who produced the fixed asset. May differ from vendor if purchased through a distributor.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned model number or designation that identifies the specific product configuration and specifications of the fixed asset.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixed asset record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the fixed asset calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the undepreciated balance on the balance sheet. Recorded in USD.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service based on the maintenance schedule and last service date. Used for maintenance planning and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: physical_location
attributes.description: Current physical location of the fixed asset including facility name, building, floor, room number, or department where the asset is deployed and in use.

attributes.name: placed_in_service_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fixed asset was ready and available for its intended use and depreciation began. May differ from acquisition date for assets requiring installation or construction.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which the fixed asset was procured. Links the asset to the original procurement transaction and vendor contract.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role responsible for the custody, maintenance, and proper use of the fixed asset. Typically a department manager or equipment coordinator.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the fixed asset at the end of its useful life. Amount expected to be recovered through sale or disposal. Recorded in USD.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number that identifies the individual unit of the fixed asset for warranty, service, and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated number of years the fixed asset is expected to provide economic benefit to the healthcare organization. Used to calculate depreciation expense.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor, supplier, or manufacturer from whom the fixed asset was purchased or leased.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage for the fixed asset expires. Used for maintenance planning and service contract decisions.

attributes.name: parent_fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fixed_asset (parent_fixed_asset_id)

products.name: depreciation_schedule
products.description: Transactional record of periodic depreciation calculations and postings for each fixed asset. Captures asset reference, depreciation period (fiscal period/year), depreciation method applied, beginning net book value, depreciation expense amount, accumulated depreciation balance, ending net book value, GL account debited (depreciation expense), GL account credited (accumulated depreciation), cost center, posting status, and any impairment adjustments. Drives monthly depreciation journal entries and supports capital asset reporting.
products.reference: Depreciation Schedule

attributes.name: depreciation_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the depreciation schedule entry. Primary key for this transactional record of periodic depreciation calculation and posting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: depreciation_schedule has cost_center_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to cost_center master. Enables joining to get cost center details for depreciation expense allocation.

attributes.name: depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the batch depreciation calculation run that generated this entry. Links all depreciation entries processed together.

attributes.name: expense_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expense Chart Of Accounts Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: depreciation_schedule has depreciation_expense_gl_account (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Using 'expense_chart_of_accounts_id' as the FK name to distinguish from the ac

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: depreciation_schedule has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) which should be normalized to FK to fiscal_period master. The fiscal_period INT likely represents period_number, which combined with

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset for which this depreciation entry is calculated. Links to the capital asset master record.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger journal entry created for this depreciation posting. Links to the financial transaction record.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation_balance
attributes.description: The cumulative total of all depreciation expense recognized on this asset from acquisition through the current period. Contra-asset account balance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation_gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code credited for accumulated depreciation. Contra-asset account that offsets the fixed asset account.

attributes.name: adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry represents an adjustment to a previously posted depreciation calculation. True if adjustment, False if original entry.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the depreciation adjustment, such as asset revaluation, useful life change, or error correction. Null if not an adjustment.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: The classification category of the fixed asset being depreciated (e.g., Medical Equipment, Building, IT Infrastructure, Furniture). Supports categorical reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: beginning_net_book_value
attributes.description: The net book value of the asset at the beginning of the depreciation period. Calculated as original cost minus accumulated depreciation from prior periods.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: book_tax_difference
attributes.description: The difference between book depreciation expense and tax depreciation amount for this period. Used for deferred tax calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740 - Income Taxes; IRS Tax Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this depreciation schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOC 2 - Service Organization Controls; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this depreciation entry (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department code responsible for the asset and associated depreciation expense. Supports organizational expense allocation.

attributes.name: depreciation_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which this depreciation calculation was performed and recognized. Typically the last day of the fiscal period.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: depreciation_expense_amount
attributes.description: The depreciation expense amount calculated and recognized for this period. This amount is debited to the depreciation expense account.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The depreciation calculation method applied for this period. Determines how the asset cost is allocated over its useful life.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: ending_net_book_value
attributes.description: The net book value of the asset at the end of the depreciation period. Calculated as beginning net book value minus current period depreciation expense.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: The facility or location code where the asset is deployed. Enables facility-level capital asset and depreciation reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for this depreciation entry. Typically 1-12 representing January through December.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this depreciation expense is recognized. Four-digit year format (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: impairment_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any impairment loss recognized in this period that reduces the carrying value of the asset below its recoverable amount. Zero if no impairment occurred.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360-10 - Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this depreciation schedule record. Supports audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOC 2 - Service Organization Controls; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this depreciation schedule record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update for audit and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 - Service Organization Controls; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this depreciation entry. May include explanations for adjustments, impairments, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: posted_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who posted this depreciation entry to the general ledger. Supports audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOC 2 - Service Organization Controls; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which this depreciation entry was posted to the general ledger. May differ from the depreciation date for timing reasons.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: The current posting status of this depreciation entry in the general ledger. Indicates whether the journal entry has been finalized.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this depreciation entry was reversed, if applicable. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this depreciation entry has been reversed. True if reversed, False if active.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for reversing this depreciation entry. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: The estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. This amount is not depreciated.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The depreciation amount calculated for tax reporting purposes, which may differ from book depreciation due to tax regulations such as MACRS.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property; MACRA

attributes.name: useful_life_remaining_months
attributes.description: The number of months of useful life remaining for the asset after this depreciation period. Used for forecasting future depreciation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this depreciation schedule record. Supports accountability and audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 - Service Organization Controls; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: prior_depreciation_schedule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on depreciation_schedule (prior_depreciation_schedule_id)

products.name: capital_project
products.description: Master record for capital improvement and construction projects tracked within the finance domain for capital budgeting and expenditure control. Captures project number, project name, project type (construction, renovation, equipment acquisition, IT implementation, leasehold improvement), project status (planning, approved, in progress, on hold, completed, cancelled), approved capital budget, total committed costs, total actual costs, project start date, projected completion date, actual completion date, responsible cost center, project manager, funding source (bond, operating cash, grant, lease), and capitalization status. Distinct from facility.capital_project which tracks physical construction details.
products.reference: Capital Project / CIP (Construction in Progress)

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital project record. Primary key for the capital project entity.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility where this capital project is located or will be deployed. Links to the facility master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for this capital project. Links to the organizational unit accountable for project execution and budget management.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this capital project record. Links to the employee or user record for audit purposes.

attributes.name: financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_entity. Business justification: capital_project should link to financial_entity to identify which legal entity owns the capital project. This is essential for multi-entity healthcare organizations to track capital projects by subsid

attributes.name: project_phase

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Transactional record of overhead and indirect cost allocations distributed from overhead cost centers to direct patient care cost centers using defined allocation methodologies. Captures allocation run ID, fiscal period, allocation method (step-down, direct, reciprocal, activity-based), source cost center, target cost center, allocation basis (square footage, FTEs, revenue, RVUs, patient days), allocation basis quantity, allocated amount, GL account, and allocation run status. Supports Medicare cost report preparation and departmental cost accounting.
products.reference: Cost Allocation / Step-Down Allocation

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation transaction record.

attributes.name: allocation_method_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.allocation_method

attributes.name: allocation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch allocation run that generated this allocation record. Groups all allocations processed in a single execution cycle.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility or hospital where this cost allocation applies. Supports multi-facility cost accounting.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finance manager or controller who approved this allocation for posting.

attributes.name: source_cost_center_id
attributes.description: The overhead or indirect cost center from which costs are being allocated. Typically represents support departments such as facilities, IT, administration, or housekeeping.

attributes.name: target_cost_center_id
attributes.description: The direct patient care or revenue-generating cost center receiving the allocated costs. Represents departments such as surgery, emergency, radiology, or inpatient units.

attributes.name: tertiary_cost_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this allocation record.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual adjustment made to the allocated amount. Required for audit trail and variance analysis.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of overhead or indirect cost allocated from the source cost center to the target cost center in this transaction. Calculated as source cost pool multiplied by allocation basis percentage.

attributes.name: allocation_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any manual adjustment applied to the calculated allocated amount. Used for corrections, policy adjustments, or rounding reconciliation.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total allocation basis that the target cost center represents. Calculated as target quantity divided by sum of all target quantities. Used to distribute source costs proportionally.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_quantity
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of the allocation basis metric for the target cost center. For example, 5000 square feet, 25.5 FTEs, 1200 patient days, or 8500 RVUs.

attributes.name: allocation_category
attributes.description: The functional category of overhead cost being allocated. Groups allocations by the type of support service provided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: facilities|information_technology|human_resources|administration|finance|legal|compliance|quality|marketing — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this cost allocation was executed and recorded. Typically the last day of the fiscal period being allocated.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting special circumstances, adjustments, or explanations related to this specific allocation transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_run_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this allocation record. Draft indicates preliminary calculation, pending approval awaits finance review, approved is ready for posting, posted means committed to GL, reversed indicates correction, and cancelled means voided.

attributes.name: allocation_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this allocation was processed within the allocation run. Critical for step-down methodology where sequence determines which cost centers allocate first.
attributes.references: HFMA Cost Accounting Standards; CMS Medicare Cost Report Instructions

attributes.name: allocation_tier
attributes.description: The hierarchical tier or level of this allocation in multi-tier allocation methodologies. Tier 1 represents first-level overhead, tier 2 represents second-level, and so on.

attributes.name: allocation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the allocation run. Supports multiple allocation scenarios such as budget, forecast, actual, or what-if analysis.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation was reviewed and approved by authorized finance personnel.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Typically USD for U.S. healthcare organizations.

attributes.name: drg_cost_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation contributes to DRG-based cost calculations for inpatient prospective payment system analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) Final Rule

attributes.name: is_medicare_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation must be reported on the Medicare Cost Report (CMS-2552-10) for reimbursement calculation purposes.

attributes.name: is_reciprocal_allocation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is part of a reciprocal allocation cycle where two or more cost centers provide mutual services to each other.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost allocation record was last modified.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation was posted to the general ledger. May differ from allocation date due to period-end close timing.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation record represents a reversal of a previously posted allocation. Used for corrections and period adjustments.

attributes.name: service_line_code
attributes.description: The clinical service line or product line to which the target cost center belongs. Examples include cardiology, orthopedics, oncology, women's health, or emergency services.

attributes.name: source_cost_pool_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of costs available in the source cost center for allocation before distribution. Represents the full overhead pool being allocated across all target cost centers.

attributes.name: reversed_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cost_allocation (reversed_cost_allocation_id)

products.name: allocation_method
products.description: Reference master defining the cost allocation methodologies and statistical basis configurations used in the healthcare cost accounting process. Captures method code, method name, method type (step-down, direct, reciprocal, activity-based costing), allocation basis type (square footage, FTE count, revenue, RVU, patient days, procedures), basis data source, weighting factor, effective date range, and applicable cost report schedule (Medicare Cost Report Schedule). Governs how overhead costs are distributed across clinical and administrative departments.
products.reference: Cost Allocation Method

attributes.name: allocation_method_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation method. Primary key for the allocation method reference master.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this allocation method record. Links to workforce or user management system for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this allocation method record. Links to workforce or user management system for accountability.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost accounting analyst or finance manager responsible for maintaining and updating this allocation method. Links to workforce or user management system.

attributes.name: primary_allocation_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the finance executive or cost accounting manager who approved this allocation method. Links to workforce or user management system for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: superseded_method_allocation_method_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous allocation method that this method replaces. Creates a lineage chain for tracking method evolution and supporting historical cost report reconstruction.

attributes.name: activity_driver_description
attributes.description: For activity-based costing (ABC) methods, describes the specific activity or cost driver that causes costs to be incurred. Examples include number of purchase orders processed, number of patient admissions, number of surgical procedures performed. Provides transparency into ABC methodology.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_type
attributes.description: The statistical or financial measure used as the basis for distributing costs. Square footage for facility costs; FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) count for HR costs; revenue for administrative overhead; RVU (Relative Value Unit) for physician services; patient days for nursing; procedures for surgical services; direct cost for proportional allocation; labor hours for labor-intensive departments; visits for outpatient services; discharges for inpatient services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: square_footage|fte_count|revenue|rvu|patient_days|procedures|direct_cost|labor_hours|visits|discharges — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Cost Report Worksheet Instructions

attributes.name: allocation_frequency
attributes.description: How often this allocation method is executed. Monthly for routine cost accounting; quarterly for less frequent allocations; annually for year-end adjustments; as needed for special allocations; real-time for continuous allocation in advanced systems.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage_cap
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of source cost that can be allocated to any single target cost center. Used to prevent disproportionate allocation and ensure equitable distribution. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 for 25%).

attributes.name: allocation_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this allocation method is applied in step-down or sequential allocation processes. Lower numbers are allocated first. Critical for step-down methodology where allocation order affects final cost distribution.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Principles

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation method was formally approved by finance leadership or the cost accounting committee. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit trail logging is required for allocations using this method. True for regulatory or high-value allocations requiring full traceability; false for routine internal allocations.

attributes.name: basis_data_source
attributes.description: The system, report, or data source from which the allocation basis statistics are obtained. Examples include facility management system for square footage, HR system for FTE counts, general ledger for revenue, clinical system for RVUs and patient days.

attributes.name: calculation_formula
attributes.description: The mathematical formula or algorithm used to calculate allocation amounts. May reference basis statistics, weighting factors, and cost pools. Provides transparency and reproducibility for cost accounting calculations.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cms_cost_report_schedule
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Cost Report Schedule
attributes.description: The specific Medicare Cost Report worksheet or schedule to which this allocation method applies. Examples include Worksheet A (Reclassification and Adjustment of Trial Balance), Worksheet B (Cost Allocation), Worksheet C (Departmental Cost Allocation). Critical for regulatory compliance and reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS Form 2552-10 Medicare Cost Report Instructions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation method record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: decimal_precision
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to which allocation amounts are calculated and stored. Typically 2 for dollar amounts, but may be higher for statistical allocations or percentage calculations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation method ceases to be active. Null indicates the method is currently in use. Used for historical tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Cost Report Filing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this allocation method becomes active and applicable for cost accounting calculations. Aligns with fiscal period boundaries and Medicare Cost Report periods.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Cost Report Filing Requirements

attributes.name: gaap_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation method complies with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) for financial statement preparation. True for methods acceptable under GAAP; false for methods used only for internal or regulatory purposes.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 605

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allocation method was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and compliance. Used to ensure methods are periodically validated and updated as business needs evolve.

attributes.name: method_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the allocation method for system processing and reporting. Used in cost accounting transactions and Medicare Cost Report preparation.

attributes.name: method_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the allocation method, including business rationale, calculation approach, and any special considerations. Used for documentation, training, and audit support.

attributes.name: method_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost allocation method. Human-readable label used in financial reports and cost accounting documentation.

attributes.name: method_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allocation method. Active methods are in use; inactive methods are retired; pending approval methods await finance leadership sign-off; deprecated methods are being phased out; under review methods are being evaluated for changes.

attributes.name: method_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost allocation methodology. Step-down allocates overhead sequentially; direct allocates without intermediate steps; reciprocal accounts for mutual service exchanges; activity-based costing (ABC) allocates based on cost drivers; simultaneous solves all allocations concurrently; double distribution performs two-pass allocation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation method record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this allocation method. Supports proactive governance and ensures methods remain current with regulatory and business requirements.

attributes.name: prior_period_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation method supports retroactive adjustments to prior accounting periods. True for methods that allow historical corrections; false for methods that only allocate current period costs.

attributes.name: reciprocal_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this method supports reciprocal allocation where departments can allocate costs to each other. True for methods that handle mutual service exchanges; false for unidirectional allocation methods.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation method is required for regulatory reporting compliance (CMS Medicare Cost Report, state Medicaid cost reports, or other regulatory filings). True for methods mandated by regulation; false for internal management accounting methods.

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Specifies how calculated allocation amounts are rounded. Round half up rounds 0.5 and above up; round half down rounds 0.5 and below down; round up always rounds up; round down always rounds down; truncate drops decimals; no rounding preserves full precision. attributes.name: source_cost_center_category

attributes.name: target_cost_center_category

attributes.name: usage_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for cost accounting analysts to document special instructions, exceptions, or considerations when applying this allocation method. Supports knowledge transfer and operational continuity.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this allocation method configuration. Incremented when method parameters, formulas, or basis types are changed. Supports change tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: weighting_factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier applied to the allocation basis to adjust for intensity, complexity, or other factors. Used to refine allocation precision when raw statistics do not fully reflect cost consumption patterns.
attributes.references: Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) Cost Accounting Standards
