products.name: bank_account
products.description: Master record for all bank accounts maintained by the healthcare organization for operating, payroll, investment, and restricted fund purposes. Captures bank account number (masked), bank name, bank routing number, account type (checking, savings, money market, sweep, lockbox), account purpose (operating, payroll, petty cash, restricted, investment), currency, legal entity owner, GL cash account mapping, account status (active, closed, dormant), signatory list, and bank contact information. SSOT for treasury cash management.
products.reference: Bank Account / Depository Account

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility or location associated with this bank account for operational and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: cash_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash Chart Of Accounts Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: bank_account has gl_cash_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Enables joining to get the GL cash account details. Using 'cash_chart_of_accounts_id' as the FK na

attributes.name: financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_entity. Business justification: bank_account has legal_entity_id (BIGINT) which should be normalized to FK to financial_entity. The attribute name uses 'legal_entity' but should point to financial_entity.financial_entity_id. Enables

attributes.name: primary_bank_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who created this bank account record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard, SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: account_closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank account was officially closed and is no longer available for transactions. Null if the account is still active.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name or title assigned to the bank account for internal identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: account_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional information, special instructions, or operational notes related to the bank account.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The masked or encrypted bank account number maintained by the financial institution. Stored in masked format for security compliance per PCI DSS and organizational treasury policy.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: account_opened_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank account was originally opened with the financial institution.

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: The designated business purpose or functional use of the bank account within the healthcare organization's treasury operations.
attributes.references: Internal Treasury Management Policy, GASB Statement 9

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the bank account in its lifecycle, indicating whether it is available for transactions or restricted.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The classification of the bank account based on its financial instrument characteristics and operational features.

attributes.name: ach_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enabled to send and receive ACH electronic funds transfers for payroll, vendor payments, and other automated transactions.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Bank Service Agreement

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The amount of funds available for immediate withdrawal or payment, accounting for pending transactions and holds.

attributes.name: bank_branch_address
attributes.description: The physical street address of the bank branch where the account is maintained.

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific bank branch where the account is domiciled and serviced.

attributes.name: bank_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the bank relationship manager or primary contact for electronic communication regarding the account.

attributes.name: bank_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary relationship manager or contact person at the financial institution for this account.

attributes.name: bank_contact_phone
attributes.description: The telephone number of the bank relationship manager or primary contact for account inquiries and issue resolution.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the financial institution where the account is maintained.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number that identifies the financial institution for electronic funds transfers and check processing.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve ABA Routing Number Standard

attributes.name: bank_swift_code
attributes.description: The Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC) used for international wire transfers and cross-border payments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the denomination in which the account balance is maintained.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The most recent available balance in the bank account as of the last reconciliation or bank statement date.

attributes.name: dual_signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions above a certain threshold require two authorized signatures for approval and execution.
attributes.references: Internal Treasury Management Policy, SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: dual_signature_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold above which dual signature authorization is required for transactions on this account.

attributes.name: fdic_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Certificate Number
attributes.description: The unique FDIC certificate number assigned to the financial institution, used to verify insurance coverage.

attributes.name: fdic_insured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank account is covered by FDIC insurance protection up to the statutory limit.
attributes.references: FDIC Insurance Coverage Rules, 12 CFR Part 330

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the grant or funding award associated with this bank account, if the account is designated for grant-funded activities.
attributes.references: Federal Grant Management Standards, 2 CFR Part 200

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: The frequency and methodology used by the financial institution to calculate and credit interest to the account.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual percentage rate (APR) of interest earned on the account balance, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%).
attributes.references: Bank Service Agreement, Federal Reserve Interest Rate Policy

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent bank reconciliation performed for this account, ensuring alignment between bank statement and general ledger balances.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required
attributes.description: The minimum account balance that must be maintained to avoid fees or meet contractual requirements with the financial institution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which the next bank reconciliation must be completed per organizational policy and internal controls.

attributes.name: online_banking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether online banking access and electronic transaction capabilities are enabled for this account.

attributes.name: positive_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether positive pay fraud prevention service is enabled, requiring pre-authorization of checks and ACH transactions before they are honored by the bank.
attributes.references: Bank Service Agreement, Internal Fraud Prevention Policy

attributes.name: primary_signatory_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary authorized signatory who has authority to execute transactions and sign checks on this bank account.
attributes.references: Internal Treasury Management Policy, Bank Signature Card

attributes.name: primary_signatory_title
attributes.description: The job title or position of the primary authorized signatory within the healthcare organization.

attributes.name: restricted_fund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holds restricted funds that are subject to donor restrictions, grant requirements, or regulatory limitations on use.

attributes.name: restriction_description
attributes.description: A detailed description of any restrictions placed on the use of funds in this account, including donor stipulations, grant conditions, or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: secondary_signatory_name
attributes.description: The name of the secondary authorized signatory who has backup authority to execute transactions on this bank account.
attributes.references: Internal Treasury Management Policy, Bank Signature Card

attributes.name: wire_transfer_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is authorized to initiate and receive domestic and international wire transfers.
attributes.references: Bank Service Agreement, Federal Reserve Fedwire Service

attributes.name: parent_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bank_account (parent_bank_account_id)

products.name: bank_reconciliation
products.description: Transactional record of monthly bank reconciliation activities performed for each bank account. Captures reconciliation period, bank account reference, statement date, bank statement ending balance, GL book balance, outstanding checks total, deposits in transit total, bank errors, book errors, reconciled balance, reconciliation status (in progress, reconciled, approved), preparer, reviewer, approval date, and unreconciled variance amount. Ensures integrity between bank statements and the general ledger cash accounts.
products.reference: Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: bank_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank reconciliation record. Primary key for the bank reconciliation transaction.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who provided final approval of the bank reconciliation. Represents the final sign-off in the reconciliation workflow.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bank account being reconciled. Links to the bank account master data.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: bank_reconciliation has gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Enables joining to get the GL account being reconciled.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal period for which this reconciliation is performed. Links to the fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: primary_bank_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who prepared and performed the bank reconciliation. Links to the workforce or employee master data for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: prior_period_reconciliation_bank_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous month's or period's bank reconciliation record. Enables tracking of reconciliation continuity and resolution of prior period outstanding items.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who reviewed the bank reconciliation for accuracy and completeness. Must be different from the preparer to maintain segregation of duties per SOX requirements.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation received final approval from the designated approver. Marks the completion of the reconciliation workflow and acceptance of the reconciled balance.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager or supervisor who approved the bank reconciliation. Provides human-readable identification for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: auto_reconciliation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation was performed automatically by the system using matching algorithms or manually by an accountant. True indicates automated reconciliation, false indicates manual reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_errors_total
attributes.description: Total amount of errors identified on the bank statement, such as incorrect charges, duplicate transactions, or processing mistakes by the bank. Positive values indicate bank overstatements, negative values indicate understatements.

attributes.name: bank_service_charges
attributes.description: Total bank fees and service charges deducted by the bank during the statement period, including monthly maintenance fees, transaction fees, and wire transfer charges.

attributes.name: book_errors_total
attributes.description: Total amount of errors identified in the organization's general ledger records, such as recording errors, duplicate entries, or omitted transactions. Requires correcting journal entries.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this bank reconciliation record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bank account being reconciled. Indicates the currency in which all monetary amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: deposits_in_transit_total
attributes.description: Total amount of deposits recorded in the GL but not yet reflected on the bank statement as of the statement date. Represents timing differences between internal recording and bank processing.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation contains exceptions or unusual items requiring management attention. True indicates exceptions exist, false indicates a clean reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_book_balance
attributes.description: The cash account balance as recorded in the general ledger for the reconciliation period. This is the organization's internal record of the account balance.

attributes.name: interest_earned
attributes.description: Interest income earned on the bank account during the statement period as reported by the bank. Requires recording in the general ledger if not previously captured.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this bank reconciliation record. Supports audit trail and accountability for changes to reconciliation data.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this bank reconciliation record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to the reconciliation data for audit and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: nsf_checks_total
attributes.description: Total amount of checks deposited by the organization that were returned by the bank due to insufficient funds in the payer's account. Requires reversal of the original deposit entry.

attributes.name: other_adjustments_total
attributes.description: Total amount of miscellaneous adjustments not categorized elsewhere, including electronic fund transfers, automatic payments, or other reconciling items identified during the reconciliation process.

attributes.name: outstanding_checks_total
attributes.description: Total amount of checks issued by the organization that have been recorded in the GL but have not yet cleared the bank as of the statement date.

attributes.name: outstanding_items_count
attributes.description: Total number of outstanding reconciling items identified during the reconciliation process, including outstanding checks, deposits in transit, and other uncleared transactions.

attributes.name: preparation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation was initially prepared and completed by the preparer. Distinct from the reconciliation date which represents the business period being reconciled.

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who prepared the bank reconciliation. Provides human-readable identification for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: reconciled_balance
attributes.description: The final adjusted balance after applying all reconciling items to either the bank statement balance or the GL book balance. Both adjusted balances should equal this amount when reconciliation is complete.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bank reconciliation was performed. Represents the business date of the reconciliation activity.

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting significant findings, unusual items, explanations of variances, or other relevant information discovered during the reconciliation process. Supports audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the reconciliation transaction, typically formatted as a sequential or date-based reference number used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the bank reconciliation process. Tracks the reconciliation through preparation, review, and approval stages.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation was reviewed by the designated reviewer. Part of the internal control process to ensure accuracy and completeness.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who reviewed the bank reconciliation. Provides human-readable identification for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the bank statement being reconciled. Represents the cutoff date for transactions included in the bank statement.

attributes.name: statement_ending_balance
attributes.description: The ending balance as reported on the bank statement for the statement date. This is the bank's record of the account balance.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to supporting documentation such as bank statements, reconciliation worksheets, or scanned images stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: unreconciled_variance
attributes.description: The remaining difference between the adjusted bank balance and adjusted book balance after all known reconciling items have been applied. A non-zero variance indicates unresolved discrepancies requiring investigation.

attributes.name: prior_bank_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bank_reconciliation (prior_bank_reconciliation_id)

products.name: financial_period_close
products.description: Transactional record tracking the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close process for the healthcare organization. Captures close period, close type (monthly, quarterly, annual), close status (open, in progress, soft close, hard close), planned close date, actual close date, close checklist completion percentage, number of open items, number of unposted journals, intercompany reconciliation status, accrual completion status, financial statement preparation status, external audit status (for year-end), and close owner. Drives the period-end close workflow and accountability.
products.reference: Period-End Close / Month-End Close

attributes.name: financial_period_close_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial period close record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user who approved the final close of this period.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this financial period close record.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal period being closed (month, quarter, or year).

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger for which this close is being performed.

attributes.name: modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this financial period close record.

attributes.name: primary_financial_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user responsible for managing and completing this period close.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_close_status
attributes.description: Status of accounts payable close activities, including vendor invoice processing and accrual verification.

attributes.name: accrual_completion_status
attributes.description: Status of accrual entries for the period, ensuring all revenue and expenses are recorded in the correct period per accrual accounting.

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the financial period close was completed and the period was locked.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the period close was formally approved.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who approved the final close of this period, for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: audit_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of audit findings or exceptions identified during the close process that require resolution.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of balance sheet account reconciliations for this period, ensuring all asset, liability, and equity accounts are reconciled.

attributes.name: budget_variance_review_status
attributes.description: Status of budget-to-actual variance analysis and review for this period.

attributes.name: close_checklist_completed_items
attributes.description: Number of checklist items that have been completed for this period close.

attributes.name: close_checklist_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of close checklist items completed, calculated as (completed_items / total_items) * 100.

attributes.name: close_checklist_total_items
attributes.description: Total number of checklist items that must be completed for this period close.

attributes.name: close_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the period close process was fully completed.

attributes.name: close_delay_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any delay in completing the period close beyond the planned close date.

attributes.name: close_efficiency_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the efficiency and timeliness of this period close process.

attributes.name: close_initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the period close process was initiated.

attributes.name: close_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to this period close process.

attributes.name: close_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the period close event, typically formatted as YYYY-MM-CLOSE or similar.

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Current status of the period close process. Soft close allows limited adjustments; hard close is final and locked.

attributes.name: close_type
attributes.description: Type of financial close being performed: monthly, quarterly, annual, or adjustment period close.

attributes.name: cms_cost_report_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Cost Report Status
attributes.description: Status of CMS cost report preparation and submission for this period, required for Medicare reimbursement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this financial period close record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_to_close
attributes.description: Number of calendar days taken to complete the close from period end date to actual close date.

attributes.name: external_audit_status
attributes.description: Status of external audit review for this period, typically applicable for year-end closes.

attributes.name: financial_statement_preparation_status
attributes.description: Status of financial statement preparation for this period, including balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement.

attributes.name: fixed_assets_close_status
attributes.description: Status of fixed asset close activities, including depreciation calculation and asset reconciliation.

attributes.name: hard_close_date
attributes.description: Date when the period was permanently closed and locked from further adjustments.

attributes.name: intercompany_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of intercompany account reconciliation for this period, ensuring balances between entities are matched.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this financial period close record was last modified.

attributes.name: open_items_count
attributes.description: Number of outstanding issues or tasks that must be resolved before the period can be closed.

attributes.name: payroll_close_status
attributes.description: Status of payroll close activities for this period, ensuring all payroll expenses and liabilities are properly recorded.

attributes.name: planned_close_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the financial period close should be completed per the close calendar.

attributes.name: prior_period_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this close includes adjustments to prior closed periods.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory reporting submissions required for this period, such as CMS cost reports or state financial filings.
attributes.references: CMS, State Department of Health Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: Date when a previously closed period was reopened for adjustments, if applicable.

attributes.name: revenue_cycle_close_status
attributes.description: Status of revenue cycle close activities, including patient accounts receivable reconciliation and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition, Internal RCM Policy

attributes.name: soft_close_date
attributes.description: Date when the period was soft closed, allowing limited adjustments before final hard close.

attributes.name: unposted_journals_count
attributes.description: Number of journal entries that have been entered but not yet posted to the general ledger for this period.

attributes.name: prior_financial_period_close_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on financial_period_close (prior_financial_period_close_id)

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of financial transactions between legal entities within the healthcare integrated delivery network (IDN), including management fees, shared service charges, intercompany loans, and cost transfers. Captures transaction date, transaction type (management fee, shared service charge, intercompany loan, cost transfer, intercompany sale), originating entity, receiving entity, transaction amount, currency, GL account (originating), GL account (receiving), cost center, elimination indicator, elimination period, and reconciliation status. Supports consolidated financial statement preparation and intercompany elimination.
products.reference: Intercompany Transaction (IC Transaction)

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record within the integrated delivery network (IDN).

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction has cost_center_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to cost_center master. Enables joining to get cost center details for intercompany transaction allocation.

attributes.name: elimination_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consolidation elimination journal entry that offsets this intercompany transaction in the consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: intercompany_transaction has fiscal_period (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to fiscal_period master. Enables joining to get period_name, start_date, end_date, period_status, and ensures inter

attributes.name: intercompany_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master intercompany agreement or service level agreement that governs the terms of this transaction.

attributes.name: originating_chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Originating Chart Of Accounts Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: intercompany_transaction has originating_gl_account_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK to chart_of_accounts. Using 'originating_chart_of_accounts_id' as the FK name to distinguish from the

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or manager who approved the intercompany transaction for processing.

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity within the IDN that initiated or is the source of the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: receiving_entity_financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity within the IDN that receives or is the destination of the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original intercompany transaction that this record reverses, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was approved by the authorized approver for processing and posting.

attributes.name: batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch or group of intercompany transactions processed together for efficiency and control purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the intercompany transaction amount is denominated.

attributes.name: elimination_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this intercompany transaction requires elimination during the consolidated financial statement preparation process.

attributes.name: elimination_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period identifier in which the intercompany elimination entry will be or was recorded for consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction amount from the transaction currency to the functional currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction was recorded for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the functional currency of the consolidated entity for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the intercompany transaction explaining the business purpose and nature of the transfer.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the intercompany transaction for audit trail and clarification purposes.

attributes.name: originating_entity_code
attributes.description: Business code or abbreviation of the originating legal entity for reporting and identification purposes.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger systems of both entities.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger of both originating and receiving entities.

attributes.name: receiving_entity_code
attributes.description: Business code or abbreviation of the receiving legal entity for reporting and identification purposes.

attributes.name: receiving_gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code in the receiving entity's chart of accounts to which this transaction is posted.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was successfully reconciled between the originating and receiving entities.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the intercompany transaction has been successfully reconciled between the originating and receiving entities.

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference identified during reconciliation between the originating and receiving entity records for this transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this intercompany transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction.

attributes.name: service_line_code
attributes.description: The service line or business unit code associated with the intercompany transaction for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system or application from which the intercompany transaction data was sourced (e.g., SAP, Epic, Oracle).

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source system that originated this intercompany transaction record.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of supporting documentation (invoices, agreements, memos) that substantiate the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount associated with the intercompany transaction, if applicable, for jurisdictions requiring intercompany taxation.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax classification code applied to the intercompany transaction for tax reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the specified currency, representing the gross amount transferred between entities.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was executed or recorded in the originating entity's books.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number assigned to the intercompany transaction for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction indicating its processing state and readiness for consolidation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|reconciled|eliminated|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the financial activity between legal entities.

attributes.name: reversed_intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on intercompany_transaction (reversed_intercompany_transaction_id)

products.name: financial_entity
products.description: Master record for each legal entity, subsidiary, and reporting unit within the healthcare organization's corporate structure. Captures entity code, entity name, entity type (hospital, physician group, foundation, ACO, health plan, holding company, joint venture), tax ID (EIN), NPI (if applicable), state of incorporation, fiscal year end, functional currency, consolidation method (full consolidation, equity method, proportional), parent entity, GAAP vs GASB reporting basis, CMS provider number, and entity status. Drives intercompany elimination and consolidated financial reporting.
products.reference: Legal Entity / Reporting Entity

attributes.name: financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial entity record. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_entity_financial_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent financial entity in the corporate hierarchy. Null for top-level holding companies.

attributes.name: accounting_basis
attributes.description: Primary accounting framework used for financial reporting. GAAP = Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, GASB = Governmental Accounting Standards Board, IFRS = International Financial Reporting Standards.

attributes.name: cms_provider_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Provider Number
attributes.description: CMS Certification Number (CCN) assigned to Medicare-certified facilities for billing and reimbursement.

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to consolidate this entity into parent financial statements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

products.name: invoice_payment_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of a payment to an invoice in the accounts payable process. It captures the specific allocation of payment funds to settle invoice balances, including partial payments, overpayments, and payment reversals. Each record links one ap_invoice to one ap_payment with attributes that exist only in the context of this payment application event.. Existence Justification: In healthcare accounts payable operations, a single vendor invoice can be paid through multiple payments (partial payments, installment payments, or corrections), and a single payment disbursement can be applied to settle multiple invoices from the same vendor (batch payment allocation). Finance teams actively manage payment applications as a distinct business process, tracking which portion of each payment settles which invoice, including discount calculations, application sequencing, and reversal handling.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: invoice_payment_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this payment application record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Invoice Payment Application - Ap Invoice Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the accounts payable invoice being paid or settled by this payment application.

attributes.name: ap_payment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Invoice Payment Application - Ap Payment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the accounts payable payment being applied to settle the invoice.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or system user who created this payment application record.

attributes.name: amount_applied
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this payment that was applied to settle this specific invoice. For partial payments, this will be less than the total payment amount. For split payments across multiple invoices, the sum of amount_applied across all applications equals the total payment amount.

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: The total amount that has been paid against this invoice to date. May be less than total_amount for partial payments. [Moved from ap_invoice: This attribute represents the total amount paid against an invoice, which is actually the SUM of amount_applied across all payment applications for this invoice. It is a derived/calculated value that belongs in the association layer, not as a standalone attribute on the invoice.]

attributes.name: amount_remaining
attributes.description: The outstanding balance remaining to be paid on this invoice, calculated as total_amount - amount_paid. [Moved from ap_invoice: This attribute represents the outstanding balance on an invoice, which is calculated as total_amount minus the sum of amount_applied from all payment applications. It is a derived value that should be calculated from the association data, not stored redundantly on the invoice.]

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment was applied to this invoice in the accounts payable system. This is the business event date for the payment allocation and may differ from the payment_date if payments are applied retroactively or in batch processes.

attributes.name: application_sequence
attributes.description: The sequence number of this application when a single payment is applied to multiple invoices. Used to track the order in which payment funds were allocated across invoices, which is important for cash application rules and aging calculations.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: The current status of this payment application. Values: applied (payment successfully applied to invoice), reversed (application was reversed due to payment void or correction), pending (application awaiting approval or clearing), cleared (application confirmed and reconciled).

products.name: fund_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between organizational providers and funds in healthcare fund accounting. It captures how restricted and unrestricted funds are allocated across organizational entities (hospitals, clinics, facilities) for compliance tracking, donor restriction management, and regulatory reporting. Each record links one organizational provider to one fund with allocation percentages, effective dates, and compliance status that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In healthcare fund accounting, organizational providers (hospitals, clinics, facilities) participate in multiple funds simultaneously (operating funds, restricted grants, endowments, capital funds), and each fund is typically allocated across multiple organizational entities within an integrated delivery network or health system. The allocation relationship is actively managed by finance teams with specific percentages, effective dates, compliance tracking, and reporting requirements that belong to neither the provider nor the fund alone.
