attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this intercompany agreement.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit or compliance review performed on this intercompany agreement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the intercompany agreement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or renewal evaluation of this agreement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the intercompany agreement.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days allowed for payment after invoice date, as specified in the agreement terms.

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine pricing for services or goods exchanged under this intercompany agreement.

attributes.name: renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement is eligible for automatic renewal upon expiration.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration that renewal notice must be provided, as specified in the agreement.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the services, goods, or resources covered by this intercompany agreement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany agreement indicating its operational state.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code representing the primary tax jurisdiction governing this intercompany agreement.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Summary of the conditions and procedures under which the agreement may be terminated by either party.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement has been reviewed and approved as compliant with transfer pricing regulations.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the agreement, incremented with each amendment or revision.

attributes.name: superseded_intercompany_agreement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on intercompany_agreement (superseded_intercompany_agreement_id)

products.name: recurring_schedule
products.description: Master reference table for recurring_schedule. Referenced by recurring_schedule_id.

attributes.name: recurring_schedule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for recurring_schedule

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this recurring schedule. Null if not yet approved or approval is not required.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which this recurring schedule posts transactions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for or associated with this recurring schedule.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this recurring schedule record.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal year this recurring schedule is associated with.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this recurring schedule record.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who owns and is accountable for this recurring schedule.

attributes.name: adjustment_factor
attributes.description: A multiplier applied to the scheduled amount for adjustments such as inflation, escalation, or volume changes. Default is 1.0 (no adjustment).

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate or distribute the scheduled amount across periods or cost centers (equal distribution, weighted, percentage-based, activity-based costing, or custom formula).

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generated activities from this schedule require approval before posting (true) or can be posted automatically (false).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recurring schedule was approved for activation. Null if not yet approved or approval is not required.

attributes.name: approver_role_code
attributes.description: Reference to the role or user group responsible for approving activities generated by this schedule. Null if approval is not required.

attributes.name: auto_generate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether scheduled activities are automatically generated by the system (true) or require manual creation (false).

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Explanation of the business rationale and need for this recurring schedule, used for audit and governance purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recurring schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the scheduled amount is denominated.

attributes.name: day_of_month
attributes.description: For monthly or less frequent schedules, the specific day of the month when the activity occurs (1-31). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: For weekly or biweekly schedules, the specific day of the week when the activity occurs. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the recurring schedule, including its purpose, scope, and any special instructions or business rules.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this recurring schedule ceases to be active. Null indicates an open-ended schedule.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this recurring schedule becomes active and begins generating scheduled activities.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the scheduled activity recurs (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual, or annual).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recurring schedule is currently active and eligible for generating scheduled activities (true) or inactive (false).

attributes.name: last_generated_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent scheduled activity was generated from this recurring schedule. Null if no activities have been generated yet.

attributes.name: max_occurrences
attributes.description: The maximum number of times this schedule should generate activities before automatically completing. Null indicates unlimited occurrences.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recurring schedule record was last modified.

attributes.name: month_of_quarter
attributes.description: For quarterly schedules, the specific month within the quarter when the activity occurs (1-3). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date when the next scheduled activity is due to be generated from this recurring schedule.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments about the recurring schedule for operational reference.

attributes.name: occurrence_count
attributes.description: The total number of times activities have been generated from this recurring schedule since its inception.

attributes.name: proration_rule
attributes.description: The rule used to prorate amounts for partial periods (none, daily proration, monthly proration, actual days, or business days only).

attributes.name: quarter_of_year
attributes.description: For annual schedules, the specific quarter of the year when the activity occurs (1-4). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: schedule_amount
attributes.description: The standard monetary amount associated with each recurrence of this schedule. Used for budgeting, allocation, or accrual purposes.

attributes.name: schedule_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the schedule based on the nature of financial activities it governs.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the recurring schedule, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the purpose or nature of the recurring schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recurring schedule indicating its financial purpose (budget cycle, forecast period, cost allocation, accrual recognition, depreciation schedule, or amortization schedule).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recurring schedule indicating whether it is in draft, actively generating activities, temporarily suspended, completed, or cancelled.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this recurring schedule record, incremented with each modification for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: superseded_recurring_schedule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on recurring_schedule (superseded_recurring_schedule_id)

products.name: asset_book
products.description: Master reference table for asset_book. Referenced by asset_book_id.

attributes.name: asset_book_id
attributes.description: Primary key for asset_book

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard or framework governing depreciation and valuation rules for assets in this book.

attributes.name: allow_manual_depreciation
attributes.description: Indicates whether manual depreciation adjustments are permitted for assets in this book, or if all depreciation must be system-calculated.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether asset assignments or depreciation changes in this book require managerial or financial approval before posting.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approval workflow process that governs changes to assets in this book. Null if no approval workflow is configured.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit logging is enabled for all transactions and changes affecting assets in this book.

attributes.name: book_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the asset book for external reference and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: book_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the asset book used for identification and reporting.

attributes.name: book_type
attributes.description: Classification of the asset book based on its accounting purpose and regulatory framework.

attributes.name: consolidation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether asset values and depreciation from this book must be included in consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the default cost center for assets tracked in this book, used for expense allocation and budgeting.

attributes.name: created_by_user_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this asset book record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this asset book record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency for asset valuations and depreciation in this book.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The default depreciation calculation method applied to assets assigned to this book.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset book purpose, scope, and any special accounting rules or business context.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this asset book was closed or became inactive. Null for currently active books.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this asset book became active and available for asset assignments and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_start_month
attributes.description: The month number (1-12) when the fiscal year begins for this asset book, used for period-based depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account where asset values and depreciation expenses for this book are posted.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently modified this asset book record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this asset book record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments providing additional context, special instructions, or historical information about this asset book.

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or organizational unit that owns and maintains this asset book.

attributes.name: parent_book_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent asset book if this book is a subsidiary or specialized book derived from a master book. Null for top-level books.

attributes.name: prorate_depreciation
attributes.description: Indicates whether depreciation is prorated based on the asset acquisition date within the fiscal period.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic or regulatory jurisdiction governing the accounting rules for this asset book (e.g., federal, state, international).

attributes.name: salvage_value_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets assigned to this book must have a salvage value specified for depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the asset book indicating whether it is actively used for asset tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this book are subject to tax reporting requirements and must be included in tax filings.

attributes.name: parent_asset_book_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on asset_book (parent_asset_book_id)

domains.name: insurance
domains.description: Master data management for insurance payers, health plans, benefit structures, provider networks, and coverage policies. SSOT for payer identity, plan configurations, network definitions, and benefit rules that are referenced by billing, claim, patient, and encounter domains.

products.name: payer
products.description: Master record for every insurance payer, health plan sponsor, and government program (Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP, TRICARE, commercial carriers, TPAs) operating as a financial counterparty to the healthcare organization. SSOT for payer identity within the insurance domain, capturing payer legal name, payer ID (CPID, NPI), payer type (commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, self-pay, workers comp), EDI trading partner ID (ISA06), remittance address, claims submission endpoint (clearinghouse, direct), payer portal URL, payer tier classification, contract status, and effective dates. Distinct from reference.payer which is the enterprise-wide reference catalog — this is the operational master used by billing, claim, and encounter domains for active payer relationship management.
products.reference: Payer Master / Insurance Carrier Master

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance payer, health plan sponsor, or government program. Primary key for the payer master record within the insurance domain.

attributes.name: successor_payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer record that replaces this payer in the event of merger, acquisition, or consolidation. Used to redirect claims and maintain continuity. Null if no successor exists.

attributes.name: accepts_assignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer accepts assignment of benefits, meaning the payer pays the provider directly rather than reimbursing the patient. True for most contracted payers; false for some out-of-network or self-pay arrangements.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer record is currently active and should be used for new claims and transactions. True if active; false if payer is inactive, merged, or no longer accepting claims. Inactive payers are retained for historical claim reference.

attributes.name: appeal_limit_days
attributes.description: Number of days from claim denial date within which appeals must be submitted to this payer. Common values are 30, 60, 90, 180 days. Null if payer does not specify appeal deadlines.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract with this payer automatically renews at the end of the contract term. True if contract auto-renews unless either party provides notice; false if contract requires explicit renewal action.

attributes.name: claim_scrubbing_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party claim scrubbing or editing vendor used to validate claims before submission to this payer. Null if no scrubbing vendor is used or if internal scrubbing is performed.

attributes.name: claims_inquiry_phone
attributes.description: Dedicated phone number for claim status inquiries and claim-related questions. May differ from general customer service phone.

attributes.name: claims_submission_endpoint
attributes.description: URL, EDI address, or mailing address for submitting claims to this payer. Format varies by submission method.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the clearinghouse or intermediary used to submit claims to this payer. Null if claims are submitted directly to the payer.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer requires coordination of benefits information when the patient has multiple insurance coverages. True if COB is required; false if payer does not coordinate benefits or is always primary.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payer record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_service_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the payer's provider customer service line. Used for claim status inquiries, eligibility verification, and general provider support.

attributes.name: edi_payer_code
attributes.description: Payer identifier used in EDI transactions, typically the ISA06 qualifier value in X12 837 claim submissions and 835 remittance advice. May differ from NPI or external payer ID.

attributes.name: electronic_funds_transfer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments from this payer are received via electronic funds transfer (EFT) directly to the organization's bank account. True if EFT is enabled; false if payments are received by check or other method.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules for ACH Payments

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_method
attributes.description: Primary method for verifying patient eligibility and benefits with this payer. EDI 270/271 indicates HIPAA-compliant electronic eligibility inquiry and response; portal indicates web-based lookup; phone indicates manual call to payer; real-time API indicates direct system integration.

attributes.name: id_external
attributes.description: Payer's own identifier for their organization, often used in their systems and communications. May be a CPID (Carrier Payer ID), plan code, or other payer-assigned identifier.

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payer record was marked inactive. Null if payer is currently active. Used for audit trail and historical analysis.

attributes.name: inactivation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this payer record was inactivated. Common reasons include contract termination, payer merger or acquisition, payer out of business, or duplicate record consolidation. Null if payer is active.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes about this payer, including special billing instructions, known issues, contact preferences, or other operational guidance for revenue cycle staff.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the payer organization by CMS. Used for HIPAA-compliant electronic transactions and provider enrollment. Type 2 NPI for organizational entities.

attributes.name: payer_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the payer organization. Government includes federal and state programs; commercial includes private insurance carriers; managed care includes HMOs, PPOs, and ACOs; TPA (Third Party Administrator) processes claims on behalf of self-insured employers; other includes specialty programs.

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the insurance payer, health plan sponsor, or government program as registered with regulatory authorities. Used for contracts, claims submission, and legal correspondence.

attributes.name: payer_tier
attributes.description: Internal classification of payer by volume, strategic importance, or contract terms. Tier 1 represents highest volume or most favorable contract terms; Tier 4 represents lowest volume or least favorable terms. Used for prioritization in revenue cycle operations and contract negotiations.

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payer by program type. Determines billing rules, claim formats, and regulatory requirements. Commercial includes private insurance carriers and employer-sponsored plans; Medicare includes traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage; Medicaid includes state Medicaid programs and managed Medicaid; CHIP is Children's Health Insurance Program; TRICARE is military health system; workers compensation covers occupational injuries; self-pay represents uninsured patients. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare|medicaid|chip|tricare|workers_compensation|self_pay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the payer is contractually obligated to remit payment after claim adjudication. Common values are 14, 30, 45 days. Used for accounts receivable aging and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: portal_url
attributes.description: Web address for the payer's provider portal used for eligibility verification, claim status inquiry, prior authorization submission, and remittance download.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payer generally requires prior authorization for certain services, procedures, or medications. True if prior authorization is required for at least some service categories; false if payer does not require prior authorization. Specific authorization rules are maintained in benefit plan configurations.
attributes.references: Payer Medical Policy and Authorization Requirements

attributes.name: provider_relations_email
attributes.description: Email address for the payer's provider relations or network management team. Used for contract inquiries, credentialing issues, and provider communications.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the payer's remittance mailing address where paper checks and EOBs are sent. Includes street number and street name.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the payer's remittance mailing address. Typically contains suite, floor, department, or other secondary address information. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: remittance_city
attributes.description: City name for the payer's remittance mailing address.

attributes.name: remittance_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payer delivers remittance advice. EDI 835 indicates electronic remittance advice via X12 835 transaction; ERA (Electronic Remittance Advice) is synonym for EDI 835; paper EOB (Explanation of Benefits) indicates physical mail; portal indicates download from payer website.

attributes.name: remittance_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or ZIP+4 code for the payer's remittance mailing address. Format: XXXXX or XXXXX-XXXX.

attributes.name: remittance_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or territory abbreviation for the payer's remittance mailing address. Follows USPS state abbreviation standards.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the payer for display purposes in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this payer record originated. Examples include Epic Resolute, Cerner Revenue Cycle, MEDITECH Financial, or manual entry. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to submit claims to this payer. EDI indicates electronic X12 837 transactions; portal indicates web-based submission through payer portal; direct indicates direct electronic connection; clearinghouse indicates submission through third-party clearinghouse; paper indicates physical mail submission.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number for the payer organization. Used for tax reporting, contract execution, and financial reconciliation. Format: XX-XXXXXXX.

attributes.name: timely_filing_limit_days
attributes.description: Number of days from date of service within which claims must be submitted to this payer to be considered timely filed. Claims submitted after this period may be denied. Common values are 90, 180, 365 days. Null if payer does not enforce timely filing limits.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payer record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute value changes. Used for change tracking and synchronization.

attributes.name: parent_payer_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payer (parent_payer_id)

products.name: health_plan
products.description: Master record for every specific health insurance plan product offered by a payer, including HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Part D, Medicaid managed care, CHIP, and self-funded employer plans. Captures plan name, plan ID (HIOS plan ID, CMS contract number, group number), plan type, metal tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum for ACA plans), funding type (fully insured vs self-funded), benefit year, formulary tier, deductible structure, out-of-pocket maximum, copay/coinsurance schedule, coordination of benefits (COB) order rules, and plan effective/termination dates. SSOT for plan configuration referenced by benefit, network, and coverage entities.
products.reference: Health Plan Master / Benefit Plan

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan product. Primary key for the health plan entity.

attributes.name: consent_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.consent_policy. Business justification: Health plans define consent requirements specific to plan design (e.g., telehealth consent for virtual-first plans, genetic testing consent for genomic medicine benefits, research consent for value-ba

attributes.name: covered_diagnosis_icd_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Covered Diagnosis Icd Code Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Health plans define coverage restrictions by diagnosis code for medical necessity determination and benefit eligibility. Essential for claims adjudication and coverage policy enforcement in real-world

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug formulary tier structure that defines covered medications, tier placement, and cost-sharing for this plan.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Standards, NCPDP (National Council for Prescription Drug Programs) Formulary Standards

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance payer organization that underwrites or administers this health plan.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network that defines in-network and out-of-network providers, facilities, and pharmacies for this plan.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Department Network Standards

attributes.name: benefit_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this plan configuration and benefit structure are effective. Used to track annual plan changes and benefit resets.

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Contract Number
attributes.description: The unique contract identifier assigned by CMS for Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, or Medicaid managed care plans. Used for regulatory reporting and plan identification.
attributes.references: CMS Contract Management Standards, Medicare Advantage and Part D Regulations

attributes.name: cob_order
attributes.description: The order in which this plan pays when a member has multiple insurance coverages. Primary pays first, Secondary pays after primary, Tertiary pays after secondary. Used for COB adjudication logic.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Coordination of Benefits, ANSI X12 837 COB Segment

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of allowed charges that the member is responsible for paying after the deductible is met. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20% member responsibility).
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, ACA Actuarial Value Calculation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this health plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Trail Requirements, SOC 2 Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this health plan configuration becomes active and available for member enrollment and coverage. Typically aligns with benefit year start or employer plan year start.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Year Standards, ERISA Plan Document Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_room_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for an emergency department visit. May be waived if admitted. Null if the plan uses coinsurance instead of copay.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act) Compliance

attributes.name: family_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount in USD that a family unit must collectively pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins cost-sharing for covered services.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Standards, CMS Cost-Sharing Standards

attributes.name: family_oop_max_amount
attributes.description: The annual maximum amount in USD that a family unit will collectively pay out-of-pocket for covered services. After reaching this limit, the plan pays 100% of covered costs for the remainder of the benefit year.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Out-of-Pocket Maximum Standards

attributes.name: fsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan allows members to participate in a Flexible Spending Account for pre-tax healthcare or dependent care expenses.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125 Cafeteria Plans, DOL FSA Guidance

attributes.name: funding_type
attributes.description: The financial arrangement model for the plan. Fully Insured means the payer assumes all risk; Self-Funded means the employer assumes risk and payer provides administrative services only (ASO); Level Funded is a hybrid with predictable monthly costs; Partially Self-Funded shares risk between employer and payer.
attributes.references: ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act) Plan Classification, DOL (Department of Labor) Guidance

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The group identifier assigned to employer-sponsored or association-based plans, used for member eligibility verification and claims adjudication.

attributes.name: hra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan is paired with an employer-funded Health Reimbursement Arrangement that reimburses employees for qualified medical expenses.
attributes.references: IRS Notice 2002-45 Health Reimbursement Arrangements, ACA Integration Rules

attributes.name: hsa_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan is HSA-qualified, meaning it meets IRS requirements for high-deductible health plans that allow members to contribute to a tax-advantaged Health Savings Account.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969 Health Savings Accounts, ACA HDHP Standards

attributes.name: individual_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount in USD that an individual member must pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins cost-sharing for covered services.
attributes.references: ACA Essential Health Benefits Standards, CMS Cost-Sharing Standards

attributes.name: individual_oop_max_amount
attributes.description: The annual maximum amount in USD that an individual member will pay out-of-pocket for covered services. After reaching this limit, the plan pays 100% of covered costs for the remainder of the benefit year.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Out-of-Pocket Maximum Standards

attributes.name: inpatient_hospital_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays per inpatient hospital admission or per day. Null if the plan uses coinsurance instead of copay.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) Payment Standards

attributes.name: issuer_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where this health plan is issued and regulated. Used for multi-state payers to track jurisdiction-specific plan configurations.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards, CMS State-Based Marketplace Standards

attributes.name: metal_tier
attributes.description: The actuarial value tier for ACA (Affordable Care Act) marketplace plans indicating the percentage of covered healthcare costs the plan pays on average. Bronze (60%), Silver (70%), Gold (80%), Platinum (90%), Catastrophic (minimal coverage for under-30 or hardship exemption). Not Applicable for non-ACA plans.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, CMS Actuarial Value Standards

attributes.name: open_enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the annual open enrollment period during which eligible individuals can enroll in or change their health plan selection without a qualifying life event.
attributes.references: ACA Open Enrollment Standards, CMS Marketplace Enrollment Periods

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the annual open enrollment period during which eligible individuals can enroll in or change their health plan selection without a qualifying life event.
attributes.references: ACA Open Enrollment Standards, CMS Marketplace Enrollment Periods

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan provides any coverage for out-of-network providers and facilities. True for PPO and POS plans, false for HMO and EPO plans (except emergency services).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Department Network Requirements

attributes.name: out_of_network_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual deductible amount in USD for out-of-network services. Typically higher than in-network deductible. Null if plan does not cover out-of-network services.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, NAIC Uniform Health Plan Benefit Standards

attributes.name: out_of_network_oop_max_amount
attributes.description: The annual maximum out-of-pocket amount in USD for out-of-network services. Typically higher than in-network OOP max. Null if plan does not cover out-of-network services.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, NAIC Uniform Health Plan Benefit Standards

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: The web URL where the official plan document, Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC), or Evidence of Coverage (EOC) can be accessed by members and providers.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Requirements, ERISA Plan Document Disclosure

attributes.name: plan_identifier
attributes.description: The externally-recognized unique identifier for this plan. May be HIOS (Health Insurance Oversight System) Plan ID for ACA marketplace plans, CMS contract number for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans, or state-assigned Medicaid plan ID.
attributes.references: CMS HIOS Plan ID Standard, CMS Contract Number Standard

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: The marketing or official name of the health plan product as presented to members and providers.
attributes.references: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Plan Naming Standards

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the health plan. Active means the plan is currently offered and accepting enrollments; Suspended means temporarily unavailable; Terminated means no longer offered; Pending Approval means awaiting regulatory approval; Grandfathered means exempt from certain ACA requirements; Closed to New Enrollment means existing members can renew but new members cannot enroll.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Status Standards, State Insurance Department Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: The structural type of the health plan indicating network and coverage model. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization) requires PCP and referrals; PPO (Preferred Provider Organization) allows out-of-network care; EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization) requires in-network only; POS (Point of Service) hybrid model; HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan) paired with HSA; Medicare Advantage (MA) for Medicare beneficiaries; Medicare Part D for prescription drug coverage; Medicaid Managed Care for state Medicaid programs; CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program); Self-Funded for employer-administered plans. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HMO|PPO|EPO|POS|HDHP|Medicare Advantage|Medicare Part D|Medicaid Managed Care|CHIP|Self-Funded — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Taxonomy, NAIC (National Association of Insurance Commissioners) Plan Classification

attributes.name: prescription_tier1_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for a Tier 1 (typically generic) prescription drug. Null if the plan uses coinsurance for pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Standards, NCPDP Pharmacy Benefit Standards

attributes.name: prescription_tier2_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for a Tier 2 (typically preferred brand) prescription drug. Null if the plan uses coinsurance for pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Standards, NCPDP Pharmacy Benefit Standards

attributes.name: prescription_tier3_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for a Tier 3 (typically non-preferred brand) prescription drug. Null if the plan uses coinsurance for pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Standards, NCPDP Pharmacy Benefit Standards

attributes.name: prescription_tier4_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for a Tier 4 (typically specialty) prescription drug. Null if the plan uses coinsurance for pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Standards, NCPDP Pharmacy Benefit Standards

attributes.name: preventive_care_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether preventive care services (annual physicals, immunizations, screenings) are covered at 100% with no member cost-sharing, as required by ACA for non-grandfathered plans.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2713 Preventive Services, USPSTF (U.S. Preventive Services Task Force) Recommendations

attributes.name: primary_care_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for a primary care physician office visit. Null if the plan uses coinsurance instead of copay.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, NAIC Uniform Health Plan Benefit Standards

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan requires prior authorization for certain services, procedures, or medications. When true, members or providers must obtain approval before services are rendered to ensure coverage.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Standards, NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance) Utilization Management Standards

attributes.name: requires_pcp_selection
attributes.description: Indicates whether members are required to select and maintain a designated primary care physician. Typically true for HMO and POS plans, false for PPO and EPO plans.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Department Plan Requirements

attributes.name: requires_referral_for_specialist
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their PCP before seeing a specialist. Typically true for HMO plans, false for PPO, EPO, and POS plans.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Standards, State Insurance Department Plan Requirements

attributes.name: service_area_description
attributes.description: A textual description of the geographic service area where this plan is available, typically defined by counties, ZIP codes, or metropolitan areas.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy and Service Area Standards

attributes.name: specialist_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for a specialist physician office visit. Null if the plan uses coinsurance instead of copay.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, NAIC Uniform Health Plan Benefit Standards

attributes.name: state_filing_number
attributes.description: The unique filing or approval number assigned by the state insurance department for this health plan product. Required for regulatory compliance and rate filings.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Filing Requirements, NAIC Regulatory Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this health plan configuration is terminated and no longer available for coverage. Null for active plans with no planned termination.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Termination Standards, State Insurance Department Notification Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this health plan record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Trail Requirements, SOC 2 Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: urgent_care_copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount in USD that a member pays for an urgent care facility visit. Null if the plan uses coinsurance instead of copay.

attributes.name: predecessor_health_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on health_plan (predecessor_health_plan_id)

products.name: benefit
products.description: Master record defining individual benefit components within a health plan, representing the specific coverage rules for a category of healthcare services. Captures benefit category (inpatient hospital, outpatient surgery, primary care, specialist, emergency, mental health, substance use, preventive, DME, home health, hospice, vision, dental, pharmacy), benefit tier, in-network vs out-of-network rules, prior authorization requirement flag, referral requirement flag, copay amount, coinsurance percentage, deductible applicability, benefit limit (visit limits, dollar limits, day limits), and benefit effective dates. Enables granular benefit adjudication and member cost-sharing calculation.
products.reference: Benefit Design / Benefit Component

attributes.name: benefit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit component within a health plan. Primary key for the benefit master record.

attributes.name: diagnosis_icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Benefits often require specific diagnoses for coverage (e.g., CGM for diabetes, PT for specific conditions). Medical necessity validation and claims auto-adjudication depend on diagnosis-benefit linka

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent health plan that contains this benefit component. Links benefit to its plan container.

attributes.name: procedure_cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Benefits are defined by specific CPT procedures with associated copays, coinsurance, and authorization requirements. Core to claims adjudication engine and member cost-sharing calculation in every pay

attributes.name: procedure_hcpcs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: Benefits for DME, supplies, and non-physician services are defined by HCPCS codes. Essential for benefit determination, prior authorization rules, and claims payment calculation in healthcare payer op

attributes.name: allowed_amount_basis
attributes.description: Method used to determine the allowed amount for benefit adjudication. Defines how the plan calculates the maximum payable amount for a service.

attributes.name: benefit_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the healthcare service category covered by this benefit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient_hospital|outpatient_surgery|primary_care|specialist|emergency|mental_health|substance_use|preventive|durable_medical_equipment|home_health|hospice|vision|dental|pharmacy|rehabilitation|skilled_nursing — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: benefit_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the benefit component used in plan documentation, member communications, and adjudication rules. Externally visible code.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Plan Benefit Package

attributes.name: benefit_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the benefit coverage, limitations, and member responsibilities. Used in Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) and member materials.
attributes.references: CMS Summary of Benefits and Coverage Template

attributes.name: benefit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit component displayed to members and providers. Example: Inpatient Hospital Services, Primary Care Office Visit.

attributes.name: benefit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit component. Active benefits are available for adjudication; inactive benefits are historical or discontinued.

attributes.name: benefit_tier
attributes.description: Tiering level of the benefit indicating cost-sharing structure. Commonly used for pharmacy benefits (generic, preferred brand, non-preferred brand, specialty) and provider networks (in-network tier 1, tier 2).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Formulary Tiers

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of allowed amount the member pays after deductible is met. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20%). Null if benefit uses copay instead of coinsurance.
attributes.references: CMS Summary of Benefits and Coverage Template

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays per service or visit as defined by the benefit. Null if benefit uses coinsurance instead of copay.
attributes.references: CMS Summary of Benefits and Coverage Template

attributes.name: cost_sharing_tier
attributes.description: Actuarial value tier of the benefit indicating the percentage of costs the plan covers on average. Used for ACA marketplace plans.
attributes.references: ACA Metal Tier Actuarial Value Standards

attributes.name: coverage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of allowed amount the plan pays for this benefit. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 80.00 for 80% plan payment). Inverse of coinsurance_percentage.
attributes.references: CMS Summary of Benefits and Coverage Template

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: day_limit_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of days covered per benefit period for services measured in days (e.g., 90 days skilled nursing facility per benefit period). Null if no day limit applies.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage

attributes.name: day_limit_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the day limit count applies. Example: per_admission for inpatient stays, per_year for annual day limits.

attributes.name: days_supply_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of days supply allowed per prescription fill for pharmacy benefits. Common limits are 30, 60, or 90 days. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Days Supply Standards

attributes.name: deductible_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan deductible must be met before this benefit pays. True if deductible applies, False if benefit is not subject to deductible (e.g., preventive services).

attributes.name: diagnosis_code_type
attributes.description: Type of diagnosis coding system used for medical necessity determination and benefit eligibility. ICD-10-CM is current standard in US; ICD-9-CM is legacy.

attributes.name: dollar_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay for this benefit per limit period. Null if no dollar limit applies. Note: ACA prohibits lifetime and annual dollar limits on essential health benefits.
attributes.references: ACA Lifetime and Annual Limit Prohibitions

attributes.name: dollar_limit_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the dollar limit amount applies. Used for non-essential benefits where dollar limits are permitted.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit component becomes active and available for coverage. Must align with plan year or mid-year plan changes.

attributes.name: essential_health_benefit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit is classified as an Essential Health Benefit under ACA. EHBs cannot have annual or lifetime dollar limits.

attributes.name: exclusions_text
attributes.description: Narrative description of services or conditions explicitly excluded from this benefit. Critical for claims denial and member communication.

attributes.name: formulary_tier
attributes.description: Pharmacy formulary tier for drug benefits indicating cost-sharing level. Tier 1 typically generic, Tier 2 preferred brand, Tier 3 non-preferred brand, Tier 4 specialty drugs.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Formulary Requirements

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit is compatible with Health Savings Account (HSA) requirements. True if benefit meets HSA-qualified high-deductible health plan (HDHP) rules.

attributes.name: limitations_text
attributes.description: Narrative description of limitations, restrictions, or conditions that apply to this benefit beyond the structured limit fields.

attributes.name: mail_order_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy benefit can be fulfilled through mail order pharmacy with potentially different cost-sharing. True if mail order option available.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Mail Order Requirements

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit applies to in-network providers, out-of-network providers, or both. Critical for cost-sharing calculation and provider network adjudication.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member cost-sharing for this benefit counts toward the annual out-of-pocket maximum. True if it counts, False if excluded (e.g., non-covered services).

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Standard two-digit code identifying where the service is delivered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 22=Outpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room). Used for benefit adjudication rules.

attributes.name: preventive_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit is classified as preventive care under ACA requirements. Preventive services must be covered at 100% with no cost-sharing when delivered in-network.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization from the health plan is required before the service is covered. True if PA required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: procedure_code_type
attributes.description: Type of procedure coding system used to identify services covered by this benefit. CPT for physician services, HCPCS for supplies and equipment, ICD-10-PCS for inpatient procedures, CDT for dental.
attributes.references: AMA CPT, CMS HCPCS, WHO ICD-10-PCS, ADA CDT

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit has quantity or frequency limits (e.g., maximum number of visits, days supply, units per fill). True if limits apply.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Quantity Limits

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral from Primary Care Physician (PCP) is required to access this benefit. Common in Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) plans.

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the type of healthcare service covered by this benefit. Aligns with X12 837 claim service type codes for electronic transactions.
attributes.references: X12 837 Health Care Claim Service Type Codes

attributes.name: step_therapy_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocol must be followed (trying lower-cost alternatives before higher-cost treatments). Primarily used for pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D Step Therapy Requirements

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the benefit category providing granular service classification. Example: Acute Inpatient, Observation Stay, Ambulatory Surgery.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit component is no longer active. Null for currently active benefits with no planned end date.

attributes.name: visit_limit_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of visits or services allowed per benefit period (e.g., 20 physical therapy visits per year). Null if no visit limit applies.

attributes.name: visit_limit_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the visit limit count applies. Example: per_year for annual limits, per_lifetime for lifetime maximums.
attributes.references: ACA Lifetime and Annual Limit Prohibitions

attributes.name: parent_benefit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on benefit (parent_benefit_id)

products.name: provider_network
products.description: Master record for every provider network defined and managed by a payer, representing the contracted network of providers available to plan members. Captures network name, network ID, network type (HMO, PPO, EPO, narrow network, tiered network, ACO network), geographic service area, network tier (preferred, standard, out-of-network), network effective and termination dates, network adequacy status, CMS network adequacy filing status, and the payer that owns the network. SSOT for network identity referenced by plan-network associations, provider participation records, and claim adjudication.
products.reference: Provider Network / Payer Network

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider network. Primary key.

attributes.name: parent_network_provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent or umbrella network if this network is a subset or regional variant. Used for hierarchical network structures where a national network has regional sub-networks. Null for top-level networks.

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payer or health plan that owns and manages this provider network.
attributes.references: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Payer Identification

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the network as a whole has capacity to accept new members. True if sufficient providers are accepting new patients. False if network is at capacity. Used for enrollment management.

attributes.name: adequacy_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent network adequacy assessment by CMS or state regulators. Networks must be reviewed annually or when material changes occur.

attributes.name: behavioral_health_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes behavioral health and mental health providers. True if behavioral health services are covered. False if behavioral health is carved out to a separate network.
attributes.references: Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA), CMS Behavioral Health Standards

attributes.name: cms_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Approval Date
attributes.description: Date when CMS approved the network adequacy filing. Null if not yet approved or not required.

attributes.name: cms_filing_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Filing Date
attributes.description: Date when the network adequacy filing was submitted to CMS. Required for Medicare Advantage and Marketplace plans.

attributes.name: cms_filing_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) Filing Status
attributes.description: Status of the network adequacy filing with CMS for Medicare Advantage or Marketplace plans. Filed indicates submission. Approved indicates CMS acceptance. Rejected indicates CMS denial. Pending indicates under CMS review. Not required for non-CMS regulated plans.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Filing Requirements, 42 CFR 422.116

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Payment model used for provider contracts in this network. Fee-for-service pays per service. Capitation pays per member per month. Shared savings shares cost savings with providers. Bundled payment pays fixed amount for episode of care. Value-based ties payment to quality and outcomes. Hybrid combines multiple models.
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Payment Model (APM) Standards, MACRA (Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this provider network record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credentialing_standard
attributes.description: Accreditation or regulatory standard used for provider credentialing in this network. NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance) is most common. URAC is utilization review accreditation. AAAHC (Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care) for ambulatory settings. TJC (The Joint Commission) for hospitals. State-specific for state-mandated standards. Internal for payer-defined standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, State Credentialing Requirements

attributes.name: dental_network_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes dental providers or if dental benefits are managed separately. True if dental is included. False if dental is carved out.

attributes.name: directory_last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider directory was last updated with current network participation information. CMS requires directories to be updated at least monthly.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider network becomes active and available for member enrollment and claim adjudication. Must align with plan year or regulatory approval dates.

attributes.name: facility_count
attributes.description: Total number of facilities (hospitals, clinics, surgery centers, imaging centers) participating in this network. Used for network adequacy assessment and member communications.

attributes.name: geographic_service_area
attributes.description: Geographic region where the provider network operates, defined by state, county, ZIP code, or metropolitan statistical area. Used for network adequacy assessment and member eligibility determination.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Department Geographic Requirements

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the provider network meets regulatory standards for provider availability, geographic access, and appointment wait times. Adequate networks meet all standards. Inadequate networks require corrective action. Conditionally adequate networks meet standards with exceptions.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Department Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: network_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the provider network, including key features, geographic coverage, specialty availability, and member benefits. Used in plan marketing materials and member communications.

attributes.name: network_directory_url
attributes.description: Web address of the online provider directory for this network. Members use this to search for in-network providers. Required by CMS for Medicare Advantage and Marketplace plans.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Business identifier for the provider network, used externally by payers, providers, and members. May be referenced on insurance cards and claim submissions.

attributes.name: network_model
attributes.description: Organizational structure of the provider network. Staff model employs providers directly. Group model contracts with multi-specialty groups. Network model contracts with multiple IPAs. IPA (Independent Practice Association) is a physician-owned network. Direct contract is payer-to-provider agreements. Rental network leases access to another payers network.

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the provider network, used in member communications, plan documents, and provider directories.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider network. Active networks are available for member enrollment and claim adjudication. Pending networks are under development or regulatory review. Suspended networks are temporarily unavailable. Terminated networks are closed and no longer accepting new members.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification of the network for cost-sharing purposes. Preferred or Tier 1 networks offer lowest member cost-sharing. Standard or Tier 2 networks have moderate cost-sharing. Out-of-network or Tier 3 have highest cost-sharing. Used in tiered network benefit designs.
attributes.references: CMS Cost-Sharing Standards, NCQA Tiered Network Standards

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider network structure. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization) requires PCP referrals and in-network care. PPO (Preferred Provider Organization) allows out-of-network care at higher cost. EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization) requires in-network care except emergencies. POS (Point of Service) combines HMO and PPO features. ACO (Accountable Care Organization) is a value-based network. Narrow network limits provider choice for lower premiums. Tiered network assigns cost-sharing levels by provider performance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HMO|PPO|EPO|POS|ACO|narrow_network|tiered_network|exclusive_network|open_network — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Standards, NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance) Network Classification

attributes.name: pcp_count
attributes.description: Total number of primary care physicians in this network. Critical metric for HMO and POS networks that require PCP selection. Used for network adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA PCP Access Standards

attributes.name: pharmacy_network_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes pharmacy providers or if pharmacy benefits are managed separately. True if pharmacy is included. False if pharmacy is carved out.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Standards

attributes.name: provider_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual providers (physicians, specialists, allied health professionals) participating in this network. Used for network adequacy assessment and member communications.

attributes.name: quality_tier_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to assign providers to quality or performance tiers within this network. May reference HEDIS measures, patient satisfaction scores, cost efficiency, or clinical outcomes. Used in tiered network designs.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) Standards

attributes.name: recredentialing_cycle_months
attributes.description: Number of months between provider recredentialing reviews. Typically 24 or 36 months per NCQA standards. Used to schedule provider credential verification and quality reviews.

attributes.name: risk_arrangement
attributes.description: Financial risk-sharing arrangement between payer and network providers. Full risk transfers all financial risk to providers. Shared risk splits risk between payer and providers. Upside only allows providers to share savings but not losses. Downside risk requires providers to cover losses. No risk is traditional fee-for-service.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Standards, NCQA Risk-Based Contracting Standards

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: Classification of the geographic service area scope. Statewide covers entire state. Regional covers multiple counties or regions. County covers specific counties. ZIP code covers specific ZIP codes. MSA (Metropolitan Statistical Area) covers census-defined metro areas. National covers multiple states or entire country.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that is the source of record for this provider network. May be Epic, Cerner, proprietary payer system, or network management platform.

attributes.name: specialist_count
attributes.description: Total number of specialist physicians in this network. Used for network adequacy assessment and member communications.

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes telehealth or virtual care providers. True if telehealth services are available. False if only in-person care is covered.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Standards, State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider network is terminated and no longer available for new member enrollment. Existing members may have a transition period. Null for open-ended networks.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this provider network record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vision_network_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes vision providers or if vision benefits are managed separately. True if vision is included. False if vision is carved out.

attributes.name: parent_provider_network_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on provider_network (parent_provider_network_id)

products.name: insurance_network_participation
products.description: Association record linking individual clinicians and organizational providers to a specific payer network, capturing the full participation lifecycle. Records provider NPI, network ID, payer ID, participation status (active, pending, terminated, suspended), effective date, termination date, participation tier (preferred, standard), credentialing status with payer, contracted specialty, service location(s) covered under participation, and the payer enrollment record reference. Enables in-network vs out-of-network determination at claim adjudication and supports network adequacy reporting.
products.reference: Provider Network Participation / Panel Status

attributes.name: insurance_network_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network participation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider (individual clinician or organizational provider) participating in the network.

attributes.name: facility_care_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.care_site. Business justification: Payers credential facilities (hospitals, surgery centers) for network participation independent of individual clinicians. Network status determines claim payment rates, prior authorization requirement

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule or rate table that defines reimbursement amounts for services provided under this network participation.

attributes.name: payer_contract_id
attributes.description: The payer's contract number or identifier governing the terms of this network participation. Links to the master provider-payer contract.

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance payer or health plan sponsoring the network.

attributes.name: provider_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service location or facility where the provider delivers care under this network participation. A provider may have multiple participation records for different locations.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer network in which the provider is participating.

attributes.name: provider_payer_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payer enrollment record that initiated this network participation. Tracks the enrollment application and approval workflow.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients through this network participation. Used for member directory and referral management.

attributes.name: attribution_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is eligible to have patients attributed to them for value-based payment programs, ACO arrangements, or population health management.

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: The method by which the provider submits claims to the payer under this network participation.

attributes.name: contracted_specialty
attributes.description: The primary medical specialty or service line under which the provider is contracted to participate in the network. May differ from the provider's board certification if contracted for specific services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this network participation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payer approved the provider's credentials for network participation.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: The status of the provider's credentialing process with the payer. Approved status is required before participation can become active.

attributes.name: directory_listing_name
attributes.description: The name of the provider as it should appear in member-facing provider directories and network listings. May differ from legal name for clarity or branding.

attributes.name: directory_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network participation should be visible in public provider directories and member portals. May be false for closed panels or restricted networks.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: exclusion_screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was last screened against federal and state exclusion lists (OIG LEIE, SAM, state Medicaid exclusions). Required monthly per CMS guidelines.

attributes.name: exclusion_status
attributes.description: The result of the most recent exclusion screening. Excluded providers must be immediately terminated from network participation.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: The provider category used for network adequacy reporting and compliance. Ensures the network meets regulatory requirements for provider access.

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation record represents an individual clinician, a provider group, a facility, or another organizational arrangement.

attributes.name: npi

attributes.name: panel_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current capacity status of the provider's patient panel. Closed or full panels may not accept new patient assignments.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider's participation in the network. Active indicates the provider is currently in-network and eligible for in-network reimbursement rates.

attributes.name: participation_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of the provider within the network, indicating reimbursement rates and patient cost-sharing levels. Preferred tier typically offers lower patient cost-sharing.

attributes.name: payer_provider_number

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether services from this provider under this network participation require prior authorization from the payer before rendering care.

attributes.name: quality_tier

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete recredentialing to maintain active network participation status. Typically occurs every 2-3 years per NCQA standards.

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: The payment methodology used by the payer to reimburse the provider for services rendered under this network participation.

attributes.name: risk_arrangement

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: specialty_code

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's participation in the network ended or will end. Null for active ongoing participation. Used to determine out-of-network status for claims adjudication.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for termination of network participation, if applicable. Examples include provider request, quality issues, credentialing failure, or contract expiration.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code

attributes.name: updated_by

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this network participation record was last modified.

attributes.name: prior_insurance_network_participation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on insurance_network_participation (prior_insurance_network_participation_id)

products.name: plan_network
products.description: Association record linking a health plan to one or more provider networks, defining which networks are available to members enrolled in a given plan. Captures plan ID, network ID, network role (primary, secondary, out-of-area), geographic region applicability, effective date, termination date, and network tier designation within the plan. Supports multi-network plan configurations (e.g., tiered PPO with preferred and standard networks) and enables accurate in-network benefit determination during claim adjudication.
products.reference: Plan-Network Association

attributes.name: filing_reference_number

attributes.name: network_adequacy_certified

attributes.name: network_priority

attributes.name: network_role

attributes.name: network_tier

attributes.name: network_type

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_applies

attributes.name: pcp_selection_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether members enrolled in this plan-network combination must select a Primary Care Physician (PCP) from the network.

attributes.name: plan_network_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the plan-network association. Indicates whether the association is currently in effect for benefit determination and claim adjudication.

attributes.name: referral_required

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: state_code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this plan-network association record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

SSOT for coverage rules referenced during prior authorization and claim adjudication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
