attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the coverage policy ceases to be active. Nullable for policies with no defined end date.

attributes.name: frequency_limitations
attributes.description: Limitations on how often the service or procedure can be performed and reimbursed within a specified time period (e.g., 'once per calendar year', 'maximum 12 visits per year').

attributes.name: gender_restrictions
attributes.description: Gender-based limitations or requirements for coverage under this policy (e.g., 'female patients only', 'male patients only', 'no gender restrictions').

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the coverage policy was last modified or revised.

attributes.name: medical_necessity_criteria
attributes.description: Clinical criteria defining when the service or procedure is considered medically necessary and therefore eligible for coverage under this policy.

attributes.name: network_restrictions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service or procedure must be performed by an in-network provider to be covered. In-Network Only = only in-network providers eligible; Out-of-Network Allowed = both in-network and out-of-network providers eligible (may have different reimbursement); No Restriction = network status does not affect coverage.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: place_of_service_restrictions
attributes.description: Restrictions on where the service or procedure can be performed to be eligible for coverage (e.g., 'inpatient hospital only', 'outpatient facility or office', 'home health setting').
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Standards

attributes.name: policy_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the coverage policy was formally approved by the payer's medical policy committee or equivalent governance body.

attributes.name: policy_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or committee that approved the coverage policy.

attributes.name: policy_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the coverage policy by clinical domain or service type (e.g., 'Radiology', 'Pharmacy', 'Surgical Procedures', 'Durable Medical Equipment').

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the coverage policy, including the clinical rationale, scope of coverage, and any special conditions or limitations.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the coverage policy, used in prior authorization and claims adjudication workflows.

attributes.name: policy_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or department responsible for maintaining and updating this coverage policy.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the coverage policy. Active = in effect and enforceable; Inactive = temporarily suspended; Draft = not yet finalized; Under Review = being evaluated or updated; Retired = no longer in use; Superseded = replaced by a newer policy version.

attributes.name: policy_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the coverage policy, describing the service or condition covered.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the coverage policy. Medical Policy = internal payer medical necessity policy; Coverage Determination = specific coverage decision; LCD = Local Coverage Determination (Medicare contractor-specific); NCD = National Coverage Determination (CMS national policy); Administrative Policy = non-clinical coverage rule; Clinical Guideline = evidence-based clinical criteria.
attributes.references: CMS National Coverage Determination (NCD) and Local Coverage Determination (LCD) Standards

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the coverage policy, used to track revisions and updates over time (e.g., '1.0', '2.3').

attributes.name: prior_authorization_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed clinical and administrative criteria that must be met to obtain prior authorization for the service or procedure covered by this policy.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required before the service or procedure can be performed and reimbursed under this policy. True = prior authorization required; False = no prior authorization required.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: provider_specialty_restrictions
attributes.description: Restrictions on which provider specialties are authorized to perform the service or procedure under this policy (e.g., 'board-certified cardiologist only', 'licensed physical therapist').

attributes.name: quantity_limitations
attributes.description: Limitations on the quantity or dosage of the service, supply, or medication that can be provided and reimbursed under this policy (e.g., 'maximum 30-day supply', 'up to 10 units per month').

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory or statutory basis for the coverage policy (e.g., 'CMS NCD 210.1', 'State Medicaid Manual Section 4.5', 'ACA Essential Health Benefits').
attributes.references: CMS Regulatory Standards, State Medicaid Standards, ACA Standards

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next policy review or update cycle, ensuring the policy remains aligned with current clinical evidence and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NCQA Quality Standards, Internal Policy Management Standards

attributes.name: step_therapy_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria defining the step therapy requirements, including which treatments must be tried first and the conditions under which step therapy can be bypassed.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy (trial of less expensive or less invasive treatments first) is required before the service or procedure is covered. True = step therapy required; False = no step therapy required.
attributes.references: CMS Coverage Policy Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: cobra_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) End Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage ends, if applicable. Null if not on COBRA or coverage is ongoing.

attributes.name: cobra_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Start Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage began, if applicable. Null if not on COBRA.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the subscriber's residence. Typically USA for US-based subscribers.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscriber's coverage. Active=currently covered, Inactive=coverage lapsed, Suspended=temporarily paused, Terminated=permanently ended, Pending=awaiting activation.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage provided under this subscriber contract. Indicates the primary benefit category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subscriber record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the subscriber. Used for eligibility verification and age-based benefit determination.

attributes.name: dual_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is dually eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid. True=dual eligible, False=not dual eligible. Critical for coordination of benefits and cost-sharing determination.
attributes.references: CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber's coverage terminates. Null for open-ended active coverage.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber's coverage becomes effective and benefits are available.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address for subscriber communication and electronic correspondence.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the subscriber as registered with the payer.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Administrative gender of the subscriber. M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, O=Other.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Employer or sponsor group number under which the subscriber is enrolled. Used for group billing and benefit determination.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (family name) of the subscriber as registered with the payer.

attributes.name: medicaid_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is eligible for Medicaid coverage. True=eligible, False=not eligible. Used for coordination of benefits and dual eligibility determination.

attributes.name: medicaid_number
attributes.description: State-issued Medicaid identification number, if the subscriber is Medicaid-eligible. Used for coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: medicare_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is eligible for Medicare coverage. True=eligible, False=not eligible. Used for coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: medicare_number
attributes.description: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) assigned by CMS, if the subscriber is Medicare-eligible. Used for coordination of benefits between Medicare and commercial insurance.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the subscriber, if provided.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Network tier or level assigned to the subscriber's plan. Determines cost-sharing and provider access levels.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the subscriber.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or postal code of the subscriber's residence.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Monthly or periodic premium amount the subscriber is responsible for paying. Amount in USD.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the subscriber pays premiums.

attributes.name: primary_care_physician_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Physician (PCP) National Provider Identifier (NPI)
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the subscriber's designated primary care physician, if applicable. Used in managed care plans requiring PCP assignment.

attributes.name: relationship_to_insured
attributes.description: Relationship of the subscriber to the primary insured. For subscriber records, this is typically 'self' since the subscriber IS the insured party. Used when subscriber may be a dependent on another policy.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this subscriber record originated (e.g., Epic Resolute, Cerner Revenue Cycle, payer enrollment system).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this subscriber in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number of the subscriber. Stored in masked or encrypted format per HIPAA security requirements. Used for identity verification and coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: State or province of the subscriber's residence. Two-letter state code for US addresses.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix of the subscriber (Jr, Sr, II, III, etc.), if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for coverage termination, if applicable. Null for active coverage.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subscriber record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: prior_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on subscriber (prior_subscriber_id)

products.name: dependent
products.description: Master record for individuals covered under a subscriber's health plan as dependents, including spouses, domestic partners, and children. Captures dependent ID, subscriber ID, dependent name, date of birth, gender, relationship type (spouse, child, domestic partner, disabled dependent), dependent eligibility status, coverage effective date, termination date, termination reason (aging off at 26, divorce, loss of eligibility), and student status for age-extension eligibility. Enables accurate member-level eligibility verification and COB determination for dependents.
products.reference: Dependent / Covered Dependent / Member Dependent

attributes.name: dependent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dependent record. Primary key.

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary care physician assigned to this dependent for managed care plans.

attributes.name: member_mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Unique member identifier assigned by the health plan to this dependent for eligibility verification and claims processing.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.mpi_record. Business justification: Dependents are patients with MPI records. Business process: dependent enrollment creates patient identity; clinical care delivery, scheduling, and medical records require linking insurance dependent t

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary subscriber under whose health plan this dependent is covered.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the dependent.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of residence for the dependent.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has other health insurance coverage requiring coordination of benefits.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the dependents residence.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependents coverage under the subscribers health plan becomes effective.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependents coverage under the subscribers health plan terminates. Null if coverage is currently active.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dependent record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the dependent, used for age-based eligibility determination and coverage rules.

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent has a qualifying disability that extends eligibility beyond standard age or relationship limits.

attributes.name: disability_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependents disability status was last verified for extended eligibility purposes.

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current eligibility status of the dependent for coverage under the subscribers health plan.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address for the dependent for communication and notifications.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependent was enrolled in the health plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Source through which the dependent was enrolled in the health plan (e.g., employer, exchange, direct, Medicaid, Medicare, CHIP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Employer|Exchange|Direct|Medicaid|Medicare|CHIP|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the dependent as registered with the health plan.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the dependent as recorded for coverage and clinical purposes.

attributes.name: last_eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependents eligibility was last verified by the health plan.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the dependent as registered with the health plan.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the dependent.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the dependent.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the dependents residence.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship between the dependent and the subscriber (e.g., spouse, child, domestic partner, disabled dependent).

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number of the dependent for tax reporting and identity verification purposes.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the dependents residence.

attributes.name: student_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent is a full-time or part-time student, which may extend eligibility beyond standard age limits (e.g., up to age 26).
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Dependent Coverage Provisions

attributes.name: student_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependents student status was last verified for eligibility extension purposes.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix for the dependent (e.g., Jr, Sr, II, III).

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of the dependents coverage (e.g., aging off at 26, divorce, loss of eligibility, death).

attributes.name: tobacco_use_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependent uses tobacco products, which may affect premium calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dependent record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: primary_dependent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dependent (primary_dependent_id)

products.name: employer_group
products.description: Master record for employer groups and group sponsors that purchase health insurance coverage for their employees through a payer. Captures group name, group number, employer EIN (Tax ID), SIC/NAICS industry code, group size (number of enrolled lives), funding type (fully insured, self-funded, level-funded), plan sponsor type (private employer, union trust, government employer, association), broker/TPA relationship, renewal date, and group contract effective dates. Supports group-level benefit administration, premium billing, and employer reporting.
products.reference: Employer Group / Group Sponsor / Plan Sponsor

attributes.name: employer_group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employer group. Primary key for this entity. This is the system-generated surrogate key that uniquely identifies each employer group record in the master data management system.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the insurance broker or agent who sold and services this employer group. Brokers receive commissions and provide ongoing account management. Null if the group was sold direct.
attributes.references: State Insurance Producer Licensing Requirements, NAIC Producer Database

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the standard benefit plan design (coverage levels, deductibles, copays, coinsurance) that applies to this employer group. Links to the benefit plan master entity. Groups may have multiple plans for different employee classes.
attributes.references: ERISA Summary Plan Description Requirements, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the health insurance payer (carrier) that underwrites or administers this employer group. Links to the payer master entity.
attributes.references: HIPAA Trading Partner Agreements, NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the provider network assigned to this employer group. Determines which providers are in-network for members of this group. Links to the network master entity.
attributes.references: Network Adequacy Standards, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: tpa_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Third Party Administrator that handles claims processing, member services, and administrative functions for this self-funded employer group. Null if the payer administers the plan directly or if the group is fully insured.

attributes.name: aca_applicable_large_employer_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Applicable Large Employer (ALE) Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this employer group meets the ACA definition of an Applicable Large Employer (50 or more full-time equivalent employees). ALEs are subject to the employer shared responsibility mandate and must offer affordable minimum essential coverage or face penalties.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H (Employer Shared Responsibility), IRS Form 1094-C and 1095-C Reporting

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the employer group's primary business address. Typically includes street number and street name. Used for premium billing, regulatory correspondence, and legal notices.
attributes.references: USPS Address Standards, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the employer group's primary business address. Typically includes suite, floor, or building number. Optional field.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premium invoices are generated and sent to the employer group. Most groups are billed monthly, but some large groups may have quarterly or annual billing cycles.
attributes.references: Premium Billing Standards, ERISA Fiduciary Rules

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city of the employer group's primary business address. Used for geographic rating, network assignment, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: cobra_administrator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Administrator
attributes.description: The entity responsible for administering COBRA continuation coverage for terminated employees and qualifying dependents. Payer: health plan administers. Employer: employer self-administers. TPA: third party administrator handles. External vendor: specialized COBRA vendor.
attributes.references: COBRA (Title X of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985), DOL COBRA Regulations

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary employer contact for benefits administration. Used for enrollment files, billing statements, and plan communications.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person at the employer organization for benefits administration, enrollment, and billing matters. Typically the HR director or benefits manager.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary employer contact for benefits administration. Used for urgent enrollment issues, billing inquiries, and plan support.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code of the employer group's primary business address. Typically USA for domestic groups. Used for international employer groups and regulatory jurisdiction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this employer group record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employer group's health insurance coverage becomes active and members are eligible for benefits. This is the contract start date.
attributes.references: HIPAA 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, Insurance Contract Standards

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: The number of eligible employees (subscribers) in the employer group, excluding dependents. Used for group size classification, premium calculations, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA Reporting Requirements, ACA Employer Mandate

attributes.name: employer_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the employee-only premium that the employer pays. The employee pays the remainder. Typical employer contributions range from 50% to 100%. Used for ACA affordability calculations and premium billing.
attributes.references: ACA Employer Shared Responsibility (Employer Mandate), ERISA Plan Document

attributes.name: employer_ein
attributes.description: The federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) assigned by the IRS, also known as the Federal Tax Identification Number. This nine-digit number uniquely identifies the employer for tax reporting and regulatory purposes. Format: XX-XXXXXXX.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this employer group's health plan is subject to ERISA federal regulations. True for most private employer plans. False for government and church plans which are ERISA-exempt.
attributes.references: ERISA Title I, DOL ERISA Exemptions

attributes.name: funding_type
attributes.description: The financial arrangement model for how the employer group funds its health benefits. Fully insured: payer assumes all risk. Self-funded: employer assumes claims risk. Level-funded: hybrid with predictable monthly payments. Minimum premium: employer funds expected claims, payer covers excess. Stop-loss only: employer self-funds with catastrophic reinsurance.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3, State Insurance Regulations, Self-Funded Plan Administration Standards

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the premium due date during which the employer group can make payment without coverage lapsing. Typically 30 days for group coverage. During the grace period, coverage remains active but claims may be pended.
attributes.references: State Insurance Grace Period Requirements, ERISA Plan Document Standards

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The legal or doing-business-as name of the employer organization that sponsors the health insurance coverage for its employees. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the group.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier assigned to the employer group by the payer. This is the group number printed on member ID cards and used in all billing and claims transactions. Also known as the policy group number or contract group number.
attributes.references: HIPAA 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance, X12 Standard

attributes.name: group_size
attributes.description: The total number of enrolled lives (employees and dependents) covered under this employer group. This count determines small group vs. large group classification for regulatory purposes and impacts premium rating methodologies.
attributes.references: ACA Small Group Market Definition (under 50 employees), State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: group_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the employer group contract. Active: coverage in force. Pending: application submitted, not yet effective. Suspended: temporarily inactive, may be reinstated. Terminated: contract ended by mutual agreement. Cancelled: contract ended by payer. Lapsed: contract ended due to non-payment.
attributes.references: State Insurance Contract Law, ERISA Plan Termination Rules

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this employer group's benefit plan is HSA-qualified (high deductible health plan meeting IRS requirements). If true, employees can contribute pre-tax dollars to a Health Savings Account.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969 (Health Savings Accounts), IRC Section 223

attributes.name: industry_risk_class
attributes.description: The risk classification based on the employer's industry and occupation mix. Used in underwriting and premium rating. Low: office/professional. Moderate: light manufacturing/retail. High: construction/transportation. Hazardous: mining/heavy industrial.
attributes.references: Occupational Risk Classification Standards, Workers Compensation Industry Codes

attributes.name: minimum_participation_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of eligible employees that must enroll in the health plan for the group to qualify for coverage. Typically 75% for small groups. Used during initial underwriting and at renewal to prevent adverse selection.
attributes.references: State Small Group Insurance Regulations, Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The six-digit NAICS code that classifies the employer's industry sector. NAICS has largely replaced SIC for statistical and regulatory purposes. Used for industry analysis, risk stratification, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the employer group remits premium payments to the payer. ACH and wire transfer are most common for large groups. Check and credit card may be used by small groups.
attributes.references: Premium Payment Processing Standards, PCI DSS

attributes.name: plan_sponsor_type
attributes.description: The category of organization that sponsors the health plan. Private employer: for-profit or non-profit business. Union trust: labor union-sponsored plan. Government employer: federal, state, or local government entity. Association: group of small employers. Taft-Hartley: jointly trusteed union-management plan. MEWA: Multiple Employer Welfare Arrangement.
attributes.references: ERISA Title I, Taft-Hartley Act Section 302(c)(5), DOL MEWA Regulations

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code or ZIP+4 code of the employer group's primary business address. Used for geographic rating, network assignment, and premium calculations. Format: XXXXX or XXXXX-XXXX.

attributes.name: rate_guarantee_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the premium rates are guaranteed not to increase. Typically 12 months (annual rate guarantee) for most groups. Some large groups may negotiate multi-year rate guarantees.
attributes.references: Insurance Contract Terms, Rate Guarantee Provisions

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The annual date on which the employer group's contract renews. Typically the anniversary of the original effective date. Used for renewal underwriting, rate adjustments, and plan design changes.
attributes.references: Insurance Contract Renewal Standards, ACA Rate Review Requirements

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: The four-digit Standard Industrial Classification code that categorizes the employer's primary line of business or industry. Used for risk assessment, underwriting, and industry benchmarking.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor SIC Manual

attributes.name: situs_state_code
attributes.description: The state code that determines which state insurance regulations apply to this employer group. For fully insured plans, this is typically the state where the policy is issued. For self-funded ERISA plans, this may differ from the employer's physical location. Format: two uppercase letters.
attributes.references: ERISA Preemption Rules, State Insurance Situs Regulations

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state abbreviation of the employer group's primary business address. Determines state insurance regulations, mandated benefits, and tax jurisdiction. Format: two uppercase letters (e.g., CA, NY, TX).
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, NAIC State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employer group's coverage ends. Null if the group is currently active. Once set, no new claims with service dates after this date will be paid under this group.
attributes.references: ERISA Plan Termination Rules, COBRA Continuation Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: underwriting_tier
attributes.description: The risk classification assigned to this employer group during underwriting. Standard: average risk. Preferred: lower than average risk, may receive rate discounts. Substandard: higher than average risk, may have rate loadings or exclusions. Declined: group was not accepted for coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Group Health Insurance, Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this employer group record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and data synchronization. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Change Data Capture Standards

attributes.name: wellness_program_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this employer group has an active wellness or health promotion program integrated with their health plan. Wellness programs may include biometric screenings, health risk assessments, smoking cessation, weight management, and premium incentives.
attributes.references: ACA Wellness Program Regulations, HIPAA Wellness Program Rules

attributes.name: parent_employer_group_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on employer_group (parent_employer_group_id)

products.name: payer_contract
products.description: Master record for negotiated contracts between the healthcare organization (provider) and insurance payers, defining reimbursement terms, fee schedules, value-based care arrangements, and contractual obligations. Captures contract number, payer ID, contract type (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payment, shared savings, P4P — Pay for Performance), contract effective date, termination date, auto-renewal terms, base fee schedule reference, carve-out provisions, quality bonus/penalty terms, risk arrangement type, and contract status. SSOT for provider-payer contractual relationships governing reimbursement.
products.reference: Payer Contract / Provider-Payer Agreement

attributes.name: payer_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payer contract record. Primary key for the payer contract entity.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.provider_group. Business justification: Contracts executed with provider groups for network participation, VBC arrangements, and group-level reimbursement. Essential for contract management, payment reconciliation, and network operations. C

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Contracts executed with organizational providers for facility network participation and hospital reimbursement. Critical for facility contract management, claims pricing, and network adequacy. Creatin

attributes.name: payer_contact_id
attributes.description: FK to insurance.payer_contact

attributes.name: primary_payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance payer organization that is party to this contract.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Contracts specify covered specialties and carve-outs (e.g., behavioral health carved out, oncology specialty contract). Critical for network adequacy planning, specialty-specific rate negotiations, an

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of amendments or modifications made to this contract since its original execution.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract automatically renews at the end of its term unless either party provides notice of termination.

attributes.name: base_reimbursement_percentage
attributes.description: The baseline percentage rate applied to charges or fee schedules for reimbursement calculation (e.g., 110% of Medicare rates). Null if reimbursement method is not percentage-based.

attributes.name: carve_out_services
attributes.description: Description or list of services explicitly excluded from this contract and reimbursed under separate arrangements (e.g., behavioral health, pharmacy, transplant services).

attributes.name: claims_submission_method
attributes.description: The method by which claims under this contract must be submitted to the payer for adjudication.
attributes.references: Health Level Seven (HL7) Standards, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Standards

attributes.name: contract_administrator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the internal contract administrator for operational communication regarding this contract.

attributes.name: contract_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal staff member or department responsible for managing and administering this payer contract.

attributes.name: contract_document_location
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the signed contract document for audit and reference purposes.

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the payer contract for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for this payer contract, used in communications with the payer and internal revenue cycle operations.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payer contract. Draft indicates contract under negotiation; pending approval awaiting internal or payer sign-off; active means contract is in force; suspended indicates temporary hold; terminated means contract ended before expiration; expired means contract reached its end date.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reimbursement model governing this contract. Fee-for-service pays per service rendered; capitation pays a fixed amount per member per month; bundled payment covers an episode of care; shared savings rewards cost reduction; pay-for-performance (P4P) ties payment to quality metrics; value-based combines quality and cost outcomes.
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Payment Models, Alternative Payment Model (APM) Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payer contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credentialing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual providers must be credentialed and enrolled with the payer to bill under this contract.
attributes.references: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payer contract becomes binding and reimbursement terms take effect.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the base fee schedule or rate table that governs reimbursement rates for services under this contract (e.g., Medicare Fee Schedule, custom negotiated rates).
attributes.references: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Fee Schedule, Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Standards

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the geographic region or service area covered by this contract (e.g., statewide, multi-state, specific counties).

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or modification to this contract.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of this provider within the payers network, affecting member cost-sharing and reimbursement rates. Tier 1 typically offers lowest member cost-sharing; out-of-network highest.
attributes.references: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO) Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special provisions, or operational guidance related to this payer contract.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the payer is contractually obligated to remit payment after claim adjudication.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization is required for certain services under this contract before services are rendered.

attributes.name: quality_bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes provisions for quality-based bonus payments tied to performance metrics such as Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) scores or Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) performance.
attributes.references: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS), Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS)

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the quality measure set or program used to evaluate performance under this contract (e.g., HEDIS, MIPS, hospital-acquired infection rates).
attributes.references: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS), Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS), Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) Standards

attributes.name: quality_penalty_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes provisions for quality-based penalties or payment reductions for failure to meet performance thresholds.
attributes.references: Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Standards, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which financial reconciliation and settlement occurs between provider and payer for shared savings, risk adjustments, or quality bonuses.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier assigned by the regulatory body for this contracts filing or approval.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract must be filed with state insurance departments or other regulatory bodies for approval or compliance purposes.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: The calculation method used to determine payment amounts. products.name: eligibility_span

products.name: accumulator
products.description: Transactional record tracking a member's year-to-date accumulation of deductible, out-of-pocket maximum, and benefit limit utilization against their health plan thresholds. Captures member ID, health plan ID, benefit year, accumulator type (individual deductible, family deductible, individual OOP max, family OOP max, visit limit, dollar limit), in-network vs out-of-network bucket, accumulated amount to date, plan threshold amount, remaining balance, last updated date, and the claim transactions contributing to the accumulation. Critical for member cost-sharing calculation and benefit exhaustion determination.

attributes.name: accumulator_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accumulator record. Primary key for tracking member benefit accumulation.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan under which benefits are being accumulated. References the plan configuration and benefit structure.

attributes.name: last_claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the most recent claim transaction that contributed to this accumulator. Provides audit trail for accumulation calculations.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary subscriber of the health plan. May differ from member_id for dependents.

attributes.description: The year-to-date dollar amount or count that has been accumulated toward the benefit threshold. Represents member cost-sharing contributions or service utilization.

attributes.name: accumulator_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the accumulator: active (accumulating), suspended (temporarily paused), closed (benefit period ended), or pending reset (awaiting new benefit year initialization).

attributes.name: accumulator_type
attributes.description: The category of benefit accumulation being tracked: individual deductible, family deductible, individual out-of-pocket (OOP) maximum, family OOP maximum, visit limit, or service-specific dollar limit.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of manual adjustments applied to this accumulator due to claim reversals, appeals, or administrative corrections. May be positive or negative.

attributes.name: adjustment_count
attributes.description: The number of adjustment transactions applied to this accumulator. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: benefit_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the benefit accumulation period ends. Typically December 31 or the plan termination date.

attributes.name: benefit_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the benefit accumulation period begins. Typically January 1 or the plan effective date for mid-year enrollments.

attributes.name: benefit_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the accumulator is tracking benefit utilization. Accumulators typically reset annually on the plan renewal date.

attributes.name: carryover_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount carried over from the previous benefit period, if the plan allows deductible or OOP carryover for services rendered near year-end.

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: The tier of coverage for which the accumulator applies: individual, family, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family.

attributes.name: cross_accumulation_indicator

attributes.name: embedded_deductible_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family-level accumulator uses embedded individual deductibles. True means each family member has an individual deductible within the family deductible.

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent adjustment transaction applied to this accumulator. Null if no adjustments have been made.

attributes.name: last_claim_date
attributes.description: Service date of the most recent claim that updated this accumulator. Used for recency tracking and accumulator aging analysis.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accumulator record was last modified. Critical for real-time benefit calculation and member portal display.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accumulator tracks in-network services, out-of-network services, or a combined bucket for both network types.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, or administrative notes related to this accumulator. May include explanations for manual adjustments or unusual accumulation patterns.

attributes.name: plan_year_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential counter indicating which plan year this accumulator represents for the member. Value of 1 for first year, 2 for second year, etc. Used for multi-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: The remaining balance before the threshold is met. Calculated as threshold_amount minus accumulated_amount. Critical for member cost-sharing estimates.

attributes.name: reset_date
attributes.description: The date when this accumulator was last reset to zero, typically at the start of a new benefit period or upon plan change.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The category of healthcare services to which this accumulator applies: medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, behavioral health, or all services combined.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the operational system that originated this accumulator record. Examples: Epic Resolute, Cerner Revenue Cycle, or proprietary claims adjudication platform.

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: The plan-defined maximum amount or limit for this accumulator type. Once reached, benefit rules change (e.g., deductible met, OOP max reached).

attributes.name: threshold_met_date
attributes.description: The date on which the member first met the benefit threshold. Null if threshold has not been met. Used for benefit transition tracking and member communication.

attributes.name: threshold_met_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the member has met or exceeded the benefit threshold for this accumulator type. True when accumulated_amount >= threshold_amount.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: The total number of claim transactions that have contributed to this accumulator balance. Used for utilization pattern analysis.
