attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment or modification to the capitation contract terms.

attributes.name: maximum_shared_loss_cap
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount of shared losses that the healthcare organization is responsible for in a performance period, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: maximum_shared_savings_cap
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount of shared savings that the healthcare organization can earn in a performance period, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: minimum_savings_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of cost savings below the benchmark that must be achieved before shared savings payments are triggered, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the capitation contract administration and management.

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: The calendar year during which performance is measured for quality metrics and financial reconciliation under this capitation contract.

attributes.name: pmpm_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the PMPM rate. Typically USD for US healthcare organizations.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: The fixed monthly payment amount per attributed member that the payer pays to the healthcare organization under the capitation arrangement, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: The standardized set of quality performance measures used to evaluate care delivery and determine quality withhold return and incentive payments (e.g., HEDIS, MIPS, ACO quality measures).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS, CMS MIPS Quality Measures

attributes.name: quality_withhold_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount withheld from capitation payments for quality performance measurement, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: quality_withhold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of capitation payments withheld by the payer pending achievement of quality performance targets, to be returned upon meeting quality benchmarks.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capitation contract requires filing with state insurance departments or CMS for regulatory approval and oversight.
attributes.references: State Insurance Department Regulations, CMS Oversight Standards

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract is eligible for or scheduled for renewal negotiation.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_methodology
attributes.description: The clinical risk stratification model used to adjust capitation payments based on member acuity and complexity. HCC (Hierarchical Condition Category) is the most common model in Medicare and commercial populations.

attributes.name: risk_corridor_lower_threshold
attributes.description: The lower percentage threshold defining the risk corridor below which the healthcare organization is protected from losses. Expressed as a percentage of target costs.

attributes.name: risk_corridor_upper_threshold
attributes.description: The upper percentage threshold defining the risk corridor above which the healthcare organization shares in savings. Expressed as a percentage of target costs.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which financial reconciliation and settlement of capitation payments, shared savings, and quality withholds occurs between the payer and healthcare organization.

attributes.name: shared_loss_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of cost overruns above the target benchmark that the healthcare organization is responsible for under the risk-sharing arrangement.

attributes.name: shared_savings_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of cost savings below the target benchmark that the healthcare organization retains as shared savings under the value-based care arrangement.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the operational system from which this capitation contract record originated (e.g., Epic Resolute, Cerner Revenue Cycle, contract management system).

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: The per-member cost threshold above which stop-loss insurance or reinsurance protection applies to limit the healthcare organizations financial exposure for high-cost cases, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capitation contract ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended or evergreen contracts.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the capitation contract.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last updated this capitation contract record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capitation contract record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: vbc_model
attributes.description: The value-based care payment model framework governing financial risk and reward sharing between the healthcare organization and payer.

attributes.name: renewed_capitation_contract_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on capitation_contract (renewed_capitation_contract_id)

products.name: capitation_payment
products.description: Transactional record of monthly capitation payments received from payers under capitation and value-based care contracts. Captures payment period (month/year), payer ID, capitation contract ID, attributed member count, PMPM rate applied, gross capitation amount, risk adjustment factor, quality withhold amount, net payment amount, payment receipt date, payment method (EFT, check), payer remittance reference, and reconciliation status. Enables capitation revenue recognition, attributed population reconciliation, and VBC financial performance tracking.
products.reference: Capitation Payment / PMPM Payment

attributes.name: capitation_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capitation payment transaction record. Primary key for the capitation payment entity.

attributes.name: capitation_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capitation or value-based care contract governing this payment arrangement.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service location or facility receiving the capitation payment for the attributed member population.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider group or practice organization receiving the capitation payment under the value-based care arrangement.

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance payer or health plan making the capitation payment under the value-based care contract.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the payment processing system or bank for the electronic funds transfer or check deposit.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional positive or negative adjustments applied to the capitation payment for retroactive attribution changes, prior period corrections, or contract amendments.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for any adjustment amount applied to the capitation payment, including retroactive attribution changes or contract modifications.

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: The number of health plan members attributed to the provider organization for the payment period under the capitation contract.
attributes.references: CMS Accountable Care Organization (ACO) Attribution Standards

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year of the capitation agreement to which this payment applies, used for multi-year contract tracking and performance measurement.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The organizational cost center or department to which the capitation payment revenue is allocated for internal financial management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capitation payment record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the capitation payment. Typically USD for US healthcare organizations.

attributes.name: days_to_payment
attributes.description: The number of days between the payment due date and the actual payment received date, used to track payer payment timeliness performance.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the capitation payment revenue is posted for financial reporting and accounting purposes.

attributes.name: gross_capitation_amount
attributes.description: The total gross capitation payment amount calculated as attributed member count multiplied by PMPM rate, before any adjustments or withholds.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net capitation payment amount received after all adjustments, risk factors, and quality withholds have been applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the capitation payment, including special circumstances, disputes, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed date by which the payer is required to remit the capitation payment to the provider organization.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used by the payer to remit the capitation payment.

attributes.name: payment_period_month
attributes.description: The month (1-12) for which this capitation payment applies, representing the coverage period for attributed members.

attributes.name: payment_period_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this capitation payment applies, representing the coverage period for attributed members.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capitation payment was actually received by the provider organization, used for cash flow tracking and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number or remittance identifier provided by the payer for reconciliation and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capitation payment transaction indicating processing state and reconciliation progress.

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: The contracted capitation rate paid per attributed member per month, expressed in dollars. This is the base rate before adjustments.

attributes.name: quality_withhold_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount withheld by the payer from the capitation payment pending achievement of quality performance metrics under the value-based care contract.

attributes.name: quality_withhold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the gross capitation amount withheld for quality performance, typically ranging from 0% to 20%.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capitation payment was successfully reconciled against expected amounts and attributed member rosters.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reconciliation process comparing the received capitation payment against expected amounts based on attributed member counts and contract terms.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the remittance advice document was received from the payer, used for payment reconciliation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal remittance advice document (835 ERA or paper EOB) was received from the payer with the capitation payment.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the capitation payment revenue is recognized in the general ledger according to GAAP revenue recognition principles.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (month and year) in which the capitation payment revenue is recognized for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_amount
attributes.description: The capitation payment amount after applying the risk adjustment factor to account for population health complexity.
attributes.references: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The risk adjustment multiplier applied to the capitation payment based on the attributed population's health acuity and complexity. Values typically range from 0.5 to 3.0.
attributes.references: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Risk Adjustment Model

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this capitation payment record originated, such as Epic Resolute or Cerner Revenue Cycle.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this capitation payment record, used for audit trail and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capitation payment record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The dollar difference between the expected capitation payment and the actual payment received, used to identify discrepancies requiring investigation.

attributes.name: variance_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any variance between expected and actual capitation payment amounts, including attribution differences or rate discrepancies.

attributes.name: adjusted_capitation_payment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on capitation_payment (adjusted_capitation_payment_id)

products.name: risk_adjustment
products.description: Transactional record of risk adjustment submissions and reconciliations under CMS risk adjustment programs (HCC — Hierarchical Condition Category for Medicare Advantage, EDGE server submissions for ACA plans) and payer-specific risk adjustment methodologies. Captures member ID, payer ID, health plan ID, risk adjustment model (CMS-HCC, RxHCC, HHS-HCC), diagnosis codes submitted (HCC-mapped ICD-10), risk score, RAF (Risk Adjustment Factor), submission period, submission type (initial, supplemental, deletion), RADV audit status, and payment impact amount. Supports risk adjustment revenue optimization and CMS compliance.
products.reference: Risk Adjustment / HCC Submission / RAF Score

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk adjustment submission record.

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the healthcare provider who documented the diagnosis codes submitted for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: diagnosis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.clinical_diagnosis. Business justification: Risk adjustment submissions must reference source clinical diagnoses for RADV audits and medical record validation. CMS requires linking HCC codes back to documented diagnoses. Essential for Medicare

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical coder or health information management professional who reviewed the medical record to validate this diagnosis submission.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific health plan under which the member is enrolled and for which risk adjustment applies.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan member whose diagnoses are being submitted for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Risk adjustment submissions track which organizational provider documented the HCC diagnosis for RADV audit trails and medical record retrieval. Essential for Medicare Advantage and ACA risk adjustmen

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance payer organization responsible for the risk adjustment submission.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Protocol

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical encounter that generated the diagnosis codes submitted for risk adjustment.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which CMS or the payer accepted this risk adjustment submission as valid and included it in payment calculations.

attributes.name: chart_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical chart supporting this diagnosis was reviewed for risk adjustment coding accuracy and completeness.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Contract Number
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned contract identifier for the Medicare Advantage or Part D plan under which this risk adjustment submission is made.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this risk adjustment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_collection_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the period during which diagnosis data was collected for this risk adjustment submission, typically December 31 of the service year.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Collection Guidelines

attributes.name: data_collection_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the period during which diagnosis data was collected for this risk adjustment submission, typically January 1 of the service year.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Collection Guidelines

attributes.name: deleted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this risk adjustment submission has been deleted or voided, typically due to coding errors or medical record review findings.

attributes.name: deletion_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk adjustment submission was deleted or voided from the payment calculation.

attributes.name: deletion_reason
attributes.description: The explanation for why this risk adjustment submission was deleted, such as coding error, insufficient documentation, or duplicate submission.

attributes.name: demographic_score
attributes.description: The portion of the total risk score attributable to demographic factors such as age, gender, Medicaid eligibility, and disability status.

attributes.name: diagnosis_present_on_admission
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the diagnosis was present at the time of inpatient admission, required for certain risk adjustment and quality reporting programs.
attributes.references: CMS Present on Admission Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: diagnosis_type
attributes.description: The classification of the diagnosis within the encounter documentation, indicating whether it was the principal reason for the encounter or a secondary condition.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting

attributes.name: disease_score
attributes.description: The portion of the total risk score attributable to the submitted HCC categories representing chronic and acute conditions.

attributes.name: hcc_code
attributes.description: The HCC category code to which the submitted diagnosis maps, representing a clinically and financially homogeneous group of conditions used in risk score calculation.

attributes.name: hcc_description
attributes.description: The descriptive label for the HCC category, providing clinical context for the condition group (e.g., Diabetes with Chronic Complications, Congestive Heart Failure).

attributes.name: interaction_score
attributes.description: The portion of the total risk score attributable to disease interaction factors, where the presence of multiple conditions results in higher expected costs than the sum of individual conditions.

attributes.name: medical_record_review_status
attributes.description: The status of medical record documentation review supporting this diagnosis submission, critical for RADV audit compliance and internal quality assurance.
attributes.references: CMS RADV Medical Record Review Guidelines

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: The specific risk adjustment methodology applied to calculate the risk score. CMS-HCC (Hierarchical Condition Category) for Medicare Advantage, RxHCC for Part D, HHS-HCC for ACA marketplace plans, ESRD for end-stage renal disease, PACE for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly, CDPS for Chronic Illness and Disability Payment System. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMS-HCC|RxHCC|HHS-HCC|ESRD|PACE|CDPS|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version year or release identifier of the risk adjustment model used for this submission (e.g., V24, V28 for CMS-HCC models).
attributes.references: CMS Announcement of Calendar Year Risk Adjustment Model Coefficients

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of risk adjustment payment associated with this submission, calculated by multiplying the risk score by the base payment rate for the plan and geographic area.

attributes.name: payment_impact_amount
attributes.description: The incremental payment impact of this specific HCC submission compared to baseline, representing the marginal revenue contribution of capturing this diagnosis.

attributes.name: payment_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which the risk adjustment payment applies, typically the year following the data collection year.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package
attributes.description: The specific benefit package identifier within the contract that applies to this member and risk adjustment submission.

attributes.name: radv_audit_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Date
attributes.description: The date on which this submission was selected for or completed a RADV audit by CMS.

attributes.name: radv_audit_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) Audit Status
attributes.description: The status of this submission in the CMS Risk Adjustment Data Validation audit process, which validates the accuracy of submitted diagnosis codes through medical record review.

attributes.name: recapture_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this diagnosis represents a recapture of a chronic condition that was documented in a prior year but not yet documented in the current payment year.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: The date on which CMS or the payer rejected this risk adjustment submission due to validation errors or policy violations.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: The detailed explanation provided by CMS or the payer for why this risk adjustment submission was rejected, including error codes and corrective action guidance.
attributes.references: CMS EDGE Server Error Code Reference

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: The calculated risk score (also known as RAF - Risk Adjustment Factor) for the member based on demographic factors and submitted HCC categories. A score of 1.0 represents average risk; higher scores indicate higher expected costs.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The date of service on which the diagnosis was documented during the clinical encounter, used to determine eligibility for the risk adjustment payment year.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Data Collection Period Rules

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the operational system from which this risk adjustment submission originated, such as Epic EHR, Cerner Millennium, or a specialized risk adjustment platform.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this risk adjustment submission was transmitted to CMS EDGE server or payer risk adjustment system.

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this risk adjustment submission, used for tracking and reconciliation with CMS or payer systems.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the risk adjustment submission in the workflow from creation through final reconciliation with CMS or payer systems.
attributes.references: CMS EDGE Server Processing Status Codes

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this risk adjustment submission was transmitted, used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The type of risk adjustment submission. Initial for first-time submission, Supplemental for additional diagnoses, Deletion for removing previously submitted diagnoses, Correction for fixing errors, RAPS for Risk Adjustment Processing System (legacy), EDPS for Encounter Data Processing System (current).

attributes.name: suspect_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this diagnosis has been identified as a suspect condition that should be documented and submitted for risk adjustment but has not yet been confirmed in the current year.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this risk adjustment record was last modified.

attributes.name: corrected_risk_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk_adjustment (corrected_risk_adjustment_id)

products.name: coordination_of_benefits
products.description: Master record managing coordination of benefits (COB) rules and active COB relationships for members with multiple insurance coverages. Captures member ID, primary payer ID, primary plan ID, secondary payer ID, secondary plan ID, tertiary payer information, COB determination method (birthday rule, gender rule, NAIC COB rules), COB effective date, COB verification date, COB verification source, and crossover claim indicator (Medicare/Medicaid crossover). SSOT for COB order determination referenced during claim adjudication to prevent duplicate payment and ensure correct primary/secondary billing sequencing.
products.reference: COB / Coordination of Benefits

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the coordination of benefits record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cob_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the third-party vendor providing COB data services, if applicable (e.g., Availity, Change Healthcare COB services).

attributes.name: member_mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member with multiple insurance coverages. Links to the patient/member master record.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.mpi_record. Business justification: COB determination for claims adjudication with multiple payers requires patient identity linkage. Business process: primary/secondary payer sequencing depends on patient-specific coverage relationship

attributes.name: primary_coordination_health_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan designated as primary coverage.

attributes.name: primary_payer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance payer designated as primary in the coordination of benefits hierarchy.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the primary subscriber on the insurance policy.

attributes.name: tertiary_payer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance payer designated as tertiary in the coordination of benefits hierarchy, if applicable.

attributes.name: tertiary_plan_health_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health plan designated as tertiary coverage, if applicable.

attributes.name: auto_cob_update_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automatic Coordination of Benefits (COB) Update Enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automatic updates to COB information are enabled through eligibility feeds or third-party vendors. True when automated updates are active.

attributes.name: cob_agreement_type
attributes.description: The type of coordination agreement between payers. Standard COB allows combined benefits up to 100% of charges; non-duplication pays only what primary did not cover; carve-out excludes certain services; maintenance of benefits pays as if primary regardless of other coverage.

attributes.name: cob_determination_method
attributes.description: The method or rule used to determine the order of benefit responsibility among multiple coverages. Common methods include birthday rule (parent with earlier birthday is primary for dependent children), gender rule (deprecated method using father as primary), NAIC COB rules, court order, separation agreement, or active/inactive employment status.

attributes.name: cob_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the coordination of benefits arrangement becomes effective and the payer order applies for claim adjudication.

attributes.name: cob_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, exceptions, or additional context regarding the coordination of benefits arrangement.

attributes.name: cob_priority_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the order of benefit responsibility. 1 = primary, 2 = secondary, 3 = tertiary. Used for claim adjudication sequencing.

attributes.name: cob_questionnaire_response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coordination of Benefits (COB) Questionnaire Response Date
attributes.description: The date when the member returned the completed COB questionnaire with updated coverage information.

attributes.name: cob_questionnaire_sent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coordination of Benefits (COB) Questionnaire Sent Date
attributes.description: The date when a COB questionnaire was sent to the member to verify or update other insurance coverage information.

attributes.name: cob_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the coordination of benefits arrangement.

attributes.name: cob_termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the coordination of benefits arrangement ends, typically due to loss of one coverage or change in member circumstances.

attributes.name: cob_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the coordination of benefits information was last verified with the member or through external sources.

attributes.name: cob_verification_source
attributes.description: The source or method used to verify the coordination of benefits information, such as member attestation, employer report, eligibility file feed, claims data analysis, third-party COB vendor, or manual research.

attributes.name: court_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the court order that specifies the coordination of benefits arrangement, if applicable.

attributes.name: court_order_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a court order specifies the coordination of benefits order, overriding standard COB rules. True when court order exists.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this coordination of benefits record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crossover_claim_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this COB arrangement involves automatic crossover claims between Medicare and Medicaid or other secondary payers. True indicates crossover claims are processed automatically.

attributes.name: custody_arrangement
attributes.description: The custody arrangement for dependent children when parents are separated or divorced, which may override standard birthday rule COB determination per court order or separation agreement.

attributes.name: dependent_relationship_code
attributes.description: The relationship of the member to the subscriber, used in determining COB order under birthday rule or other dependent coverage rules.

attributes.name: last_cob_inquiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Coordination of Benefits (COB) Inquiry Date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent COB inquiry or verification was performed with external sources or the member.

attributes.name: medicare_primary_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Medicare is the primary payer in this coordination of benefits arrangement. True when Medicare pays first.

attributes.name: msp_type
attributes.description: The type of Medicare Secondary Payer situation, if applicable. Identifies the reason Medicare is secondary: working aged (group health plan coverage), ESRD (end-stage renal disease coordination period), disability (large group health plan), no-fault insurance, workers compensation, or liability insurance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: working_aged|esrd|disability|no_fault|workers_comp|liability|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_cob_verification_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Coordination of Benefits (COB) Verification Due Date
attributes.description: The date when the next periodic COB verification is scheduled to ensure accuracy of payer order information.

attributes.name: other_subscriber_birth_date
attributes.description: Date of birth of the other parent or subscriber on the secondary coverage, used in birthday rule calculations for dependent COB determination.

attributes.name: primary_coverage_type
attributes.description: The type of insurance coverage designated as primary in the COB hierarchy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: group|individual|medicare|medicaid|tricare|va|workers_comp|auto_insurance|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: secondary_coverage_type
attributes.description: The type of insurance coverage designated as secondary in the COB hierarchy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: group|individual|medicare|medicaid|tricare|va|workers_comp|auto_insurance|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this coordination of benefits record originated (e.g., Epic Resolute, Cerner Revenue Cycle, eligibility vendor feed).

attributes.name: subscriber_birth_date
attributes.description: Date of birth of the primary subscriber, used in birthday rule calculations for dependent COB determination.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this coordination of benefits record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this coordination of benefits record was last modified.

attributes.name: superseded_coordination_of_benefits_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on coordination_of_benefits (superseded_coordination_of_benefits_id)

products.name: network_adequacy
products.description: Transactional record of network adequacy assessments and CMS/state regulatory filings documenting that a payer's provider network meets time-and-distance and provider-to-member ratio standards. Captures network ID, payer ID, health plan ID, assessment period, specialty category assessed, geographic service area, required provider-to-member ratio, actual ratio, maximum time-to-appointment standard, actual average time-to-appointment, adequacy status (adequate, deficient), deficiency remediation plan, regulatory submission date, and regulatory body (CMS, state DOI). Supports network adequacy compliance and regulatory reporting.
products.reference: Network Adequacy / Time-and-Distance Standard

attributes.name: network_adequacy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network adequacy assessment record. Primary key for this transactional record of regulatory compliance assessment.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific health plan product associated with this network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the insurance payer organization responsible for this network. Links to payer master data.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network being assessed for adequacy. Links to the provider network master data.

attributes.name: actual_average_appointment_wait_time_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Average Appointment Wait Time Days
attributes.description: Measured average number of days members wait for an appointment with providers in this specialty.

attributes.name: actual_average_distance_miles
attributes.description: Measured average distance in miles that members must travel to reach the nearest contracted provider in this specialty.

attributes.name: actual_average_travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Measured average travel time in minutes that members must travel to reach the nearest contracted provider in this specialty.

attributes.name: actual_provider_to_member_ratio
attributes.description: Measured ratio of contracted providers to enrolled members for this specialty and service area at the time of assessment.

attributes.name: adequacy_determination
attributes.description: Final determination of whether the provider network meets regulatory adequacy standards for this specialty and service area.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State Department of Insurance Standards

attributes.name: assessment_date

products.name: formulary_tier
products.description: Master record defining the pharmacy formulary tier structure for a health plan, establishing the cost-sharing tiers for covered medications. Captures health plan ID, formulary ID, tier number, tier name (Generic, Preferred Brand, Non-Preferred Brand, Specialty, Preventive), member copay amount, member coinsurance percentage, prior authorization requirement, step therapy requirement, quantity limit, and tier effective dates. Distinct from pharmacy.formulary which manages the drug-level formulary listing — this entity defines the tier structure and cost-sharing rules that govern member cost responsibility.
products.reference: Formulary Tier / Drug Tier / Pharmacy Benefit Tier

attributes.name: formulary_tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the formulary tier record. Primary key for the formulary tier entity.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent formulary that contains this tier structure. Links to the pharmacy formulary master data.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan to which this formulary tier structure applies. Links to the health plan master data.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Part D Requirements

attributes.name: ndc_drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.ndc_drug. Business justification: Formulary tiers assign specific NDC drugs to cost-sharing levels (tier 1-4). Essential for pharmacy benefit administration, member cost calculation, and formulary management in payer pharmacy operatio

attributes.name: superseded_by_tier_formulary_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary tier record that replaces this tier structure. Used for tracking tier evolution and managing transitions during formulary updates. Null if this is the current active tier.

attributes.name: cms_tier_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Tier Category
attributes.description: CMS-defined tier category classification for Medicare Part D reporting and compliance. Maps internal tier structure to CMS standard tier definitions for regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this formulary tier record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_supply_mail_order
attributes.description: Standard number of days supply allowed per prescription fill for medications in this tier through mail order pharmacies. Typically 90 days to encourage mail order utilization.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Standards

attributes.name: days_supply_standard
attributes.description: Standard number of days supply allowed per prescription fill for medications in this tier at retail pharmacies. Common values are 30, 60, or 90 days.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Standards

attributes.name: deductible_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan deductible must be met before cost-sharing for this tier takes effect. True if deductible applies; False if tier cost-sharing is immediate.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Benefit Design Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this formulary tier structure becomes active and applicable for member cost-sharing calculations. Aligns with benefit year or mid-year formulary updates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Change Requirements

attributes.name: mail_order_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether medications in this tier are eligible for mail order pharmacy fulfillment, typically with extended days supply and potentially different cost-sharing. True if mail order is available; False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements

attributes.name: member_coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the drug cost the member pays for medications in this tier. Represents percentage-based cost-sharing structure. Null if flat copay applies instead.

attributes.name: member_communication_text
attributes.description: Standardized text used in member-facing communications to explain this tier, including Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) documents, formulary guides, and member portals.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Member Communication Requirements

attributes.name: member_copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays per prescription fill for medications in this tier. Represents flat copayment cost-sharing structure. Null if coinsurance applies instead.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this formulary tier that does not fit into structured fields. Used for operational notes and exception documentation.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether member cost-sharing for this tier counts toward the annual out-of-pocket maximum. True if costs accumulate toward OOP max; False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Catastrophic Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: preferred_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier represents a preferred cost-sharing level, typically associated with lower member costs and plan-preferred medications. True for preferred tiers; False otherwise.

attributes.name: preventive_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is designated for preventive medications covered at zero or minimal cost-sharing under Affordable Care Act (ACA) preventive care requirements. True for preventive tiers; False otherwise.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medications in this tier require prior authorization approval from the health plan before coverage is provided. True if PA is required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Utilization Management Requirements

attributes.name: provider_communication_text
attributes.description: Standardized text used in provider-facing communications to explain this tier structure, cost-sharing rules, and utilization management requirements for prescribing decisions.

attributes.name: quantity_limit_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether medications in this tier are subject to quantity limits per fill or per time period. True if quantity limits apply; False otherwise. Specific limits are defined at the drug level.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Utilization Management Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the formulary tier structure received regulatory approval from CMS or other governing bodies. Null if no regulatory approval is required or if approval is pending.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Approval Process

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier structure requires submission to regulatory bodies such as CMS for approval before implementation. True for Medicare Part D plans; may be False for commercial plans.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Submission Requirements

attributes.name: retail_network_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether medications in this tier can be filled at retail network pharmacies. True if retail network access is available; False if restricted to specialty or mail order only.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system from which this formulary tier record originated. Examples include pharmacy benefit management systems, formulary management platforms, or health plan administration systems.

attributes.name: specialty_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is designated for specialty medications, which typically have higher costs and may require special handling, distribution, or clinical management. True for specialty tiers; False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Tier Guidance

attributes.name: step_therapy_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether medications in this tier are subject to step therapy protocols, requiring members to try lower-cost alternatives before coverage is approved. True if step therapy applies; False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Utilization Management Requirements

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this formulary tier structure is no longer active. Null for open-ended tiers. Used for historical tracking and transition management during formulary updates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Change Requirements

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the formulary tier, used for system integration and claims processing. May align with NCPDP or internal coding standards.

attributes.name: tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the tier structure, including the types of medications covered, cost-sharing philosophy, and member guidance for understanding tier placement.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Member Communication Requirements

attributes.name: tier_display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of tiers in member-facing materials, formulary documents, and system interfaces. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the formulary tier that describes the category of medications and associated cost-sharing level. Common values include Generic, Preferred Brand, Non-Preferred Brand, Specialty, and Preventive.

attributes.name: tier_number
attributes.description: Numeric sequence of the tier within the formulary structure, typically ranging from 1 (lowest cost-sharing) to 5 or 6 (highest cost-sharing). Used for ordering and display purposes.

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the formulary tier. Active tiers are in use for member cost-sharing; Inactive or Retired tiers are no longer applicable; Pending tiers are awaiting regulatory approval.

attributes.name: tier_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this tier structure configuration, used to track changes over time and manage mid-year formulary updates. Follows internal versioning conventions.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this formulary tier record. Used for audit trail and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this formulary tier record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: prior_formulary_tier_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on formulary_tier (prior_formulary_tier_id)

products.name: premium_billing

Captures billing period, employer group ID or subscriber ID, health plan ID, enrolled member count, premium rate per member, total premium billed, employer contribution amount, employee contribution amount, COBRA premium amount (102% of group rate), billing due date, payment received date, payment amount, outstanding balance, and billing status (billed, paid, partially paid, delinquent, lapsed). Supports premium revenue tracking and coverage lapse management.

attributes.name: premium_billing_id

attributes.name: health_plan_id

attributes.name: subscriber_id

attributes.name: administrative_fee_amount

attributes.name: billing_address_line2

attributes.name: billing_contact_name

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the billing contact for premium payment inquiries and collection activities.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: billing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which premium payment must be received to maintain active coverage and avoid grace period or lapse.

attributes.name: billing_frequency

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the coverage period for which premium is being billed.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code component of the billing mailing address.

attributes.name: billing_state

attributes.name: billing_status

attributes.name: billing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the premium billing arrangement indicating whether this is employer group, individual subscriber, COBRA continuation, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid managed care billing.

attributes.name: cobra_premium_amount

attributes.description: Premium amount charged to COBRA participants, typically 102% of the group rate to cover administrative costs. Null for non-COBRA billing. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this premium billing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this billing record. Typically USD for US-based healthcare payers.

attributes.name: delinquency_date
attributes.description: Date on which this premium billing became delinquent due to non-payment past the due date. Null if payment is current or received.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total premium paid by the employee or subscriber through payroll deduction or direct payment. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total premium paid by the employer group on behalf of enrolled members. Zero for individual and COBRA billing. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: enrolled_member_count
attributes.description: Total number of covered members (subscriber plus dependents) enrolled under this billing arrangement during the billing period.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the grace period during which coverage remains active despite non-payment. After this date, coverage may lapse. Typically 30-90 days per plan terms.

attributes.name: invoice_generated_date
attributes.description: Date on which this premium billing invoice was generated and issued to the responsible party.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique invoice number assigned to this premium billing statement for tracking and payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium billing invoice was transmitted or mailed to the responsible party.

attributes.name: lapse_date
attributes.description: Date on which health plan coverage lapsed or was terminated due to non-payment of premium. Null if coverage remains active or payment was received.

attributes.name: net_premium_due
attributes.description: Net premium amount due after applying all contributions, subsidies, and adjustments. This is the amount the responsible party must remit. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this premium billing invoice, such as special payment arrangements, billing disputes, or administrative annotations.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this premium invoice after applying all payments. Zero indicates invoice is paid in full. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of premium payment received and applied to this invoice. May differ from net premium due in cases of partial payment or overpayment. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which premium payment was received: ACH, wire transfer, check, credit card, payroll deduction, or electronic funds transfer.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which premium payment was received and posted to the account. Null if payment has not been received.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or transaction identifier for the premium payment, such as check number, ACH trace number, or credit card authorization code.

attributes.name: premium_rate_per_member

attributes.description: The per-member-per-month premium rate applied to calculate total premium for this billing period. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lapsed coverage is eligible for reinstatement upon payment of outstanding premium and any applicable fees. True if reinstatement is allowed per plan terms.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this premium billing record originated, such as Epic Resolute PB, Cerner Revenue Cycle, or MEDITECH Expanse Financial.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Government subsidy or premium tax credit amount applied to reduce the net premium owed by the subscriber. Applicable to exchange plans. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount billed for the coverage period before applying employer or subscriber contributions. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last updated this premium billing record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this premium billing record was last modified or updated.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on premium_billing (adjusted_premium_billing_id)

products.name: insurance_payer_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a clinician and an insurance payer. It captures the operational enrollment status, credentialing requirements, network participation tier, and provider-specific identifiers (PTAN, enrollment number) that exist only in the context of this clinician-payer relationship. Each record links one clinician to one payer with attributes that govern billing eligibility, claim submission rights, and network participation terms.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, clinicians must enroll with multiple insurance payers (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial plans) to bill for services, and each payer maintains enrollment relationships with thousands of clinicians across their network. The enrollment relationship is an operational business entity actively managed by credentialing and billing departments, with payer-specific identifiers (PTAN, enrollment numbers), credentialing approvals, network tier assignments, and lifecycle status tracking.

products.name: payer_compliance_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the compliance obligations between a specific payer relationship and a compliance program. It captures payer-specific compliance requirements, audit schedules, reporting obligations, and program scope as they apply to each unique payer-program combination. Each record links one compliance program to one payer with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory relationship.. Existence Justification: Healthcare organizations must apply multiple compliance programs (HIPAA, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback, False Claims Act, Medicare Conditions of Participation) across their entire payer portfolio, and each payer relationship is governed by multiple overlapping compliance programs. The compliance requirements, audit schedules, reporting obligations, and program scope vary by payer type (Medicare vs. commercial vs. Medicaid) and by specific contract terms, creating a genuine many-to-many operational relationship that compliance teams actively manage.

products.name: plan_consent_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory and operational requirement linking health insurance plans to the specific consent form templates that members must complete. It captures when each consent form became required for a plan, whether the consent is mandatory for enrollment or optional, and the business rules governing when the form must be presented (at enrollment, renewal, or triggered by specific events). Each record links one health_plan to one consent_form_template with attributes that exist only in the context of this plan-specific consent requirement.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, health insurance plans require multiple consent forms to comply with federal regulations (HIPAA), state laws, treatment protocols, and specialized services (telehealth, genetic testing, research participation). Conversely, a single consent form template (e.g., HIPAA authorization) applies across multiple health plans offered by different payers and plan types. Plan administrators actively manage these requirements, specifying which forms are mandatory vs optional, when they must be presented (enrollment, renewal, or event-triggered), and the regulatory basis for each requirement.

products.description: Master record for informed consent obtained from research subjects prior to enrollment in clinical trials and research studies. attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the consent verification event met all regulatory and organizational compliance requirements. True indicates full compliance; False indicates a compliance gap requiring review.

attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any compliance considerations, exceptions, or special circumstances related to this consent verification event. Used for regulatory audit support and quality assurance review.

attributes.description: Effective start date of the consent record that was verified. Captured at verification time for audit and historical analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: consent_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the consent record that was verified. Captured at verification time to support expiration detection and renewal workflows. Null if consent has no expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Specific scope or purpose of the consent being verified. Free-text description of what the consent covers (e.g., 'surgical procedure', 'clinical trial XYZ', 'release to insurance', 'HIE query').

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent being verified. Indicates the specific consent domain checked during this verification event (treatment consent, research participation, data sharing authorization, HIPAA authorization, Health Information Exchange participation, or telehealth consent).

attributes.description: Date and time when this consent verification record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: days_until_expiration
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until the consent expires, calculated at the time of verification. Negative values indicate expired consent. Null if consent has no expiration date. Used for proactive renewal alerts.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the clinical department or service area where the consent verification was performed. Used for operational reporting and workflow analysis.

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time elapsed in seconds to complete the consent verification check, from initiation to result return. Used for performance monitoring and system optimization.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System error code if the consent verification process encountered a technical failure. Null if verification completed successfully. Used for troubleshooting and system reliability monitoring.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable error message describing any technical failure encountered during consent verification. Null if verification completed successfully.

attributes.name: integration_transaction_code

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the patient or responsible party was notified following consent verification. Applicable when notification_sent_flag is True.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the notification was sent to the patient or responsible party. Null if no notification was sent. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: override_authorized_by
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or authorized user who approved the consent verification override. Required when override_flag is True. Links to the user master record.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the verification result was overridden by authorized personnel. True indicates an override occurred (e.g., emergency access, break-the-glass scenario); False indicates normal verification workflow.

attributes.description: Free-text justification for overriding the consent verification result. Required when override_flag is True. attributes.name: restriction_details

attributes.name: verification_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the consent verification check. Indicates whether the consent was found to be valid and active, expired, revoked by patient, missing entirely, restricted by scope limitations, or pending completion.

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: System or source from which the consent status was retrieved during verification. Indicates the authoritative source consulted (Electronic Medical Record, consent management registry, Health Information Exchange, patient portal, paper records, or external system).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consent verification check was performed. Recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Critical for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: verifying_user_npi

products.name: amendment_request
products.description: Transactional record of patient requests to amend their consent records or associated PHI documentation. Captures amendment request date, specific consent record targeted, nature of requested amendment, organization's decision (accepted, denied with reason), amendment effective date, and notification to third parties who received the original consent-based disclosure. Supports HIPAA right to amend under 45 CFR 164.526 and maintains the integrity of the consent audit trail.
products.reference: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.526 — Right to Amend

attributes.name: denial_reason_description

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accepted amendment becomes effective and is applied to the consent record or associated PHI documentation.

attributes.name: extension_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organization granted itself a 30-day extension to respond to the amendment request, as permitted under HIPAA when unable to respond within the initial 60-day period.

attributes.name: extension_notification_date

attributes.name: extension_reason

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: mrn

attributes.name: consent_session_id

attributes.description: Indicates whether all required consents were successfully obtained during this session. True if all required consents collected, False if any required consent was declined or not completed.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to detailed audit trail records for this consent session, including all user actions, timestamps, and system events.

attributes.name: consent_collection_channel
attributes.description: Interface or location through which the consent session was conducted: patient portal, mobile application, self-service kiosk, clinic, hospital, call center, or mail.

attributes.description: Method by which consent was collected during this session: in-person (face-to-face), electronic (patient portal or kiosk), telephonic (phone call), written (paper form), or verbal (oral consent documented by staff).

attributes.name: consent_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual consent items collected during this session. A single session may capture multiple consent decisions.

attributes.name: consent_document_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or document management system reference to the signed consent document(s) associated with this session.

attributes.name: consent_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form template used during this session. Critical for audit trails and ensuring patients received current consent language.

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the language in which consent materials were presented and consent was obtained (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish).

attributes.name: consenting_party_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who provided consent during this session. May differ from patient name if consent was provided by a legal representative.

attributes.name: consenting_party_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the consenting party to the patient: self (patient consenting for themselves), spouse, parent, child, sibling, legal guardian, attorney, or other authorized relationship.

attributes.name: consenting_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the individual providing consent: patient (self-consent), legal guardian, power of attorney, parent (for minor), or authorized representative.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consent session record was first created in the system. System audit field.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to complete the electronic consent session: desktop computer, tablet, mobile phone, kiosk, or other. Null for non-electronic sessions.

attributes.name: electronic_signature_method
attributes.description: Method used to capture electronic signature during the session: typed name, drawn signature (stylus or touch), biometric (fingerprint/facial), digital certificate, PIN, or none (paper signature).

attributes.name: interpreter_language
attributes.description: Language for which interpretation services were provided during the consent session. Null if no interpreter was used.

attributes.name: interpreter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the interpreter who provided language services during the consent session. Null if no interpreter was used.

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether language interpretation services were required during the consent session. True if interpreter was used, False otherwise.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the electronic consent session was initiated. Used for audit and security purposes. Null for non-electronic sessions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consent session record was last modified. System audit field.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent session met all applicable regulatory requirements at the time of collection. True if compliant, False if deficiencies identified.

attributes.name: session_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the consent session in minutes, calculated from start to end timestamp. Used for compliance tracking and session timeout management.

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consent session was completed, cancelled, or expired. Null for active sessions.

attributes.name: session_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, patient questions, clarifications provided, or other relevant details about the consent session.

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the consent session, formatted as CS- followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consent session was initiated. Represents the business event time when the patient or authorized representative began the consent process.

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent session: initiated (session started), in_progress (consent being collected), completed (all consents finalized), cancelled (session terminated before completion), expired (session timed out), or withdrawn (patient withdrew from session).

attributes.name: session_timeout_minutes
attributes.description: Configured timeout period in minutes for this consent session. Session automatically expires if not completed within this timeframe.

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consent session indicating the primary purpose: treatment consent, research consent, data sharing authorization, HIPAA authorization, Health Information Exchange (HIE) participation, or telehealth consent.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this consent session record originated (e.g., EHR system, patient portal, consent management platform).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this consent session in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: staff_role
attributes.description: Role of the staff member who facilitated the consent session: physician, nurse, research coordinator, consent specialist, administrative staff, or other.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user agent string captured during electronic consent session. Used for technical audit and troubleshooting. Null for non-electronic sessions.

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Full name of the witness who observed the consent process. Required for certain research consents and high-risk procedures. Null if no witness was required or present.

attributes.name: witness_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness signature was required for this consent session based on consent type and regulatory requirements. True if witness required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: witness_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the witness signed or acknowledged the consent. Null if no witness was required.

attributes.name: resumed_consent_session_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on consent_session (resumed_consent_session_id)

attributes.description: The unique identifier for the patient encounter or visit associated with this message, extracted from PV1-19 in HL7 v2.x ADT messages. Used for encounter-level message correlation and clinical workflow tracking.

attributes.description: The acknowledgment code returned by the receiving system indicating message acceptance status. AA=Application Accept, AE=Application Error, AR=Application Reject, CA=Commit Accept, CE=Commit Error, CR=Commit Reject. Corresponds to MSA-1 in HL7 v2.x ACK messages.

attributes.name: ack_timestamp

attributes.description: High-level business event classification derived from the message type (e.g., Patient Admission, Lab Result, Medication Order, Appointment Scheduling, Charge Posting). Used for business-level reporting and analytics independent of technical message type codes.

attributes.description: The date and time when this message log record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: error_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable description of the error or rejection reason. Includes validation failures, parsing errors, business rule violations, or system connectivity issues. Critical for troubleshooting and resolution.

attributes.description: Severity classification of the error or issue encountered during message processing. Information=informational only, Warning=non-blocking issue, Error=processing failed but recoverable, Fatal=unrecoverable failure requiring manual intervention.

attributes.name: hie_transaction_code

attributes.references: HIE Standards, EHNAC HIE Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: is_duplicate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this message was identified as a duplicate of a previously processed message. True if duplicate detected, False otherwise. Duplicate messages may be rejected or logged depending on interface configuration.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x Message Control ID Standard, Interface Engine Duplicate Detection Policy

attributes.name: message_control_number
attributes.description: Unique message control identifier assigned by the sending system, corresponding to MSH-10 segment in HL7 v2.x messages. Used for message tracking and acknowledgment correlation.

attributes.name: message_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the message for processing queue management. STAT=immediate life-threatening, ASAP=as soon as possible, Urgent=expedited processing, Routine=normal processing. May be derived from ORC-7 or OBR-5 in HL7 v2.x order messages.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x Priority Codes, Clinical Workflow Standards

attributes.name: message_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned by the interface engine for message ordering and gap detection. Used to identify missing messages in a sequence and ensure proper message ordering for dependent transactions.

attributes.name: message_standard
attributes.description: The interoperability standard protocol used for the message transmission (HL7v2 for traditional interface messages, FHIR for modern RESTful API exchanges, CDA for clinical document architecture, X12 for claims and eligibility, NCPDP for pharmacy transactions, DICOM for imaging).
attributes.references: HL7 International Standards, ANSI X12, NCPDP SCRIPT, DICOM Standard

attributes.name: message_timestamp
