attributes.name: document_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the CDA document type (e.g., Continuity of Care Document (CCD), Consolidated CDA (C-CDA), Quality Reporting Document Architecture (QRDA) Category I, QRDA Category III, Referral Note, Discharge Summary, Progress Note, Operative Note).
attributes.references: HL7 CDA Release 2, HL7 C-CDA Implementation Guide

attributes.name: document_unique_identifier
attributes.description: Globally unique identifier for the CDA document, typically an Object Identifier (OID) conforming to ISO/IEC 8824 standard. This is the CDA document's id element value.

attributes.name: document_version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this CDA document within its document set. Increments with each amendment or update.

attributes.name: exchange_direction
attributes.description: Direction of document exchange relative to the organization: inbound (received from external source) or outbound (sent to external recipient).

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CDA document exchange complies with HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the primary language of the CDA document content (e.g., en, es, fr).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CDA document record was last modified in the interoperability system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the CDA document exchange, validation issues, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: patient_mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number of the patient who is the subject of this CDA document. Links to the patient master index.
attributes.references: HL7 CDA Release 2, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: purpose_of_use_code
attributes.description: HL7 PurposeOfUse code indicating the reason for document exchange (e.g., TREATMENT, PAYMENT, OPERATIONS, RESEARCH).
attributes.references: HL7 CDA Release 2, HL7 PurposeOfUse Vocabulary

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CDA document was received by the destination system for inbound exchanges.

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the clinical service period documented in this CDA document.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the clinical service period documented in this CDA document.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system or Electronic Health Record (EHR) that generated or transmitted this CDA document (e.g., EPIC, CERNER, MEDITECH).

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the source system or EHR that generated this CDA document.

attributes.name: storage_location_uri
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier or file path indicating where the CDA document XML file is stored in the document repository or object storage system.

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CDA document was transmitted through the interface engine or HIE.

attributes.name: validation_error_count
attributes.description: Number of validation errors identified during CDA schema and implementation guide validation.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of CDA schema and implementation guide validation performed on the document.
attributes.references: HL7 CDA Release 2, HL7 C-CDA Implementation Guide

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when CDA document validation was performed.

attributes.name: validation_warning_count
attributes.description: Number of validation warnings identified during CDA document validation.

attributes.name: superseded_cda_document_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cda_document (superseded_cda_document_id)

products.name: cda_validation_result
products.description: Transactional record of CDA document conformance validation results produced by schematron validators and C-CDA validators. Captures validation timestamp, document reference, validator tool used, conformance profile tested (C-CDA 2.1, QRDA I, etc.), total errors, total warnings, total informational findings, overall pass/fail status, and structured finding details. Supports document quality assurance, trading partner onboarding, and regulatory submission readiness.
products.reference: C-CDA Validator / ONC Certification Testing

attributes.name: cda_validation_result_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Document Architecture (CDA) Validation Result Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CDA validation result record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cda_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the CDA document that was validated. References the source document in the document repository.

attributes.name: trading_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the trading partner or external organization that submitted or will receive the validated document.

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical encounter associated with the CDA document being validated.

attributes.name: certification_requirement_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the validation results demonstrate that certification requirements (e.g., ONC Health IT Certification) are met.

attributes.name: conformance_profile
attributes.description: The CDA conformance profile or implementation guide tested during validation (e.g., C-CDA 2.1, QRDA Category I, QRDA Category III).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_error_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of critical error codes that must be resolved before document can be accepted.

attributes.name: destination_system
attributes.description: Name of the destination system or Health Information Exchange (HIE) that will receive the validated document.

attributes.name: document_author_npi
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of Document Author
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the clinician or provider who authored the CDA document.

attributes.name: document_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the CDA document in kilobytes. Used for performance analysis and capacity planning.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of CDA document validated (e.g., Continuity of Care Document, Discharge Summary, Progress Note). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuity_of_care|discharge_summary|progress_note|consultation_note|operative_note|history_and_physical|referral_note — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: finding_details
attributes.description: Structured or semi-structured text containing detailed validation findings including error codes, line numbers, XPath locations, and remediation guidance.

attributes.name: hie_network_name
attributes.description: Name of the Health Information Exchange network through which the document will be exchanged.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation result record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the validation results, remediation actions, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: patient_mrn
attributes.description: Medical Record Number of the patient whose clinical information is contained in the validated CDA document.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory submission this validation supports (e.g., Meaningful Use, MIPS, HEDIS, CMS Quality Reporting).

attributes.name: remediation_assigned_to
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or team assigned to remediate validation errors.

attributes.name: remediation_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when document remediation was completed and the document was re-validated successfully.

attributes.name: remediation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether document remediation is required before the document can be accepted or submitted.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the document has been re-validated after remediation attempts.

attributes.name: schema_validation_passed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extensible Markup Language (XML) Schema Validation Passed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document passed XML schema validation against the CDA schema definition.

attributes.name: schematron_validation_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document passed Schematron rule-based validation for conformance profile requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or Electronic Health Record (EHR) that generated the CDA document.

attributes.name: structural_validation_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document passed structural validation for required sections, entries, and document hierarchy.

attributes.name: submission_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is ready for regulatory submission or external exchange based on validation results.

attributes.name: total_error_count
attributes.description: Total number of errors identified during validation. Errors represent critical conformance failures that prevent document acceptance.

attributes.name: total_informational_count
attributes.description: Total number of informational findings identified during validation. Informational findings provide guidance for document quality improvement.

attributes.name: total_warning_count
attributes.description: Total number of warnings identified during validation. Warnings represent non-critical issues that should be reviewed but do not prevent document acceptance.

attributes.name: validation_execution_time_ms
attributes.description: Time taken to complete the validation process measured in milliseconds. Used for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: validation_initiated_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that initiated the validation.

attributes.name: validation_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for performing the validation (e.g., trading partner onboarding, regulatory submission readiness, quality assurance).

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail status of the validation. Indicates whether the document meets conformance requirements.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CDA document validation was performed. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: validator_tool_name
attributes.description: Name of the validation tool or engine used to perform the conformance check (e.g., NIST CDA Validator, Schematron Validator, C-CDA Validator).

attributes.name: validator_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number of the validation tool used to ensure traceability of validation logic.

attributes.name: vocabulary_validation_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document passed vocabulary validation for coded elements (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10).

attributes.name: revalidated_cda_validation_result_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cda_validation_result (revalidated_cda_validation_result_id)

products.name: patient_identity_match
products.description: Transactional record of patient identity matching events performed during cross-organizational data exchange, including MPI (Master Patient Index) lookups, EMPI matching, and IHE PIX/PDQ transactions. Captures match request timestamp, source system, match algorithm used, candidate patient identifiers submitted, match score, match result (match/possible match/no match), matched MPI record reference, and manual review flag. Critical for preventing patient data mismatches during HIE queries and care transitions.
products.reference: IHE PIX/PDQ / EMPI / HL7 ADT^A40

attributes.name: patient_identity_match_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patient identity matching event. Primary key for this transactional record.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the healthcare facility or organization from which the match request originated.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the clinician or staff member who initiated the match request from the source system.

attributes.name: hie_organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.hie_organization. Business justification: Patient identity matching events occur when querying HIE networks. Link to hie_organization provides organizational context for match requests, enables tracking match accuracy by HIE network, and supp

attributes.name: matched_empi_mpi_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Matched Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) ID
attributes.description: The Enterprise Master Patient Index identifier from the EMPI system that was matched. May differ from local MPI ID in multi-system environments.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: The enterprise Master Patient Index identifier that was matched to the submitted patient identifiers. Represents the golden record in the MPI.

attributes.name: candidate_count
attributes.description: Number of candidate patient records identified during the matching process before final match determination.

attributes.name: consent_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether patient consent restrictions were overridden for this match request due to emergency or break-the-glass access (True=override applied, False=normal consent rules applied).

attributes.name: consent_override_reason
attributes.description: Reason documented for overriding patient consent restrictions during the match request (e.g., emergency treatment, break-the-glass).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this patient identity match record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: duplicate_record_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the match process identified a potential duplicate patient record that should be investigated for merging (True=duplicate detected, False=no duplicate).
attributes.references: AHIMA Best Practices for Patient Identity Management

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Error code returned if the match process encountered an error or exception. Empty if match completed successfully.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message describing any errors encountered during the match process.

attributes.name: hie_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the Health Information Exchange network, used to correlate this match event with HIE query logs.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this patient identity match record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: manual_review_assigned_to
attributes.description: User ID or name of the HIM staff member assigned to manually review this match result.

attributes.name: manual_review_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when manual review of the match result was completed.

attributes.name: manual_review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the reviewer documenting the rationale for the manual review decision.

attributes.name: manual_review_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the manual review process (CONFIRMED=match confirmed, REJECTED=match rejected, MERGED=records merged, NEW_RECORD_CREATED=new MPI record created).

attributes.name: manual_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the match result requires manual review by HIM staff due to ambiguous or low-confidence matching (True=manual review required, False=automated match accepted).
attributes.references: AHIMA Best Practices for Patient Identity Management

attributes.name: match_algorithm_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific matching algorithm or rule set used to perform the patient identity match (e.g., deterministic, probabilistic, hybrid).

attributes.name: match_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version number of the matching algorithm used, enabling traceability and audit of algorithm changes over time.

attributes.name: match_confidence_level
attributes.description: Categorical confidence level of the match result based on match score thresholds (HIGH=score above high threshold, MEDIUM=score in middle range, LOW=score below medium threshold).

attributes.name: match_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the patient identity match (DETERMINISTIC=exact match on key identifiers, PROBABILISTIC=statistical matching, HYBRID=combination, MANUAL=human review).

attributes.name: match_processing_time_ms
attributes.description: Time taken to process the identity match request, measured in milliseconds. Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: match_request_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the patient identity match request was initiated during cross-organizational data exchange. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: match_result_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the patient identity matching process (MATCH=definitive match found, POSSIBLE_MATCH=potential match requiring review, NO_MATCH=no match found, MULTIPLE_MATCH=multiple candidates found, ERROR=matching process failed).

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the confidence level of the patient identity match, typically expressed as a percentage or weighted score. Higher scores indicate stronger matches.

attributes.name: matched_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth from the matched MPI record, used to validate the match quality.

attributes.name: matched_patient_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the patient from the matched MPI record, returned as part of the match result.

attributes.name: matched_patient_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the patient from the matched MPI record, returned as part of the match result.

attributes.name: requesting_user_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the healthcare provider who initiated the match request, if applicable.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or application that initiated the patient identity match request.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application that initiated the match request (e.g., Epic EHR, Cerner Millennium, HIE portal).

attributes.name: submitted_address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the patient address submitted in the match request.

attributes.name: submitted_city
attributes.description: City of the patient address submitted in the match request.

attributes.name: submitted_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the patient submitted in the match request, used as a key demographic matching attribute.

attributes.name: submitted_gender
attributes.description: Gender of the patient submitted in the match request (M=Male, F=Female, U=Unknown, O=Other).

attributes.name: submitted_mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number submitted as part of the match request from the source system. May be facility-specific.

attributes.name: submitted_patient_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the patient submitted in the match request for identity matching purposes.

attributes.name: submitted_patient_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the patient submitted in the match request for identity matching purposes.

attributes.name: submitted_phone_number
attributes.description: Phone number of the patient submitted in the match request.

attributes.name: submitted_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code of the patient address submitted in the match request.

attributes.name: submitted_ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number submitted in the match request, if available. Used as a strong identifier for matching.

attributes.name: submitted_state
attributes.description: State or province of the patient address submitted in the match request.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of interoperability transaction that triggered the identity match (PIX Query, PDQ Query, MPI Lookup, EMPI Match, FHIR Patient Match, HL7 ADT).

attributes.name: superseded_patient_identity_match_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on patient_identity_match (superseded_patient_identity_match_id)

products.name: direct_message
products.description: Transactional record of every Direct Secure Messaging transaction exchanged via the Direct Protocol (DirectTrust). Captures message ID, sender Direct address, recipient Direct address, message type (referral, care summary, lab result, discharge notification), send timestamp, delivery status (sent/delivered/failed/bounced), message size, encryption status, certificate validation result, and associated clinical document reference. Supports care coordination, referral workflows, and Meaningful Use/Promoting Interoperability attestation.
products.reference: DirectTrust / Direct Secure Messaging / ONC Direct Protocol

attributes.name: direct_message_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Direct Secure Messaging transaction. Primary key for the direct_message product.

attributes.name: interface_engine_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the interface engine or Direct messaging gateway that processed and transmitted the message. Links to the interface_engine product for system tracking.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.mpi_record. Business justification: Direct Secure Messaging transmits patient PHI (referrals, care summaries, lab results). Audit trails and breach investigations require authoritative patient linkage. Meaningful Use attestation require

attributes.name: sender_direct_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interoperability.direct_address. Business justification: Direct messages are sent FROM managed Direct addresses. Currently sender_direct_address is a STRING column. Adding sender_direct_address_id FK links the message to the managed address record in direct

attributes.name: trading_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the trading partner (external organization) involved in the Direct message exchange. Links to the trading_partner product for relationship management.

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical encounter associated with the Direct message content, linking the message to a specific episode of care.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_code
attributes.description: SMTP or application-level acknowledgment code returned by the recipient system confirming message receipt and processing status.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of file attachments included with the Direct message (e.g., CDA documents, PDF reports, DICOM images). Zero indicates message body only.

attributes.name: attachment_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of MIME types for all attachments included in the Direct message (e.g., application/xml, application/pdf, image/jpeg).

attributes.name: certificate_validation_result
attributes.description: Result of the digital certificate validation process for both sender and recipient certificates, ensuring trust and authenticity of the Direct message exchange.

attributes.name: clinical_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or pointer to the associated clinical document (CDA, FHIR document, or other format) that was transmitted within or attached to the Direct message.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Direct message record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation time, distinct from the send_timestamp.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the Direct message indicating whether it was successfully delivered, failed, bounced, or is pending delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the Direct message was successfully delivered to the recipient system, or when a delivery failure was confirmed. Null if delivery is still pending.

attributes.name: encryption_algorithm
attributes.description: The cryptographic algorithm used to encrypt the Direct message (e.g., AES-256, 3DES). Supports security audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: encryption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Direct message was successfully encrypted using S/MIME encryption standards as required by the Direct Protocol for Protected Health Information (PHI) transmission.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for message delivery failure, including SMTP error codes, certificate validation errors, or recipient system unavailability. Null for successful deliveries.
attributes.references: RFC 3463 Enhanced Mail System Status Codes

attributes.name: hie_network_name
attributes.description: Name of the Health Information Exchange network or DirectTrust community through which the message was routed, if applicable. Null for direct point-to-point exchanges.

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the Direct message transmission met all HIPAA Security Rule requirements for Protected Health Information (PHI) exchange, including encryption and authentication.

attributes.name: meaningful_use_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this Direct message transaction qualifies for Meaningful Use or Promoting Interoperability attestation requirements under CMS programs.

attributes.name: message_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control identifier assigned to the Direct message by the sending system, used for tracking and correlation across systems.

attributes.name: message_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the Direct message indicating the urgency of the clinical information being exchanged. Influences routing and notification workflows.

attributes.name: message_size_bytes
attributes.description: Total size of the Direct message including all attachments and headers, measured in bytes. Used for capacity planning and transmission monitoring.

attributes.name: message_type
attributes.description: Classification of the Direct message content indicating the clinical purpose or document type being exchanged (e.g., referral, care summary, lab result, discharge notification).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Direct message record was last modified or updated in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the Direct message transaction, including manual interventions, escalations, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: patient_mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number of the patient whose clinical information is being exchanged in the Direct message. Used for patient matching and care coordination.

attributes.name: read_receipt_received
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a read receipt (Message Disposition Notification) was received from the recipient, confirming the message was opened.

attributes.name: read_receipt_requested
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sender requested a read receipt (Message Disposition Notification) to confirm the recipient opened and read the message.

attributes.name: read_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recipient opened and read the Direct message, as reported by the Message Disposition Notification. Null if no read receipt was received.

attributes.name: recipient_certificate_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the digital certificate used by the recipient to decrypt the Direct message. Used for certificate tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: recipient_direct_address
attributes.description: The Direct Protocol email address of the intended recipient (provider, organization, or system) receiving the secure message. Format follows standard email address structure with DirectTrust-accredited domain.
attributes.references: DirectTrust Applicability Statement for Secure Health Transport

attributes.name: recipient_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the receiving provider or organization. Ten-digit unique identifier assigned by CMS for HIPAA-covered entities.

attributes.name: recipient_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the healthcare organization or facility that received the Direct message. Supports care coordination tracking and organizational analytics.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the system attempted to resend the Direct message after initial delivery failure. Zero indicates successful first-attempt delivery.

attributes.name: send_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the Direct message was sent from the originating system. Represents the business event time of message transmission.

attributes.name: sender_certificate_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the digital certificate used by the sender to sign and encrypt the Direct message. Used for certificate tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: Subject line of the Direct message providing a brief description of the message content or purpose. May contain patient identifiers or clinical context.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Direct message within the internal care coordination workflow, tracking the message from initiation through final processing and archival. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|in_transit|delivered|acknowledged|processed|archived|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: replied_to_direct_message_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on direct_message (replied_to_direct_message_id)

products.name: direct_address
products.description: Master record for all Direct Secure Messaging addresses managed by or registered with the organization, including provider Direct addresses, facility Direct addresses, and patient Direct addresses. Captures Direct address (FQDN format), address type (provider/facility/patient), associated NPI or facility ID, certificate status, certificate expiration date, HISP (Health Information Service Provider) name, trust bundle membership, and activation status. SSOT for Direct address inventory.
products.reference: DirectTrust / HISP / Direct Protocol

attributes.name: direct_address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Direct Secure Messaging address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the facility associated with this Direct address when the address type is facility or organization.

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the provider associated with this Direct address when the address type is provider.

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the patient associated with this Direct address when the address type is patient.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this Direct address was activated and became operational for sending and receiving secure messages.

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the Direct address. Active addresses can send and receive messages; inactive, suspended, or revoked addresses cannot.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the Direct address by entity type. Indicates whether the address belongs to an individual provider, a facility, a patient, an organizational unit, a department, or an application endpoint.

attributes.name: administrative_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the administrative contact responsible for this Direct address. Used for notifications and operational communications.

attributes.name: administrative_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the administrative contact responsible for managing this Direct address. Used for operational coordination and issue resolution.

attributes.name: administrative_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the administrative contact responsible for this Direct address. Used for urgent operational communications.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic certificate renewal is enabled for this Direct address. True if auto-renewal is configured, False if manual renewal is required.

attributes.name: certificate_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the digital certificate for this Direct address will expire. Certificates must be renewed before this date to maintain secure messaging capability.
attributes.references: Direct Trust Certificate Policy, X.509 Standard

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the digital certificate for this Direct address was issued by the Certificate Authority.

attributes.name: certificate_issuer_dn
attributes.description: The Distinguished Name of the Certificate Authority that issued the certificate for this Direct address. Identifies the trusted CA in the PKI hierarchy.

attributes.name: certificate_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the X.509 digital certificate issued for this Direct address. Used for certificate identification and revocation checking.

attributes.name: certificate_status
attributes.description: Current status of the X.509 digital certificate associated with this Direct address. Valid certificates are required for secure message encryption and signing.
attributes.references: Direct Trust Certificate Policy, X.509 PKI Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Direct address record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this Direct address was deactivated and ceased to be operational. Null if the address is currently active.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: The name of the clinical or administrative department associated with this Direct address when the address type is department or organization.

attributes.name: direct_address
attributes.description: The fully qualified Direct address in email format (e.g., provider@direct.hospital.org). Used for secure HIPAA-compliant messaging between healthcare entities.
attributes.references: Direct Project Specification, ONC Direct Standard

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The human-readable display name associated with this Direct address, typically shown in message headers and address books (e.g., Dr. John Smith, Cardiology Department).

attributes.name: encryption_algorithm
attributes.description: The cryptographic algorithm used for encrypting messages sent to this Direct address (e.g., AES-256, 3DES). Ensures HIPAA-compliant secure transmission.
attributes.references: Direct Security and Trust Specification, NIST Cryptographic Standards

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this Direct address has been verified as HIPAA-compliant for secure transmission of Protected Health Information (PHI). True if compliant, False otherwise.

attributes.name: hisp_domain
attributes.description: The domain name of the HISP that manages this Direct address (e.g., direct.hospital.org). Used for routing and trust validation.

attributes.description: Indicates whether a positive acknowledgment (ACK) was received from the subscriber endpoint. True if ACK received; false if NACK or no response. Used to distinguish between delivery success and failure.

attributes.description: The date and time when the acknowledgment was received from the subscriber endpoint. Null if no acknowledgment received. Used to calculate delivery latency and SLA compliance.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the notification delivery. Sent indicates dispatched; delivered indicates acknowledgment received; failed indicates delivery error; retrying indicates automatic retry in progress; abandoned indicates retry limit exceeded.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the notification was transmitted using encryption (e.g., TLS, HTTPS). True if encrypted; false if transmitted in clear text. Used for security compliance auditing.

attributes.name: http_response_code
attributes.description: The HTTP status code returned by the subscriber endpoint (e.g., 200 for success, 404 for not found, 500 for server error). Null if transport protocol is not HTTP-based.

attributes.description: The maximum number of retry attempts configured for this subscription before the notification is abandoned. Defines the retry policy threshold.

attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was last updated (e.g., status change, retry attempt). Used for audit trail and tracking notification lifecycle changes.

attributes.description: The scheduled date and time for the next delivery retry attempt. Null if delivery succeeded or retry limit reached. Used by the notification engine to schedule retry jobs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, troubleshooting notes, or operational comments related to this notification. Used for documenting manual interventions or special circumstances.

attributes.description: Indicates whether an alert or notification was sent to support staff regarding this delivery event (e.g., for failures or SLA breaches). True if alert sent; false otherwise. Used for operational monitoring.

attributes.name: payload_content_type
attributes.description: The MIME type or format of the notification payload (e.g., application/fhir+json, application/hl7-v2, empty for id-only notifications). Defines how the subscriber should parse the notification body.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Subscription.channel.payload, IETF RFC 2046 MIME Types

attributes.name: payload_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the stored notification payload (e.g., object storage key, message queue ID, archive location). Enables retrieval of the full notification body for audit or replay purposes. Null if payload is not persisted.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Subscription Payload Storage

attributes.name: payload_size_bytes
attributes.description: The size of the notification payload in bytes. Used for capacity planning, bandwidth monitoring, and identifying oversized notifications that may cause delivery issues.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Subscription Payload Management

attributes.name: phi_transmitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the notification payload contained Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined by HIPAA. True if PHI was included; false if only identifiers or metadata were sent. Used for compliance auditing and security monitoring.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned to this notification, determining delivery urgency and retry behavior. STAT indicates immediate delivery required; urgent indicates expedited delivery; routine indicates standard delivery.
attributes.references: HL7 v2.x Priority Codes, HL7 FHIR R4 Request Priority

attributes.name: retry_count

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag

attributes.name: sla_target_delivery_seconds

products.name: public_health_report
products.description: Transactional record of every public health reporting submission made to state and federal public health agencies, including electronic lab reporting (ELR), immunization registry submissions (IIS), syndromic surveillance (BioSense), cancer registry reporting, and vital records reporting. Captures report type, reporting agency, submission timestamp, reporting period, message standard used (HL7v2 2.5.1, FHIR), submission status (accepted/rejected/pending), acknowledgment code, and case count. Supports Promoting Interoperability public health measures.
products.reference: ELR / IIS / BioSense / CDC PHIN / HL7 Public Health Reporting

attributes.description: Name of the state or federal public health agency receiving this report submission (e.g., State Department of Health, CDC BioSense Platform, State Immunization Registry).

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this public health report submission has been retried after initial failure. Used to track resubmission attempts and prevent infinite retry loops.

attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source clinical system that generated the data for this public health report (e.g., Epic EHR, Cerner Millennium, Laboratory Information System). Used for troubleshooting and data lineage tracking.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the public health report submission. attributes.name: transmission_method

attributes.references: CDC PHIN Transport Standards; Direct Project Specification

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `healthcare_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_adjustment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Adjustment metrics to track financial corrections and reversals"
  source: "`healthcare_ecm`.`billing`.`adjustment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "adjustment_date"
      expr: adjustment_date
      comment: "Date the adjustment was created"
    - name: "adjustment_status"
      expr: adjustment_status
      comment: "Current status of the adjustment"
    - name: "adjustment_type"
      expr: adjustment_type
      comment: "Type/category of the adjustment"
    - name: "adjustment_category"
      expr: adjustment_category
      comment: "Business category of the adjustment"
    - name: "reversal_flag"
      expr: reversal_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the adjustment was reversed"
  measures:
    - name: "total_adjustment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all adjustment amounts"
    - name: "adjustment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of adjustment records"
    - name: "reversal_adjustment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN reversal_flag THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total amount of adjustments that were reversed"
$$
metric_views.description: Adjustment metrics to track financial corrections and reversals

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `healthcare_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_charge`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Charge‑level financial metrics for utilization and revenue analysis"
  source: "`healthcare_ecm`.`billing`.`charge`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "service_date"
      expr: service_date
      comment: "Date the service was provided"
    - name: "charge_status"
      expr: charge_status
      comment: "Current status of the charge (e.g., posted, pending)"
    - name: "charge_type"
      expr: charge_type
      comment: "Classification of charge (e.g., procedure, medication)"
    - name: "charge_category"
      expr: charge_category
      comment: "Business category of the charge"
    - name: "is_billable"
      expr: is_billable
      comment: "Flag indicating if the charge is billable"
    - name: "is_voided"
      expr: is_voided
      comment: "Flag indicating if the charge was voided"
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_charge_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_charge_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of gross charge amounts for all charge records"
    - name: "total_expected_reimbursement"
      expr: SUM(CAST(expected_reimbursement_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of expected reimbursement amounts"
    - name: "total_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of services/items charged"
    - name: "average_unit_price"
      expr: AVG(CAST(unit_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average unit price across charges"
    - name: "charge_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of charge records"
    - name: "billable_charge_amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_billable THEN gross_charge_amount ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Sum of gross charges that are billable"
$$
metric_views.description: Charge‑level financial metrics for utilization and revenue analysis

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `healthcare_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_invoice`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core invoice financial KPIs used by finance leadership to monitor revenue, collections and patient liability"
  source: "`healthcare_ecm`.`billing`.`invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "invoice_date"
      expr: invoice_date
      comment: "Date the invoice was issued"
    - name: "invoice_status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current status of the invoice (e.g., posted, pending, voided)"
    - name: "invoice_type"
      expr: invoice_type
      comment: "Classification of invoice (e.g., inpatient, outpatient)"
    - name: "bill_type_code"
      expr: bill_type_code
      comment: "Bill type code indicating billing category"
    - name: "place_of_service_code"
      expr: place_of_service_code
      comment: "Code for place of service where care was delivered"
    - name: "revenue_code"
      expr: revenue_code
      comment: "Revenue code associated with the invoice"
    - name: "admission_source_code"
      expr: admission_source_code
      comment: "Source of patient admission"
    - name: "admission_type_code"
      expr: admission_type_code
      comment: "Type of admission (e.g., emergency, elective)"
  measures:
    - name: "total_charges"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_charges AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total charges for all invoices"
    - name: "total_patient_responsibility"
      expr: SUM(CAST(patient_responsibility AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of patient responsibility amounts across invoices"
    - name: "total_non_covered_charges"
      expr: SUM(CAST(non_covered_charges AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of non-covered charges across invoices"

    - name: "total_gross_pay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_gross_pay AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of gross pay for the payroll run"
    - name: "total_net_pay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_net_pay AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of net pay for the payroll run"
    - name: "total_deductions"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_deductions AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all deductions for the payroll run"
    - name: "employee_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct employees paid in the run"
$$
metric_views.description: Core payroll financial metrics per payroll run
